dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/ rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'i〈cog las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so se'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun nga/'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1 28yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa bo cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/1

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad gar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu zho//spung lha'i bod rig pa dpe sgrun khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/2

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gcug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung 1

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi ris gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nos te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las gar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las gar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dbe rnying 'chos bas phyogs ga khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla ba 6pa'i tshes 7la/

bsdi/sgrig gab55 sand/mgong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug kha' brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 200ldanas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang /de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa 4

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum rmang gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa' gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa' gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la zhib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb 1nas 4bar pod rtags rka) (kha) rtoganartong ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas 7bar pod rtags 6) (cha) (ja) ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum ste pod rtags la (ja she (ja/ (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags6) ste rgyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod na mas mchoge ldan/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags 6)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la pod rtags 6)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags lda)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags 6)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags (pa)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (pha)ste 'dul ba'i

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags 9)ste bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags (5) (mi 64ste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (dza/ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags (zhin ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma (kha)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung na sgyu ma rtong)ste le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ha cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su lañja mong tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du lañja'i yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags (2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/6

zhu dag byed skabs/ thog ma'i zhu dag dang / bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing / tshig phrad dang / lhag bcas/ rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang /tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/ mtshams la 'tshams/ mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/ med la smad/ byung la 'byung / rang rkya la rang skya/ grwa la ga klong la slong / rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/ rig gnas la gas gnas/ rigs pa la rig pa/ gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/ rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang / nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang / shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'brul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad gar ram/yig thog zhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/ lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang / mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o/ /ser ga khuganang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bas phyog sgrig khang nas/bod sa glang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15la/7

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog ces byar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ rat+na'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i ste'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags smyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi ban+de zhes ( su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'brungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sgrul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'brungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'khrol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhud chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsisadang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ gzhan yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/ chos gzhis mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu kho/ /ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'chos ba phyog sgrig khang nas//(3

dkar chaga'aphags bal bod dang bod chen rgya hor sog pos mtsho ni mchog dman bar ma mtha' dag la blang dor gyi khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa (1)dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi 'dus tshogs grwa rigs sbyin bdag dang bcas pas go bar byed pa'i yi ge dang lho rgyud dang gtsang rgyud kyi dgon khag 'ga'i bca' tshe (1)chos 'khor rgyal gyi khrims ldan 'dus sde rnams kyi khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa (7)ri khrod dga' ldan pa'i spyi khrims kyi bca' tshe shel dkar me long (11)chos grwa chen po dpal snar thang gi rab 'byams grwa skor gyi bca' tshe shel dkar me long (19)chos grwa chen po dpal rtses thang gi rab 'byams grwa skor gyi bca' tshe shel dkar me long (24)rwa sgreng dang ri bo bde chen sogs chos sde chung rigs 'gar stsal ba'i bka' yig sogs/ (30)chos 'khor rgyal gyi 'dus sde'i khrims su bca' ba sngar shing bya lo bris par bzo bcos bgyis pa chu shel dbang po/ (39)lnga pa chen po rgya nag tu zhabs sor bteg pa nas yar gangs ljongs su ma 'byor gyi bar sgar spyi sger mtha' dag gis spang blang du bya ba'i bka' yig sogs/ (47)sku 'bum byams pa gling gi bca' yig nyung ngu rnam gsal sogs/ (54)gong ra nges gsang rdo rje gling gi khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa (58)dga' ldan thub bstan rab rgyas kyi dge 'dun spyi'i khrims su bca' ba dran pa'i lcags /// (69)

li thang thub bstan byams chen phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde'i khrims su bca' ba'i skor/ (77)'ba' dga' ldan phan bde gling pa'i khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa blang dor gsal ba'i zla ba sogs/ (87)lha sa smon lam chen mo'i tshe dge 'dun rnams kyi khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa sogs/ 〈94)nyang smad bsam grub rdzong gi gso rig grwa tshang drang srong 'dus gling gi bca' yig (110)chos sde chen po zha lu'i sgrub mchod bco lnga gsar tshugs kyi bca' yig shel dkar me long sogs/ (122)sangs rgyas rgya mtsho gangs ljongs chos srid kyi bdag por bsko bzhag gi bka' lung dang ngam ring chos sde mnga' dag rgyal gsum sogs chos sde khag gi go bar byed pa'i yi ge (147)dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa tshul 'chal sa srungs 'dul ba'i lcags kyo kun gsal me long (157)snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (195)mchod brjod/ (195)gleng gzhi/ (200)mtshan don dang 'gyur phyag sogs bshad pa/ (203)dgos pa de ldan gyi bstan bcos dngos las snyan ngag gi lus kyi mtshan nyid sogs bshad pa/ (208)tshig bcad kyi skor bshad pa/ (210)tshig lhug bshad pa/ (215)spel ma bshad pa/ (217)2

le'u dang po/thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan bshad pa/ (219)sbyar ba'i yon tan bshad pa/ (220)rab dwangs kyi yon tan bshad pa/ (221)mnyam pa'i yon tan bshad pa/ (222)snyan pa'i yon tan bshad pa/ (223)shin tu gzhon pa'i yon tan bshad pa/ (229)don gsal ba'i yon tan bshad pa/ (230)rgya che ba'i yon tan bshad pa/ (231)brjid pa'i yon tan bshad pa/ (233)mdzes pa'i yon tan bshad pa/ (234)ting nge 'dzin gyi yon to bshad pa/ (236)le'u dang po'i mjug bsdu ba/ (238)le'u gnyis pa/don rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (240)rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (241)dpe rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (243)dpe rgyan las mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi skor bshad pa/ (255)gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (261)gsal byed kyi rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (269)bskor ba'i rgyan bshad pa/ (273)'gog pa'i rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (274)don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (284)ldog pa can gyi rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (287)3

srid pa can gyi rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (292)bsdus brjod kyi rgyan bshad pa/ (294)phul byung gi rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (296)rab rtog gi rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (298)rgyu'i rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (301)phra mo'i rgyan bshad pa/ (307)cha'i rgyan bshad pa/ (309)rim pa can gyi rgyan bshad pa/ (311)dga' ba'i rgyan bshad pa/ (312)nyams ldan gyi rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (313)gzi brjid kyi rgyan bshad pa/ (316)rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan bshad pa/ (317)kun phan gyi rgyan bshad pa/ (318)rgya che ba'i rgyan nga tā na da pa/ (318)bston dor gyi rgyan bshad pa/ (319)sbyar ba'i rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (321)khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (325)mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (327)'gal ba'i rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (328)skabs min bstod pa'i rgyan bshad pa/ (330)zol bstod kyi rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (331)nges bstan gyi rgyan bshad pa/ (332)lhan gcig brjod pa'i rgyan bshad pa/ (333)yongs rjes kyi rgyan bshad pa/ (334)4

shis brjod kyi rgyan bshad pa/ (335)rab spel gyi rgyan bshad pa/ (336)dgongs pa can gyi rgyan bshad pa/ (337)le'u gsum pa/sgra rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/ (338)zung ldan gyi rnam gzhag las bya sla ba rkang pa dang po na yod pa'i zung ldan gyi skor nga'i nad pa/ (340)bya dka' ba gnas g.yin la yod pa'i zung ldan gyi skor bshad pa/ (348)mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan gyi skor bshad pa/ (353)kun tu zung ldan gyi skor bshad pa/ (353)'dres pa'i zung ldan bshad pa/ (358)ldog pa'i zung ldan bshad pa/ 4359)dbyangs sogs yi ge nges pa'i bya dka' ba'i skor bshad pa/ (362)gab tshig gi rgyan skor bshad pa/ (366)skyon sel gyi rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad pa/ (375)mjug gi don/ (387)rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan nyin byed dbang po'i snang ba/ (399)mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba (399)gleng gzhi/ (400)dri ba dang po/ skar nag gtsug lag 'di nyid rig gnas lnga po gang gi khongs su gtogs min gyi dris lan/ (405)dri ba gnyis pa/ zla bshol ji ltar 'don lugs sogs kyi dris lan/ (414)5

dri ba gsum pa/ rgya lugs kyi rtsis gzhung las skor 'go'i gtso che skye rme 'dzin pa la brgyad cu skor dang drug cu skor zhes lugs gnyis las gang zhig khungs dang ldan min gyi dris lan/ (438)dri ba bzhi pa/ rgya nag 'gyur gyi skor 'go tshul bzhin shes pa las mngon mtho nges legs sogs 'thob pa'i gnas yod med kyi dri ba/ 〈449)zhar byung 'phan yul drug brgya ba'i rtsis rig smra ba nang so bstan 'dzin gyis ra sa 'phrul snang gi rtsis pa rnams la dri ba bzhi btang ba'i dris lan khag (466)dri ba dang po'i dris lan/ (466)dri ba gnyis pa'i dris lan/ (473)dri ba gsum pa'i dris lan/ (474)dri ba bzhi pa'i dris lan/ (475)yar klung bkra shis rtse'i paṇ+ḍi tar rloms pa nyi 'og mkhas par grags pa'i rtsis rig las 'phros pa'i dri ba 'ga' zhig gi dris lan go bde bar bkod pa/ (477)dge bsngo'i smon tshig dang mjug byang / (480)snyi

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wanar༅༅/ /'phags bal bod dang bod chen rgya hor sog pos mtshon mchog dman bar ma mtha' dag gi spyi bye brag legs nyes 'byed pa'i bca' yig lam yig sko 'ja' sogs bkod pa khrims gnyis gser shing phun tshogs 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs sku sto/ /dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi 'dus tshogs grwa rigs sbyin bdag dang bcas pas go bar byed pa'i yi ge dang lho rgyud dang gtsang rgyud kyi dgon khag 'ga'i bca' tshe/༄7/ /su ra swa sti ba ka shwa re na ne ma sa : smi ma bla le she ya khya ya smodabyangs can ngag gi dbang phyug gis dus thams cad la bkra shis dge legs stsol/ /bai khru rla la ra dza lha ṭa ka lwa kra ba stin so khya gu rla rmi ga na ya ni kā tsi te na/phun tshogs be+eḍūr rdul brtsegs sgyu rtsal spros/ /grangs med rta ljang ri dwags mig can gyis/ /ā le sgri tan ma dhi ya su tsa kā ya ka lu su rdo pa la sha sa na 〉〉 tsab nas ra tsā/ /mngon par 'byud pas gang sku'i cha shas la/ /'gran pa'i dper bstan nyi ma'i gnyen des skyongs/ /dpal stug bstan pa rnam rgyal khang bzang du/ /dpag dka' blo gros dbyu gu'i 'phrul gyi (2na)sgos/ /mdo rgyud bzang po'i legs bshad 'chi med rnga'i/ /grags pa srid gsum sgeg mo'i thos 'dzin rgyan/ /— 1 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)mkhyen rab bkra shis rtags kyi sgyu thabs las/ /mkhas grub gser gyi 'dab can tshogs rnams kyi/ /gsung rab lus stobs snyems pa 'phrog mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan mi yi seng ge spyi bos mchod/ /chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi 'dus tshogs grwa rigs sbyin bdag bcas pa mtha' dag gis nges rgyur/ sgo mang bka' bcu ba ngag dbang rgya mtsho dang / sngags pa dge legs phun tshogs gnyis 'os 'du mthun nang du grub pa byung ba bzhin chos khrims par bsko bzhag bgyis pa yin pas/nyi ma'i gnyen gyi ring lugs kyi snying po 'dul ba'i sde snod las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin/ shākya'i dge sbyong rnams kyis spang blang gi gnas rnams so sor ma 'dres par yang dag par bsgrub pa dang / chos khrims pas kyang rang 'dod phyogs lhung dang nye 'gyangs spangs pa'i sgo nas bca' khrims dag la 'bad rtsol lhur len bgyid pa ci nar gal che/ zhes 'phags pa'i yul du pra ma ti zhes brjod (2bcung / gangasacan gyi ljongs 'dir myos ldan du 'bod pa sa mo yos kyi lo thos ldan zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi bzang po dang po'i tshes la bris/ /phul byung byams brtse'i legs bris dpung tshogs dag gis chu srin rgyal mtshan bcud bral sde bcas rnams/ /legs bcom thabs mkhas bsod nams stobs bcu'i 'khor los lha lam bde chen ngos su rtag rgyu ba'i/ /phyogs bral 'gro ba 'chi med rnams kyi phan bde'i gnyen gyur zas gtsang sras po mig stong can/ /'dren mchog khyod kyis dus kun dge tshogs bdud rtsi'i dpal gyi dga' ston 'dod 'jo rgyas par mdzod/ /phun tshogs gnam bskos dbang phyogs rgyal po yi/ /bka' khrims bzang po'i lung gis lha'i bla mar/ /rab grags nyi ma'i gnyen gyi 'phrin las pa/ /tshangs sras ba 'ad pa'i rdo rje gang de'i gtam/ /khrims ldan 'dus gling dbyig 'dzin gyi spo las mngon par 'phags pa'i chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi slob dpon grwa rigs sbyin bdag dang bcas pa rnams la zlo ba/ chos khrims gser gyi shing rta kha lo mngon par sgyur ba'i byed por/ blo gsal gling nas dge slong don grub rgya mtsho dang /—2

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)bde yangs nas dge slong ngag dbang bsod nams gnyis 'os 'du spyi mthun du 'dug pa ltar bsko gzhag byas yod pas/ khyod gong 'khod rnams kyis ston pa bu ram shing pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa spyi dang khyad par rje btsun 'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa las legs par byung ba'i 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba mtha' dag yar ldan du 'gyur ba'i blang dor gyi gnas rnams la brtson pa lhur len du bgyid pa gal che/ zhes (3na ji bus 'gyur 'chang du bī ra zhes grags pa/ bsil ba'i ljongs 'dir dpa' bor 'bod cing / shar phyogs rgya nag gi rgyal khams su dbang thang dang bstun pa lcags 'brug hor gyi zla ba drug pa'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po'i tshes la/lon spro dwa gyi gi bas lika su nā sī rā hiḥmā tu〉shu ma ru pa ka tsakarti kyi/'jig rten dbang po rna ba brgyad pa gtsug na zla ba pad dkar mig /grags pa'i mu khyud ma gnyis pa dang sngo bsangs lus can ga rnyika /3bha bkyu1ba la ka ba hu gi re pa tan ya smokhyi shrī dwa yi su gtas ka la kā ledzosgasrid gsum 'di na dregs ldan kun gyi spyi bor bgrod byed nyer 'god pa/ /phan dang bde ba'i dpal ster rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras po dus kun rgyal/ /chos rgyal mes dbon bka' drin nor 'dzin dbus/ /mkhan chen zhi 'tsho'i so thar dpag bsam ljon/ /mtsho skyes theg mchog gang bu'i g.yur za ldem/ /byed po lo paṇa rgyal blon phyag gi yul//sa hor rigs kyi mkha' las(3ba〉snga rig pa'i/ /'od stong bka' gdams bstan pa'i pad+ma'i tshal/ /rgyas tshe 'byom ston rje sogs bh+ra ma ra:/ /theg chen glu dbyangs 'gro 'di'i phan bde'i dpyid/ /'jam mgon blo bzang mkhyen pa'i gdong drug gis/ /legs bshad 'brug sgra mngal 'dzin ma cane gyur tshe/ /shes sgro me glang gdong tshig gi mche ba kun/ /phyung ba'i grags pa srid 'di'i rna ba'i rgyan/ /phul byung bsod nams ri skyes 'khor lo yis/ /'jigs bral chos kyi gling bzhir mnga' sgyur ba/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho'i —3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)mtha' yang dog por mdzad/ /zla bral brgyud par bcas pa rgyal 'gyur cig /ces shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gi 'phreng ba sngon du btang nas/ tshe ring gnam gyi she mong la brten nas stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba dbang phyogs gong ma rgyal po'i lung gis rdo rje 'chang lha'i bla mar 'bod cing / gnam gyi bu bo don cha mur gan gyi rigs brgyud las son pa jing gir hor gyi rgyal po'i mnga' 'og yangs pa'i char/ tā la'i bla ma badz+ra dha ra zhes ming yongs su grags pa'i gtam/ sde drug gis thog drangs pa'i lho phyogs kyi rgyud du 'khod pa'i khrims ldan 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams la zlo ba/ grangs med pa'i lus can thams cad kyi phan pa dang bde ba'i dri bsung dam pa yun du gnas pa/kun mkhyen stobs bcu mnga' ba'i bstan pa dri ma med pa dpag bsam gyi ljon pa chen po la rag lus shing / de'ang 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams kyis bgyid par 'os pa'i gnas 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba yang dag par bsgrub pa la rag lus pas/ ke la sha yi ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir/ chos kyi rgyal po mes dbon rnam pa gsum dang / mkhan slob gnyis la sogs pa'i lo paṇa rnams kyi gzhal du med pa'i bka' drin las/ (4na)thub pa'i lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che dbyar dus kyi chu gter bzhin ches cher rgyas par mdzad cing / khyad par du'ang rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag la phyogs su lhung ba mi mnga' bar mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i srol mtha' dag spel bar mdzad pa la gcig tu gzhol pa'i khams gsum kyi chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po'i rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa mtha' yas pa las/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud du bstan pa rin po che'i btsas su lung grwa zhes/ thal 'gyur ba dang rang rgyud pa'i grub mtha'i gzhung lugs rnams la dngos stobs kyis rigs pa'i sgo nas legs par gtan la 'bebs pa'i srol deng sang gi bar du gnas pa'i tshogs dpon du dbus 'gyur 'chang sogs 'phags yul gyi mkhas pa kun gyi cod pan/ yongs rdzogs gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī bha dra'i chos kyi gdan khri la mngon par 'dzigs pa'i mkhan chen blo bzang dge legs rgyal mtshan par mnga' gsol yod pas/ khyod gong 'khod mtha' dag gis rjes su 'jug pa rnams kyis —4

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wanabagyid par 'os pa'i klog pa thos bsam dang spong ba bsam gtan gyi bya ba sogs blang dor gyi gnas kun la bka' gdams gsar rnying gi rnam par thar ba'i srol las mi g.yel ba'i spang blang 'dzol med nye bar 'dzin pa/ chen po'i gsung bzhin gyis zhes go bar bya ba'i yi ge khyu mchog ces pa lcags mo sprul gyi lo'i dbyangs 'char ba nyin mor byed pa glang gi khyim du zhugs pa'i phyogs snga ma'i dga' ba dang po'i tshes la chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi lugs zung mtha' dag sgo 'phar cig car 'byed pa dga' ldan pho brang nas bris/ /(4ba)a nu t+ta ra dz+nyā na ru pa pra kṛ ta bha ba sa ṣ+ṭha 'i rba la ba tsu na thi ka /bla na med pa'i ye shes rang bzhin lus/ /srid 'dir grub pa'i stobs bcu mnga' ba'i mgon/ /hri ya byu| rnyo da na rta'i sto ṣa sha ga ta dha ta nā nā byu ba sa zhi ma kha tu/ /dpal ldan zas gtsang sras kyi grags pa'i dbyangs/ /sgra 'dzin lus phra'i dpyid du rgyas gyur cig /rlung gi rgyal mtshan rab bkra'i lding khang nas/ mtshams sprin mi yi srid pa'i lang mtsho la/ rjes chags mtshan dpe'i snang ba mi zad pa'i/ /'jam mgon btsong kha pa des dge bar mdzod/ /gzugs sku'i zla snang cha shas yongs rdzogs par/ /mdzes sdug ri dwags ngo mtshar dra ba'i gar/ gser mngal mche ba'i pir gyis rab bris pa'i/ /dbyangs can tshangs pa'i sras kyi dge legs stsol/ /zhes dbyangs can bdun gyi rang bzhin mi zad pa'i 'dod pa 'jo ba'i rgyud las nye bar drangs pa'i shis pa brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas gnam (ldan〉skos sa la spyod pa'i tshangs pa mi'i gzugs can/rgya nag gong ma'i lung gis 'ding gu shrī zhes chos kyi rgyal po rgyal khams thams cad kyi 'dren par dbang bskur ba gang gi yi ge /'phags mchog rigs gsum gyi mgon po'i zlos gar bod rgyal por shar ba rnams kyi bkas ru bzhir grags pa'i g.yas ru gtsang gi char/ bskal ba bzang po 'di'i 'dren pa'i dbang phyug rgyal ba bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas —5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ma/'dzin pa'i ngam ring chos sde'i 'dus pa/ dgon phran/ sbyin bdag sne slebs dang bcas pa mtha' dag la zlo ba/ chos sde'i khri thog tu sngon gyi 'jig rten gyi mig gcig bu rnams kyi rjes su zhugs pa/ thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i rab 'byams smra ba lo tsā ba tshe brtan rgyal mtshan/ bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po mchod yon nas bsko bzhag mdzad song ba/ khyod gong 'khod rnams kyis/ klog pa thos bsam dang spong ba bsam gtan sogs rab tu byung bas bgyid par 'os pa'i gnas thams cad dang khyad par rab 'byams kyi grwa skor/ bstan pa rin po che'i mig rkyen du gang 'gyur dgos pa/ /gang sar mkhan pos ji ltar mnos pa las mi g.yo ba byed dgos/ zhes 'phags yul ba bhu pā lar 'bod pa/ phyogs 'dir sa skyong du grags shing / rgya nag pa yi yi'ur brjod pa/ ljongs 'di'i skad du shing mo bya lo/ /hor gyi zla ba drug pa'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba dang po/ /dus 'khor ba ya ṇa'i dbyangs la dang gsal byed ṭaṃ 'char zhing / khams/ sa/ snying stobs kyi mun pa 'jug pa'i chung ngu'i bu mo dang dbyangs ra ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba dang po/ /ā dang ka /khams sa dang 'dod yon dri'i char che dga' ldan phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang nas bris/ /(5ba)me ya dz+nyā sa ཿ a k+ṣa ya tha la sto ma ta kaḥ su spun ma hā/ /shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i bdud rtsi la/ /spyod pa'i mi zad 'bras bu bde ba che/ /da ba la ku bu nga yi taḥ sa de be khri ku ba rā ṇa de hā/ /stobs bcu'i 'chi ba med pa'i 'dun sa ste/ /bu ram shing pa mig stong can gyi yul/ /shwa tsho pa shā lha da ye ra mo dha smo ཿ a khya : ma dha ka ra yi/mtshar du dngar ba'i pad+ma'i snying po'i bcud/ /grangs med chos phung sbrang rtsi'i za ma tog /gha : pra pra sti rnya sa khri ya dzad taḥ sho rnyo da na she ya ku ru ka ruḥ ka ra hā/ /'gro 'di'i phan bde'i dpyid du rab rgyas pa'i/ /byed po zas gtsang sras kyis dge legs mdzod/ /—6

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (5)chos 'khor rgyal gyi khrims ldan 'dus sde rnams kyi khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa bzhugs so/ /yi ma la / la ba ku la ba k+ta : sho ཿ ka ma tu u ṇa na / /dri med tshul khrims ba kū la yi kha/ /tshangs spyod mdzes ma'i chang gis legs phye ba'i/ /sto ṭi tha dzi shu sa ra tha lha ra ༷ dzi pu da sgo sa ba sha ba ra k+ṣi ta/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'di'i thub bstan shing rta pa/ /kun mkhyen zhi 'tsho'i zhabs zung gtsug na rgyal/ /de yi rigs las sdom gsum lus stobs rgyas/ /mang thos rin chen gser gyi rgyan 'chang zhing //myang 'das 'gugs byed byang chub sems kyi sna/ /ring por rkyong mdzad di paṃ ka rar 'dud/ /ring mo i nas grub pa'i yon tan ma la ya yi dri bsung gis/ /rmongs pa'i blo ngan 'thibs po kun 'joms shes rab ches cher rab tu gsal/ /mdzad bzang lo 'dab stug po'i khur ldan grags snyan srid 'di'i rna bar mdzes/ /dus gsum rgyal ba btsong kha pa zhes kun gyi ral pa'i bla na mtho/ /dge legs gser mngal can gyi thod yangs las/ /rnam dpyod gaṅgā'i chu klung rtag 'bab pa/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la 'dun pa'i bgrod pa yis/ /legs bshad rgya mtshor 'jug la rings par brel/ /mtha' (6ba)bral chos tshul mes po'i thod yangs las/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i nyal 'gro yis/ /rgyal bstan 'jug pa bcu pa'i 'khas bsil du/ /rnam par sbreng ba'i khrims ldan bos pa'i ste/ /'jug dang 'jug bya ma yin phra rags kyi/ /blang dang dor bya nyams su bstar ba'i tshul/ /gsal byed yi ge'i 'phreng bar spel byed na/ /kun gyi sgra 'dzin lus phra'i 'gram par chongs/ /de'ang bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la grags can gyi rnam 'dren stong byon pa rnams kyi nang nas/ /snying stobs kyi go cha btsan po ma smad par gyon pa'i rgyal ba zas gtsang gi sras po'i bstan pa ni/ /ji ltar rdzing bu brgya phrag la zla ba'i gzugs brnyan so sor 'char ba bzhin —7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)'dul bya'i las dang bskal ba'i dbang gis mtha' klas na'ang / /yongs su grags par bod gangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir chos kyi rgyal po mes dbon dang mkhan slob sogs paṇa grub rim par byon pa rnams kyi bka' drin las/ bstan pa rin po che snga phyir dar zhing / de dag gi yang snying chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po'i dri ma med pa'i ring lugs la phyi'i kun spyod bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa nyid gtso bor mdzad pa'i phyag len mchis pa ltar/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dbyangs can bzhed pa'i rdo rjes/ rje bla ma'i 'phrin las spel ba'i ched du/ dus gsum mkhyen pa pad+ma ka ra dang /glegs bam rin po che sogs nas lung gis zin pa'i sprul pa'i gnas chen sbas yul dkar mo ljongs su rten dang brten par bcas pa'i sde chen por gnas pa'i 'tshangs par spyod pa po rnams kyis lag tu blang bar bya ba 'di ltar ro/ /de'ang yul phyogs g.yin du rab tu byung ba'i sdom pa nos zin pa min pa rnams 'dir bzhugs nas zla ba gcig las mi 'gyang par bar ma rab byung yan ji ltar 'os pa sgrub dgos shing / /de ga'i dge rgan ngo shes sogs khur 'khris kyis rting skul dang / zla gcig rdzogs par nye tshe legs bshad gling gi chos khrims sogs(kyis rgyu mtshan bskul ma byed/ /bskul ma byas nas kyang zla dus las 'das tshe/ gtsug lag khang du snyan dar dkar me/ slob dpon par snol po gsum tshan (7na〉snol mo bsnel tshan thob pa rnams la dar kha re/ tshogs su brgya phyag 'tshal/ rab 'byung gi nyer spyad rdul gzan sham thabs gding ba lhung bzed sogs zla khongs su ma 'grig pa rnams kyis kyang g.yar po tshun gyis dge 'dun spyi mtshungs byed dgos shing rang rang gis blangs pa'i sdom pa'i ngo skal gyi spang bya phra rags kun blos 'chun pa rnams kyis bslab bya'i yi ge rnams la zhib tu blta nyid / blo dman rnams kyis kyang gnas kyi slob dpon bstan pa dang rang las bslab pa rgan pa'i rab byung rnams kyis ji ltar bslab pa'i tshul la dper 'dzin/ dge 'dun du longs pa la chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed lta bu'i rnyed pa spyi la byung na yo byad de dag med cing bsgrub pa'i longs spyod dang ldan mi ldan brtags nas dge skos kyis ster/—8

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wanadage 'dun rnams kun dga' ra bar 'du ba'i brda gaṇ+ḍi sogs dang bstun te gzhan mi dad pa'i spyod lam spangs te/ dge slong rnams bla gos dang / de phyin chad kyang zhwa/ zla gam gding ba sogs 'chang dgos shing / tshogs su long gtam smra ba/ gnyid log pa mchil snabs gos kyis ma bkab par 'dor ba/bza' btung gi tshe cag hub kyi sgra 'byin pa/ lhung bzed rtsi med dang / ja phor spyi dang mi mthun pa sogs mi byed/ tshar dus mchod 'gyed sogs sbyin bdag dang sne mo bas 'os mi 'os bltas nas gtong ba las dgos med kyi rtsad pa mi gtong / rgyal gnyer pa'i zla bo dang g.yog nang gzan gyi rigs dgon par rgyun sdod yin na ma gtogs 'ol dwags sogs gzhis yas mas la sdod mi la mi gtong / rgyun stod byed mi yin kyang phyogs la song na skal ba mi gtong / tshogs skal len par dngos su yong ba rnams kyis rab byung gi rtags ma tshang ba dang phu thung gyon pa sogs mi byed/ sgrub mchod dus gtor sogs kyi nang mchod dang / gtsug lag khang sogs kyi zhig gsos ar po'i skabs lta bu'i dmigs bsal ma gtogs/dgon pa'i nang du chang gi 'grim 'grul mi byed cing / gnas mjal ba dang dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur du 'ongs pa'i bud med la zhag sdod kyi gnang ba mi ster zhing / de las g.yin pa'i bud med dgon pa'i nang du mi gtong / (7ba)dgon pa'i nang du 'thab rtsod kyi gri bton tshe/ tshogs che chung dang bstun pa'i mang ja/ thug dar lcog /gtsug lag khang du dkar me/ rje btsun byams pa la snyan dar/ dung dar/ bla ma la sum tshan/ sne slo ba rnams la rnam gzhag byed/ des mtsho ni te rtsa ba bzhi dang 'gal ba'i gnas nas dbyung gi 'os rnams la chad las gong ltar dang / dmigs bsal ma rtsa stongs pa'i log dgos rnams kyang chad pa gong gi steng du tsha ra gtong / tshogs 'grim rab byung gis ar jag rdung 'phrog byas na chad pa gong ltar ram gnas dbyung gang 'os bla ma dge skos sogs kyis byed/ gling khrod du dgos med kyi ku co skad rgyang 'bod pa/ rgyu mtshan med par rta zhen pa/ gos sku 'grem pa sogs la rtsed mo'i dbang du btang nas 'then skor chud zos byed pa/ rab byung tsho gos 'grim yin bzhin du/ khams ma snyoms pa dang dgos pa dmigs bsal med par 'bog tho dang phu thung gon pa/ gzan sham med par 'gro ba sogs —9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)dge 'dun spyi'i mig ltos bshas pa byas na gtsug lag khang du dkar me snyan dar 'bul/ tho btsun dang dad btsun su yin yang dgon par thog mar bsdad pa nas bzung / zla ba drug thog la skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste chos spyod tshogs 'don gyi rgyugs dang / de nas rim gyis gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi mngon dkyil bskang gso sogs gang 'tsham bltas pa'i rgyugs len byed/ tshogs 'don la skyabs 'gro sems skyed/ ltung bshags gnas bcu phyag mchod/ gzhung che ba gnyis/ ja dang po song nas sa gsum ma/ lam gnyis/ mkhan brgyud kyi gsol 'debs sogs dang / sbyin bdag gi rim gro'i mdo sgrub tshe gzungs sogs skabs dang sbyor/ gong gi sgrigs 'gal dang chad las gnas dbyung sogs byed dgos la/ gzhan gyis ngan rgyab byas pa byung na cig shos kyi nyes chad gang 'thob de ga khur dgos shing / ngos mi len tshe tshogs pa'i dbus su dag 'don byed/ bla ma chos khrims sogs sne mo bas nye 'gyang spangs pa'i ngos nas sgrigs mnan pa la/ 'phral du rgyab gnyer gang dgos gnyer pas byed dgos shing / mdor na bstan srung chos skyong rnams kyis g.yel ba med par legs (8na gis so sor 'byed par mdzod cig ces chos 'khor rgyal gyi khrims ldan 'dus sde rnams kyi khrims su bca' ba lag tu blang ba 'di'ang / sa skyong zhes pa shing bya chu shel gyi dbang po ston gyi nya ba'i phyogs snga ma'i dga' ba dang po'i tshes la dga' ldan phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang nas bris/ /— 10

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)ri khrod dga' ldan pa'i spyi khrims kyi bca' tshe shel dkar me long /ya dza ya tri ga bha khyu na ba da ha sko ra ṇ+ḍi sgyu ra/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang gsum nor/ /mkhyen pa'i za ma tog 'chang ba'i /bha da dhi ya ga su sto ṣa da sha di spu mā ya na mya/blo gros bzang po'i grags pa'i dbyangs/ /phyogs bcur g.yo ba de la 'dud/ /bsod nams ye shes chu gter chen po rlabs chen spyod pa'i sa 'dzin dbang pos bsrubs pa las/ /bla na med pa'i ye shes nyin byed bzang po'i bskal pa dbang phyogs gyen 'phyur rtse ru son pas srid 'dir rmongs pa'i mun pa ma lus drung nas rab 'byin phan bde'i pad tshal yongs 'phel zhing / mngon mtho nges legs sbrang rtsi sbyin mkhas zas gtsang sras po snyan pa'i grags 'bar gang de rgyal/ /mtha' gnyis yongs bral yang dag lta ba klu dbang gtsug gi nor bu mchog /(8ba)srid sgrub mda' ltar drang por bstan pas bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba gcod/ /'phags chen rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod tshul thogs pa med par gdul bya la/ /bshad las yang dag lam la bkri mkhas shing rta chen po rjes gong rgyal/ /zhi ba myang 'das ston pa'i gsung rab sdosnod gsum gyi mchog gyur pa/ /bstan dang pa ston gnyis ka kun 'dus 'dul ba'i gzhud lugs thub bstan srog /'tsho mdzad mkhan chen snyan pa'i grags pa gdugasadakar nor bu'i yu ba can/ /srid rtse'i bar du lan brgyar 'khor bas rgyal bstan lus phra 'dzum gyis bsu//legs byas gzugs brnyan stong phrag 'char ba'i rgyal ba'i chos tshul ā dar+sha/ /log rtog ra ri'i dri mas sbags pa kun/ legs par bsal ba'i byed po mchog a ti sha zhes gnas lnga rig pa kun gyi gtsug gyur ring lugs gang / /'dzin mkhas 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po brgyud par bcas pa'i bka' gdams rgyal/ /dbang brtul tshogs pa'i gtam gyi sbyor bas rang dang ris mthun dga' skyed par/ /— 1/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)mtshar du 'dzin pa'i spyod chu la ring dor 'chad brtsod rtsom pa'i sra ba'i gzhu/ /'gugs mkhas rin bzang rngog lo sa paṇa shong dpang bu dang stag tshang pa/ /chos skyong bzang sogs grags pa don ldan mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams phyag gi yul/ bu ram shing pa'i dri med ring lugs lung rtogs khur gyis rab lci ba/ /sngon rabs rgan po'i log rtog gtam gyi rgya mtshor byings la mngon phyogs tshe/ /shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i rnam dpyod rus sbal khur gyis 'degs mdzad pa/ /mkhas grub 'chi med yongs kyi khyu mchog blo bzang grags pa pad dkar mig /stobs bcu'i lang tsho bde ba'i mtho ris bdag po'i lding khang nas/ /ma smad gzhan phan snying stobs dbang po'i gzhu yi them skas las/ /bde bar babs pa'i 'jam mgon mi yi srid pa'i gar mkhan can/ /ngag gi rgyal po grub pa'i dbang phyug kun mkhyen btsong kha pa/ sdosnod kun 'chad de don sgrub pa'i tshul/ /tshul bzhin rnam par dpyod pa'i blo gros mchog /mchog tu rgyas kha pa' bskal bzang stsol mdzad pa/ /pa sangs lta bur dkar ba'i grags/pa gsal/ /'grig 'grig mkhas pas bshad tshe go (9na)sla yang / /mang mang tshig gis blun po mgo bo 'khor/ /snyan snyan mkhas grub 'dod kyang skye bo kun/ /yang yang thos bsam sgom la skyid pa bskyur/ /tshig gi 'khar ba med na na tshod dag /mthon por lon kyang don med med mthar grol/ /dal 'byor snying po 'dod na tshe stod la/ /mang du thos pa'i rna lung lung bzhin long / /mtha' med shes bya lus phra khengs can ma/ /ji tsam rtogs kyang tshad du gzhal dka' ba/ /blo gros zur mig gcig gis 'gugs nus pa'i/ /'jam dpal snying po'i ring lugs 'di rmad byung / /dri ba thon bser bus bskyod tshe ma la ya'i/ /rkang 'thung las 'ongs tshang du dngar ba'i dri/ /'dod ldan skye bar bde ba ster ba la/ /ngal ba med par rang gi ngang tshul yin/ /pas nyon thags su byas pa'i za 'og gos/ /'phral rkyen mdangs kyis bsgyur ba'i sna tshogs mdog /ji tsam longs su spyad kyang mi 'dzad pa/ /slu med rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rang bzhin mtshar/ /thos bsam bsgom par bgyas pa' sa bon las/ /kun mkhyen ye shes dbyar skyes myu gu yis/ /don gnyis 'bras bu ster ba'i thabs tshul gyi/ /lag tā blang bde'i deb ther 'di na'o/ /zhes snyan tshig gis shis pa brjod — /2

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)pas sdun bsus te/ skabs su gleng bar 'os pa gtam du bya ba ni/ 'o skol gyi rnam 'dren dam pa/ snyigasam lnga ches cher bdo ba'i tshe/ snying stobs chen po'i go cha ma smad par gyon pa'i rgyal po zas gtsang gi sras po zhes pad dkar lta bur bsngags pa'i yul du gyur ba 'di nyid kyi bstan pa rin po che'i lus can yongs kyi phan dang bde ba'i rtsa lag yin la/ /de'ang mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyis/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mang du thos par bya ba lung gi bstan pa dang / de don tshul bzhin nyams su bstar ba rtogs pa'i bstan pa gnyis (9ba)las/ yang dag pa'i lam rgyud la skye ba la thog mar de ston byed kyi lung sdosnod gtsug lag gi yon tan la dpyad pa gsum gyis dag pa'i rigs pas nges pa 'dren nus pa zhig dgos pas/mdo sde rgyan las/ 'di na dang por thos la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'byung / tshul bzhin yid la byed las yang dag don yul ye shes 'byung / che'o/pa ltar/ go rim ma 'khrul ba zhig gtso bor gda' bas/ grub rdze 'dir sdod mi rnams kyang / thog mar gsung rab la sbyangs shing don cung zad blo nges pa zhig med du mi rung ba'i phyir thos bsam gang yang ma myong ba'i sgom par rlom pa 'ga' bug sgo 'dam sbyar byas kyang 'phyi ba dang khyad med cing / spyir sngon gyi mkhas grub mang po dang / khyad par khamasagasum chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba btsong kha pa'i lugs 'di la/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis/ rgyu tshogs pa las 'bras skye ba/ /rjes su dpog pa gang yin pa/ /zhes pa ltar/ rgyu tshang ba las 'bras bu skye dgos pas/ gcig shes kun grol dang dkar po tshig thub sogs ma spungs par shes par 'dod pa'i lugs ngan rgya gar mkhas pa la ma grags pa'i blun bcos byed srol med pas/ mdo sngags gang gi skol ma nyams su len pa la/ de ston par byed pa'i rjod byed kyi tshig nges par bsgrubs pa zhig dgos la/de tsam gyis kyang chog pa ma yin te thos pa'i tshoms las/ gal te thos pa mang gyur kyang / /tshul khrimasalegs par mi sdom na/ /de ni tshul khrims phyir smad cing / /de yi thos pa phun tshogs min/ /zhes dang /lung rnam 'byed las gdul bya ma thul pa yi sra ba 'di yin zhes pa ltar/ yon tan thams cad kyi rten — /3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)gzhi lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che yin cing / khyad par rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs 'di la rab tu byung ba'i bslab pa la (10na skon tan snying por byed pa'i srol mchis pas jo bo chen pos/ so sor thar pa rigs bdun no/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bshad pa la/ tshangs spyod dpal ni mchog yin te/ /dge slong sdom pa dag tu bzhed/ /ces pa ltar/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa/tha ma'ang dge 'dun gyi sde yin pas/ dge tshul cho ga tshul ldan gyi sgo nas blangs pa/ rtsa bzhi chang lnga'i mthong thos rdugs gsum med pa/ sde g.yin nas gnas dbyung sogs ras ma phog pa gal che bas gsar 'jug skabs phyi khag nang khag dang bcas pa'i gan rgya gzims spyil bas len/ de'i steng nas tshe 'di 'byid thabs tsam ma yin par/ dal ba'i rten gyi snying po len 'dod yod pa/ de'ang skyes bu chung 'bring cam gyi lugs su ma song ba zhig dgos pas/ slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mis/ bde gshegs lam brten 'gro ba 'dren par chas gyur cing / /sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa/ /lam de lha dang klu yis rnyed min lha min dang / /mkha' lding rig 'dzin mi'am ci dang lto 'phyes min/ /zhes pa ltar snying po len lugs kyang rang gcig po zhi bde don du mi gnyer bar/ ris med kyi 'gro ba sgrol ba'i khur 'khyer pa'i theg pa chen po'i rigs sad pa zhig sgrub gral du 'jug bya yin la/ de lta bu'ang sgrub grwar bsdad nas rang mnyams kyi nyams len gang bder skyod pa ma yin par/ blang dor ston pa'i slob dpon bsten pa gal che bas/ /mdza' bshes kyi tshoms las/ /dman pa bsten pas mi bdag nyams 'gyur nyid / thad gar babs pa bsten na so na gnas/ /gtso bo bsten pas dam pa 'thob 'gyur ba/ /de phyir bdag las gtsor gyur bsten par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla mar gegs sel bogs 'don sogs mdor na blang dor thams cad mtha' (10ba)chod par sgro 'dogs gcod dgos shing / de'ang theg pa chen po la'ang mdo sngags gnyis su yod pa las/ mchog tu gyur pa rdo rje'i theg pa yin kyang / 'di khe nyen gnyis ka che bas/ dus dbang gi skye bo'i snang tshul dang bstun nas/dpal di baṃ ka ras kyang / skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim gyi sgo nas go rim ltar 'khrid par mdzad pa — //

'pha gas bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wanadang / 'brom la/ chos zab mo'i grags pa sngags la 'khrul/ /las 'khor ba'i gting rdo byas kyi drogs/ /zhes thun mong ba'i lam gyis rgyud 'byongs dang gsang sngags pa dang / rnal 'byor pa skad du byas nas/ bag med kyi spyod pas rang 'khor ba'i gting rdor bsgyur ba mang bas na/ thog mar byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid 'debs shing / 'jog sgom kho na sgom du 'dzin pa'i snga rabs rgan po lugs mi byed par/ rigs dpyod pa dang / de mnyam par 'jog pa sogs zung 'brel gyis bsgom dgos pas/ rje btsun ma pham pas/ nges khed yan lag dang mthong ba'i/ /lam dang sgom pa'i lam nyid la/ /yang dang yang du sems pa dang / /'jal dang nges rtog sgom pa'i lam/ /zhes mkhas grub tshad ldan la grags pa ltar nyams su len/ khyad par 'jug pa las slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyi lam las ni/ phyi rol gyur la zhi ba'i thabs med do/ /zhes pa ltar/ zab mo rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i tshul 'di med du mi rung bas thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i lta khrid rgyas bsdus gang rung nas khrid/ de la myong ba thon nas/ rgyal ba btsong kha pas/ sangs rgyas las kyang dkon pa'i rdo rje'i theg ces pa ltar/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la 'jug dgos shing / de la'ang / dgod dang lta dang lag bcang dang / gnyis gnyas 'khyud dang rnam pa bzhi/ /srin bu'i tshul gyi rgyud bzhin gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar/ nyon mongs lam du byed tshul mi 'dra (11na tha bzhin yod pa las/ mchog gi rnal 'byor bla med la 'jug dgos pas/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum dus 'khor sogs kyi khrid 'debs shing go yul du lus pa tsam ma yin par nyams su myong ba byed/ thog mar zhugs 'phral nas/ lo gsum dkar nag gi phyogs ring mtshams kyi byed srol dus 'khor ba dang bstun pa'i sngar nas yod 'dug par/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ dge dang mi dge'i las rnams goms byas pas/ /mi rnams la ni 'dris pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes dang / ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ de yang byas nas rig par mi 'gyur min/ /gzhan gyis byas pa tshor bar 'gyur ba'ang med/ ces pa ltar/ las ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad/ byas pa chud mi 'dzad pas/rjes su khrid rnams rgyud la skye ba la gsag sbyang gal che bas/ de'i ring 'a / skyabs 'gro/ phyag /yan lag — /5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2re/bdun pa/ stobs bzhi'i bshags pa sogs kyi sgo nas sngar bsags kyi sdig pa sbyong ba dang / bsod nams kyi tsho gos ci skye byed/ ston zla ba'i dkar tshes bco lnga nas bzung dbyar mtshams zla gsum/ smin drug can gyi yar tshes nas bzung dgun zla gsum mtshams byed/ rgyun gyi tshogs 'don la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rje sa paṇa gyi bstod pa chos rgyal ma/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa'i bstod pa sa gsum ma/rnam dag gangs ri ma/ lam rim gsol 'debs/ lam rim bsdus don/ nyi bzhon (gzhon 'char ka ma/ mchams sprin ma/ thub dbang bstan sgron ma/ rab dkar dge tshogs ma/ phun tshogs yon tan ma/thub dbang zhal pad ma/ bgrang yas ma/ phun tshogs 'dab stong ma/ rab 'byams skyob pa/ ja mchod/bde ba can/ dus 'khor smon lam rnams snga sor tshugs grub 'dug pa dang / slar 'jug dgos/bstan pa'i gtso bo'i bstod pa skabs gsum pa/ jo 'brom gyi bstod pa snang ba mtha' yas ma dang lhar bcas ma/ rje bla ma man (11ba〉gye lam rim bshad rgyud kyi gsol 'debs/ bzang spyod/ byams smon/tshangs cod ma/ thog mtha' bar gyi smon lam/ lnga mchod chen mo'i thog sgrub mchod dang / sbyin bdag gi don du dkyil 'khor zhal 'byed sogs gang 'os la/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i bde mchog dril bu lta lnga mngon dkyil dang bcas pa gzhi gsum gyi phyag len byed/ khyi dang slong mo ba sogs nang du mi gtong bar phyi rol du mchod ro dang bza' gas gi lhag rnams ster/ mang po ldan cig tu 'dus nas long gtam smra ba/ ku co'i sgra sgrog pa/ nyo 'tshong dang / skye bo gzhan dang 'dris bshes ha cang che bar byed pa sogs bsam gtan gyi tsher mar gyur pa'i rnam par g.yeng ba mtha' dag mi byed/ dben pa kho na gtso bor 'don dgos pas/ mdo sde dgongs 'grel las/ de gcig pu dben par 'dug ste/ nang du yang dag bzhag nas ji ltar yang dag bsam pa'i chos de dag nyid yid la byed cing gang gis yid la byed pa'i sems de nang du rgyun chags su yid la byed pas yid la byed pa'o/ /the blo/gsungs pa ltar yin la/ tsho gos gral rnams su rtse zhwa dang gra zhwa gang ris kyi zhwa ser/ zla gam/'ding ba/ lhung bzed sogs nges can du 'khyer/ sgom zhwa/ 'bar zhwa/ sgom thag /ma ṇi'i lag skor — /(nyi

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)'khyer ba rnams mi byed/ bza' btung gi tshe cag hub kyi sgra 'byin pa/ rtsig pa dang ka ba la snye ba/ kha gtums nas sdod pa sogs bag yengs kyi spyod pa mi byed/ mtshams res min pa'i skabs su'ang /khrims grogs med pa dang / chos khrims bar gnang ba ma zhus par/ bud med nang mtho brgal nas mi yong / phyi mtshams bsdams nas bzung / sga ru la kha man mi 'da'/ nang mtshams bsdams nas bug sgo 'dag sbyar byed/ na khar gzims spyil ba'i mdzo gsum thong la/ sbyin bdag 'o ma ma 'byor ba'i ris la 'o ma thob/ dge 'dun spyi'i rdzas 'phral spyod bde ba rnams kyi spyi 'gyed dang / de min gzims spyil ba dang tsho mi gsum pos thel 'byar dang / chos khrims pas gnyer cag byas (12na slo(sa/ bed spyod dgos par shar na gong gsal lnga po 'dzom thog nas byed/ nyung ja thob dus/ dbu mdzad/ chos khrims/ mchod g.yog /nye gnas/ chu ma gsum ma gtogs ga' na la mi gtong / srung sdom pas gna' g.yag sogs sems can la gzhan gyis gnod pa mi yong ba'i do dam byed/ dkon gnyer dang me tog do dam pa/ chu ma rnams kyis so so'i byed dgos zim lus gseng shor du ma song ba byed/ gzhung sanas dmigs bsal byung na ma gtogs/ lcang shol/ gla ba/ se nags la gcod 'dreg mi byed/ sbyin bdag gi che ra/ mang ja bsnyen bkur gyi ris la mi 'os pa'i mang nyung gi rtsod pa mi gtong / kha 'thab byas pa sogs sgrigs phran rnams dang 'gal ba la/ bla ma chos khrims sogs sne mo ba rnams kyis brgya phyag mang ja sogs 'os 'gab bltas pa'i chad pa 'grel/ rtsa bzhi'i mthong thos dogs gsum byung ba/rmas khrag thon pa/ sgrigs rnams la rgyun du rtsi med byas pa byung na gnas nas dbyung / bla mas thog drangasapa'i sne mo ba rnams kyis kyang / sger don/ ngo dga' zol 'jog mi byed gong shar rnams kyis rtsa 'dzin khrim snon dgos pa rnams rgyal rtse rdzong sdod kyis byed rgyu yin pas so so nas go bar gyis/ gnyis med gsung ba gang gi legs bshad bshad dang sgrub pa'i bstan pa zhes/ nyi zla lta bur kun tu rab grags grags pa don ldan phan bde'i dpal/ /'jam dpa la snying po'i ring lugs bzhin du du mar spel ba'i lhag bsam gyis/ /khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge'i spel legs legs par 'dod rnams dang du long //— /7—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)dug sprul khung bur gnas la bde ba'i nyams/ /'byung ba ji bzhin ltar snang chos tshul la/ /tshad mar bzung ste 'jug pa'i blun po rnams/ /lung dang rigs pas skabs 'gar bzlog pa srid/ /ci yang yid la mi byed 'gog pa'i mtha'/ /ha shang rgan po'i ring lugs ka mā las/ /bkag kyang gzig lpags (12ba)gyon pa'i mgrin bzang ltar/ /mi mdog bsgyur ba'i sgom chen 'ga' mchos kyang / /yid bzhin nor dang mching bu'i rnam dbye dag /ma 'dres 'byed pa'i ded dpon blo ldan bzhin/ /skyes thob shes rab can gyi skye bo yis/ /yang dag ltar snang so sor cis mi 'byed/ /mkhas bas ri mor bris pa'i mar me'i gzugs/ /ma brtags byis pa 'khrul ba'i gnas srid kyang / /zhib mor dpyad na mun pa sel ba'i mthu/ /med par shes ldan su zhig the tshom bral/ /mang du thos pa'i bsregs bcad rab brdar ba'i/ /tshul bzhin bsam pa 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser/ /dpyad 'jog bsgom pa'i rna rgyan legs bsgrubs pa/ /'dod ldan skye ba'i 'gram par cis mi mdzes/ /brjod par 'os pa'i gtam gyi dbyangs bdun glu/ /mi bzad mgrin pa'i lam nas blangs pa yis/ shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i go 'phang khrir/ /ris med lus can mtha' dag 'dzeg gyur cig /ces ri khrod dga' ldan pa'i spyi khrims kyi bca' tshe shel dkar me long zhes pa 'di'ang ri khrod spyi tshogs nas mchod yon du dgos tshul gleng 'dug pa ltar/shākya'i ring lugs pa ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde/'phags yul du ak+ṣa ya zhes pa phyogs 'dir mi zad pa/ rgya nag pa bang zu'i du brjod pa me pho khyi'i lo/'dul mngon pa'i lo'i thog ma smin drug gi nya bar/ dus 'khor ba'i lugs kyi snying stobs kyi mun pa 'jug pa chung ba'i mar ngo / dbyangs ā/ gsal byed ska dbyangs ra ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba dang po/dbyangs ā/ gsal byed dha / 'byung ba sa/ 'dod yon ni/ tat+pa lag zhu'i dus sbyor la/ bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan ra sa 'phrul snang dang zung du 'brel ba'i gtsug lag lugs brgya'i sgo 'phar gcig tu ni 'byed pa dga' ldan phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang du grub par bgyis pa dza ya// / (13na)— /8

'phags bal bod sogs yul thur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)chos grwa chen po dpal snar thang gi rab 'byams kyi grwa skor gyi bca' tshe shel dkar me long /: bha rma : sa mu ཿ su dza ta dz+nyā sa ཿ tsa ji tsa/tshogs gnyis zla ba'i ma ma las/ /legs 'khrungs kun mkhyen chu shel dbang / /pu rgyu ku spo ba ka ཿ pra bha 4 cho da na pu shu kro/ /thugs rje'i 'od kyis legs byas tshal/ /rgyas par mdzod cig zas gtsang sras/ /gang zhig ches brling rgyal bstan gser ldan ma/ /rnam dpyod mkhyen pa'i stobs kyis 'degs pa la/ /bstan 'dzin skabs gsum g.yin gyis zla bral ba'i/ /rgyan drug mchog gnyis pad dkar mig gang rgyal/ /rmongs pa'i tsha bas gdungs pa'i gangs can khrod/ /thub bstan snga na med pa'i dri bzhon gyis/ /khyab mdzad chos rgyal mes dbon lo paṇa tshogs/ /gzur gnas shes ldan yongs kyis phyag bya'i yul/ /'jam dbyangs rang gzugs mi yi srid pa'i gar/ /'gro la rjes su ston pa'i btsong kha pa//khyod kyi rnam dkar mdzad pa'i phung po 'di'i/ /snod du tshangs pas khams gsum sprul par nges/ /dge legs rnam bkra 'ja' 'dra'i gur khyim nas/ /phun tsho gos shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gi glus/ /(13ba)dpal ldan rgyal ba'i ring lugs rgya mtsho'i sder/ /brjod pa'i dngos po don dang ldan 'gyur cig /dge ba'i rang bzhin rgyas pa'i ku mu da/ /yon tan zla bar 'dun zhing chags pa'i chus/ /'dab ma mngon par g.yo ba'i grags pa'i dbyangs/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can kun tu khyab 'di mtshar/ /blo dman kun gyisabalta ba'i yul bral zhing / /blo chen rnams kyang the tshom khyogs 'chang ba'i/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i lugs srol gzhung chen rnams/ /blo ldan skye bos thos bsam bgyis pa'i 'bras/ /rab tu brjod bral kun gsal pha mtha' ltar/ /rab mang shes bya'i gtsug lag ma lus par/ /rab tu brgal brtags dpyad — 19

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2re/nas 'byams klas pa'i/ /rab dkar rnam smin dkar por 'dzag pa'i rnga/ /tshul ldan 'khrul med srol gyi dbyu gu yis/ /mngon par brdungs tshe rgol ngan dpung tshogs las/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i ngo mtshar gtam gyi dpyid/ /'brul med yi ge'i lam du deng 'dir shar/ /de'ang 'o skol gyi ston pa rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen zhes/ ris bral gyi 'gro ba mtha' dag la gcig tu brtse chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid can des gsungs pa'i bka' sde snod gsum lung dang / de don nyams su blangs pa las lam mngon rtogs kyi rim pa ste/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che ni/ 'phags pa'i yul las ljongs 'dir/ sa spyod dam pa rnams dang / lo paṇa rnams kyi drin las ches dar zhing / khyad par gsung rab mtha' dag dngos stobs kyi rigs pas gtan la 'bebs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi sde zhes/ lo chen blo ldan shes rab dang / cha gtsang sogs mkhas grub rim par byon pa rnams las ches cher 'phel ba las blo gsal rnams kyis thos bsam bgyis pa'i 'bras rtags dang / bstan pa rin po che'i mig rkyen du rab 'byams gra skor zhes pa'i srol/ gos grwa chen po rtses thang du sde srid rin po che phag mo gru pas 'dzugs par mdzad pa dang /g.yin yang yul gru du mar byung 'dug pa rnams dang cha mthun par/ chos kyi rgyal po (14na)btsong kha pa chen po'i mdzad pa/ srid pa 'di na rnam dkar gyi dge ba la 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba'i chos 'phrul gyi dus ston chen po 'di nyid kyi thog tu grwa skor gyi srol 'dzugs pa 'gab tshul/ gsung rab rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son zhing / 'chad cing rtsod pa la smra mkhas ngag gi dbang por 'gran bzod pa'i chos rje rin po che dkon mchog chos 'phel/ mkhas mang blo gsal gling gi 'chad nyan las thog tu bzhugs pas gtso gnad slob dpon rnams gros bsdur thog nas/ shing glang smon lam dus gsar 'dzugs grub 'dug na'ang / nyi ma kha grangs nyung zhing grwa skor ba mang bas cung zad byed sla ba dang / smon lam chen mo'i do dam gang ci 'bras spungs spyi so nas mdzad pa'i stabs kyis grwa skor byas pa dang / 'bras spungs kyi gling bsre byas par khyad med cig dgos rgyur 'dug kyang / rdo bcal du dam bca' ma bzhag par gdong gral du mi chud pa sogs bar skabs su/ dge skos ci ris kyis sger don spyi 'khyer gyi rnam pa'i bcos bslad —2(/

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)sna tshogs 'dug par brten/ da cha me phag smon lam chen mo'i thog nas bzung 'gyur med lag tu len dgos kyi dran tho ni/ mdo phyogs kyi grwa skor ba brgyad las mang ba mi byed/ de yang nyi ma bcu gsum tsam la mtshon na/ bzhi po shos dbye ba'i sho che bas rnam 'grel le'u bzhi pa dang / phar phyin skabs dang po gnyis la bshad chen nyi ma re re dang / bshad chung mdzod la nyin gcig byed/ sho de'i 'og mas bshad chen le'u gsum pa dang / skabs gnyis pa/ bshad chung mdo rtsa ba/ sho de 'og mas bshad chen le'u gnyis pa dang / skabs bzhi pa/ bshad chung dbu ma 'jug pa/ sho de 'og mas/ bshad chen le'u dang po dang / skabs brgyad pa/ bshad chung rang phyogs dge lugs pa yin na byang chub lam rim/ drang nges rnam 'byed gnyis gang 'dod dang / sa lugs pa yin na/ sdom rig gnyis gang 'dod 'dam/ bo dong /gar 'brug (14bsgo bu ma nges pa'i byung tshe/ mngon pa kun las btus rtsa she/ rgyud bla ma gsum po gang rung 'dam 'jug /dmigs bsal sngags rams pa byung na/ gong gi grangs la mi the zhing / snga phyi dang gzhung yang shos dbye ma dgos pas/ nyi ma bcu gsum la mtshon na/ mtshan nyid pa bzhi pos bshad chen nyi ma phyed gnyis re dang / bshad chung nyi ma re grub pa'i de lhag gsum po la sngags rams pas bshad pa byed pa dang / dge lugs la/ bshad chen gsang 'dus bshad chung dus 'khor/ sa lugs la bshad chen brtag gnyis/ bshad chung bde mchog /rnying lugs la bshad chen gsang ba snying po/ bshad wo rgyud bcu bdun gang res/ jo zhal/ bo dong / gar 'brug rnams bshad wo dus 'thor/ bshad chung sa ṭar byed sbyor 'god ni/ skas gdang dang po ni/ 'grel pa don gsal las/ spyod pa'i gnyen por chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa rnam pa thams cad skor bar mdzad pa/ zhes sogs/ mdo sde rgyan las/don shes don ston rab tu 'du byed ngag dang tshig rnams dri med pas/ zhes sogs/ rgyud bla mas/sangs rgyas chos tshogs khams dang byang chub dang / zhes sogs/ rtsa she las/ gang gi rten cing 'brel par 'byung / /zhes sogs/ 'jug pa las/ zhen thos sangs rgyas 'bring rnams thub dbang skyes/ zhes sogs/ ma' pa kun las btus las/ khams rnams ni bco brgyad do/ /zhes sogs/ mdzod las/—2/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)gang zhig kun la mun pa gtan bcom zhing / zhes sogs/ tshad ma kun las btus las/ tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed pa/ zhes sogs/ rnam 'grel las/ rtog pa'i dra ba rnams bsal zhing / zhes sogs/ mdo rtsa ba las/ nges par 'byung ba tshul khrims kyi dbang du byas te/ zhes sogs/ so thar gyi mdo las/ snyan pa'i ba dan 'jig rten gsum na grags/ /zhes sogs/ spyod 'jug las/ bde gshegs chos kyi sku mnga' sras bcas dang / /zhes sogs/ lam sgron las/ dus gsum (15na)rgyal ba thams cad dag dang de yi chos/ /zhes sogs/ skas gdang gnyis pa ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /zhes sogs/ mdo sdo rgyan las/ sbyor ba'i sngon du snying rje dang / /zhes sogs/ rgyud bla mar/ ji lta ji snyed nang gi ni/ /zhes sogs/ rtsa she las/ gang zhig bdag la mi lta ba/ /zhes sogs/ 'jug pa las/ rgyal ba'i sras po 'di yi sems gang 'gro ba rnams/ /zhes sogs/ mngon pa kun las btus las/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa gang zhe na/ zhes sogs/ mdzod las/ zag bcas zag pa med chos rnams/ /zhes sogs/ tshad ma kun las btus las/ ming dang rigs sogs sbyor ba yis/ /zhes sogs/ rnam 'grel las gtan tshig kyi ni tshul gsum la'ang / zhes sogs/so thar gyi mdo las/ 'di ni dam chos rgyal po yin/ zhes sogs/ mdo rtsar/ dang po'i mkhan po nyid kyis bar chad dris nas/ zhes sogs/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /zhes sogs/ lam sgron las/ chung dang 'bring dang mchog gyur pa'i/ /zhes sogs/ skas gdang gsum pa ni/mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems mi 'gong ba nyid la sogs/ /zhes sogs/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rgyal sras rnams kyas sems bskyed ni/ /zhes sogs/ rgyud bla las/ rang don gzhan don don dam sku dang ni/ /zhes sogs/ rtsa she las/ lta dang nyan dang sgom pa dang / /zhes sogs/ mngon pa kun las btus las/sa'i khams gang zhe na/ zhes sogs/ mdzod las/ de la snod kyi 'jig rten gyi/ /zhes sogs tshad ma kun las btus las/ rjes dpag rnam gnyas rang don ni/ / zhes sogs 'jug pa las/ shes bya'i bud shing ma lus bsreg pa'i me/ /zhes sogs/ mdo rtsa ba las/ rang gis dge bsnyen nyid du nye bar bsgrubs —22

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)nas/ zhes sogs/ rnam 'grel las/ tshad ma slu med can shes pa/ /zhes sogs/ spyod 'jug las/byang chub rgyur ni dge bsags pa/ /ceXg sogs/ bzhi brgya pa las/ tshul khrims kyis (15ba tsārne bde 'gror 'gro/ /zhes sogs/ rin chen phreng ba las/ dge las bde 'gro thams cad dang / /zhes sogs/skas gdang bzhi pa ni/ mdo sdo rgyan las/ gnas brtsom 'bras bu 'byung ba chos bdag nyid/ /ces sogs rgyud blar/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'di ni/ /zhes sogs/ rtsa sher/ bstan pa dag ni thams cad du zhes sogs/ bzhi brgya bar/ de bzhin kun mkhyen sgra 'di ni/ /zhes sogs/ mngon pa kun las btus las/ ci yis bslab par btags she na/ /zhes sogs/ mdzod las/ gang zhig gsum la skyabs 'gro ba/ /zhes sogs/ tshad ma kun las btus las/ g.yin don rjes su dpag pa ni/ /zhes sogs/ rnam 'grel las/ gtan tshigs rab tu dbye ba'i don/ /zhes sogs/ 'jug pa las/mngon du phyogs pa mnyam gzhag sems gnas te/ /zhes sogs/ spyod 'jug las/ spong ba'i sems ni thob pa las/ /zhes sogs/ mdo rtsa ba las/ dbyar gnas pa khas blang bar bya'o/ /zhes sogs/lam sgron las/ sems can dam pa 'byung ba mchog ces sogs mngon rtog rgyan las de na 'khor ba ji srid par/ zhes sogs/ bshad chen bshad chung gi gzhung yod kyang sbyor 'god 'jog mi dgos/ sngagasarams pas sbyor 'god kyi tshab tu bshad pa byed cing / dam bca' 'jog 'dod yod na ma gtogs ka dpe ma mi byed/ spyir grwa skor las chos su mi 'gro ba'i do dam mkhan slob tshang mas byed pa dang bye brag mdo'i grwa skor ba rnams kyi chos grwa smon lam gyi dam bca' yun ma thungs pa'i ched gzhung las pas byed cing / gra tshang khag gi grwa pa rnams der 'dud gos pa'i do dam dge skos kyis byed/ grwa skor grub nas gdong gral du tshud rgyu yin/ me khyi hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu gcig la dran tho 'di bzhin bkod pa/ slar rang dran gyi bzo bcos bzhin mi byed par 'di ga sor gnas byed dgos rgyu yin/ med byung bsod nams dbyar skyes ljon shing tshogs/ kun mkhyen 'bras bu' khur gyis rab dud pa'i/ /byed pa zas gtsang sras kyi bstan pa 'di/ /phyogs (16na)dus kun tu dar shing rgyas gyur cig /—23

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ni/chos grwa chen po dpal rtses thang gi rab 'byams grwa sgor gyi bca' tshe shel dkar me long /dzā yi shā sa rgya rno ga skyi dha rma sa mū PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB/rgyal bstan dri med ring lugs nyan mor byed/ /rnam dpyod dpyad gsum dri bzhon gyis 'dren pa'i/ /hi ma hā nā tha ka ཿ nu sa rna byu ska ma khyo na ka ñca sa bi bya ྅ sa sko ra/shing rta chen po rjes 'brang lte sngon can/ /dbus 'gyur gnas lnga rig kun gtsug gi rgyan/ /bsil ldan ljongs kyi 'dab gshog yangs par 'khor lo gsum gyi phur lding gis/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar byed po mkhan slob chos rgyal mar me mdzad/ /rin rngogs lo shong dpang bu sogs mkhas grub gnyis skyes lus dkar can/ /rmad byung bka' drin mtshungs pa med phyir shes ldan yongs kyi phyag gi gnas/ /tshogs gnyis bye ba'i man shel rtsegs pa'i lding khang nas/ /rlabs chen smon lam rin chen sbrel ba'i them skas las/ /bod yul tshal 'dir 'ongs pa'i 'jam dbyangs mi'i zol can/ /'gro ba'i bla ma btsong kha pa la gus pas 'dud/ /legs byas gser gyi 'khor los rdzogs ldan gyi/ /sgo 'phar brgya phrag 'byed la mnga' (16ba〉〉ra ba'i/ /dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i sde srid kyi/ /lugs gnyis mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar rgya mtsho las/ /mang du thos pa'i dpyid kyi dpal mo'i mngal/ /tshul bzhin bsam pa'i dri bzhon gyis sgrums pas/ /rab 'byams shes bya'i dbyar dus dga' ston gyi//'gyur med ca tshe'i rim pa spel bar spro/ /zhes shis pa brjod pas sdun bsus te/ gnam skos rgya nag gong ma wan li'i lung gis kun ding gu shri zhes chos kyi rgyal po lha yi lhar dbang bskur zhing / kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa'i ring lugs par ming yongs su grags pa ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'i yi ge /bzang po'i bskal pa 'di'i stobs bcu mnga' ba —24

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wadarnams zad mi skye shes pa'i ye shes brnyes pa'i gnas 'phags yul rdo rje gdan nas bzung / chos rgyal rigs ldan sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas sham bha la'i grong khyer tshun gyi sar 'khod pa'i skye 'gro spyi dang / bye brag bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi sar gnas pa'i lha sde mi sde/ rgyal po rgyal rigs/ dpon chen dpon skya/ rdzong sdod/ zhi drag sne mor mngags sleb/ lhag tu rtses thang gi drung chen lho byang / gzhung las rigs las/ grwa skor byed mi sogs mtha' dag la springs pa/ 'o skol gyi ston pa thugs rje'i dbang phyug bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa rin po che ni/ chos mngon pa mdzod las/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang / /sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ /zhesapa ltar/ lung rtogs kyi bstan pa gnyis yod pa las/ bslab pa gsum sogs rtogs pa'i bstan pa gdul bya'i rgyud la skyed par byed pa la/ de brjod byar byed pa'i lung gi bstan pa la thos bsam sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ rje btsun mi pham pas/ 'di na dang por thos la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'byung / tshul bzhin yid la byed (17na〉pas yang dag don yul ye shes 'byung /zhes gsungs la khyad par rang cag gangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs 'di'i skye 'gro rnams la mtshungs pa med pa'i bka' drin/ chos rgyal mes dbon/ mkhan slob lo paṇa rnams kyi mdzad pa bzang pos/mtha' 'khob kyi yul mtha' dag dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston rlabs po ches/ 'gro ba mtha' dag gi legs byas rgya mtsho'i sgo 'phar phye zhing / bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus/ mnyam med jo bo yab sras/ rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab/ sa lo tsā ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhas pa'i dbang po shong dpang / thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston chos rje/ mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba btsong kha pa yab sras sogs mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyis sde snod gsum dang / phyi nang gi rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag lung dang rigs pa'i sgo nas dpyad pa gsum gyis gtan la phab pa'i skabs las/ dus kyi kyang cher ma zhugs pa'i tshe/gnam rim pa bcu gsum gyi mthongs nas 'jig rten thams cad kyi byed po tshangs pas/ rtsod pa'i dus su stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur par dbang bskur ba/ sde srid phag mo gru pa ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal —25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)mtshan dpal bzang pos/ 'jig rten mi chos nas dpa' mdzangs rtul phod rnam dpyod kyis/ bod khri skor bcu gsum mtha' dag legs byas kyi dpung pas rang dbang du mdzad cing / dam pa chos kyi sgo nas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel ba'i mdzad pa rgya mtsho lta bu las/ mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun gyi dge mtshan mtha' dag gcig tu 'du ba yar klungs kyi sa'i char chos grwa chen mo dpal gyi rtses thang zhes/ mdo sngags zung du 'brel ba'i bshad sgrub kyi sdo chen po nye bar bskrun pa nas bzung / 'jam dbyangs gu shri/ dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skyong chos kyi rgyal po grags pa 'byung gnas sogs sde bzhi'i (17ba)dpal phun sum tshogs pas mngon par mtho ba'i gong ma rim par byon pa rnams kyis legs pa'i srol bzang po yar ldan du btod pa/ zhabs drung gong ma chen po ngag gi dbang phyug bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba kwan ding gu shri ha wang gi bar du srol bzang nyams pa med par gnas na'ang / bar skabs yul gru so sor rgyal phran rang nyams kyis bzung ba dang / sa kun la dbang sgyur ba rnams kyis kyang / bstan pa'i rnam gzhag gi tshul la dag ther/ lugs gnyis kyi khrims gnon sogs ma byung bar brten/ gong sa'i bca' yig dang mi mthun pa'i bshad pa gzhung bskyar sogs sla chos kho na la yid bstad pa'i yon tan yod med mtha' dag chu dang 'o ma chabs gcig tu 'dres pa'i bstan pa rin po cher rma 'byin pa zhig byung 'dug pa/ spyir yang rang cag mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang don du gnyer ba'i skye bo rnams/gang tshe rang dbang 'jug cing mthun gnas pas/ /gal te 'di bdag 'dzin par mi byed na/ /g.yang sar lhung bas ga then dbang 'jug 'gyur pa/ /de las phyi nas gang gis slong bar 'gyur/ zhes pa ltar/tshe 'di tsam gyi ched du ma yin par/ /dal ba'i rten la snying thag pa nas snying po len 'dod kyi bsam pas kun nas blangs pa/ de'ang slob spring las/ /bde gshegs lam brten 'gro ba 'dren par chas gyur cing / /sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa/ /lam de lha dang klu yis rnyed min lha min dang //mkha' lding rig 'dzin mi 'am ci dang lto 'phyes min/ /zhes pa ltar/ ring mo nyid nas phan pa brgya phrag —26

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wadabasgrubs pa'i mar gyur gyi sems can rnams/ rnam pa thams (18na7da mkhyen pa'i sar 'god 'dod kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa zhig med du mi rung ba yin na/ gnas skabs rang nyid thos bsam byas par khas 'che nas/ bka' pod kyi bshad pa sogs rab 'byams grwa skor byed par yongs grags kyi gzhung gong 'og rnams la sbyangasang smra ba'i rnam
