dpyod kyi rtsal cung zad kyang med bzhin du/ 'dod pa'i chom rkun gyis ngo tsha'i nor brkus pa'i ngang tshul du lhur len pa ni/ skye bo ma rabs kyi rnam thar las kyang dman par gyur pa sha stag tu 'dug pa/ dang khyad par bsgyur gzhung snga phyi rang nyid kyi 'dod pa ltar lon pa sogs kha drag can gyis dbang dang / nor ldan gyis rgyu ngom la brten pas mkhas grub gong ma'i phyag srol nyams su 'jug pa ni/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rma 'byin pa kho nar zad pas ji skad du rgyud bla ma las/ gang phyir rgyal las ches mkhas 'ga' yang 'jig rten 'di na yod min te/ /ma lus de nyid mchog ni tshul bzhin du kun mkhyen gyis mkhyen gzhan min pa/ /de phyir drang srong rang nyid kyis bzhag mdo sde gang yin de mi dkrug /thub tshul bshig phyir de yang dam chos la ni gnod pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don kho na thog tu 'bab pas/ da cha tshang ma nas spang blang byed dgos kyi rim pa/dngos gzhi gong ma chen po nas gnang ba'i bca' yig sor gnas ngos/ grwa skor ba mang nyung sogs kyi kha grangs med 'dug pa/ ha cang mang tshe de lugs kyi nyi ma mang por 'gro zhing / yun rings pa'i bshad pa nyan pa dang rigs lung byed mi sogs kyang snyugs bud pa'i nyams kyis tshang ma nyog por 'gro ba zhig yod (18bsti nas che ba dang / rigs ja kha grangs mar song ba'i tshogs lang kyang ldangs mi ldangs sna tshogs byung togs nas da cha dbyar grwa skor ba mang mtha' dgu /dgun bcu bzhi byed pa dang / dus tshod kyang dbyar hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bzhi dang / dgun dor zla bcu pa'i tshes brgyad la nges can du 'dzugs/ dbyar dgun gyi dus gnyis por ma sleb phyin/ lo phyi ma'i dus sgug pa ma gtogs 'phar ma 'dzugs pa sogs gang mos mi byed/ bshad skor de'i yun tshad nyi grib rgyug mtho re la cha 'jog /bskyur gzhung nges med yod 'dug pa de bzhin las/ gzhung las dang 'gos nas sa 'og dar 'thag gi dran —27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)'phrul mi byed/ rgyu/ dbang / mi/ dpung / lta grub sogs la bsnyad pa'i dbang che shed che mi byed/ ston pa bu ram shing pa'i rjes su zhugs phyin grub mtha'i phyogs lhung gi gtod lugs byung na mig rkyen du phan pa zhig mi yong 'dug pas/ dgu dang bcu bzhi las mang ba byung na thob mi thob kyi sa mtshams shos dbye/ ma thob pa slar byed 'dod yod pa rnams grwa skor rjes ma'i tshe thob pa 'os med steng / gsar pa byung bas snon ma gang dgos kyang sho brgyag /gang gi grangs bcad mtshan nyid pa yin zhing / sngags rams pa de la brtsi rgyu min pas gang byung kha grangs 'phar 'gro /drung chen/ gzhung las/ rigs las pa sogs sne mor slebs pa rnams kyis kyang / grwa skor byed dka' tsam gyis bshad grwa rnams slob gnyer shugs kyis 'phel zhing / de la brten nas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'phel rgyas su 'byung ba'i tshul bsam pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan nye ring / za 'dod mi byed/ ja 'dren sogs zang zing gi 'du long dgos pa rnams las chen rang thag par dam chos rgya mtsho/ (19na gon la cha gzhag byed/ 'di'i gang ci'i rgyab gnyer mtha' dag nor 'dzin skyong ba'i dbang phyug sde pa rgya ri nas kyis mdzad dgos rgyu yin/ ring nas bskrun pa'i tshogs gnyis zla ba'i ma ma las 'ongs sku gsum go 'phang bdud rtsi'i bcud/ 'gro la rjes chags mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rnam par rgyas pa'i za ma tog tu legs gtams pas/ mi mthun bdad bzhi'i lnga pa'i grong khyer pha mthar yongs bskrad 'chi med rdo rje'i ska brnyes pa/ /ris med 'gro /ji mi ra gi zhengal gcig tu sman mdzad nyi ma'i gnyen gyi mgur las 'ongs pa'i gsung rab tshogs/ /sngon med srol btod shing rta 'dren mkhas 'dren pa dam pa klu sgrub rje/ /rje btsun thogs med la sogs mkhas dbang mkhas mang 'phags yul gtsug gi dpal/ /dpal ldan dge bcu tshang ba'i sa 'dir sa rngog bu sogs mdzangs shing mkhas/ /mkhas mang bye bas thub bstan ma lus ma smad spel phyir de don 'chad/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la 'gran zla kun bral kun mkhyen gnyis pa 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /dbyangs bdun mgrin par len la rab mkhas rab tu yangs pa'i blo gros mchog /mchog dman yongs la stsol ba'i rnam dpyod rnam thar bzang pos su la'i yul gru kun tu spel di'i grags snyan grags pa don ldan btsong kha —28—

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)pa/ /rnam gsum mkhas pa'i bya ba'i rin chen gdugs/ /lugs gnyis nor bu'i yu bas rab bteg nas/ /don gnyis srid rtse'i bar du 'khor byed pa'i/ /sa yi tshangs pa phag mo gru pa yi/ /sdebazhi'i 'dod dgu'i dpal 'phyur sa yi dpyid/ /sman ljongs rkang 'thung 'khrigs pa'i yar klungs kyi/ /bde skyid gar du rtse ba'i thang chen por/ /mang du bshad cing nyan pa'i yang dag 'bras/ /rab tu rtogs dka' rgyal ba'i gzhud lugs kun/ /blo gros gcig gis 'byams su (19ba〉klas nus pa'i/ /mkhas pa'i go sar 'god pa'i rnam gzhag gi /'gyur med bca' tshe yi ge'i phreng bar spel/ /mang thos lo 'dab 'bras bu ma ldan par/ /rnyed grags 'khor gyi sdong bu lhur len pa'i/ /blun po bstan 'dzin go sar 'gyings pa yis/ /bod yul gang bas mkhas pa' bya ba nyams/ /mdzad med nor la spyod pa'i gdengs can dbang //tshe 'phos yi dwags grong du skyes pa ltar/ /mkhas pa'i sprul par rlom nas cung zad tsam/ /mi shes rmongs pa'i mgo bo bskor 'di nongs/ /de lta na yang rnam 'dren thub pa'i bstan/ /lnga phrag drug pa'i nang gi dus yin na/ /da dung gang gi bstan pa ma nyams pas/ /blo dang ldan rnams thos la 'bad par rigs//mi dman lhag bsam shing rta yis/ /nyer drangs gtam gyi yid bzhin nor/ /thub bstan 'dod dgu'i grub char gyis/ /blo gsal dga' ston 'phel gyur cig /ces chos grwa chen po dpal rtses thang gi rab 'byams kyi grwa skor gyi bca' tshe shel dkar me long 'di'ang / las chen dpal 'byor rgya mtshos bskul bar brtan/ za hor gyi btsun pa tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje gdong drug dga' ba'i bshes gnyen du 'bod pas/ 'phags yul pa ā ji ta zhes pa thams cad 'dul du grags shing / rgya nag pa ting ha zhes pa me phag chu shel gyi dbang po dbos nya ba'i dmar phyogs kyi bzang po dang po/ g.yul rgyal ba'i dbyangs sī 'char ba'i tat+pal seng ge'i dus sbyor la rdzogs ldan gyi rnam thar bzhi'i sgo phye ba lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang nas bris pa dza yas/ /(20na)—2(3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)rwa sgreng dang ri bo bde chen sogs chos sde chung rigs 'gar stsal ba'i bka' yig rbe rdzogs/u bi nā ya ta sti ga bha shā khru ( khri : ka rā dza gu ṇa nā tha/rnam 'dren kun gyi gsang ba gsum/ /bdag nyid sman rgyal yon tan mgon/ /kā ru ṇi ra nu ta ri ya ṇa po khi ka : lha khya ma dhu ya smobla na med pa'i thugs rje yis/ /phan dang bde ba legs par stsol/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser sbyangs las grub nyin byed bye bas rab 'khyud pa/ /bla na med pa'i sa 'dzin dbang po mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rgyas pas na/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug 'gro ba'i dpung gnyen sman gyi bla/ /thugs rje'i 'od gzis dug gsum nad kyi mun pa sel ba'i bka' drin stsol/ /grangs med skye rgu'i bsod nams tshong zong gis/ /lan brgyar bsgrub pa'i yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /gnas rigs rjes sbyangs 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ /rgya bod gso rig smra ba'i tshogs rnams rgyal/ /nad kyi dri ma drungs nas rab 'byin cing / /phan dang bde ba'i rgyun chen rtag 'bab pa'i/ (20ba)gso rig gzhung lugs yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /ris med 'gro ba'i ngal gso 'di med thong / /dga' skyid dbyar gyi dpal mo 'bod byed pa'i/ /legs ldan dpyid kyi lus phra'i mngal gyi khur/ /yongs su rgyas pa'i lugs gnyis pho brang che'i/ /sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye ba las/ /rab 'ongs 'gro ba kun la mdzad med kyi/ /'jigs pa med pa'i skyabs kyi sbyin pa'i nor/ /yid kyi re ba skong ba'i za ma tog /gso rig 'gro phan gling gi bca' tshe bri/ /de'ang rang cag gi ston pa thugs rje'i bdag nyid bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa rin po cher 'jug pa'i sgo ni/ mgon po byams pas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas par ma sbyangs na/ /'phags mchog ci sems thams cad mkhyen nyid 'thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes —3(/

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wanagasungs pa ltar/ log smra tshar gcod pa sgra dang tshad ma/ gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa bzo dang gso ba/ rang nyid kun shes par byed pa nang rig pa dang lnga las/ tshe'i rig byed sman dpyad kyi gtsug lag 'di nyid rdzogs ldan gyi mjug tu/ shed bu zhes bya ba sa'i zhag ma 'ju ba'i nad kyis btab tshe/ tshangs pas chu skol la brten nas gsos pas/ sman la la snga pa tshangs pa/ sman la snga ba chu skol/ nad pa la snga ba shed bu/ nad la snga ba ma 'ju ba/ zhes grags shing / rtogs brjod rin po che las/ bdud rtsi'i chu gter ma srubs shing / /nor rgyas thang yangs ma bcad la/ /ri bo bsgril ba med par yang / /glang po 'di dag gang las byung / /zhes pa'i gtam rgyud ltar/ /bdud rtsi la phan tshun brtsod pa la brten nas tshangs pas tshe'i rig byed dran pas/ lha yul du dar zhing / 'phags yul du rgyal ba rang nyid dang (21na)rigs gsum gyi mgon pos gsungs pa la brten nas/ 'tsho byed gzhen nu/ dpal ldan dpa' bo sogs kyis rgya cher bstan la khyad par rang cag gangs can pa rnams la bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyis gso ba rig pa'i dbu brnyes/ srol btod/ dar rgyas su mdzad pa las/ mtha' bzhi'i gzhung lugs sogs ches mang yang / nyi ma'i 'od kyis zla skar zil gnon bzhin/ /rgyud rgyal 'di yis gso rig kun zil gnon/ /zhes pa ltar/ sman pa'i rgyal pos lta na sdug gi grong khyer du gsungs pa'i bdud rtsi'i snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud 'di/brjod byed kyi tshig nyung zhing brjod bya'i don thams cad 'dus pas/ rgya gar yul du sman gyi sbyor ba gsungs/ rgya nag yul du me btsa' rtsa sbyongs gsungs/ /dol bo'i yul du gtar kha gtso bor bstan/bod kyi yul du rtsa chu'i brtag pa bstan/ /lha yi 'khor la gsodapyad 'bum pa gsungs/ drang srong 'khor la tsa ra ka ste brgyad/ mu stegs 'khor la dbang phyug nag po'i rgyud/ /nang pa'i 'khor la rigs gsum mgon po'i skor/ /gso dpyad rgyud 'dir thams cad 'dus par bstan/ /zhes rgya cher bsngags pa'i glegs bam 'di nyid chos rgyal gyi dus su zab mo'i gter du sbas pa grwa pa mngon shes kyis spyan drangs shing rje btsun g.yu thog pa sogs mkhas grub mang pos rgya cher spel ba 'di nyid kyi 'chad nyan lhag —3/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)pa'i bsam pas gsar du bskrun pa'i slob dpon du/ rang gi gam du nye bar 'khod pa'i bla sman dpon tshang byang ngos pa blo bzang gzhan phan dbang po bskos pa'i spang blang rim pa blo gsal brjed thor bkod pa ni (21ba)thog mar slob ma gsar 'jug gi tshe snod brtag pa gal che bas/ snod ngan rnams kyis gdams pa'i bcud mi thub/ /dper na seng ge dkar mo'i 'o ma de/ /rin chen ma yin snod ngan phal par blug /snod kyang 'chag la 'o ma'i bcud kyang 'bo/ /de phyir gsang ba'i snod ngan 'di lta bu/ /slob dpon gsang zhing rang che 'byin pa dang / /thabs kyis brku zhing gzhogs slong byed pa dang / /drin med khyad sod byed la shor ra re/ /g.yo sgyus 'gro ba'i nor la 'jab pa dang / /nga rgyal dregs pas bcings dang snying rje med/ /tshe 'diX gtsor 'dzin lag tu shor ra re/ /gser g.yu rta khrab rin gyis mi blu bar/ kha 'jam dred po'i lag tu shor ra re/ /de ltar skal med snod dang mi ldan na/ /chu srin gre bar rin chen chud pa bzhin/ /zhes pa ltar/ snod dang mi ldan zhing sngar bshad kyi skyon gyis sbags pa la mang du bstan kyang ga then la phan par dka' bas/ gdams pa thub tshad spel bas mkhas khyad med/ /dug dang 'dres pas kun la phan mi thogs/ /khong du rul pas gdams pa'i mgo mi thon/ /dam tshig nyams pas phyi ma ngan 'gror lhung / /de phyir shin tu gsongs shig drang srong rnams/ /zhes pa'i don thog tu 'bab cing snod dang ldan pa zhig dgos pas/ rgyud 'di gtad par bya ba'i snod ldan ni/ /dam tshig ldan pas bla ma spyi bor khur/ /snor dang srog la 'phangs med gtong phod nas/ zhes rab che bas tshig don 'gal 'grel 'byed/ /byang sems che bas g.yin don gtso bor len/ /chos la brang gtad g.yo sgyu zol thog med/ /sman pa'i rgyu drug tshogs pa'i skal ldan la/ /drang srong chen po'i rgyud 'di gtad par gyis/ /(22na tshe zhes pa'i don yongs su tshang ba dus dbang gis dka'ang/ de'i rjes su mthun pa zhig dgos shing / 'jug bya'i gang zag kyang / 'dzin she gtan nas med pa dang / rigs shin tu dma' ba'i ya bshan lta bu dang na tshong yod pa dang / shin tu gzhon skyon gyis slob gnyer mi nus pa ma yin pa'i ris la/—32

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wadalo lnga drug tshun sdod pa dang / rgyud bzhi yongs rdzogs 'dzin cing / ma 'grel bar lag len mi skyong pa'i khas len bskor/ lo ltar gyi hor zla gsum pa'i tshes gcig nas/ bdun pa'i gnam gang bar chos tshugs pa'i ring / nam seng nas dpe cha'i 'dzin mtshams skyor sbyang byed/ dpe cha mthong mtshams nas so so'i stod sar shub bur zla bo'i sgra mi 'brog pa byas nas tsha rting kha tshun blo 'dzin byed/ de nas skyabs 'gro sems skyed/ sa gsum ma/ blo bzang rgyal ba ma/ rgyud bzhi'i gsol 'debs/ mtshan brjod tshar gsum/ sman bla'i mngon rtogs gzungs brgya rtsa dang bcas pa 'don/ gung yol nas bzung / so sor gang bder dpe cha khyer nas bshad sbyang byed/ dgongs ja'i thog /slob dpon gyis bshad pa sa bcad gtong / nye mtshams nas sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig ta der snying bcu gcig /tshe gzungs brgya rtsa/ g.yu thog pa'i bstod pa rnams 'don/ sgrol 'don grol nas srod 'khor bar/ gang 'os su bsdad nas dpe cha skyor sbyang byed/ zla ba ngo re bzhin rgyugs len/ dgon gseb/ zhol sogs nye skor la zhag gcig tshun 'gro dgos gnyer bar 'dri/ de phan slob dpon la 'dri/ bod sog hor gsum su 'dra zhig yin kyang (22ba)rgyu ngom/ mi dpung gra sdebs/ yul lugs la bsnyad pa'i shed che mi byed/ rtsed mo 'dzing rgyag sogs bag med kyi spyod pa byas par brgya phyag gnang ba ma zhus par phyin pa dang / kha 'thab/ khu tshur brdegs pa sogs lag 'thab phran bu byas par gtong cha/ rmas khrag bton pa slob gnyer byed ring nye skor du nag chang byas pa la gnas dbyung byed/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig nas/ gnyis pa'i gnam gang bar so sor dpe mtshams gang smar byas pa'i slar chos tshugs skabs rgyugs sprod rgyu yod pa byed/ lag len/ ngos 'dzin/ bsngo sman skabs ngo sprod sogs gang cir zhib tu dpyad pa'i rjes sor gzhan phan tshul ldan yong ba gal che/ gong shar gyi bca' tshe dang / slob dpon gyi ngag bkod las 'gal ba byung tshe rtsad gcod yong bas go bar gyis/ de ltar tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i dgos pa/ snod dang ldan pas rgyud 'di sus 'chang ba/ tshe 'dir btsan phyug phan dar 'dzom pa dang / 'gro ba spyos 'khar dpal grags 'thob pa dang / /phyi ma byang chub go 'phang 'grub par bsngo/ /zhes dang / thams cad —33—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2re/'dus pa'i rgyud 'di khyung ldeng 'dra/ /nad kyi g.yang sar nyam nga bag tsha med/ /yid du 'ong ba khu byug gsung snyan 'dra/ /'gro ba gang gis thos kyang spro ba bskyed/ /ces sogs phan yon rgya cher gsungs pa ltar 'byung ba yin no/ nad kyi dgra dpung ring du 'joms shing phan bde'i dngos po kun ster ba'i/ rgyal ba sman bla drang srong rig 'dzin brgyud par bcas pa'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las ma smad nor bu dbang gi rgyal po che/ /srid mthar gnas shing yid kyi re ba'i 'dod pa 'jo ba'i dpal gyur cig /ces pa'ang za (23na ltos gyi btsun pa ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dge legs so/ /kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras kyi 'phrin las par ming yongs su grags pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'i yi ge /bka' gdams rin po che'i chu 'go /gdan sa ra sgreng rgyal ba'i dben gnas kyi grwa rigs sbyin bdag sne mor mngags sleb dang bcas pa mtha' dag la springs pa/ 'o skol gyi ston pa brtse chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'gro ba kun gyi sman yon dam par gyur pa 'di nyid/su la'i yul gru chen por chos rgyal mes dbon rnams kyi bka' drin las dar bar gyur na'ang / bar skabs su 'phel 'grib cung zad byung ba slar yang ma rtogs pa dang log par blta ba mtha' dag drungs par bya ba'i ched du/ mgon po snang ba mtha' yas kyi ye shes sgyu ma rol pa'i zlos gar las dpal di paṃ ka ra shi sgo nas shing rta chen po rnam pa gnyis kyi lugs srol dri ma med pa la brten nas/ gangs can gyi ljongs thams cad la rnam par khyab pa'i bstan pa rin po che/ sgrol mas lung bstan pa'i sras kyi thu bo pad dkar 'dzin pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la nye bar btad pa'i yul du byung ba'i 'bras bu yongs su grub pa'i lha chos bdun ldan gyi rnam thar gtsang ma'i chos tshul ma lus par 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu/rten dang brten par bcas pa'i 'dus sde dam pa legs par bskrun pa gang 'di bka' gdams kyi bstan pa'i btsas su mi nyams shing 'phel bar byed pa'i slad du mkhan por gdan sa chen po dga' 34

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling nas/ byang rtse chos rje ngag dbang (23ba)rdo rje bsko gzhag bgyis yod pa/spyir yang thar pa don du gnyer ba mtha' dag dang khyad par bka' gdams rin po che'i rjes su zhugs pa rnams kyis nan tan snying por bsgrub bya bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshul khrims rin po che rnam par dag pa'i gzhi bzung / klog pa thos bsam dang spong ba bsam gtan gyi tshul la sgo gsum gyi 'bad pa bsten pa kho nar gda' bas/ mkhan pos kyang sngar srol nub pa rnams gsar du gso ba dang ma nub pa rnams gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i chos khrims bca' ba la/ khyod gong 'khod rnams kyi lhag pa'i bsam pas yang dag par bsgrub dgos rgyu yin/ 'phags yul ba ā dha rar 'bod pa kun 'dzin zhes pa sa pho byi ba'i lo nyin byed dbang po seng ge'i khyim du spyod pa dbyangs e 'char ba'i tshes la chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs nas bris/ /kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras po'i 'phrin las par ming yongs su grags pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde/ /ming gzhan jing gir gnam gyi yul du tā la'i bla ma badz+ra dha ra zhes pa'i gtam/ dad stobs ldan pa ja sag thu rgyal pos gtsos pa'i khal kha'i rgyal po rgyal rigs/ dbang tha bu na/ mi bzang sogs lugs zung gi bya ba'i kha lo sgyur ba mtha' dag la zlo ba/'gro ba kun la gcig tu sman par mdzad pa phan dang bde ba'i dpung gnyen dam pa/ rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyis mngon par mtho ba dang / nges par legs pa'i rgyu sgrub byed kyi thabs su gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis bka' stsal ba mtha' dag brjod bya'i snying po mi dge ba bcu spong zhing / dge bcu sgrub par gsungs pas/ sngon 'dzam gling yangs pa'i rgyal khams su byon pa'i chos ldan rgyal (24na)po rnams kyis dge ba bcu'i khrims la brten pas rang gzhan gyi don rlabs po che skrun pa ltar skye rgu kun gyi phan bde 'byung ba ni/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la rag lus shing / de'ang lugs so so'i sa chen skyong pa rnams kyi rgyal khrims chos bzhin du spyod pa la rag lus pas/ sngon nas rgyu mtshan rim par song ba ltar phyogs de'i phyi nang kun tu phan tshun mtha' dag mnyes gshin pa'i ngang tshul can gyis/—35

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)rang rang gi mnga' ris la chog shes pa dang / sdig spyod kyi tshul la ngo tsha shes shing / sngon nas gnyen dang mdza' grogs su gyur pa'i khrel yod ya rabs kyi spyod tshul bgyis pa'i gzhung bzang po bde 'jags lhag bsam gyi khur chen po dang ldan pa dgos tshul zhib pa er ti na chos rje'i ngag nas smreng ba ltar/ brjod pa'i 'bras bu yang dag par smin pa nan tar gal che/ tshul 'dir bsam sbyor ngan pa'i kun dkris kyis log par 'khu na/ dam can rgya mtsho'i chad pas lus sems la brnag dka' zhing lci bar mi 'gyur ram/ /smras pa don dang ldan pa rnams la gnas skabs su legs pa'i don rnams 'grub cing / mthar thug rdzogs pa'i byang chub la reg pa'i bsngo smon gyis rgyas 'debs yid la 'grogs pa yin/ zhes 'phags yul pa ā dha rar 'bod pa kun 'dzin zhes pa sa pho byi ba'i lo chu shel gyi dbang po gro bzhin gyis/ nye ba'i yar tshes dge bar chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs nas bris/ /dbang phyogs rgyal po wā na li'i lung gis kān ding ta'i gu shrī zhes chos kyi rgyal po rgyal khams kyi 'dren par dbang bsgyur zhing / gnam gyi bu jing gir (24ba)hor gyi rgyal khams su tā la'i bla ma badz+ra sa ra/ ming g.yin de bzhin bshegs pa'i 'phrin las pa ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'i yi ge /lus can kun gyi legs byas rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis nye bar bsgrubs pa'i sgron me'i bskal pa rnams kyi nang nas bla lhag tu 'gyur pa bzang po'i bskal pa zhes stobs bcu mnga' ba stong gis ye shes mchog gi bdud rtsi brnyed pa'i gnas 5rnyede sha bsgrus na zhes 'phags yul rdo rje gdan gyis nye bar mdzes pa'i 'dzam gling yangs pa'i rgyal khams spyi dang / bye brag lha ldan gtsug lag khang nas bzung / ri bo che tshun gyis sa lam du 'khod pa'i lha sde mi sde rgyal po rgyal rigs/ dpon chen dpon skya/ rdzong stod sner slebs dmag ar jag gi 'grim 'grul/ ko gru lcags gsum gyi mnyan gnyer/ la 'phrang srung mi sogs/ bod/ sog /hor gsum gyi mchog dman bar ma'i skye 'gro mtha' dag la bzlo ba/ 'gro ba kun gyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po rgyal po zas —36

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)gtsang sras po'i lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa rin po che phan dang bde ba'i bdud rtsi zad mi shes pa'i bdag nyid can gyi snying por gyur pa/ nang du yang dag par 'jog pa'i bsgrub rgyud rgya mtsho'i shing rta pa chen po/ /nges pa'i don du rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen dang tha mi dad par zhal gyis 'ches shing / dbang po tha ma'i gdul bya'i ngor rim gyis sbyangs (25na)pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po dpal phag mo grub pa rdo rje rgyal po gang gi ring lugs gdugs dkar po gcig gis nor 'dzin gyi khyon kun yongs su khyab pa'i 'phrin las kyi sgo 'phar las grub pa'i dpal stag lung thang pa'i bka' rgyud ces grags shing / gong ma'i lung dang las gas bod gling dgu'i rgyal khams su dbang gis che ba'i lugs gnyis nas mngon par mtho ba gang gi rigs chos 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug stag lung nas zhabs drung rin po che dpon slob chos srid kyi 'phrin las rgya chen po/ shar phyogs nyi 'og gi rgyal khams su rgya mtsho'i rlabs ltar dus las yol ba med par 'jug pa'i sgor ri bo che phyogs su phebs song bar/ dam pa'i skyes bu rnams 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing rmad du byung bar rgyal dang de sras rnams kyis bsngags par mdzad pa 'khrul pa med pa'i phyir na/ khyod gong 'khod rnams kyis gus 'dud lhur len gyi bkur ste dang ri mor bgyi ba ma gtogs/ thugs sun phyung ba'i log sgrub tu 'gro ba ma byed/ yi ge mthong bzhin 'gal char song na/ dam can rgya mtsho dpang du btsugs te/ lus sems la brnag dka' zhing lci ba'i chad pa 'bebs par mi 'jigs sam/ tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i dge ba bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'jug pa yun du bgyid pa yin zhes legs sbyar gyi skad du ā dha ra/ kun 'dzin gyi lo sa byi hor zla brgyad pa'i dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i tshes la chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs nas bris/ / (25ba)dzi ni: sho 'o da na su ka re ya ya ba ri na me lha ra ya ya sho wa gyi riḥ su dri rabha yi ra wa na : bha 4 nas shā sa na su yu ba nā ni se nā na 6 de:/—37

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ma/rgyal ba zas gtsang gi sras po'i 'phrin las par ming yongs su grags pa ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'i yi ge /'phags mchog phyag na pad+mas 'dul ba'i zhing khams gangs kyi ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i ru bzhi'i rgyal khams spyi dang / khyad par g.yon ru'i sa'i cha/ mtho ris kyi dge mtshan rgya mtshos mngon par dpa' ba'i 'phying bar stag rnam par rtsen pa'i rgyal khams kyi mnga' ris su gtogs pa'i mchog dman bar ma'i skye rgu ma lus pa dang / bye brag ri bo bde chen gyi grwa ris sner sleb dang bcas pa mtha' dag la springs pa/ slob dpon blo bzang bstan 'phel 'di pa mdo sngags gnyis tshogs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen thos bsam sgom pa'i 'bras bu g.yur du za bas gdul bya mtha' dag rjes su 'dzin pa'i mkhan po'i yon tan dang ldan pa dang / nye char spyi so'i mthun grub dang bcas/ mkhan thog tu bskos yod pas/ khyod gong 'khod rnams kyis lugs gnyis thad nas phu dud tshul bzhin byed pa dang /mkhan pos kyang 'dzin skyong spel gsum thams cad yar ldan du dgos rgyu yin/ kun 'dzin zhes pa sa byi hor zla bcu pa'i yar tshes bzang po la chos sde (26na)chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs la bris/ /—38

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)chos 'khor rgyal gyi 'dus sde'i khrims su bca' ba sngar shing bya lo bris par bzo bcos bgyis pa chu shel dbang po/me pha lha sa sna a k+ṣa ya wa la 〈 PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB/shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i bdud rtsi la/ /spyod pa'i mi zad 'bras bu bde ba che/ /sha ba la ku bu nga skyi ta ཿ sa de be k+ta ku ba rā ṇa de sha hā/ /stobs bcu'i 'chi ba med pa'i 'dun sa de/ /bu ram shing pa mig stong can gyi yul/a : ru pa rla ji ga ye nga PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROBPROBPROB PROBPROB PROB PROB PROBPROBtshar du dngar ba'i pad+ma'i snying po'i bcud/ /grangs med chos phung sbrang rtsi'i za ma tog /gha : bra 2 nyi ñca su khri ma dze ta : |sgo na shi ya ku ru ཿ ka jo hā/ /'gro 'di'i phan bde'i dpyid du rab rgyas pa'i/ /byed po zas gtsang sras kyis dge legs mdzod/ /(26ba)bi ma la shi la ba ku la ba ku sdi hā/ tsi ka ma tu ta u ba ha ta ta na :/dri med tshul khrims ba ku la yi kha/ /tshangs spyod mdzes ma'i chang gis legs phye ba'i/ /sto te khya dzi shu sa ra tha lha ra di dzi pu ra rnyo sa re zha ba ra k+ṣi ta/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'di'i thub bstan shing rta pa/ /kun mkhyen zhi 'tsho'i zhabs zung gtsug na rgyal/ /de yi rigs las sdom gsum lus stobs rgyas/ /mang thos rin chen gser gyi rgyan 'chang zhing / /myang 'das gugs byed byang chub sems kyi rna/ /ring por skyong mdzad di po ka rar 'dud/ /ring mo nyid nas grub pa'i yon tan ma la pa yi dri bsung gis/ /rmongs pa'i blo ngan thibs po kun 'joms shes rab ches cher rab tu gsal/ /mdzad bzang lo 'dab sdug po'i khur ldan grags snyan srid 'di'i rna bar —39

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)mdzes/ /dus gsum rgyal ba btsong kha pa ches kun gyi ral pa'i mtho/ /dge legs gser mngal can gyi thong yangs las/ /(27na sgom dpyod gaṅgā'i chu klung rtag 'bab pa/ /'chad rtsod rtsom la 'dun pa'i bgrod pa yis/ /legs bshad rgya mtshor 'jug la rings par brel/ /mtha' bral chos tshul mes po'i thod yangs las/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i nyal 'gro yis/ /rgyal bstan 'jug pa bcu pa'i zhabs bsil du/ /rnam par sbreng ba'i khrims ldan 'dus pa sde/ /'jug dang 'jug bya ma yin phra rags kyi/ /blang dang dor bya nyams su bstar ba'i tshul/ /gsal byed yi ge'i 'pheng ba spel byed na/ /kun gyi sgra 'dzin lus phra'i 'gram par chongs/ /de'ang bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la grags pa can gyi rnam 'dren stong byon pa rnams kyi nang nas snying stobs kyi go cha btsan po ma smad par gyon pa'i rgyal ba zas gtsang gi sras po'i bstan pa ni ji ltar rdzing bu brgya phrag zla ba'i gzugs brnyan so sor 'char ba bzhin/ /gdul bya'i las dang skal ba'i dbang gis mtha' klas na'ang / yongs su grags par bod gangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir chos kyi rgyal po mes dbon dang mkhan slob sogs paṇa grub rim par byon pa rnams kyi bka' drin las/ bstan pa rin po che mya phyir dang zhing / de dag gi yang snying chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po'i sadri ma med pa'i ring lugs la/ phyi'i kun spyod bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa nyid gtso bor mdzad pa'i phyag len mchis pa ltar/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rdo rjes/ rje bla ma'i 'phrin las spel ba'i ched du/ dus gsum mkhyen pa pad+mā ka ra dang / glegs bam rin po che sogs nas lung gis zin pa'i sprul pa'i gnas chen sbas yul dkar mo ljongs su/ rten dang brten par bcas (27ba)pa'i sde chen por gnas pa'i tshangs par spyod pa po rnams kyis lag tu blang bar bya ba 'di ltar ro/ /de yang yul gzhan nas sdom pa nod zin pa min pa'i 'di gar gsar bu zhugs pa rnams na tshod phra ba sogs kyis dmigs bsal byung na ma gtogs/ zla ba gsum las ma 'gyangs par bar ma'am dge tshul gang rung bsgrub dgos shing / de ga'i rting bskul dge rgan ngo shes dang / legs —40

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)bshad gling dang chos khrims pas do dam byed/ bskul brda byas nas kyang dus las 'gyangs tshe chad pa snyan dar/ dung dar/ dkar me/ legs bshad gling gis gtsos pa'i sne mo ba sne tshan thob pa rnams la dar kha re'i rtsis/ tshogs su brgya phyag 'tshal/ rab byung spyi'i nyer spyad rdul gzan/ sham thabs/ gding ba/ lhung bzed/ zla gam/ zhwa ser rnams rang nyid la med kyang g.yar po tshun chad byas pas gra 'grig pa byed/ des mtsho ni pa'i rab byung gi blang dor gyi rim pa rnams kyang / rang las bslab pa rgan pa rnams kyi ngang tshul dper bzung bas/ sdom pa'i ngo skal gyi spang bya phra rags kun la/ dran shes bzhin gyis zin pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i kun spyod la gnas par byed/ dge 'dun du longs pa la chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed lta bu'i rnyed pa spyi la byung na/ yo byad de dag med cing rtsol sgrub byed pa'i nus pa yod med brtags nas dge skos kyis ster lugs byed/ tshogs kyi cha/ dung dang gaṇ+ḍi lta bu'i brda byung ba dang bstun te/ gzhan mi dad pa'i spyod lam spangs nas thams cad dus gcig tu 'du ba ma gtogs/ snga phyi gang 'dod la mi 'byon/ dge slong rnams bla gos gyon zhing / de phyin kyang zhwa mo zla gam sogs (28na)dge 'dun spyi dang mthun pa byed/ gral mtshes pa la long gtam smra ba/ rtsig pa dang ka ba la snye ba/mchil snab gos kyis ma gab par dor ba/ gnyid log pa/ bza' btung gi tshe cag khung kyi sgra sbyin pa/lhung bzed rtsi med dang phor pa tshad las 'das pa dang kham phor 'byer ba/ dge skos kyis dgos pa'i dbang gis btang na ma gtogs/ rang dran gyis tshogs ma grol bar 'gro 'dug rnams mi byed/ rgyun gtan du tshogs la sgrig 'jug gi zhal 'don mdzad dgos/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ de rjes rgyan 'jug gdugs dkar gsum po gang rung nas ja dang po la gang 'gro re mos kyis gtong / ja dang po song rjes sher snying tshar gcig bdud bzlog dang bcas pa/ sa lam gsum po gang rung gcig la gdangs dang gnyis la 'dur ma skabs sbyar byed/ skabs gsum ma/ thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i mdzad bcu/ gnas bcu phyag mchod/ snang ba mtha' yas ma dang 'brom gyi bstod pa lha bcas ma gnyis/yongs rdzogs ma/ thub dbang bstan sgron ma/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid ma/ rab dkar dge tshogs ma/—41

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)rgyal chen bsod nams ma/ phun tsho gos yon tan ma/ blo bzang rgyal ba ma/ gtan bzhugs mtha' yas ma/ rab 'byams skyob pa ma/ bde chen lhun grub ma/ byams pa'i sku gzugs ma/ tshangs pa'i cod pan ma/ mtshams sprin ma/ zab yangs ma/ bde ba can gyi (28ba〉slon lam/ bzang spyod smon lam/byams smon/ thog mtha' bar gyi smon lam/ gsang 'dus smon lam/ dpal ldan dmag zor ma/ zhal lcam sring dang bcas pa'i gtor 'bul rnams byed/ sbyin bdag gis dmigs bsal gyi sku rim la tshe gzungs dang sgrol ma lta bu 'don dgos byung na skabs dang sbyor/ tshwa ra nyin thub yod tshe/ gsang 'dus kyi bdag 'jug sta gon dang sgrags pa phyag len gtsang bar len/ tshwa ra dus mchod 'gyed sogs kyi skabs sbyin bdag dang sne mo bas 'os babs kyis gtong ba las dgos med kyi skal ba sogs la rtsod pa mi gtong / /bla brang gzhung gi nang zan dang / /gnyer pa'i g.yog mi skya'i rigs kyis tshogs skal mi len/ btsun gzugs rnams kyis tshogs skal len tshe/ de'i skabs rab byung gi rtags ma tshang ba dang phu dung gyon pa sogs mi byed/ khyad par rgyal rang du btsun pa byas pa'i rigs nang zan du bsdad pa yin na/ tsho gos skal blangs phyin dmigs bsal byung na ma gtogs sgrol 'don la yong / rab byung tshogs 'grim yin bzhin du/ 'bog do phu dung gyon pa/ gri ring skra ring / pho chings byed pa/ khugs ma phor shubs gra chung 'dogs pa/ gzan sham med par 'gro ba sogs/ dge 'dun spyi'i mig ltos bshas pa'i rigs byas pa dang / gri bton pa ma yin pa'i lag 'thab byas pa byung na/ dkar me dang snyan dar 'bul/ de las che ba'i mes khrag bton pa la/ mang ja thug dar lcog /dkar me snyan dar/ legs bshad gling du sum tshan/ sne mo ba rnams spa rnam gzhag /nad pa la rmas 'jal sogs skabs sbyar gyi gcod rgya byed/ de mtshungs 'ol dwags 'brog pa sogs kyi btsun pa yul chen so so'i phyogs sdebs kyis tsho longs byas pa byung na/ spyi pa'i gong gi chad pa 'dab 'phar dang gte po ngo ma rtsad chod na de la chad pa sger du 'grel/ de mtshungs rku 'phrog /ar jag sogs byas pa la'ang nyes pa che chung la dpags 'grel/ sgrub mchod dus gtor gyi nang mchod dang / nad di'i sman rta/ ar po'i skabs lta bu dmigs —42

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)bsal du chang len dgos pa byung na ma gtogs/ gnyer pas gtsos pa'i bla brang gzhus sger dang gra khang sogs gang du yang chang gi 'grim 'grul mi byed/ mchod khang dang 'du khang steng shod sogs thag nye sa dang mgon khang du tha ma kha mi 'then/ rnyed bkur zhu mi dang gnas mjal ba'i bud med yin kyang gnang ba bzhag tu mi ster/ gzhan bud med kyi rigs dgon pa'i nang du mi gtong rtsa ba bzhi la rten pa'i bslab pa la skyon byung na/ bslab pa bskyar ba'am yang na tshogs su mang ja tshwa ra/ gtsug lag khang du dkar me snyan dar/ thug dar lcog brje ba/ bla ma gsum chen/ sne mo ba gzhan rnams la sne gtor sogs chad pa tshul ldan bsgrub tshogs su rab byung tshul ldan gyi gral 'gor sdod pa sogs kyi tam pa mi byed/ spyi sger sus kyang dgon pa'i nang du gnag phyugs mi gso/ zho tshul dang dkar me ru ba'i sems can la med spyod mi byed/ dge skos dbu mdzad sogs las (29ba〉sno'i rigs kyis bab thog yod pa rnams bab 'brel dang bstun pa'i tho gang grwa btsugs kyis byed/ mtshams min pa'i tshe ri khrod pa rnamasatshogs la gang rtag 'byon/ ri khrod pa nas spyi pa'i dbu mdzad bskos tshe/ dbu mdzad ma bzhag par ri khrod kyi sgrigs mi 'grim/ ri khrod yas mas gnyis nas tshogs dpon dge skos dbu mdzad 'os pa yod tshe dgongs pa mi zhu/ ri khrod du sdad phyin tshong khe dpogs mngon tshan can mi byed/ 'brog pa lta bu rang yul dang skya rtsa yod pa'i rigs ma gtogs/ gzhan la gnas g.yar ba'i rta phyug gso 'phel mi byed phyogs nas byon pa'i ri khrod pa'i rigs la yul pa'i ri khrod pa rnams kyis yul bsgrigs la brten pa'i zos mi bder 'gro ba mi byed/ lo sum cu la lon pa dang mthil gyi las sne ma thon par ri khrod la mi 'gro/ dbyar chos chen mo'i skabs grwa tshang rnams kyi dge skos dbu mdzad langs pa sogs sngar srol gang yod byed dgos na'ang / gtso bor gzhis ba'i bla ma dge skos kyis dgon pa'i sgrigs rgyun bsdams pa la gzhi byes tshang mas nyan 'jog byed dgos shing / dbyar ma'i smon lam gyi tshogs la gzhi byes thams cad tshogs dgos shing de'i do dam dang rting bskul spyi sger gyi dge skos kyis byed/ dbyar chos kyi dam bca' 'dod sbyar gyis 'jog pa ma gtogs grwa tshang phyogs 'dod kyi bkag 'gog mi byed/—43 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)nad pa mtshams pa yin na ma gtogs dbyar zhal gyis bzhes pa dang gso sbyong la byon/ dbyar gyi nang du 'thab rtsod sogs dbyar ral ba'i bya ba byas pa byung na/ gzhi byes kyi slob dpon sogs gros thog nas chad pa gang 'os 'grel/ gzhan yang ku co rgyang skad 'bod pa/ gling khrod du rta bzhon pa/ gos sku 'grem pa'i tshe 'then skor chud zos su 'gro ba rnams mi byed/ spyi (30na)pa'i dbu mdzad sus byed kyis slob gra'i slob dpon byed dgos shing / slob gnyer byed lugs gong gsal rgyun 'don gyis khrod nas rgyan 'jug gdugs dkar gsum bzhags pa'i gzhan ma rnams 'dzin/ de rjes gsang 'dus sta gon bdag mdun dbang chog dang bcas pa dang / 'jigs byed kyi bdag bskyed/ mgon po phyag drug pa/ rnam sras las gshin/ dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor ma'i gtor chog rnying pa dang / gur zhal las mkhan pu tra lcam sring dang bcas pa'i gtor chog dga' tshal du byed pa dang go mtshungs par 'dzin/ de rjes chog gra so sor nyung mtha' bco lnga la cha bzhag pa'i gsang 'dus pa rnams kyis sa chog /'jigs byed pa rnams kyis sa chog sta gon dbang chog /bde mchog pa rnams kyis sa chog nas bzung yongs su rdzogs pa/ dus 'khor sgrub mchod sngar yod 'dug pa bar skabs su cho ga ldis pa la brten pa'i cho ga pa yin la dug kyang / slad nas bstan pa'i rgyun la dmigs pas chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i yig cha 'am/ de la gzhi byas pa'i cung zad 'khyer bde zhing gsal du btang ba ci 'grub byas pa lta bu gang rung zhig slar 'dzugs rtsis dang / de bar sku rim la dmigs pa'i rnam rgyal sgrub mchod tshugs pa byed pas/ snga 'gros rnam rgyal ma'i cho ga dang / dus 'khor cho ga tshugs bstun de ga'i skor rnams 'dzin/ de rnams grub rjes rgyan 'jug gdugs dkar dang / tshe mdo tshe gzungs sgrol ma/gzhan yang blos 'chun pa rnams kyis gsang sngags kyi gzhung chen mo'i bshad 'grel sogs la thos bsam byas pas bstan pa'i mig rkyen la phan pa byed/ dbyar gyi slob gra nyer bdun mchod pa'i sgrub mchod grol ba dang dbu btsugs/ lnga mchod chen mo'i gdong (30ba)du shes rab che ba rnams kyis kha gras tshad ma lnga bcu/ 'bring gis sam cu/ chung bas nyi sha/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gcig nas ri ri za ri sa bye ni ga —44

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)dgun gyi slob grwa'i dbu btsugs pa'i/ brgyad mchod chen mo'i gdong du shes rab che 'bring chung gsum gyis shog bu nyi shu/ bcu bzhi/ bdun rnams kyi rgyugs sprod/ rgyugs ma 'phrod na chad pa slob grwa rang du mang ja dang / slob chung la dar kha re gtong / sgrub mchod rnams kyi rjes su spyi tshogs rnams kyis bskang gso rgyas pa nyi ma gsum gtor rgyag dang bcas pa byed/ mgon khang mthil gyi dus gtor/ tshes gsum/ lnga/ brgyad/ bcu/ bcu bzhi/ bco lnga/ nyer gsum/ nyer lnga/ nyer dgu rnams la dus gtor mgon khang bar gyi dkon gnyer gyis do dam byas pa'i mthil nas gra pa brgyad re gtong tshes gcig gi gtor chen yang sngar rgyun bzhin chag med byed/ lhun grub dga' ba'i tshal du dkon gnyer rgyun tshogs nyi shu tsam byed rgyu la/ dge 'dun spyi'i khrims gong du smras pa rnams kyis 'thus shing / dmigs bsal dpe 'dzin gyi rim pa/ nag po skor gsum/ rnam sras/ dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor ma'i bskang gso sngar gyi rnying pa dang / gur zhal las mkhan pu tra beg tse gnyis dang bcas pa'i bskang gso gtor chog bstod bskul dang bcas pa gsar du bsgrigs pa sor gnas mgon khang po ta la'i chos skyong phyag bzhi pa/ ma ning / dur khrod bdag po/ rnam sras drags po/ beng / zhang blon/ zhing skyong / gza' gdong dmar nag /rā hu la/ rgyal po pe har/ rdor legs rnams dang / jo bo rgyal mtshan pa dang rta rgod shel lcags kyi gsol mchod sogs 'dzin/ de rjes gong gsal chos spyod dkyil chog gzhan (31na)ma sogs 'dzin dgos dkyus ltar dang / zla ba ngo re bzhin dkon gnyer gang yod de wi ko ṭir 'tshogs nas tshes gsum la bstan gsol/ lnga la bsil ba tshal du beg tshe'i dus gtor gtso bo yin kyang cho ga dkyus gcig pa'i gur zhal sbrags nas gtong / tshes brgyad dang nyer gsum la gur zhal las mkhan gnyis dang bcas pa bsil pa tshal du gtong / /tshes bcu bco lnga nyer lnga rnams la dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i dus gtor de wi ko ṭir gtong / tshes dgu dang bcu dgu la phyag bzhi pa nas rta rgod shel lcags kyi bar po ta lar gtong / tshes bcu bzhi dang nyer dgu la mgon po chos rgyal rnam sras ser chen rnams kyi dus gtor po ta lar gtong rgyu'i gtong mkhan mgon khang gang du 'tshogs kyang dkon gnyer dpon —45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)gyis gtsos pa'i dkon gnyer gang yod 'tshogs de skyi ko zhir lo gsar tshes gcig gi gtor chen dang / hor zla gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la bsil ba tshal du dpal mgon gyi gtor chen byed/ mthil gyi gtor chen dus gtor gtong lugs kyang dga' tshal du yod la 'dir med pa'i dus gtor zur pa rnams bzhag phyin/ g.yin tshes grangs gang la chos skyong gang gtso bor byed dga' tshal dang mtshungs par byed/ hor zla dgu pa'i nang du mgon khang yas mas tshang mar lo dus kyi gtor ma rgyas par brje ba dang / de skabs nyi ma gsum gyi ring / mgon khang so sor dkon gnyer rnams kha phral nas bskang gso so sor rgyas par gtong / nyin ltar gyi mgon khang so sor gtor gso ba dang gtor 'bul ma chag pa dang / kha char sogs dang bcas mchod khang du sdod rtag cing 'dzin spras thon pa dgun ka mtshams re mos su bcad pa'i bsnyen sgrub la brtson pa (31ba)zla ba bcu pa'i dgu gtor la lha mo'i gtor bzlog dang bcu gnyis pa'i dgu tor la lcam sring gi gtor zlog byed/ 'di ga'i bskang gso/thugs dam/ slob grwa'i do dam dang gtor ma 'phen pa sogs dkon gnyer dang dpon gyis byed cing /ma thus pa byung na chad pa sogs gong dang 'dra/ dus gtor min pa'i tshe mang ja'i tshogs la yong zhing /dus gtor gyi tshe mang ja yar len/ gso spyong dbyar gnas sgrub mchod rnams la mthil du yong /mgon khang phan tshun gyi 'dzin spras sogs gang ci'i stabs nas/ chog dpon ma gtogs pa'i gzhan ma dge skos dbu mdzad/ byams smon spyi pa sogs las sne'i rigs mi bkod/ lo re'i nang du sgrub mchod thengs gnyis re tshugs na bstan pa'i mig rkyen dang sku rim la phan zhing khyad par dpe 'dzin mi brjed pa sogs khyad che ba yong 'dug pa nas/ hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer gsum nas 'go btsugs pa'i nyer bdun mchad pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dzugs/ gong gi sgrub mchod dus gtor rgyun gtor sogs gtong dgos khra ma zur du yod pa la gnyer pas sku rim la dmigs pa'i gzings bstod ma gtogs chung bcad mi byed/ mchod khang dang mgon khang yas mas rnams la gnyer pas zla re bzhin rtog pa bcug pa'i dkon gnyer rnams kyis 'dzin spras sogs byung ma byung lta ba dang / zhig gsos do dam —46

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)dgos pa'i rigs la zom lus su ma song ba 'khur len byed dgos/ gong gi sgrigs 'gal chad las gnas dbyung sogs byed dgos par/ gzhan gyis ngan rgyab byas pa byung na/ de ga'i nyes chad 'phar ma 'khur/ ngos mi len na tshogs kyi dbus su dag 'don byed/ legs bshad gling dang dge skos sogs sne mo ba rnams rang 'dod phyogs cha nye ring du ma song bas sgrigs gnon dgos shing / (32na8 kha'i rgyab gnyer gang dgos 'phral du rgyal gnyer pas byed pa dang / gtso bor chos skyong bsrung ma mthu rtsal can gyi legs pa la bya dga' dang nyes pa la tshar gcod kyis 'phrin las g.yel ba med par mdzod cig /ces chos 'khor rgyal gyi khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde rnams kyi khrims su bca' ba lag tu blang bde ba 'di yang sngar shing bya lo bris par bzo bcos bgyis te lcags mo yos lo chu shel gyi dbang po smin drug gis nya ba'i phyogs snga ma'i dga' ba dang po'i tshes la bris/lnga pa chen po rgya nag tu zhabs sor bteg pa nas yar gangs ljongs su ma 'byor gyi bar sgar spyi sger mtha' dag gis spang blang du bya ba'i bka' yig /pya da yu spu tsa kra tsa ma ri tsa yi tsi tra bha 6 shā rnya mo li ma lo ba da sha ba sa/zhabs zung 'khor lo'i ri mo rnam bkra ba/ /srid zhi'i cod pan la 'chang stobs bcu'i rtsal/ /shwa rā kra 6 ra ta ni rwa lha ga tsa dha rma shu kyu si khyu tsu lha ya ba re spri dza ya n+tu /lhun grub chos kyi 'jigs pa med pa'i sgra/ /sgrog mdzad shākya seng ge rgyal gyur cig /mtshams sprin lang tsho dar ba'i 'jo sgeg la/ /shes (32ba)bya thams cad gzigs mor tshar dngar ba'i/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i 'od stong 'di spros tshe/ /mi shes mun pa'i smag rum de ga re/ /bka' dang bstan bcos gzhud lugs gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /nyon mongs dri ma 'khrud pa'i gdams ngag tu/ /—47—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)legs shar lha chos bdun ldan bka' gdams pa/ /sngon med skal ldan shing rta 'di sus bskrun/ /chos kun gzigs pa'i blo gros mig stong can/ /skal bzang 'chi med rnams kyi mgon gcig pu/ /chos kyi rgyal po grags pa'i mu khyud ces/ /sa gsum 'gro ba'i mchod sdong rgyal gyur cig /'di na blang dang dor bya'i pad dkar tshal/ /tshig don nyin mor byed pas legs bskyangs pa'i/ /spang blang 'dzad med sbrang rtsi'i bcud myangs pas/ /don ldan rkang drug glu dbyangs dar dir sgrog /ces bkra shis pa'i tshig gis sngun bsus te/ rgya gar ba rnams na ni zhes dga' bar 'bod cing / rgya nag dbang thang dang bstun pa bod skad du bsgyur ba chu pho 'brug gi lor/ gnam kyis bskos pa sa'i tshangs pa 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i pho brang chen por bteg pa nas bzung / yar dbus gtsang nor 'dzin gyi thig ler ma 'byor gyi bar du/ sgar spyi sger mtha' dag gis spang blang du bya ba dran thor bkod pa la/ mdo sngags kyi grwa tshang sde tshan du bcad pa bdun po rnams yul dus dang bstun pa'i spyir btang dmigs bsal gyi blang dor dgos pa byung na ma gtogs/ dngos gzhi grwa tshang so so'i sngar babs kyi sgrig kun spyod dang bstun pa star chug mdzad pas 'thus shing / drung 'khor bla ma slob dpon nang so rnam pa dkyus ma las tshan yod med rnams dang / drung 'khor du mi gtogs pa'i gzhung sger g.yog gi rigs btsun gzugs/ ban ma hor skya bo sogs mtha' (33na teg gis kyang spyod lam rang dran sgar gyi zhabs 'dren du ma song ba zhig dgos gal che ba nas/ de'ang cho 'phrul chen po'i dus kyi smon lam dang / sgar byings la gzhan gyi tshogs gsog rnyed bkur byung ba'i tshe chos 'khor gling pa/ mnga' dwags gnyas/ ra ba stod pa dang bcasapa'i mtshan nyid kyi grwa tshang bzhi po tshogs pa'i mjug tu gral mtshams bzhag pa'i ngos/ drung 'khor ma yin pa'i gzhung sger gyi skya ser mtha' dag tshogs gral du sgrig /grwa tshang rnams la 'jug snga phyi sna tshogs la dug na'ang / da lam khrag bzhi ka nyung bsdus las yongs rdzogs min cing / de khrod nas legasabashad chos 'khor gling pa gra tshogs che ba 'dug pa'i stabs kyis dbu mdzad dung mkhan chos 'khor gling pas byed/ dge skos kyi tshab kyi sgrigs gnon khrims pa gnyis kyis byed/ 'di'i skabs tshogs —48

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wadadabur bsngo ba bla ma dgos pa byung na khrims pa rgan pa 'dul ba chos rjes byed/ rnam gzhag gtong dgos khrims pa gnyis/ dbu mdzad/ dung mkhan rnams dang / khrims pa gzhon pa gnyis su thun mong du rnam gzhag gcig gtong / grwa tshang bzhi rang tshogs pa'i dus su chos 'khor gling pas gral dbu dang / dge dbu mdzad dung mkhan ja ma rnams byed/ drung 'khor gang yin yol skor 'gag tu tshogs par mang 'gyed kyi skal ba gtong / de mtshungs phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams rgyun gyi bskang gso rnam grangs mang ba dang rgyud pa khag gnyis kyang gsang 'dus gsung pa sbyin bdag tshogs rdzogs par 'dug pas sngags gra khag rnams la yang skal ba gong mtshungs su skyel/ gzhung gi thab tu skol ba'i ja rnams gtong ba'i do dam pa khrims pas byed/ smon lam skabs kyi mchod dbyangs pa mtshan (33ba)nyid grwa tshang khag bzhi nas re re byed/ dgongs mo smon lam gyi skabs mdo sngags kyi grwa tshang thams cad bsres nas 'tshog /drung 'khor rnams tshogs pa'i dus su skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ skabs gsum ma/ sa gsum ma/ sku stod lnga/ brtan bzhugs smon lam lnga/ za mdo/ sgrol ma shes rnying rnams 'don/'grul gyi skabs sgar grol med pa'i snga phyi sna tshogs yod pa dang / char chen po babs pa sogs kyi dus ma yin pa'i tshe/ dgongs mo 'bar rnga'i brda dang bstun nyer len byed dgos kyi rigs ma yin pa'i drung 'khor byings tshogs yul khrims pa'i ngag bkod ltar tshogs pa'i sgrol 'don rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar byed/ dal tshogs skabs/ gzhogs snyes/ rkang pa rkyong pa/ ngan mtshang 'dru ba/ gtam chol mi mdzes pa sna tshogs smra ba/ shags ha gad chen po sogs mi byed/ gur gral gyi nang sgrib g.yogs kyis skyor ba med par rkyang nyal rkang pa rkyong ba/ kob ma snyed pa/ rdog pa rgyag pa/ thag skud yog pa/ 'dzing rgyag /skad rgyang gtong ba/ ku dang bshu rgyag pa/ gos gzan phud nas gcer bur sdod pa sogs spyod lam mi mdzes pa'i rigs mi byed/ tha ma kha 'di myos 'gyur dri ngan gyi rigs su 'dug pas sgar phyi nang gang du skya ser sus kyang ma 'then gal srid 'then pa mthong thos byung ba rnams kyis khrims par babs pa'i chad pa gas la'i drung du mar khal gnyis kyi dkar me dang / yol skor 'gag nas brgya phyag 'bul/—4(3—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)mthong thos byung ba la sbas gsang byas kyang chad pa gong ltar sgrub/ sgar pa ma yin pa'i bod sog gi rigs la sgar gral nang du 'then sa med pa'i brda sbyor/ sgar sgo gsum po ma gtogs gur so so'i bar nas phyi ma'i rgyu (34na)'grul byed du mi 'jug /gur gral nang du rta drel glod nas 'jog pa/ rta bzhon pa/ gnag lug bsten pa sogs mi byed/ mjal kha zhu mi mang ba'i stabs nag khrims la gnang ba 'phral len pa zhig mi yong 'dug pas zhogs pa nyi ma kha dros nas btang / dgong mo nyi ma bzhud pa dang gcod mtshams byed/ dkyil sgar skor lam/ mgron gur ma gtogs gzhan ma phyag mdzod gnyer tshang gis gtsos so so'i gur la rgyu 'grul mi byed cing / gal srid kha ta ngo shes lta bu'i 'gro dgos byung na khrims pa la gnang ba bzhu/ gzhung sger thams cad nas bud med kyi rigs snar du bzo chem la mi 'bad/ nang mchod dang sman rta/ bur chang phran du len dgos byung na khrims par gnang ba zhu zhing gzhan ma chang gi 'grim 'grul mi byed/ sgar gra sgrig lugs sgar tho'i nang bzhin byed/ ca po gnangs che chung gang 'dra zhig rnyed kyang khrims pa la brda spyar ba'i sprod lugs ma gtogs sbas bskums mi byed/rta drel/ sgrog rke thig /mthur mgo sogs gang la yang bsam log gi rkun ma mi byed/ sgar 'degs pa'i dus ca ga thag pa gtso bor bton pa'i rang gang dran byed sa med pas rol cha dang po la g.yas sgar/ gnyas pa la dkyil sgar/ gsum pa la g.yon sgar rnams rim gyis 'grim/ nyin rjes ma la g.yas g.yon go brjes ri mos kyis 'grim/ lam 'phrang dog sar lnga rim gyis 'gro ba ma gtogs shed khyer dang mi dpung gra sdeb sa kyis snga ma la sbud dang 'tshang ka mi byed/ sger gyi phogs len yin phyin mi nag pa yin kyang gri ring dang sag thag 'degs pa/ me mda' 'khyer ba/ ri dwags la gnod (34ba)'tshe sogs mi byed/ sgar dang chibs rags kyi nye skor la sog pos kyang ri dwags mi gsod pa'i brda sbyor/ gal srid byas pa byung na 'og rta len/ dpyad dngos khrag chags sogs sbas bskums byas pa byung na rtsad gcod dos drag byas ngos/ ngo bo la de ga'i rtsis kyi chad pa dang / bdag po la ngo bo the ba'i sum 'jal bsgrub/ yol skor nang du sdod 'os mi 'os kyi bkag sdom mgron gnyer dang sdom —50—

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wanagacod pas byed/ gral sgrig pa'i do dam mgron gnyer gyis gral yig zur gsal ltar byed dgos la/mgron gnyer chung bas go rim ma log pa btang ngos/ mgron gnyer che ba rnams kyis rim sgrig byed cing / snga sleb dang 'tshang kha mi byed/ grwa tshang gnyis po'i slob dpon pa'i gral mgor grwa tshang gsar pa'i slob dpon pa dang dgon chung gi bla ma'i rigs bslab pa rgan yang mi skyil/ chos rje/ mkhan po/ sprul sku'i rigs la gdan thog /bdag rkyen rtog pa bcug nas byed/ bla ma drag rigs dang nang so rnam pa'i g.yog mi babs gon pa/ rta sga chos sogs nas 'gre nges shes pa grangs bcad chibs rags la phyin chog /de phyin sger g.yog gi rigs chibs rags dang drung sgor gyi khrod du mi bsre/ phyag mdzod dang gnyer tshang skor gyi rta bzhen drung 'khor min pa rnams chibs rags las rgyang bcad nas 'gro/ byang lam 'gol sar chibs rags ka dpe ma mi sgrig /gal che sar mgron gnyer gyis chibs rags sgrig pa'i brda byung bstun go rim ma 'khrul bar chig sbrengs ma gtogs nyis gshibs sogs sna tshogs mi byed/ mgron gnyer rnams kyis mjal kha zhu mi 'di bzhin yod tshul ma byung na gal che chung dang bdag rkyen gdan bzos zom (35na)lus yod 'dug pa nas/ mgron gnyer chung ba rnams kyis 'phral 'phral nye len rtog 'jug byas pa'i mi rigs dang kha grangs 'di tsam 'dug mgron gnyer che ba brgyud pa'i gzhogs su gtug dgos dang sku tshab tshor 'phros gtong dgos go rim ma log pa byed/ mgron gnyer che kha la 'phros ma btang bar mgron gnyer chung bas rkang mgyogs stab 'gros ma byed/ mgron gnyer che ba rnams kyis mjal mi 'di tsam yod rim gtong gis zer ba'i bkod pa sdom gcod par byas pa bzhin sor gnas byed/ nyung ja khang du las byed brgyad dang dmigs bsal ma gtogs drag zhan sus kyang 'grim 'grul mi byed/ de'i skyon gnon dgos pa nor bus byed/ gzhung gis 'dogs khyi grangs bcad ma gtogs sus kyang khyi mi gsos/ btsun gzugs yin phyin gri ring skra ring mi byed/gur g.yabs kyi ka tshabs la mdung dang kring rkang mi rgyag sha pags gur thag dang shing sgroms la mi 'gel/ ser mo ba rnams kyis grang nges shes pa'i dus ma gtogs phyu pa dang rtsag pa mi gon zhing —5/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)bod lugs kyi btsun chas bag dang ldan pa byed/ gdan gung ma 'then ring dang dgongs mo ngag 'don la tshugs nas drung 'khor nang la yong bzhin pa rnams ma gtogs yol skor nang la mi yong rol cha ba rnams rol mo bslab sbyang byed pa las gzhan sus kyang pi wang sgra snyan rtsed mo bag yangs/ dkrug sdeb gros ngan phyar ka 'dogs pa sogs mi byed/ phan tshun 'bod phyogs kyang drag zhan so so'i thob thang dang bstun pa snyan phyogs nas 'bod pa ma gtogs ming ngan dang brjod bya mi legs pa'i rigs nas mi 'bod/ phan bde legs bshad gling pa/ rgyud pa khag gnyis ma gtogs gzhan ma dmigs bsal med par sgar (35bskyong du rnga chings mi byed/ mtsher sa sa mkhan rgyus yod kyis byas pa'i rtsa gang bzang dang ba chu chu 'khyil rmye sogs ma yin pa'i chu gang bzang du bab pa ma gtogs gur pa sogs kyis 'os med rig dpyad mi byed/ nged rang nas las tshan so sor bslab ston byas pa'i rigs la sku tshab rnams kyis dri ba ma byas par sgyur bkod mi byed/ khrims pas nye 'gyang phyogs lhung spang zhing / sku tshab gsum gyis gtsos pa'i drag zhan su la'ang mdzes lam du ma song ba'i sgrigs drang 'thad gnon/ de'i rgyab gnyer dang sgrigs la bzos 'jog byed mi byed gyi rtog la jug sku tshab rnams kyis byed/ phogs 'gyed ston mo sogs len skabs tho thog nas ming rim mthon bzhin du kun spyod gang legs kyis yongs pa'i skal ba len pa las 'tshang kha shed spyod/ skad shugs khrams gnyer gyi ngag las 'gal ba mi byed/ tho gsal med par khrims mgron sdom gcod chibs 'chang pa sogs las tshan sus kyang skal 'phar mi len/ drag zhan thams cad kyis nyis len mi byed/ bca' yig gi 'bru don las 'gal bar khrims pas sgyur sbyang lang phyogs drag zhan su 'dra zhig la byed dgos byung yang kha lan lag len mi slog /ser mo ba yin phyin gos dkar gyi rigs dang gos thung mi gon/ gnyer tshang phyag mdzod sogs gzhung gi las tshan rnams kyas kyang so so'i sngo tshan du gtogs par ngan rgyab khu 'dzin byed pa dang / shed khyer la brten pa'i sne mo ba rnams byed mi bde ba'i rigs mi byed/ grwa tshang khag bdun pos kyang gzhan dag dang ba 'dren pa'i chos mthun gtso bor mdzad pa las/ sger gzhung gi sne mo ba rnams la rtsi med sogs —52

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)ar shed rtsing sgal du 'gro ba mi byed/ grwa tshang nang khul du rtsod 'gras byung na so so'i bca' khrims (36na)kyi don ltar byed/ nang tshan ma yin pa'i zlos pa'i rigs dang / phyogs langs dpung gra sdebs byas pa byung na nyes byas mi grangs dang bstun chad pa rta nyi shu nas gsum gyi bar skabs sbyar sgrub/ phyogs 'grol ma yin pa'i smas pa la sma tshabs dang bstun pa'i rta gsum bzhi nas nor lug sogs skabs sbyar/ gri bton par rta nor lug gsum gyi bar skabs sbyar/ bsams bzhin du rta phyugs la brgyab nas mig bcar ba/ rkang lag bcag pa'i rigs la ngo bo bzang ngan dang bstun pa'i rta nor gyi chad pa dang tshab lo ba sprod/ sems skyon ma chags par bya rdo lam 'phrad lta bu'i skyon byung na ngo bo dang mi babs bstun pa'i sems skyon chags ri'i dag bskyal rjes ngo bo de ma'i bzhi zur sprod/ sku tshab gsum dang las chan so sos gzhung don drang por bsrangs pa'i bya ba byed dgos shing las tshan so so'i 'og tu yod pa rnams kyis 'go mis gang zer la nyan pa las 'go 'og tu nga lus ma chur ba'i bya ba mi byed/ sku tshab gsum gyis gzhung don drang por bsrangs pa'i bslab bya byas par drag zhan tshang mas nyan 'jog byed dgos pa sogs gan rgya zur gsal ltar spang blang byed/ 'di nang du ma 'thus pa'i gsar skyes kyi rigs byung na slar bkod pa so so nas nges pa gyis/ legs byas gser ldan lte bar g.yur za ba'i/ /rnam smin dkar por 'dzag pa'i a shāt+pa/ /phan bde'i yal 'dabs rgyas pa' grib bsil la/ /lus can kun gyi ngal gso'i gzhir gyur cig /ces chu pho 'brug lo nyin phyed dbang po 'khrig pa'i khyim du spyod pa'i phyogs snga ma'i dbyangs o 'char ba'i tshes la mtsho mo ra ba bkra shis sum mdor sgar 'byor thog bris pa she yan+tu/ /(36ba)

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesku 'bum byams pa gling gi bca' yig nyung ngu rnam gsal sogs/pa sko sa bhā ba ma dhu ra su ra 'i kho dha :: ska na bra ku khyi la ba ra chu tsa a rdzu tā go /chos phung rgya mtsho'i rang bzhin dbyangs snyan rgyud/ /rmad byung ngag gi yol gor rab 'khyil ba'i/ /gri sa su ma ra si ti khri ya sa mya da ya dz+nyā shā r+ya de ba si ta ya:tsa ma tho li ku / /mtshungs med mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dbyangs can lha/ /mgrin pa'i pad+ma ra bzhugs la shis pa stsol/ /sgrib gnyis tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i nags kyi klung / /tshogs gnyis byin za'i phung pos rab bsregs pa'i/ /rnam 'dren de'i gsung dge 'dun bcas pa rnams/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du phyag gi yul/ /rgyal ba'i yab cig 'jam mgon btsong kha pa/ /bsams bzhin mi yi srid pa bzung ba'i sar/ /rnam gsum 'khor lo'i bya bas rab mdzes pa'i/ /'dus pa'i sde 'di skye rgu'i bsod nams zhing / /'og min dag pa'i rin chen them skas las/ /nyer babs sprul sku'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ /bstan tshe (37na ti bus 'gyur 'chang gi thu bi'i tshal/ /mdo smad btsong kha'i yul du 'phos pa bzhin/ /rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i 'dab ma rab rgyas par/ /brtse ba'i 'dzum gyis phan bde'i bh+ra ma ra:/ /bsu ba'i sngon med pad dkar chun po 'dis/ /chu skyes gzhan la gdung ba'i mdud pa grol/ /ches phra'i na tshod sgo nga'i sbubs rgya nas/ /gsang gsum mi zad 'khor lo'i skad snyan can/ /kun mkhyen ka la piṅka 'di mthong tshe/ /dam par rlom pa phal cher ngur pa'i khyu/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa rmongs chen mun pa'i dpung / /mthar byed dam chos snang ba'i skya rengs ma/ /dkar min 'bras bu'i thun gsum rdzogs pa'i mthar /'char ba'i byed po nyin byed 'di sus bskrun/ /zhing 'dir mgon khyod 'brungs pa'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /phur bus tshig gi 'phreng bar rab bsgrigs nyid / /tshangs pas lo rgyus smra ba'i dka' thub la/ /bskal brgyar 'bad kyang rdzogs pa'i pha mtha' ci/ /de phyir bdag blo'i bung ba'i gshog pa yis/ /legs —54

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wadabashad gdengs can ston par nus min phyir/ /dngos don sku 'bum byams gling 'dus tshogs kyi/ /chos ldan khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa 'dri/ /zhes shis brjod phyag bya dngos po nges bstan gyi tshig snyan pos mdun bsus te gleng bar bya ba la/ yon tan rin po che sdud pa las/ rgyal ba'i nyan thos pa dag ji snyed chos ston dang / 'chad dang rigs pa dag dang ldan par brjod pa dang / mchog 'phags bde ba byed dang de yi 'bras thob pa/ de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthu/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ srid pa dang zhi ba'i legs tshogs thams cad kyi (37ba)byed po ni thub pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la rag lus shing / sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'gro ba 'dren pa'ang legs par gsungs pa'i brjod bya lung gi bstan pa thos bsam gyis gtan la phab/ brjod don rtogs pa'i bstan pa nyams su len dgos bzhin de tshul bzhin du 'dzin pa dge 'dun gyi sde rnam par dag pa la brten nas 'byung bas/ de'ang sngon lha btsan po mes dbon rnam gsum sogs kyi 'bangs bod chen po'i rgyal khams su gtogs pa shar btsong kha'i yul grur/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i sman yon du sprul pa'i zlos gar bstan pa'i nor 'dzin gyi gzhir tsan+dan gyi ljon pa lo 'dab g.yur du za ba'i steng du de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i nga ro'i sku'i snang brnyan 'bum shar ba las dad ldan gyi skye bo du mas mthong ba'i gnas der/ chos sde zhig tshugs na shar phyogs rgya mtsho chen po'i mthas gtugs pa'i bar du rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa 'phel rgyas 'byung ba'i rten 'brel du thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos zhabs kyis bcags shing gsung gi snang ba bstsal bar brten gsar du bskrun pa'i sku 'bum byams pa gling gi bca' khrims ni/ dge 'dun spyi la dgos pa'i khrims kyi rim pa rgyal ba btsong kha pa'i bka' 'bum thor bur bzhugs pa'i yi ge gzhir bzhag /bye brag dmigs kyi bsal ba/ bla ma las thog pas sgrigs bsdam pa sogs chos ldan gyi bya ba'i ris la nyan 'jog mthun rkyen du 'gro ba ma gtogs log sgrub mi byed/ nang mchod dang sman rta ma gtogs —55

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ma/dgon pa'i nang du chang mi len/ gnang (38na〉ba ma zhus par bud med mi gtong zhing zhag tu mi 'jog /dgon pa'i sgrigs 'grim yin phyin gzhi byes tshang mar phu thung dang skra ring gri ring slo cha 'dogs pa sogs 'bags rengs kyi chas spros pa dang / zhwa ser ma gtogs zhwa ris ma gcig pa mi gyon/ tshogs su long gtam smra ba/ bag med kyi spyod pa byed pa/ gnang ba ma zhus par tshogs su mi yong ba mi byed/dpon po yul tshan mthu sdebs sogs la brten pa'i chags sdang gis dkrug shing mi byed/ dgon spyir gnod pa'i nang gtam phyir bskyel mi byed/ so nam sogs 'jig rten pa'i bya bas dam pa'i chos 'dul pa sun dbyung ba mi byed/ sgrigs dang 'gal ba'i ris la bla ma dge skos sogs kyis nye 'gyang spangs pa'i chad las byas pa tshul bzhin bsgrubs dgos shing / de ltar mi sgrub pa dang ngan rgyab byas pa sogs chos sde'i bstan bshig chen por 'gro ba'i ris la gnas dbyung sogs che chung bab thob kyi chad pa 'gel zhing / der ma brtsis pa byung na rgyab gnyer rgya sog kyi dpon po su 'os kyis gyis/ mdor na chos sde'i sgrigs tshul ldan du bgyis pa dang ma bgyis pa'i dpang po dam can srung ma rnams kyis mdzad de tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gyi 'phrin las kyi sgo nas/ chas sde chen po 'di nyid ji srid nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams snang bar byed pa de srid du gnas zhing rgyas pa'i mthun dang ldan par gyur cig /phun tshogs rnam par dge ba'i gru rdzings la/ /brten nas kun mkhyen nor bu'i gling chen por/ /rab bgod don gnyis 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor la/ /(38ba 'gro ba mtha' dag longs su spyod gyur cig /ces sku 'bum byams pa gling gi bca' yig nyung ngu rnams gsal 'di ni/ sku 'bum chos rje grwa bu slob dang bcas pas bskul ba'i ngor 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal ba'i lung gis/ sbru then tā bzhin/ tsi ci'i phyo/ shi wu'i then zhwa/ shi kyis yi thung bi zhi/ lha ta lwa/ tā la'i bla ma zhes/ nub kyi lha gnas/ ches dge ba/ bde bar gnas pa'i sangs rgyas/ bka' lung gnam 'og gi skye 'gro thams cad bstan pa gcig tu gyur pa 'gyur med rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho bla mar grags shing / ming gzhan za hor gyi rigs las a wa spyi tī pa'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sder 'bod —56

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)pa'i ldum bu pas/ rnam rgyal zhes pa chu sprul gro bzhin zla ba'i phyogs phyi ma'i dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la/ gnam sngon zhun mar 'khyil 'dra'i mtsho khri shor rgyal mo'i 'gram nas bris pa dza yas/dbang drag pad+ma drag po he ru ma'i/ /snang ba sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar la/ /chen pa'i nga rgyal dpa' gdengs rab 'chang ba/ /gang shar rang grol drag rtsal rdo rje yis/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs/ /khyad par rta ra shag chen khang pa'i nang / /gnas pa'i 'dre dang phyi nas rgyu byed pa'i/ /lus med rnams la rdo rje'i 'phrin 'di springs/ /skye bar phan btags pha mar ma gyur pa'i/ /'gro ba med phyir gnod bya'i yul ma (39na than/ /kun rdzob zhabrul ngor gnod bya gnod byed kun/ /don dam stong pa'i dbyings su sgrub pa med/ /khyed rnams sngon tshe zhe sdang rang rgyud kyi/ /dbang bsgyur gzhan gnod 'tshe ba mang byas pas/ /'bras bu mi bsrun 'byung po'i lus thob pa'i/ /tshul 'di soms la sdig spong dge ba sgrubs/ /khyad par gnang rigs rjes sbyangs 'gro ba'i gnyen/ gso rig gzhung lugs 'dzin pa'i byang ngos pa/ /nang so dar rgyas mi nor 'khor bcas la/ /bar chad gnod cing 'tshe ba'i rigs mi byed/ /gal ste bsam ngan sbyor ba rtsub gyur na/ /rdzas kyi mda' la sngags kyi dar btags bzhin/ /ting 'dzin ye shes 'bar ba'i rdo rje yis/ /mgo lus tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas pa dang / /ye shes sdig pa nag po mgo dgu pa/ /bco brgyad rwa dang ldan pas khyod rnams kyi/ /snying khrag hub kyis 'thung ba pad+ma'i bka'/ /dam tshig 'gyur med thog ltar bab tā re/ /de skad me sprel hor zla bcu gcig par/ /yongs su grags pa dga' ldan pho brang zhes/ /rig sngags grub pa'i brtul zhugs 'char ba'i gnas/ /dbang drag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang nas bris/ /rang sems 'khrul pa'i dug gsum las skyes pa'i/ /sgyu ma'i seng ge khros 'dra'i lha ma srin/ /sde brgyad bran 'khor mngag gzhug bcas pa rnams/ /sngags 'chang ba 'ad pa rtsal gyi gtam 'di nyon/ /a chi thu zhes bya ba 'di dag gi /mi nor g.yog 'khor phyug dang bcas pa la/ /gnod 'tshe spongs la mthun rkyen sgrub par gyis/ /dge ba bla med byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /gu da phya sa ma ya (39ba)—57—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)gong ra nges gsang rdo rje gling gi khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa/kā sha (ti pra bhā sa bi bla ma ba dz+ra lha sdo rā sgo ga ru dra shi ba la kya ma ya su ni rti/mkha' khyab 'od gsal rang rig rdo rje sems/ /lhun grub 'ja' zer zhi khro sgyu dra'i dgar/bi lha li tā ka ru smo a ཿ ta ci t+ta ma sgyu ba dha ka rā du na nga ga tu 5 tsa dwa la/ /ma smad thugs rje'i rnam rol pad+ma 'byung / /snying dbus ye nas 'bral ba med des skyongs/ /dpal ldan kun bzang ma dros mtsho chen las/ /theg mchog chu bo kun 'bab 'khyil ba'i gzhi/ /rnam gsum yo ga'i bka' babs rig 'dzin dang / /bod yul grub brnyes rje 'bangs nyer lnga rgyal/ /mdo sgyu sems phyogs srol 'dzin so zur gnubs/ /ches dngar mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs 'thul ba'i gter/ /spel mdzad nyang ral chos kyi dbang phyug sogs/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i nyin byed rnams la 'dud/ /sgrib gnyis srog rtsa bcad pa'i khrag rgyun gyis/ /rab myos zhi khro kun 'dus bka' brgyad lha/ /(40na)zab gter snying po'i bstan skyong ral gcig sogs/ /bka' srung dam can rgya mtshos las kun sgrubs/ /nges don zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i lam/ /theg kun rtser bgrod a ti'i rnal 'byor mchog /bsgrub pa'i rig 'dzin gling gi blang dor gyi/ /khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa 'di ltar ro/ /zhes shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gis sdun bsus te lha rnams kyis ched du brjod pa'i grags can gyi bskal pa bzang po 'di la skye dgu rnams kyis las kyi mthus dus bzhir byung ba'i nang tshan rtsod ldan gyi dus ches cher 'dul bar dka' ba'i gdul bya rnams 'dul ba'i don du bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po zhes yongs su mkhyen pa/ ma lus pa spangs pa/ tshul bzhin bsgom pa/ legs par mngon du mdzad pa gang gi bstan pa rin po che ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gis bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing mchog bla na ma mchis pa yin cing / bstan pa mo yang / mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa las/—58

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)'dren pa'i theg pa gsum po dag /bcom ldan nges par gsung lags na/ /rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu spyod cing / /sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i/ /nges pa'i theg pa cis ma gsungs/ /ches zhus pa'i lan du/ rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas/ /'bras bu theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dbang rtul rgyu lam du byed par mosapa rnams la mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang / dbang rnon 'bras bu lam byed la mos pa'i ngor gsang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su bstan pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa gsang (40ba)chen rdo rje theg pa la 'phags pa'i yul du rgyud sde rin po che rnams kyi bka' babs kyi byung tshul rnam grangs ches mang na yang / yo ga rnam pa gsum gyi lugs la 'og min gyi gnas su thog ma'i mgon po dpal kun tu bzang po'i thugs kyi dgongs pa las snye bar brgyud de rdo rje sems dpas dga' rab rdo rje la a ti yo ga'i skor thabs dang brda la brten gsungs shing / lha klu mi'i rig 'dzin la brgyud nas rgyal po jo'i khang steng du tan+t+ra chen po ste bco brgyad babs pa la brten nas ma hā dang a nu'i theg pa rnams byon pa bsil ldan bod kyi rgyal khams 'dir mkhan slob chos gsum bi ma la mi tra sogs lo paṇa rnams kyi bka' drin las gsang sngags snga 'gyur zhes nyi zla lta bur gsal ba'i theg pa mchog gi bstan pa 'di la/ thang yig las/ slob 'chad grwa la rje yis mthun rkyen sbyor bod kyi ban sngags dbu zlum lcang lo can/ zhes mchod gnas sde gnyis su gsungs pas/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes nas nye bar bzung ste so zur gnubs gsum sogs sngags sde phal cher gos dkar lcang lo'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa sha stag tu byon cing / 'dul ba'i skabs rab tu byung ba'i rtags rnams mkhan pos gnang zhing bskon pa zhig dgos par bshad pas khyim pa rnams kyis rab byung gi cha lugs 'dzin mi 'os pa shugs las byung yang / theg pa chen po'i sde snod du yan lag brgyad pa'i gso sbyong blangs kyang / mtha' gcig tu tshangs par spyod pa'i nges pa med cing sgrib par mi 'gyur ba'i skabs mang du bshad cing / sgyu 'phrul las/ sems nyid theg par rab nges na/ /nyon mongs 'dod lnga kun spyad kyang / /pad+ma la ni 'dam —59

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)bzhin te/ /byas la (41na)mi gsog sdom pa'ang rdzogs/ /zhes dang / slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes/theg chen dam tshig la gnas na/ /'og ma'i 'dul sdom dam tshig kun/ /bsrungs pa med par thub pas na/ /dge slong byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug ces bya'o/ /zhes pa ltar theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor dang ldan pa rnams theg dman gyis gzhal ba'i yul las 'das pas ngo bo dge bsnyen la rnam pa rab byung gi cha lugs can yang sngags rnying ma'i phyogs su mang du byung bas so/ /de yang ji skad du/ dge slong mchog yin dge tshul 'bring / /khyim na gnas pa tha ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i gsang sngags sgrub pa'i rten la rigs gsum du bshad pa'ang / bslab pa'i gnas la mchog dman yod pa'i dbang gis yin la/ de'i tshul ni/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ mi dge bcu po yongasaspong bar/ /byed pa de ni dge bsnyen te/ /bslab pa'i gnas bcu rab sbyin pa/ /srung byed de ni dge tshul yin/ /bslab pa bye ba'i gnas byin nas/ /brtul zhugs byed pa dge slong ngo / /zhes byung ba'i phyir/ gong gi nang tshan gsum las khyim pa'i sngags sde lugs bzhin byed na sngar bshad pa des khyab la/ rab tu byung ba'i rten la gsang snga gas bsgrub pa'i lugs srol ltar spro tshe nges par rab dge slong /'bring dge tshul/ tha ma'ang bar ma'i tshul khrims tsam zhig blangs pa dgos par sngon chad gong ra rnying pa ba rnams sdom pa sna gcig kyang ma blangs bar rab tu byung bar rlom pa'i phyi dro'i kha zas sogs 'bad pas bkag pa'i srol yod 'dug pa ni mu stegs byed kyi zas gcod pa dang me lnga bsten pa'i brtul zhugs ltar ngal ba 'bras bu med pa'i 'khor (41ba〉du bskor bar zad pa'i phyir/ thub pa'i rang lugs dang mi mthun pa lung du ma bstan pa'i spyod pa ni blun po'i rang mtshang tsam du zad la/skabs don rdzus gter rang bzo'i dri ma can rnams spangs te dge lugs bstan srid la log sgrub tu mi 'gro ba dgos tshul sa skyong phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan gyis bkod 'doms dang bcas khra tshang pa mkhas grub chen po blo gros mchog gi rdo rje bla mar bskos kyang sngar srol lugs ngan la zhen pa rlams kyis tshul ྅ na ma byas par brten/ grub mthas bslad pa'i chos dang gang zag rnams dbyung ste —60

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)bstan pa spyi rim dang sger gzhung gi rim gro sogs sgrub pa'i ched gsar du spel pa'i gong ra nges gsang rdo rje gling gi sde 'dir spang blang gi rims pa ni/ bshad rgyud rdo rje 'phreng ba las/ phyi ru nyan thos spyod pa bsrung / /nang du 'dus pa'i don la dga'/ /zhes pa ltar/ rab tu byung ba'i sngags sde mtshan nyid dang ldan pa byed pa la thog mar gsar bu ba rnams bar chad dang ldan mi ldan legs par brtags te rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs rang nyid dbang ba 'am/ ma mtha' brnyan po tshun chad kyis tshang bar byas la bar ma'i tshul khrims dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa gang rung na rgyan gzhon dang bstun pa'i bsgrub tu 'jug lo tshegs su sleb cing bsnyen par rdzogs 'dod yod pa rnams kyang bar ma'i skabs ltar spyir btang dmigs bsal gyi 'gal rkyen med cing mthun rkyen tshang ba 'dug na bsgrub tu 'jug /rtsa bzhi gco bor gyur pa'i bslab khrims rnams dge 'dun spyi khrims la mi gnod pa'i legs par bsrung / de'ang so thar gyi mdo las/ sems rta kha bslan dka' ba la/ /mthun pa'i gzer rnon brgyab pa yi/ /srab ni so sor thar pa yin/ /zhes bstan pa'i rtsa ba/ (42na)so thar gyi khrims la brten nas rang rgyud 'dul ba'i thabs kyis gzhi bzung / gtso bor thos bsam du bya ba na/ 'khrul med gling pa'i nang tshan rig 'dzin chen po rat+na gling pas gnam skas brag nas spyan drangs pa'i dbang chen 'dus pa'i chos sde zhal gdams gsal ba'i sgron me las/ shin tu zab pa'i mthar thug snying po rnams/ spyir yang bod rnams sar ngas che ba dang / snyigs ma'i 'gro ba lhag par snying rje bsaḥ mtha' dbus thams cad gter gyis bkang nas bzhagaḥ las can bu dang phrad pa'i smon lam btab/ /ma 'ongs dus su rtog ge tha snyad mkhan/ /sgom chen la sogs phyogs dang ris dred can/ /rang che 'byin cing gter la rtsod na yang / /snyigs ma'i chos byed phal cig gter gyi 'dren/ /zab la kha tshar ma bsgribs mtha' rgyas shing / /gdams pa sna ris gang zag grol bar nges: /de bas las sad skal ldan sbyangs pa can/ 'chi ba dran na gter chos nyams su long / /tshe gcig thar lam 'thob bo rjes 'jug rnams: snyigs dus gter la mos pa'i skal ldan rnams/ /deng sang ghu ru'i zhal mthong smom lam thob/ /thams cad las —6)/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)can yin pas dga' ba sgoms/ /zhes pa ltar gter kha gong 'og lha brag gi gter gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i gter kha gsar rnying gi 'phrin las sgrub bskor gyis thog drangs gsol 'debs smon lam sogs kyis mtha' brten pa'i tshogs 'don 'og tu gsal ba rnams kyi slob dpon sogs la brten nas slob sbyang la brtson par byas ngos/ shes rab dang bstun pa'i zla grangs lo gcig (42bskos tsam dang / mang mtha' 'ang lo gsum tshun la khong du chud par byed/ rab tshes bcu'i 'chams dang gal te ma 'grub kyang bka' brgyad zor 'chams/ gar thig dbyangs gsum/ bris 'bur/ bde yig gzab shur/ brda dag /rtsis skar nag gtor mdos sogs lus ngag gi yon tan la sbyang bdar byed/gong gsal gyi bslab sbyang rnams grub rjes sgyu 'phrul gsang snying rtsa bshad/ rong zom chos bzang /sman lung shākya 'od/ tshong 'dus pa g.yung ston rnams kyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa sogs gzhung chen po rnams bslab sbyang gis mtshon pa'i mang du thos pa 'tshol/ 'on te legs sbyar la sbyangs na gnas lnga'i pha rol du son thabs su 'gyur zhing de lha'i dpyod ldan rnams la gtsug lag kun gcig grogs su gcig 'gro na'ang / cung zad thos rlom gyi blo chung phal cher rnying ma'i sngags zur chag mi ma yin dang 'gro lding skad sogs la som nyi dang / klog thabs kyang rang lugs dor te sgra pa ltar bklags pas sngags nus nyams te ji tsam bzlas kyang 'bras bu nam mkha'i dbyings su deng par byed pa'i nyes dmigs yod pas ka tsan sogs sgra rig mi bslab/ mi bsad pa/ rin thang tshang ba'i dngos po brku 'phrog /dge 'dun spyi rdzas la sbas shubs/ mi tshangs spyod kyi skyon/ tha mi kha'i du ba rngub pa/ mtshon sogs brdegs pa la brtan pa'i rmas 'gram tshabs chen bzos pa byung na gnas dbyung / sman rta ma gtogs chang btungs pa/rmas phran bu cam gyi lag 'dres pa'i 'thab rtsod/ /spyi don la sger gyi 'khon zhe bzhag gi ngan len len pa/ /phan tshun dkrug rkyen gyi phra ma byed pa la mngon tshan dang tshabs che chung la gzhigs pa'i tshabs (43na tha ris la mang ja/ tsha ra/ thug dar lcog /dkar me snyan dar/ bla mar bdun tshan/ sne mo ba rnams la rnam gzhag gtong / /rma gsos gtong cha sogs tshad ldan dang / chung ba'i ris la mang ja snyan —62

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)dar/ bla mar 'bul ba sum tshan/ sne mo bar rnam gzhag sogs rgyas bsdus rim 'gros kyis 'gel/yul dang thab grogs sogs bde tshan du bcad pa'i mi dpung dgra sdebs la brten pa'i ngan rgyab kha 'dzin byas pa/ bla ma dbu chos sogs kyi sgrigs mnan par mi brtsi ba'i log sgrub tshan chen byas pa byung na ste po ngo bo gnas dbyung / tshan chung ba'i ris gong gsal mang ja tsha ra sogs kyi chad las 'gel/ tshong 'dus sogs tshong ra'i sar yo byad bsgrub par 'gro mi rnams kyis sngon mas tshong thag ma chod par phyi mas hab thob dang dog 'tshangs mi byed/ byas tshe snyan dar 'gel/ gong ra dang chu bo ri'i zo bo 'chi med bkod pa sogs gtsang dgon gyi ris su gnas mjal/ chos zhu rnyed bkur byed mi dmigs bsal gnang ba zhus pa ma gtogs gling gseb tu bud med mi gtong / ri lung sbug lta bu'i ser khyim dgon rnams su grwa dmangs chos thog bteg tshe bla brang gi nag mtho tshun la nag khrims gong bzhin byed/ gtang na gtong mkhan su yin la mang ja dang snyan dar 'gel/ nang mchod gser skyems tshogs chang dam tshig gi rdzas su nyung ngu ma gtogs chang gi ris mi len/ nad pa'i sman rta dang mkhar las sogs la dmigs bsal gyis len dgos byung na gnang ba zhu/ ma zhus par blangs tshe mang ja 'gel/ bsam gtan gyi tsher mar 'gro ba'i gling gseng nas skad rgyang gtong ba/ ku co 'don pa/ gzhisabyes (43ba)gang 'du'ang mchongs brgyag pa/ mda'/ 'ur rdo/ rdo sgor brgyag pa sogs mi byed/ gal ste byas na mang ja bsnyan dar 'grel/ gos phu thung ma/ kha dog ma 'gyur ba'i dkar po/ ska rags phu gu can/ phor shubs 'dogs pa/ sgom thag dra phad/ gri ring / skra ring / sug rtsa/ jom pa gyon pa sogasami byed/ byas tshe dngos po ngo bo 'phrog cing snyan dar 'gel/ o rgyan paṇa zhwa ma gtogs/ rtse zhwa/ paṇa zhwa/ sgom zhwa/ 'bar zhwa/ pags zhwa sogs zha ris sna tshogs mi gyon/ gyon pa byung na chad las gong bzhin byed/ tshogs la chos gos zhe gcig byung na legs shing ma byung kyang gding ba nges par bsgrig /zhing sngo thog la lam po mi bya zhing dud 'gro zar mi la jug /byung na de'i gun yong nges zhing bdag la sprod/ shes bdag la gra pa 'gro mi bla brang nas thog gang bcugs 'gro zhing / de la bsod stoms la(33

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)'gyed/ tsha ra sogs gang byung gi skal pa ma chad pa gtong / spyi sger gyi don la grong gseb sogs su song ba rnams nye du ma yin pa'i bud med dang gnas khang gcig tu zhag por nyal pa sogs dogs gnas kyi gzhi chen po yod pa mi byed cing / gal te byas pa byung na bslab skyon med pa lag 'dogs tshad ldan dang bcas pas dag pas bkrus na ma gtogs slar grwa khyur mi 'jug /sger gzhung drag yin gang gi rim gro sogs grong chog gi ris la'ang bag yod cing cho ga phyag len sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i gang rgyas ma gtogs sbyin bdag dad pa log rkyen du 'gro ba mi byed/ gling gseb kyi spyil po 'tshong na bla ma dang dge skos la 'dri/ gling gi spyil po bshig nas bsgril ba sogs mi byed/ rten gsum/rol mo/ snyan (44na)dar/ 'bag phod/ rus rgyan/ phyag mtshan sogs bcag grum chud zos la btang ba byung na skyin tshab bsgrig /byed mi rtsad ma chod cing ngos mi len na mdo sgrub kyis mtshams gcod/gong ra'i gra rnying snang sogs goms gsum gyi lta grub la chen pa'i ma rungs pa'i ris la/ gnas tshang gtong ba dang sten skyob 'dris chen byas tshe sbal pa rma can gyi dpe bzhin gra pa gsar pa skyon med rnams kyang lhad can du 'gro ba'i snyen 'dug pas mi byed cing / byas pa byung na tshogs su mang ja tsha ra /bla mar lnga tshan/ sne mo ba rnams la snel gtong byed/ nye skor gyi spyi la stong dang phug pa tshor sdad ma sdad dge skos kyis gsang bdar byed cing / gzhan gyis tshor ba byung kyang spyi sor 'phros btang ba'i 'phral du dbyung zhing mdo sgrub kyis mtshams gcod shes bzhin du 'phros ma btang na snyan dar 'gel/ phyi nang skya ser gang gi dngos dpyad bor ba rnyed na bdag po ngo shes na dang ma shes na dge skos la sprod/ gling gi lam srang dang chu 'go sogs su bshang gci mi 'dor/ 'du khang gi rtsig pa ka ba sogs la mchil snabs mi 'dor/ grwa ris yo byad med pa'i nad pa byung tshe dkon mchog dang dge 'dun gyi rdzas kyi steng nas sa rim gro byed/ nad sos nas dngos po 'byor ba yod na gun bsab/ sde 'dir mi gsogs pa'i nad pa nyam thags pa byung yang zas gos sman dpyad gdams ngag sogs kyis phan 'dogs/ g.yin gyi khrims las 'gal ba'i nag chen zhu ba byung tshe phan pa bsgrub/ dgon pa nas rgyang grags gcig —64

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (5)tshun gyi ri dwags dang nya gshor mi byung tshe bsrung sdom byed/ tshogs su 'du ba'i tshe dung 'khar rnga sogs kyi brda dang bstun spyod lam mdzes (44ba)pas 'du zhing bslab gral/ skad gral/ sngags brgyud khungs btsun gyi rigs la che gral dang bcas te gral ma 'khrugs par byed/ dung mjug rdzogs mtshams tshogs su ma 'byor tshe brgya phyag 'grel/ tshogs 'don gyi tshe gnyid log pa/ long gtam smra ba/ ba 'ad gad bya zhid slong ba/ rtsig pa dang ka ba la snyeb sogs spangs te 'phrin las sgrub thabs ngag nas brjod pa dang bstun so so'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs ris dang bcas te gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor ming dang don mthun par byed pas mtshon chos spyod kyi rab 'degs/ grong chog sogs la phyin pa'i yon gyi ris gang byung rnams grwa tshang spyi thog tu 'jog pa ma gtogs so sos mi 'khyer/ dge 'dun spyi la 'bul ba byung na spyi rdzas kyi thebs su 'jog /lag gtod kyi 'gyed rnams so so dbang zhing dmigs bsal mchod rdzas sogs spyi'i dgos byed la dgos nges byung tshe spyi 'bul gyi khongs su bsdu/ zla re bzhin du tshes brgyad la 'bras shangs lha ri rin chen snying po nas rig 'dzin chen po legs ldan rdo rje lhan spyan drangs pa'i tshe sgrub bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i las byang sngon 'gro gnyis bsnyen sgrub kyi gzung sngags dang bcas pa'i rjes su brtan bzhugs brtse ldan ma dang bye ba phrag brgya ma/ zlog rim shis brjod dang bcas pa/ tshes bcu la gter kha 'og ma'i klu bdud gtsug gi zab gter bla ma gsang 'dus kyi sgrub gzhung lhan thabs/ gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma brgyud 'debs rnams dang bcas pa/ rig 'dzin chen pos bsam yas kyi rnam snang gi thugs ka nas gdan drangs pa'i thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi las byang / gter srung mchod pa/ sgrob dpon chen po'i thugs kyi nying khu gter kha (45na sgog ma'i phur pa yang gsang spu gri'i bka' srung rnams kyi mchod gtor dang bcas pa/ bcu bzhi la dus gtor bdag bskyed du byang gter gyi dbus snying mdzod smug po nas spyan drangs pa'i zhi ba rig 'dzin gdung sgrub las byang sngon 'gro gzer lnga sogs/ chog sgrigs par ma ltar dang / dus gtor tshor mdo mgon rgyud mgon gnyis bka' ma/ ldeng ma lhun rgyal gyi gter ma'i sngags srung / gter kha gong ma'i 'bar —65

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ma/ma/ stag bzhen/ drag po bde 'dus kyi gzhi bdag gtor ma/ 'og ma'i ma ning / bdud 'dul re ma twe/ rnam sras/ sde dpon sum cu/ thag ston pad+ma'i gter ma srog sgrub re ma tī/ byang gter gyi bka' srung brgyad mchod de chos skyong gter srung rnams/ bco lnga la ltung bshags/ bzang spyod/ mtshan brjod/ ngan song dong sprug rgyas pa/ nyer gsum la mang ja 'grub na dus gtor gang 'gro gtong / nyer lnga la sgyu 'phrul bka' ma rgyas bsdus gang 'grub dang / rnam thar dri med ma/ sangs rgyas dwags ston gyi mdzad pa'i rdzogs chen brgyud 'debs/ bka' brgyad brgyud 'debs 'og min chos dbyings ma/rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i gsol 'debs smin byed dbang gi chu rgyun/ dpal ldan sa gsum ma/ blo bzang rgyal ba ma/ ri bo che'i khro rol chen mo'i
