phyag len sogs la phan khyad kyis nyer dgu la bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs las byang lhan thabs dang bcas pa'i cha tshang / sgyu 'phrul skong bshags/ bka' brgyad mdangs skong / chos skyong skor cha tshang / smad las rgyas pa spyi bskul/ dmod byang / gser skyems/gzu dpang / tshogs tha ma'i bsgral (45ba tshe pas stobs pa/ dmar sbreng / gtor dril/ gtor zor/phyir zlog /tshe 'gugs sogs mtha' rgyas shis brjod dang bcas pa/ gdangs dbyangs/ rnga chings/rkang gling / dung chen sogs spros bcas don dang 'brel ba/ gnam gang la brtsams bcos min pa'i gter gzhung gang 'os kyi lha bsangs brgyags rngan/ rgyun du par bgab med kyang 'char ka gnam skas ma/ kiskor dmar nag sogs kyang gzhung sger gyi sku rim la yong ba byung tshe thogs med yod pa'i lag len dpe cha sogs la do dam byed/ nar ma'i dge sbyor thun rnga btang ba dang bstun thun drug la gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma rten bskyed dang bla ma sku gsum ma sngon du 'gro ba'i skabs thob so so'i gsol 'debs mjug sdud dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang rgyun gyi nyams len la so so'i blo dang bstun te bstod tshogs brgyud 'debs dang / thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i ma ṇi gang 'gro'am/rang rang gi yi dam zur gsal chag med yod na de bzhin byed/ gshin don la ngan song dong sgrug /smon lam rnam gsum sogs dang / sbyin bdag gi sku rim la so so'i dmigs bsal med tshe/ skyabs —66

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)sems yan lag bcu pa/ brgyud 'debs/ ja mchod 'dren pa mnyam med dang legs byas ma gnyis/mtshan brjod/ gsol 'debs tshe 'dzab/ tshe gzungs/ tshe 'gugs/ sher snying / 'joms byed byol zlog /nan dgu ma/ yang zlog /bde legs su byed pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rnams bya/ tshes bcu chen mo'i dus chen tshad ldan nam mthongs phyi ma yin kyang / rnyed pa tshol sla khyad kyis gong rar hor zla drug par byed rgyun yod 'dug pa 'brel mi che'ang skyon chung ba'i dbang du byas sngar (46na)babs su bzhag pa'i tshes brgyad nas bcu gnyis bar rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gsum so sor zhengs nas/ bla ma gsang 'dus/ bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs/ phur pa spu gri gsum gang rgyas gtong / cho 'phrul mchod pa zhag bco lnga dang / nam mthongs sngon mar zhag bco lnga'i ring chu bo ri 'chi med bkod par gong dkar rdzong nas mthun rkyen star chug bzhin tshe sgrub bdud rtsi 'khyil pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas tshe chog gang rgyas byed/ hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer dgu la mgon po legs ldan gyi mdos gtong / phung po ri bo cher hor zla bcu pa sngags pa zor mdos kyi zla ba la bstan pa spyi rim khro bo rol pa rang byung rang shar thugs kyi me long sogs ma bslad pa'i bde 'dus sor bzhag gi tshig don/ 'khor lo/ gtor ma/rdzas/ bsnyen sgrub/ phyag len rnams sla bcos su ma song ba'i 'phyug med dang / hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du 'khor lo gong ltar gtong / grwa tshang rang nas dus mchod gtong dgos sogs chad 'khrums med pa deb nang bzhin gtong / gong gsal gyi 'phrin las sgrub thabs sogs nyams su len pa la'ang smin byed kyi dbang grol byed kyi 'khrid rgyab rten gyi lung sogs dgos pas dbang rig gtad/ 'khrid lung man ngag phyag bzhes sogs 'bad pa chen pos thos shing zhun thar gcod/ lho byang gi gter kha gang yang rung ba'i rig 'dzin bla ma dang bka' brgyad phur pa gshin rje sogs rang gang mos kyi yi dam la bsnyen sgrub tshad du thongs pa byed/ tshogs 'don gong gsal rnams mang nyung 'tsham par mngon zhing yang sbyin bdag sogs kyi mthun rkyen la brten gsar 'phar 'dzugs pa'i dpyad gzhi shar tshe gter (46bskong 'dod na/ sprul sku rgya 'kho khrom/ tshe brtan rgyal mtshan/ mung po byang chub gling pa/ rat+na gling —67

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)pa sogs gling pa bcu gcig /dri med gsum gyis mtshon pa'i ris dang / gter gsar byed sgor spro na mnga' ris paṇa chen dang / 'bri gung zur pa rin po che/ 'phrang 'go gter ston/ byang bdag rig sngags 'chang ba chen po rnams kyi gter kha gang 'os las gter gsar gyi ming thogs tshad mi bya zhing /khyad par snang sogs gong gsung gyi gter chos brtsams chos lta ci smos/ de dag brgyud par yod pa'i chos kyang spangs nas mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma nyams pa'i zab gter 'khrul med rnams nyams su blangs te mchog thun gyi dngos grub bsgrub par rigs so/ /de ltar thos bsam gyi rim pa blang dor go ldog pa sogs byung na bla ma dbu chos sogs kyis thog mar ngag bshad sdig bkrol gyi brda sprod/ de la'ang lkog tu gyur tshul gyis bsgo ba rnar mi gzon pa rnams la chad las sogs kyis nan tung bya/des kyang ma ldog na gnas nas dbyung ste rjes kyi mig bltos la mi gnod cing 'dus sde yun ring du gnas pa'i thabs tshul la 'bad par bya'o/ /thub bstan zla ba'i ma ma'i yang snying nor/ /pad 'byung ring lugs nyin mor byed pa yi/ /'phrin las 'od kyis gangs can rgud pa'i mun/ /rab bcil phan bde'i snang ba rgyas gyur cig /nges legs zung 'jug sar bgrod gsang ba'i lam/ /rdo rje'i theg kun rtser son rdzogs pa che/ /chas sku' rang zhal mngon sum mjal nus gling / /nyi zlas mun sel de srid rgyas gyur cig /tshe dbang rigs 'dzin lus kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /sgrub pa sde brgyad srung mar bcas pa rnams/ /gdod nas rang zhal mthu yis bstan (47na)pa dang / /de 'dzin g.yo med dus kun rgyas gyur cig /ces gong ra nges gsang rdo rje gling gi khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa zhig dgos zhes rdo rje slob dpon chen po gtso bor gyur pa'i spyi tshogs kyis 'bad rtsol la brten nas bca' yig drang srong ṛ sti'i dkyil 'khor zhes bgyi ba 'di ni khro mo zhes pa shing pho 'brug gyi lo khrums kyi zla ba'i tshes lnga lhag pa lha mtshams kyi 'grub sbyor thog za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs kyis bgyis pa su sid+dhi ra sdu/ /—68

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig/ (wa)dga' ldan thub bstan rab rgyas kyi dge 'dun spyi'i khrims su bca' ba dran pa'i lcags kyu/sag⑧ṅgātu rgatan dzag ri dz+nyā na tsa〉pa pāḥshā bā ronāpā yī pa tu na ra dza tsā bishā mā hā ka ru khyu//rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sems can rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa bag la nyal//rdul bral ye shes spyan gyis nyer gzigs sna tshogs thabs mkhas thugs rje che//sgru yog ma k+ṣaḥsu khagatatsa tu rlag nā grwa su ka lha nā ma pradzathig bha ba ya sha tsā shākya siṅgādza yas/mngon par mtho dang nges legs sar sbyor bskal bzang rnam 'dren (47ba)bzhi pa'i mtshan//grags snyan srid pa'i rtse mor rab 'bar zas gtsang sras po rgyal gyur cig/rgyal kun yab tu zur phud lnga ldan pa//gnag snum lcang lo'i thor tshugs cher ldem yang //ljongs 'dir ngur smig gar gyis thub pa'i bstan//rgyas mdzad blo bzang grags pa'i dpal des skyongs//rab dkar 'dus sde'i pad tshal rnyog byed pa//nyon mongs brlang por spyod pa gnyis 'thung snar//bag yod khrims su bca' ba'i lcags kyu yis//dul ba'i rnam thar gtsang byed 'di na'o//zhes shes pa brjod pa'i tshig gis sngun bsus te//'o skol gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po zhes mtshan gyi sgra dbyangs rna bar thos pa tsam gyis kyang srid zhi'i gdung ba ma lus pa sel bar nus pa gang des/tshogs gnyis kyi mthu phul du byung ba bsags nas 'og min du bla med ye shes mchog gi go 'phang mngon du mdzad de/dbus 'gyur 'chang rdo rjes spa ba'i bstan la mchog gi sprul pa'i skur ri tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan nas chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor la/'phags pa'i nyan thos chen po 69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)rnams kyis bka' bsdu ba rim pa gsum du mdzad cing / shing rta chen po gnyis la sogs pa'i paṇa grub dam pa rnams kyis bstan pa nyi zla ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i rgyun ma nyams pa bod gangs kyi ra bas bskor ba'i rgyal khams su chos rgyal mes dbon bla mchod lo paṇa rnams kyi bka' drin la thub pa'i ring lugs dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel bar gyur pa'i theg pa'i tshul la mchog dman bar pa mtha' klas kyang / 'jig rten na yongs su grags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni dam pa'i chos 'dul ba la byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ gleng bzhi las/ (48na)btsun pa ji tsam gyis na dam pa'i chos mchis pa zhes bgyi/ ji tsam gyis na zhig pa zhes bgyi/ u pa li ji srid du las byed cing nan tan byed pa'ang yod pa'i bar du ste/ las byed la nan tan byed pa'ang yod pa'i dam pa'i chos yod pa zhes bya'o/ /las kyang mi byed la nan tan byed pa dag kyang med na de ni dam pa'i chos zhig pa zhes bya'o/zhes pa'i don la dgongs nas/ 'gos lo thams cad mkhyen pa yid bzang rtse bas/ de ltar bod yul 'dir 'dul ba'i bstan pa la 'phel 'grib cher byung mod kyi/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi bstan pa ni/ deng sang gi bar du nub ma myong zhing / zhes gsungs la/ 'brog mi lo chen dang stag lo gnyis rgya gar du rdzong ba'i dus/ mkhan slob gnyis kyi zhal bkod la/ bstan pa'i gzhi ma yin pas 'dul ba nyon/ /bstan pa'i snying po yin pas sher phyin nyon/ /bstan pa'i nying khu yin pas gsang sngags nyan/ /zhes 'byung bas/ ji skad du/ ji ltar 'dir na shing rtsa gtso bo ste/ /rnam par 'phel dang kun 'dzin gnyis kyi gzhi/ /de bzhin dam chos tshogs rnams thams cad kyi/ /gzhi dang rtsa ba 'dul ba yin par gsungs/ /zhes ljon shing gi rtsa ba nyams par gyur na lo 'bras mtha' dag bskams par 'gyur pa ltar/ 'dul ba'i sde snod ni theg pa che chung gi chos g.yin mtha' dag gi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa de 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun la rag lus shing / dge 'dun gyi sde rnams khrims gtsang mi gtsang gi rjes su 'gro ldog byed par ma (48ba)zad/ khyad par dpal mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid la bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa la gtso bor —7()

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)'don pa rje bdag nyid chen po'i rnam thar gtso bo yin pas/ thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i spyi mes chen po rje yid bzang rtse pas/ dus kyi dbang gis dge slong lhod pa'ang mang rab byung ba ni/ rje btsun dam pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis dang por skyor mo lung du mkhyen chen blo gsal ba las 'dul ba legs par blangs/ phyis dben pa'i gnas rnams su sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa'ang 'dul ba'i kun tu spyod pa las ma 'das/ phyis 'khor skyong ba'i tshe 'ang drung na 'khod pa thams cad 'dul ba nas ji skad bshad pa'i chos gos gsum gding ba dang lhung bzed la sogs pa mkho ba'i yo byad rnams 'dzin du bcug jo bo chen po lha gcig gi man ngag la brten nas skyes bu gsum la blo sbyangs nas 'khor ba mtha' dag las yid 'byung ba'i blos sdom pa thams cad so so thar pa mtshan nyid pa la bkod/ de dag gi spyan ltos la brten nas bod kyi khams 'dir 'dul ba'i bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar gyur pa yin no/ /zhes bsngags brjod mdzad pa ltar sngon byung gi rnam thar la rjes 'jug gis nyams su len pa zhig dgos pas/ mkha' 'gro blo bzang bstan skyong gis bstan pa'i 'khas 'degs dang tshogs gsog gi ched du gsar du btsugs pa'i dga' ldan thub bstan rab rgyas su grags pa'i 'dus sde 'di nyid kyi khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa/ gangs ri'i dbang po 'o de gung rgyal gyi lha zhol dben gnas byams pa gling du thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa chen pos 'dul khrims gtso bor bton (49na)pa'i bca' yig che chung gnang 'dug pa la gzhi byas/ yul dus gnas skabs su dgos pa'i dmigs bsal gyis brgyan te bkod pa la/ de yang thar pa don du gnyer ba'i gang zag rnams kyi lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum nyams su blang dgos pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi gzhi rten tshul khrims kyi bslab pa nyams su len pa la/ thog mar gsar bu 'ongs pa rnams kyis sdom pa ma thob pa thob par byed dgos pas/ bar chad can rab tu byung na mkhan slob dge 'dun gyi sde sogs la gnod pas bar chad yod med legs par brtag /med par nges pa rnams la bla gos mthang gos gding ba chu tshags sogs rang nyid kyi 'am tha na'ang brnyan po tshun chad kyis tshang bar byas shing / lo —71

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)tshigs su ma sleb pa dang bsrung ba'i mtshams mi zin pa ma yin pa rnams rab tu byung ba bsgrub tu gzhug cing gong gi dgag bya dang ldan pa rnams mi 'jug /rtags cha lugs rnams bdag gir byar rung ba zla ba gsum tshun la nges par shoms pa byed/ sdom pa ma blangs pa dang / blangs kyang rtags cha lugs mi tshang ba tshogs su mi 'jug /rab tu byung zin pa phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i ris gsar du 'jug pa dag byung na/ sde ga then nas dbyung ba dang bslab pa nyams ma nyams sogs brtag /bsnyen par rdzogs 'dod pa rnams kyang bar chad dang mi ldan zhing mthun rkyen rnams tshang dgos pa sngar dang 'dra/grwa sar zhugs ma thag pa nas bzung zla ba gcig gnyis sogs yun ring thung so so'i blo mchog dman dang bstun gnas kyi slob dpon bsten nas lung rnam 'byed las gsungs pa'i sdom gyis bsdus (49ba)pa'i bslab khrims dang / lung gzhi dang phran tshegs skabs kyi 'byung nye ba'i blang dor rags pa rnams la sbyangs te/ rab tu byung ba rnying pa rnams dang spyod lam mthun par byed/ dge 'dun spyi'i chos spyod kyi rim pa rnams kyang sngar gyi slob dpon de ga 'am yang sngags kyi cho ga sogs la mkhas pa g.yin dag yod na'ang ji ltar 'os pa bsten pa'i bshar sbyang la brtson par byas nas rang rang gi shes rab dang bstun ngos lo gsum la ma mtha' byas pa'i khong du chud par byed/ rtsa ba bzhi las 'das na 'chab med rnams slar bskyar zhing 'chab can rnams gnas nas dbyung / dge 'dun lhag ma'i lhung ba la spo mgu dbyung gsum dang sbom po ltung byed nyes byas sogs che chung dang bstun pa'i dge 'dun dang gang zag la so sor bshags pa skabs su gang bab byed/ mkhan slob sogs kyi gnang bar ma khrol bar grwa sa gzhan du 'gro ba/ dge 'dun nang mi mthun pa'i rkyen zhe ngan 'dzin pa/ ngan lan len pa/phung dkrug khro ba sogs spangs nas gzhan du ngo bsrung / phan tshun lag 'dres pa'i 'thab rtsod/ des mtshon pa'i phyi rol gyi dpon skya/ bza' pa/ skya btsun gyi ris bzang ngan gang dang yang 'thab rtsod dang byed mkhan gyi rgyab dpung kha 'dzin mi byed/ bre srang sogs spyod 'os pa rnams ma gtogs dge 'dun spyi'i rdzas la gang zag gis longs mi spyod/ bre srang sogs kyang longs spyod 'phral la spyi sar skyel/—72

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)'phral gyi nyer mkho'i yo byad ma gtogs zong phan tshun du bsrung ba'i khe tshong bun skyed/ so nam zhing las/ dud 'gro 'tsho skyong mi byed/ tshong mi byed par tshong rar 'gro ba/ snga mas tshong thag ma bcad par phyi (50na)mas hab thob dang dog 'tshang mi byed/ glu gar bro gzhas kyis mtshon pa'i 'dus pa la blta ba/ ko gru'i btsas mi ster ba sogs mi byed/ bla mas dbyar bse theb phying dmar/ dgun ber zlam rtse zhwa'am paṇa dom grwa pa rnams kyis rtse zhwa ma gtogs pa pan zhwa/ sgom zhwa/ 'bar zhwa/ pags zhwa sogs zhwa rigs sna tshogs mi gyon/ sles phying pa/ gos phu thung ma/ gos kha dog ma bsgyur ba'i dkar po/ ska rags phu gu can/ phor shub 'dogs pa/ sgom thag /dra phad/ gri ring / skra ring / kha sha'i lham/ sug rtsa/ zom pa/ thul pa/ ko pags kyi snod sogs la mi spyod/ gling gi nye skor dang chu 'go'i lam srang sogs su bshang gci mi 'dor/ dge 'dun gyi 'du khang gi ka ba dang rtsig pa sogs la mchil snabs mi 'dor/ bre srang log pa mi bzo/ gzhan gyi ka ca bor ba rnyed pa bdag po ngo shes na dang ma shes na dge skos la gtod/ nye du ma yin pa'i bud med dang lhan cig zhag tu sdod pa/ tshul 'chal dang gnas gcig tu sdod cing 'grogs pa/ gnang ba ma zhus par grong gseb dang grong chog la mi 'gro/ dmigs bsal gyi dgos pa yod na ma gtogs gling gseb tu bud med mi gtong / gling khongs su rta mi bzhen/dud 'gro zhag tu mi bsrel/ chos zhu bar bsnyen bkur byed na ma gtogs mi skya'i ris kyang zhag mang gling gseb tu mi sdod/ skad rgyang gtang ba/ ku co 'don pa/ mchongs rgyag pa/ mda'/ 'ur rdo/ rdo sgor 'phen pa/ rgyan po 'gyed pa/ mi dmangs tshogs sar long (50ba)gtam dang 'du 'dzi'i gtam smra ba/gzhan gyi skyon brjod cing mtshang nas 'dru ba/ sde phan tshun gyi phyogs ris bzung ba'i ngan gshags/chos kyi 'gro ba la bsnyad pa'i g.yin dag dma' 'bebs pa'i bzhad gad tshig ngan sogs kyi sgo nas grogs tshangs par mtshungs pa rnams sun mi dbyung / khyi dang sprang po gling gseb tu mi gtong zhing gang zag gi bza' btung phyi rol du ster/ zhing sngo thog la lam mi bya zhing dud 'gro zhing bzas na de'i gun bsab de zhing bdag la sprod/ sde 'di'i sgrigs khong du zhugs zin nas gzhan du song pa'i tshe rtsa bzhi —73

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)sogs gnas nas dbyung bar 'os pa'i rgyu dngos bstan dang / gzhan yang chang dang phyi dro'i kha zas sogs 'dzem med du spyad pa/ 'khrugs seb tu zhugs pa/ khrims grogs med par nye du ma yin pa'i bud med dang gnas gcig tu zhag tu nyal ba rnams byung na slar grwa sa 'dir mi 'jug /glo bur du lhag pas rab tu byung ba la dag snang sbyong zhing gnas mal dang stan gos g.yor/ rab tu byung ba la phyi dro'i kha zas dang khyim pa la chang dang chang rin mi ster/ gling gi spyil pu 'tshong na dge skos la dri/ gzhan gyi spyil bu bshig nas bsgril ba sogs mi byed/ chos gos gsum gding ba rdul gzan sogs rung ba tshad dang ldan pa las tshad ma longs pa'i ngan ngon dang / tshad las lhag cing kha dog bzang por byed pa'i mchor chas mi byed/ mthang sham rdul gzan med par lam srang dang phyi rol du mi 'gro/ tshogs su 'du ba'i tshe/ dung gaṇ+ḍi gor rnga sogs brda byung ba dang bstun rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lugs kyis mdzes shing / spyod lam bag dang ldan pas myur du 'du zhing bslab gral (51na)ma 'khrug par byed/gral mtshes dang long gtam smra ba/ rtsig pa dang ka ba la snye ba/ ba 'ad gad bya zhing slong ba/ gnyid log pa sogs mi byed cing tshogs pa'i chos spyod kyi ram 'degs/ zas kyi tshe cag cag dang hu hu dang lces bldog pa sogs 'dul ba dang 'gol ba rnams mi byed/ bya ba glo bur ba byung na ma gtogs bsngo ba ma tshang bar mi 'gro/ 'gyes pa'i tshe'ang gzhan dag mi dad pa'i spyod tshul mi bya/ dge 'dun gyi pham phab dang rnyed pa khyim pa dang sprang po khyi sogs la mi ster/ gal te dmigs bsal gyi dgos pa byung na dge la dun la gnang ba zhu/ nad pa dang mtshams pa la sbyin bdag rang gos sgos su ster ba yin na ma gtogs ma tshogs pa rnams la skal ba mi ster/ dgos pa'i dbang gis sngon du 'gro bar 'os pa'i ris ma gtogs spyi'i zas kyi sngon rol du skal ba mi len/ dge 'dun bzhir longs pa la phul ba'i chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed yo byad de dag med cing sgrub mi nus pa'i ris la rgan rim bzhin dge skos kyis sbyin/ dge 'dun bcur longs pa yan chad la dar ras snam bu sogs snam sbyar dang ras chen gyi rgyur rung ba byung na mi bgo bar sngar ltar sbyin/ dge 'dun spyir 'bul ba byung tshe bsnyen —74

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wanapar rdzogs ma rdzogs kyi rnyed pa mnyam por thob mi thob 'dul ba'i gzhung bzhin byed/ chang dang phyi dro'i kha zas gtan nas spong mi nus pa tshogs su mi 'jug /sgog tsong sogs dri ngan pa'i ris lus la gos par byas nas dkon mchog gsum gyi rten gyi drung dang dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra bar mi 'gro/nang mchod dang sman rta mkhar las kyi dus sogs ma gtogs chang gi 'grim (51ba)'grul mi byed/nad pa byung na yo byad med tshe dge 'dun dang dkon mchog gi rdzas kyi steng nas de la rim gro byed/nad sos nas rang yul lta bu nas rdzas lon rgyu yod na dkon mchog gi rdzas la 'bags tshe gun bsab/ med kyang nad pa yul gnyen pa nyes par mi 'gyur/ sde 'dir mi gtogs pa'i skya btsun nad pa'i ris nye 'khor du byung na nad g.yog zas gos sman sogs kyis phan gdags/ nad rims yod sar phyin na dge 'dun spyi la gnod pas mi 'gro/ gzhan gyi khrims la thug pa'i nag chen skyabs zhu bar byung na mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa byed/ dgon pa nas rgyang grags gcig gi tshun gyi ri klungs su ri dwags dang nya gshor ba sogs byung na dgag pa'i ri rgya klungs rgya byed/ dbyar gnas dgag dbye gso sbyong rnams ma chag pa dang / gtso bor rgyud lugs kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i sngags dgon yin 'dug pas/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi mngon dkyil/ rje bla ma'i gsung bzhin 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i kun rig dang / tshe dpag med lha dgu'i mngon dkyil/ mgon po phyag drug pa/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po/ dpal ldan dmag zor ma gsum gyi bskang bshags bstod bskul/ sa lam sogs chos spyod rags bsdus/ smon lam lnga/mtshan brjod/ gdugs dkar sogs tshul dus mchod kyi ris par bkab dang / slo bur ba sbyin bdag gi rim gro dge las sogs la byed dgos pa rnams skabs dang bstun/ 'dzin chos gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka/ mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs/thams cad mkhyen(52na)pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i bde mchog gi bskyed rdzogs/ 'jigs byed kyi skyed rim/ nyan chos/ 'grel ba bzhi sbrags/ rim lnga gsal sgron/ lam rim che chung / bka' —75

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)gdams kyi glegs bam sogs skabs dang sbyar/ de yang rtsa ba bzhi la mthong thos drogs gsum byung ba sogs gnas nas dbyung bar 'os pa rnams dbyung / de las nyes pa chung bar tsha ra/ mang ja/ thug dar lcog brje ba/ dkar me snyan dar/ brgya phyag sogs nyes pa che chung dang bstun pa'i chad las brgyag /de ltar bslab par bya ba'i gnas rnams dran shes kyi bag dang ldan par byas nas 'khor 31 gsum gyi bya ba la brtson par byas pas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'phel zhing rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po 'grub par 'gyur ba yin no/ /mtha' dang tshad du gzhal dka'i 'gro rnams kyi/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan/ /de 'dzin spel ba'i khrims ldan dge 'dun gyis/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin khyon kun khyab gyur cig /dkon mchog gsum la bla mar 'dzin byed cing / /phu dud sri zhung byed pa'i sbyin pa'i bdag /gzugs can snying po'i ngang tshul nyer 'dzin pa'i/ /rje 'bangs tshogos rnams dang zhing rgyas rgyur cig /zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i chos srid bstan/ /lha bcas skye rgu'i gtsug gi mdzes rgyan du/ /bde 'byung ral pa'i rtse mo'i zla ba bzhin/ /rtag tu g.yo ba med par 'char gyur cig /ces dga' ldan thub bstan rab rgyas kyi dge 'dun spyi'i khrims su bca' ba zhig dgos zhes(52ba)mkha' 'gro bstan skyong gis bskul bar rten nas/ lung sbyor dang rgyu mtshan sogs mangs na yi ge'i tshogs kyis 'jigs te/ tshig nyur ngur byas pa'i bca' tshe dran pa'i lcags kyu zhes pa 'di ni khro mo zhes pa shing 'brug chu stod zla ba'i phyogs snga ma'i rdzogs pa dang po'i tshes la za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis bgyis pa sarba tho/ /

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)li thang thub bstan byams chen phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde'i khrims su bca' ba'i skor /tsi sto na rdu rme bra ka tsa li ma hā swā ra mā la byung ka ( bi : nga cu〉rba su ba dha tu lha lha lha ra bha dha rgya be saḥdamigs pa med pa'i thugs bskyed rlabs 'phreng nam yang yol min chu gter che/ /ma smad brtson pa'i nor rgyas kyis bcings tshogs gnyis sa 'dzin bsgril ba las/ /bi tswa yu sa : ka ra sa nu pa re dz+nyā na to nya khra 6 rā : dzā ga rnyo pā ṇirdzi ba su kha lha rta shā kya thu byo dza ya ( / /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen par byed pa'i bla med (53na)yid shes bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /lus can yongs kyi phan bde'i srog 'tsho bu ram shing pa rgyas gyur cig /khyod bstan gser ri'i ngogs gnas de 'dzin bya/ /lung rtog 'od kyis gcig tu ser na yang //lhag bsam — sa zla'i mched gyur pa/ /mar me mdzad dpal rnam par thar la dad/ /skye bar gnasalnga rig pa'i bag chags kyis/ /smra ba'i spobs mtho ri mo g.yas 'khyil las/ /rten 'byung zab mo'i sgra 'byin btsong kha pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yab gcig gtsug na mdzes/ /bsod nams byas pa'i rgya chen 'gro blo'i mtshor/ /'phrin las zla gzugs 'jug byed g.yin don du/ /mi skyo'i dri bzhon rgyal rnams gang bzhed khyim/ /'geng bar sgang ga'u gangs kun tu khyab de bsngags/ /thub bstan spel la 'khu ba'i yid grubs mun/ /byams chen 'od kyis phyogs mtshams thams cad las/ / rnam par rgyal ba'i chos sde'i 'dus pa rnams/ /blang dor bzhin mthong ā da r+ṣa 'di ltos/ /zhes yul khyad par can la shis pa brjod pa dang phyag bya ba sngon du 'gro ba'i dngos po nges bstan gyi snyan 'gyur phang 'gro'i sgra —77

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)las nyer bar drangs te/ ji skad du phal chen las/ 'dren pa la ni mthar thug med/ /de dag sku ni gcig tu snang / /sku gnyis de dag bsam mi khyab/ /'jig rten khams su snang gyur kyang / /sku la gnyis su gyur ba med/ /ji ltar zla ba shar gyur pa/ /tshad med pa yi gzugs brnyan rnams/ /chu yi snod du snang gyur kyang / /zla ba gnyis su gyur ba med/ /(53ba༄sa 'og min gyi zhing du nges pa lnga ldan gyi gzugs sku mthar thug las/ g.yo ba med na'ang gdul bya'i dbang gis gang la gang 'tsham gyi sprul pa sna tshogs su ston pa ni/ bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi chos nyid yin la/ de'ang bzang po'i bskal pa 'di la yul dbus 'gyur 'chang du rnam 'dren stong 'byon par bshad pa'i nang tshan sangs rgyas bzhi pa zas gtsang gi sras po don kun yongs su grub pa'i snying stobs mchog gi go cha btsan po dang ldan pa gang 'dis snyigs ma rnams las kyang ches cher snyigs pa rang cag gdul dka'i 'gro ba rnams kyi don du mchog gi sprul pa'i skur mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bstan pa rin po che ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu yin la/ lung rtogs kyi bstan pa 'dzin par byed pa'ang dge 'dun gyi sde la rag lus shing /de'ang theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun ngos 'dzin lugs so sor yod na'ang gtso bo ni mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyis/ dam pa'i chos nub pa na las kyi mtha' rnams med pa'i phyir blangs kyang mi skye bar bshad pas so/ /zhes so sor thar pa'i cho ga ma nyams pa la brten nas sdom pa blang ba dang / nan tan du byed pa yod na dam pa'i chos ma nub pa dang / de las ldog na dam pa'i chos nub par bshad pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa zhes ngos 'dzin rgyu ni rab tu byung ba'i sde la rag las pas bstan pa snga dar la rje btsad po khri srong lde btsan gyis mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho spyan drangs/ srad mi mi (54na)bdun rab tu byung ba nas bzung ste dge 'dun gyi sde dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel/ phyi dar la bla chen po dang / stod kyi pā la rnam pa gsum la brten nas 'dul ba'i bstan pa dar zhing / khyad par kha —78

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrīs sdom rgyun rgya cher spel te/ rang rgyud 'dul bar byed pa'i sde snod kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad pas/ bod gling dgu'i rgyal khams thams cad dge 'dun gyi sdes khyab cing / skabs don thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dpal bzang po'i 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa dus la yol ba med pas gser gyi rgyal po'i lung gis chen po hor gyi rgyal khams su gdan drangs pa'i tshe bstan pa spyi dang khyad par snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi bstan pa mdo khams kyi char 'phel rgyas kyi slad du li thang thub bstan byams chen phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes pa'i chos sde 'di nyid gsar du bskrun par mdzad pa bar skabs su sdig can gyi lhongs la brten pa'i bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib sna tshogs su gyur na'ang / slar rtsod pa'i dus su stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i bsod nams chen po'i dpung gis mdo khams sgang drug mtha' dag 'bangs su bsdus pa'i tshe bstan pa'i me ro bsos te rim gyis 'phel ba'i 'dus sde 'di nyid kyi khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa ni/'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo las/ 'od srungs de ltar tshul khrims nyams shing chos mi bsrung ba ni khyim bdag mgo reg ces bya yi tshul khrims (54ba)bsrung ba ni ma yin no/ /zhes rab tu byung ba'i ming dang rtags tsam lhur len pa las nan tan tu mi byed pa dag yang dag pa'i bstan pa ma yin nyid / khyad par thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi bstan pa 'di la nges par bslab pa'i gnas rnams la nan tan du byed pa'i srol 'di gtso bor gyur pas kun mkhyen yid bzang rtse ba'i gsung las dus kyi dbang gis dge slong lcod pa'ang mang rab byung ba na/ rje btsun dam pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis/ dang por skyor mo lung du mkhan chen blo gsal ba las 'dul pa legs par blangs/ phyis dben pa'i gnas rnams su sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa na'ang 'dul ba'i kun tu spyod pa las ma 'das/ phyis 'khor skyong pa'i tshe na'ang drung na 'khod pa thams cad 'dul ba nas ji skad bshad pa'i chos gos gsum gding ba dang lhung bzed la sogs pa mkho ba'i yo byad —79

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)rnams 'dzin du bcug /ces bsngags pa ches cher brjod pa ltar/ rjes la jug rnams kyis kyang sngon byung gi rnam thar ris su ma bor ba'i nyams len zhig med na/ ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ de bzhin rnal 'byor mi brtson pa/ /tshul khrims bsngags pas 'tsho ba dag /phyi ma'i dus la byung 'gyur te/ /de dag la ni tshul khrims med/ /ces ni tso'i kha ton lta bu spangs te nyams su bstar ba la/ thog mar gsar du grwar zhugs pa'i sdom pa ma thob pa dag thob par ma byas par rtags tsam bzung nas yun ring por dge 'dun gyi rdzas la longs spyad na/ lung rnam 'byed (55na〉pas/ lcags gong me lce 'dra ba dag /zos par gyur pa mchog yin gyi/ /tshul 'chal yang dag mi sdom pa/ /lus 'khor bsod stoms za ba min/ /zhes rang nyid rnam smin lci zhing tshogs kyang 'bags par 'gyur bas rab tu byung dgos shing / de la'ang bar gcod dang ldan na sdom pa mi skye ba'am skyes kyang ring por mi gnas pa sogs kyi nyes pa yod pas legs par brtag /med pa rnams la bla gos/ mthang gos/ gding ba/ lhung bzed / chu tshags sogs rab byung gi rtags rnams brnyan po tshun gyis tshang bar byas shing / lo tshigs su ma sleb pa dang bsrung mtshams mi zin pa'i dgag bya dang ldan pa rnams mi 'jug /thog mar gzhan dag las mkho ba'i yo byad g.yar dgos byung yang / de nas bzung ste zla ba gsum tshun la rang nyid dbang ba'i rab byung gi rtags 'grig par byed/ sdom pa dang mi ldan pa'am/ ldan kyang rtags cha lugs ma tshang ba tshogs su mi 'jug /sngon nas rab tu byung zin pa yul phyogs gzhan dag nas 'ongs pa gsar du 'jug na/ de gzhan du bslab skyon gnas dbyung sogs ras phog ma phog legs par brtag /bsnyen par rdzogs 'dod pa rnams kyang bar gcod brtags pa sogs rab byung gi skabs dang mtshungs/de'ang gnas brtan rnams dang gsar bu ba rnams tshul khrims mnyam par gyur pa la nges par sbyor dgos pas de ring bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong / des (55ba)bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo brgya /spon pa'i dge slong gis gang bslab pa de la bslab dgos par bstan pa'i shugs la/ dge tshul bar ma sogs la'ang 'dra bas grwa sar zhugs nas gnas kyi slob dpon bsten te/ shes rab che chung dang —8(/—

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig / (wa)bsten pa'i zla grangs ji ltar 'os pa'i khongs su/ lung rnam 'byed las gsungs pa'i sdom gyis bsdus pa'i bslab khrims dang / lung gzhi dang phran tshegs skabs kyi 'byung nye ba'i blang dor rags pa rnams la bslabs te gsar rnying thams cad kun spyod mthun par byed/ sdom pa thob zin mi nyams par bsrung ba dang nyams na phyir 'chos pa gnyis med na rab byung gi sdom pa len pa la dga' ba tsam du zad pas rtsa ba bzhi la skyon byung na 'chab med rnams slar sdom pa len cing 'tshab can gyi ris gnas nas dbyung / dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba la spo mgu dbyung gsum dang / sbom po lhung byed nyes byas sogs la dge 'dun dang gang zag so sor shags sdom gzhung bzhin byed/ yul tshan mi tshan du bcad de mi dpung dgra sdebs kyi 'thab rtsod sogs dge 'dun gyi dbyen chen por 'gro ba byung na lan cig ma yin par dkrug rkyen sel 'jug gi rtsa ba su yin de gnas dbyung dang / de min ste po'i ris la mang ja/tsha ra/ thug dar lcog brje ba/ bla mar ja 'khor gsum gyis gtsos pa'i dgu tshan/ snyan dar/ gang 'tsham gyi rnam gzhag /dung dar 'grel/ ram 'degs pa rnams la spyi thog tu mang ja sbyor sbrel/ bla mar ja bar khag gis gtsos pa'i bdun tshan/ rnam gzhag (56na)snyan dar sogs gong 'dra 'grel/grwa pa re gnyis nas zhe ngan gyis 'jings nas lag 'dres pa'i 'thab rtsod/ ngan lan len pa sogs la brten pa'i rmas 'gram sogs che bar byung na mang ja/ bla mar 'bul ba/ snyan dar/ rnam gzhag /me gsos 'jal gcod sogs tshad ldan byed/ rmas 'gram ma yin pa'i 'thab mo'i ris la snyan dar/brgya phyag /dkar me sogs skabs su gang bab 'grel/ rab tu byung ba ni dge sbyong gi chos bzhi gtso bor byed dgos pas 'phung dkrug /khro rdeg gshe ba/ mtshang 'dru sogs spangs te gzhan ngo bsrung /dge 'dun gyi nang du ma zad phyi rol du dpon skya/ bza' ba/ skya btsun gyi ris mchog dman gang dang yang 'thab rtsod mi byed cing gzhan dag rtsod pa'i kha 'dzin dang rgyab dpung mi byed/ byas na tshabs che chung la dpags pa'i nyes chad gong gi rim 'gros kyis 'grel/ tshong sogs byed mi dgos par tshong rar 'gro ba/ sngon mas tshong thag ma bcad par rjes mas dog 'tshang kyi tab thob byed pa/ 'dums —81 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ni/byed pa sogs min par dmag gseb tu 'dug pa dang blta ba/ glu gar bro gzhas kyis mtshon pa'i 'dus pa la blta ba/ gling gseb tu skad rgyangs gtong ba/ mchongs brgyag pa/ ku co 'don pa/ rgyan po 'gyed pa/ mda' 'ur rdo/ rdo skor 'phen pa/ mang po'i tshogs su 'du 'dzi dang long gtam smra ba/ tshig ngan sogs kyi sgo nas grogs tshangs par spyod pa sun dbyung ba/ sde phan (56bskos gyi phyogs ris bzung ba'i ngan gshags/ chos kyi 'gro ba lab snyad pa'i g.yin dag dma' dbab pa/ gzhan skyon brjod cing mtshang 'dru ba/ 'phral gyi nyer mkho'i mthun rkyen ma gtogs khe tshong 'bun skyed/ so nam zhing las/ dud 'gro 'tsho skyong sogs mi byed/ bla mas dbyar bse theb phying dmar/ dgun ber zlum rtse zhwa 'am/ paṇa dom/ grwa pa rnams kyis rtse zhwa zhe gcig gyon/ de las g.yin du paṇa zhwa/ 'bar zhwa/ sgom zhwa/ pags zhwa sogs zhwa ris sna tshogs/ pags thul/ gos phu thung ma/ sle'u/ phying pa/ gos kha dog ma 'gyur ba'i dkar po/ /kha sha'i lham/ sug rtsa/ zom pa/ ska rags phu gu can/ phor shubs/ sgom thag /dra phad/ skra ring / gri ring / ko pags kyi snod sogs la longs mi spyod/ gal te spyad na dngos po ngo bo 'phrog cing / slar yang byas pa byung na snyan dar/ brgya phyag /dkar me 'gel/ nyid gi sngo thog la lam mi bya zhing/ byas na dkar me dang / dud 'gros lo tog thos pa byung na de'i gun bsab kyi dngos po zhing bdag la sprod/ bre srang sogs brnyan por 'os pa rnams ma gtogs dge 'dun spyi'i rdzas la longs mi spyod/ bre srang sogs kyang 'degs 'jal grub 'phral spyi sar skyel/ gling khrod du ka ca brlag dor rnyed na dge skos la sprod/ lcags ri'i nang du bla ma slob dpon sogs grwa ris dmigs bsal ma gtogs rta mi zhon/ bzhon/ khyi dang sprang po gling gseb tu mi gtong zhing las byed kyas bza' btung (57na)phyi rol du ster/ glo bur du lhags pa'i rab tu byung ba la dag snang sbyong zhing gnas mal dang gos stan g.yor/ rab byung la phyi dro'i kha zas dang khyim pa la chang rin mi ster/ dgon pa'i spyil po bshig nas bsgril ba dang shing cha 'tshong ba sogs mi byed/ byas pa byung na khang pa rnying par cha bzhag sgrub 'jug /rab byung gi rtags cha lugs rnams rung ba tshad ldan ma gtogs rgyags pa dang dregs pa 'phel ba'i kha —82

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)dog bzang po dang tshad las lhag pa'i mchor chas mi byed/ mthang sham rngul gzan med par lam srang dngo phyi rol du mi 'gro/ byes bgrod lta bu'i tshe chang dang phyi dro'i kha zas 'dzem med du spyod pa/ 'brug gral du go gyon mtshon thogs pa/ khrims grogs med par nye du min pa'i bud med dang gnas dben pa skyabs yod par zhag tu lhan cig nyal ba byung na slar grwa sa 'dir mi 'jug pa 'am/ yang na chang phyi dro'i kha zas 'khrug pa gsum la mang ja tsha ra 'bul tshan sogs kyi chad pa dang / phyi ma la mi tshangs spyod kyi skyon yod med kyi char lag 'dogs kyi dag pa byas nas spyod lam ma bzo ba'i chad pa gong bzhin bsgrub/ spyi so'i 'du khang du sde gnyis ka tshogs pa'i tshe chab skad dang dung gtong lugs sogs dpal ldan 'bras spungs dang dbyibs mthun par byed/ dge 'dun rnams bag med pa'i spyod lam spangs te gzhan dag dang ba 'dren pa'i tshul ldan gyi sgo nas 'du zhing bslab gral ma 'khrugs par byed/gral mtshes dang long gtam smra ba/ gnyid log pa/ ba 'ad gad/ rtsig pa dang ka bar bsnye ba/ de dag la mchil (57bskob 'dor ba sogs bdud las rnams spangs te ma yengs par chos spyod kyi ram 'degs/ bsnyen bkur la spyod pa'i tshe cag cag hu hu dang lces bldog pa sogs chos 'dul ba nas bkag pa rnams mi byed/ gshol du mi btub pa'i ris mi byung bar bsngo ba ma tshar gong nas 'gro ba/tshogs gyes pa'i tshe gzhan dag gis 'phya smod kyi gnas su 'gro bar mi byed/ dge 'dun gyis pham phab dang rnyed pa khyi dang sprang po sogs la sbyin na yul der gnod pas mi sbyin/ gal te dmigs bsal byung na dge 'dun la gnang ba zhu/ nad pa/ mtshams pa/ spyi pa'i las byed sogs dmigasabasal ma gtogs ngos len med par tshogs skal mi ster/ dge 'dun spyi'i bya ba sgrub pa sogs la dus kyis gtugs te sngon du 'gro dgos ma yin par spyi zas kyi sngon rol du skal ba mi len/ tshogs kyi zhal 'don dper na/ gdugs dkar rdzogs mtshams nas ja dang po gtong ba dus mtshungs/ des gzhan dag la yang mang nyung gi rigs 'gre zhing ja dang po'i rjes su bstan pa spyi sgos la nye bar 'tshe ba'i rigs dang chos sde rang gi phyi nang du dkrugs shing bstan pa'i sel 'jug /nag chang sogs la —83

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)dmigs pa'i mdo sgrub tshar gcig byed/ skyabs sems rjes su sa lam gsang ba'i rnam thar sogs chos spyod rags bsdus/ smon lam lnga/ sgrol ma/ sher snying / gdugs dkar/ tshe gzung/ 'dod khamasabadag mo'i gtor bsngo/(58na)bstan 'bar mas mtha' brten pa las zhal 'don mang nyung gdangs 'dur sogs sbyin bdag gi gshin gson gyi don gang yin dang mang ja mang nyung sogs la yang skabs dang bstun/ cho 'phrul gyi zla bar mnyan yod mchod pa'i phyag len lha sa smon lam chen mo sor gnas dang / tshogs dbu spyi par mkhan po med phyin grwa tshang gnyis kyi bla ma bslab pa su rgan gyis byed/ gzhi gsum gyi phyag len 'chag med dang / slob dpon rnams gnyis ma byung ba'i dus bslab pa rgan pa zhig gis mdo 'don/ dge skos/ zhal ta/ chab ril ba rnams spyi so gros thog nas rang 'dod kha 'tshangs su ma song ba'i dgon par khebs gang che 'os 'du bsdus/ 'ba' rdzong sdod la bsdur ba'i khog nas gtso bor lha mo don grub ma'i sku brnyan gyi mdun du zan ril gang babs kyis lo gsum re'i bar byed/dbu mdzad skad dang gdangs nges pa gal che bas dngos yon gang 'dug gtso bor byed cing lo grangs kyi nges pa med/ mang ja'i bsngo rten slob dpon gnyis so sor rnam gzhag dang / slob dpon dbu mjad par bsngo rten byang 'dren dge skos zhal ta ba gsum so so dang/ dung mkhan gnyis dang chab ril ba thun mong du rnam gzhag gcig /lha mo don grub mar snyan dang rnams 'bul/ dge 'dun bzhir longs pa la phul ba'i rab byung gi rtags cha lugs sogs kyi dngos po dge skos la gtad pa'i yo byad de dag sgrub mi nus pa'i rgan rim la ster/ dge 'dun bcur longs ba yan chad la snam sbyar dang ras chen kyi rgyur 'os (58ba)pa'i dar ngas snam bu sogs byung na ma bgod par sngar ltar ster/ dge 'dun spyir phul ba bsnyen par rdzogs ma rdzogs kyi rnyed pa mnyam por thob mi thob 'dul ba'i sde snod nas bshad pa bzhin byed/ sgog btsong sogs dri ngan pas gos par byas nas dri gtsang khang dang dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba sogs su mi 'gro/ nang mchod smon rta mkhar las/ dge 'dun spyi'i ched du bzo ris pa 'ongs pa'i skabs dmigs bsal ma gtogs chang gi 'grim 'grul mi byed/ yo byad kyis —84

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)dbul ba'i nad pa la dge 'dun dang dkon mchog gi rdzas kyi steng nas phan pa bsgrub cing slar de la gun bsab med kyang yul gnyan pas nyes par mi 'gyur/ gal te rang yul lta bu nas dngos po len rgyu yod na gun bsab/ 'dus sde 'di'i khongs su mi gtogs pa'i nad pa sogs nyam thag pa'i yul rnams la zas gos/ sman/ nad g.yog sogs rim gro byed/ nad rims yod sar phyin na dge 'dun spyi 'bags pa'i nyen yod pas mi 'gro/ srog la rgol bar thug pa'i nag chen skyabs 'tshol bar byung na bsten cing / rgyang grags gcig tshun gyi ri klungs su sems can rngon pa bsrungs te mi 'jig pa'i sbyin pa ster/ bye brag grwa tshang gnyis su phye ba'i sngags grwa ba rnams kyis mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i bde mchog gi bskyed rdzogs/ des mdzad pa'i 'jigs byed kyi bskyed rim rnams kyi 'chad nyan/ rgyal ba btsong kha pas mdzad pa'i gsang bde 'jigs gsum (59na tsher dul 'dzin pa'i kun rig rnams kyi mngon dkyil/ rgyud gzhung / phyag drug pa/ las gshen/ dmag zor ma/ rnam sras/ a phyi/ pe har/bse khrab pa rnams kyi bskang gso sogs tshogs 'don sngon nas tshugs zin pa rnams la do dam gang che las gsar 'dzugs mang po mi byed/ hor zla drug pa'i nang du/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum dang /kun rig gi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ lo mjug sku rim sogs gra gang 'grig byed/ mdo grwa ba rnams kyis dbu phar mdzod gsum yig cha gsar pa dang / 'dul bar yig cha gang 'os/ rnam 'grel ra ba stod pa'i lugs sor gnas/ gtso bo'i rtsis gshag bgro gleng la rtsol 'don dang / de 'og nas chos spyod smon lam/ gdugs dkar/ sher snying / sgrol ma/ tshe gzungs sogs kyi 'dzin sbyong / gdangs sogs rtsol 'don las sngags phyogs su gtogs pa dmag zor ma'i gtor 'bul tsam ma gtogs mi byed/ chos thog brgyad kyi phogs ja tshul/ smon lam/ lnga mchod/ nyer bdun sogs sngar rgyun gyi gtong sgo dang / de ga'i yong deb kyi chos gzhis sogs yod 'dug pa rnams sgo bstun las tshan rnams khur bsam gang che'i ngos/ gtso bor chos phyogs kyi 'gan 'khur slob dpon gnyis dang 'jig rten —85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)gyi la rgya'i khur len 'ba' lhun grub rab brtan gyi rdzong sdod nas byas pa'i chos sde chen po 'di 'khor lo gsum gyi sgo nas yar ldan du (59ba〉pa chog dman skya ser kun gyis bsgrubs na 'di phyi'i don chen spel ba'i thabs bla na med pa'i/ thugs rje'i skya rengs dang po shar tsam gyis/ /'gro kun ma rig gnyid las nyer slong ba'i/ /rnam 'dren nyin mor byed pa shākya'i gtso/ /khyod bstan skye rgu kun gyi chos dkar yul/ /de tshul 'dzin pa'i rnam dag grub mtha' bzhi/ /lugs srol rab dkar 'o mtsho gangs ljongs 'dir/ /'khyil yang log bshad rnyog mas cher sbags pa/ /drungs byed mkhas rnams ring mo zhig nas nongs/ /'on te cha shas yongs gang bsil zer can/ /smag rum mun pa'i khrod du shar ba bzhin/ /kun mkhyen 'jam dpal snying po'i mkhyen dpyod kyis/ /rgyal ba'i ring lugs dri ma lan brgyar bkrus/ /gang gi gsung rab gaṅgā'i yab cig las/ /snying po khrims su bca' ba'i nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /spyi dang khyad par bstan pa'i rgya mtsho cher/ /'bab byed kho bo'i blo gros nyi gzhen bzhin/ /dkon mchog thugs rje rten 'brel slu ba med/ /bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs kyis/ /thub bstan byams chen chos kyi sde chen po/ /srid mtha'i bar du dar zhing rgyas gyur cig /ces li thang thub bstan byams chen phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde'i khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa blang dor gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba 'di ni za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes sbyar pa'i yi ge pa ni gnas ban 'jam dbyangs kyis bgyis pa sarba di glur yastu/ /(60na)—86

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)'ba' dga' ldan phan bde gling pa'i khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa blang dor gsal ba'i zla ba sogs/rte ya tā ya thu ba tā : bha ba de sha tsa ku na tsa/ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i khyon/ /mngon sum gzigs pa'i spyan ras kyis/ /spru la mā dza go ba dṛ ka na she ṣa u tho sa dha na mya/ris med 'gro la nyer btsa' ba/ /don kun ma lus grub der 'dud/ /gang gi ring lugs kun bzang ma'i/ /rgyan du legs bshad nor bu'i 'phreng / / rnam dpyod srad bur brgyud mkhas pa/ /'jam dpal snying pos dge legs stsol/ /dga' ba'i dpal ldan chos kyi sgra/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas mchog /sdom ston gling gi blang dor rnams/ /gsal byed ri bong 'dzin 'di shar/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i pi wang gi rgyud las drangs te shis par brjod nas/ de'ang bskal bzang gi 'dren pa bzhi pa rnam 'dren nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa rin po che sa gsum gyi 'gro ba ma lus pa'i kun rmongs kyi smag rum mtha' dag sel (60ba)bar byed pa'i sgron me yin la/ thub pa'i bstan pa'i slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ /ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ / lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /zhes lung rtogs kyi chos gnyis su gsungs pa'i thog mar lung gi chos dkon mchog rnams tshul bzhin thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa la brten nas mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs rgyud la skye bar 'gyur bas na/ /mdo sde rgyan las/ 'di na dang por thos la brten nas tshul ba chin yid la byed pa 'byung / /tshul bzhin yid la byed las yang dag don yul ye shes 'byung / /zhes thos bsam sgom gsum phyin ci ma log pa zhig byung na gnas skabs dang mthar thug don rgya chen pa 'grub pa'i rgyu yin pas/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa'i —87

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)chos 'dzin pa/ /brgya byin tshangs pa de bzhin 'jig rten skyong / /'khor los sgyur dang mi yi rgyal por 'gyur/ /bde dang yang bde byang chub de 'tshang rgya/ /zhes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan dang ldan la/ de lta bu'i 'jug bya rgyal ba'i bstan pa la 'jug byed kyi thabs theg pa che chung gi chos tshul mtha' klas na'ang / bshes spring las/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhis rten lags par gsungs/ /zhes sa chen po ltar yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi rten lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la rag lus par gsungs shing / khyad par zhwa ser cod pan 'chang pa'i sde mtha' dag thams cad mkhyen pa shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi phyag len ltar mdo sngags kyi sde gang yin yang 'dul khrims la gtso bor mdzad pa yin pas 'ba' dga' ldan (61na)phan bde gling du grags pa'i 'dus sde 'di'i khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa la/ thog mar gsar bu ba rnams rab tu byung ba'i lo tshigs slebs sa ma sleb sogs bar gcod yod med brtags te 'gal rkyen dang mi ldan pa rnams la chos gos gsum/ lhung bzed/ chu tshags/ rdul bzan rnams ma mtha' brnyan po tshun gyis tshang bar byas te rab byung bsgrub/ zla ba gsum mam lnga las mi 'gyangs par rung mthun gyi gos sogs yo byad rnams rang nyid bdag gir byar rung ba gshom par byed/ rab tu byung ba dang de'i rtags dang mi ldan pa tshogs su mi gzhug /gzhan dag nas 'ongs pa'i grwa rnying gi ris 'jug pa byung na g.yung bo dang rtsa ba nyams pa yin min brtag /bsnyen par rdzogs 'dod rnams kyang bar ma'i skabs bzhin mthun rkyen tshang zhing 'gal rkyen yod med brtag pa sogs kyi sgo nas bsgrub/ gnas kyi slob dpon bsten nas rnam 'byed dang 'phran tshegs byung ba'i bslab bya rag rim khong du chud par byas te rab tu byung nas ring por lon pa rnams kyis bslab pa gang la bslab dang mtshungs par slob/ 'og nas byung ba'i thos bsam bya bar 'os pa rnams kyang blo nus dang bstun pa'i bslab sbyang la brtson par bya/ rtsa ba las nyams na gnas nas dbyung zhing / lhag ma sogs dge 'dun dang gang zag so sor bshags pa gzhung bzhin byed/ yul tshan sogs sde ris su bcad de dge 'dun gyi dbyin chen po byas na ste po su —88

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)yin dbyung zhing / gzhan rnams la spyi thog tu mang ja/ tsha ra/ thug dar lcog /snyan dar/ bla mar ja khag yas gtsos pa'i bdun tshan/ sne mo ba so sor rnam gzhag gtong / re gnyis (61ba〉nas 'thab rtsod kyi 'gram lta bu byung na rmas che chung la dpags pa'i gong gi chad pa rim 'gros/ rma sogs 'jal spyod sogs tshul ldan bsgrub/ de min lag 'thab sogs la dkar me snyan dar/ grwa ja brgya phyag sogs che chung nyes byas dang bstun pa 'gel/ dge 'dun spyi'i rdzas la gang zag gis longs mi spyod/spyod par 'os pa'i bre srang sogs kyang spyi sar skyel/ khe tshong so nam zhing las bun skyed/ dud 'gro bsrel ba/ rgyan po 'gyed pa/ 'dus la blta ba sogs spong / bla mas ber zlam/ phying dmar/ bse zhu/rtse zhwa/ paṇa dom las lung ma bstan gyi zhwa gos mi gyon/ grwa pa rnams kyis rtse zhwa zla gam zhe mtshungs las/ paṇa zhwa/ pags zhu/ sgom zhwa/ 'bar zhwa/ sles phying pa/ gos dkar po/ phu thung dang / phu gu can gyi ska rags/ phor shubs/ sgom thag /dra phad/ sug rtsa/ zom pa/ pags thul sogs la mi spyod cing /spyad na dngos po ngo bo 'phrog /gling gseb skad rgyangs/ ku co/ mchongs/ rdo skor/ 'ur rdo 'phen pa/zhing sngo thog lam byed pa/ mthang sham/ rdul gzan med par lam srang dang phyi rol sogs su mi 'gro/tshogs dang chos rar 'du ba'i tshe dung dang gaṇ+ḍi 'khar rnga'i brda dang bstun spyod lam bag dang ldan pas 'du zhing bslab gral sogs ma 'khrug par byed/ gnyid log pa/ long gtam/ ba 'ad gad/ rtsig pa dang ka bar snye ba dang / bza' btung la spyod pa'i tshe cag cag khu hu/ lce bldag pa sogs spong /(62na skod pa/ mtshams pa/ spyi pa'i las byed du 'khod pa min phyin tshogs su ma yongs par skal pa ma ster/ nang mchod/ sman rta/ mkhar las sogs na dmags bsal la dgos pa byung na ma gtogs chang mi len/ nad pa nyam chung gi ris la dge 'dun dkon mchog gi rdzas kyi steng nas rim gro byed/ nag chen gyi srog skyob dang / rgyang grags gcig tshun gyi bya ri dwags bsrung ba sogs mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa byin/ dbyar gnas 'gag dbye gso sbyong rnams 'chag med dang / tshogs 'don gyi chos spyod skor 'bras spungs tshogs chen sor gnas kyi steng sman bla chen mo 'dzugs/ mdo phyogs la shes 'dod yod —89

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2re/pa dang 'char sgo yong ba'i gzhen grwa rnams la dbu phar sogs kyi 'chad nyan byed/ mtshan nyid pa rnams kyis cho ga bskang ba sogs la mi blta/ yon tan gyi gzhi things nas grwa sa phan tshun du po ti phyi ma'i slob sbyang la gtong / rgan grwa mdo phyogs la shes 'dod chung ba rnams gsang 'dus/ 'jigs byed/ kun rig chen mo/ mi 'brugs pa/ mgon po phyag drug pa/ chos rgyal/ dmag zor ma'i bskang ba rnams 'dzin bshar byed cing / de rnams zur du tshogs pa'i tshes brgyad la mi 'brugs pa/ bco lnga la kun rig /nyer lnga la gsang 'dus/ nyer dgu la bskang ba byed/ grwa ja la thams cad lhan du 'tshog cing chos spyod sman bla sdebs su 'don/ lnga mchod sogs dus mchod kyi ris gang yod la lhan du tshogs na sman bla dang / mdo phyogs mi byed pa rnams zur du 'tshog na de rnams kyis gsang 'dus mi 'khrugs pa sogs gang (62ba)ris gtong / cho ga bskang gso sogs kyi rtsi zhag chos rar btang kyang 'gal ba med/ chos thogs gi dus gung tshogs grol nas lam rim che chung / bka' gdams glegs bam/ bka' gdams thor bu/ blo sbyong sogs spyi chos grwa pa tshang mar 'chad/ snga dro 'bum tshar re sgrog pa sogs bstan pa rin po che 'phel rgyas kyi rgyur 'gro ba'i 'khor lo gsum gyi rim pa rnams bla ma rdzong sdod las 'dzin rnams kyis 'bad pas bsgrub pa ni legs byas rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i gzhi dam pa'o/ /de ltar khrims su bca' ba'i zla zer gyis/ /dga' ldan phan bde gling gi kun+da'i tshal/ /rab ba 'ad legs byas yal byang chub che'i/ /rma gong mdzes min de srid rnying med shog /sems can rnams kyi mtha' dang mnyam 'jug pa/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i 'phrin las rgyun mi chad/ /gsar pa'i mtho ris chu bos bdag gzhan gyi/ /sdig chos dri ma ma lus bkru bar shog /phun tshogs 'dod 'arjo nor 'dzin yangs pa'i mngal/ /gser sbyangs cod pan 'bar ba'i gzi byin gyis/ /legs khyab kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar gzugs/ /mngon sum mthong ba'i snang ba ches dkar shog /ces 'ba' dga' ldan phan bde gling pa'i khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa blang dor gsal ba'i zla bar grags pa —90

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)'di ni 'ba' lhun grub rab brtan gyi rdzong sdod dar rgan dka' bcu pas bskul ba ltar za ho ra gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis pa dza yas/ /snang ba rig pa'i rtsal du shar ba'i 'phrul/ /zil gnon dbang drag grub pa'i (63na)brtul zhugs kyi/ /seng ge'i rgyud kyi nga ro'i gtam 'di la/ /snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum rna ba lhog /chosaskyabs tha yang chi yi ming 'dzin pa/ /tshul gnas thos bsam sgom par byed pa la/ /bsam sbyor ngan pa'i 'tshe ba rab spangs te/ /'dod dgu yid bzhin 'grub pa'i mthun rkyen sbyor/ /'gal tshe ma rig 'khrul snang sdig pa'i gzugs/ /gtum drag rngams pas snying gi khrag dren 'jib/ /legs par byas rnams srid zhi'i phun tshogs la/ /spyod ba'i bden tshigs brjod par yi rang byos/ /dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin dang mtshungs pa/ /dam pa'i chos kyi skyed mos tshal chen po/ / stag lung sku skyes 'bad pas nyer bskrun pa'i/ /med byung khrims ldan 'du ba'i chos sde 'di/ /legs ldan nag po dpal ldan phyag drug pa/ /ma he'i gdong can lha chen nyi ma'i bur/ /gnyer du gtad na thos bsam sgom pa dang / /bya ba las kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa/ /yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar mdzod/ /ces han stag lung sku skyes sha sbrang du 'dus sde gsar du btsugs pa'i ming dang chos skyong la gnyer gtad dgos tshul byung ba ltar dgon pa'i ming dga' ldan skyed tshal dang chos skyong phyag drug pa dang las gshin la gnyer du gtad pa'i tshigs bcad 'di'ang za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'o/ /chu glang dga' ldan hung tha'i jis mi ma yin gyi 'tshe ba las skyob pa'i srong yig cig dgos tshul byung ba ltar bris pa dkon cog mthu skyin no/ /na mo tā tra yā ya/ slu med mchog gsum thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang / /chos nyid gdod nasa'agyur ba med cing dag(63ba)/chos can rgyu las 'bras bu lhun grub pa'i/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i mthu chen pos/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sa chen rab skyong 'di'i/ /lus ngag yid gsum tshe srog stobs 'byor la/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba glags lta'i bsam pa dang / /sbyor ba ngan pa ma byed rak+ṣa —9/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)ya/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam chos srung gis/ /rtag tu byin rlobs legs tshogs yon tan kun/ /yar ngo'i zla ba lta bur rab 'phel te/ /bsam don ni ḍā bho ga ku ru ho/ gu ru de wa ḍaki ra khyi tai re khā dhar kā ya wa stsa t+ta badz+ra ra k+ṣa/ /par mgu ru shu ya mā ri di wi rā dhi ṣ+ṭha te su hā/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa'i gshed gyi rgyud la brten nas mkhas shing grub brnyes lwa li ta dang /bi spru pa dpal 'dzin sogs 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub/ ra skyo mal zhang gnyos te phyogs 'di'i srol 'byed 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che rdo rje 'chang tshar ba chos rje yab sras sogs rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka'/ bdud sde'i gshed du 'jam dpal drag por khros pas 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i lung / gong ma'i lung gis de'i ching kying gang zhes srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan du dbang bskur zhing / 'khor 'das phyag rgya zil gnon 'jam dpal dus dgra'i sngags 'chang ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gtam/ khams gsum na mngon par rgyu ba'i gzugs med snang zhing srid pa'i lha srin sde brgyad/ gzugs can gyi skye dgu spyi dang / bye brag stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang khri skor bcu gsum/ smad mdo khams kyi 'dzin mar 'khod pa'i lha sde mi sde bla ma che phra/ sa skyong ba'i mi'i rje (64na)bo/ dpon chen/ dpon skya/ rdzong sdod/ gnyer las 'dzin/ dmag ar jag gi 'grim 'grul/ ko gru lcags gsum gyi mnyan gnyer/ lam 'phrang srung mi sogs mchog dman bar pa'i skye dgu mtha' dag la springs pa/ ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub dang gsang chen rnying ma'i sngags chang gos dkar lcang lo'i phreng can mthu chen g.yung stan rdo rje dpal ba gnyis kyis yos lo hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang du 'chi bdag gshin rje'i grong khyer thod pa lcags kyi khang pa nas las kyi gshin rje 'khor sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag tshogs dang bcas pa/ mngon 'byor chos su zhugs pa'i stang stobs dang / ngo bo rnal 'byor pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bkug pa'i chos srung sogs skye phal gyi mig gi yul du ma gyur pas gzhi bar snang gi khyon gang ba spyan —92

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)drangs te/ dam rdzas gtor ma'i ri bo dang / dmar chen khrag gi rgya mtsho bskyil ba sogs/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod cing thugs dam bskang / spyi bor rdo rje bzhag /lce thog tu a mri ta blug ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde 'joms pa'i dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i dam tshig bsgrags shing 'phrin las gnyer du gtad/ dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dmar chen gtor ma 'phen pa'i srol gtod par mdzad pa'i rgyun ding sang gi bar du ma nyams par 'dug pa nas/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du ma lha'i mchod pa 'dzugs rgyur skye dgu rnams ngo mtshar gyi ltad mo'i dga' ston dang / lha srin sde brgyad rnams dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tshogs su rol pa'i mgron la shog cig brda 'grems pa rlung sems la nang byan chud pa'i rnal 'byor brtul zhugs spyod pa 'di (64ba)bzhin song ba/ khyod gong 'khod rnams kyis gzhi lam byes gsum thams cad du zhag babs su gnas mal gtong zhing bza' btung mkho dgu'i longs spyod kyis bsten pa dang / ko gru'i gnyen pas kyang 'phral sgrol gyis/ gal te gnod 'gal du 'gro ba byung na yul gru'i dpon che chung dang / rdzong sdod so so'i khrims kyi bda' ded btang na mi 'jigs sam/ go bar byed pa'i yi ge shing stag smin drug zla ba'i gral tshes dge bar gtsug lag lugs brgya'i 'dun sa pho brang chen po po ta la nas bris so/ /—93

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ma/lha sa smon lam chen mo'i tshe dge 'dun rnams kyi khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa sogs/pu rba ta bu ( tu da dza sbu da ngo phe la sdu ga 9 su sa ra tā zwa spya:sngon goms thugs bskyed 'dzam bu'i shing gi 'bras/ /tshogs gnyis chu gter klong du yongs smin pa'i/ /rne mi : swā hā ra ra ma nyu ri ri sho mu na ma skyu la myu kha lha nga :mchan dpe gser gyi snye ma g.yur za mkhan/ /zas gtsang sras kyi bkra shis sgo 'phar phye/ /lung rtogs theg (65na tha mchog mar chags pa'i gdong / /rig byed chos phung brjod pa rnam dag khungs/ /sngon med dga' ba brgya ba btsong kha pa'i/ /zhabs sen zla ba gtsug tor rtse mor tshes/shāka seng rgyud sgras mu stegs ri dwags klad/ /'gems pa'i mnyan yod dus ston 'phags yul dngos/ /yongs 'phos 'jam dpal snying po'i mdzad chen rjes/ /'jug rnams blang dor me long 'di la gzigs/ /de'ang sgron ma'i bskal pa bzang po 'di la 'o skol gyi ston pa sa gsum gyi sgron me gcig pu pa rnam 'dren bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa rin po che ni/ spyod 'jug las/ ji ltar mtshan mo mun nag sprin rum na/ /glog 'gyu skad cig rab snang ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas mthu yis brgya lam na/ /'jig rten bsod nams blo gros thangs 'ga' 'byung / /zhes dngos bstan mun pa dang glog mi khom pa dang dal 'byor gyi dper bzung nas brgya lam tsam du rnyed dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi rten bsod nams kyi 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi mthu la brten nas thangs 'ga' re tsam 'byung bar bshad pa'i shugs la mun pa'i smag chen po'i nang du glog 'khyug pa srid pa bzhin du mun bskal mtha' klas pa'i bar mtshams su sgron me'i bskal pa la de bzhin gshegs pa byon pa'i bstan pa rin po che lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing rmad po che yin pa ni/ bde bar gshegs —94

'phags bal bod sogs yul thur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)pa'i gsung rab las byung ba'i dkar nag gi las 'bras ji bzhin bsams pa'i blang dor la brten nas 'di phyi kun gyi bde skyid dpyid ka sa bon gang btab kyi 'bras bu ston gyi dus su mi 'tshol bar 'byung ba'i phyir/ dbu ma (65ba)rin chen phreng ba las/ mi dge ba las sdug bsngal kun/ /de bzhin ngan 'gro thams cad do/ /dge las bde 'gro thams cad dang / /skye ba kun tu bde ba dag /ces gsungs la/ de yang / sangs rgyas phal po che las 'dren pa la ni mthar thug med/ /de dag sku ni gcig tu snang / /sku gnyis de dag bsam mi khyab/ /'jig rten khams su snang gyur kyang / /sku la gnyis su gyur pa med/ /ji ltar zla ba shar gyur pa/ /tshad med pa yi gzugs brnyan rnams/ /chu yi snod du snang 'gyur yang / /zla ba gnyis su gyur pa med/ /ces bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi 'gro ba'i dbang po dang 'tsham par sku gsung thugs kyi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig ston pas na 'dren pa nyi ma'i gnyen ni nges pa'i don du 'og min sdug po bkod par sangs rgyas zin kyang 'dzam bu'i gling du mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i snang brnyan bzung ba'i 'gro blo'i dwangs mtshor zla gzugs bzhin shar ba theg pa che chung gi bshad tshul mtha' klas shing / bye brag mnyan yod du ston pa drug sogs btul ba'i cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa yang mdo sde mdzangs blun sogs su tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar du bstan pa dang 'dul ba lung du tshes brgyad kyi cho 'phrul las nyi ma g.yin rnams mi gsal zhing rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing du'ang theg dman gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i bshad tshul byung na'ang don cho 'phrul gyi mdzad pa bstan par mtshungs shing 'phags yul du dar ba'i rgyun bzang po gangs kyi ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir so so'i bsdi gnas su dus mchod mdzad pa mang dag byung mod/ gtso bor/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs (66na)pa'i bstan 'di la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bya ba byed/ /byang gi phyogs la brten nas ni/ /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ /gangs can ri yi nang gnas pa'i/ /rgyal po mi yi lha zhes pa/ /li tsa bī rnams rigs su 'byung / /de yang sngags kyi don sgrub ste/ /longs spyod che dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rig pa longasacha(35

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)spyod ldan zhes bya/ /mi yi bdag pos de yang 'grub/ /lo ni brgyad cur rgyal srid bya/ /des na rkun ma rnams par spangs/ / rgyal po des ni srog spangs nas/ /de yang sngags ni myur 'grub ste/ /zhi dang rgyasadang bsil byed pa'i/ / 'jig rten sgrol ma zhes grags dang / /lha mo gos dkar mo dang ni/ /dkar mo chen mo g.yin phan btson/ /rtag tu yid ni mi skyo ba'o/ /de la sogs pa gsungs pa yi/ /de bzhin rgyal po mang po ni/ /rnam pa du ma mang po dag /kha dog sna tshogs sna tshogs gzugs/ /kha ba can na kla klo'i rgyal/ /de yang ston pa mchod byed pa'o/ /khyu mchog khyu mchog bzang po dang / /sa 'od de bzhin sa 'od bzang / /de bzhin pha rol gnon nyid dang / /rkang pa'i 'gros shes ldan pa yin/ /sa srungs dang ni be'u dang / /'od ldan nyid ni phyi ma yin/ /tha mar 'char rgyal ngang tshul te/ /kla klo rnam pa sna tshogs yin/ /de 'og lugs ni rnam zhig cing / /phyi rol skye dgus nye bar spyod/ /ces bstan pa'i nang tshan thugs rje chen po'i rnam sprul chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang lha mo rnam gsum gyi sprul pa khri btsun/kong jo/ 'bri (66ba)bza' thod dkar rnams gtang dpyal gyi tshul bzung zhing btsun mo snga ma gnyis kyi sangs rgyas dngos dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i jo shākya rnam gnyis sogs gdan drangs/ rgyal po yab yum gsum gyis pho brang ma rur sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe rigs gsum mgon po'i lung bstan bzhin mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon gyi lha khang rnams bod srin mo gan rkyal du bskyel ba 'dra ba'i sa'i me btsa' gnon pa'i tshul du bzhengs pa'i mthar 'phrul snang dang ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang legs par bskrun nas bstan pa'i rin po che srol btod par mdzad pa'i gzhi ma rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lo srid pa gsum na zla ma mchis pa 'ji nyid du cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa'i srol btod cing nyams pa med par gnas pa'i mdzad pa po ni/ rgyal rabs bka' khol mar/ de nas khyad par bsnyen bkur cher mdzad pa/ /dge slong byang sems shar phyogs sku 'khrungs pa/ /gsang sngags 'chang zhing rnal 'byor chen po ni/ /snying po'i mtha' can skyes chen dam pas ni/ /zhal yang bsgyur nyid bsnyen bkur dam pa mdzad/ /de la bsnyen bkur cher byed de dag ni/ /'phags pa'i gang zag dge sbyong sha stag go /zhes —96

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wakeshar phyogs btsong kha'i yul du sku bltams shing dge slong gi rten la nges gsang rdo rje theg pa'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa 'jam dpal snying po'i mtshan dang ldan pa gang des 'og min zhing gi gtso bo longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nges pa lnga dang ldan pa'i rten 'brel gyis gser gyi shākya mu ni la rin po che'i dbu rgyan sgron te longs sku'i rnam par zhal bsgyur zhing sri zhu rgya cher mdzad pa lung don dang shin tu 'byor ba'i phyir rje bdag nyid chen po'i mdzad chen bzhi'i nang tshan lha sa'i smon lam chen mor grags pa/(67na tshe sna di nyid dgung lo nga gsum pa sa mo glang gi lo'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar lha mchod mi mchod shin tu rgya che ba dngos bshams yid sprul gyi kun tu bzang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba yid can rnams kyi blo'i ra ba las 'gong bar mdzad/ gtso bor rje btsun nyid nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa'i 'phrin las kyi cha shas las byung ba yin mod/ gnas skabs kyi byed rkyen sde srid phag mo gru pa gong ma chos rgyal chen po kwa ting ta'i gu shri ho wang gi lung la brten nas sne'u rdzong pa nang so nam mkha' bzang pos sbyin bdag gi mthil mdzad cing de rjes me pho spre'u'i lo 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan pa dang sne'u rdzong pa yon mchod bka' bgros te chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab/ de nas bzung rje bdag nyid chen pos bka' gnang ba dang / sne'u rdzong pa du dben sha nam mkha' bzang po'i bzhed pa skong slad/ lha sa smon lam chen mo'i mkhan pos thog drangs/ zhal ta dang chab ril bas mtha' brten pa yan 'bras spungs pas mdzad/ tshogs pa ser 'bras gnyis gtso bor gyur pa'i mdor na rab byung gi rtags cha lugs dang ldan phyin ris su ma chad pa'i phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun 'du bar rgyal ba gnyis pa'i phyag len ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa la dad pa mang ba rnams gsar du dad pa dang / dad pa dang ldan pa rnams la'ang slar gsos btab pa'i ched du/ snga dro snyan ngag mkhan rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu dpal ldan dpa' bos mdzad pa'i 'khrungs rabs so bzhi pa'i chos thun re dang / dgongs mo sras bcas rgyal ba slob mar bcas pa rnams mos pa (67ba)dang bden pa'i mthu las/ mkha' khyab tu spyan drangs la(37

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ma/par mchod pa dang mjug bsngo smon gyis mtha' brten/ gdan gung skye dgu'i tshogs gsog gi dus kun tu bzang po'i smon lam sogs chos spyod kyi rim pa la brten nas bsod nams kyi tshogs dbyar mtsho ltar spel ba'i rnam dkar gyi las rlabs po che bskrun pa ni/ sangs rgyas phal po che las/ skyes bu la las rdo rje zos gyur de la ni/ /zhu bar mi 'gyur gdon mi za bar phyir 'byung 'gyur/ /de bzhin stobs bcu rnams la mchod byas bsod nams kyi/ /ye shes rdo rjes nyon mongs ma lus 'joms par 'gyur/ /tsā skam spungs pa ri bo'i mchog tsam yod gyur kyang / /me mdag yungs 'bru tsam gyis de ni tshig 'gyur te/ /de bzhin bde gshegs mchod pa cung zad cig byas kyang / /nyon mongs thams cad tshig byed mya ngan 'das rgyur 'gyur/ /ri bo kha ba can la mthong legs sman yod de/ / mthong zhing thos pas nad rnams thams cad zhi bar byed/ /de bzhin stobs bcu rnams ni mthong ngam thos gyur kyang //yon tan kun ldan sangs rgyas ye shes 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes phan yon mtha' klas shing / dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen po bskrun pa de tsam du ma zad bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten la dmigs te me tog tsam gtor ba dang / sri zhur bya ba cung zad bgyis pa'ang bsod nams kyi tshogs gzhal du med pa ni/ lung gzhi las/ gang zhig rab dang sems kyis sangs rgyas kyi/ /mchod rten me tog sil ma spungs pas 'thor/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser phye bre bo ni/ /stong phrag brgya la de dang mnyam pa min/ /zhes dang (68na)mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dad pas/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten la ni gom 'dor na/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi tshad srang ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min//gang zhig rab dang sems kyis sangs rgyas kyi/ /mchod rten la ni 'jim gong 'jog byed na/ /'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi gong bu ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min/ /zhes dang / snying rje pad dkar las/ kun dga' bo nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo rab tu byung ba'am/ khyim na gnas pa gang dag kha cig tha na ring bsrel yungs 'bu tsam la bsti stang byed/bla mar byed/ rim gror byed/ mchod par byed na/ kun dga' bo dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyi —98

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)'bras bu yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa yin te/ tha ma yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar nga smra'o/ /zhes bsod nams kyi phung po'i tshad gzung bar dka' ba'i ngang tshul de la 'jug byar yod pa ni/ tshe rabs mang por goms pa'i legs byas kyi 'bras bu yongs su dud pa'i bzang po'i skal ba can yin la/ tshogs kyi zhing dam pa ni/ lung gzhi las/ dge slong dag dge 'dun ni lnga po 'di dag yin te/ lnga gang zhen/ ngo tsha med pa'i dge 'dun dang / lug ltar lkugs pa'i dge 'dun dang / tshogs kyi dge 'dun dang / kun rdzob kyi dge 'dun dang / don dam pa'i dge 'dun no/ /zhes sngar bshad pa'i nang nas slob pa dang mi slob pa'i don dam pa'i dge 'dun dang / phal cher kun rdzob so skye'i dge 'dun yin pa'i phyir/ mdo sde nyi ma'i snying po las/ gal te dge (68bskyosang chos kyi sa gnas pa tshul khrims yongs su dag pa ngo tsha shes pa dang / khrel yod pa phun sum tshogs pa dge slong lnga yang 'dun/rgyal po chen po dge slong gi dge 'dun de ni chos tshad med pa dang ldan pa yin cing sbyin gnas chen po dang / lha dang mi thams cad kyi mchod par 'os par 'gyur ro/ /zhes mchod gnas kyi yul dam par gyur pa de dag gi spyod tshul kyang bag med par gyur na/ theg pa chen po la dad pa rab tu sgom pa las/sa yi bdag po rtag tu bag yod mdzod/ /bag med sems can dmyal ba'i g.yangs sar bor/ bag med spyod pa sems can dmyal bar mchi/ /zhes gsungs shing / de'i ldog phyogs ni/ lung phran tshegs las/ gang bag yod par byos shig /ces zer ba bag yod pa ni chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin no/ /ches bshad pa'i bag yod pa ni/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis/ bag yod pa gang zhe na/ ma chag ba'i pa dang / zhe sdang med pa dang / gti mug med pa dang / brtson 'grus dang bcas pa la gnas nas gang dge ba'i chos rnams bsgom pa dang zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos rnams la sems bsrung ba ste/ zhes bshad pas spang gnyen la blang dor phyin ci ma log pa byed pa'i gzob pas lhur len pa ni bag yod pa ste/ des sgrubs shig /so so thar par/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom par yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub dang / g.yin yang gang dag de lta bu dang mthun pa/ dge ba'i chos —99

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)byang chub kyi phyogs rnams kyang bag yod pas thob bo/ /zhes dang / mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ bag yod bdud (69na)rtsi'i gnas te bag med pa/ 'chi ba'i gnas su thub pas bka' stsal to/ /de bas khyod kyis dge chos spel slad du/ /gus las rtag tu bag dang ldan par mdzod/ /ces 'khor rnam pa bzhi'i rtsa ba bag yod la rags lus shing bye brag tu/ rgan rim la bsnyen bkur dgos te/ lung gzhi las/bdag cag gi nang na su rgan de nas gong ma sreg gis shing n+ya gro dha zhig bstan nas/ shes ldan dag sus shing n+ya gro dha 'di'i tshad ji tsam pa mthong / glang po ches smras pa/ kho bo khyu dang lhan cig lam 'di nas 'gro ba na 'di'i kho bo'i lus dang mnyam pa kho na mthong ngo / /spre'u sa smras pa/ kho bo khyu dang lhan cig lam 'di nas 'gro ba na 'di'i srid kho bo dang mnyam pa kho na mthong ngo / /de dag gis smras pa/ de bas khyod rgan no/ /ri bong gis smras pa/ kho bos 'di'i lo ma gnyis skyes pa na lo ma'i zil pa'i thigs pa lces bldogs so/ /de dag gis smras pa/ 'di dag pas kyang khyod rgan no/ /gong ma sreg gis smras pa/ khyed cag gi shing n+ya gro dha'i tshad chen po'i rnam pa 'di mthong ngam de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'di mthong ngo / /kho bos sa bon rnams zos nas phyogs 'dir sdug pa bor ba de las skyes pa ni 'di yin no/ /de rnams kyis smras pa/ gal te de ltar na bdag cag thams cad kyi nang na khyod rgan no/ /de nas glang po ches thams cad la bsnyen bkur byed par brtsams so/ /spre'u yis ni ri bong dang gong ma sreg la'o/ /ri bong gis ni gong ma sreg kho na la ste/ zhes dud 'gro yin kyang rgan gzhan go rim ma log par bsnyen bkur bas 'jig rten du bde skyid byung bar bshad cing / phran (69ba〉〈gas las/ dge slong dag de bas na deng phyin chad dge slong rgan rabs rnams la ming nas 'bod par mi bya/ rus nas 'bod par mi bya ste/ btsun pa zhes brjod pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa zhes brjod pa ma gtogs par kun tu spyod par mi bya'o/ /zhes bslab pa rgan gzhen sogs kyi rim pa ma nor bar gral gyi dang po dang rnyed pa gral rim nas 'grim pa sogs 'og ma dag gis gong ma la 'dud par bya bar gsungs pas na 'dus tshogs 'di dag tu'ang brlang spyod bag yangs su ma song ba'i gra sa phan tshun gyi gral 'dzin sngar — /////

'phags bal bong sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)srol gang yin dang / de phyin phyogs 'dus kyi dge 'dun tshul ldan rnams gtso che ba byas nas tshul 'chal dang dge sbyong gi cha byad mgo reg dag dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa la lhan cig tu longs spyod pa ni/lung rnam 'byed las/ lcags gong me lce 'dra ba dag /zos par gyur pa mchog yin gyi/ /tshul 'chal yang dag mi sdom pas/ /yul 'khor bsod snyoms za ba min/ /zhes dang / mdo sde nyi ma'i snying po las/ /spu gri rnon po dag gis su/ /rang gi yan lag gtubs pa bla'i/ /bsngos zin pa yi dngos po ni/ /khyim pa rnams la sbyin mi bya/ /zhes tshe rabs phyi ma rnams su ngan song gi sdug bsngal mi bzod pa'i rgyur snang mod/ 'on kyang / snying rje pad dkar las/ kun dga' bo phyi ma'i dus zad pa'i dus dam pa'i chos 'jig par 'gyur pa'i dus na gang dag nga'i bstan pa 'di la rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur pa dag rab tu byung nas bu'i lag pa nas bzung ste/ bu dang lhan cig tu chang skyogs gang gi phyir chang ma'i khyim nas chang ma'i khyim du 'khrum pa/ nga'i dam pa'i chos 'di'i rjes su bslab pa de dag thams cad kyang kun dga' bo bskal pa bzang po (70na tshe sna di la yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / kun dga' bo nga'i bstan pa 'di la gang dag dge sbyong gi rigs can dge sbyong shin te ma/ dge sbyong du khas 'ches pa/ dge sbyong ltar bcos pa/ ngur smrig gyon pa 'byung ba de dag thams cad kyang bskal pa bzang po 'di la gang byams pa nas mos pa la thug gi bar du phyis 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi 'og tu mthar gyis mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bstan pa 'di la rab tu byung bar khas 'ches pa'i tshul 'chal dang rtags tsam 'dzin pa dag kyang bskal pa sogs la mi bltos par myang 'das thob par dbugs dbyung ba ltar na gzhan las khyad zhugs shing snyigs mar spyad pa'i dus 'dir yul dang dus bstun dgos pa'i phyir bka' srol mi 'dug rung gral gyi mtha' dkyil sogs kyi khyad gsung rab dang bstun na dgos par snang mod/ rang bstan la ched du phan par mi 'gyur bzhin du pho rus su ming btags pa'i kun slong ngan pas dbyen du 'gyur ba'i spyod pa ni/ sems dpa' chen po thogs med bzang po dpal gyis/ /gzhan gnod gzhi bcas — 101 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)spong bar khas blangs nas/ /dgra la sdug las thongs pa'i pho rgod po/ /rang gi sdom gsum yul nas 'don nyen gda'/ /gnod sems rtsad nas thon par byin gyis rlobs/ /dge sbyong chos bzhi bsgrub par dam bcas nas/ /khe drag dbang chen 'dod pa'i nga rgyal can/ /khas blangs thog tu khel ba mi gda' 'o/ /rtag tu dman cha 'dzin par byin gyes rlobs/ /zhes khro ba la slar mi khro/ rdeg pa la slar mi rdeg /gshe ba la slar mi gshe/ mtshang 'dru ba la slar mtshang mi (70ba tshe sru ba khas 'ches nas bsam sbyor 'jig rten pa gzhung ma dang khyad par med pa/ kong btsun shes rab rdo rjes/ blo chags sdang gis 'chad pa'i ston chen dang / khong 'jig rten pa'i gtso bo rgyad bu gnyis/ khyad e 'dug kun slong sems la dris zhes pa'i don thog tu bab dus 'di de 'dra'i ngang tshul 'byung ba/ 'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu bdud sdig can gyis ni nga 'das pa'i lo bdun brgya lon pa na/ nga'i bstan pa phye zhing bshig par 'gyur te/ dam pa'i chos nub pa'i tshe bdud sdig can zag pa can gyis zag pa med pa lta bur bsgyur te/ bya ba'i rtags kyis tshul byed pa bzhin du dge slong gi gzugs dang / dge slong ma'i gzugs dang / dge bsnyen gyi gzugs dang / dge bsnyen ma'i gzugs 'di rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang / sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis bshig par 'gyur te/zhes sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la glags lta ba'i ched du yid srubs dge sbyong gi gzugs ltar bshad pa ni dus dbang gis 'byung nye zhing dge 'dun rnams 'thab rtsod la sbyor ba'i 'bras bu dge 'dun srungs kyi rtogs brjod du/ dgung gi gdugs tshod la babs pa na rab tu byung ba dag mgo bo tho bas bsnun te khrag babs pa dang 'du sgo bkag pa la brten nas bza' btung lcags khur gyur par bshad cing /der ma zad dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa'i rnam smin ni/ lung rigs gter mdzod las/ bar bskal gcig gi bar du mnar med kyi sdug bsngal myong bar byed cing dbyen gyi mtshams med gnyis byas na mnar med (71na)du lus nyis 'gyur la gnod pa sngar las nyis 'gyur du myong dgos te/ bskal — 102

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)bar mnar med par smin 'gyur/ /lhag pas gnod pa lhag par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ni/lung phran tshegs las/ zla ba skar ma'i tshogs bcas sa la lhung yang srid/ /sa 'di ri dang nagasabacas mkha' la 'gro yang srid/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i chu ni skam par 'gyur srid kyi/ /drang srong chen po rdzun gsung 'gyur ba srid pa min/ zhes bde bar gshegs pas rdzun gsung pa'i skabs ni nam yang med pas nges par bden la de ltar yang bshes springs las/ khyod kyis dge slong bram ze lha dang ni/ /nor dang yab yum dag dang btsun mo dang / /'khor gyi slad du'ang sdig pa mi bgyid de/ /dmyal ba'i rnam smin skal nod 'ga' ma mchis/ /zhes rang gzhan gang gi ched du bsags pa'i sdig pa'i 'bras bu bdag nyid gcig pu'i thog tu smin pa'i phyir blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyi blang dor gnad ma 'dzol ba zhig gnad du che la/ skabs don gyi snying po/ thub bstan 'chi med lam du gsal byed nyi zla lta bur zung du 'brel ba dpal ldan 'bras spungs dang se ra theg chen gling phan tshun rab byung drug pa'i lcags pho byi ba nas bzung cho 'phrul chen mo'i dus chabs cig tu 'du tshogs mdzad bzhin par brjod gleng sna tshogs yod don mi 'dug kyang las sne ba 'dra'i skyon gyis snga phyir thugs mi mthun pa ci rigs dang nye char rab byung bcu gcig pa shing yos kyi lor 'bras spungs dge skos dang bya rung ba thug pa'i rkyen slong dang ngo bo 'byung po'i cho 'phrul lta bu'i za zir sna tshogs pa'i rgya cher nye ba sde ba'i bslab ston gyis smon lam bar 'gyangs shing de rjes se ra ba dpon slob nas gcod mtshams dgos tshul byung ba phan tshun so so'i khyer phyogs ci yod things dka' (71ba)gshis grwa tshang gnyer pa 'phyong rgyas pa blo bzang sbyin pa dang 'phan yul lha khang pa sger logs a dar gnyis btang ba'i gsung rigs rnam grangs mang ba so sor sbyangs bshad kyi khongs su thus pa byas/ me glang ri kha bla ma tshal pa rab 'byams pa blo bzang chos skyong gis dge skos dus gral 'dzin gyi gral bzo ba dang ja gtong ba sogs pher rgya mang du byas shing dgon par 'byor nas 'di bzhin byas yod pas dbyar mjug gangs la skyol gyi tshogs gtam btang ba rim gyis mched pa 'bras spungs pa rnams kyi thugs su ma shong ba'i rkyen gyis skyor lung bla ma snang — 103

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)mgo rab 'byams pa ngag dbang rgya mtsho dang sprul sku dgos skyes kyi bu grags pa blo bzang sogs dge skos 'ga' re'i thog se ra ba phyogs kyi gral rnams rim shor dang / dge slong don grub rgya mtsho'i dge skos kyi thog ja gtong ba yang phyogs lhung ha cang ches pa dang / rgyu rkyen zhig la dpon sa lha mos mas se ra chos rje gnyal ston pa'i drung du skye rtags zhus par chu srin du skye ba'i sgo dgag par dge 'dun stong ra can gyis sman bla'i mdo chog chen mo gsung bar lung bstan pa bzhin rgyas btab ra mo che'i gan+dho lar btsugs pa na mchod dbyangs pa bzhi ma gtogs mkhan pos thog drangs las sne ba thams cad se ra ba kho nas mdzad pa'i sne mo ba ci rigs kyi skyon la brten lho pa dang spo 'bor ba'i gral gyi bar du 'bras spungs pa'i bla ma rnams bzhugs dka' zhing grwa dmangs tshogs byings po'i khrod du mnyam bsres thog 'bri phag la dmag btang skabs gling khu ru dben po'i dpa' dar la byung ba'i ka gling dgu dang / ka bzhi la sgor mor byas pa'i nya khug gral dmigs bsal du bsgrig pa zhig yod 'dug par yang brdung 'tshog dang ja thug ji bzhin mi gtong ba sogs phan tshun gcig ngan gcig rgyag dang / sa bya'i smon lam dus (72na tsher brang spungs dge skos rgan pa star sdong bka' bcu blo bzang rab brtan la byes pa'i sog po zhig gis lag lan gyi rnam pa byas par byes slob dpon pa bya bral rab 'byams pa 'jam dbyangs lhun grub kyis legs jo'i lba dar btags pa sogs se ra phyogs nas bstan bshig gi gnya' mi gnon par gzengs bstod pa byung zhing 'bras spungs phyogs nas de rigs kyi skyon med tshul phan tshun gzigs stangs ma gcig cing rmu rgod la la ma pher ba'i rigs la sngon las dang gang du'ang gsha' ma med pa skad kyis zla grogs 'tshol zhing ngang pa mtsho ngom dang 'ug pa brag jom gyi rgyab brten/ khrel bdas la ngo sor 'khyer ba'i dge skyon sna tshogs byung 'dug pa da cha blang dor mdzad rgyu'i snying po lha sa smon lam chen mo'i gdong gral nub lta dang de'i rgyab sprod zhal shar gzigs tshun 'bras spungs pa dang / de'i rgyab nub lta rtsa gral nas bzung pa'i gral drug tsam se ra ba sha stag dang de nas rmi ru bzhi sde bar gral gcig /de rgyab ser 'bras 'dres ma dang phyogs mtha'i — 1(/zhe

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (5)dge 'dun sogs sna tshogs 'tshog pa/ se ra ba rnams kyis gral khungs yod pa sor bzhag gis gral 'dzin la ma byon na rtsod pa'i rgyu yod 'dug pas gral 'dzin la nges par 'byon/ 'bras spungs kyi grwa tshang bdun nas dge skos res skor dang spyan ltos kyi khyad nas dge skos kyis mdzub mo gar bstad shar gyi dpes chun che zhing / se rar grwa tshang gsum ga nas dge skos langs pa'i phyogs khyer gyis so so'i grwa tshang ma yin par rgyag brdung sogs cher ma nus pa'i chun chung skyon gyi rigs la thang lhod tsam yod 'dug pa smon lam gyi dus dge skos dang char btag mas rgyun gyi mig shugs la brten tshogs 'jam mi 'jam byung bar sgrigs gnon gyi brdung 'tshog byas par se ra ba phyogs nas bsnyad 'dogs mi mdzad cing / de rigs (72bas dgos tsam byung phyin zhen gsog tu 'gro ba'i brdung 'tshog mi byed/ gra sa gnyis ka nas bstan bshig byad mi'i rigs la tshogs gtam du gnya' gnon ma gtogs dbugs dbyung dang bya dga' mi ster/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me sprul nas bzung sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan gyis 'bras spungs pa dpon slob dang bka' bgros pa'i se ra slob dpon gsum tshogs la 'byon pa'i sa bcad mdzad pa lcags 'brug gral 'dzin la lag thug byung ba'i rkyen gyis sa khri bshig 'dug rung se ra ba'i slob dpon rnams da lta bar 'byon bzhin par de rigs kyi gze gsag mi byed/ de gong lo shas gsung chos ra ba dang maṇ+ḍal ra ba sogs su se ra'i slob dpon gsum gyi gsham du dge skos dbu mdzad kyang 'thud par brjod gleng byung ma song ba sa stag za zir chen mo'i skabs nas bcad mtshams grub 'dug pa bzhin dbu mdzad dge skos rnams grwa dmangs kyi khrod las slob dpon pa rnams kyi gsham du mi bsgrig /ja thug rnams gdong gral gnyis gong du phud/ de phyin gral thams cad la mnyam khebs shig ma byung na rtsod slong gi rgyur ma zad bzhes pa rnams phyogs
