mtshungs su mi yong ba'i tshogs kyi kun spyod la yang gnod par snang / se ra'i khams tshan gyi mang 'gyed byung dus sbyin bdag gi spos sna re tsam yong ba snga thog gi khungs dang yig rigs sogs skyel rgyu mi 'dug rung bar skabs su har ldong gis thog mar srol btod 'dug pas mtshon khams tshan rnams — 105

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shenye che 'brel zab byas 'dug pa sbyin bdag gi mi re tsam ma the ba blo ma rangs pa'i dge 'dun gyi 'du sgo gzhan du bsgyur thabs kyis rang gzhan la brten nas sdig gsog pa'i nyen 'dug gshis dper na se ra har ldong gi mang 'gyed lta bu byung ba'i tshe 'bras spungs dge rgan gyi rjes su khams tshan gyi ngo so tsam gyi ched du se ra (73na)har ldong gi mi re phyin pa spos sna smon lam chen mo'i las tshan du mi gtogs gshis skyon du mi 'gyur/ 'gyed shar kha gnyis dgos pa byung na 'bras spungs pa rang gi dge rgan gnyis kyis gtong zhing se ra'i dge rgan las grogs lta bu las lag 'jug mi byed/ gra sa so sor khams tshan 'dzin thebs dang dgra gnyen dbye 'byed lta bur 'gyed skal sna tshogs gtong srol 'dug rung smon lam chen mor de rigs byas tshe dge 'dun spyi'i rnyed pa la gnod pa nas khams bod ngo bo rnams dang skyid sdug gcig pa'i nye logs kyi khams pa rnams la nyis skal lam sum skal/ dge rgan dang rogs byed rnams la lnga skal lam bcu skal tsam yang gtod ba'i srol ngan bar skabs su dar 'dug kyang da cha gong gsal mtha' dag rang skal las mi gtod/ 'phar chag med pa smon lam gyi las tshan rnams deb gsal ltar yin/ sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyi dus 'gyed gtong skabs gzhung gi sku tshab re yong gin yod 'dug pa/ sa khyi gsang sgo nas bzung bar bkab ma byung 'dra yang da cha mtshams tshigs kyi mig lta dang bcas yod pa 'gab 'bul ba rnam gzhag gi skabs 'bras spungs kyi bla ma dbu mdzad par bsngo rten dgos pa smos ma dgos shing sgo mangs slob dpon pa dang nye logs kyi bla ma rnams la 'bul ba byas pa'i steng se ra har ldong gi byes pa slob dpon pa sogs la sgo mangs slob dpon can las rim 'gros kyis chung ba ma gtogs 'dra ba mi byed/ 'bras spungs har ldong gi mang ja'i skabs se ra'i har ldong gi dge rgan spos sna mdun ja sogs la 'bod par dgag sa med/dpe 'dis khams tshan gzhan rnams la'ang mtshon zhing co ni khag lnga'i mang 'gyed la bar skabs su spos sna dang 'gyed/ (73ba)gtong mkhan kho rang tsho'i dge rgan gyis byas 'dug pa 'bras spungs su co ni rnams la khams tshan gyi thob thang 'dug pas dper na co ba gzhung pa 'bras skrungs su rta dbon — 106

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)pa dang rgya yi wang gnyis por lo re mos kyi 'bab kyi yod 'dug pas de gnyis re mos su yin gyis gzhung pa'i mang 'gyed la gong gi har ldong gi dpe ji lta ba bzhin byed/ ra mo che'i smon lam la yang 'bras spungs kyi slob dpon tsam byung la zos gang legs las lho pa spo 'bor bas gral la zhi brdung dang dge skos gsum gyis 'bras spungs pa'i gra pa rnams la dgos med kyi zhen gsog mi byed cing /ja thug sogs bzhes pa rnams kyang phan tshun khyad med snyams par gtong / bya rung pa 'di skyed shod sde pa g.yul rgyal nor bu'i dus dbon po bskal bzang zer ba'i gzugs btsun zhig la khog zhugs byung tshod chos skyong du bya rung ba tsam yin byas pa las ming der thogs pa rim gyis sgra 'chol ba ma gtogs shar phyogs sku'i rgyal po'i blon po gra tshong 'dus bya khrid mig gcig pa min pas nub phyogs gsung gi rgyal po'i blon po rdo rje grags ldan du zhal gyis bzhes pa tshal yang dgon rgyal chen lta bu'i do zla min rung 'bras spungs kyi sne mo ba rnams kun rtog sna tshogs kyis sdangs tsam snang ba snga thog smon lam chen mo'i gral 'dzin gyi dung ma btang tshun khog zhugs bkag cha byed srol med na'ang de sgos gral 'dzin gyi nyin gra dmangs thams cad tshogs zin pa dang gra thog kyang yang yang brje ba'i gshis gsar bu ba rgyus med 'dras brdung 'tshog byas tshe da lo ltar dge 'dun thugs mi mthun pa'i phyi yul du gtam cha nan cing rnam smin nag por 'dzag pa'i rgyun kho na'i dgag bya che zhing dgos pa chung ba nas ra mo che'i gos sku'i dus bya rung pa g.yul khang rgyab nas ra mo cher shar mar byon ngos byams pa gdan 'dren ma zin bar khog (74na sko dugs mi byed/ de yang sngar smos kyi phan tshun thugs mi mthun pa'i zing rkyen gyi rgyu byas tshe mtha' klas pa'i 'dus tshogs 'di lta bur phal mo che'i so skye'i dge 'dun bzhin du snang yang gang zag gi tshod gang zag gis bzung ma nus par mdo las bshad pas skyes bu zung bzhi gang zag ya brgyad sogs 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dang der ma zad byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i theg pa chen po'i dge 'dun sogs sbas pa'i tshul can dam pa ji snyed cig yod par nges pas/ de dag la khro ba dang rtsod pa 'tshang 'dru ba ni/ la jug pa las gang phyir rgyas sras rnams la khros pa yis/ /sbyin dang — /07

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)khrims byung dge ba bskal pa brgyar/ /bsags pa skad cig gis 'joms de yi phyir/ /mi bzod labatagazhan sdig pa yod ma yin/ /zhes 'byung la/ der ma zad 'phags pa dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i mdo las/ shwa ri drwa ti'i bu de bzhin du gang byang chub sems dpa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa gcig gis bar chad byed pa de ni chos dkon mchog gi phung po 'bum phrag mang po dpag tu med pa grangs med pa dag gi bar chad byed pa yin no/ /zhes theg pa chen po'i gang zag gcig gis gzhan phan bsgrub pa la gnod par byed pa'i sdig 'bras bsam gyis mi khyab par bshad pas bag dang ldan pa 'di phyi kun gyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir gong smos rnams kyi blang dor 'dzol ba med par brtson pas lhur blangs na 'jig rten kun tu gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde skyid rgya chen po 'byung bar 'gyur ba ni/ji skad du/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig /ces (74ba tsher gro ba kun gyi nyon mongs pa'i nad ma lus pa 'joms pa'i rtsi sman chen po phan pa dang bde ba ma lus pa 'byung ba'i sgo dam pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che yin la/ de yang mngon pa mdzod du/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang / /sgrub par byed pa kho na'o/ /zhes lung rtogs kyi bstan pa de yang / ma pham pas/ yi ge 'dri mchod sbyin pa dang / nyin dang klog dang len pa dang / /'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang sgom pa ste/ /spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid kyi/ /bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /ces dge 'dun rnams klog pa thos bsam dang spong ba bsam gtan 'phel ba la rag lus/ de yang phan tshun mnyes gshin pa'i thugs mthun pa rtsa ba lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ gso sbyong la'ang rigs mang du yod pa sngon bsags kyi sdig pa sbyong ba zhi gnas dang / bcu bzhi pa/ bco lnga pa/ gnod pa phyir bzlog /rtsod pa phyir bzlog /bkra shis pa rnams tshe 'di'i zag pa 'gog phyir mthun pa'i gso sbyong gi khongs su bsdus pa'i dgos pa yang lung rigs gter mdzod las/ bslab pa gsum gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i sgo nas gnas — /()ni

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wanaskabs mngon mtho/ mthar thug nges legs thob pa'i dgos pa yod pa dang / khyad par ston pa'i bcas pa dang mthun cing sa phyogs bkra shis pa dang / phyogs de na gnas pa'i skye bo mang po la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /zhes gso sbyong gi phan yon bshad pa/ der ma zad dge 'dun thugs mthun pa'i 'bras bu ni/ so sor thar pa'i don las/ tshe dang ldan pa dge 'dun dang lhan (75na༄ga par mthun par gyis shig /dge 'dun mthun pa mi byed/ kun tu dga' mi rtsod/ mchog gcig 'don pa gcig cing chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa lta bur gyur pa/ ston pa'i bstan pa yang gsal bar byed na bde ba la reg par gnas par gyur gyi/ zhes rgya cher bsngags shing / mgon po zhi ba lhas/gtsug lag khang rnams klog pa dang / kha ton gyis rgyas legs gnas shog /rtag par dge 'dun mthun pa dang / dge 'dun don yang grub par shog /ces smon lam mdzad pas kyang shes nus so//lus can bsod nams nya phyis yangs pa'i khog /bde skyid mu tig phyung bur legs spungs pa/ /star brgyu'i srad bur spel ba 'dus pa'i sde/ /srid zhi'i gdung ba kun gzhil cho ga mkhan/ /de phyir phyogs lhung ri dwags 'khrul rjes su/ /ma 'brangs lhag bsam rgyud las drangs pa'i mdos/ /dge 'dun dbyen gyi la sgo'i mgrin gcod pa'i/ /'phongs skyen gnyis pa'i dga' byed lha zhig snang / /legs byas gaṅgā'i yab gcig las babs klung / /mtha' klas yang srid 'dzin lam 'ongs pa'i rgyun/ /byang chen chu gter 'phel klong ma rgan klu/ /gtan bde gdengs ga'i nor bu 'od 'bar shog /ces lus can kun gyi ma 'dris pa'i gnyen gcis pu rnams 'dren zas gtsang sras po'i cho 'phrul gyi dus chen lha sa smon lam chen mo'o tshe dge 'dun rnams kyi nyams bzhes su bstar bar 'os pa'i bca' khrims dang gzu gzhi mthun pa lta bu'i yi ge srid sgrub nyag phran 'di ni za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes srin po zhes pa shing yos nam mthongs zla ba'i tshes gcig (75bskran pa snar ma'i 'grub sbyor gyi nyin 'dzin ma'i spos las mngon par 'phags pa'i rgyal khab chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson rig pa 'dzin pa — //)mi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2re/'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis sa sarba di k+ka le la smyi bhawa skyo/ /shing yos rgyal mo rdo rje rab brtan dang / tshe dbang lha mo ma bu/ thor god dbu mdzad chos rje an+da ra bka' bcu/ dar khan dbon po rnams la lus med kyi 'tsho ba bsrung ba'i 'phrin yig rdo rje'i bzhad sgra/ dpal ldan rtsa ba gsum gyi lha sngags ye shes sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i zlos gar gyi rnal 'byor spyod pa po zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal gyi ched du smras don/chos nyid gdod nas rnam par dag par gnod bya gnod byed dmigs su med na'ang / rde'u shing bur rta glang dang / thag khrar sprul du mthong ba'i dngangs skrag bzhin kun rdzob zhabrul pa'i snang ngor sngon byas sdig 'bras kyi nyer 'tshe'i gzugs brnyan 'char bas/ khyod lha ma srin bran mngag gzhug dang bcas pa rnams kyis gnod pa byas par brten yul de gnas skabs su mnar zhing / byed pa po rnams kyang dkar min gyi 'bras bu rang gzhan gnyis 'phung gi sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ che ge mo zhes pa 'di pa'i mi nor la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor spong bar gyis/ de ltar na ring min gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol la brten nas byang chub mchog la gzhol ba'i ting nge 'dzin 'grub pa'i rnam par dag pa'i smon lam gyis mtshams sbyor ba yin/ ci ste log par spyod na ye nas snying la gnas pa'i las nyon lcags kyi sdig pa nag po'i rang gzugs su gyur te snying khrag 'jib pa la ya nga bar mi 'gyur ram/khrag 'thung rnam par rol pa'i gtam gyi yi ge srin po'i lo nam mthong zla ba'i dmar cha'i gral tshes la dbang drag rol pa'i gzhal med khang nas bris/ /nyang smad bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i rdzong chen du tshe'i rig byed gso ba rig pa'i grwa tshang drang srong 'dus pa'i gling gi bca' yig /e ma 2 6 su ka rnya ku shu 〉 kri ca 'i rnya sto hi ma hā tsho ma ko di na rma : ta /ngo mtshar lta na sdug pa dag pa'i zhing / /sman gyi grong khyer chen por mchog sprul gar/ /— //(3

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)su ba rte kya rba nga khru rla ra smi 3so bu rnya ka 8rgya ga kṛ tā ta shā sa tu/ /legs bsgyur be+eḍūr+ya 'od rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /thugs rje zil dngar 'gro srog zungs 'gyur mdzod/ /drang srong gnyis kyi zhu ba zhus lan tshig /ma smad byin gyis brlabs pa rgyal ba'i bka'/ /bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa'i rgyud/ /chos phung rgya mtsho'i rab dang phul rtser son/ /de tshul bshad cing nyan pas 'khrul med du/ /gtan la 'bebs pa'i 'phags yul paṇa grub tshogs/ /gangs can lha yi rje bo mu thi li'i/ /phreng mdzes dge 'dun legs byas bya ba'i zhing / /tshe yi rig gzhung ston 'chang mchog gsum dngos/ /rigs 'dus sman gyi bla ma g.yu thogs pa/ /yon tan mgon po'i bka' drin 'jig rten khams/ /dzaskru'i gser gyis bkang yang gzhal nus ci/ /(76ba)phyogs 'dzin gdon gyis ma bslad ma 'dris pa'i/ /skye dgu gdung ba'i mi lus sa skad cig la/ /bde skyid lha yi gzug bas su bsgyur nus pa/ /gso rig brgya sbyin gtsug gi nor bu bzhin/ /byang pa rigs ldan brang ti rim byon dang / /drang srong mnyam nyid rdo rje zur mkhar ba'o/ /bzhed srol bshad bka' phyag bzhes man ngag rgyun/ /srin mthar mi nub phan bde'i dpag bsam ljon/ /gangs can tshangs pa rgan po'i brgyud 'dzin mkhan/ /gnad rigs 'tsho byed gtsang stod tsha rong pa/ /tshe brtan rdo rje mched kyis legs lam du/ /gzur gnas blo gsal mang po bkri 'di mtshar/ /de phyir nyang smad nyi ma phung po'i ri/ /srin pa'i rdzong chen bsam don lhun grub par/ /'chi ba'i dngos 'joms rig byed 'dzin pa'i sde/ /blang dor ma 'dres yongs su bstar ba'i ched/ /bag med ci bder rgyu ba glang po'i snar/ /bca' yig rnon po'i lcags kyu nyer 'debs na/ /thos bsam shalbi ka yi nags yangs por/ /rnam dpyod lus stobs rgyas pa'i tshul 'di mtshar/ /zhes phun sum tshogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pas sngun bsus te skabs don gleng bar bya ba ni/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa/ /rang blo shes bya kun la ma sbyangs na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' ltar ring/ /de ltar dgongs nas rgyal dang de sras kyis/ /shes bya'i gnas kun sbyangs zhes legs par gsung / /zhes bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub par byed la shes bya — 1// —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)mtha' dag la legs par bslab dgos par gsungs shing bslab bya'i yul rig pa'i gnas chen bco brgyad sogs sngon gyi mkhas pa'i lugs srol mang na'ang snying por dril na/ mdo sde rgyan las/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas par ma byas na/ /(77na/ri phags mchog ci sems thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob mi 'gyur/ /de bas gzhan rnams tshar bcad rjes su gzung phyir dang / /rang nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed/ /ces rig pa'i gnas lnga gsungs pa'i log smra tshar gcod pa sgra tshad/ g.yin rjes su 'dzin pa bzo gso/ rang nyid kun shes par bya ba nang rig pa ste lnga las phyi ma nyid kyis chog gam snyam na/mgon po zhi ba lhas/ rgyal sras rnams kyis mi bslab pa'i/ dngos de gang yang yod ma yin/ /de ltar gnas pa'i mkhas pa la/ /bsod nams mi 'gyur gang yang med/ /ces rgyal ba'i sras po rnams kyis sems can gyi don sgrub pa la bslab bar mi bya ba'i gnas gang yang med par gsungs shing khyad par gso ba rig pa ni/ rtogs brjod rin po che las/ bdud rtsi'i chu gter ma bsrubs shing / /nor rgyas thang yang ma bcad la/ /ri bo sgril ba med par ni/ /glang po 'di ni su yis bskrun/ /zhes nor rgyas kyis srubs thag /lhun pos srubs shing byas nas lha rnams kyis/ /rgya mtsho bsrubs pa las nyi zla/ /lha mo dpal mo/ glang chen sa srungs/ rta thor thos/ chang rnams byung ba rig byed kyi gzhung nas bstan la/ de yang bstan pa 'di'i sngon rol du lha shed bu dang shed las mi rnams thog mar byung ba'i tshe de gnyis kyis sa'i zhag zos pas ma 'ju ba'i nad kyis btab par tshangs pas chu skol btang bas nad pa la snga ba shed bu dang shad las/ nad la snga ba ma 'ju ba/ sman la snga ba chu skol/ sman pa la snga ba tshangs pa zhes grags shing / rgya mtsho'i gting du bdud rtsi shel bum gang 'dug pa sgra gcan gyis mthong ste lha rnams la sbran pas de dag gis rgya mtsho bsrubs (77ba)pa'i skabs der thog mar dug ha la zhes bya ba gdong dgu pa gang gis kyang 'dul bar dka' ba zhig thon pa tshangs pas sangs rgyas kyi lung bstan dran te hūm̐ zhes sdigs mdzub mdzad pas de zhig nas rgyu dang mi rgyu ba'i dug gnyis song zhing — 1/2

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)de rjes su bdud rtsi thon pa lha ma yin gyis sgra gcan brku bar btang ba lha'i bur sprul nas bdud rtsi 'dren pa po byas te rang nyid kyis btungs shing lhag ma khur nas bros par zla bas lha rnams ra mdar sbran pa sgra gcan gyis 'khor lo 'phangs pa tshangs pa'i 'khur tshos la phog /mes po'i 'khor lo dam bca' bzhi ldan gyis sgra gcan gyi ske bcad pa'i tshe tshangs pas rang gi rma'i zug rngu dang sgra gcan gyi ske bcad pa'i snying rjes sdug bsngal rab tu zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas mkhur tshos las o a tha zhes pa'i sgra byung ba'i rkyen gyis sngon sangs rgyas shākya thub pa chen pos gsungs pa'i gsod dpyad 'bum sde dran/ de la brten nas tshangs pas gsang ba snying po'i don bsdus mdzad de rim gyis skye dgu'i bdag po dang brgya byin la sogs par brgyud pa ni lha'i lugs/ brgya byin gyi slob ma rgyun shes kyis sman gyi bskos bstan pa dang / tsa ra ka sde brgyad sogs drang srong gi lugs/ dbang phyug chen po'i ska rags kyi rgyud dang skra shad 'dzings pa'i rgyud sogs phyi rol pa'i lugs su grags la/ rdo ring mdzes byed du/ gcig na rig byed rdzun yin par/ /gzhung lugs chen po 'ga' las bshad/ /mi gcig ce na spyi sgos kyi/ /gtam rgyud gang gis sgo nas 'chad/ /ces pa'ang sgra yangs pa'i dbang du byas na srog 'tsho ba'i thabs mtha' dag tshe'i rig byed du smra mi rung ba min cing / dog na dpal ldan rgyud bzhi sman rgyal gyis bka' stsal phyin gong gi lo rgyus la bltos mi dgos par sems (78na)bstan pa 'di la 'o skol gyi ston pas chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor ba'i dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi dus 'dul ba sman gyi gzhi gsungs pa ni nad thams cad bkris pa dang 'du ba gnyis su bsdus/ sman thams cad dus rung mthun tshod/ zhag bdun/'tsho ba'i bar bcad pa bzhir bsdus pa'i sngon ma gsum dngos bstan gso rig la mi mkho ba 'dra zhig snang yang sman dpyad mtha' dag lus yun du gnas pa'i thabs las ma 'das pas/ shes spring las/ kha zas sman dang 'dra bar rig pa yis/ /'dod chags zhe sdang med par bsten bgyi ste/ /rgyags phyir ma lags bsnyems pa'i phyir ma lags/ /'tshag phyir ma lags lus gnas 'ba' zhig — //3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)phyir/ /zhes pas kyang rtogs sam snyam/ bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i dus rgyal po pad+ma'i dpal gyis dbyar gnas la spyan drangs pa'i tshe shā ri bu dang 'od mdzes la gcer mthong rig pa'i rgyud/ gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje'i gnas su lha dang drang srong gi 'khor la rgyud shel gyi me long / tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i skabs gser 'od dam pa'i chu 'bebs kyi le'u gsungs shing dus de'i tshe thub pa'i dbang po sman gyi bla'i rnam par bstan nas nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul du grong khyer lta na sdug /ma la ya sogs ri bo bzhis mtshon pa'i gnas kyi khyad par dkyil 'khor gyi mtha'i dur khrod dang lha klu ltar de dang / de'i ming du btags pa las don/ he badz+ra las/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga / rang gi tshogasaldan nyan pa nga / zhes thams cad gtso bo'i ye shes bzung bya'i rnam par 'phrul pa sha stag tu gsungs pa dang 'dra ba'i gnas der ston pa nyid kyis byin gyis rlabs shing sprul pa'i (78ba)drang srong rig pa'i ye shes dang yid las skyes gnyis kyis zhu ba dang zhus lan gyi tshul du bdud rtsi'i snying po yan lag brgyad pa rtsa bshad man ngag phyi ma'i rgyud 'di bka' stsal zhing drang srong yid las skyes kyis gser gyi ljang 3|ga la be+eḍūr+ya'i khu bas bris te glegs bam du byas par grags pa de'ang mkhas pa mang dag 'di ni rje btsun g.yu thog pas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos su bzhed na'ang lugs 'di la g.yu thog pa rigs 'dus sman pa'i rgyal po dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dngos yin pas de'i gsung rgyud min par mi 'gro zhing / cha lag bco brgyad kyi khog dbug las/ bka' man ngag yin pa'i phyir/ /man ngag gi che ba dgu yis bshad/ de ltar che ba sum ldan gyi rgyud 'di ji ltar yin pa'i khungs ni/ dang por rgyud yin te/ gleng gzhi gleng slong zhus pa dang / /zhu lan le'u 'brel bcas pa dang / /'khor gyis bstod dang ston pas bstod/ /de bdun ldan phyir rgyud ces bya/ /de ni rgyud yin no/ /zhes dang / ston pa sman gyi bla'i bka' yin pas de la lung zhes bya'o/ /lung de yang yid ches bdun gyis bshad de/ ston pa'i thugs las rtsa rgyud byung bas rtsa rgyud chos sku'i lung du yid ches/ ston pa'i sku las bshad rgyud byung bas bshad rgyud long sku'i lung du yid — //4

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)ches/ ston pa'i yon tan las man ngag rgyud byung bas ngo bo nyid kyi lung du yid ches/ ston pa'i 'phrin las las phyi ma'i rgyud byung bas sprul sku'i lung du yid ches/ ston pa'i gsungs las zhu ba po dang drang srong yid las skyes byung bas zhus tshad pad+ma'i lung du yid ches/ rgyud bzhi sku lnga lhun grub tu byung bas sangs rgyas sman bla'i lung du yid ches/ zhes pas log rtog sel bar mngon/ bka' ru bzhed pa la la bskyed rdzogs dang dbang bzhi bla med la yin pas/ (79na)/'di bya rgyud ngos 'dzin par mi dgos shing rig gtad rjes gnang bya rgyud la yod pa 'dir yang tshang ba'i rgyu mtshan ni gzhung las ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa/ snying po bzlo ba/ shis pa brjod pa/ rigs 'dzin mchod pa sogs la brten nas rje g.yu thog pas sman bla gsang sgrub/ drang srong brgyud pa'i byin 'bebs/ sman gyi lha mo'i bka' gtad rnams yod pa'i sgrub byed mdzad na'ang rgyud 'di nyid drang srong yid las skyes kyis 'tsho byed gzhon nu/des mgon po klu sgrub/ des dpal ldan pa'o/ /des kha che paṇa chen zla ba mngon dga' la gsungs pa slob dpon 'dis tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes shing rgyud 'di lkog chos dang ca ra ka sogs gzhung / gzhan rnams thun mong du 'chad nyan mdzad par ma zad 'phags yul dang rgya nag gis mtshon yul gru gzhan tshor gso dpyad shin tu dar mod bod 'dir mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus rgya gar gyi sman pa zhi ba'i snying po/ rgya nag nas stong gsum gang ba dang bhā la hā shang / kha che nas gu la mtha stag gzigs ha la shan+ti/ gru gu nas se do 'od chen/ dol po nas khyol po sig bal po nas dharmā shi la rnams gdan drangs te tshod bgams pas thugs yid ches nas mchims phur slob dpon chen pos dbang dang ska cog gnyis kyis lo tsā mdzad de so so'i gzhung man ngag dang bcas pa bsgyur bar mnga' bdag dgyes te/ bod kyi rje blon 'bangs bcas gus pas nyon 'tsho mdzad sman par gyur pa 'di rnams la/ bod 'bangs mgo nag yongs kyi bkur bar gyis/ /ci phyir 'dis ni tshe srog ster ba'i phyir/ /mgo nag yongs kyi lha ni btsan po ste/ /des kyang bkur bas mtshan yang lha rjer thogs/ /zhes pa nas/ bdag (79ba)gis phul ba'i bka' tshigs bcu gsum po/ /gang gis 'gal kyang chad la — 115

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)bcad par bya/ /zhes rgya chen bsngags shing gso ba rig pa'i gzhud lugs stod smad kun tu dar dus der/ thang yig las/ lo stor btags kyang don la paṇ+ḍitaḥ 'di yi chos drin yod do phyi rabs rnamasaḥzhes pa'i lo tsā ba chen po'i be+e ro tsa nas kha che zla mngon la gsan nas bsgyur te mnga' bdag rgyal po phul ba/ mtha' bzhi'i gzhung lugs 'di rnams ma 'ongs skye dgu'i blor chud dka' bas de'i tshe/ srog 'tshe'i skyabs sbyin bla na med pa tshig nyung don rgyas kyi rgyud 'di yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar dgongs pa bzhin dpal o rgyan chen pos chos skyong zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul dang gter srung rgyal po shing bya tsan la bka' bsgos/ rje btsad pos bsam yas dbu rtse bar khang gi ka ba'i nang du gter du sbas te smon lam mdzad pa de nas lo brgya dang lnga bcu 'gro ba'i tshe/ thang yig las/ ta'i dus brtsigs pa'i rtsig pa sdug pa 'ongs paḥ jing dang rgya rnams grog ma tshang zhig 'dra: jo mo gling gsum sbas pa'i gter kha 'diḥ mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags der bstan nas 'byung / gter ston gra pa mngon shes zhes bya 'byung : sa steng gnas gzhi brgya dang rtsa brgyad 'gengs: gra mda' 'di la gtsug lag khang zhig 'byung : rgyal pos ba chengs pa'i lta khang bdag po byed ces pa ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen gra pa mngon shes kyi spyan drangs nas rim par brgyud de rje btsun g.yu thog pa chen por bka' babs shing rgyud kyi shugs bstan gyi cha nas sman rgyal rigs 'dus kyi dbang bzhi bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i lam zab mo'i snying tig gi srol legs par phye bas rgyud 'di bya rgyud du 'grel ba'i ngal ba mi dgos par (79ba7skyed pa ma hā yo ga sgrub sde brgyad kyi nang nas tshe mchog bdud rtsi'i rgyud kyi sde tshan du bzhugs shing dngos bstan du'ang khog dbub las/ smon pa tshad med pas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pas de'i la sdug sgo ma log ste theg pa gzhan gyi sgo ru 'jug mi dgos pa'i che ba/ dman lhag log pa'i mtha' dang bral ba'i dbu mar blta zhing lta sgrib pa med pa'i che ba/ 'jug pa tshad med pa bzhi nyams su len pa'i sgom la gol sa med pa'i che ba/ mi dge bcu la sogs pa spyo 'chal tho co'i ngan spyod thams cad dor bas dam tshig ma nyams pa'i che ba/ lam pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyad de — 116

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)byang chub tu sems bskyed nas sman sbyar te byin pas sbyin pa/ nyes skyon gyi dri mas ma gos par byed pas tshul khrims/ dal brel khyags lhogs la sogs pa dang nad pa'i tshig bzod pas bzod pa/ le lo med par nad pa gso ba'i bya ba la brtson pas brtson 'grus/ sman dpyad la rtog cing bsam par byed pas bsam gtan/ de ltar bcos pas sman dpyad la nges shes skye bas na shes rab bo/ /de ltar dza rol tu phyin pa drug la skyed pa'i tshogs gzhan bsag mi dgos pa'i che ba/ thar pa dang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob pas 'bras bu gzhan nas btsal mi dgos pa'i che ba/ bshad pa lag len 'di rang la tshang ba gso dpyad gzhan la bltos mi dgos pa'i che ba/ dgra la'ang phan thogs pas dgra bo gnyen du chod pa'i che ba/ yul la phyogs ris med par yul gang du bsdad kyang gzhan gyis phud du 'khrur ba'i che ba/ de ltar che ba dgu dang ldan par bshad pas sman gyi sbyor sde dang dpyad kyi rigs rnams kyi nang thun mong gi lag len mtshungs pa ltar snang yang (80ba〉lta sgom spyod pa'i khyad par de dag gis khyad zhugs pa yin la/ gzhan du phyag rgya ba rgan po'i ci yang yid la mi byed pa las lhag pa srid rtse'i mthar thug tu 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin mu stegs byed la yod pas zur mkhar legs bshad 'tshol gyis/ chos 'di kho nas mngon mtho dang nges legs thob pa'i gnad e yod/ /g.yin du khrims dang sngags lam la/ /ma brten 'di gnyis med par gsungs/ / zhes pa'i dogs gnas kyang rang sar grol lam snyam zhing min na thugs zhen mdzad yul gyi bka' brgyud pa'i mgo la chu drangs kyi dogs so/ /hril gyi dril na/ mjug don yongs gtad las/ rtsa ba thugs kyi rgyud 'di sa bon 'dra/ /'di las ma skyes gso dpyad yod ma yin/ /sku yi bshad rgyud bar snang nyi zla 'dra/ /tshig don ma lus sgrib med gsal bar ston/ /man ngag yon tan rgyud 'di nor bu 'dra/ /dgos pa ma tshang ba ni gcig kyang med/ /phyi ma 'phrin las rgyud 'di pha lam 'dra/ /nad kyi steng du thogs pa yod ma yin/ /zhes gso bya'i lus/ gso byed gnyen po/ ji ltar gso ba'i tshul/ gso ba po'i sman pa bzhi gnad 'gag thams cad mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyi sgo nas ma tshang ba med par bstan pa'i — 117

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)rgyud 'di nyid kyi phan yod kyang / nyi ma'i 'od kyis zla skar zil gnon bzhin/ khyud rgyal 'di yis gso rig kun zil gnon/ /'di ni sngags med pa yi srung skud yin/ /'chi bdag bdud sde bzlog pa'i 'khrul 'khor yin/ /nad kyid dgra dpung 'joms pa'i dpa' bo yin/ /'du ba 'phel zad snyom pa'i spyi bo yin/ /dus min 'chi zhags gcod pa'i 'khor lo yin/ /nad kyi zug gzer cog pa'i tho ba yin/ /(81na)sdug bsngal 'dam nas 'dren pa'i lcags kyu yin/ /'chi ba'i srog skyob mi 'jigs sbyin pa yin/ /'chi ba slong byed bdud rtsi bum pa yin/ /ces bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i ris su ma chad pa'i lus can kun gyi spyi nor rtsi sman gyi ljon pa chen po gang 'di sman rgyal mi'i gzugs can g.yu thog yon tan mgon po nas dbus gtsang gi phyogs kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa'i 'phrin las kyi rgyun rigs ldan chen po rnam rgyal grags bzang dang brang ti pa yab sras sogs byang sman 'tsho mdzad mtha' klas pa dang zur mkhar chos rje mnyam nyid rdo rje/ mtsho smad mkhan chen/ shākya dbang phyug /mtshungs med byar pho paṇa chen gyis mtshon pa'i dbus 'gyur tshe'i rig byed 'dzin pa rnams kyis bshad pa sa bcad phyag len man ngag so so'i lugs bzhin rgyun ma chad pa zhig byung na ris med pa'i skye dgu mtha' dag la 'chi med tshe'i mchod sbyin bla na med par mthong nas dbus gtsang gnyis mar 'dzugs 'dod lhag bsam rdul bral gyis ston zla ltar dkar ba'i zer gyi blo brtson kun+da yongs su bzhad pa'i nyang smad rdzong chen bsam grub rtser dpon tshang tsha rong pa tshe dbang rnam rgyal slob dpon du bskos pa'i rgyun rigs kyi bu drang srong tshe brten rdo rje spun gyis bzung ste gso rig slob gra drang srong 'dus pa'i gling gi blang dor nyams su bstar ba la dbyar chos hor zla lnga pa'i tshes gcig nas btsugs pa'i bdun pa'i gnam gang bar/ dgun chos zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gcig nas gnyis pa'i gnam gang bar/ de 'phros zla ba bzhi chos mtshams byed par dus tshes snga phyi gnyis ga'i chos tshugs gdong slob ma 'dzom pa'i rdzong stod phyag rten dang bcas (81ba)rgyu mtshan smed ngos mi grangs du yod kyi phogs len/ slob dpon la thog mar 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i 'bul — 118

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)tshan dang lo rjes ma rnams su phyag rten skabs su gang bab/ dus tshes lam slebs na zhag grangs dang mnyam pa'i phogs ldab gcog /grwa par ma zad mi skya yin na'ang nag chang sogs don med g.yeng bas mi khyer ba'i ched du dpe 'dzin skabs sdod yul spel dkar sbus 'byed yan/ shar steng bar sgo yas mas tshun la gzhan 'dres mang pa'i mtshams chod dang gnang ba ma zhus bar de phan 'gro 'ong mi byed/shag che chung dang bstun pa'i mi grangs brgyad nas lnga tshun/ khang dpon gyis khang deb nang bzhin shag 'du khang / thab tshang lde mig dang bcas pa rtsis sprod grub mtshams nas shag so so'i rgan pa re dge rgan du bskos pa'i khang pa la bag med kyi chud mi za ba byed/ skad legs shing 'don cha nges pa zhig gis dbu mdzad dang dge rgan rnams zhag bco lnga res bskor gyi dge bskos bgyis te sgrigs rnam gzhag la nye 'gyang spangs pa'i do dam che ba byed/ de 'og rgan gra re mos kyi ja mar len gtong sogs spyi gnyer sprel po dang ja ma gcig bskos pa'i rtsis khri tho nang ltar sprod/ ja thug drug re gtong ba'i dgos cha sprad nas nam gseng la thug pa/ tsha rting snga phyogs ja/nyin gung thug pa/ dgongs ja rnams shag so sor 'dren par gtong / ja gnyis dgongs mo 'don chos la tshogs/ ja thug skol 'dren la sha mo'i spang blang ma gtogs rang 'dod kha khyer gyis phugs gleng brjod mi yong ba byed/ nyin ltar dpe 'dzin dbang po rno rtul sde tshan lngar phye ste/ gra thang rgyud bzhi bar mar cha bzhag pa'i rab kyis yig 'phreng bdun nam drug /de 'og gi lnga 'am bzhi/ de (82na tshe snog gis bzhi 'am gsum/ de 'og gis gsum mam gnyis/ tha mas gnyis sam gcig rnams bzung dgos par thog mar tho rengs tsha dud btang ba dang bstun dge rgan so sos skul lcag byas pa'i nam lang bar bshar sbyang nam gseng nas nyin phyed ma zin bar so so'i rang mal du dpe 'dzin la 'jug cing de mtshams dge rgan tshos rgyugs dang zhag bcu mtshams su slob dpon gyis rgyugs len/ gung tshigs grol nas nyi ma phyed yol bar gung gseng byed par mig mangs rgyal gling dmag 'khrugs sogs bag med kyi rtse mo mi bya/ de nasaslob dpon gyi drung du tshogs pa'i thog mar 'don cha sogs rim slob byas rjes dbang po dang 'tshams — 1/9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2re/pa'i 'grel bshad man ngag gi gnad/ sman gyi sbyor sde'i go don ngag slob rtsi bzhag 'os 'tshams re gtong / nyi tshod kyi brda dang bstun dpe 'dzin la 'jug /nyi ma bzhud tsam la 'khar rnga brdungs 'phral 'du khang du 'chag par grwa pa gang yin zla gam sogs rab byung gi rtags ldan dang skya bo rnams kyang phyam tse dmar ser gang rung gi steng gyon byed pas mtshon kun spyod gang legs ngos sgo gsum gzhan du ma yengs pa'i ngang nas skyabs sems/ sman bla dang g.yu thog yon tan mgon po sogs brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ smon lam tshigs bcad/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig /zhang blon gyi gtor 'bul/ shes rab snying po/ tshe gzungs/ shis brjod/ chos spyod gang 'tsham dang nya stong brgyad gsum lta bur sman bla'i mdo chog chen mo tshar re gtong / rgyun tshogs grol nas so so'i shag tu khyug tsam phyin pa'i mun mtshams nas srod 'khor bar sogs nam ring thung la dpags pa'i 'phros brda ma byung (82ba)bar bde yangs dang thog tu bshad sbyang byed par 'khyams rgyug long gtam gyis mtshon rnam g.yeng mi byed/ gal srid byung na brgya phyag sogs skabs thob 'gel/ tshogs dang bshar sbyang ga dus nad kyis mnar na dge skos la gnang ba zhu bzhin/ rang 'tsham gyis bsdad na brgya phyag gnyis re 'tshal/ zhol sogs nye skor du 'gro bar slob dpon la ma zhus par mi 'gro/ gal srid phyin na mang ja re skol/ zhag gcig phan la 'gro tshe rdzong sdod la dgongs pa zhu/ chos thog tshugs ring skya bo rnams kyang nag chang gi 'brel spang zhing skya ser tshang mas mdzes lam bor ba'i kha lag 'khrug pa'i dpe srol la gnod pa sus byas kyang byas tshabs dang bstun brgya phyag mang ja grangs bcad/ rnam gzhag sogs 'gel/ chos mtshams la 'gro gdong sngar bzung rnams yang bskyar gyis rgyugs blangs pa thor bkod grwa pa rnams gzhis dgon so sor slob gnyer las gzhan du ma yengs pa'i dpe 'dzin byed cing / skya bo rnams kyang gsar 'dzin ma thub rung thor 'khod pa ma brjed pa byas rjes 'khor bstun skya ser tshang mas rgyugs sprod/ gong gsal sngar bzung brjed pa byung tshe zla grangs kyi phogs gcod pa'am 'khor zhag rjes ma'i dus dpe mtshams la stod pa gang rigs byed/ 'dzin grwa mtho zhing — 120

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)shes rab che ba'i rigs chos mtshams skabs dpe mtshams la dmigs bsal sgor ba tsho chos thog las brtson gshis slar ngo so thon pa rgyugs sprod/ rgyun gtan btsun pa gang yin grwa pa'i sgrigs dang mthun pa'i rang tshugs ma bor ba dang skya bo rnams kyang pa lo zhe gcig la sarba mgo sogs mgo stabs dang lus chas ya ma zung gi rigs mi byed par zhwa 'bog do/ gos dang stod gos gzan sogs tshos ma las gzhan pa'i dkar po khra bo mi gyon (83na thing gri rings theb krad kyis mtshon hor 'dra'i rtsing spyod spangs pa'i gzhes lam byes gsum thams cad du 'jol chas dang 'dren pa'i kun spyod kho nar gnas pa byed/ 'on kyang rna rgyan sogs bsnyems chas kyi rigs shis pa'i yan lag yin pas byas par 'gal ba med/ rgyud bzhi ma 'khril bar lag len la 'jug cing rang rkya ma pher par slob ma bsten pa sogs mig ltos la gnod pa'i rigs gtan nas mi byed pas mtshon gso ba rig pa'i gtsug lag gi rgyun bzang po bla nas blar 'phel ba dgos rgyu yin/ gso rig ma la ya las phan bde'i dri/ /lcag bsam rlung gis drangs pa'i ngang po ches/ /dug gsum des bskyed nad kyi tsha gdung kun/ /drung nas 'byin pa'i skal bzang thob par shog /zug rngu'i dri bkru mtho ris sman gyi chab/ /rnam dpyod rgyal mtshan tog tu 'bar ba'i 'od/ /'gro gzhan dogs med mi yi rten bzang po/ /rnyed rnams dga' ston dpal la spyod par shog /sman gyi bla ma drang srong rig pa 'dzin/ /rdo rje bdud 'dul gnod sbyin yongs kyi rje/ /gter gyi srung ma shing bya can sogs kyis/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /ces nyang smad bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i rdzong chen du tshe'i rig byed gso ba rig pa'i grwa tshang drang srong 'dus pa'i gling gi bca' yig gsong por spyod pa'i rgyud mangs 'di ni tsha rong dpon tshang tshe brtan rdo rjes sa bon dang bcas bskul ba ltar me 'brug nag pa zla ba'i dkar cha'i bzang po dang po'i tshes la za hor gyi ban+de 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rgyal khab chen po dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa sid+dhi ra stu// //(83ba)— 121

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)chos sde chen po zha lu'i sgrub mchod bco lnga gsar tshugs kyi bca' yig shel dkar me long sogs/no ga 9 su ka lpa ba hā kā la ti ma sa stu to ga me bra du khru rti ba du :rka tha ma ho rma 'i rtsa ra di go ga ta lta bu gi ru dra/grangs med bskal mang dus nas ma 'dris 'gro ched thugs bskyed sa bon rnams/ /bya dka' rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i tshogs gnyis drod gsher dang drag pas/ /dha rma ( ba dza skru ra su ma ñja ri ba skra de mi gi shu ru pā ku yo : deb ta spu nā lha ba tsa sha r+sha 6 sha si dha shu : ya smochos gzugs dzaskru'i gser gyi snyi mas srid zhi'i 'dod dgur lus can kun/ /sbyor mdzad lha yi lhar gyur skyob pa shākya seng shes dge legs stsol/ /khyod bstan nyi zla 'phags bod me zhal lam/ /'dren pa'i rta ljang lo paṇa mkhas grub kyi/ /ngo mtshar skyes rabs ljongs 'dir bu ston zhes/ tags bya thams cad mkhyen de phyag gi gnas/ /gang gi rang lugs dbyar chu dus ngan dgun/ /ches phra pad+ma'i skud pa'i srog zungs su/ /bdud rtsi'i thigs phreng sbyin mdzad tshar chen zhabs/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas pa bsngags bya'i gnas/ /(84na/byad par 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos byang gling rje/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i smin grol phyag bzhes nor/ /stsol la sprul pa'i zlos gar zha lu pa/ /rin chen bsod nams mchog grub rigs kyi bdag / mgon des spyi dang bye brag lung rtog rgyun/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' rnyed dus su/ /chad med 'bab phyir gsar bskrun rnam dkar gyi/ /'phrin las nam mkha' ska rags mas mtshon min/ /ches dkon bya dka' rnal

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)'byor rgyud sde'i tshul/ /bag la zha ba'i ri mo rnying pa deng / /sngon rabs mkhas pa'i bzhed srol slar gsal la/ /gzur gnas dpyod ldan snying po bdud rtsi'i dpyid/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' mi'i gzugs can/ /dbang phyug rab brtan khud bon sgrub khang pa/ /bka' drin zla med bla ma rnam gsum gyi/ /thugs dgongs chos kyi dbyings su rab rdzogs shing / /gangs can dpal mo'i mngal du nyer sbrum pa/ /mdo sngags lugs srol legs 'dzin tsan dan ljon/ /phan bde'i dri bsung dngar pos skye rgu kun/ /sim pa'i tshor ba myong la sbyor de med/ /rgyud ldan rdo rje slob dpon slob mar bcas/ /sngags rgya ting 'dzin phyag len 'khrul bral gyi/ /bgrang yas dkyil 'khor sgrub cing nyer mchod pa/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing las dmigs su med/ /'on te sta gon ma tshang gzer dkyil la/ /sgrub mchod tshul bzhin ma bgyis rtsing po'i spyod/ /rnam dag bstan pa'i bgrang byar 'os min 'bras/ /tshad ldan srol la ras dkar snum zhugs bzhin/ /de phyir mig rkyen ngan dper mi 'dzin pa/ /'dzol med blang dang dor bya ma lus gzugs/ /mngon sum 'char (84na tha'i bca' yig ā dar+shar/ /rjes 'brangs gzigs mor dngar ro lag tu long / /de yang 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā bas/ /mchod bstod 'dud pa'i bdag nyid can/ mas pa brjod sogs mi 'gal te/ /thams cad du yang ston pa yi/ /che ba 'ba' zhig ston phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yul khyad par can la brten nas shis pa brjod pa dang bstod tshig gi me tog man+da ra 'thor ba sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas gleng bar bya ba ni/ 'o skol gyi ston pa sgrib gnyis kyi dgra tshogs ma lus pa bcoms shing yon tan mtha' dag mngon du mdzad zin pa'i 'dren pa mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras po'i bstan pa rin po che ni/ ji skad du/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig /ces ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag thog ma med pa nas las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal gsum gyi zug rngu drag po'i nad kyis btab pa rtsa ba nas phyungs te zhi bar byed — /23

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)pa dam pa'i chos kyi rtsi sman la brten nas srid pa dang zhi ba'i phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che lus can rnams kyi legs byas kyi zhing dam par bla nas blar bskur ba'i sri zhu dang bcas nas sems can rnams kyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen du yun ring par gnas par 'gyur bar gsung pa mkhas dbang paṇ+ḍi tas/ mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos po la/ /smon pa shis pa brjod de dper/ /zhes bshad ma thag pa'i 'dod pa'i don de 'grub par gyur cig pa'i smon lam du mdzad pa yin la/ don chen po dang ldan pa'i lung rtog kyi bstan pa rin po che de yang /(84ba)thos bsam sgom pa dar ba'i yul ni/ 'grel chen dri med 'od las/ 'dzam bu'i gling chen po zlum po'i rnam pa zheng du dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig dang 'a shes ra yug tu 'bum phrag gsum yod pa gang tu mi rnams gnas pa de ni las kyi sa dang drug ni longs spyod kyi sar rig par bya'o/ /'dzam bu'i gling ni lan mo'i rgya mtsho'i jogs na ste lhag ma ni chang la sogs pa'i ngogs na'o/ /zhes ri rab lhun po rdo rje'i dbyibs can du yod pa'i rā'i 'og tu longs spyod kyi sa'i gling drug dang de'i phyi rol tu gling bzhi gling phran brgyad 'dzam gling chen por grags pa las kyi sa par gsungs shing de dang mthun par mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ 'dzam bu gling ni chen po yi/ /dum bu bcu gnyis kyi ni dbus/ /zhes bshad la shing 'dzam bu'i sgra la brten nas de ltar 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod na'ang 'di pa'i lugs la 'dod rgyal gyi ming las sgra bshad rgyu med cing 'dul mngon sogs gsung rab spyi skad du/ lho phyogs kyi gling 'di nyid la 'dzam bu'i gling zhes pa las 'dzam gling che chung gi tha snyad ma gsungs sa shing / mdo rtsa bar mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba pa dang / byang gi sgra mi snyan pa sdom pa'i zhing ma yin no zhes dang / sdom gsum du/ gling gsum skyes pa bud med las/ /'gro ba gzhan la sdom pa bkag /ces byang sgra mi snyan par so thar gyi sdom pa mi skye bar bshad cing / mdzod du/ sgra mi snyan sgrib gsum du 'dod/ ces las sa ma yin pa'i 'chad tshul dang lugs gcig la sdom 'byung las/ shar gyi lus 'phags ba lang spyod/ /de bzhin byang gi sgra mi snyan/ /gling gsum po yi mi rnams ni/ /longs — /24

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa) spyod chen pos yang dag (85na 'tsho/ /rnam rtog med cing rtog dpyod med/ /blun rmongs bye brag mi phyid pa'o/ /'dzam bu gling du legs skyes pa/ /las kyi sa par rab tu grags/ /legs byas nyes par byas pa'i las/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma yi/ /skye ba snga ma'i rnam smin 'dir/ /skye bo kun la mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes las kyi sa pa lho 'dzam bu'i gling 'di nyid la ngos gzung zhing / /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dus 'khor dang dgongs pa mthun par bkral ba'i 'dzam gling chung ngu 'di dum bu bcu gnyis kyi gtso bor bzhag nas 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rabs bdun nub gling nas bzung gling dum bu bcu gnyis su rim bzhin 'khor ba las bskal pa bzhin gyis sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor can/ thams cad skyob gsum 'das rjes su bskal pa bzang po 'di'i gling bcu gnyis kyi 'gro ba'i don du/ 'khor ba 'jig /gser thub/ 'od srungs/ shākya thub pa bzhi skye ba bzhes pa'i bzhi la shākya'i rigs su 'khrungasapas mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor/ /'dzam bu gling ni chung ngu 'dir/ /bdag ni shākya'i rigs rjes 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rang cag gi ston pa shākya don grub pa ni/ lung las/ mnyan yod gnas bcas tsam pa ka /wa ra ṇa sir yangs pa can/ /rgyal po'i khab dang drug po ni/ /de dag grong khyer chen por grags/ /zhes yul gru chen po drug gi cha shas ser skya'i rgyal khab chen por zas gtsang ma'i sras su sku bltams nas rdo rje gdan gyi spo la theg pa 'og ma ltar na zad mi shes pa'i ye shes mngon du mdzad pa'am gong ma'i lugs la mchog gi sprul pa'i skur mngon 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan pa bzhin 'das pa dang ma (86na)'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang de ltar du mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyis bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus mngon pa ba'i lugs la mkha' la zo ba btags pa bzhin gzhom gzhig dang bral bar gnas shing gong du bshad pa'i yul de dag gi ma 'gyur ba'i lte ba lta bur yod pas ma dhu ga ta dha ra zhes pa tsan+d+ra pa ra bṛ kho dha ra'i bsdu ba byas pas ma ga dha zhes dbus 'gyur 'chang du grags pa 'di nyid 'jam gling gi lte bar byas pa'i yul gru'i dbye ba dus 'khor las/ 'phags yul bod li rgya nag dang / /kai la sha dang gangs can che/ /zhes drug tu gsungs pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'phags pa'i yul — /25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)du paṇa grub rnams kyis nyi zla ltar gsal bar mdzad pa las byang phyogs su dar ba ni 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ /kha ba can du mtsho bri nas/ /swā la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ / zhes byang phyogs kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'di thog mar mtshos gang ba rim gyis bri nas swā la'i ljongs su gyur bar rgyal bu ru pa ti dpung bcas bud med kyi chas su zhugs nas 'ongs pa las mched par yang bshad cing /yongs su grags pa spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i spre'u dang brag srin mo 'dus pa las 'phel ba'i rus chen bzhi 'am drug sogs rim gyis mched de mi'i rgyal khams su gyur pa dbus su byas pa'i shar du rgya nag dang khri stan/ lhor rgya gar dang kha che/ nub tu stag sde dang gzigs yan/ byang du khrom dang ge sar gyis bskor bas yul gru chen po dgur grags pa'i nang nas bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal po phal cher sprul pa'i gang zag tu bshad cing / rje tho ri gnyan btsan gyi dus dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes mnga' bdag srong btsan (86bskom po'i dus gser gyi lha jo shāka rnam gnyis gdan drangs nas ra sa 'phrul snang sogs gtsug lag khang rten dang bcas pa mang du bzhengs nas srol btod/ lha sras khri srong lde'u btsan gyis mkhan slob gnyis sogs lo paṇa rnams bla'i mchod gnas su bkur zan g.yang lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas dam pa'i chos dar bar mdzad/ rje khri lde btsug brtan gyi dus skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa sogs bstan pa snga dar la rgyal po sdig can gyis gnod pas 'phel grib byung na'ang slar bstan pa'i me ro stod smad gnyis nas gsos te so so thar pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshugs/paṇ+ḍi ta smri ti dz+nyā na shrī jo bo chen po dī paṃ kā ra ka smi ra'i bsod snyoms pa chen po shākya shrī sogs paṇa grub du ma dang / 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu rin chen bzang po dang bla chen 'brog mi shākya ye shes sogs mkhas pa grangs med pa byon te 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas bstan pa spel bar phyi dar du grags pa de yang bstan pa snga dang gyi dus khri lde 'od srungs kyi sras dpal 'khor btsan/ de'i sras mched gnyis byon pa'i che ba skyid lde nyi ma mgon stod du byon nas mnga' ris kyi rgyal po mdzad/ de la sras gsum — /26

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)byung ba stod kyi mgon gsum du grags/ skyid lde'i gcung khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal dbus nas spyugs pa gung thang man la chags/ de la sras gsum byung bar smad kyi lde gsum du grags pa'i chung ba skyid lde ba 'ad rta nag phyogs su phog pa la sras drug byung ba'i lnga byang phyogs su yod cing / gcig grum pa sha ba sras nyang yul rnams kyis bdag mdzad par nyang yul du sras khyung rtsad/ 'dre rtsad/ lce rtsad gsum gyis dbus gtsang ru bzhir (87na)grags pa las sum rtsen yul la 'gran pa ru lag nyang stod smad kyi sa'i cha so sor bgos te bzung nas mi ring bar dar gud byung mthar chung ba lce rtsas bskyangs/ nyang stod gzhung phal cher zhing la thag ma dang chu mig la brten pa las med par lce rtsad kyi sa rnams bed chad pa'i phyir nyang stod du rtsa rnams kyi rgyal rka dang / lho rgyud du yang yul bzhengs kyi 'or rka bya ba/ nyang smad byang du pa tshab rka mo che/ lto ru sna nam rka mo che rnams bzos par rka so so'i 'og nas son khal khri phrag re thon pa'i rka rnams ma 'jags bar bsrung mi sdod sar rgya khrom lce mkhar dang / pa nam lce mkhar gnyis brtsigs pa sogs stobs 'byor rnam dpyod phyag rjes nan tar che ba'i lce rtsad kyi gdung brgyud kha yar song ba'i rigs lce g.yu 'bum gyi sras lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas kyis lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug ces pas mdo smad nas sdom pa blangs shing chos mang du zhus nas bod du byon pa'i nye gnas mdzad/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog ma la ngos 'dzin lugs mi mthun pa mang na'ang me bya la byung pa'i dbang du byas pa'i phyi lo lo ston dang lce dpon slob gnyis kyis rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang brtsegs/ de rjes zhwa lur byung bar brteri rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes/ kha ba can ljongs bstan pa phyi dar gyi/ 'ang rta'i srol 'byed lo ston rin po che/ /gtsug lag khang chen 'debs mdzad lce btsun sogs/ zhes zha lu'i ma dgon rgyan gong yin zhing lce btsun lo ston gyi mkhan bu 'go pa ye shes g.yung drung la bsnyen par rdzogs kyang slar rgya gar rdo rje gdan du 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas par sdom pa bskyar bzhes mdzad (87ba)pas ma dgon 'phags yul rdo rje gdan las 'chad pa'i tshang pa'i bu dgon bod gyi rdo rje gdan zha lu gser khang du grags pa bzhengs pa'i rgyu mtshan — /27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)gser sdings kyi bag ma la gong du byon nas 'grul mi kun la gtsug lag khang ya gi sus bzhengs dris par/ lo ston gyis bzhedas zer/ de bzhin tshong 'dus kyi dbu rtsa brag kha nas dris pas kyang lan sngar byung ba nas/ da rang gis bzhengs pa zhig dgos snyam ste lte btsun gyis bdag lha khang zhig bzhengs bar 'tshal bas nyid kyis mda' 'phangs pa gar slebs su brtsig pa lags zhus lan du da ltar bya zhes gsung pa na lo ston mthu che bas yul thag ring zhig tu slebs dogs nas mda' nang gser gyis bkang ste phul ba 'phangs pa da lta'i dbu rtse rnying pa'i thod du dpal kha'i zha lu zhig la thebs pas phun tshogs myu gu gsar pa bzhin du sde yar rgyas yong ba'i rten 'brel 'grig cing / mda' de dbus su bzhugs pa'i mchod rten la mda' 'bum du grags/ gong gi rgyu mtshan de dag la brten nas dpal zha lu gser bkang ngam yang yum chen mo'i lha khang gi lha thams cad la gser byugs pas gser khang yin yang zer/ gang ltar rgyan gong bzhengs nas lo sum cu song ba me yos la sde 'di nyid brtsigs pa'i dbu rtse nub ma'i lho byang gnyis dang / shar ma'i yum chen mo'i steng man/ 'og gi mgon khang byed sa sgo khang rgyun lam/ dbu rtse lho mar rgyu rin po che dang sman sna tshogs las grub pa'i thugs rje chen po'i sku rnams bzhengs/ des lung bstan pa ltar rgya gar du byon nas/ jo bo kha rla pā ṇi'i sku khyad 'phags gdan drangs pa chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram nas mi nyis 'gyur las che ba'i mon nag cig (88na)gis zha lu'i bar khur ba mgon po beng gi sprul pa yin/ jo bo chen po dpal mar me mdzad gdan drangs nas rab gnas zhus pas yum chen mo'i spyan la me tog chags mdo phyogs kyi 'chad nyan yang shin tu dar pas chos rje thams cad mkhyen pas mkhan po gdan drangs pa la gdams pa las/gtsug lag khang 'di jo bo a ti sha chen pos phyags pheb 'go ba ye shes g.yung drung gis 'dul ba'i bshad pa btsugs/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa dang rngog chen pos phyag pheb bshad gra btsugs/'dre khyung gnyis kyis chos gzhi byas pa nas ding sang gi bar du bshad gra ma nyams pa'i gra sa yin/zhes pa don la gnas par ma zad bstan pa phyi dar gyi gtsug lag khang dang 'dus sde chags pa'i thog — /28

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wanam lta bu yin pas drung chen rin po che tā'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan la phul ba'i chab shog tu/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su sde 'di btab/ chos sde btsugs nas gtsug lag khang khyung mgo can brgya rtsa brgyad kyi ma ma yin/ gdan sa chen po snar thang lta bu 'ang 'di pa'i ka chen gcig las gyes pa'i yal ga yin pas/ chos sde brgyud pa can gyi bdag po lags/ zhes gsungs/ jo bo chen po'i lung bstan dang mthun par mkhan brgyud gsum pa g.yu thog sgra gser bzang gi dus gtsang g.yas ru phye ma g.yu zur zhes pa'i gtsang 'gram du 'phags pa'i rdo sku dbug nyug tsam byas bzhugs pa na lang 'gro'i mda'i lug rdzi dge bsnyen rdo rje 'bum gyi ra lug gi khrod nas ra ma khyad 'phags shig gis jo bo'i dbu la bldag pa dang g.yas skor byed cing 'o mas sku khrus gsol ba rdzi bos mthong bar (88bskon bye khrod nas gdan ma 'drongs par zhag gsum gsol ba btab pas thugs rje'i shugs kyis steng du byon pas mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa tshar chen gyis/ rab dngas dal 'bab chu bo pa klu'i 'gram//rin chen mu tig brdal 'dra'i thang yongs su/ /mgon po khyod sku dngos su byon pa'i tshe/ /mkha' 'gros brnga bstan skal bzang rdzi bos rnyed/ /gsung ba don la gnas shing yul gzhan du gdan ma 'drongs par g.yas ru gtsang 'gram gyi lha khang du gdan drangs de'i tshe zhwa lu'i dge bshes brtson 'grus kyi rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang rten brje byas te ri phug tu bzhugs/ lo rgyus la lar stag gi rgyal mtshan gyi bus/ gnas nang gi lcags ri sa sgo yan khram pa gnyis rnams byas rjes rgyan gong la dmag brgyab mchod cha thams cad dang rdo sku rang byon yang gdan drangs zer/ chu zhal 'brugs pa'i dus ngo bo rku thabs kyis khyer ba ri phug ma'i nus pas gzhan du ma bgrod par byang 'brog gi rdzing du lus pa rig 'dzin chen po rat+na gling pa'i lung bstan chen mor/ zha lu'i jo bo chu mig la stod 'byon/zhes pa'i dus rtags su snang / slar sku brnyan zhwa lur phebs pa gar bzhugs som nyi'i tshe ma pang du bu sdad chog ces gsungs byon pas spyan ras gzigs pā ṇi'i sku mdun du bzhugs su gsol ba ni sa phyogs thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'phags pa'i skur lhun gyis grub pa dam tshig pa'i thugs dar ye — /29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)shes sems dpa'i rnam par bzhugs par rten rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes/ de lta'i dam tshig sems pa'i thugs ma'i dbus/ /ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du bzhugs pa ni/ /gang sku stan gyi zla (89na) shel ltar dkar zhing / /nor bu chu shel bzhin du dngas shing gsal/ /pad+ma'i gnyen ltar 'od stong gzi bar ba/ /bcu drug lang tsho gsar pa'i na tshod can/ /zhes ngo mtshar pa'i bsngags brjod mdzad/ de ltar rten brten pa/ de 'dus sde/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel bar bkur sti rim gro mdzad pa'i spyin bdag lce'i gdung rabs zhang ye shes kun dga'i lcam ma gcig mkha' 'gro 'bum 'gro mgon phyag na'i btsun mor byon pa nas bzung / 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan dang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan sku mched bla chen kun rgyal ba yab sras sogs gdung brgyud khu dbon sku zhang na rim lnga'i bar sku nyer 'brel ba nas zha lu sku zhad du grags/ phyag na'i sras bla ma dharmā phu la rak+ṣi ta gong du byon hor rgyal po ol ji du dang mjal dus bod na nged kyi zhang po zha lu khri dpon bya ba yod par lung las bzang pa gnang dgos zhus pas/ bla ma'i 'ad po yi na nged kyi 'ad po yin du chug la khri stong byings pos phud du khur ba dang mi rabs kyi bar la khri skor 'jags su chug gsung pa'i lung bzang po stsal zhing / gong ma mchod yon gyi sku rim la dmigs nas rten gsum bzhengs pa'i thebs su gser bre brgyad dngul bre brgya'i gnang sbyin stsal/ de yang yig tshang rnying pa las/ /de phyir sa skya'i dpon chen ni/ /zam glu gun ming dben hu yi/ /ming thob shākya bzang po de'i/ /deb ther shog dril can bzhin yin/ /khri skor de bas dbus gtsang gi /'ja' mo 'dzin lugs 'di ltar snang / /zhes khri skor bcu gsum gyi nang tshan/ /tshong 'dus (89ba)'ja' chen zha lu pa'i/ /steng du bya rog tshang ba'i dud/ /lnga bcu rtsa bdun rgyab nas 'dzin/ /zhes dbus gtsang so sor khri skor drug re'i dbus gtsang gi mtshams su yar 'brog khri skor ram/ yang 'brog gtsang gi phyogs su bsdu ba ji ltar yang gong du bshad pa'i zha lu khri skor gyi bdag por gyur pa nas khri dpon gzhan las lhag pa gdung rus btsad po/ las ka ka bzhi/ dam chos rgya — /3() tsha

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)gar ma/ sa skya'i sku zhad / sbyin bdag rgyal po ste lngas che bar grags/ g.yu thog sgra'i sras lce 'bum nas gdung rus brgyad pa sku zhang rnga sgra'i sras rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi sprul pa sku zhang grags pa rgya mtshan gyis gas la rnying pa la zhig gsos/ lho nas shing cha drangs shing / rgya'i bzo bo mkhas pa bkug ste rgya phibs g.yu rtsi can gser gyi 'gan 'ji ra btsugs pa che ba bzhi/ slo bur mig mangs ris su bres pa g.yu rtsi'i ba gam lan kun la gser gyi 'gan 'ji ras brgyan pa/ gser khang rgya phib sum brtsegs/ gzhan rnams nyis brtsegs su yod pa/ brtan pa tshon sna brgya phrag gis bkra ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ gtsug lag khang nub ma gnyis kyi gtso bor rang byon 'phags pa dang / rnam snang / lhor dus gsum sangs rgyas/ byang du thub dbang / shar du yum chen mo/ de'i 'og tu rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi mgon khang dang bcas par 'khor grangs kyis mi chod pas bskor ba rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa/ gser gyi bka' 'gyur sogs gsung rab rnams la mchod pa'i sprin phung phul du byung ba/ lcags ri'i khor yug gi nang du dge (90na〉khyun gyi gnas mal/ ra ba bzhi la mchod pa chen po bzhis btsugs shing / mdor na sku gsung thugs rten dang dge 'dun mchod pa'i gzhi rten/ mnga' 'bangs rnams bsdu ba rnam bzhis dbugs dbyung ba sogs chos rgyal mes dbon gyi rnam par thar pa la 'gran bzhin pa'i ngang nas da dung dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu la chos 'chad pa brgya dang / kun gyi chos dpon 'gran du bzod pa zhig dgos dgongs pa'i tshe/ bstan pa rin po che 'phel rgyas kyi rten 'brel 'grig ste chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub khro phu nas lcags pho spre'u'i lo la gdan drangs nas khrir phebs mkhan po grags gzhon yan la sngog lo sogs kyi lugs srol gtso bor mdzad na'ang / 'di nas chos lugs khro phu ba dang sdom rgyun paṇa chen brgyud par song / phar tshad mngon pa sogs kyi 'chad nyan mdzad pa'i tshe nag po'i 'tshub lhongs byung ba'ang thabs la mkhas gshis thugs rje chen pos btul te skal pa dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams la mdo sngags kyi chos 'khor rgya cher bskos/ ring zhig nas 'jam dpal rgyud las/ yi ge ra dang ba dang po/ dge slong — 131

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)gang zhig rab 'byung gsung / /ston pa'i bstan pa gsal byed pa/ /'byung rab rab 'gyur the tshom med/ /ces dang dpal o rgyan chen po'i lung bstan rnams go mthun par gnas dang gang zag gnyis ka lung gis zin pa dgon gong ma ni dpal mar me mdzad stan chags nas/ de'i phyag cha bzhugs pa'i mchod rten dang / slob ma paṇa grub gsum gyis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten bzhugs pa sogs jo bo rje lha gcig gis rmang bting ba chos rje thams cad mkhyen pas jo bo chen po'i gzims khang spe'u zhig la gzhi lhas gtsug lag khang dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pa bzhengs/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od sogs mkhas grub du ma'i zhal lung las byung ba'i 'phags yog dus gsum gyis mtshon pa'i rgyud sde rgya (90ba)mtsho'i smin grol phyag len rgyud bshad man ngag sogs thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gtams pa dgon gong du gsang sngags dang mthil du bka' pod bcu'i 'chad nyan sogs nyin mtshan bar med du mdzad pa'i snyan grags kyis kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta su ma na shrī byon par dus 'khor yongs rdzogs gnang zhing /pan chen la bde mchog pad dra gsan/ srid pa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i chos rje bla ma dam pa sogs 'khon rigs 'jam dpal dpa' bo du ma/ rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po/ sgra tshad pa rin chen rnam rgyal/ gong gsum bde tshan pa chos kyi dpal ba/ khyung lhas pa gzhen nu bsod nams/ yo ga pa mgon po bzang po sogs dbus gtsang gi dag pa'i bshes gnyen grangs med pa zhal slob tu byung nas snga snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad sgrub kyis gangs can dpal mo'i lto ba yongs su lci/gnam gyis skos pa'i rgyal po dpal phag mo gru pa tā'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan sogs che rgu mtha' dag gis rigs gi cod pan du bskur/ thugs sras lo tsā ba sogs dang sa slob rnams la snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang bka' man ngag mtha' dag gsan pas mtshon/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'phrin las ma dros pa'i mtsho chen las ris med grub mtha'i chos rgyud chu bo rnam bzhi phyogs kun tu babs pas rgyal bstan yongs kyi phyi mo lta bur snang / de nas mkhan thog kha yar song mtshams nyid kyi bshad gra rnams rim gyis — /32

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)'gribs na'ang / mkhas pa tsan+d+ra shrī/ shar chen ye shes rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje sogs rjes 'brangs kyi mkhas grub mkha' la rgyu skar ltar 'khrigs pas rgyud sde bzhi'i bshad sgrub gyi rim pa ma mnyam par gnas pa dag rjes 'jug 'du 'dzi dang le lo'i mal du 'byar ba du ma'i skyon gyis dgun chu ltar nyag je phrar song mtshams chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sprul pa'i (91na) zlos gar tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po dang / thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug yab sras gnyis mkhan thog tu byon nas bstan pa'i me ro legs par gso bar mdzad na'ang / rjes kyi mkhan thog rim byon rnams reg la ma 'byor ba lta bu'i dar rgyas cher ma song ba'i tshe/ 'jam dbyangs byang gling rje bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyi rnam sprul khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rang gi snyan grags dang dbang thang sogs don du gnyer ba mi mnga' ba'i bstan pa spyi dang bye brag kun mkhyen bu'i ring lugs thugs la bcags pa'i rgyal sras spyod pa'i rnam thar kho nas gsung gleng la khyab bdag rnam snang chen po rdo rje sems dpa' rab gsal zla ba sogs nas rim par brgyud de 'phags yul gyi mkhas pa mi gsum/ khyad par kha che dharma pā la nas rgyud de slob dpon chen po kun dga' snying po'i dbang bshad bka' gdams ngag ma lus pa sprul pa'i skyes mchog lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab pa'i stod lugs smad lugs kyi bzhed srol kun mkhyen 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho'i bar du zam ma chad par shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin chen grub la bka' babs shing / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa kun mkhyen 'phags pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i gsung gis/ nga'i rnal 'byor rgyud kyi phyag len dri ma med pa 'di bla ma brgyud pa gzhen so dkar nas rgan skra dkar gyi bar du rnal 'byor rgyud skor la sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa'i lag len yin/ chos kyi rnam grangs gsog pa'i lung thob re tsam byas nas brgyud pa'i phyag len bzang po chud gzan pa'i lag len bla chos la gtang ba'i gdug pa'i slob dpon gyi lag len gyis chud ma gzon pa yin pas khyed kyis kyang brgyud pa'i gdams ngag ma chad gzod — 133

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)par mgo thon (91ba tsā byeg gsungs pa bzhin du thugs la bzhag nas yig 'jog dang dbang bshad gdams ngag chud gzan par bris thig gar dbyangs sogs gangs can gyi ljongs su dar bar mdzad pa slar yang dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin nas thugs rje'i byin rlabs 'phrul po che las/ mkhyen rab rin po che byon te rtse mo'i sgrub mchod gsar 'dzugs sogs nyams gsos cher mdzad pas rnam thar du/ nga dga' ldan nas bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas zha lur rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa spel ba la btang ba yin kyang zhal lu ba rnams kyis byed dpags kyi phan thogs chen po ma byung bas chos rje'i drung du 'gro ba la ngo gnong ba yang gsung ba dang / rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur bas/ rnal 'byor rgyud 'di phyag len dka' la dkon pa 'dug pas dar zhing rgyas pa zhig byung na bsams gong dkar chos sder yo ga sgrub mchod nyin gcig spar thub/ nga zha lur rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gsum po sgo bzhi'i phyag len gar dbyangs rgyas pa zhig tshugs la re yin zhes pas mtshon/ 'phags bod brgyud pa'i dam pa rim byon gyi bzhed pa skong zhing rje nyid kyi bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan khu dbon/ e waṃ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub gsum gyi zag med chos kyi dbyings su dgongs pa khyad par can rdzogs pa rje btsun bla ma nyid kyi sa lam gyi yon tan bogs 'don thub bstan spyi bye brag dang / khyad par nged rang gi rim gro sogs la dgongs pa bstad de lo lo bzhin rgyal bas cho 'phrul bstan pa'i mnyan yod mchod pa'i dus chen gyi thog dpal ldan rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rtsa bshad cha mthun 'phros yan lag rgyud dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bcu gsum/dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs thun mong ma yin pa lha bcu gsum/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i rten 'brel du thub dbang gnas bcur bcas pa'i phyag mchod rnams kyi sgrub mchod gsar 'dzugs kyis (92na)ris gsar sbyor dgos pa'i rten du bkra shis kha btags/ dngul gyi rnam rgyal mchod rten/ jus lu lha'i gos ber nang ldan/ kha thi dmar ser/ gos rgyan gzhi sngo dmar/ gos lu hi yug rnams spus legs/ maṇ+ḍal/ mdong mo/ lnga bcu ma sogs khyon sdoms dngul srang sum brgya lhag bcas/ rta lnga/— 134

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (5)dre'u gnyis/ ka ras yug gnyis kyi gnang cha dang bcas thugs rtsol chen po'i bka' nan dang / g.yin yang chos rje thams cad mkhyen pas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor ba'i ri phug chos khri thang ga'i steng du gser thog 'bubs dgos tshul phebs pa bod yul gyi chos sde spyi 'gre las zha lu pa'i bla gra gang gi go yul bzung ba'i khral babs kyi 'bur dod dgos pa med na'ang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bzhed pa bsgrub pa dang rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa la bsam nas mchod thebs dar rgyas chu btags kyis gtsos gzhis ka ma lag bzhi mi ser bsdad grong khral rkang bcu bdun/ drug zur gcig /rdo thab pa gnyis kyi yong 'bab/ gzhis thon sgrags pa'i 'bru rkyang thog sha mar ra lug la gong rgyab bcas khyon mkhar khal stong phrag gnyis dang nyis brgya rtsa shing gi bdag thob gang yod dang / gzhis rtse nas bzang ja dang sha shan phyed 'dres mkhar rgya'i dmar 'degs khal sum cu lhag bcas/ bu ram mkhal bcu rnams gtong deb la 'khod pa'i sbyor 'jags 'byed khra zur gsal bzhin zhus pa'i lo star chags su chad med dgos pa'i blang dang dor bya'i bca' yig gi rim pa la/ gnas bcu ma gtags pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu bzhi po rnams phyag chen thig le las/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /bye ma bcir yang mar med bzhin/ gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma (92ba)thag/ dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma la ni dbang nod bya/ zhes smin rung du ma byas par gsang sngags byung rgyal du sbyang pa nyes dmigs shin tu che zhing / gsang ba'i mdzod las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyin ldan na/ /skye zhing skye bor dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yis skye ba bdun na ni/ /ma bsgoms par yang sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes dbang thob pa'i phan yon rgyud sde rnams su rgya cher bsngags pa ltar yin la/ dbang de yang slob dpon la legs par bltos dgos kyi/ gzhan gyis ni ma yin te/ 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra bar/ slob dpon med par gyur na ni/ /dngos grub 'thob par mi 'gyur bas/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /zhes dang / rdo rje 'byung bar/ slob dpon la ni dbang bskur 'thob/ /ces gsungs/ dbang yang rtsa — 135

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ni/bshad sogs la slob ma'i dbang dang slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis car thob dgos pas/ chos gra chen po 'di ga'i mkhan slob zur 'chad dang hor khongs su byung ba rnams gong dkar rdo rje gdan/ e wam chos ldan/ bkra shis chos sde sogs brgyud khungs gcig pa rnams nas dbang legs par nos rjes/mkhas pa'i dbang po dpang lo tsā ba chen pos/ rgyal ba'i sras kyis shes bya thams cad la/ /bslab par gsungs phyir ji snyed mkhyen pa yi/ /ye shes rgyu ru 'gyur bas shes ldan rnams/ /byang chub don gnyer bsam pas 'di blang rigs/ /zhes bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyu ru 'gyur pa'i sems kyis kun nas blangs te shes bya'i gnas gang la'ang bslab rigs par gsungs na/ gsang chen rdo rje thog pa'i mngon dkyil/ sbyin sreg /gar thig dbyangs gsum/ phyag len che phra mtha' dag la zhib mor dpyad de thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pas bstan (93na)pa rin po che'i gsal byed du 'gyur bar ma zad/ rang nyid ring por mi thogs par lnga ldan ye shes khyab bdag rdo rje sems pa'i sku mngon du byed pa'i dgos pa khyad par can yod pa'i phyir na 'og tu gsal ba rnams khong du chub par byas te bstar dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang dpal rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil chog bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i rin chen bsam 'phel li mkhyen rab chos rje'i phyag len ji lta ba chos rje dbon rgyal bas zin bris su mdzad pa bzhin/ khrus kyi skabs su nang khrus/ gsang khrus/ rnal 'byor gyi khrus/ phyi'i khrus bzhi ste/ bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las/ nyin re bzhin ni ci nus par/ /khrus bzhi dag ni rab tu bya/ /rnal 'byor ji ltar 'khrul bya ba/ /go rims bzhin du rab tu bshad/ /sdom pa gsum la rab tu gnas/ /dang po'i khrus su brjod pa yin/ /gnyis pa rgyu las gsungs pa yi/ /bshags dang gsol ba 'debs la sogs/ /phyag rgya bcing pa gsum pa ste/ /bzhi pa chu ste tha ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sdom pa gsum ni bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mor/ brtan pa ma thob bar du yang / /kha na ma tho rdul med cing / /sdom pa gsum la gnas par bya/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'o/ /zhes gsung pas thog mar sdom gsum rnam par dag pa la gnas pa gal che zhid /— 136

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wadades nyams su len rgyu'i cho ga'i rim pa la/ cho ga /phyag len/ gar dbyangs/ sgo bzhi'i cho ga rgyas pa gong ma'i phyag len chu babs ma/ thugs sras lo tsā bas sku zhad nam mkha'i mtshan can la rdor dbyings kyi dbang gi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rjes gnang gi tshe/ bu ston rin po che'i dbang rdzas rnams gnang sbyin du stsal/ nga'i rnal 'byor rgyud skor gyi bstan pa khyod (93ba)brgyud pa dang bcas pa gtad pa yin pas ma nyams pa gyis shig gsungs pa ltar dge 'phel chos rdzong du sgrub mchod sgo bzhi'i phyag len chos skyong chen po'i bstod ring sogs chag med du tshugs pa'i rgyun sku zhang mchog legs rnam rgyal/ mkhas pa'i dbang po tsan+d+ra shrī/ slob dpon rin chen dpal grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje'i sku tshe'i stod kyi bar du yod pa/ dus 'gyur gyis ri phug bla brang shar chen du tshugs pa sku zhang chos rje phun tshogs/ sku 'ad bsod nams mchog grub/ sku 'ad rin chen bkra shis bsod nams rgyal mtshan yan la dar rgyas su byung ba/ sku 'ad nam mkha' chos ldan pa/ chos rje ka bzhi ba'i slob ma phyag chen pa'i har spyod kyi rnam pas do dam ma mdzad par chag ste nyag phra bar gyur pa 'phags pa'i yul du stod 'grel ba'i lugs ltar sir+sha la zhes pa phyogs 'dir dmar ser can du grags shing / 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i khyab tu ting zi zhes rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me mo sbrul kyi lo chu shel gyi dbang po rta chen gyis nya ba'i tshes gcig la thog ma'i sngon 'gror slob dpon chen po shārnya kā ra wa mes mdzad pa'i cha gsum gyi cho ga gsal byed yo ga ba chen po mkhas grub sangs rgyas tshe dpal gyis mdzad pa bzhin dbyangs rol dang bcas rgyas par sgrub pa nas brtsams te bkra shis kyi bar sgo bzhi'i cho ga'i phyag len thur gsal ltar dang / de bzhin du rdor dbyings 'grel lugs dbang mchog rgyas pa'i kha skong du kun mkhyen bus mdzad pa la byang gling chos rje'i lhan thabs sbyar ba/ dum bu gnyis pa khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dkyil chog chos rje thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad par 'jam dbyangs byang gling rje'i lhan thabs sbyar ba/ bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo rigs bsdus kyi dkyil chog bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog la mkhyen rab rin po che'i lhan thabs (94na〉sbyar ba/ cha — 137

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)mthun gyi rgyud rdo rje 'chang gi rigs dpal mchog rdo rje sems pa'i dkyil chog thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rjes mdzad par byang gling rje'i lhan thabs sbyar ba/ dpal mchog rigs bsdus kun mkhyen bus mdzad pa'i dkyil mchog gi dgongs don ji lta ba shar chen ye shes rgya mtshos legs par bkral ba la thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa'i gsung mchan gyis brgyan pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin/ thog mar cha gsum/ bum pa 'bul ba/ sgo dbye ba/ phyogs gtor rgyas pa/ yan lag gi rgyud chos dbyingasagasung dbang gi dkyil mchog mkhas pa'i dga' ston dang bstod chen kun mkhyen bus mdzad pa la/thig rtsa/ phyag rgya 'ching tshul/ dkyil 'khor 'dri tshul/ cho ga'i lhan thabs rnams byang gling 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mdzad pa sbyar ba/ 'jam dpal gsang ldan mkhas grub khyung lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'am/ shangs pa dge bsnyen yongs grags rgyal bas mdzad pa gang rung la/ mkhyen rab rje'i zhal slob dbang ldan chos 'khor ba dge 'dun dpal bzang gi lhan thabs sbyar ba/ 'jam dpal rigs bsdus rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rjes mdzad pa'i dkyil chog bzhin/ rtsa rgyud dum bu gnyis pa'i ngan 'gro dgug cing sdig pa dpral ba'i skabs nas 'phros pa'i tshul du gsungs pa'i rgyud kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dkyil chog kun mkhyen bus mdzad par 'jam dbyangs chos legs dpal dar bzang po'i lhan thabs sbyar ba/ shākya seng ge gtsug tor dgu pa'i dkyil chog bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa la byang gling pa rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis lhan thabs sbyar ba/ rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa yo gar bkral ba'i dkyil chog thams cad mkhyen pa bus mdzad par chos rje dbon (94ba)rgyal ba'i lhan thabs sbyar ba/ phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil chog 'chi med grub pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad par khyab bdag mkhan rin po che rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyis reg zig sbyar ba/ shar du sher phyin/ lhor stong po bkod pa/ nub tu gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ byang du gser 'od dam pa ste bzhi'i gsungs sgrogs/ sa chog bu ston yab sras dus kyi phyag len ltar dbus kyi khro bo spro ba rdor dbyings rtsa lugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon/ shar sgo ba rtse mo'i rdo rje slob dpon/— 138

'phags bal bod sog ba'i yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wanalho sgo ba rdor dbyings 'grel lugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon/ nub sgo ba dpal mchog rigs bsdus kyi rdo rje slob dpon/ byang sgo ba shākya seng ge gtsug tor dgu pa'i rdo rje slob dpon te lnga/ dkyil 'khor zhal 'byed skabs rdor dbyings rtsa lugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyis bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i rgyas po'i sbyin sreg gi cho gar chos 'khor ba dge 'dun dpal bzang gis gsal byed lhan thabs sbyar ba la/ cha lugs/ 'dug stangs/ phyag rgya/ thab/ sreg rdzas/ mchod rdzas rnams bshad tshod bzhin/ grangs rdzun med pa'i sreg rdzas/ thab nang gzhal yas khang rdor dbyings dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs par grwa tshang bzhi ga nas gar bzabs mchor gyi rdor dbyings mchod gar chos rjes thams cad mkhyen pa'i gar yig la mkhas pa zla ba dpal rin gyi gsal byed slob rgyun gyi phyag len reg zig mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi mdzad pa bzhin rgyas pa/slar kun rig sham+bha ta'i gar las bzhi'i rnga brdung dang bcas pa chad par nye 'dug pas bu ston rin po che'i gsung rab las bslab rgyun sbyar nas ma chad tsam 'di bstan rgyun la bsam nas mkhan slob sne mo ba rnams kyis rgyas par gso ba'i (95na/cir bzhes/ rdul tshon chu bor gdan 'dren skabs kun mkhyen bus mdzad pa'i klu chog bzhin spyan 'dren byin rlabs kyi rgyun brtan pa'i phyir sangs gtor sogs rdor dbyings rtsa lugs kyi slob dpon pa/ shis brjod kyi dus bkra shis kyi rims spyi 'gro la rdor dbyings kyi bkra shis mchod phreng nas byung ba/ bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i rtse mo'i bkra shis dang / dpal mchog gi chos dang bkra shis 'phel byed bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa/ de thams cad la rgyal ba gnyis pa bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog so so la brgyud pa'i gsung rgyun ma nyams pa'i kha skong sbyor te/ slob dpon mkhas pa'i mdzub khrid steng nas byang zhing chub pa/ bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i yo ga ṭī ka yid bzhin nor bu la mkhas pa tsan+d+ra shrī'i bshad sbyar bslan pa gtso bor bton/ g.yin yang thams cad mkhyen pa bus mdzad pa'i yo gi'i phyogs kyi gsung rab snga phyi rnams dang / de dag gi dgongs don gsal byed khyung po lhas pa gzhen nu bsod — /39

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)nams sogs dngos slob rnams kyis mdzad pa dang / de rjes mkhas mchog tsan+d+ra shrī/ thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal sogs kyis gsungs pa'i legs bshad las byung ba ltar cho ga'i tshig don/ phyag rgya'i 'ching tshul/'ching mtshams sogs khong du chud nas mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzang po khyad du mi gsod par legs par brtags te mi shes pas rang gar sbyar ba'i 'khrul pa rnams ring du bor/ khyad par phyag rgya/ bris thig /gar dbyangs rnams dpe bltas pa tsam gyis mi shes pas slob dpon mkhas pa'i ngag la gus pas mnyan te mkhas pa tsa spros mdzad pa'i bris thig (95ba)gar dbyangs sogs kyi bstan bcos las byung ba ltar phyag len du thebs pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi mngon dkyil mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rwa chen lo tsā bas mdzad par/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi lhan thabs dang thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i chog sgrigs sbyar ba/tshar chen yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i brgyud 'debs lam rim gyi smon lam dang bkra shis/ las gshin gyi bkang gso dbyangs rol sogs/ tshar lugs kyi phyag len gzhan 'dres med pa 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi mchod chog rje bla mas bka' gnang ba bzhin nged rang gis rang bzo spangs te yig rnying rnams las btus pa rgyal bstan mdzad med nor bu rnams/ sgrub mchod grol ba'i sang nyin bzlog chen bzhi'i cho ga rgyas par bstar ba la sgrub mchod tshugs pa nas ma grol bar dpon slob bzhis gdugs dkar gyi cho ga rgya gar slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mi'i gsung rab kyi dgongs don 'khrul med so'i sngags 'chang chen po shākya dpal bas grub pa'i rtags mngon sum du bstan pa'i chog sgrigs dang / 'jam dbyangs chos legs dpal dar bzang pos mdzad pa'i bdag mdun gyi steng nas zor rnams nus ldan du sgrub pa/ bstod res kyi rnam sras drag gtor/ gshed dmar drug cu pa chos rjes thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rab ltar rgyud sde 'dzin pa chos rig rgyal mtshan gyis legs par bkral ba/ kha 'bar ma la sngags rnying ma'i nang bdag kha bsgyur gyi kha nang du me sbar zhing rdzongs kyis — /4(/

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)bskul sogs byung ba dag /gsar ma ba mi mkhas pa 'dras/ ming tsam la 'khrul nas sbyar ba sogs kyi lhad dang bral ba ba ri lo tsā ba'i dgongs don slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa'i chog sgrigs la gsal byed sngags 'chang shākya dpal ba'am rje chos (96na)legs dpal dar gyis sbyar ba gang rung / de ltar bzlog chen bzhi'i gtor rgyag skabs rnam sras kyi las bzhi'i rnga brdung rnga 'gros spro ba gsum gyi 'tshams dang bcas rgyas pa/ gtor rgyag byas pa'i sang nyin rdor dbyings pa sogs kyis mkhyen rab chos rje'i phyag len bzhin gtor 'bul rgyas pa dang bstun/ gdugs dkar ba rnams kyis rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i cho ga /sgrub mchod la gegs sel gyi sku rim du dpon slob gsum res ma grol ring snga dro gzungs gra lnga'i sgrub mchod dang / dgongs mo chos skyong rnams kyi bkang gso/ gnas brtan phyag mchod pa rnams kyis rje bla ma'i dgongs pa bzhin 'di ga'i ring 'tshor dmigs pa'i snga dro tshe chog rnams mdzad/ thams cad kyis tshogs mnyam dang gyes mnyam ngos tshogs 'phral thun mong du rdor dbyings rtsa lugs kyi dbu mdzad chen mos gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen bu ston rin po che'i sku bstod gang rigs/ thugs sras lo tsā ba'i rnam thar gsol 'debs gsung rab ma sngon du btang nas zha lur bka' drin che ba'i bla ma rnams kyi sku bstod 'di ga nas gsar rtsom dang nged rang gi ring 'tsho'i tshig bcad rnams gsung / sngags sde dgon shar nub gnyis kyis bka' brgyad bder 'dus kyi khro rol dang 'brel ba'i sgrub pa byed/ mchod rdzas dang dge 'dun gyi rnyed bkur rnams gtong deb gzhung gi dam 'byar nang bzhin chad 'khum med par gtong / ja ma las byed ma gtogs tshogs bzhugs ma yin par drag gzhan su la'ang skal ba mi gtong thams cad kyis dam tshig dang sdom par gnas pa gtso bor 'don/ kun gyis bsnyen pa song na rab de min chog dpon gyis bsnyen pa nges par song ba/ cho ga phyag rgya dang bcas pa rgyugs ma 'phrod na tshogs su mi 'jug cing de rigs la ngo chen ngan skyob kyi rigs gtan (96ba)mi byed/ tshogs la rang nam khom gyi res 'jog byas nas cho ga cha lag mi tshang ba dang na ba sogs khams kyis mi lcogs nges min par brel ba yod pa rgyu mtshan du byas — 14/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2re/nas chos khrims par gnang ba zhu ba dang / dbang gshed kyi ras spyod sogs mig bltos gshas rkyen du 'gro ba drag zhan sus kyang mi byed/ gong gsal gyi rgyab gnyer dgos pa gzhis rtse rdzong stod sbrel pos gyis/ bstan 'gro spyi'i bde skyid dang bye brag shes bya thams cad gzigs pa bu ston rin po che yab sras kyi ring lugs ma pham mgon po dbus 'gyur 'chang du ma byon de srid kyi bar du dar rgyas dang rang gzhan gyi 'di dang gtan gyi 'dun ma la bsams nas khral 'jal tsam du ma song ba'i blo dang brtson pa'i nus pa ci yod kyis 'bad par rigs so/ /nam mkha'i mtha' snyed lus can kun gyi bstan bde'i srog tu nyer song ba/ /khyab bdag rnam snang rdo rje sems dpa'i mi zad rgyan 'khor bdud rtsi'i thig /rgya bod mkhas grub rim byon zhal lung chu gter che las slar 'don pa'i/ /rin chen bsod nams mchog tu grub khyod sngon med legs bris yongs kyi gtso/ /lugs gzhan ma 'dres 'jam dbyangs rwa chen gyi/ /phyag bzhes dus dgra'i dbang po ma he'i zhal/ /bcu gsum 'khor lo'i gsal byed tshar lugs zhes/ /'khrul rnyog dwangs mtshor dngos grub gzugs kun 'char/ /spang rtogs srang la byin rlabs bdog pa yis/ /lci dang yang med sangs rgyas spyi srol kyang / /snyigs dus bstan pa'i srog tu thugs rje'i shugs/ /cher lhag gnas brtan bcu drug grags snyan dkar/ /'phyas dar 'dus sde'i thog ma gser bkang zhes/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho 'phel pa'i mdzes rgyan du/ /ma pham bu ston yang sras ring lugs ding / /ches cher rgyas pa dpal (97na)ldan zha lu sa /bgrang yas rgyud snge yid bzhin rin chen mdzod/ /phul byung bsod nams zhing sa gshin po na/ /lha sngags ye shes mchog tu nyer sgrub pas/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis snye ma g.yur za nges/ /ngo mtshar bkod pa bye pa'i cho 'phrul che/ /nyi ma'i gnyen gyi legs bstan rta chen zlar/ /sras bcas rgyal bar kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar slar phye 'bras/ /'khor ba tshang tshing klung du las nyon gyi/ /gcan gzan gdug pas rab gces ma rgan tshogs/ /thar pa'i rin chen gling 'khrid sa mkhan che/ /bstan dang de 'dzin bshes gnyen tshogs 'phel zhing / /sgra bsgyur 'jig rten — /42

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)mig gcig bu ston rje/ /rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i bzhed gzhung gtsor gyur pa/ /legs bshad dbyangs kyi pi wang rgyud mang sgra/ /phyogs bral lus phra'i rna bar snyan par shog /byang chen de srid bskrun kyang gzhal dka' ba/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gsum gyi/ /dgongs pa bde chen chos dbyings klong rdzogs nas/ /yol med thugs rje'i spyan gyis rtag gzigs shog /tshe dbang lhun grub rab tu brtan pa yi/ /sa lam yon tan zla ba'i ma ma sa /bskyed rdzogs nyams rtogs ma nub dbang bzhi'i chu/ /yongs babs zung 'jug srid rtser phyur bar shog /'phrog byed kyis bteg sra brtan rdo rje'i khrir/ /mgon khyod zhabs zung bskal brgyar bkod byas te/ /nges gsang theg mchog chos 'khor skal bzang gi /gdul byar bsko ba'i re 'bras lhun grub shog /bstan 'gro'i don por dgongs bzhed tshul bzhin du/ /legs ldan ser chen rnam mang thos pa'i sras/ /las kyi gshin rje rdo rje rab brtan (97ba)sogs/ /chos srung rgya mtshos 'phrin las lhun grub mdzod/ /gnam lo thog mar tshes pa yar gyi ngo / gza' skar dus sbyor dge ba'i 'phrod bzang nas/ /bgrang yas dkyil 'khor mchod cing nyer bsgrubs pa'i/ /bkra shis 'jig rten kun tu khyab par shog /ces chos sde chen po zha lu'i sgrub mchod bco lnga gsar tshugs kyi bca' yig shel dkar me long 'di ni khyab bdag bla ma dam pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi bka' stsal ba dang du blangs te za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes 'phags yul ba ā na la zhes pa phyogs 'dir mar grags shing / shar phyogs rgyal khab tu bing shing du 'bod pa me pho 'brug gi lo/ legs sbyar gyi skad du māḥ shi ra zhes mgos nya ba'i zla ba/ rgya nag pa shi dbyi zhes pa hor zla bcu gcig pa/ dus 'khor ba'i snying stobs kyi mun pa 'jug pa 'bring bo'i dmar cha/ yon tan gyi dbyangs au/ gsal
