byed skyed rim dang mthun pa dbyangs ā/ gsal byed dza/ na tshod gzhen nu/ khams chu/ 'dod yon ro/ grub pa'i mtha'i nyi ma dpo/byed rtsis pa'i chu tshod kyi me bzhis sleb pa'i 'grub sbyor/ taṅka la bum pa'i dus sbyor la rdzogs ldan gyi rnam par thar pa bzhi'i sgo phye ba pho brang dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa — 143

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa dza yan+tu/ /chos rnams don dam stong zhing bdag med kyang / /kun rdzob snang ba 'gag med 'byams klas par/ /bgegs mthar bskrod pa'i khro bo rig pa'i rgyal/ /tshig mda'i lam du dbang po'i gzhu ris ltar/ /sgyu mas bslan pa'i 'phrog byed sder mo yis/ / (98na)gnyis 'thung lto ba 'dral mtshungs med bzhin du/ /btags cam 'khrul ngor shar ba'i sde brgyad rnams/ /dpyad na mtha' bral stong chen dbu ma'i lam/ /ma rtogs phung po lnga tsam tshogs pa'i ngar/ /mi bzad zug rngus gzir byed gnod pa kun/ //skrag 'thung rnam par rol pas rmi lam ltar/ /med bzhin snang ba'i sgo gsum rak+ta ya/ /gser gyi rgyal po'i lung gis/ /chen po hor gyi rgyal khams su tā la'i bla ma badz+ra dha rar 'bod pa'i gtam/ yangs pa'i sa chen po la spyod pa'i rgya dor bod sog gi skye dgu spyi dang / bye brag khal kha tsho pa bdun/ o rod tsho pa bzhir gtogs pa'i bla ma ser mo ba che chung / rgyal po rgyal rigs/ tha'i ji/ ji nong / dpon che chung / tha bu na/ ja'i sang / dmag sogs bya ba zhi drag gi sne mo las 'dzin/ mngags sleb sde dmangs dang bcas pa mtha' dag la springs pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams su rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i lus can ma lus pa bde skyid la spyod pa 7thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa rin po cher rag lus shing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'ang lha mo dri ma med pa lung bstan pa'i mdo sogs las byang nas byang phyogs su rgyas par gsungs pa ltar bod kha ba can gyi byang phyogs hor gyi rgyal khams su tā la'i bla ma bsod nams rgya mtsho dang al then chos kyi rgyal po mchod yon nyi zla zung du 'brel ba nas yangs pa'i rgyal khams mtha' klas pa dam pa chos kyis dkar por gyur pa nas bzung 7rgyal ba gnyis pa shar btsong kha pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i gdugs dkar po gcig gi grib bsil la 'di phyi'i bde skyid sgrub par ngal gso bzhin pa yin na'ang bar skabs su sems can las la spyod pa'i dus kyi chad pas stod smad du g.yul (98ba)'brug rtsod ldan kyi mtshan nyid dngos su bstan pa'i dus kyi 'pho 'gyur — /44

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)mang ba byung na'ang khal kha tsho pa bdun gyi la rgya la 'khyoms lad cher med cing / tse/ rod tsho ba bzhi'i mtshams su bde dog sna tshogs byung ba'i mthar ding sang dga' ldan hung tha'i ji'i las shugs dar drag pas stobs kyi dbang phyug chen por gyur skabs yin 'dug pa bstan 'gro'i bde skyid sa la spyod pa'i mi'i bdag po rnams phan tshun mnyes gshin par gyur pas dkon mchog gsum la bla mar 'dzin pa dang / mnga' 'bangs rnams lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba dge ba bcu'i khrims la brten nas bde bar skyong bar rag lus pa nas sngar co ni chos rje o chir dha ra dang cha gan no mon khan gnyis kyis khal kha o rod 'khrug rtsod lha min gyi grong khyer 'dra ba'i ya nga ba 'dums par byas pa'i mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa yod mur/ lcags pho 'brug gi lo khal kha ja sag thu rgyal po sogs rje blon mang po dang g.yon ru pā thur hung tha'i jis gtsos pa'i o rod kyi dpon khag mang pos rnam par dag pa'i bsam pa blo gros dang brtson pa'i mthu brtas te phan tshun bde 'jags kyi bstan gzhung gcig tu 'gyur pa'i yig dan btsan po mdzad yod 'dug pa ltar khong rang rnam gnyis kyi ring de don ltar phan tshun dus bde byung ba rjes su sa ster sdod mi 'dra'i skyon gyis dmag jag thor bu byung 'dug pa dga' ldan hung tha'i ji yang pha mes kyi bya ba bzang po bsgrubs pa'i rjes su zhugs te gzhung bzang po'i mdun ma 'dug pa ltar sngar gyi yig dan rnying pa'i don ltar gnas pa dang / gal te de las 'gal ba'i brlang por spyod pa'i rigs la khal kha o rod kyi rgyal po dpon khag mdun na 'don sogs phan tshun gros bsdur mthun grub ngos nas dran 'dzin phyis 'doms byas nas slar zhod 'jags pa'i thabs la brtson pa byed (99na)sngar mchog thu bshes gnyen ngan pa'i blo brid dang las smon gyis zha ser cod pan 'chang pa'i bstan pa la log par 'khu ba'i dus bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po dang pā thur hung tha'i ji gnyis blo rtse gcig tu bsgril ba'i dpung shed kyis bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs su 'gyur ba bzhin slar yang bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po dang da la'i hung tha'i ji gnyis kyi gtsos pa'i dpon khag rnams kyis mtsho khri shog rgyal mo yan chad dang / dga' ldan hung tha'i — 145

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)jis o rod phyogs kyi bstan gzhung bzung ste phan tshun bstan srid gcig tu gyur pa'i legs lam che ba byed 'dun dga' ldan hung tha'i ji'i lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyu mtshan byung ba ltar rgyal po dang hung tha'i jis kyang de don ltar 'dod mthun phan tshun gnyis yab mes bzang po'i srol rgyun kho na lhur blangs te bstan srid kyi zhabs tog bsgrub pa/ o rod tsho pa bzhi snga phyi/ 'brug rtsod sogs la brten dar gud che ba byung 'dug pa/ nye lam dga' ldan hung tha'i jis rang rgyal kho na gtsor 'don ma yin pa'i o rod kyi la rgyar so so'i ming ma dor ba sogs khebs gang che'i 'dun pa 'dug pa g.yon ru dang thor gog mnga' thang rgyas skabs la bzo bcos ma dgos rung / kho shod/ dur bod/ khod sogs nyams chags byung ba rnams dngos gzhi la rgya dga' ldan hung tha'i ji'i lung len pa las spros pa mi 'dug rung / nang gses kyi go bsdur sogs tha'i ji'i bkod pa dang bstun ngos so so'i 'tsher sar bde 'jags gang che'i skyong bdar dang / tshul de la rjes su yi rangs ba'i bsam pa rnam dag las sngar 'khon zhe bzhag gi ngo log g.yul 'khrug mi byed pa sogs kyi dpang por shi rā thu no mon khan 'di ga'i ngo tshab kyi dpang po'i 'os thor dga' ldan hung tha'i jis byung ba khong na mthos shing de (99ba)phyogs su yun rings ba'i bod du yong chog pa dgos tshul byung rung khong rang brtag par yang ma babs pa med cing bla ma gsar ba yang 'phral gtong ma 'grig pa sogs nas skor cig no mon khan rang sdod dgos pa'i bslab bya song zhing khong na tshod dang bcas yar yong ba shar dus de tshab kyi bla ma zhig ched gnyer du mngags pa'i gong du gsal ba rnams su ma zad rgya nag gong ma rgyal pos gtsos par gzhung 'grig po sogs bde 'jags kyi rgyun mi nyams pa'i slad du dpang po re chad med du 'jog rgyu yin/ da lam rje bdag nyid chen po'i bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs rgya cher bsgrub pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'byed du rgyal por mnga' gsol ba'i lung las skyel ba dang / gong gsal gyi don skor rnams gleng bar mgron gnyer skyar po ba rdo rje dbang phyug rdzong bda' byas yod pa so so nas go ba'i spang blang 'dzol med byed dgos rgyu yin/ tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa rnams la smon lam bzang po'i mtshams sbyor ba yin/— /46

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)go bar bya ba'i yi ge dus kyi pho nya zhes pa sa pho rta'i lo hor zla lnga pa'i yar tshes la nor 'dzin gyi spo las mngon par 'phags pa pho brang chen po po ta la nas bris/ / (100na)sangs rgyas rgya mtsho gangs ljongs chos srid kyi bdag por bsko bzhag gi bka' lung dang ngam ring chos sde mnga' dag rgyal gsum sogs chos sde khag gi go bar byed pa'i yi ge /u t+ta 'e kho su 1 sha ka sgyu ga mi na/ pa sti ma su de ba snya na she shubha sku khaḥ ti — su bu snya dz+nyā ga ma ga ga nu 'i phya dza ta ga ma na sa rba sa ni ka ba bha dak+ṣa ra ba sbra dha ra sa mu dra klo gu nā lha na ñca ga khyu ta/ /chen khro'i hong de'i khri ldung nga'i/ zi then tā tī/ tsi co re phyo/ sho lu'i then zhwa/ shi gyos yi thung /de'i chi kying gang / de'i khe'i/ shang zi/ tsi yin/ gong ma hong de'i lung gis/ nub kyi lha gnas chos dge ba bde bar gnas pa'i sangs rgyas bka' lung gnam 'og gi skye 'gro thams cad bstan pa gcig tu gyur pa 'gyur med rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho'i bla mar dbang bskur ba'i gtam/ ri brik+ṣa sa mngon par mtshan pa'i nor 'dzin gyi gzhir 'khod pa'i nyi 'og gi skye dgu spyi dang / bye brag gdan sa chen po ser 'bras dge gsum/ gam du 'khod pa'i rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa sogs ris med khrims ldan 'dus pa'i sde/ gsang sngags 'chang ba/ g.yung drung bon sogs lha sder gtogs so cog dang / sog po tsho chen bzhi bcu/ o rod tsho pa bzhi/ mtsho khri shor rgyal mo'i 'gram du gnas pa'i rgyal po rgyal rigs/ ju nang / tha'i ji/ dpon che chung / tha bu nang / ja'i sang / mi bzang / sde dmangs dang bcas pa/ skor gsum (100ba)ru bzhi/ sgang drug ces bod dang bod chen po'i rgyal khams su — 147

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)'bod pa'i/ dpon chen/ dpon skya/ rdzong sdod/ nang rnam/ rta drung / gnyer kha las 'dzin sogs mdor na mchog dman bar pa mtha' dag la springs pa/ tshe ring gnam gyi gshe mong gis yangs pa'i sa kun la dbang bskur ba bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i lhag bsam dang / snying stobs brtson pa'i mthus/rgyal dbang btsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa bla nas blar 'degs par mdzad skabs chu rta pho brang chen po bsam 'grub rtses gtsos pa'i mnga' 'bangs dang / rgyal po nyid kyi rigs brgyud dang bcas pa mtha' dag gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin du sbyor 'jags mdzad pa'i tshe/ chos srid nyis 'dzin nged rang nas ma lcogs pa'i 'jig rten srid skyong gi khur len sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyis mdzad pa'i rjes su gdung gcig pa'i mi ngo rdzogs par brten/ sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho sogs khur len rim par bkod cing / grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho 'di pa sa skyong 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i rus tsha yin par ma zad/ gter gsar rgya can sogs lung bstan 'ga' zhig tu bod kyi rje bor 'os pa lung gis zin pa nas/ shing yos lo khur len byed dgos tshul rgyu mtshan mtha' gsed nan chags byas kyang zhu nan ches pa'i khrol cha byed dgos shing / g.yin ma'i 'os tho mang ba ha cang gi brtag par ma bab ba shing / gra tshang gnyer pa blo bzang sbyin pa sangs rgyam pa'i 'og gi brtag pa ngo dkar ba yod gshis rgyu mtshan smod par/ shes 'dod ni med/ bka' rgyan ldog ni mi nus/ 'on kyang brtag pa bskyar nas brling cha dgos tshul byung ba/ lo gsum gye bar 'tshub cha med cing bzang bas/ slar gegs zhi na mu 'thud byed long yong rtsis kyi lo grangs kyis brda 'grems dang bcas khrir bkod pa/ rang 'dod/ (101na)chung zhing bstan srid lar rgya'i khur bsam che ba dang khyad par 'di ga'i ngag bkod las cung zad kyang mi g.yo ba sogs thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i nye gnas gsung rab par gnang ba'i tshigs kyi brjod don dang tshungs par mu 'thud thub par byung ba/ sde pa rang yang lo grangs thengs nas 'tshub 'dra byung nyen gyis nan zhus che zhing / brtag pa lan gnyis gsum bskur ba dang tshangs pa dung thod can la dri ba zhus pa sogs kyang mtshungs pa nas gsar bkod kyi sgo dod par/ gzhan pa 'os dkon — 148

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)zhing sngar gyi brtag pa lung bstan sogs gang sa nas grong smad pa sangs rgyam pa rang la nan tan du labs par yal yol sogs thabs sna tshogs las dang len zhig mi 'dug rung / dung dkar dang chu srin gyi dpe bzhin dgongs pa gtan nas ma khrol phyin/ phyis skor blo snang 'gyur pa'i chos la dung sems che ba zhig yod kyang sde srid 'di gas mu 'thud gnang na smos ma dgos/ de min khri 'don zhig grub pa'i sgo ma dod gong la zhus na/ mi dmangs kyang rnam rtog gi 'char sgo sna tshogs byung dogs kyi de lam du lus pa yin/ da cha bsnyen rdzogs shig byas pa'i lo gnyis kyi bar bka' ma bcag par zhus/de nas khur yang byas chog pa dgos tshul zer ba/ dngos gzhi rab tu byung na legs pa'i char 'dug rung / thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho yan bka' gdams kyi rnam thar kho na lhur bzhes 'a dper ma mtshon/ dga' ldan pho brang lugs gnyis kyi mnga' thang je 'phel gyi 'go zug pa'i phyag mdzod rgya seng gnyis nas bzung / da lta phan sde pa blo bzang sbyin pa tsam ma gtogs tshangs spyod la gnas pa ma byung zhing / lhag par dpal phag mo gru pa dang sde srid gtsang pa'i stobs 'byor las brgyal ba shar dar rtse mdo yan gyi bdag por gyur ba'i dmag dang khrims sogs drag po'i rtsub spyod kyang sna tshogs dgos par/ tshangs spyod gcig pus rab byung du 'gro ba'ang dka' zhing / bsam pa'i 'gyur khyad drag gzhan kun la gtan (101ba)mi chags pa zhig yong gshis da lta'i blo 'di gar stod pa'i nges pa yang med/ lhag tu dge 'dun dang ngang pa khyus 'tsho dgos par gnas grogs sogs gang sa nas lhus things dka' bar ma zad/ sde dpon chen po'i rigs la blon brgyud sogs drung 'khor drag pa rnams 'khor ba dong sprugs lta bu'i blo sna bstungs pa rten 'brel la yang mi legs/ bla brang du bdag mo bsten pas mtshon sger gzhung mnyam bsres gzhan blor mi chud pa ni ga la byed/ de phyin sger gzhis kyi 'dzin skyong kyang blos ma bor ba byas na phugs yul gzhung gi zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba rgya le kun 'dun rin po che'i dpe dang bcas mol ba ltar yid 'jog byed rgyu yin cing / go sa 'di bod kyi sde dpon gzhan dang ma 'dra ba'i rgya bod hor gsum tshang ma'i sne len stabs brel ba rgyun mi 'chad lta — 149

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)bu'i khrag sbyong che bar la lar nyams 'char rtsed mo'i gung sangs kyis gzhung las la thud shor dang mi rnams kyis kyang 'phya gleng sna tshogs yong 'dug pa da cha nyams len gyi snying po 'di ga'i ngag bkod la dang len ngos/ tshul 'chos bag ldan gyi par bkab med pa'i kho rang gi blo mthun dang / nya stong brgyad gsum la yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims len pa'am/ dge sbyor zol sdod gung sangs lta bu gang byed kyang zla rer nyin gsum res las gar le shor mi yong bas khrol cha byas shing / lo grangs dgos zer ba de bzhin byas tshe tshang ma khag bsun dang gzhung rang 'gros sgo che ba las mi 'dug gshis/ nam lcogs bar khur len byed rgyu dang bcas phyag mdzod bsko bzhag bgyis pa/ 'di ga nas mi chos kyi khur len ma lcogs pa'i ngo tshab yin gshis/ 'di pas gang byas nged rang nas byas pa dang khyad med pa'i 'then khyer gyi gleng brjod med par kun gyis bkod pa g.yo med dang nged dang sde pa'i bar sel 'jug sogs byas tshe gzhung don lar rgya chugs tshabs che bas bden med brdzun bsgrigs kyi g.yo 'phrul byas chog rgyu min/ na tshod sogs nas mi lcogs pa'i khur len 'jog pa shar tshe/ nam yin pa la bzhag pa'i zur (102na)pa spyi 'gre bzhin byed lugs blo dang sbyar chog rgyu yin pa sogs gong gsal gyi tshig don rnams la skya ser drag zhan sus kyang tshul bzhin bsgrubs par rjes 'dzin dang / log par 'khu bar tshar gcod pas mtshon pa'i legs nyes kyi bstangs 'dzin 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo dang / chos skyong beg tse lcam dral sogs bstan srung rnams kyis 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa'i grogs don g.yel ba med par mdzad du gsol/ 'phags pa'i yul du siṅgā tho phyogs 'dir jon grub tu grags shing 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i rgyal khab tu gyi yi zhes pa dbang thang dang bstun pa sa mo lug gi lo hor zla lnga pa'i dkar cha'i rgyal ba gnyis pa'i tshes la sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar rnam par phye ba pho brang chen po po ta la nas bris pa dza yan+tu/ /gong ma thong de'i lung gis/ zi than/ tā zhan/ tsi tsi'i phyo/ sho wa'i then zha/ shi skyog yi thung /bī shi/ de'i chi kying gang de'i khe'i/ shad zin/ tsi yin/ zhes nub kyi lha gnas ches dge ba bde bar — 150

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)gnas pa'i sangs rgyas bka' lung gnam 'og gi skye 'gro mtha' dag bstan pa gcig tu gyur pa 'gyur med rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho'i bla mar dbang bskur ba'i gtam/ nyi 'og tu 'khod pa'i skye 'gro spyi dang /khyad par bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi sa'i 'char 'khod pa'i bla slob dpon sogs rgya bod hor sog gi gra rigs/ grub mtha' ris med kyi gra skor ba ngam ring chos sde'i mkhan slob chu lho byang gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i 'du tshogs byed mi mchog dman bar ma'i skye 'gro mtha' dag la springs pa/ ngam ring chos sde'i gra skor go rim la/ mkhan spyi'i ngag bkod la nyan mi nyan sna tshogs shig yong gi yod 'dug (102ba)pa de rigs byas tshe bstan pa'i mig rkyen la gnod pa 'dug gshis/ lcags spre nas bzung gra skor ba'i go rim grub mtha' ris med kyi grwa tshang khrag mang nyung sna tshogs yod kyang / 'char can nyi shu tsam la cha bzhag na/ snga ldang dang po 'bras spungs sgo mangs pa/ gnyis pa ser theg chen gling pa/gsum pa 'bras spungs blo gsal gling pa/ bzhi pa dga' ldan pa/ lnga pa bkra shis lhun po/ drug pa gangs can chos 'phel/ bdun pa ngam ring gzhi gra/ brgyad pa dwags po grwa tshang / dgu pa sa skya lha khang chen po mo ba/ bcu pa dga' ldan phun tshogs gling pa/ bcu gcig pa lha rtse chos sdo pa/ bcu gnyis pa shel dkar chos sde pa/ bcu gsum pa byams chen pa/ bcu bzhi pa thub bstan rnam rgyal/ bco lnga pa yangs can/ bcu drug pa bya rgod ga sgongs pa/ bcu bdun pa shel dkar mngon dga' chos sde pa/ bco brgyad pa yar 'brog 'dzam gling chos 'khor ba/ bcu dgu pa snye mo chos sde pa/ nyi shu pa 'bras yul skyed tshal pa/ nyi shu rtsa gcig pa lho brag bshad sgrub chos 'khor ba rnams nas re re ldang rjes slar yang gra sa so so nas gnyis re yod na nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa 'bras spungs sgo mang ba/ rtsa gsum pa ser ba sogs go rim snga ma thar chags su 'gro/ yang se ra ba'i gra skor ba cig las med na nyi shu rtsa gsum pa 'bras spungs blo gsal gling pa ldang ba sogs grangs med kyi bar du rigs 'gre zhing / bar ldang dang phyi ldang yang gra skor ba'i go rim snga ldang dang 'dra ba byed dgos rgyu dang / chos sde'i sgrigs bkod sogs mkhan spyi gnyis dang / las chen chos khrims rnams kyi ngag bkod gang byas sor gnas las — 15/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)bstan pa'i mig rkyen la gnod pa'i rtsing spyod/ shes khyer sogs (103na)log par 'gro ba gtan nas byas chog rgyu min pas dbyar dgun gyi chos ra'i ring tshogs chen du nyin ltar gyi mang ja'i thog da phyin mgo che rkang ring dkrug rkyen ngan bslabs byed mi sogs la dmigs nas sher snying 'phar ma re'i mdo sgrub star chags su brgyag pa dang mkhan slob kyis rdzong du brda sbyar ba'i rtsad gcod dang der ma 'thus pa byung na 'di gar gnyugs pa'i btsa' ra gtong rgyu yin pas so so nas spang blang 'dzol med yong ba gyis/ go bar byed pa'i yi ge don grub ces pa sa lug hor zla bdun pa'i dkar cha'i rgyal ba gnyis pa'i tshes la dpal ri bo gru 'dzin gyi gzhal med khang chen po nas bris/ /gong ma hong de'i lung gis de'i ching kying gang zhes srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan du dbang bskur zhing chen por hor gyi rgyal khams su tā la'i bla ma badz+ra dha rar 'bod pa'i gtam/ 'dzam gling yangs pa'i skye 'gro spyi dang / bye brag chos 'khor rgyal me tog thang gi gzhi ba/ dwags po gra tshang / mnga' ris gra tshang /sgar pa gra tshang rnams kya bla ma dge skos dbu mdzad/ gnyer las 'dzin/ dka' rab 'byams/ mi tshan/dge rgan/ sne slebs mtha' dag la springs pa/ sbas yul dkar mo'i ljongs su thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dpal bzang pos thub bstan spyi dang khyad par rgyal ba gnyis pa shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi ring lugs shar phyogs rgyal khams su dar rgyas kyi ched du dri gtsang khang brtsigs/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten bzheng ba dang dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs pa thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos bstan pa bsrung ba'i lcags rir dga' tshal dbang drag rol pa'i mgon khang bzhengs pa sogs/ phyag rjes dri ma med pa deng sang gi bar gong nas gong du (103ba)'phel rgyas su yod pa'i bca' yig rnying pa rnams la gzhi byas/ lcags mo yos lo gsar du bris par ma tshang ba cher med rung dbyar chos chen mo'i dus gzhi byes phyogs mthun du 'tshog pa'i skabs kyi spang blangs chu lam zhugs yod pa'i dbang du btang nas ha cang gi zhib cha ma thebs pa dang / grwa tshang phan tshun gyi bla gra bsam yod blo gzur gnas rnams kyis lo lo bzhin rdo lag brgyud kyi nyams su len — /52

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)bzhin par gsar 'gyur gyi gleng brjod ga la byed kyang / bdud sdig can rab byung gi gzugs su bsgyur nas dge 'dun gyi dbyen byed par 'byung ba mdo sde rnams las bka' stsal ba ltar nag po'i phyogs kyis yid bskyod pa'i gra rigs bsam chung ci rigs kyis gra sa grwa tshang gi zhen du rlom pa'i pho gsar gtam 'dod sogs dgos med kyi gsar du rtsod pa dang / sngar med gsar byung gi ngos phran bur dpa' mtshan du rtsi zhing / klad chung ci rigs kyis legs so brjod pa dang / dus phyis rang bstan dbu 'phang mtho bar brten mi tshe 'byid thabs su gar 'brug sogs grub mtha' mi gcig pa'i mi/ grwa sa grwa tshang du rku thabs su zhugs pa mang zhing lhag tu bon dang dwags po bshad sgrub gling sogs su grub mtha' gzhan gyis rgyud bslad pa 'dres ches gshis/ gnas skabs bstan chen yin khul la kun slong ngan pa yid la brnags te bde skyid phung la re ba'i bsam sbyor sna tshogs rgyun ldan mnyam tshogs dgos na mi yong ba'i nges pa mi 'dug na'ang dbyar zhal zhes snga ma'i dbang du btang ba'i hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la 'byor ba'i bco lnga la gso sbyong / bcu drug la dbyar zhal gyis bzhes pa nas bzung / bdun pa'i dgag dbye'i bar dang / de rjes smon lam nyer bdun (104na)po grub nas so sor gyes shing / zla ba gnyis ma longs tsam las 'du 'god lhan cig par mi dgos pas dbus gtsang gi sa dge'i chos sde chen po tshor grwa gtsang du ma rgyun du mnyam 'tshog dgos par yang bsgrigs kun spyod sogs chu babs las dran gsar skyes kyi gleng brjod mi yong bar zla ba phyed gnyis kyi ring la sgo gsum bag yangs kyi rnam 'gyur ston pa gzhan dag la/ dbyar tsha ba'i tshod du 'dug cing khyad par dus gzhan dang mi 'dra bar dbyar gnas ral ba sogs kyi nyen shin tu che ba 'dug pas dge 'dun rnams thugs mthun zhing 'chad nyan 'phel ba zhig dgos gal che ba nas/ chos rje legs bshad gling ba byams pa chos mchog yan gyi srol rgyun thog sngas pas rgyus mnga' che ba mi 'dug rung / rdzing phyi mkhan po rin chen blo gros tshun dran pa mang bas zhib mor dpyad de spang blang 'dzol med du bkod pa la/ dgon pa'i rigs gang du yang gzhi gcig la grwa tshang gnyis tshun gyis byes pa'i rigs 'du mkhan — 153

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)yod phyin/ gzhi ba la ma dang byes pa la bu'i tha snyad byed pa srol lam yin gshis 'dir yang mchod rten yas sbom du ma song ba'i mgo 'og lus 'chud dgos pa/ tshogs chen du 'du 'god gang mdzad gzhi ba'i rgyun sgrigs kyi rjes su 'brang ba skabs su bab cing / de yang dbyar chos kyi ring bla ma gzhan 'tshog srol med 'dug cing / gdong gral gyi 'gor legs bshad gling mkhan pos khri mnan pa'i gdong gral g.yas kyi 'gor gzhi ba'i dbu mdzad/ g.yon gral gyi 'gor gzhi ba'i dge slong ba/ sum gyi 'og tu dwags grwa tshang / mnga' ris grwa tshang / sgar grwa tshang gsum gyi dbu mdzad/ de (104ba)phyin gdong gral gnyis su gzhi pa/ rtsa gral g.yas mnga' ris grwa tshang / rtsa gral g.yon drugs po gra tshang /gdong gral gnyis su/ ma shong ba'i gzhi ba dang sgar grwa tshang phan tshun gang 'dod la mnyam bsres byed/gzhi ba'i dbu mdzad kyis 'don pa gdangs 'dur gang bskul kyang tshang mas ka khyag gdung khyag las g.yas khyer g.yon khyer gyis mtshon phyin ci log mi byed/ dge skos kyi go rim gzhi ba'i rgan pa/dwags grwa tshang / gzhi ba gzhon pa/ mnga' ris grwa tshang / sgar grwa tshang rnams 'khod/ chos rje legs bshad gling pas bca' yig gi nang bzhin sngar yod gsal 'debs kyi tshul du tshogs gtam rgyas par gtong / gzhi ba'i dge skos gnyis kyis de don bzhin sgrigs gnon/ tshogs gtam gzhi ba'i dge skos gnyis kyis ma gtogs btang mi chog cing / ma khom pa'i skabs gral 'gor su yod kyis mang ja'i gnang ba zhu ba tsam byed/ tshwa ra'i gtong lugs gzhi ba'i gdong gral gnyis sngon du song rjes rtsa gral g.yon ma nas zad mtha'i bar dang / de rjes g.yas gral la gtong ba zhig bca' yig dang sngar srol la 'dug rung / chos rje rin chen blo gros tshun gdong gral gnyis song rjes/ rtsa gral g.yon de rjes g.yas su gral re mos bsnol rgyag tu byed yod 'dug pa mod snyoms shing mi legs rgyu mi 'dug pas de don sor gnas byed/ 'gyed gdong gral gnyis btang rjes/ rtsa gral g.yas phyogs sngon la gtong srol dang / bar skabs su grwa tshang gnyis kyi dge skos sho brgyab nas gtong srol dang / deng sang mnyam bzhengs kyi (105na)mi 'dra ba gsum byung 'dug pa/ da cha gdong gral gnyis btang rjes rtsa 154

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)gral g.yas/ de rjes g.yon sogs phan tshun bsnol nas gtong / brtsi ba sogs do dam dgos pa gzhi ba'i dge skos gnyis dang des ma lcogs na bla brang gnyer ba'am de'i ngo tshab kyis byed pa ma gtogs grwa tshang gsum gyi sne mo ba'i rigs kyis kha 'jug mi byed/ ja thug sogs blug nas thog mar gdong gral gnyis dang de nas rtsa gral g.yon dang g.yas su phyin pa'i gral g.yon g.yas re mos su 'gro/ ja gzhes kyang gzhi ba'i phyag bde bas bskul bar gzhan rnams kyis ram 'degs shing zhal ta ba yang gzhi bas gtso che ba byas pa'i 'debs skur zhal 'debs sogs byed pa las lag su ring mi byed/ tshogs shing kyang grwa tshogs che chung la dpags pa'i bzang 'gran las ngan khreb med pa nad pa lta bu phud/ de phyin phogs yig tu gsal ba'i ngo yod kyis len/ gzhi ba'i 'khar rnga gaṇ+ḍi dung rnams 'du khang steng nas gtong zhing / dwags grwa tshang sger gyi 'khar rnga 'du khang phyi'i skor lam nas brdung / sger tshogs kyi ja dang dus bzang chos spyod kyi ja thab chen la bskol na khror gzan pa yang 'dug pas sngar srol gzhin thab chung logs su bcos nas bskol/ gra tshang gzhan gnyis gtsug lag khang chen mor 'tshog srol mi 'dug rung / byams pa'i zhal ras lha khang lta bur theng re tsam tshogs srid pa byung na'ang 'khar rnga thog steng nas mi gtong / dam bca' la legs bshad gling dang bla brang gnyer par bsnyan gsan byed yod 'dug pa'i stabs snga phyi 'dzol ba'i srubs dbar la mi dan pa zhig yong gi yod 'dug (105ba)pa mang nyung tsam byung gis sho brgyab pa'i thob rim bzhin sngon la byed cing gral 'gor sdod/ nag khrims kyang bla brang chen mo nas gnang ba sde bas zhus byed dgos byung na ma gtogs grwa tshang khag nas sdebs zhus mi byed/ stobs kyis ma 'byud pa'i mi zhu ka med byung kyang chu skor gling smad sogs la sdod pa ma gtogs dgon 'khris su sdod sa med/ cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i skabs dbus su mkhan por khri/ de'i g.yas su dwags gra tshang / g.yon du mnga' ris grwa tshang / sgar grwa tshang bcas pa'i slob dpon bar sa gdan grum tse/ g.yon gral gyi 'gor gzhi ba'i mchod dbyangs pa gcig dbu mdzad rnams rim bzhin/ dge skos bcas go rim ma 'brugs par byed cing / phyag len — /55

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)mtha' dag rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i bka' 'bum thor bur bzhugs pa bzhin sla bcos su ma song ba byed/ legs bshad gling gdan sa ba med pa'i gsang cher mi yong zhing gal srid byung tshe de khrod dam 'di phyogs nas rdzong bda' sogs ci 'gab byed rgyun yod pas gzhung du dri ba byed mi gtong / snga phyi bar gsum srol rgyun dang dge rgyun babs 'brel sogs la zhib mor brtags nas bkod par bstan bshig kha re'i 'dod thog tu ma song bar nges pa med/ gzhi byes su 'dra zhig nas kyang dmangs ma phal cher glo kha mi gyang ba'i rgyu mtshan gling rgyu yod tshe 'di don sor gnas dgos pa'i ral gri gnam bskyur ma byed rtsis min pas btsun pa mna' mir mi btub pa khrims yig tu gsal bas/ lcags sprel rtsas ma chod 'phral snum gyis dkar g.yeng byed cing / de min tshang ma blo kha mi khengs pa rtsod gleng gi mtshan nyid yin pas gra rigs phan tshun gzur (106na)gnas rnams de tsam gyis mthus gras la dan tshe da nas bzung 'di don sor gnas ma gtogs sgrigs 'gal gsar skyes mi byed pa dang / gal srid byas pa byung na dam pa gong ma rnams kyis dam la btags pa'i srung mi spyi dang / khyad par 'dod khams dbang phyug re ma twe/ gnod sbyin beg tse lcam dral/ dpal ldan rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong g.yu sgron ma rnams kyis/ /33ring bshig byed mkhan su yin la chad pa drag po thog ltar 'bebs pa dang / rgyal khrims kyi tsa ra'ang zhu 'byor dang bstun phyir lam khegs pa yong bas so so nas nges pa gyis/ zhes sa lug mgo zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi bzang po dang por pho brang po ta la nas bris/ /rig sngags 'chang ba che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyi yi ge /rang sems ma dag pa'i 'khrul ngor snang srid lha 'drer shar ba phan gnod bar ma'i bya ba byed pa mtha' dag la springs pa/ u khi re tha'i ja'i brgyud pa er ta na ju nang 'di pa nged kyi skyabs 'og tu bcug pa yod pas khyod rnams kyis sgyu ma'i rta glang ltar med bzhin du dngangs skrag dang / de'i 'bras bu nyams su myong bar gyur ba'i gnod pa ma byed par tshe dpal stobs 'byor rgyas pa'i mthun rkyen yin yang dag sgrubs/ blang dor tshul bzhin byas par ring por mi thogs par 'khor ba mtha' can du 'gyur ba'i smon lam byed pa yin — /56

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (5)zhes lcags sprel hor zla drug pa'i yar tshes bcu gsum la dga' ldan pho brang nas bris/ / (106ba)chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa tshul 'chal sa srungs 'dul ba'i lcags kyo kun gsal me 61nga zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /su kra ta ma dhi ka ma ju ma bya rnya ka k+ṣa ta khyu tri bi na : : 6 PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROB PROBha ra na tā 0 ji na ma : lu ra 3 nyi sa mi pa ta co khya nu bya rdzi no khyu ta mu ga sa shud+dhi na ka she khushā sti ma tsho stu ma tā sto ga su mā ༷ hā ྅ pa ka:chos dbyings ngang las mtha' dbus dang bral zhing khams rgya mtsho'i gtsor gyur 'og min stug po bkod pa'i gnas/ /sum cu'i mtshan mnga' dpe byad brgyad cus nyer spras dri med dag gsal ston pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ (107na)da sha ṣa ṭa ba ya ba sla bā rdzi ra ka ༷ mā dz+nyā rla su ྅ nu ta kā ru byu ga bu t+pad lu ma hā yu na dha rma sa rā rba ṇa ga rdza ba ba ra ṇa bi nā ri ka rma sha ka tsho samā dzā : lha ye da shā snru rmi tshu kla phru ga rgyu rgya twa mā lha bo da na tu yu k+ta ka:yan lag drug cu'i gsung dbyangs rab snyan stong nyid snying rje'i snying po rang rtsal theg chen chos sgra sgrog /las nyon shes sgrib dgra tshogs zil gnon sa bcu'i 'khor la nam mkha' dus gzhan gyur min ye shes sbyar/ /gzugs pa lnga yis skye dgu'i bsod nams rgya cher spel ched ser skyar mchog sprul gar//zas gtsang sras por yongs gtams lha klu la sogs dregs ldan kun gyis bkur sti bstabs/ /gdul bya'i khams dang dbang po 'tsham pa'i bla med chos kyi 'khor lo legs bskor te/ /'phrin las rgyun mi chad pas 'gro rnams rnam 'dren sar 'khrid bu ram shing pa kye/ /thub bstan bdag po dgra bcom — /57—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)rim gtad shing rta chen po klu sgrub zhabs/ /thogs med sku mched rgyan drug mchog gnyis la sogs shes bya'i (107ba)gnas kun mkhyen/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dbang po sa lam rab brnyes grub thab brgyad cu'i tshogs/ /mdzad bzang nyi dngos brgya phrag 'od stong 'bar bas 'dzam gling rmongs mun gzhil/ /rigs gsum sgyu dra'i gar mkhan chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gzugs/ /bsil ldan skye 'gro'i rnam dkar legs byas phung po dngas shel ngos/ /yongs shar gzigs mo'i snang brnyan ding bar shin tu tshar dngar ba/ lhag bcas nyis stong bgrang bya'i gnas de slar yang ring par gyur/ mchog gsum rin chen rten dang brten pa'i sdong bu cher/ mtha' klas mang rgyud 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i phang phung rgyas/ /tshul khrims dri bsung swa la'i ljongs 'di ma la yar/ /bsgyur mdzad lo paṇa tshogs la snying nas lhag par dud/ snang ba mtha' yas zlos gar a ti sha: pad dkar 'chang dngos rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas so/ /lha chos bdun ldan mtshungs med bka' gdams pa'i/ /bshes gnyen dam pa'i tshogs rnams phyag gi yul/ /rgyal kun sprul pa gaṅgā'i klung rdul snyed/ /rnam dpyod phung po dngos gang 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /lus can srid par 'khyams pa'i skyabs gcig pu/ /mi yi zol bzung blo bzang grags pas skyongs/ /sgron bskal sangs rgyas bzhi pa shākya'i bstan/ /mngon sum rab smin lung rtogs ro bde'i zas/ /mkhas mang blo gsal yongs la 'gyed mdzad pa/ /'jam dbyangs bkra shis dpal ldan las lhag su/ /dpag dka'i legs bshad gnad gsang si rgyu'i rgyun/ /rnam dpyod hub gcig gis 'dren chos grwa cher/ /mkhas grub rim par byon dang 'byon (108na)'gyur gyi/ /mkhan brgyud tshogs rnams bsod nams bla med zhing / /thos bsam yon tan mthar phyin 'dus sde'i dpal/ /dga' ldan bshad sgrub ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /'bras dkar phyur bur spungs pa'i chos sde che'i/ /phra zhib bca' ba'i yi ge ma smad 'phrul/ /rnam dag tshul khrims chu skyes dga' ba'i tshal/ /bag med 'chol bas brdzi ba'i gnyis la thung tshogs/ shes bzhin ra bar 'jug pa'i lcags kyi kyo/ /blang dor kun gsal me long 'di na spel/ /zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pas sdun bsus te/ /de'ang bskal pa — 158

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing spyod pa rlabs po che goms par mdzad pas sgrib gnyis zad par spangs pa'i sku brnyes nas 'gro ba'i don du snang tshul ni/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pas/ shes bya'i bud shing skam po ma lus pa/ /bsregs pas zhi de rgyal rnams sna'i/sku ste/ /de tshe skye ba med cing 'gag pa med/ /sems 'gags pas te sku yi mngon sum mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ chos longs gnyis thob snga phyi med par dus mnyam du 'thob tshul/mgon po byams pas/ gang gis 'khor ba ji srid bar/ /'gro la phan pa sna tshogs dag /mnyam du mdzad pa'i sku de ni/ /thub pa'i sprul sku rgyun mi chad/ /ces dang / mngon pa kun las btus las/cig car nyen mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa spong ngo / /cig car dgra bcom pa dang de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa ltar/ chu nang gi zla ba bzhin 'gro ba'i mos (108ba)blor gang la gang 'tsham gyis dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos kyi sku 'og min gyi zhing mu mtha' dang bral bar nges pa lnga ldan gyi longs spyod rdzogs sku mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus yang dag par brgyan pa las g.yo ba med bzhin du sna tshogs pa'i sprul skur ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par thar pa yin te mdo sde rgyan las/ de ni cig car la lar sgo mang brgya nas chos kyi 'khor lo dang / la lar skye ba mi snang la lar skye ba'i spyod pa sna tshogs dang / la lar byang chub thams cad la lar de ni mya ngan 'das ston kyang / de ni gnas de las kyang rnam par g.yo mi mnga' la thams cad mdzad/ ces pa ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdzad 'phrin ston pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de'ang phyi rol na yod par theg pa 'og ma dang mu stegs kyi gzhung nas bshad cing mdo sde pa dang sems tsam pa yan/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes 'khrul rgyus bslad pa ma gtogs phyi na med par bzhed/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lor 'jig rten kun rdzob tu mos pa sna tshogs pa'i sems can rnams kyi bsam pa'i dbang gis 'jig rten khams la tshad sna tshogs pa gsungs shing / don dam pa'i bden pas 'jig rten gyi khams la tshad med de/ sems can gyi bsod nams dang sdig pa'i dbang gis 'jig rten khams la tshad sna — 159

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ni/tshogs su snang ba yin/ zhes dang / chos mngon par stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten khams su bshad theg pa chen por stong gsum bye ba phrag brgyar rab 'byams mtshams sbyor/ de nyid rim bzhin phrag brgyar longs res kyis rgyud dang bar ma'i rgyud/ gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa sprul pa sku'i zhing yin cing / zhing khams de dag thams cad rnam snang (109na)gangs can mtsho'i ba spu'i khung bu re la'ang bye ba phrag brgya/ sku'i rdul phran re la'ang de 'dra/ zhing gi rdul re la'ang de 'dra ba rnams longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing khams nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gnas pa de rnams ni la la nyon mongs pa dang / la la yongs su dag pa dang / la la kun nas nyon mongs pa med par dag pa dang / la la dag pa'i zhing yin kyang kun nas nyon mongs pa dang ldan pa/ la la spyi bo tshugs dang la la snrel zhi'i zhing dang / rgyu dbyibs rgyan dang 'gro ba'ang tha dad nyid du gnas pa'ang / ji skad du/ ji ltar me long ngos la bzhin snang ltar/ /'jig rten zhes bya phyin yod min kyang / /byes rnams ji ltar snang ba de tsam la/ /bden par zhan de so sor a thang chad/ /ces sems can so so'i bsam pas bag chags so sor bzhag pa'i las snang gi nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mthus dngos po gcig nyid che chung mdog dbyibs bzang ngan mi 'dra ba du mar mthong ba mngon sum du grub pa mngon pa gong 'og /gdags pa dran pa nyer gzhag /phal chen/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ dus 'khor sogs mdo rgyud mang po nas 'byung ba ltar yin la/ dus kyi 'khor lo longs spyod kyi gling drug dang / bdun pa las kyi sa pa 'dzam gling chen po ni/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor/ 'dzam bu gling ni chen po yi/ /dum bu bcu gnyis kyi ni dbus/ /zhes lho gling 'dzam gling chung ngu shing 'dzam bu tri shas mtshan pa/ mchog tu gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan shar phyogs na 'phags pa 'jam dbyangs kyi zhing ri bo rtse lnga/ lto phyogs na dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten dang ri bo po ta la/ nub phyogs na o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i (109ba)gsang mdzod/ byang phyogs na sham+bha la'i grong / gangs ldan mtsho ma dros pa nas chu bo bzhi 'bab pa spos dang ldan/ brag gser gyi bya skyibs/ shing su la rab brtan/ gzhan yang yul nyer bzhi dang gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis/— /60

'phags ba pa bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)dur khrod brgyad sogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams rang bzhin gyis 'du ba'i gnas dang / dus 'khor las/ 'phags yul bod li rgya nag dang / kai la sha dang gangs can cha/ zhes yul drug gis mtshon te yon tan brjod kyis mi lang ba dang ldan pa'i yul dbus ma ga dhar 'das ma 'ongs da lta ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dam par gyur pa rnams kyi nang nas khyad par snying rjes pad+ma dkar por/ sngon bskal pa chen po 'dzin pa zhes bya bar 'khor 'o sa sgyur pa'i rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud sras 'khor dang bcas pa sangs rgyas rin chen snying po lo mang po'i bar bsnyen bkur ba'i tshe rmi ltas ji ltar byung ba bzhin rgyal po srid la chags pas ngan song dang gzhan rnams byang chub thob par gsungs/ de'i tshe bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis rgyal bar/ rgyal po chen po mir gyur pa'ang rnyed par dka'/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ba rnyed par dka'/ dam pa'i chos nyan pa'ang rnyed par dka' yis/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu thugs skyed cig /ces bskul bas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa sems bskyed par zhal gyis bzhes pa sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i zhing sprul ba 'dam du bcug pas rgyal po'ang dad nas don yid la bsam par byed pa las lhas blangs te sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar zhing khams bzung zhing sems bskyed pa bram ze bye ba phrag gsum lung bstan rjes bram ze rig byed klog pa stong gi tha mar (110na)bskul bas skal pa bzang por thub pa ji tsam 'byung zhus pa'i tshe de bzhin gshes pa rin chen snying pos thub pa nyi ma stong dang bzhi 'byung bar 'gyur ro gsungs pas/ de dag gi sku tshe'i tshad dang / 'dul bya sogs ji tsam yod pa 'byung ba'i smon lam btab pas legs so'i bar song nas bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis zhing ma dag pa mi mjed gyi zhing sems can ma rungs pa mi dge ba bcu tshang bar spyod mtshams med pa lnga byed pa shin tu gdul dka' ba rnams la thugs rjes lhag par gzigs nas smon lam chen po lnga rgya'i stobs brjod pa sangs rgyas kyis shin tu bya dka'i brtson 'grus bzhir smon pa sogs la dgongs nas/ khyod ni pad+ma dkar po lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' 'o/ /gzhan ni me tog lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa' 'o/ /zhes sogs tshad bzung dang bral ba'i rnam 'dren — /61 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2re/bzhi par lung bstan pa na phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas dang mi'i skye dgu thams cad kyis mchod cing bsngags pa srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du sgrog par mdzad pa dang mthun par gzigs pa lnga dang ldan pas zas gtsang gi sras po don thams cad grub pas mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mdzad pa ni lhar bcas skye dgu mtha' dag gi phan pa dang bde ba ma lus pa 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can du bshad pa'ang / rje btsun byams pas/ gang zhig don ldan chos dang nyer 'brel zhing / /khamasagasum kun nas nyon mongs spong byed gsungs/ /zhi ba'i phan yon ston par mdzad pa gang / /de dag drang srong gsung yin ldog pa gzhan/ /zhes (110ba)dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas gdul bya'i rgyud kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i tshogs zhi ba dang / mthar mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang 'thob pa'i mchog dang / 'ga' zhig yan lag gi tshul du gsungs pa sha stag yin la/ bstan pa rin rin po che de'ang 'dul ba las/ mnyan yod gnas bcas tsam pa ka/ wa ra ṇa si yangs pa can/ /rgyal po'i khab dang drug po de/ /'di dag grong khyer chen por grags/ /zhes grong khyer de dag gis mtshon pa'i yul gyi shar du li kha ra'i shing tshang tshing can/ lhor chu klung 'dam bu can/ nub tu bram ze'i grong ka ba dang nye ba'i ka ba/ byang du u shi ri rnams kyi nang du 'khor rnam bzhi bzhugs pa chos dang sa tshigs gnyis da'ang yul dbus su bka' rnams rim par gtad cing bsdu ba rnam pa gsum dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub dang thogs med la sogs pa paṇa grub mtha' klas pas 'chad nyan gyis gtan la legs par phab ste dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos dpag tu med pa bstar nas nyin mo bzhin gsal bar mdzad/ de nyid gangs can gyi ljongs su ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul yang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ nga yi dus nas lo brgya na/ /kha ba can du mtsho bri nas/ /su la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bod 'di chus gang bar rim gyis nags tshal dang mi'i 'gro ba rnams chags tshul de'ang rgyal po bka' 'bum du thugs rje chen po dang sgrol ma'i — /62

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)rnam 'phrul spe'u dang brag srin 'dus pa las gdong dmar sha zan gyi phrug gu drug byung ba rus chen bzhi 'am mi'u gdong drug /yang na lha las phul byung gi bstod pa'i 'grel par rgyal po ru pa ti dpung bcas —las gyes pa stag tshang lo tsā bas snod bcud chags ma nyams las mched pa sogs bzhed pa (111na)mang na'ang don bur rgyal gyi yul 'dir deb dmar las byung ba ltar rgyal phran nyer lnga sogs mang dag gi mthar bka' gdams glegs bam rin po cher/ bod ni rgyal po dag la tshad mar 'dzin/ /mi dbang mdzod la bod khams bde bar skyongs/ /zhes rje gnya' khri btsan po nas rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul tho tho ri snyan shal sogs byon dang 'byon 'gyur gyi rgyal po de dag kyang /glegs bam le'u bcu dgu par/ de hril de bsgril na sngon gyi rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' de dag rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul par grags te ral pa can sogs pa gcig gnyis rigs gzhan yin gyi phal che ba ni mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par bshad cing / der ma zad/ lha'i rgyal po'i skyes rabs su/ kun tu bzang dang sgrib pa sel/ /nga bskul rgyal por bstan gyur na/ ci de nga la der mi smra/ /zhes brtse chen thugs rje dang ldan pa'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi 'dul zhing du dam pa'i chos dar ba ni/ lha mo dri ma med pas zhus pa'i mdor/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / yul dbus nas lho phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro/ /lho phyogs nas byang phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro/ /byang phyogs nas byang phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyal po 'da' dus spang skong phyag brgya pa sogs kyi char babs nas dam pa chos kyi dbu bsnyes/ de rjes gdung rabs bzhi song ba na/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ /gangs can ri yi nang gnas pa'i/ /rgyal po mi yi lha zhes (111ba)pa/ /li tsā bī rnams rigs su 'byung / / zhes chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos bod srin mo gan rkyal du gnas pa'i sa dgra gnon byed du/ mtha' 'dul/ yang 'dul/ ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang sogs mang du btab/ jo shāka rnam gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i rten rnams bzhugs su — 163

rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)gsol/ slob dpon ku sa ra dang bram ze sham ka ra sogs rgya bal gyi paṇ+ḍita spyan drangs nas/ thu mis mdo rgyud kyi chos bsgyur te bstan pa'i srol btod/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga pa rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho slob dpon pad+ma sam+bha wa sogs gdan drangs te zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang lha tshogs dang bcas pa bzhengs/ mkhan pos sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ste bstan pa'i rtsa ba bla na med pa btsugs/ lo tsā ba brgya rtsas chos mang du bsgyur nas dar rgyas su gyur/ sad na legs mjing yon gyi sras mnga' bdag khri ral gyis paṇ+ḍi ta mang du spyan drangs te gsung rab kyi don rtogs dka' zhing mi legs pa rnams skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/ log pa'i smon lam gyi mthus glang dar mas 'dul ba'i bstan pa bsgrubs shing rten dang brten pa bshig pa sogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ming cam du gyur pa'i dus sras bcas rgyal ba'i byin rlabs nus mthu rnams 'gro ba'i bsod nams su smin par brten lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes rgyal po sdig can bkrongs nas ring zhig song ba na smad nas bla chen dang stod nas pā la rnam gsum gnyis kyis 'dul bstan rin po che'i me ro spar bar mdzad/dpal ldan a ti sha zhes bya ba sngon thub pa'i dbang po'i spyan (112na)sngar byang sems bzang skyong du gyur pa/ yab za hor rgyal po dge ba dpal dang yum dpal 'od kyi sras sku 'jam zhing gsal ba 'gro ba thams cad kyi shin tu dad gus kyi spu long g.yo bar nus pa mthun snang du grub pa gzhen nu nas rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag thugs su chud cing khyad par dngos grub brnyes pa'i bla ma du mar rgyud sde bzhi'i gzhung thams cad la mkhas par sbyangs pa mdzad nas yi dam gyi lha dpag tu med pas mngon sum du rjes su bzung zhing rgyud 'bum phrag gcig dang bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa gcig gsan pas mtshon phyi nang gi grub mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'i mthar son cing 'gro ba rnams la bu gcig pa ltar dgongs pa'i thugs rje can de nyid bod chos kyi rgyal pos spyan drangs pas rkyen byas slob ma'i mchog 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sku mched gsum la sogs pa bka' gdams pa'i srol byang chub lam sgron gyis gzhi — 16)4

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)bzung ste bstan pa'i bdag po lha shākya thub pa/ bod khams kyi lha thugs rje chen po/ jo bo'i thugs dam gyi lha sgrol ma/ bdud las rgyal ba'i lha mi g.yo ba dang bzhi/ chos sde snod gsum ste lha chos bdun ldan sogs kyi sgron mes bod mun pa'i gling lta bu ches ches gsal bar mdzad pa yin la/ de nas bka' gdams gzhung par grags pa'i gzhud srong zhing gdams ngag gis brgyan pa bstan pa'i bdag po shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal zhes bya ba chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa'i spyan mnga' ba 'gro ba thams cad gyi bshes gnyen dam pa 'di nyid ni/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i bka' chems ka ba shing lo can du sbas pa mkha' 'gros bskul nas jo bo a ti shas bzhes par/ dge slong byang sems shar phyogs (112ba) sku 'khrungs pa'i/ gsang sngags 'chang zhing rnal 'byor chen po ni/ /snying po'i mtha' can skyes chen dam pa yis/ /zhal yang bsgyur cing bsnyen bkur dam pa mdzad/ /de la bsnyen bkur cher byed de dag ni/ 'phags pa'i gang zag dge sbyong sha stag go /zhes 'byung nyid / slob dpon pad+mā ka ras/ 'jam dpal sprul pa gdul bya bstan pa'i dpal//mdo sngags bstan 'dzin blo bzang grags pa 'byung / /zhing 'dir 'das nas byams pa'i drung du 'gro//zhes dang / lab sgron la zab don spyod kyi bstan pa'i 'phel grib ji ltar 'byung dris pa'i lan/ bu mo khyod kyis dris pa'i byang sems te/ /ma 'ongs bskal bzang sangs rgyas bdun pa yin/ /da lta byang chub sems dpa' snying stobs che/ /snyigs dus log spyod dar tshe bod du 'byon/ /dge slong tshul 'dzin grags pa'i mtshan yang 'dogs/ /gang gi zhing du seng ge'i nga ro zhes/ /khrims 'chal log spyod tshogs rnams zil gyis gnon/ /khrims 'chal sna tshogs yang dag khrims la sbyor/ /zhes dang / lho brag mkhan chen las kyi rdo rje sogs kyi lung bstan du gsal bar bstan pa mdo smad btsong khar yab klu 'bum dge dang yum a chos kyi sras su dge mtshan gyi rtags du ma dang bcas sku 'khrungs shing nar son pa na rdo rje gtum po dang dpal ldan a ti sha'i dag snang rgyun mar gzigs shing chos rje don grub rin chen las tshigs snga ma bzhes te mtshan blo bzang grags par gsol/ dbus phyogs la gsan — 165

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)bsam mdzad par bskul ba 'di ltar/ gzhen nu blo bzang grags pa khyod/ /sngon sbyangs dge ba'i las 'phro can/ /sngon tshe dam chos bdud rtsi'i ro/ /'thungs pa'i (113na)bag chags yod par nges /zhes pa'i gsung bzhin/ 'bri gung / bde ba can/ sa skya/ snar thang / nyang stod bzang ldan/ ngam ring /srin po ri/ gsang phu/ rtses dang / po ta la/ bye rdzing / skyor lung sogs su slob dpon yon tan rgya mtsho/gong gsum bde chen pa/ khyung lhas pa/ 'jam rin pa/ re mda' pa/ skyabs mchag pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mchan gyis mtshon par phyi nang gi gnas theg pa gsum dang gsang sngags spyi bka' sgos bka'i dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang rgyud lung man ngag spyi dang khyad par rdo rje theg pa dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos dang bcas par thos bsam sgom pas nyin mtshan dus 'da' ba mdzad par brten chos sde chen po rnams su grwa skor mdzad pas thams cad rtsod pa'i gnas dang bral zhing bu slob du gyur/ yar klung rnam rgyal du ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa kha che'i bsod snyoms pa paṇ+ḍita shākya shrī bha dra zhes gangs can ljongs kyi ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa thams cad kyi mchog gyur mkhan brgyud bka' bzhi pa tshul khrims rin chen gyis mkhan po mdzad de dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ gzhan phan gyi 'chad rtsod rtsom pa 'gran zla med cing khyad par skyid shod dga' gdong du bla ma dbu ma pa chen pos lo tsā ba mdzad de bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi chos skor ma lus pa gsan cing bsnyen sgrub la brtson pa lhur bzhes pas mngon sum du rje btsun nyid zhal gzigs pa 'di nas bzung the tshom thams cad dri ba nga la gyis shig gsungs dris pa na stong phyogs las snang phyogs gtso bor bzung dgos par bka' (113ba)stsal/ yi dam gyis bya bral mdzad par lung bstan pa'i 'khor 'jam dkar sogs dbus pa bzhi rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho sogs mdo smad pa bzhi dang 'ol dga' sogs su sgrub pa snying por bsgril ba'i tshul mdzad pas lha sngags ye shes kyi rol pa las byung ba'i bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dpa' bo srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa sku lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs te byin rlabs dngos grub rnams 'bad med du stsal zhing — 166

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wanabar gcod kyi g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpa' rtags la sogs pa thogs pa med par bsgrubs nas gsung gi snang ba rgyun chad med pa 'byung ba sogs mtha' las 'das pa'i rnam par thar pa ni bskal pa'i bar du'ang brjod par mi nus par ma zad bu slob rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho sogs la'ang lha dang bla ma mkha' 'gros gnang ba rgyun mar stsol ba yin la/ bye brag chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs ji bzhin mkhyen par dka' ba'i gnas kyang dbu ma 'jug pa las kyang / slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyi lam las ni/ /phyi rol gyur la zhi ba'i thabs med do/ /de dag kun rdzob de nyid bden las nyams/ /de la nyams pas thar pa 'grub yod min/ /zhes pa'i don phyin ci ma log par gzigs par zhal gyis 'ches tshul yang gsung las/ / khyod kyi bla med theg pa'i tshul/ /yod dang med pa'i mtha' spangs te/ /ji bzhin 'grel par lung bstan pa/ /klu sgrub gzhung lugs kun+da'i tshal/ /dri med mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /gsung rab mkha' la thogs med rgyu/ /mthar 'dzin snying gi mun pa sel/ /log smra'i rgyu skar zil mnon pa/ /dpal ldan zla ba'i legs bshad kyis/ /'od dkar (114na)'phreng bas gsal byas pa/ /bla ma'i drin gyis mthong ba'i tshe/ /bdag gis yid kyi ngal gso thob/ /ces bla ma'i yang bla mar gyur pa rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi yab mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis mkhyen brtse'i nus pa thugs la zhugs pa'i bdag rkyen phul du byung ba la brten pas 'ud po che gzhan gyis phye ba'i yon tan gyis 'gran pa'i go skabs dpag par nus pa ga la srid/ mdzad chen bzhis gtsos pa'i rnam dkar gyi dge tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu bskrun cing che ba chen po bzhi dang ldan pa'i skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i snying po bdag pas g.yin gces kyi byang chub kyi sems phyin drug bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi sogs dang lam thun mong ma yin pa gsang ba sngags kyi mtshan bcas mtshan med bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor mchog la brtan skye dgu rnams mngon mtho nges legs la bkri ba sogs kyis mdzad pa rgya chen po rna bas thos shing mig gis mthong bas rkyen byas sa steng na 'khod — 167

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag rje bla ma 'di'i rjes su zhugs pa ni gnam gyis sa bkab pa bzhin zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid 'dzin pa'i skyes chen dam pa'ang rags rim brjod na/ chos 'brel gsan pa'i bla ma dbu ma pa/ mkhan chen phyag rdor/ rje btsun re mda' pa ste gsum/tsha dbon ngag dbang grags pa/ mdo stod pa grags blo/ mdongs ston dz+nya na shrī/ dge bshes ston pa ste snga tshar bzhi/ 'jam dkar/ bzang skyong pa/ rin rgyal pa/ byang seng ba/ rtogs ldan pa/ sher gragasapa/ 'jam bkras pa/ dpal skyong pa ste 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad/ sras kyi thu bo rgyal (114ba)tshab 'dul 'dzin gnyis dang / 'jam dkar ba gsum/ gsang bdag gi lung gis zin pa'i khyad par can gyi 'khor/ nang thugs kyi sras gcig mkhas grub chos rje/ 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sras mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dpal ldan/ gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po/ rje shes rab seng ge /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa ste bzhi/ dbus gtsang bstan pa'i gsal byed chos rje dkon mchog tshul khrims sogs bcu/ g.yin don lhun gyis grub pa'i sems dpa' drug sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nang nas dgon gnas mang du bskrun pa'i skyes bu'ang du ma byung ba'i mchog tu gyur ba 'jam dbyangs bkra shis dpal ldan zhes bya ba sku tshe sngon ma paṇ+ḍita 'bar ba/ nag po spyod pa/ ra pa hu la/ rong zom chos bzang / 'bab rong pa dar ma dbang phyug /a ba dhu tī 'od zer dpal/ zhang 'brug sgra rgyal mtshan/ gnyos chen rgyal ba lha nang pa/ kun mkhyen saṃ gha bha dra sogs mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug mang por byon pa'i mthar bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i nye 'dabs bsam grub gling du gsal bar sku 'brungs shing gzhon nu nas rab tu byung ste rtses dang du bslab gnyer la byon mtshan med du 'jam dkar dang spyan ras gzigs/ klu sgrub/ zhi ba 'tsho/ srong btsan sgam po/ rje rin po ches ngo chen mdzad pa sogs yi dam gyi lhas zhal bstan/ rje rin po che yab sras/ sha mi smon lam 'od kyis bka' brgyud thag pa ma ba'i bu chen sbas ti dgra bcom pa'i gdan sa pa mkhan chen blo gsal sogs yongs 'dzin mang po las mdo sngags chos kyi bka' drin dpag tu — /68

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)med pa gsan/ khams (115na)gsum chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis mkhan po 'dul ba 'dzin pas las slob/ rgyal tshab rin po ches gsang ston/ kha skong dge 'dun nyi shu dang bcas pas dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ rje bdag nyid chen por mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob nas pu ti bdun cu 'chad pa'i dam bca' mdzad pa phyis brgya sum cu tsam bshad pas 'jam dbyangs chos rjer grags/ sne'ur bzhugs dus/ dan 'bag tu smra seng gi chos sde zhig 'dug pa nas phebs pa'i gsal snang byung ba'i tshe lha gnam the dkar pos/ khyed kyi chos sde zhig 'dir thob ngas btsun pa stong phrag lnga 'bul zer ba dang mda' nas yar byon pa'i lam bar longs spyod kyi chu yin zer ba'i rdzing dang glang chen ri'i gdong rdzing bu mang po'i 'gram na rje rin po che bzhugs nas 'di thos bsam gyi rdzing bu yin pas 'thung gsung ba sogs ltas ya mtshan pa byung ba'i rgyur brten rje rin po che'i bkas bskul te sne'u nas chos rgyal nam mkha' bzang pos mthun rkyen mdzad de legs par btab pa'i dpal ldan 'bras spungs su mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa chen po btsugs/ rje rin po ches dga' ldan chos dung khyad par can gnang ste/ dgon ma las dga' ba'i bu 'ong bar lung bstan pa bzhin ring por ma lon par dge 'dun stong phrag kha shas 'dus/ de skabs bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan po mdzad pa'i grwa grangs stong phrag lngar longs pa gnam the'i lung bstan du go gsung / lha sa smon lam gyi dus jo bo shākya mu ni'i zhal nas pu ti brgya'i tshig don gnyis ka gzung zhig pa'i bka' stsal pa ltar sher phyin stong phrag rtsa lnga pa/brgyad stong pa/ sdud pa/ mdo phran sogs bka' du ma dang / byams pa/ thogs med/ chos (115ba)skyabs/ klu sgrub/ 'phag bas pa lha/ zla grags/ dpa' bo/ zhi 'tsho/ seng bzang / legs ldan 'byed/dpal sbas/ ye shes snying po/ zhi ba lha/ jo bo rje/ thu btsun grub rje/ bde byed bdag pa/ dbyig gnyen/tsan+d+ra go mi/ phyogs glang / chos mchog /yon shāka gnyis/ kha che 'dus bzang sogs kyis mdzad pa'i dgongs 'grel brgya phrag bod mkhas pa'i bstan bcos bshad srol dang bcas pa'i zhib rgyas mdzad pa de lta bu ni sngar mthong thos su ma gyur pa phul du byung ba'i rnam par thar pa ya mtshan cing / mkhas pa — /69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)ye bzang rtse pas/ rje bla ma'i sras gcig la 'bras spungs chos rje 'di rang mkhyen pa che ba'i bsngags pa mdzad pa yin dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud don gces pa 'ga' tshogs su gsungs pas mnal lam la srin po ri'i gtsug lag khang du bud med sma ra ser po can gnyis thod pa khrag gis cung ma khengs tsam bzung bar nged kyi skye ba sngon ma gang yin dri ba mdzad pa'i lan du gnyos rgyal ba lha nang ba yin zer/khrag 'di ci yin gsungs pa sa nged mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag yin/ a tsa ma khyod dam tshig med par gsang sngags ma 'chad/ bshad tsa na mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag pho ba tsam gyi sdug bsngal yod ces gsungs pas/ de phyin nas gsang sngags nan cher zhus kyang cung zad las mi mdzad/ thugs dam dus rgyun 'khor mor skyes bu che 'bring dang / bdag pas gzhan gces kyi byang sems/ phyin drug gi spyod pa spyod ched spyod 'jug sngon du song ba'i a ra pa tsa na nyis stong / sgrol ma dkar ljang / mi g.yo ba/ spyan ras gzigs/ rnam snang mngon byang / mtshan brjod mtshar gsum re sogs (116na)bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud dang 'brel ba/ pha rgyud gsang 'dus 'phags lugs/ dgra 'jigs gshed gsum/ ma rgyud dgyes rdor/ bde mchog lo nag dril gsum sogs kyi nyams bzhes/ khyad par dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor ba yan lag drug sogs kyi ting nge 'dzin las g.yo ba med par mthil du bzhes pas bde stong dbyer med kyi rdzogs rim la dbang 'byor bas rlung 'od zer lnga pa'i kha dog gsal por gzigs pa sogs dpag par dka' ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i mthu stobs kyis myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa gtso 'khor/ traka da/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i chos skyong srung ma rnams dngos nyams su byon nas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las thogs med du bsgrub pa mdzad/ dngos rdzas rnams kyang cha gsum du mdzad pa'i/ cha gcig gi sku gsung thugs rten bzheng ba/ cha gcig gis sman sbyin/ cha gcig gis 'phral gyi yo byad dang dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog gis mtshon 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa rnams yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar mdzad de/ gsung las bshes gnyen po to ba gzhung bshad gtso bor 'don pa bzhin kho bos kyang bshad pa mang du — 170

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (5)bgyis/ dge bshes spyan sngas rten gsum bzheng ba dang / phu byung bas dkon mchog mchod pa'ang kho bos byas pas mdzad 'phrin rgya che ba'i mthus bu slob kyis kyang bstan 'gror phan thogs che ba byung gsungs pa ltar gyi kun mkhyen mus sras pa/ nyan ston shāka brtan/ snar thang rab mchog /grwa chung yon rgyam/ stag tshang lo chen shes rab rin chen sogs bgrang bar dka' ba byung ba yin la/ de'ang (116ba〉dros kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen pos/ res 'ga' rgyal la dmigs pa'i dad pa dang / /skabs 'gar shing rta chen po'i sku drin dran/ /gzhan tshe mkhas pa'i bshes la gus pa dang / /nyam chung 'gro la snying nas brtse ba dang / /bstan pa rin chen ring du gnas 'dod pa/ /'di dag phan tshun 'gran bzhin 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhes lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi dad gus spu long rab tu g.yo bas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la mchod bstod bgyis pa'i bsod nams la tshad bzung ga la mchis te/ sngon chos rgyal mya ngan med chung ngu'i dus sangs rgyas mthong bar dad nas gzugs kyis ma stogs par zla bos skur steng nas sa sbar mo gang gtor ba'i 'bras bur 'dzam bu gling du 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gran bzod pa ltar byung ba'ang slob dpon bde byed bdag pos/ sa 'di rgya mtsho chen po bzhi yis ska rags bsdams pa'i ljid kyis ni/ /lci lci ltar 'dug khyab 'jug sa gsum byin kyang stobs ldan sa 'og rgyu/ /sangs rgyas la ni rdul tsam phul bas rgyal po mya ngan med pa yis/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dpal gyi 'od zer gos can sa steng mtha' dag rgyu/ /zhes pa dang mthun par mngon pa kun las btus su/ phan yon bcu gzigs nas de bzhin gshegs pas mdor smos pa'i tshul gyis chos ston te/ rnam par bzhag sla ba dang / bshad sla ba dang / gzung sla ba dang / chos la gus pas myur du tshogs yongs su rdzogs par byed pa dang / myur du chos nyid rtogs par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas la shes nas dad pa thob pa dang / chos dang dge 'dun la shes nas dad pa thob pa dang / mthong (117na tha'i chos la bde bar gnas pa'i mchog la reg pa dang / 'bel ba'i gtam gyis gtan la 'bebs pa'i dam pa rnams kyi sems mgu bar byed de mkhas pa mkhas pa zhes — 17/ —

rgya pa dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebya bar grangs su 'gro'o/ /zhes phan yon bla na med pa bden pa'i sangs rgyas de'ang chos la brten nas rtogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khrungs pa ni/ klu sgrub kyi gtam bya rin chen 'phreng bar/ theg pa che la rab dad zhing / de las bshad par spyad pa yis/ /bla med byang chub 'thob 'gyur zhing / /bde ba kun kyang zhar la 'grub/ /ces dang tshom las/ thub rnams sdig pa chu yis mi 'byud cing / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gis mi sel la/ /nyid kyi rtogs pa'ang gzhan la spo min te/ /chos nyid bden pa bsten pas grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes don chen po de nyid tshul bzhin sgrub par byed pa dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde las tshogs gsog pa'i zhing mchog tu gyur pa stong gsum bye ba phrag brgyar btsal kyang mi rnyed de/ bya rgyud legs grub las/ grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gnas/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes 'byor ldan dad pa can rnams kyis sdig pa sbyang ba la khyad par 'phags tshul/ dper na pha rol gyi zhing la rmos khrol brgyab steng lud tshogs yongs su bkram par sa bon skyon med btab cing / chu 'chu ba sogs kyi byed pas lo tog phun sum tshogs pa la nas 'bras gro sran gyis mtshon pa'i 'bras bu smin pa rten 'brel gyi chos nyid bshad pa bzhin bsnyen bkur phu dud byas pa'i mthus 'khor ba dang (117ba)myang 'das kyi dpal zad mi shes pa 'byung ba'i gzhi dam pa dge 'dun dkon mchog tu gsungs pa theg pa chen po'i lugs kyi byed chos sangs rgyas phal po che/ rgyal ba gang dag gang zag brgyad gsungs pa/ /de dag rnams ni skyes bu zung bzhi ste/ /sbyin gnas de dag sa steng shin tu dkon/ /de dag rnams la sbyin pa dpag med 'gyur/ /ngo mtshar shin tu rmad byung dpag med de/ /dge 'dun rin chen gang zhig 'jig rten mchog /ces sbyor mthong sgom gsum la gnas pa'i byang sems re re'ang tshogs lam dge 'dun du 'jog pa dang / rgyud bla mar rig grol gyi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa sogs la bshad cing nyan thos sde pa ltar na slob pa dang mi slob pa'i lam bden du ngos 'dzin tshul yang mdzod las/ sangs rgyas dge — /72

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)'dun byed pa'i chos/ /mi slob pa dang gnyis ka dang / /zhes dang / sdom gsum du/ nyan thos rnams kyi bla ma ni/ /bzang yang gang zag /bo nar bas/ /zhes 'dul bar dge slong bzhir longs dgos pa sogs rnam grangs mang na'ang don chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bur 'bad pa chen pos slob dgos pa ni/dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pas/ rgyal ba'i sras kyis shes bya thams cad la/ /slob par gsungs phyir ji snyed mkhyen pa yi/ /ye shes rgyu ru 'gyur bas shes ldan rnams/ /byang chub don gnyer bsam pas 'di blang rigs/ /zhes spang rtogs dang ldan pa'i byang sems rnams kyis kyang rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par shin tu rings stabs kyi slob dgos na rang cag so skye rnams kyis nyin mtshan kun tu zas gos gtam sogs kyi dbang du ma song bar btsal dgos pa mdo sde (118na〉pas/ gang zhig zas dang gos kyi gtam tsam ni/ /de ni rab dang mchog ces sems ma yin/ /mi yi rnyed pa rab mchog rnyed nas ni/ /gcig la gcig gis chos kyi gtam yang bya/ /zhes rnyed par dka' zhing 'jig rten du ma dang ldan pa'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob pa'i dus 'dir snying po yang dag par smon pa'i thabs du ma'i sgo nas la jug dgos pa'i tshul mkhas pa'i gsung las/ gang phyir dge legs thams cad ni/ /rtag tu sbyin zhing 'phel 'gyur ba'i/ /thub bstan dpag bsam ljon shing gi /ngo mtshar gleng la su mi gus/ /de phyir chos kyi rgyal po'i mdun/ /'bel mchid phun tshogasa'abyung ba la/ /yid gzhung bsam mno mtha' yas pa'i/ /dpyad gsum dag pa 'di 'os so/ /zhes dad par bshad byar mkhas pa shes bya mtha' dag pa'am sde snod rnam gsum gyi tshig don la lung rig man ngag dang ldan pas the tshom gcad nus pa de'ang mdo rgyud bstan bcos dang mthun pa'i gsung rab sgra tshad dngos stobs dang mtshungs pa'i rigs pas mdo rgyud dang mi 'gal bar rjes su gdams pa'i man ngag sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa mkhas pa las brgyud/ grub thob kyis bsgoms/ paṇ+ḍi tas bshad/lo tsā bas bsgyur/ rgya gar dang bod kyi sde snod 'dzin pa thams cad la grags pa zhig dgos par dgongs pa nas/ jo bo bka' gdams pa'i gsung bgros su/ don gyi thag chod tshig nyung don kun go/— 173—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)mang thos lung bstan don gyi sa mtshams phyed/ yi/ba mtha' ma 'dris chos skad bzang la brten/ /zhes pa ltar yin cing / bar du 'chad byed la mkhas pa rjod byed kyi brda dag pa gang nas bshad (118ba)kyang 'grel chags pa/ ji tsam bshad kyang ran la 'tsham pa/ ji ltar bshad kyang 'thad pa gsum gyi ngag 'brel bas gzhan dga' bar nus pa yin te/ rgyal ba byams pas/ ngag tshig shin tu rigs pa dang / /bstan dang rnam 'byed the tshom gcod/ /lan mang byed dang ldan pa ni/ mgo smos rnam spros go rnams la/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ston pa 'di/ /'khor gsum gyis ni dag pa ste/ /zhes gzhan dring 'jog mi dgos par dbyis phyin pa mngon du gyur nas mthar kun spyod la mkhas dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ 'jam dpal dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis/ 'chad na blo yi mig 'byed la/ /brtsod na rgol pa'i klad 'gem zhing / /brtsom na bstan pa'i srol btod pa'i/ /slob dpon rang gi srog pas gces/ /thos bsam grub pa'i rgyal mtshan la/ /bslab gsum nor bu dang ldan pas/ /nyes spyod rims nad kun sel ba'i/ /rgyal mtshan 'dra ba srog pas gces/ zhes shes bya'i chos 'dul ba mngon pa mdo sde ste sde snod rin po che rnam gsum legs par sbyangs shing lam mngon rtogs tshul khrims ting nge 'dzin shes rab ste bslab pa gsum gyis rgyud yongs su phyug pa/ /thos bsam sgom gsum gyis smin par byas nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa skyes chen dam par rag lus la/ de'ang / slob dpon chos kyi tshong dpon gyis/ rgyal ba ston pa de yi dam chos dag /mdo dang chos mngon yin gsung 'dul ba ni/ /ston dang bstan bcos dngos yin de yi phyir/ /gnyis 'gyur phyag byas sangs rgyas khyod gcig bzhin/ /zhes mngon pa dang mdo sde'i sde (119na 'od kyis bstan pa'i go chod kyang ston pa'i go mi chod cing 'dul ba'i sde snod kyis gnyis ma'i go chod pa de gnyis las/ ji ltar 'di na shing rtsa gtso bo ste/ /rnam par 'phel dang kun 'dzin gnyis ma'i gzhi/ /de bzhin dam chos tshogs rnams kun gyi yang / /rgyu dang rtsa ba 'dul ba yin par gsungs/ /zhes bstan pa'i rtsa ba'am gzhi ma lung sde bzhi sogs la brten nas lhag pa tshul khrims kyi — 174

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)bslab pa rin po che nan tan byas pas gnas skabs su mngon mtho lha mi'i yang srid brgyud mar thob cing nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal te/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi byang chub gsum po gang rung 'thob nas phyir mi ldog pa'i 'bras bur lhun gyis grub pa/ sum brgya par/ /nyon mongs dgra g.yul rgyal byed tshul khrims te/ dge tshul brtul zhugs chu lon brtsig pa dang / /'chi ba'i 'tshe ba 'byin par byed pa'i thabs/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub dpal nod dbang bskur yin/ /zhes dang / nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims sdug bsngal spong / /'jig tshogs blta ba gdon gyi rtsa ba 'joms/ /dpal 'byor lha dang me tog mda' can 'joms/ /zhes yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i sum cha tshul khrims de'ang gangs g.yag gi rnga ma'i nyag ma gcig shing la thogs na ma shi bar sdod pa de bzhin du nyes byas phra mo yan chad la'ang lus srog la mi blta bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ so thar 'grel par/ /ji ltar bsil rum gangs khrod la gnas pa'i g.yag rnga ma bag yod pas bsrung ba rnga ma 'dra mjug ltar mi rkyong bar rtse mo ldang du gzar te 'gro ba de bzhin du tshul khrims 'di yang bag (119bsti(da par bsrung bar gyis shig ces pa'i tha tshig go /zhes gsungs na phan yon chen po dang ldan zhing / ma bsrungs na nyes dmigs kyang / dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdor/ la la'i tshul khrims bde ba ste/ /la la'i tshul khrams sdug bsngal yin/ /tshul khrims ldan pa bde ba ste/ /tshul khrims 'chal pa sdug bsngal yin/ /zhes dang / srog dang bral zhing shi ba ni tshe 'di nyid kyi skye ba zad par 'gyur gyi/ tshul khrims nyams shing zhig pas na skye ba 'bum phrag brgya'i bar du rigs dang bral zhing bde ba spangs te rnam par lhung ba chen po myong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes legs par bsrung dgos shing dgos dbang gi bsrung ma nus na 'chab bsam gyis gnas pa las sdom pa phul ba phan yon che ste/ de nyid las/ gang zhig bslab la mi gnas pas/ /bde gshegs rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa las/ /bslab pa mi gnas skad cig la/ /gzugs por khyim par gnas pa bzang / /zhes dang / lung rnam 'byed du/ lcags gong me lce 'bar ba dag /zos par gyur pa mchog yin gyi/ /— /75

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)tshul 'chal yang dag mi sdom pas/ /yul 'khor bsod snyoms za ba min/ /zhes bslab pa dang mi ldan pa'i gang zag gis dkor la longs spyod pa dang der ma zad khyim pas spyad kyang de dang cha 'dra ba'i nyes dmigs bzod par dka' zhing nyi ma'i snying po'i mdor/ lhun po dang ni 'dra ba'i me/ / blang bar bya ste bzod pa sla'i/ /khyim par gyur pas dge 'dun gyi/ /longs spyad par ni mi bya'o/ /zhes pa'i dge skyon phra rags thugs la 'jog dgos pa yin cing / tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ni bsam gtan shes rab gnyis 'phel zhing yun ring por gnas pa'i (120na〉lhan du rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas lan grangs mang por bsngags pa de nyid las brtsams te kun spyod rnams yongs su dag par bya ba'i dngos don gtso bor sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang bye brag kun mkhyen gnyis pa khams gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal po shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi ring lugs zhwa ser cod pan 'dzin pa'i bstan pa bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis spras pa'i gdugs dkar po gcig gis bod dang bod chen po rgya hor bal po sogs 'dzam gling yangs pa'i rgyal khams kyis mtshon pa'i khyon thams cad yongs su khengs pa'i grib bsil gyis bde zhing skyid par bkod pa nas ches cher phun sum tshogs pa nyi ma ltar yongs su grags pa chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi 'dus tshogs rnams kyis phyag tu bstar rgyu'i rim pa la/ grwa tshang bdun la ma 'dus pa'i khams tshan dang mi tshan mi yong bas thog ma nas/ dge bsnyen/ dge tshul bsnyen rdzogs rnams kyis so so'i bslab pa blangs nas chos gos rnam gsum/ zhwa ser sogs rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lugs rnams sgra ji ba'i na tshang zhing brtul zhugs la gnas pa las/ skra ring gri ring thul pa sogs pags rigs kyi gos/ 'bar zhwa glogs cha/ ske rgyan/ther gzan rgya sog gi lham/ 'jam 'gag gis mtshon pa gyon pa rnams spangs te tshul dang ldan phyin lto len pa rnams la gzan sham stod 'gag tsam las mi dgos/ dmigs brtse ma dang chab skad btang nas bzung / dung theng gsum par tshogs rnams gdong gral la mkhas gral/ g.yas kyi rtsa gral la skad gral/ gzhan mar bslab gral sogs go ma log pa'i grwa rnying yongs grags rnams gral stod/— 176

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (5) wa wa bar (120ba〉nar ba rnams gral rked/ dkor phyir 'breng mi 'bags rengs rnams gral gsham/gral rnams 'bur gyong med par mu tig bstar la brgyus pa bzhin gang legs su 'khod pa las rkang mgyogs gral mi byed cing ka ba dang zhal bar mi mnye/ mgo gos kyis ma bkab par mchil snabs 'dor pa/ gnyid dang gleng mo/ lag rtsed/ mig yengs/ kha gtums/ zhogs gcus bza' btung gi tshe hub cag gi sgra sogs spyod lam mi mdzes pa'i rigs mtha' dag la dran shes bzhin gyis zin pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dul pa'i kun spyod la gnas par byed cing / des mtshon pa'i rab byung gi blang dor gyi rim pa rnams kyang rang las bslab pa rgan pa rnams kyi ngang tshul dper bzung nas nyams su bstar/sngar lha btsun che bas rgyug tshad mdzad pa'i gtam tsam las dkor phyir 'breng mkhan gyi 'bags rengs bkag srol med kyang da cha tshang mar byas na chos grwa 'grim mkhan gyi btsun chung mi chud 'dug pas grwa pa gang yin brjod med dang 'bags rengs kyi rigs lo brgyad dang rgyug tshad mtho lnga ma longs na mi gtong / rgyun gyi tshogs yun ring thung nges pa mi 'dug kyang / 'bring por cha bzhag pa'i gdugs dkar lta bu dgos pa'i dmigs bsal byung na/ skyabs sems/ mdo sgrub/ gtor 'bul/ ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad ci rigs kyi rjes su gdugs dkar tshar gsum/ yang na sher snying gcig gam sgrol ma nyer lnga'am/ tshe gzungs nyis brgya tsam/ dus rgyun nar ma'i zhal 'don sgos kyi gang yin dor ba'i sa lam sogs sngar gyi chos spyod rnying pa gdangs dang bcas pa babs chags las g.yel chung la ma song ba'i re mos dgos rgyu yin/ tshogs kyi snga phyi ston (121na)dgun ja dang po song ba dang nam langs pa dus mtshungs snga dro'i chos grwa'i rtsis bzhag rdzogs par snye ba dang / dmigs brtse ma sogs gong bzhin gtong / snga gung gnyis kyi bar la mang ja btang na chos grwa chag che gshis ring khyad yod tshe dgongs jar rim shugs byed/ rigs grwas mtshon par tsha ra dang 'gyed sogs kyi skal len par dan 'bag phu mda' dang dga' ba gdong pa sngar srol gang yod dang / stod lung phan yul sogs kyi dgon pa nas chos sde rang gi skyid sdug then mi rnams sngar lugs gang yod la bkag cha med/ de phyin skyid sdug me — /77

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)'then pa'i grwa tshang so so'i chos gzhis par bsnyad pa'i lho len ldebs 'byar sogs dang / lta grub mi gcig pa re gnyis byung ba sngar nas 'bud bzhin pa yin pas/ dus phyis dge skos dang zhal ta dpon gyi grwa tshogs che gshis ngo ma shes pa rnam pa gcig tu mi bden pa'i nges pa mi 'dug rung rgya gar dang bal po lta bu la mi tshan khams tshan gyi tha snyad ma mchis kyang g.yin ma rgya nag dang hor sog gis mtshon tshang mar ngo mi shes pa dang gcig la gnyis brten yong ba gzhir bcas par ngan rgyab byas te btsun pa'i rtags cha lugs tsam tshang ba rtags su bkod nas thams cad tshogs pa'i 'du khang gi phyi nang mdo sbugs thams cad khengs kyin yod 'dug pa bar skor lta bur mi sna tshogs bsdad na me mi brgyag pa'i nges pa'i mi 'dug pas skyid sdug then par mi phan pa rnams gtong sa med cing / kha yod tshad kyis dkor zos pa spyin bdag gis lcogs pa'i gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin yin na ma gtogs pa'i 'jig rten nas gzhal na'ang 'brel shin tu chung ba'i ma dad mi 'dod bzhin du khral lta (121ba)bur de la 'bras bu dkar ba'ang mi 'byung bas dper na lam pa bar de ga'i grwa ba rgan pa zhig gis do dam byas pa'i ngo yod rnams gtong ba sogs so sos 'di ni 'di'o zhes ngos 'dzin byas na yin pa tshang thebs mi 'dug pas de bzhin byed/ bzhi pa phyi nang gi mang ja ma yin pa'i rigs kyi 'grul pa'i ja tshul rnams la mtshon na thog mar ja bag dgu sprad pa nas gsum gyis mang ja/ gsum gyis mdun ja/ nyung ja shing tshwa bul 'o rin rnams/ gsum gyis khams tshan gyi yong sgo dang bcas pa 'dengs pa dang / de las lhag tshe sbyin bdag rang la phar sprod/ nang ja bcu tshun la thog mar len cing gzhan la mi len/ de las mang na thog mthar len sbyin bdag 'byor pa chung ba sbag bdun las med nges la de ga 'deng sor btang ba'i bkol lugs byed pa las rtsod pa mi gtong / ja thug dga' ldan pho brang du khro rkyan gsum/ spyi khang du zangs rgyan gang / sbyin bdag la chu ban tshad ma re/ dbyar zhal bzhes gang mdzad pa 'deng tshod/ tham kha dmar nag yod par mi lnga tsam 'dengs pa'i nyir chung re las mi gtong / ja ro spungs nas 'jog pa las thab g.yog pas 'khyer na ja mi thon pa'i rkyen du 178

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wada'agyur zhing / kha zhag bsags kyang tshogs par gnod pas mi byed/ bsngo rten rnam gzhag 'gyed sbyin bdag gis gang byung las brje ba dang bzo ras mi 'don/ snyan dar/ rnam gzhag che gras/ dga' ldan pho brang / slob dpon khri thog pa dang rigs grwa lan gnyis btang ba'i zur par ngo yod/ dge skos gnyis/ dbu mdzad/ spyi sor gnyis/ dkon gnyer la rnam gzhag chung gras/ mchod khang gi sdong rasakyi rgyur bcu gnyis/ sngags khang dkon gnyer la gnyis/ lam (122na jim lha khang / kun dga' ra ba/ sman sbyin pa/ lag bde dbu mdzad/ rigs grwa ba rnams la re/ spyi sor drug /sngags pa sgrub mchod par gnyis/ rigs grwa ba dang sgrub mchod par 'gyed sogs kyi skal 'phar mi dgos/ 'gyed dang tsha ra'i skabs dge skos kyis tshogs gtam rgyun la nad pa dang mtshams pa ba ma gtogs zhal sngon du ma gyur pas skal ba blangs mi chog ces gtong srol yod rung / phyis skor stod smad ra ba stod sogs phyogs kyi grwa tshang ngam rings sogs la grwa skor dang dpe mtshams la song bar gtong bar mi 'thad par ma zad deng sang khams sogs gis mtshon yul thag ring la 'bul sdud du song ba sogs la'ang skal ba len pa'i rgya che mu med yod 'dug cing / gzhis dgon pa'i rigs nas grwa pa tshor bslab gnyer lta bur song ba la skal ba gtong ba ni tshul sgrub mchod kyis mtshon so so'i sham thabs khral sgrub dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yin 'dug /grwa pa 'di tshor de 'dra'i srol med gshis dpe mi khebs shing / sbyin bdag rnams kyis zhabs tog byed pa la'ang gnad 'dug pas gtong sa med/ dus phyis nye phyogs che zhing khams tshan dang dge rgan ci rigs kyis za sgo gtso bor bton nas mi khyams khungs med mtha' dag la bdag rkyen sprad gshis/ sbyin bdag rnams kyang ha las te mang ja dang 'gyed so so'i grwa tshang la mi bsgyur tho med yong shin yod 'dug pa/ dge 'dun spyi'i 'du sgo 'phrogs pa'i gnod tshabs shin tu che ba 'dug pa snga thog dngos gzhi sbyin bdag 'byor pa che chung la gzhigs nas lhus gang things byas pa'i dper na dga' ldan pho brang du mtho bzhi bcu/ slob dpon khri gdan zur rnams la lnga skal (122ba)rigs grwa gcig btang ba'i slob dpon rnams la nyis skal/ phyogs la song ba'i bla ma tshur yong gi — 179

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)ris la ngo skal/ dbu mdzad la lnga skal/ dge skos la drug skal/ gzhud las pa/ sman sbyin pa/ dmigs brtse ma/ chab skad pa/ dung mkhan/ gtor ma pa/ chab ril pa/ khro gnyer/ ja ma lag bde dbu mdzad/shing gnyer/ thabs g.yog pa bzhi dang tshwa tshul ba gcig sogs la skal 'phar re/ 'bags sel ba gsum la ngo skal re/ thabs g.yog pa bzhi po nas so so'i ram 'degs kyi mi gsum bzhi re sla dgos kyi yod 'dug pa mi 'khyam grub mtha' mi gtsang ba'i rigs mi 'gab pas so so'i skyes yul sogs zhib dpyad pa'i dge skos dang spyi so'i gnyer par gnang ba zhus nas bzhag par skal ba re/ spyi pa'i phyag mdzod du mtho bzhi bcu/ gnyer tshang du nyi shu rtsa gsum/ dga' ldan pho brang gi gnyer par sum skal/ spyi gnyer la nyis skal re/ phan bde legs bshad gling pa/ bde yangs pa/ sngags pa sgrub mchod pa gsum gyi gnyer pa sdad dus nyis skal/ gnas chung sku khog la bdun skal/ gsol kha brgyad la ngo skal/ dbyar gnas kyi gnyer par lnga skal/ gzhung gi drung 'khor dang nang zan/ grwa tshang gi skal ba la'ang phyogs la phar song dang tshur slebs bstun do dam pas brda sbyar nas yod med kyi dbye ba phyed pa byin/ dge 'phel ba dang dngul chu chos rdzong pa ngo yod/ mchod khang dkon gnyer gyis mtshon gnyer las pa'i rigs sku rim do dam dang grwa pa grangs bcad song nges la ngo skal re/ chos sde spyi so dang dbyar gnas pa'i shas bdag ngo yod/ blo gsal gling pa dang sgo mangs par (123na lnga zhi re/phan bde legs bshad gling pa/ bde yangs/ sngags pa sgrub mchod pa gsum gyi spyi par gsum re dang bla brang so sor skal ba re/ rgyas pa/ 'dul ba/ shag skor ba gsum gyi bla brang dang sman sbyin pa/mchod khang dkon gnyer/ rgyud stod pa'i phogs kyi do dam/ tā dben pa rnams la so sor skal ba re/ra ma rdzong dpon g.yog bdun ma gtogs gzhan ma'i brel gcod par skal ba gtong len mi byed pa gzhung dang bod pa'i rigs la yin cing khams tshan de ga'i khams par gsum skal btang na bod pa dang nye logs rnams la nyis skal/ dge 'dun spyir mi gnod pa'i ngos rta drung sogs skyid sdug la phan sgrubs che ba tshor bcu skal tsam gtang ba sogs skyid sdug lan 'jal byed srol 'dug /'byor pa yod — 18()

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)nges kyi sbyin bdag la cha bzhag na/ rang gi khams pa/ skyid sdug gcig pa'i nye logs gal che ba/bod pa rgan pa bab thob dang 'brel ba rnams la lnga skal re/ de phyin nye logs dang bod pa byings la nyis skal re/ rang gi dge rgan mi sna dang skyid sdug gcig pa'i nye logs kyi mi snar bcu skal/ nye logs byings kyi mi snar gsum skal/ rta drung sogs skyid sdug 'then mkhan la bcu skal re gtong bas mtshon rang gi khams par gsum skal lta bu chu ba btang ba'i tshe sbyin bdag gi 'byor ba dang bstun pa'i cha shas nas byed cing 'grul pa 'byor pa che ba'i rigs kyis sgo mang dang blo gsal gling slob dpon par skal ba lnga bcu man/ slob dpon gzhan ma tshor bco lnga man/ nye logs gal che ba'i slob dpon par sum cu man/ dge skos so sor bzhi bcu (123bsgon/ dbu mdzad la nyi shu man/dga' ldan pho brang dang spyi gnyer sogs sne mo ba gzhan ma rnams la bcu rer mang mtha' byas pa las lhag pa btang chog rgyu min/ spyi so'i phogs rgyag dus gzhung gi ngo tshab dang sbrel nas phogs yig dam 'byar gyi nang bzhin a di dang por chos grwa ba sogs grwa tshang khag gnyis par gzhan gyi ldebs 'byar med pa'i gzhi ba dang dge 'phel dang dngul chu chos rdzong ba sogs/ gsum par thab g.yog sogs 'bags rengs skor babs 'brel gang yod rnams la rgyag /chos grwa lo gsum tsam yang ma 'grim pa'i phyogs mi gso dpyad rtsis sogs bslab mkhan dang dbon chos mdzad lta bu'i g.yog gzhi bar bsnyad pa'i spyi so'i phogs deb tu mi skyel zhing chos grwa bar khag gtags nas lus thang zhing shes rab yod bzhin du slob gnyer mi byed par tshong khe spogs dang nas 'bun 'dzugs pa sogs mi byed/ snga thog shes rab dang shes 'dod yod pa'i rigs rnams ra ba stod du phyin pa'i bsdus tshad phul phyin bslabs nas po ti phyi ma rnams sbyong bar grwa sar log pa'i dge bshes mang rigs dang / de rigs blor med pa rnams yas chags mas chags kyi tha snyad byas pa'i bsdus ra sdogs kyi g.yeng ba skyungs te dbu phar gyi thal phreng rang la dmar 'jus byas te po ti bzhi zur bkol dang bcas pa mgo thon pa'i dge bshes re mang yong gi 'dug kyang / dus phyis grwa sa rang du bsdus tshad rnam rtog sad sod re btang ba'i rkyen — 181 —
