rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegyis g.yin la 'gro ba'i go'ang 'gags shing po ti phyi ma'i slob gnyer la cung zad gnod 'dug pas da cha bsdus ra 'os rigs ma gtogs tshad mar shes yod 'dod pa gang yin ra ba stod du 'gro gang 'dod gtong zhing / phyir (124na)log skabs kyang bkag cha med pa'i blo sbyar byed cing sngar dbu phar gnyis kyi thal phreng song rjes spyi don dang phar phyin la 'grel ṭika/ dbu mar rtsa ṭika/ 'dul mdzod rnams 'dzin grwa'i blo sbyar dang bstun nas stong rung chos sde 'di dbu phar gyi gras yin gshis zur bkol dang bcas par rtsol 'don byed/ rdo bcal du dbyar chos dang dgun chos dmigs bsal gyi sku rim la tshang ma tshogs dgos nges 'dug kyang bar skabs su tshul gnas ma byung 'dug pas da cha tshogs gtam tsha nan btang rjes slebs ma byung na gling gseb myul ba sogs byed cing / 'khar rnga chos 'chad nyan gyi slob dpon dang sgo bstun nas gtong / nyi ma ring dus chos grwar spyi chos 'jam dbyangs chos rje nas phyi ma'i bar 'chad srol 'dug pa ltar lam rim che chung / bka' gdams pha chos bu chos/chos 'byung / 'dul ba'i gleng 'bum/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i rnam thar sogs rgyun chad pa rnams kha gso blo gsal gling pa'i gzhung las pa su yin gyis gdan gung gi snga rgol phyi rgol ba sogs snyan gsan su sngar sprod pa las nye ring phyogs char ma song ba'i drang bzhag byed/ gzhung las blo gsal gling pa dang dbu mdzad sgo mangs nas byed srol 'dug pa sngar gyi lo rgyus brjod pas rkyen byas sgo mangs pas sngar lugs bzhin dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan byung rung da lta'i dbu mdzad 'di'i rjes su babs 'brel tsam 'dug kyang dus phyis phal cher blo gsal gling rang nas mang gshis khe gud che ba med pa'i bsgyur bkod mangs na dge 'dun thugs nang mi gshin pa'i rgyu kho na yin 'dug pas/ da cha grwa tshang lnga po su byung nas skad gzugs zung 'brel byung na rab de min gzugs lod min pa'i skad (124ba)bzang ba gal che bas dbyibs lta byas te bsko/ gling bsre gtong skabs dge skos kyi rngan pa blangs nas yon tan che chung la/ mi blta bar gtod pa yongs su bsgrags shing / de la 'dzem bag kyang cher ma byed pa zhig sngar nas da lta'i bar 'dug kyang / dbu phar gnyis po'i thal phreng spyi don zur bkol — 182

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)bzhi cha tshang song ba/ rnam 'grel gyi rigs lung phog pa rnams brda lan 'byor nges shes pa ma gtogs stong khrab pa'i rigs la slad nas gtad na bstan rgyun la gnod pas mi sprod cing kha btsan 'ga' re'i ngo chen gyis byed gtan byung zer ba bden na da phyin che phra sus kyang de rigs kyi ngo sgron mi byed/ so so grwa tshang la grwa ja/ bzhes thug /'phan/ dge skos gnyis la dgongs ja bu ram dang / ston mo glu bar shar na dngul srang gang la cha shas pa gtod/ bshad pa'i thog rgyug ja drug dang rigs lung la gnyis tsam las rgyag ja mang tshe lham gyon 'bud sogs kyi bya byed rang la zad nas rigs lung la shin tu gnod pas slar ja mgron wa dar sogs nang du byas chog pas mi byed/ snga thig phod khang pa dharmā bzang / gung ru ḍom+bi/ phyis su cha ba a bsam gyis mtshon pa'i snga rgol ba mang pos bsun 'byin che ba byas 'dug pa ham pa mi byed pa'i 'dzem bag la phan pa 'dug kyang / deng sang gzhan ngo bzung ba'i mdzes mtshon byed mkhan mang bar brten hor rab 'byams pa dang gung ru khams phrug phud pa sogs gu dogs skyon gyi tshang ma rta la g.yag 'dzem byung 'dug pa da cha rdo bcal gyi dam bca' po ti lnga ga nyin lnga la 'jog pa dang de skabs grwa pa thams cad tshogs dgos pas do dam dge skos kyis byed cing bgro gleng kyang nan chags gtong / lha sa smon lam gyi grwa skor (125na)byed mi la'ang po ti lnga byung na rab/de min bzhi po yod nges ma gtogs gtad pas 'thus rgyu min cing ngam rings sogs phyogs la 'gro mi rnams kyang yon tan 'bring tsam med par btang na rang phyogs kyi zhabs 'dren byung dogs pas so so'i slob dpon gyis slob gnyer med pa rnams 'gro sa med pa'i dam ra byed/ de mtshungs gsang phur 'gro mi tshor yang phar phyin gyi thal phreng song mtshams 'gro zhing bshad pa'i yun nyi ma dang / mang ja'i grangs bcad kyis mtha' brten pa'i bsgrigs ji ltar yod pa bzhin rgyag pa las khams sogs la las nyi ma gcig gnyis brgyab nas log pa'i dbang gshed kho na byas zer ba'ang da nas bzung kha grangs ma rdzogs par bshad brgyag pa las shang 'dod byed sa med/ zho ston gyi skabs nyer brgyad kyi dgongs ja nas nag khrims glod pa'i dgu gzhom gnyis la phal cher bsdad nas tshes gcig la rim — 183

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2re/gyis log cing gnyis kyi dgongs tshun ma log pa byung tshe gsum gyi zhogs nas tshogs gtam btang rjes nag khrims bsdams nas phyi rol gyi mtho brtsig /rigs gras mtshon gtad sgo rnams kyang da lta'i 'di ga bzang 'gran mu mthud tshe las sne ba byed dka' zhing ja thug kyang mang skyon gyis dge 'dun rnams kyis bzhes mi thub cing snod dpyad sogs la gzan pa las spros pa'i dgos pa gzhan mi 'dug gshis da phyin 'gyed tsha ra gtong mir gang yod nas zhu ba dang / nyin reng ja thug drug re btang ba'i zhag nyi shu rtsa gsum la mang mtha' dang nyung mtha' nyin bcu gsum gyi bar skabs dang sbyor/ grwa tshang phan tshun slob dpon par chos 'brel zhu gang 'dod la bkag cha mi byed zer ba'ang grwa tshang gcig gi grwa pas gcig gi slob dpon par brtsi bzhag (125bstan na pas thus rgyu min cing / dbang rdzas gnang lung sogs chos 'brel zhu bar rtsa ba'i grwa tshang gi slob dpon par gnang ba zhus phyin bkag cha byas chog rgyu min/ sgrigs 'gal gyi skor rtsa bzhi chang dang lnga la mthong thos dogs gsum gyi sgo nas rtsad chod pa dang / dge skos la kha lan lag len slog pa byung na gaṇ+ḍi shog thod kyi rgyang 'bud gtong zhing de las g.yin pa rmas khrag byung ba/ gri bton pa/ de ma yin pa'i lag 'thab dang 'phrog 'joms byas pa rnams gang la gang 'tsham gyi dbyibs bltas pa'i tshar gcod rjes 'dzin byed/ rdo skor/mchongs/ mig mangs/ sha ta ras mtshon cho lo'i rigs bag med kyi spyod pa yin 'dug pas dgon nang du bkag cha gang dam byed cing gling kha sogs spro seng dang 'gol sar byas chog /mda'i skor la dgos pa yod med kyi gleng brjod sna tshogs yod 'dug pa dge skos la bag 'dzem byas ngos rgyab par 'gal ba med/ khams tshan rnams mi nor sogs kyi don du 'thab 'dzings kyi dus mda' rdo sgrogs sogs kyis mtshon pa ni sngar nas byed srol 'dug kyang sog po dngos grub rgya mtshos me mda' brgyab nas klu 'bum rab 'byams pa bsad pa tsam las ma byung 'dug pas slad nas kyang me mda'i srol mi byed/ grwa sa phan tshun dang khams tshan 'thab rtsod kyis mtshon dge 'dun gyi dbyen dang bstan bshig khrims 'gal byas rigs la gte po sde tshan dang bcas par rgyal khrims kyis tsa ra skabs thob byed pa — 184

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)'dir gsal ma dgos/ gzhan ma chos sde 'di mtshan nyid kyi bshad pa gtso bor bton gshis mkhan po'i bla brang dang sngags khang ma gtogs snga thog cho ga bkang gso sogs ting shags kyis mtha' brten pa'i rol mo'i rigs dkrol ba la bkag cha yod cing / dmigs bsal (126)thengs re thengs gnyis la'ang dge skos la gnang ba zhu dgos pa zhig yin rung phyis skor sgo mangs bla brang dang chos 'khor gling sogs la bkang gso 'os med rim pas gtong ba byung song ba da cha sgo mangs su btsugs grub pa rta ma chag tsam gtang mi gsum bzhi tshun dang / bde yangs su gtos ja'i skabs dung chen gtong ba dang sman bla'i mchod rol/ chos skyong chen po'i bkang ba btsugs grub pa las slar nas gsar 'dzugs kyi rigs gzhan mi byed cing / grwa tshang gnyis nas rol mo dkrol ba'i dgongs yangs la lo re'i nang du mang ja re skol/ bar skabs nas bod mo ma gtogs sog mo'i rigs la bzhag stod sogs la'ang gnang ba sbar bkab zhu yin med 'dug kyang sbyin bdag bud med yin na gnang ba zhus pa'i bzhag re tsam dang / spyi ste ri zur dang dar 'bag gling stod man gyi dgon pa nas mthong sar srog gcod byed chog rgyu min/ gnas mjal ba'i rigs bod sog gis mtshon bud med yin phyin gnang ba zhus pa'i nyin skor las bsten skyabs mi byed/ dgon nang du skya ser dmangs kyis rta zhen nas mi 'gro zhing gyang gzhas phud rgyangs 'bod dang ku co'i sgra che ba mi bsgrag /ston dpyid zhing las sogs grwa pas byed sa med cing gzhi ba'i khrod nas sdom ldan min pa'i dkor phyir 'brang mkhan gyi gal srid byed pa shar na dge skos la gnang ba zhus pa'i skya chas sprad nas byed pa ma gtogs btsun chas kyis byas mi chog /grub mtha' 'gyur la re'i dgos dbang gis gzhan phyogs pa'i rigs ched gnyer bcug na min pa lta grub mi gcig pa'i mi dang g.yung po dang bros po'i rigs dang rkun po dang lto gos tshol thabs sogs 'jigs skyabs kyis (126ba〉smongs pa rnams grwa tshang dang khams tshan so sos thob pa rgyu mtshan du byas te ngan mtshang phyir skyel gyi phugs zhabs 'dren las spros pa'i dgos pa chung nges su 'dug pas mi bsten/ sngags pa 'di spyi pa'i grwa tshang du song ba'i ris med yin na'ang bar skabs su — 185

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)khams sog sdod mkhan byung song ba/ mtshan nyid ma nus shing rgyud stod smad kyang sgyu lus kyis ma lcogs pa rnams sngags chos phran bu re bslabs nas rang yul du log phyin tshe rting sor bod du phyin rung bka' rab 'byams pa ni mi yongs 'dug zer nas grwa tshang phan tshun gnyis kyis grwa rgyun la gnod dogs pas dge skos phyogs mi la mi bsko ba'i sa mtshams yod pa ltar sa mtshams tshun gyi grwa pa 'gro gang 'dod byas na sngags pa'i grwa rgyun yang mi 'chad cing / gal te stongs pa'i skyon byung na dus thog grangs bcad skabs sbyar lta lugs byed/ mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa nas gnas skor la rtsal 'dod byed pa blo lod kyi rgyu yin 'dug gshis chos grwa pa 'gro sa med cing / gzhi ba 'gro 'dod yod pa rnams kyang lha sa dang ra sgreng sogs rang phyogs kyi skor yul gangs can thag nye sar yod bzhin du tsā ri sogs gzhan bskor ba'ang 'brel chags 'dog ma kha bas mi byed/ bstan pa spyi dang dge lugs kyi chos spyod ma gtogs grub mtha' gzhan gyi gsol 'debs sogs chos spyod kyi rigs gling gseb tu 'don sa med cing/ dge 'dun tshor bgod rin mi chog pa'i 'gyed kyi rigs tshal par btang tshe nor mi nyen du 'gro bas bgod pa las spyi pa'i phyag mdzod du bzhag na spyi sor phan slebs che bas 'jog ston ka sogs bod rang du bsod snyoms brgyag pa ni 'dul ba'i dgongs pa dang yang mthun pas dgag mi dgos shing / rgya (127na〉〈ga khams sogs la grwa pa grwa tshang khams tshan spyi don gyi slong mo byed mi ma gtogs las sne dang spyi don dmigs bsal med par kha mthun sdebs slong mo brgyag par mi 'gro/dge ba par bkab mi byed par lha sar don gcod la yongs pa lta bur dge rgan ham pa can la las khams tshan la thob pa tsam rtags su bkod nas chas ka la rgya sdoms byed cing / gnas tshang du 'tshangs nas dngos po 'don pa sogs byung 'phros 'dug pa grwa sa chen po rnams rlabs kyis 'gro dgos gshis de rigs zhabs 'dren kho na yin 'dug pas byed sa med/ shar nub kyi chu lnga zhogs pa 'ong glang mgo mar nyi ma shar ba nas grib gso spra ba mgor ma slebs par gling gseb la re mos dang / de nas sang zhogs nyi tshod la ma slebs par shar nub kyi 'ong kha so sor sngar lugs ltar gtang / rdo bcal gyi 186

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (5)khrom la bre srang dam 'byar ma gtogs mi 'khyer zhing tshong snga ma thag ma chod par phyi mas hab thob mi byed/ rgyun ldan du bla brang tshor rta gnyis re dang mdzo mo gnyis re/ rigs grwa dang dmigs bsal la skabs dang sbyor zhing 'bul bar byung ba tshong ma byung bar zla gnyis tshun tshags byas chog spyi khang du rgyun ldan rta drug dang bzhen ma bzhi/ phyogs nas don spyod pa slebs skabs khal ma ngo yod rnams zhag lnga la mang mtha' byas pa bsdad chog / bla brang khag /khams tshan spyil po che ba sogs su zhag gcig nasagasum tshun bzhag chog cing / gling gseb tu bong bu zhag por 'jog sa med/ dge skos gnyis la rta re/ phan bde legs bshad gling gnyer par rta lnga/ bde yangs gnyer par rta gnyis dang mdzo mo gnyis/ sngags pa sgrub mchod par rta (127ba〉na cag dang mdzo mo gcig /sman sbyin pa/ sku skye dang dbon chos mdzad yin nges/ khams tshan dge rgan rnams la chos skyong gi bkas bcad pa'i so sor rta re/ mchod khang dkon gnyer la rta gcig dang mdzo mo gnyis/ dbyar gnas gnyer par rta gcig dang mdzo mo gnyis/ sngags khang dkon gnyer/ bar gnyer/ lam rim lha khang gi dkon gnyer so sor mdzo mo re/ mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab la mdzo mo lnga/ skyar po ba rdo rje dbang phyug /byings pa blo bzang chos ldan gnyis la mdzo mo re/ lha sa smon lam gyi 'gyed la smon lam rang gi las sde'i skal 'phar gang yod sngar gyi thob thang las khams tshan mi tshan gyi skal ba sogs dgon pa ltar rtsod srol med kyang re gnyis nas gu yangs kyis phran bu byas 'phros 'dug pa de 'dra byung tshe smon lam tshogs chos pas/ rgya che mu med du 'gro 'dug gshis da phyin mi byed/ dge rgan 'ga' res dbang za thag gcod ma byung ba zhe la 'tshangs nas smon lam gyi 'gyed phar bsgyur tshur bsgyur byas 'phros 'dug pa cho 'phrul gyi dus bzang la rgyal ba btsong pa kha chen po'i mdzad chen yin par ma zad 'bras spungs pa rang la 'khri bas mi 'gab/ dge skos kyis dge g.yog lag nas rngan pa bltas pa'i bsko lugs byas pa dang / de brten gyi dge g.yog rnams kyis rgyun du rgyug pa 'dom gang tsam tshags byed par 'gyed dang tsha ra'i skabs rgyug pa mchan 'og tu sbas chog pa'i thung thung khyer te gral mtshams thams cad du — /87

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2re/'tshangs nas skal theb len pa ham pa kha thal gyi za sgo las spros pa'i babs dang mi 'brel zhing gzhan gyis nya mgo non par shar tshe sgro bkur gyi rgyu yin pa shes bzhin du dge skos kyis bla re gsum re'i 'jog la khag btags (128na tonas skal theb sogs mi 'tsham pa byed 'jug gin yod 'dug pa da cha bla re'ang re mang 'dug gshis dge skos nyis 'thul gyis spyi pa'i phyag mdzod du dngul srang bcu 'jog tu phul phyin 'di lo nas dge skos kyis 'grul pa sogs la slong mo dang dge g.yog lag nas rngan pa mi len cing dge g.yog rnams kyis kyang 'gyed tsha rar skal theb dang phyogs mi'i sto len pa'i 'gyed tsha ra dngos chas 'phrog pa sogs byed sa med cing dge g.yog rnams zhwa mo ltag gcus rgyag bzhin pa yin rung sgro thab byed kyin 'dug zer ba/ dge skos dang yin khyab mnyam lta bu la ya mtshan rgyu mi 'dug pas da nas bzung zhwa mo ltag gcus dang gri ring thung rgyug pa'ang 'dom gang tsam 'khyer dgos rgyu yin/ dge bsnyen/ dge tshul/ dge slong la sogs pa rnams rang rang gi sdom pa'i ngo skal gyi spang blang phra rags bslab bya che chung tshor zhib mor blta zhing blo dman rnams kyis kyang gnas kyi slob dpon bsten pa dang bslab pa rgan pas ji ltar zer ba bzhin bslab byar nyan bsrung la 'bad pa dang /gso sbyong gi tshe yang bshag rnga sdom tshul bzhin byed/ dbyar gnas pa tshos gsang 'dus gtong gi yod 'dug pa tshang mas dbang thob pa'i nges pa mi 'dug cing bdag mdun bum gsum mtshan nyid tshang ba rdul tshon dang ras bris gang rung la brten nas btang na phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin 'dug rung mtshan nyid kyi grwa sar tshang mas cho ga shes pa'ang dka' bas jo bo bka' gdams pa'i phyag len ltar sman bla rang btang na khe che la nyen chung ba yin/ de ltar dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde bgrang ba la brjod kyis mi lang zhing rgyu dang dpe gang gis kyang bsgrub par mi nus pa rnams kyi thar pa dang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen (128ba)pa'i go 'phang mchog don du gnyer nas dang por thos byung / bar du bsam byung / tha mar sgom byung gi shes rab zab mos blang bar bya dgos na'ang thog mar gzhi rten du gyur pa shes bya thams cad la mkhas par bya ba'i phyir bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' dri ma med pa — / 0 —

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos dang bcas par 'bel gtam gyis gtan la dbab dgos pa/ rnam bshad rigs par/ chos ni shes bya lam dang ni/ /mya ngan 'das dang yid kyi yul/ /bsod nams che dang gsung rab dang / /'byung 'gyur nges dang chos lugs la'o/ /zhes chos de'ang sgra yangs pa'i dbang du byas na bcur la jug kyang gtso bor dam pa'i chos kho na yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ dam pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang des bstan pa'i chos yin pa'i phyir/ 'od ldan las/ bslab pa gsum ni rab ston cing / /phyag rgya gsum dang yang dag ldan/ /thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba/ /sangs rgyas gsung du mkhas pabs rtogs/ /ches bsgrub bya bslab pa gsum/ chos thams cad bdag med pa/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa/ zag bcas sdug bsngal te lta ba bka' btags kyi phyag rgya gsum ston cing / ngo bo thog mtha' bar gsum du dge bar bshad/ so so thar par/ sdig pa ci yang mi byed cing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhesagasungs shing / rnam bshad rigs par/ thog mar dang / bar du dang / tha ma ni tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi phung po yongs su nyams pa med pas dge ba'o/ /don bzang po ni phyin ci ma log pa'i brjod par bya ba phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /tshig 'bru bzang po ni go bar (129na)byed pas brjod par byed pa phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /ma 'dres pa ni gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /yongs su rdzogs pa ni nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi gnyen po'i phyir ro/ /yongs su dag pa ni rang gi sa pa'i nyon mongs pa las rnam par grol bas ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par grol ba'o/ /yongs su byung ba ni sa g.yin gyi nyon mongs kyi bag la nyal spangs pas rgyud rnam par grol ba'o/ /de dag dang ldan pa ni dam pa'i chos su rtogs par bya'o/ /zhes sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dam pa'i chos ni 'phags pa'i bden pa'i mdo sde la 'jug /nyon mongs pa 'dul pa la snang / rten 'brel gyi chos nyid dang mi 'gal ba zhig yin pa theg pa thun mong ba'i lugs dang theg chen lugs la tshangs spyod yon tan bzhi dang ldan dgos shing thun mong ma yin pa'i theg pa chen po ba rnams stong nyid snying rje'i snying po — /89

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)can la ngos 'dzin pa/ ji skad du/ sdug bsngal dag ni thams cad dang / /sgrib kun sel phyir dam pa'i chos/ /zhes lung rtogs gnyis su gsungs pa'i lung gi tshogs rnams yongs su bzung bas yon tan ji ltar 'byung ba'ang gsang ba lung bstan pa'i mdor/ dam chos 'dzin pa'i bsod nams ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis nan tan du/ /bskal pa bye bar brjod mdzad kyang / /tha mar phyin par 'gyur ma lags/ /zhes pa dang mthun par blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa/ /dran ldan blo gros ldan cing blo ldan 'gyur/ shes rab rgya chen kun nas ye shes ldan/ /mkhas pa bag chags bcas pa'i nyon mongs spong / /zhes gti mug sogs dug lnga'i mun tshogs bsal nas ye shes kyi snang ba chen pos khyab ste ji ltar 'dod (129ba)par skye zhing tshe rabs kun tu dran shes dang ldan pas sangs rgyas kyi zhal mngon sum du mthong bar bshad pa sogs phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab dang ldan pa bla na med pa'i gsung rab la bshad nyan gyis rjod byeng kyi tshig don mtha' dag la the tshom gyi dri ma tsam yang ma lus par mtha' legs par dpyad de rang rgyud la brjod don nyams su blangs par brten yon tan mngon du gyur pa'i rtogs pa'i chos kyang / gang zhig gang gis chags bral ba/ /bden gnyis mtshan nyid can de chos/ /chags bral nyid ni 'gog pa dang / /lam gyi bden pa bdag gis bsdus/ /zhes rgyud bla mar/ gang zhig 'dod chags bral bas 'gog bden dang gang gi 'dod chags dang bral byed lam bden 'gog bden gyi mtshan nyid de bzhin nyid la dmigs pas gang du zag nga/ dang bcas pa'i dngos po 'gags pa 'gog pa'i mtshan nyid du bshad pa de'ang slob mi slob kyi spangs pa dang lhag med kyi myang 'das dang theg chen lugs kyi chos skur 'dod/ lam bden gyis mtshan nyid zag med ye shes 'khor bcas 'gog bden thob pa'i thabs su bstan te de nyid las/ dag gsal gnyen po'i phyogs nyid kyis/ /zhes pa ltar mthong sgom mi slob lam gsum zag med dam yang na mthong sgom gnyis dang tshogs sbyor gnyis lam bden gyi 'khor du bsdu ba yin/don gyi snying po sangs rgyas gnyis pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis — /90

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wa)dge 'dun gyi khrims su bca' ba dang por mdzad par/ /rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa la/gus pa dang bstan pa rin po che la gces spras su 'dzin pa dang bstan pa phyogs re bar ma song bar rgyal ba'i dgongs pa'i gnad yongs su rdzogs pa'i lugs (130na)bzang po mi nub pa la brtson par mdzad pa rnams kyis shin tu rlabs che ba'i thugs khur bsnams nas rang yang de la gnas gzhan yang de la 'god chos mthun pa mthong na legs par bsngags pa'i sgo nas brtson pa chen po thugs la 'dogs pa zhu/ mdor na mtho dman 'bring gsum thams cad nas thugs khur rgya chen po bsnams la dge 'dun gyi spyi'i khrims su bca' ba 'dis gzhung srong bar mdzod/ rgyal ba sras dang slob pa'i tshogs bka' sdod dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang mngon par 'dod pa'i gnas 'di dag gegs med par bde blag tu 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ slob par bya ba'i gzhi phyogs re ba ma yin pa'i gnad yongs su rdzogs pa la bslab tshul phyogs re ba ma yin thos pa dang bsam pa dang / sgom pa gsum char gyi sgo nas bslab pa'i khrims su bca' ba 'di sgo thams cad nas phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /ces gsungs pa ltar bslab bya phra mo tsam la'ang spang blang tshul bzhin du bstar ba'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas spyir rnam 'dren bzhi pa rgyal ba zas gtsang gi sras po sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che dang bye brag dpal ri bo dga' ldan pa zhes zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs rgya mtsho'i gos can mtha' dag la ris su chad pa med par khyab pa'i nang tshan dpal ldan 'bras spungs phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos sde chen po 'di nyid kyi chos srid mdzad pa rnams srid mtha'i bar du mi nyams shing gong nas gong du 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir lhag bsam dri ma med pa'i smon lam mtshams sbyor ba'i ched du/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa chen pos/ dge ba cung zad (130ba tshe brtsams yang rgyal sras kyi/ /thabs mkhas smon lam mchog gis zin gyur na/ /'bras bu dman pa'ang phul du 'byung 'gyur zhing / /myur du mdzad pa'ang nam yang mi zad par/ /gsungs phyir — /91 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)dus gsum dge ba ci mchis pa/ /rlabs chen smon pa rnams kyis bsgyur ba la/ /mkhas pa su zhig rab tu brtson mi byed/ /de phyir thabs mkhas de ni 'dir bya'o/ /zhes 'das ma 'ongs da lta bar dge ba sngon byas dang byed 'gyur byed bzhin pa thams cad thabs mkhas mchog gis zin par gyur pa de nyid dus nam du'ang zad pa med pa'i rgyur bsngo ba yin te/ dang por rgya chen mang du thos pas btsal /bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par shar/ /tha mar nyin mtshan kun tu nyams su blangs/ /kun kyang bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du bsngo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /smras pa/ rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro rnams bde zhing skyid pa'i gzhir/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa nor 'dzin log rtog rgya mtsho cher/ /mi 'byin khur chen nyer blangs bshes gnyen 'dus pa'i sde'i/ /legs byas 'phrin las rus sbal stobs kyis 'degs nus shig /dung dung dad pa'i rta ljang shar ba'i mod/ /legs legs rnam dkar puṇ+ḍa ri ga'i tshal/ /gsal gsal yongs phye rgyal gsung mtha' yas don/ /mang mang sde snod skye dgu'i rgyud 'jug shog /rgyal rnams brtse ba'i thugs rje rab mnyam yang / /gangs can 'gro la mchog gyur bka' drin can/ /mnyam med blo bzang grags pa yab sras kyi/ /bshad sgrub ring lugs bla nas blang 'phel 3|ga /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi grong khyer nas/ /dar zab thags su bskrun pa'i rgyal khams bar/ /zhwa ser cod pan (131na〉chang ba'i chos srid kyis/ /yongs khyab nor 'dzin bu mo'i mngal sprums shog /gser ldan dga' ma'i khyon kun ma lus par/ /dbang sgyur lugs zung ldan pa'i pho brang che'i/ /bka' khrims gser gyi gnya' shing rab lci bas/ /'gro rnams bde skyid dpal la 'god par shog /dbul 'phong ri dwags 'phrul gyis brid min par/ /stobs 'byor longs spyod sī ta lang tsho mar/ /'dod rgur brtse ba'i dga' byed spun zla sto /deng nas sems can ma lus 'gyur bar shog /dus dgra'i dbang po myur mdzad ye shes mgon/ /rnam mang thos sras las gshin stobs 'phrog dbang / /dmag zor rgyal mo rdo rje grags ldan sogs/ /bstan srung tshogs kyis nyin mtshan mel tshe mdzod/ /ces chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi bca' yig dgos tshul — /92

'phags bal bod sogs yul grur bstsal ba'i bca' yig (wanarim par sgo mangs slob dpon pa don grub rgya mtsho/ blo gsal gling zur pa legs pa don grub/ 'dul ba pa blo bzang dga' ldan/ blo gsal gling khri pa blo bzang 'jam dpal/ shag skor ba ngag dbang don grub/ rgyal po chos lhun grub/ bde yangs pa blo bzang yon tan/ sngags pa legs bshad rgya mtsho sogs slob dpon pa/ dge skos dka' bcu blo bzang don grub dang / rab 'byams pa blo bzang ye shes/ dbu mdzad ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/ gnyer pa dka' bcu blo gros lhun grub dang / rab byams pa blo bzang rab yangs sogs kyis bskul ma yang yang byung ba sde thog 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan pas mdzad pa yang ji ltar rung rnying pa zhig 'dug pa bde zar dus bor ba'i 'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel/ sa skyong bsod (131bsgoms rab brtan/ slob dpon sangs rgyas bkra shis sogs dus de'i slob dpon pa dang grwa rgan rgyus can rnams go bstun nas mdzad pa'i bca' yig de la la spam drags pa dang / 'ga' zhig shin tu phra bas mtshon nyams su bstar bde mi bde sna tshogs 'dug pa bcas bgyid 'dun yod kyang chu gnyer lta bu'i rnam g.yeng gis dus 'das pa'i rim lus su song bar ma zad phyis skor khams tshan sogs re gnyis kyis ngan gshed la brten pa'i sgrigs spang blang rnams lo re bzhin 'gyur nas/ ma gnas gshis bgyis pa rnams kyang tshul bzhin ma byung ba'i tshe de lam du bzhag na ma 'thus pas rim 'gyangs su lus pa yin rung sprul pa'i chos skyong chen po nas rta mdzos mtha' brten pa'i bkag cha'i bcad brdar dang / nged rang la'ang myur du gyis shig pa'i bskul ma mdzad pa ltar rtsa tshig bzos par rnying pa'i spang blang rnams mchan bur bkod de brling cha gang che 'gab 'dug pa lha sa smon lam grol 'phral las sne ba rnams bos nas dngos kyi yong mi yong gi dri mol lan gnyis bgyis te phal cher gtan la phab grub na'ang bar skabs su bro 'tshal ba dang bcad rgya'i stabs 'phro lus rnams bskur ma'i dri ba byed par dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs dang rig byed pa blo bzang dbang po gnyis btang sde lan kha yar zhib dpyad cing da lta lag yod skal gtong gi tho gzhi rnams sde pa'i lag tu 'dug pa dang yang bcad de spang — 193

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)blangs 'dzol med nyams su len pa'i bca' yig tshul 'chal sa srungs 'dul ba'i lcags kyo kun gsal me long 'di ni za hor gyi ban+de sde snod gsum pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos 'phags pa'i yul du du rgya bhi zhes pa ljongs 'dir rnga chen/ tsi na'i yul du (132na tha zhin zu zhes chu pho khyi'i lo nyin mor byed pa glang gi khyim du spyod cing chu shel gyi dbang po sa gas nya ba mnyam med shākya'i rgyal pos bla med byang chub brnyes pa'i dus chen la lugs brgya'i 'dun sa 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gzhal med khang dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'chams dpon dge slong ngag dbang dkon mchog gis bgyis pa dza ( / /

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)ra༅༅/ /snyan ngag me 31nga gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /mchod brjod /༄༅/ /pra kṛ ta su sa dha ra bya ⑤ ti khya tri ga shā dza ma sharu ba sbra su dha to rna bha ṅgā ya nu ta ru shā dha rma bhā/ /bla na med pa'i gsang gsum rang bzhin gzhom med rdo rje'i khams las legs grub bgrang yas rgyal ba kun gyi dbang phyug nyin mor byed/(2na kho sa bha sa ga ga na : snyi ma rnyi ni wa rnga su khyo daya dz+nyā na ba kru sa tā ti k+ṣa ra a su sa sha rī/ /chos dbyings kun gsal ka shi mdzes dga'i bzhin ras la 'char ye shes 'od rnon 'khyog por 'phro ba'i dkyus ring 'dren byed zur mda' yis/ /(2ba)pra bha da ya pa ri dzā ga zhwa 5 nu rā ga bla rā pā shadi su 'i ya su to : gli twa pa tra su rnya sgra ni/lus can chu skyes tshogs la rjes chags brtse ba'i zhags 'od ring por rkyong bas skye dgu yongs la phan bde'i 'dab stong 'dzum rlabs can/ /(3na)tri bha wa ka ra tsa shā kya ji ṅgā na mo na ma nya dzo : mā nasnya ta ma pra ma rdi tho ni : she khya se na ༷ khri/ /mtshan gyi gzis kyang mtha' bral 'khor ba'i dgra sde'i mun tshogs ma lus — 195

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)'joms mdzad srid gsum 'dren pa shākya seng ger phyag 'tshal lo/ /(3ba)phul byung mkhyen pa'i me long gtsang mar grangs med chos kyi snang brnyan ma lus gcig car 'char ba'i rnam dpyod rtse dga'i lcags kyu yis/ /phra zhib lang tsho mngon par rgyas pa'i khengs ldan shes bya ri dwags mig can dga' bas mgrin 'khyud legs bshad dgyes dgur spyod pa las/ /zab gsal gnyis med bde chen gyis myos mtshams sprin gzhon nus lan brgyar byugs pa'i mtshan dpe'i rang gzugs bcu drug nyams kyi rnam 'gyur can/ /'dzum ldan tshems dkar chu 'dzin dbus nas blo gros char gyis skal bzang myu gu ci yang smin mdzad 'jam dpal dbyangs des bdag skyongs shig /ke la sha yi kha dog mdangs 'phrog rab dkar gzugs sku mdzes sdug cha shas yongs su gang ba'i sngon med zla ba gsar pa can/ /mtshan bzang dang 'dres smin 'byog sked phra nu 'bur mngon mtho 'jo sgeg nyams kyis srid gsum kun+da'i brtan pa 'phrog pas 'dar nyams byed/ /mchu sgros (4na/nut+pal dmar po 'dzum dbus tshangs dbyangs rkang drug rgyud mang glur len gtsug lag bye ba'i li shi'i dri bsung rab 'thul ba/ /rin chen rgyan gyi gdub sil sgra 'khrol smin legs 'bum gyi snyems pa kun 'phrog dbyangs can lha khyod mgrin par bzhugs la ngag gi 'dod pa 'jo bar mdzod/ /mkhyen yangs zla ba'i ma ma las 'ongs nyams dang 'gyur ba'i rgyud mar legs bkug 'jigs pa med par gdong lnga'i dbyangs su nyer blangs pas/ /'phags yul mkhas rlom dregs ldan gnyis 'thung khengs pa'i srog btang blo gsal ri dwags 'dar zhing 'dud phyir lag pad snying khar zum byed cing / /chos kyi gnas lugs smin legs dga' mar tshig sbyor za 'og rnam bkra'i gos bzang legs par sdud la mkhas kun gzigs mor mtshar byed pa'i/ /smra ba'i khyu mchog snyan dngags mkhan dbang daṇ+ḍi zhes grags snyan pa'i gdugs dkar srid rtser 'khor de'i legs bshad zil mngar snying gi dpyid/ /(4ba)gang zhig thos nyung 'dod pa'i zas la rnam par sred pas ngo mtshar gtam gyi rang 'od nyer bcom rmongs rtul mun khrod la 'khyams tshe/ /mes po bi shu da rma'i sor rtses rnam par 'dar ba'i tha — 196

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i phe/ dbyangs/ (wa)snyad gtsug lag nam mkha'i nor bu legs bshad snang ba'i 'od stong can/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i bdud rtsis legs bran margad gzhen nu'i kha dog la 'khu blo gros dri bzhon shing rta bdun gyis nyer drangs nas/ /gangs can 'chi med lam du rgyu bas mkhas pa'i dga' ston tshar du dngar ba'i byed por shong dpang brgyud par bcas pa phyag gi yul/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen pa'i snying po phul byung zil mngar mi yi srid pa'i nor bu'i za ma tog gang ba/ /blo ldan skal bzang 'chi med tshogs kyis longs su spyad byar 'og min zhing nas rin chen them skas las 'ongs pa/ /mkhas pa'i nga ros rgol ngan klad 'gems btsun pa'i 'od gzis thub bstan rab gsal bzang pos lus can thar par 'dren/ /dpal stug ring lugs 'dzin pa'i grags 'bar kun mkhyen bla ma btsong kha pa yi zhabs kyi pa blor phyag bgyi'o/ /sgra tshad 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser sbyangs dpyad gsum dag pa'i khams las legs grub rtsibs stong can/ /gtsug lag rin chen sna bdun sngon 'gro sde snod rgya mtsho'i yan (5na)lag rnam bzhi'i dpung pa yis/ /ris bral rgyal ba'i bstan pa gling bzhi kun la lhun gyis grub pa'i 'jig rten rnams kyi mig gcig pu/ /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor los bskor ba'i shes bya kun gzigs chos skyong bzang po rgyal gyur cig /rnam dpyod brtson pa'i gru gzings la brten mtha' klas rig gnas rgya mtsho cher bgrod pas/ /ngo mtshar legs bshad nor bu'i phreng ba snyan 'gyur tshig gi srad bur legs brgyus te/ /chad pa med par 'dzin cing sbyin mkhas mang thos tshe dbang don kun grub pa'i dpal/phyogs res tshim min shes bya kun rig grags pa don ldan bod yul paṇ+ḍi ta/ /gang gi zhal lung bdud rtsi'i thigs pa mu tig phreng ltar dkar 'jam can/ /dbyangs can thugs rje'i za ma tog dang lhan cig snying la sim pa yis/ /gnas lnga rig pa kun la dbang bsgyur phyogs las rnam rgyal rdo rje'i sde/ /gangs khrod dge dbang smon 'gro pa zhes grags snyan lha yi rnga chen ldir/ /e ma ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i rang bzhin kun gsal sgeg mo'i ske rags kyis kyang gzhal du med pa bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas rnams kun/ /ma smad mkhyen dpyod brtson pa mchog gi ka shi mdzes dga'i 'gram pa'i chang gis ba ku la yi — 197

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2re/(5ba tshe dog pa ji bzhin 'byed mdzad pas/ /swa la'i yul ljongs tha snyad man+ta ra ba'i phreng mdzes mang du thos pa'i dpag bsam yongs 'du'i 'bras bur spyod pa'i dga' ston tshogs/ /sngon byon mkhas pa'i zla med drin gyi 'phags yul paṇa chen rnam par thar pa sa 'dir 'phos la snying nas dga' bas yid rab phrogs/ /'on kyang deng dus blo gros na tshod ches cher yol bas rnam dpyod gom khyor nang don rdzu bag 'khar ba la brten blun pos gang / /mkhas par rlom zhing grags pa rnams kyang tha snyad rig pa'i bdud rtsi'i bcud ni myang ba'i ljags de g.yo bar mi mdzad thung ngur gyur/ /tshul des shong dpang brgyud pa'i bstan pa khyod nyid gcig pus 'dzin par 'os zhes dbyangs can ma des legs bshad lde mig kho bor gtad/ /de phyir mkhas dbang daṇ+ḍi'i bstan bcos 'chad pa'i kha ni lhag pa'i lha yis rnam par phye bas spobs pa'i mgrin pa cung zad bteg /phra zhib rtogs ge'i tshig don brgyad kyi lcags ris yongs bskor bzo dang gso ba gzhung lugs bye ba'i sa 'dzin dbang po yangs pa'i rtser/ /ka tsan brda sprod rin chen brtsegs pa'i khang bzang dbus su be+e da rta dang go ḍa'i lugs bzang snyan dngags 'dzam bu'i gser gyi khri/ /bra t+ta dzā ti'i sdeb sbyor 'phras bkod steng na rab 'gying go rta la sogs mngon brjod gos mdzes bha ra dha sogs zlos gar brgyan/ /dbyangs 'char rdo rje (6na྾ brgya 'dzin pa'i mchod sbyin brgya pa tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjes dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs len no kye/ /snyan 'gyur 'bum gyi rgyud mangs khrol ba'i rtser/ /nyams ldan stong gi glu dbyangs len pa yi/ / sgra 'dzin dga' bder spyod pa'i chu gter cher/ /grangs med rgyan gyi zla ba'i snang bsnyan 'char/ /yid 'ong rkang 'thung 'khrigs pa'i dga' tshal na/ /tsan+dan ljon pa g.yur du za ba la/ /ches cher bla na mngar ba'i dri bsung can/ /ser bus phyogs bcur bskul ba chos nyid yin/ /dpyid kyis bskyangs pa'i chu 'dzin lang long dbus/ /dbyar skyes rnga gsang dal gyis sgrogs pa'i tshe/ /rma bya'i sgro gshog zlum por legasabyas nas/ /zlos gar bsgyur ba rang gi ngang tshul yin/ /blo gros dbang phyogs lha yi lam yangs nas/ /lung dang rigs pa'i skya rengs ma shar bar/ /rtogs pa'i rta ljang rgyu ba'i ngang tshul rnams/ khri yi gos mi — /98

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i che/ dbyangs/ (wa)shes dam pa'i skyes bu mtshar/ /khengs pa'i gdengs can dregs pa'i phud sgra sgrog /nyes bshad dug gis thar pa'i srog 'phrog kyang / /zang zing nor gyis gzhan mgo skor byed pa'i/ /deng dus bstan 'dzin phal cher klu dbang bzhin/ /rnam thar gshang gcis nyer gos rjes 'brang gi /spre tshogs lcags kyu med pa'i glang po ltar/ /dug gsum btung bas myos de rgyal ba dang / /de sras yin na zas gtsang sras de nongs/ /mkha' (6ba8byings rtsig ngos mdzub rtse'i tshon yir gyis/ /ri mo 'char 'dod grong tshig glegs bam gyi/ /ngal ba bsten rnams chul 'chos mun khung du/ /rigs mthun blun po'i stegs la ngal sos shig /dpang ston legs bshad gur kum gzhon nu'i tshos/ grub rigs rgan pa'i ngag sgrol snag tsha dang / /bsres pa'i glegs bam bya rog bsad pa'i sha /gnag rdzis blun rgan ba lang khrod du 'grim/ /sngon byon mkhas mang drang srong a ga sta'i/ /rnam bshad bdud rtsir gyur pa'i dal 'gro'i rgyun//cung zad 'khrul pa'i rnyog pas sbags pa rnams/ /dpyad gsum dag pa'i dbyangs kyis drungs par bya/ /dus kyi shes rab lus phur chags pa'i dpyid/ /legs bshad mchu yi dbyar skyes 'dab brgya pa/ /kun dga'i mdza' ba ster phyir 'dzum pa la/ /blun po dgun gyi grang reg des ci bya/ /'di na nyams 'gyur ldan pa'i snyan tshig rgyud/ /dang po brdungs tshe grong tshig snyan ngag tu/ /rlom pa'i bcad lhug spel sogs glegs bam gyi/ /phal pa'i rdzings de skad cig nyid la 'jig /dungs dungs snying nas legs bshad 'tshol 'dod gsal gsal blo gros rnam par yangs pa'i skal bzang rnams/ /khyug khyug dbang po'i gzhu ltar rnam bkra lhang lhang snyan tshig yon tan bcu tshang daṇ+ḍi'i gzhung / /'grig 'grig tshig gi phreng bar spel nas lhod lhod mgrin pa'i lam nas len pa'i dga' ston la/ /yang yang bsam gyin spro dga'i sems kyis ling (7na〉peng dga' ba'i zlos gar bcas te dang du long / /gang zhig kho bo'i rnam dpyod la/ /blo ldan phur bu yid phrogs te/ /bcu gnyis khyim gyi shul lam der/ /rgyu ba'i zol gyis 'ongs pa bzhin/ /des na legs byas nor bu yis/ /lan brgyar bkug pa'i sgra 'dzin snod/ /snyan ngag ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin pa/ /sdugs so shes ldan rna ba nyon/ /— 199

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)ste/nga gzhi/zhes snyan 'gyur 'bum sde'i rgyud las nye bar drangs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'i glu dbyangs kyi phreng bas sngun bsus te/ skabs su gleng bar bya ba/ skal ba mchog gi bdud rtsi'i ro la longs su spyod pa'i legs byas kyi bgo skal nye bar thob pa'i rang cag rnams kyi rnam 'dren dam pa kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i rjes su nye bar zhugs te/ bla na med pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mchog gi dbyar skyes dpag bsam gsar ba'i 'bras bu la longs su spyod par 'dod pa rnams kyis rjod byed kyi tshig rnams mang du thos shing / brjod bya'i don rnams nan tan du bsam par bya ba'i gnas ni/ /rje btsun byams pas rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen pa mi 'thob ste/ /de bas gzhan dag tshar bcad rjes su bzung phyir dang / rang nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de rtson byed/ ces shes bya rig pa'i gnas che ba lngar bshad pa (7bsko/ tshig don 'brul pa zhugs pa tshar gcod pa brda' sprod dang gtan tshigs/ g.yin la phan zhing rjes su 'dzin par byed pa bzo dang gso ba/ rang nyid chos kun shes par byed pa nang don rig pa ste/ lnga po 'di ni khong du chud pa la/ 'phags pa'i yul du mahā paṇ+ḍita zhes grags shing / de dang mthun par rje btsun sa paṇ+ḍi tas/ de yul brda' sprod rtog ge dang / /'tsho ba phyi nang rig ces bya/ /gzhan las gzhan dag rnam bshad pa/ /'di yi nang du 'dus che//bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'phags mchog ci sems thams cad mkhyen pa thob mi 'gyur/ /de bas g.yin rnams zhes lo chen 'gyur med bde chen gyis 'gyur bcos mdzad pa ni legs par sems te 'phags pa mchog sangs 'phags la sbyar na smos ci dgos/ byang sems dang nyan rang gis 'phags pa'i lam mngon du gyur na yang / rig pa'i gnas lnga la legs par sbyangs pa zhig 'dod dgos te/ de —200

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i rā1 dbyangs/ (wadalta min na 'phags pa de dag blun po yin par thal ba'i skyon yong zhing / dag la rnam dbye au dang rnams la dzas ster bas/ dag gi gnyis dang rnams kyi gsum nas grangs ji tsam 'dod pa bsdu nus pas so/ /de ltar gnas lnga po de'i nang nas kyang thog mar slob bar bya ba ni/ thog mar sgra la mkhas pa yis/ /tshig don rnam par phye ste bstan/ /de nas don la mkhas pa yis/ /lhag chad 'khrul pa med par bshad/ /ces pa ltar/ sgra shes na don la mi rmongs pas rjod byed kun (8na 〉 ) gzhir bzung ba'i steng du/ snyan dngags shes na tshig rgyan la mi rmongs/ sdeb sbyor shes na tshigs bcad la mi rmongs/ mngon brjod shes na ming la mi rmongs/ zlos gar shes na skad rigs la mi rmongs shing / dpang lo/ 'jam kha/ snar thang pa/ rin spungs pa sogs kyi 'grel chen na/ sgra the ba'i rig gnas chung ba lngar bshad kyang / dpal sgang lo tsā bas skar rtsis rig gnas chung ba gcig tu 'dren pa ni/ dus 'khor gyi rtsis dang / dbyangs 'char ba'i rgyud le'u bcu pa gnyis kyis/ sngar bshad pa'i rig pa'i gnas de dag dang mi 'dra ba'i brjod bya khyad par can gzhan ston pas na 'dren par kho bo 'thad par sems shing /bdag gi slob dpon mkhas pa chen po yang de ltar bzhed do/ /lugs snga ma ltar na rig gnas bcu phrag gcig 'dren pa la dgu las mi 'byung ba'i skyon 'jug pas/ don 'di la dgongs nas lo tsā ba chen po'i gsung las skar rtsis snyan ngag sdeb sbyor dang / /mngon brjod zlos gar 'di lnga la/ /rig gnas lnga zhes 'phags yul na/ /grags pa'i ba dan rlung ltar sgrog /ces gsungs so/ /phyag rgya ba sogs gangs khrod kyi sgom chen rnams kyis/ tha snyad rig pa 'di rnams phyi rol pas kyang thos bsam du bya bas na snying po med do snyam na/ khyod rang rnams kyis nyams su len pa'i phyag rgya chen po de'i (8ba〉〉ga mthong gi rten gzhir gyur pa'i zhi gnas de la goms pa'i phyi rol pa ji snyed cig 'byung bas/ khyod rang rnams kyi zhi gnas de yang spang byar mi 'gyur ram/ nged kyi zhi gnas la skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed sogs kyi khyad par yod do zhes smra na/ nged —201 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2rje/cag tha snyad mkhan po rnams kyi tha snyad rig pa la'ang theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed kyi rtsis zin pa'i bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gro'o zhes smra na ci skad zer/ 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen pos/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyis thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam bstan par bzhed pa la/stag tsang lo tsā bas/ rig gnas kun shes rtsa 'grel du dgag pa mdzad pa ni/ lo tsā ba mkhas pa chen po yin pas dgos pa can gyi gsung yin mchi/ de ltar min na/ sa paṇa gyis/ chos kyi grags pa'i gsung rab dri ma med/ /ces 'gyur byang du mdzad pas/ gsung rab yin phyin sde snod dang / de'i dgongs 'grel gang rung las ma 'das shing / de gang rung yin phyin thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam brjod byar mi byed pa mi srid pas don med kyi dgag pa mi mdzad pa zhu/ gzhan yang dpang los/ mngon pa la lung gi mngon pa dang / rigs pa'i mngon pa gnyis su bzhed pas kyang / rje bla ma'i dgongs pa'i rgyab bskyor du 'gro'o/ /dwags rgyud pa ci rigs kyis stag tshang pa'i gsung de dag la brten nas/ (9na)rje bla ma la zur za bar 'dod pa'i tshig sbyor ba byed pa ni/ sa dge'i mkhas pa lung rigs kyi lus stobs rdzogs pa'i stag seng kha 'thab pa'i bar du bka' brgyud pa'i sgom chen wa skyes lta bu dag rgyu ba ni shin tu 'tshang che bas bag yod par byos sheg /de yang tha snyad rig pa lnga'i nang nas thog mar gang la slob ce na/ zur mkhar blo gros rgyal pos/ rgyal po lang tshos dregs gyur kyang / /rgyan med pa na skye bos gleng //de bzhin snyan ngag mi ldan pa'i/ /bstan bcos mkhas la rtsis su med/ /ces pa ltar/ /tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i snyan ngag dang mi ldan pa'i grong tshig tsam la brten nas don bzang po yod par rlom pa ni/ lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing mdzes pa'i skyes bu zhig rgyan gos dang bral te gcer bur rgyu ba na 'jig rten na 'phya smod byed pa ltar/ tshig rnam par nyams pa'i bstan bcos la mkhas pa rnams kyis brnyas par mdzad pas na/ blo ldan dga' ba'i rtse dga' khong nas rgod pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos 'di nyid la 'jug rigs te/ rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ mkhas pa nyid ni med —202

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)na blo gros rnam nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod min/ /mtshungs med rgyas pa'i snyan ngag med na mkhas pa nyid ni ne'u sdu'i klog dang mtshungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar rjod byed kyi tshig (9bskong zhing / brjod bya'i don phun sum tshogs pa'i daṇ+ḍi'i bstan bcos me long ma 'di nyid mkhas pa'i bshad srol ches mang ba la yang / skabs 'gar cung zad 'khrul pa'i lam du 'phyan pa'ang srid pas/ de dag la dpyad pa gsum gyi sgo nas dag par byas pa'i legs par bshad pa'i glu dbyangs len pa la 'jug pas/ de yang kho bo'i slob dpon mkhas pa chen po smon 'gro lo tsā ba yab sras kyi phyag len du/ 'gyur rnam grangs snga phyi mang bar 'dug kyang blo brtan bzhi pa'i 'gyur nyid bde bas gtso bor mdzad/ dpang lo'i 'grel pa la tshad thub kyi gzhin bzung / rin spungs pa'i 'grel pa phal cher la brten/ 'jam kha/ snar thang pa sogs mkhas pa mang po'i legs bshad kyis zur brgyan/'on kyang 'grel pa gong ma de dag gi brjod bya kho na la brten pa tsam ma yin par/ shong los rgya gar paṇa chen la gsan pa nas gzung / thams cad mkhyen pa chos skyong bzang po sogs mkhas pa rnams rim par brgyud pa'i bshad srol thun mong ma yin pa nyid rang lugs kyi snying por mdzad pas/ 'dir yang gsung sgros dri ma med pa'i legs bshad ltar bri bar bya'o/ /mtshan don dang 'gyur phyag sogs bshad pa/'di la bzhi/ mtshan gyi don/ 'gyur gyi phyag /gzhung gi don/ mjug gi don no/ /dang po ni/bstan bcos 'di'i mtshan la rgya gar du skad rigs bzhi yod pa'i legs (10na)sbyar lha'i skad du/ka bī a dar+sha:ste de bod skad du bsgyur na/ ka bi ni snyan dngags/ /ā dar+shaḥni me long / de gnyis mtshams sbyar ba'o/ /yang na ā ni kun dang / dar+shaḥni mthong ba ste/ tshig 'gyur byas na'ang 'grig ste/bstan bcos kyi me long du snyan ngag gi lus srog rgyan gsum 'char ba dang / bstan bcos 'dir sngon —2()3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)byung gi snyan ngag gi brjod bya kun mthong bar bshad pa'i tshul gnyis ka legs pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'jam dpal dbyangs shong ston lo tsā ba sogs kyis/ 'gyur mthar phyin pa dang bsod nams spel pa'i slad du/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bkod do/ /gsum pa la/ bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i sgo/ brtsams pa'i dgos sogs/ dgos pa de ldan gyi bstan bcos dngos bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la shis brjod dang / rtsom par dam bca' gnyis/ dang po ni/ slob dpon daṇ+ḍi sa/ mchod par brjod pa'i yul ni dbyangs can ma yin la/mchod par brjod tshul la thun mong dang thun mong min pa gnyis las/ dang po ltar na mi mjed kyi bdag po changs pa de la gdong bzhi las/ mchod sbyin/ srid srung / nges brjod/ snyan tshig ste rig byed bzhi byung ba'i snyan tshig byung ba'i gdong de pad tshal dang sbyar/ dang po ni/ 'chi med mdzod kyi 'grel pa 'dod 'jor/ dri za'i ming du bshad pas dri (10ba)za'i bu mo'am/ yang na dngos bstan gyi 'dab chags ngang pa'i bu mo lta bur lus thams cad shin tu dkar zhing yid du 'ong ba'i dbyangs can ma ni zhes so/ /snyan tshig gi rig byed 'byung ba'i gdong dang sbyar ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / tshangs pa chu klung gi gzugs su 'jig rten du babs pa 'dzam gling gi lho phyogs su tshangs pa'i mtsho zhes 'khyil pa la/ su ra swa sti zhes pa'i sgra byung ba dbyangs sam/ dbyangs can zhes par 'gyur la/ mo rtags kyi rkyen ma byin pas dbyangs can zhes pa ni snyan ngag gi rig byed la yang 'jug pa dang / dbyangs can ma nyid snyan dngags kyi lhag pa'i lha yin pa sogs kyis/ tshig snga phyi thams cad sgrub byed kyis 'brel pa yin no/ /dbyangs can mas phyi rol pa rnams rjes su bzung ba'i phyir du tshangs pa'i bu mor sprul pa ni/ bram ze shang kus/ thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pha rol rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ /tshangs pa'i bu mo mdzes ma khyod sku gsal ba'i rnam 'gyur can/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang du byas na/ rgya dper/ mu kha zhes pa/ gdong / zhal/ sgo rnams—2//4

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)la 'jug pas/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi tshad med pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i zhal gyi sgo'i mche ba las 'khrungs te/ bram ze shang kus spyan ras gzigs dbang zhal gyi mche ba'i rtse las mngon 'khrungs shing / /tshangs pa'i bu mo mdzes ma khyod sku gsal ba'i rnam 'phrul can/ /zhes bshad pas/ /'jig rten (11na〉dbang phyug gi sras mo/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dang dgyes dgur spyod pa'i yum dbyangs can lha mo khyod ni/ dbyugs pa can kho bo'i yid de snying gi dbus su yun ring du gnas pa ste bzhugs nas/ ngag gi dngos grub stsol bar mdzod cig ces brjod pa'o/ /de yang rgyan gyi dbang du byas na/sh+lauka gcig po 'di gzugs can gyi sbyar ba yin pas/ le'u gnyis par gzugs can gyi sbyar ba la/don sbyar ba dang sgra sbyar ba gnyis yod pas/ 'dir yang gnyis kyi don sbyar ba ni/ mngon brjod sna tshogs gsal ba dang / 'dod 'jo sogs las ngang pa dri za'i ming gi rnam grangs su bshad pas ngang pa ste/ dri za'i bu mo dbyangs can ma nyid 'dab chags ngang pa'i bu mo mgrin pa'i dbyangs can ma sbyar ba grub bo/ /sgra sbyar ba ni/ yid la ring du rol bar mdzod// ces mā na se zhes pa yid nyid dang mtsho'i khyad par la sbyar bas/ lha mo la ltos na yid la dang / ngang mo la ltos na mtsho la ste/ dus ring du rol ba ste bdag la brtse bar mdzod ces mkhas pa grangs can lo tsā ba gsung ngo / /dpa' bo gtsug lag gis/ me long mchan gyis gsal ba der/ nang ltar du dbyangs can ma mdun bskyed dang / gsang ba ltar du bdag bskyed du sbyar ba'i bshad srol mdzad 'dug pa/ spyir yang rnam rtog chos sku dang / gcig shes kun grol dang / (11ba tshe dkar po gcig thub sogs mkhas pa la ma grags pa'i gtam kham po che re/ gsung rab gang gi skabs su yang mdzad pa 'di khyed rang bka' rgyud pa rnams kyi phyag srol du 'dug pas/ snyan ngag phyi nang thun mong ba'i rig byed kyi bstan bcos la/ lo paṇa rnams la thugs rgyus ma mchis pa'i bdag mdun sogs gsang sngags kyi tha snyad mdzad pa legs 'dug cing / slad nas kyang don rgyan gyi dbang dang / sgra rgyan gyi rjes gnang gab tshig gi rgyan gyi sems ngo sprod pa sogs mdzad na phyag rgya chen po ba'i bstan pa la mdzes par 'gyur/ /gnyis pa ni/—2(15

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)drang srong rgyas pa'i bha ra ta dang / me gzhan 'jug gi bu mo'i sgom pa'i chos/ grogs mkhar gyi rā ma ya na/ mā rkaṇ+ḍi ya'i sngon rabs kyi chos/ nag mo'i khol bo'i gzhen nu 'byung ba dang / rā ma sha me sogs kyis mdzad pa'i snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos snga ma tshig tshogs ches mang ba rnams nyung ngur bsdus shing / de dag gi legs pa'i tshig gi sbyor ba dper brjod pa rnams kyang nye bar mtshon par byas pa'i steng du/ bha ra ta'i sbyar ba sogs yon tan bcu po yang bsnan te/ snyan ngag rnams kyi lus rgyan gyi mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa zhig daṇ+ḍi bdag gis ni blo gros kyis ji ltar nus pa bzhin bshad par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa brtsams pa'i dgos sogs la/ brtsams pa'i (12na)yon tan/ ma brtsams pa'i skyon/ brtsams pa de ring du gnas pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rtsom byed mkhas rmongs kyi khyad par rtsom pa'i skyon spong thabs/ bstan bcos mi shes pa'i skyon/ mkhas pas legs par dbye ba dang bdun las/dang po ni/ sngon gyi slob dpon mkhas pa mchog rnams kyis rjes su bstan pa yi brjod bya sde bzhir bsdus nas bstan bcos kyi tshig rnams nyid kyi drin gyi mthus/ 'jig rten 'di na dus rnam pa kun tu snyan dngags la mkhas 'dod kyi skyes bu mchog blo gsal rnams kyi blang dor gyi mig phye bas kyang 'jig rten gyi lugs kyi sde bzhi'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa la 'jug par byed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ sgra don phyin ci ma log pa'i snyan dngags kyi snang ba 'di ni/ gal te 'khor ba ji srid pa'i bar du mi gsal na/ lha mi klu'i 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag 'di/ mi shes pa'i smag rum mun pa nyid kyis khebs par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni/ sngon gyi rgyal po nga las nu la sogs pa rnams kyi dpa' 'dzangs btul phod pa'i grags pa'i gzugs brnyan ngag gi rang bzhin las grub pa'i gtam rgyud kyi me long gi nang du thob pa ste deng sang gi bar du shar ba na/ da lta rgyal po de dag nye bar mi gnas kyang / rang nyid dngos su gnas pa lta bu'i snyan grags nyams pa med pa la ltos zhes sgrub byed dngos su (12ba tha kod nas/ shugs la bsgrub bya ma 'ongs pa na bstan bcos rtsom pa po rang —206

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i phe1 dbyangs/ (wa)nyid mi gnas kyang / brtsams pa'i bstan bcos kyi brjod bya phun sum tshogs pas/ rtsom pa po'i mkhas pa'i grags pa mi nyams par gnas zhes pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ snyan dngags la sbyangs shing khong du chud pa'i mkhas pas yang dag par rab tu sbyar ba'i snyan ngag ni/ tshig don bzang po 'dzad med du 'byung bas ngag gi 'dod pa 'jo bar bshad la/ de nyid las bzlog ste nyes par sbyar na bstan bcos de 'dor bar ma zad slar sbyor ba po'i gang zag ba lang dang 'dra ba nyid du rjod par byed do/ /dpa' bo gtsug lag pas/ rang gis rang la ba lang du brjod pa'i 'bru gnon pa ni/ bstan bcos 'di'i tshig dang mi 'brel bar 'dug pas/ khyed rang gi shangs la mdzub mo 'dzugs rgyu yin nam/ lnga pa ni/ de phyir snyan dngags kyi sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa dag la skyon chung ngu tsam tshogs par gyur kyang / ji zhig ltar/ 'di ni shin tu phra bas skyon med do zhes btang snyoms su bzhag par mi bya ste/ dper na/ skyes bu'i lus shin tu mdzes pa zhig yod kyang / mig gi blta lugs la cung zad skyon chags pa'am/ yan lag la rmen pa phra mo tsam gyis mtshon pa'i skyon chung ngu gcig gis ni/ gzugs byad de nyid skal pa ngan par 'gyur ro/ /dpa' bo gtsug lag mig nyams par 'bru gnyer na/ mig zhan ba lta bu (13na)las 'os med cing / de 'dra'i gang zag de mdzes par kun la ma grags pas/ khyad gzhi med pa'i khyad chos so/ /drug pa ni/ skye bo snyan dngags kyi bstan bcos la ma shi sbyangasang mi shes pas ni snyan dngags kyi yon tan dang skyon dag 'di'o zhes ji ltar dbye ste dbye mi nus te/ gzugs kyi kha dog dang dbyibs sogs kyi dbye ba dmigs pa'i skabs/ long ba dag la de'i rgyu mtshan 'chad rgyu yod dam ci ste med do/ /bdun pa ni/ sngon gyi mkhas pas skye dgu blo ldan rnams la legs nyes kyi bye brag rtogs pa la mngon par dgongs nas/ sgra don gyis rnam par bkra ba'i lam dang ldan pa'i snyan tshig gis ni rim pa shes par byed pa'i bya ba'i cho ga ste/ rtsom pa'i thabs la nges par sbyar te/ snyan dngags kyi skyon yon shes pa bstan bcos rnam dag la rag lus pa de'i phyir/—207

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)dgos pa de ldan gyi bstan bcos dngos las snyan ngag gi lus kyi mtshan nyid sogs bshad pa/gsum pa dgos pa de ldan gyi bstan bcos dngos bshad pa la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i snyan dngags 'di ni/ sngon gyi slob dpon de rnams kyis ni/snyan dngags kyi lus dang / de'i rgyan gyi mtshan nyid kyang rab tu bstan pa ltar bshad do/ /gnyis pa la/ lus dang / rgyan dang / skyon sel ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid dbye ba/skad rigs bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni snyan dngags kyi lus ni/ re zhig rtsom pa pos (13ba)brjod par 'dod pa yi don snyan dngags rang lugs ltar gyi rnam par dpyad pa'i ming tshig yi ge gsum gyi bdag nyid kyi phreng bar spel ba'o/ /gnyis pa la mdor bstan pa dang rgyas par bshad pa gnyis kyis/ dang po ni/ snyan dngags kyi lus de la yang / tshigs bcad 'ba' zhig dang / lhug pa rkyang pa dang / de gnyis spel ba ste rnam pa gsum nyid du gnas so/ /skabs 'dir 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas sdeb sbyor me tog gi chun por/ snyan dngags kyi lus tshigs bcad rkyang pa rgyun chags gsum du bsdus pa dang / rgyun chags la rkang par bcad ma bcad sogs kyi rnam gzhag 'ga' zhig mdzad par/ mkhas pa'i dbang po dpang ston lo tsā ba dang / zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po gnyis kyis dgag bzhag cung zad mdzad par/ snar thang lo tsā ba/ rin spungs sa spyod dbang po/ mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ mkhan ngag dbang chos grags pa sogs mkhas pa mang pos sa skya pa'i thugs chen gyis lan sna tshogs shig mdzad 'dug na'ang / rigs pa rnam dag gi sgrub byed du mi 'dug cing / mkhas 'jug las/ rgyun chags ma bcad pa ni sdeb sbyor rgyun chags dang 'dra la/ zhes pa ltar na/ sdeb sbyor rgyun chags dang 'dra na rkang pas nges par gcod dgos/ rkang pas bcad na/ me tog chun por/ rkang pa —208—

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)dag gis ma bcad cing / /gang la yi ge sbrel legs yod/ /ces pa'i tshig dang dngos su 'gal zhing (14na〉skrug pa dang 'dra ba sdeb sbyor gyi pra star mi 'byung ste/ rin chen 'byung gnas su brit+ta dza ti gang la yang rkang pa med pa la sdeb sbyor gyi rnam gzhag ma mdzad pas so/ /g.yin yang tshigs bcad rkang pa bzhi'i rkang pa re la yi ge nyi shu rtsa bdun yan chad yod pa la rgyun chags sam/ rab bsags su bshad pas/ rgyun chags dang tshigs bcad so sor 'chad pa yang mi rigs la tshigs bcad la rkang bzhi mi dgos pa'i khungs su mngon pa kun las btus las/tshigs su bcad pa ni rkang pa gcig pa dang gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lnga pa dang /drug pa rnams su yod do/ /zhes 'dren pa ni mi rigs te/ sdeb sbyor gyi lugs la/ rkang pa gcig pa ni blo/ mchog /rgyal/ gyur/ zhes pa lta bu/ /gnyis pa ni/ dpal ldan/ shes bya/ kun mkhyen/ khyod ni/ gsum pa ni/ shes bya'i gnad/ ma lus pa/ thugs su chud/ rdzogs sangs rgyas/ bzhi pa ni/ mkhyen dang brtse ba/ mtshungs pa med pas/'gro ba kun gyi/ 'dren pa gcig pu/ lnga pa ni/ rig pa'i gnas rnams kun/ thogs pa med par mkhyen/ zha lu lo tsā ba/ bka' drin mtshungs pa med/ drug pa ni/ gangs kyi sa 'dzan dbang po/ nyin byed stong gis 'byud 'dra'i/ mdzes sdug yid 'ong lha mo/ dbyangs cag mgrin par bzhugs shig /ces pa lta bu yin gyi/ bram ze chu la ji tsam zhig /ces pa lta bu ni kun las btus kyi dgongs don yin kyang de sdeb sbyor la rgyas 'gebs pa ni zhwa dpe (14ba/snam la 'gebs pa lta bu yin pas mi rigs so/ /'on kyang rje btsun de nyid dang / sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis la/ dpa' bo gtsug lag dang / drung pa si tu dag gis/ mu to bas rgyal po la 'thab pa ltar ngan smras kyi smre sngags phyogs bcur sgrogs pa lta bu min gyi/ rgyal ba'i bka' ltar drang nges so sor dbye ba dang / phyogs 'di la shong dpang yab sras thugs rgyus che bar gda' bas/ de'i rjes su 'brangs kyi/ rje btsun sa paṇa la 'jam dpal dbyangs dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i snang ba ni rgyun mi chad pa'o/ /—209—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2rje/tshigs bcad kyi skor bshad pa/gnyis pa la tshigs bcad bshad/ lhug pa bshad/ spel ma bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la sdeb sbyor gyi sgo nas gnyis su phye ba/ rigs kyi sgo nas bzhir phye ba/ sa rgyu chen po'i mtshan nyid bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po la dngos dang / kha 'phangs pa/ rigs pa de dgos par bstan pa dang gsum/dang po ni/ snyan dngags kyi tshigs bcad rkang pa bzhi pa de yang ni/ yi ge bgrang ba brit+ta dang / phyi mo bgrang ba dzā ti zhes rnam pa gnyis yod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ sdeb sbyor de dag gi rnam gzhag ji lta bu snyam na/ brit+ta dzā ti de yi spros pa mtha' dag ni/ rin chen 'byung gnas dang / dmar ser dang / rgyal ba'i lha'i gzhung rnams su med par bstan pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ sdeb sbyor gyi rig pa de ni skabs 'dir mi dgos pa min te/ snyan dngags rgya mtsho chen po ltar zab cing brling ba dag ni brgal par 'dod pa rnams kyi gru lta bu yin pas so/ / (15na)gnyis pa rigs kyi sgo nas bzhir phye ba ni/ grol ba ni/ sh+lau ka gcig gis brjod bya'i don gang yin pa de rdzogs par ston nus pa/rigs ni bsngags brjod kyi yu la gcig la sh+lau ka du ma yod pa bya ba'i tshig gcig gis thams cad gsal nus pa/ mdzod ni/ gcod mtshams sna tshogs pa'i ngos nas blo ka bya tshig sogs mang nyung nges bzung med cing / brjod bya du mas phyug pa/ 'dus pa zhes bya ba ni/ brjod bya'i don gcig la/ slo ka du ma yod pa la bya tshig kyang du ma yod pa ste/ de 'dra ba'i tshigs bcad rgya che ba ni/ sa lhas bcings pa'i snyan dngags kyi cha shas te/ de'i nang du 'dus pa'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir na/ dper brjod logs su ma brjod do/ /sngon gyi 'grel pa rnams su 'di bzhi la dper brjod/ rtogs brjod rin po che sogs gzhung chen mo rnams nas 'dren par mdzad 'dug na'ang / 'dir las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir du —210

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)rang blos cung zad bskrun tshe/ grol ba ni/ rab dkar chu skyes rgyas pa'i lte ba la/ /tshangs pa'i bu mo yid 'phrog 'jo sgeg can/ /rgyud mang sgra las ngag gi dpal ster ba/ /dpag bsam 'dod 'jo snying gi dpyid der 'dud/ /ces pa lta bu/ rigs ni/ 'jam mnyen rab dkar pad+ma yi/ /brtan pa ci yang 'phrog byed pa'i/ /bzhin gyi zla ba gsar pa 'di/ /g.yin yid 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bzhin/ /'ja' tshon 'byug 'dra'i mig gi dkyus/ /zur gyis ring (15ba)por blta ba yis/ /rna gong ut+pal phon po la/ /phrag dog byed pa'i chom rkun ma/ /u dum wā ra 'dzum pa'i zhal/ /tshems phreng ze'u 'bru rgod pa can/ /ha ri tsan dan dri bro ba'i/ /dga' ma mthong bas 'dod 'phel gyur/ /ces brjod bya mdzes ma'i gdong gcig pu la bstod pa la/ 'dod 'phel gyur ces pa'i bya tshig cig gis gsal ba lta bu/ mdzod ni/ dri ma dang bral rab tu dkar/ /'dod pa'i gdung ba 'phrog par byed/ /mdzes pa'i cha shas ma lus gang / /zur mig bsil zer spros pa yis/ /snying gi kun+da ci yang 'dzum/ /kha yi dri zhim zla shel gyis/ /rab dga'i chu sgros brlan par gyur/ /lang tsho rgyas pa'i 'dod pa'i nyams/ /:dwags mtshan ma rnam par ngom/ /yid 'ong ma 'di lha'i bu mo/ /zhes pa lta bu/ 'dus pa ni/ yid 'ong ri dwags mig can gyi/ /'jam zhid mnyan pa'i lag pa yis/ /chu skyes gsar pa'i 'dab ma dag /skad cig nyid la pham byed bzhin/ /snyim pa'i med byung reg bya can/ /'dod pas myos pa'i yid can gyi/ /lus la reg pa'i bde ba yis/ /sngon med snying gi bdud rtsi byas/ /'dzam bu'i gser sbyangs gdu bu la/ /sna tshogs rin chen 'phras mdzes pa'i/ /'dren byed yul gyi dga' ston 'di/ /'jig rten byed pos bsgrub par byas/ /zhes brjod bya mdzes ma'i lag pa gcig bu/ bya tshig byed bzhin/ bdud rtsir byas/ bsgrub par byas/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /'di skor la dpa' bo gtsug lag pa'i mchan la brjod bya ci yang mi (16na)'dug pas rtog dpyod byed ma dgos so/ /gsum pa san chen po'i mtshan nyid bshad pa la/ dam bca' ba dang dngosaganyis/ dang po ni/ sa rga ste le'u gnyis yod pa yan chad kyis bcings pa ni snyan dngags chen po ste/—211

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)des mtshon/ ar shā sa dang a sko dang ā wa dang gī tis bcings pa'ang snyan ngag chen por 'chad cing snyan ngag chen po 'di'i mtshan nyid ni brjod par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ sgo/ srog rtsom tshul/ ring du gnas tshul/ dmigs bsal/ mkhas pas che bad tshul so sor bshad pa dang drug /dang po ni/ snyan ngag chen po la sngon du shis pa brjod pa/ phyag bya ba/dngos po nges pa bstan pa gsum po gang rung de yi sgo nas 'jug go /dper na/ shis brjod ni gur kum tshos kyi legs bran pa'i/ /mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rgyas pa can/ /'jam mgon zur phud lnga pa yi/ /blo gros mchog des shis par mdzod/ /ces pa lta bu/ phyag ni/ rin chen rgyan gyi gdu bu dag /sil sil khrol ba tsam gyis kyang / /yid la dga' ba'i dpal ster ba/ /dbyangs can lha der snying nas 'dud/ /ces pa lta bu/ nges bstan ni/ bcad lhug spel ma'i lang tsho dar la bab/ sde bzhi'i gtam gyi srog can rig ldan ma/ /sgra don gab tshig nor ba'i rgyan gyis spud/ /nyams 'gyur snyan pa'i glu dbyangs mgrin par len/ /zhes me long la sbyar na brjod bya kun bsdus nas bstan pa lta bu/(16ba〉na nyas pa la mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngon byung ba'i skyes rabs rig byed sogs gtam las gyur pa'am/ yang na de'i cig shos sde bzhi la brten pa'i brjod bya legs pa gzhan dag la bsten pa gang rung bya'o/ /skabs 'dir 'jam kha/ snar thar pa/ rong pa sogs mkhas pa mang po dang / dpal dpa' bo gtsug lag sogs rmongs pa mkhas pa'i go sar 'gyed pa mang po dag gis/ gtam rgyud dang sde bzhi sogs snyan ngag gi lus su 'chad cing / la la don gyi lus dang /tshig gi lus zhes 'byog por 'grel pa sogs ni/ chu shing la snying por 'dod pa kho nar snang bas/des na gong du lus dang rgyan yang rab tu bstan/ zhes pas srog shugs la bstan yod de/ dper na srog ldan gyi skyes bu lus mdzes pa la rgyan gyis spras pa bzhin du/ sde bzhi sogs kyi brjod bya'i srog dang ldan pa'i snyan ngag gi lus bcad lhug spel ma la/ don rgyan sgra rgyan gab tshig gi rgyan gyis rnam par spros so zhes kho bo'i slob dpon gyis/ grangs can lo tsā ba 'jam dpal rdo rje'i bzhed pa yin no —2/the

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)zhes ngom bshad du mdzad la/ zur mkhar blo gros rgyal pos kyang de dang mthun par bshad do/ /snyan ngag chen po'i lus kyang sngar bshad pa'i lus las logs su med cing / skabs 'dir srog bshad pa yang snyan ngag thams cad la khyab bo/ /gnyis pa ni chos ni mngon mtho nges legs bsgrub pa'i rgyu/ don rig (17na)byed mang du thos pa dang / sa gzhi rin po che sogs sog pa dang bsrung ba/ 'dod pa ni lha mi'i yul la longs spyod pa/ thar pa ni gtan gyi bde ba byang chub sgrub pas/sde bzhi po ni skyes bu'i don gyi 'bras bu yin la/ de'i dbang du gyur pa'i tshul brjod pa'i sngon gyi gtsug lag gi bstan bcos du ma dang / shes bya kun la mkhas shing / 'gro ba rnams kyi yid du 'ong ba'i 'dren pa dam pa rnams la bsngags pa brjod pa rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing lta bu/ grong khyer rgya mtshos ri gsum la bsngags pa'i dper brjod ni/ gnam sngon zhun mar 'khyil 'dra'i rgya mtsho las/ /brgal te gser dngul ri yi phreng 'das tshe/ /rin chen rdul mang brtsegs pa'i grong khyer dbus/ /be+eḍūr ser po'i rgya phibs 'od du 'tsher/ /zhes pa lta bu dus dang nyi zla 'char ba dang / /skyed tshal chu yi rol rtsed rnams kyi bsngags pa ni/ /'bras ldan ston gyi mkha' dbyings dwangs pa la/ /tsha zer 'od gsal gzi yis chu skyes tshogs/ /'dzum pa'i skyed tshal dbus su 'khyil ba'i mtshor/ /'dod ldan skye bo khrus kyi rtsed 'jor rol/ /zhes pa lta bu/ chang 'thung ba'i dga' ston dang /'khrigs pa la spyod pa'i dga' ston dang / skyes pa dang bud med la btab nas ma tshogs pa gsum ni/rgyan gos rnam bkra grogs dang lhan cig par/ /chang gis myos shing smin legs chu skyes la/ /rtse dgar rol tshe 'ga' zhig g.yon ma dang / /dus btab las 'das mi zad 'dod pas gdungs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ (17ba〉bag ma gtong len dang / gzhon nu skye ba dang 'phel ba gsum ni/ lus phra mchil 'brang la khugs dgyes dgu la/ spyad pas kun+da dar ba'i dpyid kyi bu/ /btsas nas ring por ma thogs gzhon nu de/ /bsod nams bzhin du lus stobs bskyed nas 'phel/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bya ba rtsom pa'i gros dang / pho nya'i 'gro 'ong dang / yul thag ring por bgrod pa gsum ni/ rgyal gsung rgyud mang gros kyis —213

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)nyon mongs rdzings/ /bshig tshe sems kyi pho nya thar pa'i sar/ /btang bas gtan gyi bde ba'i mdza' na mo/ /thag ring yul nas skar mda' lta bur 'ongs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ g.yul bshams pa dang /'dren pa ste rgyal po'i mnga' thang dar ba'i tshul dag kyang dper brjod na/ gnam sa 'gul 'dra'i sprul pa'i dpa' bo'i dpung / /'jigs rung g.yul gyi sbyor bas dgra sde'i tshogs/ /phye mar 'thag tshe sa dbang rgyal po yi/ /sde bzhi'i mnga' thang dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de rnams kyis kyang bstan bcos brgyan par gyur cing / mdor bsdus pa min par skabs dang 'tsham par brtsam mo/ gsum pa ni/ brtsam bya'i snyan ngag de yang sgeg pa sogs nyams dod pas yid 'gyur zhing tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa dag gis gtams pa/ blo chung ba rnams ngal ba spang slad/sa rga shin tu rgya che ba ste mang ba yang min la nyung skyon dang yang bral ba'i mnyan par 'os pa de nyid/dbang po rdo rje sogs brit+ta dang / 'phags ma sogs dzā tis legs par mtshams kyang sbyar la/ rnam pa kun tu sa rga dag la/ dper na tshig rkang phal cher yi ge nyer gcig (18na)tsam yod na/ de dag gi mtha' rdzogs mtshams su bco lnga dgu bdun sogs su 'bebs shing / dngos gzhi bdun bsgrigs lta bu la/ dgu bcu gcig sogs yar 'phel zhid / bcad mthar lhug pa dang / lhug mthar bcad pas gzhung dkyus ma las tha dad pa lte/ khyad chos dang ldan pas 'jig rten na mkhas pa rnams kyi kha las mdzes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ de lta bu'i snyan ngag dam pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa de ni blo ldan rnams kyis ngo mtshar du 'dzin pas bskal pa'i bar du snyan pa'i grags pa dang bcas te gnas par 'gyur ro/ /lnga pa ni gang zhig grong khyer la bsngags pa lta bu'i yan lag 'gas dman yang / gal te sbyar ba'i tshig don rnams phun tshogs kyis tshul de rig pa'i mkhas pa rnam mgu bar byed nus shing /le'u gsum yan dang ldan phyin/ 'dir ni snyan ngag chen po ma yin pa'i skyon med de/ yon tan de rnams tshang phyin/ skyed tshal gyi bsngags brjod tsam srog tu byas pas kyang rung ngo / dpa' bo gtsug 214

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)lag pas/ rig pa des g.yin mgu bar byed ces 'bru phyin ci log tu 'bad pas rgyag go /drug pa la/bhā ma ha'i bzhed pa dang / dbyug pa can gyi bzhed pa gnyis/ dang po ni thog ma rang phyogs kyi 'dren pa ste/ rgyal po lta bu la dpa' ba sogs kyi yon tan gyi bsngags pa nye bar bkod nas/ rgyal po de yis ni pha rol gyi dgra sde la gnod pa ste tshar gcod par byed do zhes bstod pa'i snyan ngag gi lam 'di (18ba)'jig rten na rang bzhin gyis mdzes pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ rigs mtho ba dang /brtson 'grus che ba dang / thos pa mang ba sogs yon tan du mas pha rol gyi dgra bo la yang bsngags par byas shing bstod nas/ de las kyang rgyal bar nus pa'i phyir rang cag gi 'dren pa 'di ni zhes bstod pas/ pha rol gyi yon tan phun sum tshogs pa las kyang phun sum tshogs pa'i khyad par du 'phags par brjod pa la bdag dga' ba bskyed kyi/ lugs snga ma'ang mi 'dod pa ni min no/ /tshig lhug bshad pa/gnyis pa lhug pa bshad pa la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshig rkang bzhi sogs su bcad pa med pa'i tshig gi rgyun ni lhug pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ ming tsam gyi dbye ba bstan pa dang / don gyi dbye ba dgag pa gnyis/ dang po ni bhā ma has/ lhug pa la brjod pa dag dang /gtam zhes pa de yi rab dbye gnyis bshad do/ /gnyis pa la dgag bya bhā ma ha'i 'dod pa re re 'god pa/ dgag byed dbyug pa can gyi rigs pa re re 'phangs pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de la bhā ma has/ 'dren pa ste rgyal po rang nyid kyis rang la bstod pa byas pa lta bu ni brjod par bya ba yin la/ brjod pa de las g.yin gtam ni pha rol gyi 'dren pa ste rgyal po'am/ de las g.yin bram ze lta bus kyang 'dren pa la bstod pa de yin no/ /de'i rgyu mtshan/zlos gar gyi mtshan nyid kyang snyan ngag gi rgyan du bstan pa'i sgo dang / gzhan sgo dang yid brtan ldan pa —215

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegasum brjod pa la yod kyi/ gtam la med do/ /brjod pa (19na)rang gis rang la yon tan bsgrags pa la skabs 'dir skyon yod pa min te/ yang dag pa ste ji lta ba'i don can sgro bskur med par bsngags pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / nga la sogs pa dang / a shā sa dang / bu mo 'phrog pa/ g.yul/ slu ba/ dar ba sogs dang / snyan ngag mkhan gyi dgongs pas byas pa'i rtogs rnams brjod pa la yod kyi/ gtam la med pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'on kyang khyod kyis zer ba de la nges pa yod par ma mthong ste/ brjod pa der yang rgyal po las gzhan pa dag gis brjod pa'i phyir/ phan tshun gnyis gas brjod par mnyam pa la gzhan gyis brjod na gtam dang / rang gis brjod na brjod pa zhes dbye ba'i rgyu mtshan ni ci zhig yod de med do/ /gal te sgo zhes pa phar smras pa dang / gzhan sgo zhes pa smras pa'i lan dang / phan tshun du gtam smras pa de la brten nas yid gtan ldan pa ste nges pa rnyed pa de gsum brjod pa la yod cing gtam la med pas tha dad pa yi rtags yin par smra na/ gtam la de gsum ma tshang bar 'gyur zhing / des na rgyal pos smras pa'i gtam la gtam lan 'jal mkhan med par 'gyur ro/ /skabs 'di'i brjod pa dang gtam ni lhug pa'i dbang du byas kyi tshigs su bcad pa la de ltar 'jug go zhe na/brjod bya tshigs bcad la de gsum tshang ba ltar/ zhar gyi gtam rnam dag ste gtam tshigs bcad la yang de gsum tshang (19ba)dgos te/ dper na sdeb sbyor 'phags ma sogs kyis bcings pa'i brjod pa la de gsum tshang ba bzhin/ gtam la yang sgo dang / gzhan gyi sgo dag cis mi 'jug ste 'jug rigs pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'phags mas bcings pa'i brjod pa dang gtam gnyis ka la phyed phyi ma'i drug pa la ka dang / gnyis ga'i brgyad pa la da/ mi mnyam pa la dza spangs pa sogs mtshan nyid mtha' dag mtshungs pa'i phyir/ sogs kyi sgras 'phags ma dper mtshon pa ste brit+ta dzā ti thams cad la shes dgos so/ /rin spungs pas/ legs bshad nyi ma gsar pas bslang zhes gsungs 'dug kyang /'grel pa gzhan la ltos na skya rengs tsam shar ba yin mchi/ nyi ma dngos gzhi ni da lam shar ba yin no/ /gzhan yang nga ste gzhen nu ma rnyed pa dang / sogs kyis ngal so ba dang / dus btab pa las ma —216

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)tshogs pa dang / a shā sa ni yid gtan dang ldan pa ste/ de dag brjod pa yod cing gtam la med pa'i dbye ba mthong yang / des pad+ma dang ku mu ta bzhin rigs tha dad pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yang med cing de'i phyir gtam dang brjod pa zhes pa ni/ dper na gdong lnga pa dang kha lnga pa zhes pa'i ming gnyis dag gis seng ge'i rigs gcig mtshon pas so/ /dngos su ma bshad pa'i lhag ma brjod pa'i rigs rnams kyang chad pa'i skyon med de/ brjod pa dang gtam 'di nyid kyi nang du 'du bar 'gyur bas so/ /(20na)gzhan yang khyod kyis bu mo 'phrog pa dang / g.yul 'gyed pa dang ni/ pho mo dus btab pa las yol te slu ba dang / rgyal po mnga' thang dar ba la sogs pa brjod pa dang gtam de dag gi khyad par 'byed pa'i yon tan min te/ brjod bya de rnams sa rgyas bcings pa'i brjod pa dang gtam gnyis ka la mtshungs pa nyid yin no/ /gzhan yang snyan ngag mkhan gyi bsam pas byas pa'i rtags de 'dra ba ni brjod pa las gzhan du gtam la yang ni yod par skyon du mi 'gyur te/ 'dod don tshig sbyor gyis bsgrub pa'i sgo ru mkhas pa rnams la ci yang mi 'gyur ba med pas so/ /dper na sman pa mkhas pas dug bdud rtsir bsgyur ba bzhin no/ /spel ma bshad pa/gsum pa spel ma bshad pa ni/ bcad lhug spel ma 'jig rten kun tu dga' ba sogs skad rigs bzhi ka 'dus pa'i rnam gzhag yod pa ni zlos gar te/ de dag gi tshul rnams ni bha ra ta sogs g.yin las rgyas par bshad do/ /spel ma la zlos gar kho nar mi sems te/ lhug pa dang tshigs bcad spel ba'i rang bzhin gang la/ skad gcig la brten pa skyes rabs so bzhi pa lta bu la tsas zhes par mngon par brjod do/ /gsum pa skad rigs bshad pa la/ dbye ba/ so sor gtan la dbab pa/ de dag gi byas pa'i —217

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)bstan bcos bshad pa/ gtam sogs skad rigs kyis bcings tshul dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ snyan ngag gi lus bcad lhug spel ma'i rang (20ba tha zhin de dag kyang / legs sbyar gyi skad dang / de bzhin du rang bzhin gyi skad dang / zur chag gi skad dang / de gsum bsres pa'i 'dres ma zhes pa ste rnam pa bzhi ru rā ma sha me sogs mkhas pas gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la legs sbyar/ rang bzhin/ zur chag dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ legs sbyar zhes bya ba ni/ byings las kṛ ta rkyen gyis sgrub pa'i ming dang kun bshad kyis sgrub pa'i tshig dang ming las tshig tu grub pas/ skad rnams kyi mchog saṃ skṛ ta lha'i skad ces drang srong chen po sarba dz+nyā gsung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ spyi dang / khyad par ba/ de'i yul ngosabazung ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ legs sbyar de las skyes shing de dang mtshungs pa'i yul can zhes grags pa'i rang bzhin gyi rim pa'i skad rigs du ma zhig yod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ bzo gnas bco brgyad sogs tshang ba'i yul 'khor chen po la brten pa'i skad de ni/ legs sbyar ma yin kyang / legs par bshad pa mang du smra ba'i skad rin po che dag gi 'byung khungs kyi rgya mtsho yin pa dang / se ru ste le'u sa bcings pa dang / sogs khongs nas ma tha na zhes bya ba de 'dra'i rigs can gyi rang bzhin gang yin pa'i snyan ngag kyang skad de las mthong ba'i phyir/ rang bzhin gyi skad rnams kyi nang na mchog tu gyur par rig go /gsum pa ni/ so ra se na dbang po'i sde dang / go ḍa shar phyogs dang / lwa sgyi rol ba dang / gzhan yang de 'dra'i yul dbus 'gyur sogs kyi skad rnams rang bzhin gyi skad nyid ces (21na)bya ba yi ming gis tha snyad zlos gar la sogs pa rnams la nye bar bstan cing sbyor bar 'gyur ro/ /dpa' bo gtsug lag gis/ so ra se na lnga len du 'grel pa'i tha chad kyi gtam smra'o/ /gsum pa ni/ ba lang rdzi la sogs pa'i grong tshig rnams snyan ngag gi skabs 'di la zur chag tu gnas shing / ka tsan sogs kyi bstan bcos rnams la legs sbyar las gzhan pa kun zur chag nyid du brjod do/ /gsum pa de dag gis byas pa'i bstan bcos ni/ legs sbyar 'ba' zhig las byas pa sa rgas bcings pa la sogs pa dang / rang bzhin gyi skad 'ba' zhig 218

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i rā/ dbyangs/ (wa)las byas pa skan dha ka sogs dang / zur chag gi skad 'ba' zhig las byas pa nyes sa ra sogs dang /'dres ma'i skad 'ba' zhig las byas pa zlos gar sogs so/ /bzhi pa la dngos dang / dogs sel gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngon byung gi gtam sogs skad rigs bzhi po gang rung ngam/ gnyis gsum dang /thams cad 'dres pas bcings pa dang / gtso bor ni legs sbyar 'ba' zhig gis kyang bcings so /gnyis pa ni/ sha za'i skad 'ba' zhig las byas pa'ang med pa min te/ rmad du byung ba'i don can brjod bya ston pa rgya chen zhes pa'i gtam dang rin chen rab snang zhes bya ba yang 'byung po'i skad kyi rang bzhin du brjod do/ /gnyis pa rgyan la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ lus sgeg pa dang / nyamasakyi rol pa dang / rkang lag gi stabs la sogs (21ba)pa'i nyams brjod pa ni gtso bo mig gis blta bya'i don yin la/ de'i cig shos rgyud mang dang tshangs dbyangs sogs kyi nyams brjod pa yang / gtso bor mnyan pa ste rna bas mnyan par bya ba nyid ces bya ba'i don kyang yin la/ skabs 'dir yang rgyan gyi sbyor lugs gnyis dag tu brjod do/ /le'u dang po/thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan bshad pa/gnyis pa la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan dang / thun mong pa'i rgyan gnyis / dang po la/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad/ snyan ngag gi rgyu bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ lho shar gnyis kyi 'dod pa phan tshun mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba phra mo can rnams snyan ngag gi lam 'dir ni mang du yod do/ /gnyis pa la dam bca' ba dang / bshad tshul dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ dbye ba de ni 'chad tshul ches mang yang / 'dir lho phyogs be+e da ṣ+ṭha dang / shar phyogs go ḍa pa'i lam gnyis su bsdus nas khyad par gsal bar brjod —2/9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2re/do/ /gnyis pa la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa/ mjug bsdub dang gsum/ dang po ni/ yi ge'i sbyor ba lci ba sbyar ba dang / 'jig rten la grags pa'i don rab dngas dang / yi ge 'jam rtsub kyi sbyor ba mnyam pa nyid dang / nyams khyad par can dang ldan pas snyan pa dang / yi ge 'jam pa shas che bas shin tu gzhon pa dang / don brtag mi dgos par gsal ba dang / brjod bya'i yon tan rgya che ba dang / tshig sdud mang zhing lci yang do mnyam pas brjid pa dang / lung chen po ma yin pa'i 'jig rten dang mthun pas mdzes pa dang / sems ldan gyi chos sems med la bkod pa'i ting nge 'dzin te/ yon tan bcu po 'di ni lho phyogs be+e da lha'i lam gyi (22na)srog tu bshad pa yin la/ 'di dag phal cher go ldog pa ni shar phyogs go ḍa pa'i lam dag mtshon pa yin no/ /sbyar ba'i yon tan bshad pa/gnyis pa la sngar bshad pa'i sbyar ba sogs bcu las/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ zlog zla/dngos kyi dper brjod dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sbyar ba'i yon tan ni/ sde pa'i dang po/ gsum pa/ lnga pa mthar gnas kyi srog chung ba'i yi ge mchog ste 'ba' zhig tu yod pa de lhod pa nyid kyis ma reg par/ sde pa'i gnyis pa/ bzhi pa/ dro ba/ ha k+ṣa rnams las brtsams pa zhig dgos so/ /de'i phyir 'di ni le'u gnyis pa'i sbyar ba dang mi 'dra bar srog che chung la byed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ mā lwa tī/ dza ti'i me tog mā lwa phreng ba/ lo la sred pa/ ā li ka/ bung ba/ li lā/'khor ba ste/ lhod pa dza ti'i me tog phreng / /sred pas bung ba 'khor bar byed/ /ces khrung ba bzhin/shar phyogs rgo ḍa pa dag la yig bskor ba'i rjes khrid tshul 'dir la jug pa'i blos/ lhod pa sbyor bar 'dod do/ /bod la dper mtshon na/ rab dkar gangs ri ltar dkar ba/ /dkar mdzes pad+ma dkar por 'gran/ /legs dkar sgeg mo'i gdong ltar dkar/ /sprin dkar rjes 'gro lhag bsam dkar/ /—22()

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)zhes pa srog chung zhing ka yig la bskor ba lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ mā la tī/ dza ti'i me tog dā ma phreng ba/lo ghi rta 'khor ba 'o lding pa/ bh+ra ma ra/ bung ba rnams kyis te/ dza ti'i me tog phreng / bung ba rnamasakyis 'khor zhing lding / zhes gha dang bha sogs srog chen po mang du tshogs pa'i 'dus pa lta bu la bskor ba'i sbyor ba lci ba be+e da lha byed de/ (22ba〉dper na/ tshang tshing kho ra khor yug gi /sra mkhregs sar 'khod skye bo 'ga'/ /thags mkhan tshul mtshungs 'thad 'thad tshig /kha nas mi yong pha rol tsher /zhes pa srog chen gtso bor sbyar ba lta bu/ skabs 'di'i lci ba ni sbyor lci ba yin la/ sdeb sbyor gyi lci ba ni yi ge lci ba yin pas mi mtshungs so/ /rab dwangs kyi yon tan bshad pa/gnyis pa rab dwangs la lto pa dang / shar pa gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang / dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ rab tu chu dwangs pa'i nang gi rde'u mthong ba lta bu dang ldan pa/ grong tshig gis ma bsrangs pa'i ngos nas 'jig rten la grags pa shas che ba'i don can no/ /gnyis pa ni/ zla ba'i mtshan ma ri bong gi gzugs ut+pa la sngon po'i 'od kyis mdzes pa rgyas zhes pa/ don de 'bad med du rtogs pa'i skal ba bzang po dang ldan pa'i tshig go /dper na/ dkar gsal zla gzhen cod pan legs 'chang zhing / /mgrin par in+d+ra rnyil gyi mdangs 'phro ba/ /'jig rten byed po dus kun sgrib med par/ /gzigs khyod skabs gsum gtsug na mngon par mdzes/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang / dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ go ḍa pa ni 'jig rten la shin tu grags che ba min yang nges tshig brjod rgyu yod pa tsam gyi phyir go dka' ba zhig la'ang 'dod do/ /gnyis pa ni shin tu dkar ba min pa la sngon po dang / chu las skyes pa la ut+pa la'i nges tshig tu byas te/ de 'dra ba'i ri bong gis mtshan pa'i 'od dkar can zhes so/ /dper na lang tsho dar ba'i 'od kyis dka' thub (23na)—221 —
