rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)mun/ /nyer bcom bde ba'i dpal mnga' 'dren byed zhugs/ /pad dkar mig bu lhag mar byas pa'i sgras/ /'chi med rje khyod nus mthu'i rang bzhin dpal/ /zhes pa lta bu/mnyam pa'i yon tan bshad pa/gsum pa mnyam pa la lho shar gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang / dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ yi ge'i sbyor ba mnyam pa ni srog chung ba 'jam pa dang / mi mnyam pa dang bral ba ni srog che ba rtsub pa yin la/ de lta bu'i 'jam rtsub gnyis po ni phyed snga ma la 'jam na phyi ma la rtsub pa'i yi ge bkod pa las byung ba'i snyan ngag de ni de 'dra'i sbyor ba 'jam rtsub bar ma'i skye gnas las grub pa'i bar ma ste/ dre'u la khal bkal na do ya mnyam pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ dpyid ka khu byug rnams skad snyan pa'i ca co sgrog par byed cing / nyar ma ste chu'i zegs ma rab tu 'thor ba dang / chu dngas shing dngas pa'i rgyun te chu'i thigs pas dran pas/ ma la ya rlung gi dri dang mtshungs te/ bdag gi 'dod pa 'phel ba'i slad du 'ongs so/ /bod dper mi gsal yang / rgya dper phyed snga ma la ka la pa sogs 'jam pa dang / phyi mar tsha dzha bha k+ṣa sogs rtsub pa mang ngo / /dper na/ dkar mdzes mig gi bdud rtsi dbyangs can zhal/ /'dren byed yul gyur tsam gyis blo gros rgyas/ /dga' ston sgra yis sa phyogs pha mthar khyab/ /shes byar hol hol ma yin mkhas mkhas bslabs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ zur mkhar blo gros rgyal pos/ 'jam par mnyam pa dang rtsub par mnyam pa(23ba/zhes 'grel pa snga ma 'ga' zhig gi rjes su 'brangs te 'chad pa ni gzhung don du 'jam rtsub mnyam pa'i tha snyad med pas mi 'brel lo/ /zur mkhar ba/ dpal sgang pa/ 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po gsum gyis rdzog rtags ma bskyal tsam de mdzad na/ gzhan ni sgo nga'i mthil mdzub len du 'dug pas/ khyed gsum gyi bka' rgyud pa mi gral du chud pa mdzod cig gnyis pa la dper brjod dang / don —222

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)bsdu gnyis/ dang po ni tsan+dan gyis gos pa'i dri ngad bzang po ldang zhing / bsil nyid 'jam pa ma la ya'i rlung des ni/ bdag gi sems kyi brtan pa dbang med du 'gog pa ste phrogs nas/ dga' ma bud med mchog gi kha nang gi rlung dang 'gran pa de la co 'dri'o/ /rgya dper rkang pa gsum par dha mang du tshogs shing / gzhan gsum la srog chung bar shas che ba'i sbyor lugs la 'dod de/ dper na/ snyan ngag snang ba ster mdzad cing / /rgyal ba kun gyi yum gcig ma/ /tshangs sras sha sha dha ra yi/ /dri med dkar ba'i rjes 'gro can/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ zhes pa mi mnyam pa bshad ma thag pa la/shar phyogs pas ma brtags par mnyam pa'i mtshan nyid du 'jog kyang / tshig gi don dang rgyan phun sum tshogs pa dag la ltos nas te bsams na shar phyogs pa'i lugs dag la mi mnyam pa'i snyan ngag gi lam 'di 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /snyan pa'i yon tan bshad pa/bzhi pa snyan pa la/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ snyan pa'i yon to ni/ yid 'gyur thub (24na)pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'i tshig dang ni brjod bya don gyi dngos po la yang nyams khyad can gnas pas tshig don gnyis ka sbrang rtsi bzhin du gang gis sbrang rtsi la spyod pa'i bung ba ltar/ gang gis blo ldan rnams dga' bar byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ sgra'i nyams/ don gyi nyams/gnyis ka la grong tshig spang ba dang gsum/ dang po la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgra'i nyams yi ge dang tshig gang dang ci la sbyar kyang / snga ma dang phyi ma la ṣa yig tu mtshungs pa lta bus gang zhig nyams su myong ba de yis/ bshad ma thag pa'i gzugs dang / sogs kyis gnas dang / phyi mo dang /brtsegs pa'i tshig nye bar gnas pa/ rjes su 'khrid pa dang bcas pa sgra'i nyams dang ldan no/ /gnyis pa la lho pa dang / shar pa gnyis/ dang po la/ dper brjod dang / mjug bsdub gnyis/—223

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)dang po ni/ gang gi tshe bram ze dga' ba'i rgyal po zhes bya ba 'di yis rgyal srid kyi dpal thob par gyur pa de nas bzung ste sde bzhi'i chos kyi dga' ston 'jig rten 'di ru byung ngo / /rgya dper e ṣa dang / la k+ṣi ma/ pra sta dang / pri ya/ : ti dharma dang / sa bo bha ba ta/ rkang pa bzhi la rim bzhin ṣa yig tu mtshungasapa yig dang po can gyi ra yig tu mtshungs pa pa yig dang po can gyi ra yig tu mtshungs pa/ brtsegs pa dang po'i ra yig tu mtshungs pa/ skye gnas su mtshungs pa'o/ /dper na/ rnam dkar rnam dpyod rnam mang rnam thar rnams/ /ma lus phul byung bla med spungs shing 'phyur/ /rab yangs (24ba〉ngag dbang dbyangs can lha gang la/ /rtag tu bstod cing stobs chen rta sogs stob/ /ces rkang pa dang po la ra la na sbyar ba/ gnyis pa skye gnas gsum pa dbyangs gcig /bzhi pa brtsegs pa'o/ /bru hā ṇa'i bru ring po ni bu rgyud kyi rkyen byin shul yin pas tshangs par bsgyur ba mi legs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ zhes 'di nyid be+e da rta ni 'dod kyi/ go ḍa pa ni/ rkang pa bzhi la rigs mi mthun pa 'di mi 'dod de/ de dag ka lta bu yi ge gcig la bskor ba dang tshig la bskor ba'i tshe rkang pa dang po la tsa yig dang / gnyis pa la ma yig dang ldan pa'i ba yig la bskor ba la sogs pa'i rjes su 'khrid pa la dga' bas/ sbyor ba phal cher yang rjes su 'khrid pa zhes pa byed do/ /gnyis pa shar pa la/ mtshan nyid mdor bstan pa/ ming dang sbyor ba rgyas par bshad pa/ zhar byung zung ldan smos pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ tshigs bcad la ltos pa'i rkang pa rnams dang / bcad lhug gnyis ka la ltos nas tshig rnams la dbyangs la nges pa med kyang / gsal byed kyi yi ge gcig yang yang bskor ba ni rjes su 'khrid pa'o/ /de yang gal te snga mar bkod pa'i sgra nyams su myong ba ni yi ge'i 'du byed yin la/ yi ge de nyid rtogs pa ste dran par byed pa'i yi ge snga phyi thag mi ring ba nyid du gnas pa zhig dgos so/ /gnyas pa la/ rkang pa la bskor ba/ tshig la bskor ba/ ring bar thos pa/ shar pa kho na 'dod pa'i rjes khrid dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ ston (25na)dus kyi mtshan mo nam mkha' g.ya' dag pas dbu rgyan du gyon pa'i zla ba de ni dkar mdzes sogs kyis ku mu ta'i phon por skye bo 'ga' zhig 'khrul ba las/ slar —224

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)brtags tshe ri bong gi mtshan ma in+d+ra ni la dang mtshungs pa'am/ yang na bung ba'i kha dog gi dpal ni yang dag par 'dzin pas zla bar nges so/ /rgya dper/ rkang pa bzhi'i dang po rnams su/ tsan+d+ra/ kun+da/in+d+ra/ sa spro zhes / na yig dang ldan pa'i da yig la bskor ro/ /dper na/ rag gan gser gyi mdog ltar rdzu ba 'ga'/ /rang 'od rnam par spyod pa'i mthu dman yang / /rak+ta ltar dmar rtog pa 'og 'gyu mkhan/ /ra lug mi yi gzugs brnyan can 'di su/ /zhes pa bod skad la 'os pa dang / yang yon tan dbyar mtsho lta bur rgyas 'dod rnams/ /nan tan 'bad pa chen pos mkhas par 'gyur/ /'on tang sngon goms bag chags sad pa las/ /nan tang ma byas mthong ba tsam gyis shes/ / zhes rgya dpe dang bstun nas bod skad la 'di lta bu/ le'u gsum pa'i zung ldan la ni yi ge tshogs pa mtha' brten sogs gzugs thams cad cig cing tshig rkang snga ma'i thog mtha' bar gang la 'ong ba de phyi mar ma 'chol ba zhig dgos la/ rjes khrid la ka lta bu mtha' brten phul byed mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge'i srog zhugs med pa 'am/ lho pa ltar dbyangs sna tshogs srog tu zhugs chog pa dang / shar pa ltar mtha' brten sogs la nges pa med pa'i dbye ba 'di ni shong dpang gi brgyud 'dzin rnams ma gtogs mkhas pa phal cher gyis dgongs par ma mngon no/ /gnyis pa ni/ kye mdzes ma nam mkha' la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar zhing mdzes pa bsil ba'i reg bya 'dis/ bdag gi yid dbang med du yid srubs te 'dod lhas mnan cing brtse med du 'joms par brtson (25ba)pa 'di la ltos la chags pa sol cig /rgya dper/ rkang pa bzhi la rim bzhin/ tsā tung/ tsā spro dang / ba sba dang / man+t+ra do/ ma d+ma dang / rda yaṃ/ du rta/ zhes tsa dang / ma dang ldan pa'i ba/ na dang ldan pa'i ma/ ra dang ldan pa'i ya la bskor zhes pa yi ge de rnams kyi bar du yi ge mang pos ma chod pa'i shin tu mi ring bar thos pa dag ni tshig la bskor ba'i rjes khrid du 'dod do/ /dper na/ pa sangs ltar dkar pad+ma'i bzhin/ /mdzes ldan sgyug mo gar stabs bsgyur/ /rnga shon rnga yab thogs nas 'gying / /skad snyan mgrin glu len nam snyam/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /—225

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2re/ gsum pa ni/ dga' ma khyod kyi bzhin ras kyi chu skyes dkar po 'di dang mtshungs pa ni zla ba nyid tsam yin zhes 'jig rten na mi mthun pa med par 'dod do/ /rgya dper/ rā mā/ tsā rgyu mā zhes pa'i ma gnyis kyi bar du yi ge dgu tsam gyis chod pa'o/ /dper na/ la ba'i bem po gyon pa 'ga'/ /don med la lung mang por 'khyam/ /bya bral yin zhes la la dad/ /rtags tshe 'khrul ba'i rang tshang la/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ kho mo bdag gi lus ni mdza' bo dang bral ba'i dbang gis rid por gyur pas/ yan lag rnams phra zhing gdu bu rnams yangs 'phrol du rgyug pa/ de bzhin ngo tsha bas mi 'dod pa'i khro ba de yang phra ba ste ngo tsha dang bral ba lta bur/ 'dod pa chags pa'i mtshon ni rno la rtsub na yang /snying ring ba'i mdza' bo ngan pa des dor bas/ da ni lang tsho'i khengs pa nyams shing mi bzod pa'i chags pa drag tu rgyas la 'khrig pa kho na yid la 'char ba'i rmongs pa skyes te/ da ni srog rnams sod pa ste 'chi ba la thug go zhes sogs sbyor ba rtsub pa dang / de'i 'gal zla lhod pa yang ni shar phyogs pa rnams ster ba ste sbyor bar byed la/ de 'dra ba'i rjes khrid de ni lho phyogs pa rnams mi (26na)'dod pas mi sbyor ba de'i phyir ro/ /'di'i rtsub pa ni/ rgya dper/ sma raḥ lta bu rnam bcad yod pa rnams dang / lhod pa o yig srog tu zhugs pa dang / tsan+d+ra go mi'i yi ge'i mdor bshad pa'i yi ge 'jam rtsub dang mi mthun kyang /ngag nas 'don pa'i sgra mtshungs pa tsam bod skad la yang rtsub pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bkas/ khyod kyi smras/ zhes pa lta bu/ lhod pa ni/ gsung mnyan zhes pa lta bu ste/ tsan+d+ra go mi'i yi ge'i mdo'i srog che chung las rgya che bar sum rtags nas bshad pa'i pho dang shin tu mo sogs kyi rnam gzhag da lha'i gzhung dngos la brten nas 'chad rgyu med kyang bod skad kyi gdangs la brten nas rgya dpe dang 'dra mtshungs su sbyor ba slob dpon mkhas pa'i legs bshad gsar pa'o/ /dper na/ sgra sgrog /kha gdangs/ mche ba gtsigs/ ha ha sgrog cing thag pas bsdam/ mi snyan gtam zer sked med la/ /dga' byed skyes bu nyams re dga'/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa zhan byung —226

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i che/ dbyangs/ (wadazung ldan smos pa ni/ yi ge bskor ba kho na rjes khrid dang / gnyis gsum sogs 'dra ba tshogs pabasabaskor ba'i snga ma bkod pa'i spyod yul du phyi ma rnams ji lta bar gyur pa ni zung dang ldan par rig par bya la/ de yang mtha' gcig tu snyan pa min pas/ de'i phyir na le'u dang po 'dir cung zad brjod kyi/'di dang 'dra ba rnams le'u gsum par bshad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa don gyi nyams ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i sgra'i (26btams kyang stan pa'i ro dang ldan mod/ 'on kyang nges par thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan rnams kun la yang blta ba dang mnyan pa sogs don gyi nyams khyad par can dag sbyin par byed pa gtso che'o/ /gsum pa/ gnyis ( ka la grong tshig spang ba la/ spyi dang / bye brag gnyis/ dang po ni/ de lta na yang grong pa nyid kyi tshig gis bslad pa min pa'i brjod bya don gyi nyams dang ldan pa'i snyan ngag gi khur ni tshul 'di la mkhas pa phal cher gyis 'dzin no/ /gnyis pa la/ don gyi grong pa spang ba/ sgra'i grong pa spang ba/ don bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po la/ spang bya'i grong pa ngos bzung ba/ spong byed kyi nyams ji ltar sbyin pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'khrig pa'i bde ba kho na'i 'dod pa dang ldan pa'i skye bo bdag la/ gzhen nu ma khyod ni/ ji ltar 'dod pa brten par mi byed de byed dgos so zhes pa 'di la grong pa'i tshig dngos su zhugs pas don gyi bdag nyid nyams dang bral ba kho nar byed pas spang dgos so/ /dper na/ yid du 'ong pa'i bu mo khyod/ / 'bol zhing 'jam pa'i man stan la/ /bdag dang lhan cig nyal byas nas/ /'khrig pa'i bde ba dga' mgur spyod/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/g.yon mig ma zur gyis blta bas brtan pa 'phrog par byed pa'i 'dod pa'i gtum po 'di ni nges par bdag la brtse bar med par 'dod pas gdung bar byed na'ang / khyod la khro ba med pa'i steng du shin tu dga' bar byed pa 'di nyid ci yin zhes brjod pa ni/ grong pa'i don (27na༄na min par snyan ngag gi ro dang ldan pa yin no/ /dper na/ 'dren byed zur gyis blta ba'i 'od/ /bdag yid 'dab brgya ci yang bzhad/ /dbang po'i bung ba chu skyes kyi/ /rtsed 'jor rol cig smin legs ma/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa sgra'i —227

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegrong pa spang ba/ skyon brjod dang bcas te dpes spyir bstan pa/ dbye ba so sor bshad pa/ dmigs bsal khas len pa dang gsum/ dang po la/ dngos dang dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ don tsam du ma zad/ sgra la'ang grong pa'i tshig nyid zhugs pa yod de/ de'i mthus ni snyan ngag legs pa'i cig shos mi legs par grags pas spang dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ grong tshig gi dpe ni/ dga' ba'i dga' ston ste 'khrig pa go bar byed pa brjod pa la/ ji ltar/ yā yig dang / la sogs pa'i sgras/ bha yig gnyis tshogs na/ yā bha zhes pa 'khrig pa'i dngos ming yin pas mi mdzes pa bzhin/ rgyas par 'og tu 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa dbye ba so sor bshad pa la/ rnam grangs mdor bstan pa/ dper brjod rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgra la grong tshig zhugs tshul de yang 'ga' zhig tu/ /tshig gi mtshams sbyor nyams pa'i dbang gis zhugs pa dang / /slar yang der ma zad ngag tshig gcig la go bya'i don tha dad pa dag gis kyang nges par legs pa ma yin pa rtogs par byed pa'i grong pa'i tshig rnam pa gnyis 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa lan mtshams sbyor log pa (27bskong / tshig gcig don tha dad du go ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ yā gang dang / bha ba ta:khyod kyi dang / pri yā dga' ma la 'jug pa bzhin/gang khyod kyi dga' ma zhes 'byung la/ gcod mtshams log na/ yā bha/ 'khrig pa/ ba taḥ ldan pas 'khrig pa dang ldan pa'i dga' ma zhes grong tshig tu 'gro'o/ /dper na/ grub chen nyams len byed 'dod blo/ /chung chung phug par nyal bar dga'/ /phyag chen bsgoms pas nyon mongs kun/ /'phel ba mtha' dag zhi bar byed/ /ces pa lta bu/ /gnyis pa ni/bīrla brtson 'grus/ bi shun+taḥrnam par gnas pa la 'jug pas/ g.yul du gzhan gyi dpung tshogs la mtshon cha bsnun nas gzhom par byed pa'i skyes bu brtson 'grus dang ldan zhing / brtul phod pas ni rnam par rgyal ba'i sa la gnas par gyur to/ /yang na skad dod snga ma khu ba dang / phyi ma rnam par ngal ba la go bas/ gzhan bud med la bsnun pa'i skyes bu ni khu ba dang ldan pas rnam par ngal lo zhes pa 'byung ngo / /—228

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wanadaper na/ sngo gsang ma 'di'i mtshan ma la/ /khu ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su 'khyil/ /bcud bral mang po rab tshogs nas/ /dad gus kyis 'dud chim med bsten/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ grong tshig de lta bu sogs lho shar gnyis rka'i lam dag la yang bsngags pa ma yin pas na spang dgos so/ /gsum pa dmigs bsal ni/ bha ga ni mo mtshan dang skal pa/ wa tī ldan ma/bha gi nī sring mo la 'jug pas/ (28na tshe tshes sogs te sbyor tshul mi 'dra ba gnyis byung yang / rang gi sring mo la ngo tsha ba'i gtam mi smra bas/ sring mo skal ldan zhes pa las 'os med cing / des na dmigs bsal 'di ni rnam pa kun tu lho shar gnyis gas khas len pa nyid yin no/ /dper na bdag gi sring mo mtshan ldan 'di/ /pha la nam yang nye bar gus/ /drin ldan ma ma 'dod pa'i rten/ /ji snyed bu tsha rnams kyis bsgrub/ /ces pa lta bu/ gsum pa snyan pa'i mjug bsdu ba ni/ sngar bstan pa de ltar snyan pa'i yon tan rnam par phye nas bshad zin no/ /shin tu gzhon pa'i yon tan bshad pa/lnga pa shin tu ga cho zhe pa la lho shar gnyis/ dang po la/ dam bca' ba/ mtshan nyid/ dper brjod/ don bsdu dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ da ni shin tu ga 'an pa zhes bya ba bshad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsub pa min pa'i 'jam pa'i yi ge mang ba ni/ lho phyogs pa'i lam 'dir shin tu gzhon pa'i mtshan nyid du 'dod la/ gang gi phyir yi ge thams cad mnyen pa ste 'jam pa 'ba' zhig ni mi dgos te/ de la sbyor ba lhod pa'i skyon du bshad do/ /gsum pa ni/ char sprin gyi phreng ba ldan pa dbyar gyi dus su skad snyan par sgrog pa'i mgrin pa dang ldan pa rma bya yi ni mjug ma dag gdugs phub pa ltar zlum por byas nas gar byed do/ /rgya dpe la/ la ṇ+ḍasnyi kri du sogs 'jam pa'i yi ge shas che bar gnas pa'o/ /dper na/ sbrang —229

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)rtsi'i rgyal mtshan 'dab ma'i dbus/ ze'u 'bru'i phang phung ldan pa la/ /bung ba gzhon nu snyan pa'i glu/ /len zhing ro bcud myang bar byed/ /ces pa lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ zhes pa de ni don rgyas pa zab cing brling ba nyid ma yin la/ rgyan yang rang (28ba)bzhin brjod pa tsam ma gtogs/ phul du byung ba de 'dra yod pa min pa ste min mod/ 'on kyang shin tu gzhen pa nyid kyi tshig sbyor de lta bu ni yi ge 'jam zhing ngag nas brjod bde ba'i phyir dam pa ste mkhas pa rnams kyi kha na gnas so/ /gnyis pa la 'dod tshul dang / dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni shin tu gzhen pa'i tshig sbyor des don gsal bar mthong ba'i phyir/ gzhan shar phyogs pa dag skabs 'gar 'jam pa sbyor ba srid mod kyang / phal cher ni rtsub pa brjod par dka' ba dag sbyor ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgya k+ṣa ste dgra ste rā ma ṇa sa srid sgrub bsad pa'i rjes su/ 'gal zla'i rgyal rigs rnams kyi phyogs skad cig gis nyams par byas so/ /'dir rgya dpe la k+ṣa yig lnga tsam tshogs pas brjod dka' ba ste/ dper na/ khong khros kha yi so lte the the du/ /bsgrig cing sha khri thogs nas rgyug byed cing / /khu sgras sa phyogs 'gengs pa'i hor 'dra ste/ /rgyal rje'i dma' 'bebs kho ra'i thong yang 'grib/ ces pa lta bu/ don gsal ba'i yon tan bshad pa/drug pa don gsal la/ lho shar gnyis/ dang po la mtshan nyid dang / dper brjod gnyis/dang po ni/ brjod bya'i don gsal bas/ don de gtan tshigs kyis brtag mi dgos par rtogs nus pa nyid do/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'phrog byed de khyab 'jug gis ni phag pa'i gzugs su sprul nas/ sa gzhi dag rgya mtshor bying ba las 'don pa'i ched du mtsho'i nang du zhugs te phyin pa na rmig pas klu'i gzugs rnams bcad pa'i khrag gis chu'i gter dmar por gyur pa las sa gzhi phyung ngo / /zhes pa rig byed kyi gtam rgyud rnams 'jig (29na〉rton na grags chung yang / chu mdog dmar por 'gro ba brtag mi —230

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)dgos par gsal ba lta bu ste/ dper na/ sngo bsangs go skabs kun nas 'phrog byed pa'i/ /zla ba'i ma ma las 'ongs 'od rnon can/ /bi sha rkarmas lan brgyar bdar ba la/ /ne ru ka yi 'dod pa yongs su rdzogs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ /gnyis pa la dper brjod/ don bshad pa/ mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ khyab 'jug gis phag pa chen po dag tu sprul nas phyung ba'i sa 'di chu gter te/ rgya mtsho dmar po dag las byung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ zhes pa'i sbyor ba 'di nyid bstan pa ni/ brjod bya snga ma dang gcig kyang / brjod byed kyi tshig sbyor mi gsal ba'i dbang gis/ chu dmar po brang 'gro ste klu'i khrag las byung yang de ni zhib tu brtag dgos pa nyid do/ /dper na/ 'chi med bdag po'i tshogs kyi sgyu rtsal las/ /'jig rten mthong bar byed pa'i mi zad 'od/ /lus phra can gyis bzod mi bzlog pa'i thabs/ /sna tshogs las kyi dum bur cha ru bgos/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i lam 'di lho shar gnyis ka dag la yang / don rtogs pa'i skal pa bzang po dang mi ldan shing / chu gter dmar po las byung ba'i gtan tshigs ni rjod byed kyi sgras ma zin zhing rigs pas kyang bsgrub tu med pas/ de gnyis ka las 'gong ba 'di 'dra shar phyogs pa re re tsam ma gtogs/ lho shar phal che ba bzhed pa min no/ /rgya che ba'i yon tan bshad pa/bdun pa rgya che ba la lho shar gnyis/ (29bskong po la/ mtshan nyid dper brjod/ don bsdu ba gsum/ dang po ni/ tshig sbyor gang du don 'ga' zhig dngos su brjod pa'i shugs la/ yul de nyid du khyad par 'phags pa dang ldan pa'i yon tan rtogs nus pa de ni rgya chen por gyur pa'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid du brjod de/ des ni snyan ngag gi lam kun gyi mgon dang bcas pa ste mchog yin no/ /le'u gnyis pa'i rgya che ba dang mi 'dra bar yul gang la sbyar kyang chog go /gnyis pa ni/ slong —231

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)ba rnams kyi bkren pas nyen pa'i mig dag sbyin du re bas lan gcig tsam khyod kyi gdong la lhung ba ste lta bar byas na/ lha gcig des gnas skabs su ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos pos tshim par byas pa'i mthu de yis/ slar slong bas ched du sbyin pa po gzhan gyi gdong la blta dgos pa ma yin no/ /dper na/shong dpang rig byed 'chad pa'i rnam thar dri/ /sngon byung lo rgyus ma la ya rlung gis/ /drangs pas dad pa'i spu long g.yos pa na/ /'dren pa gzhan la mkhas pa'i re ba lhod/ /ces pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/zhes pa 'di nyid kyi ngag gi sbyor lugs 'di la gtong ba'i sbyin pa khyad par du 'phags par mtshon zhing / lam 'di nyid kyi shugs la dpa' brtul sogs gzhan dag kyang rigs pas mtshungs pas dpag par bya'o/ /gnyis pa shar pa la mtshan nyid dang / dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ bstod yul gyi bsngags par 'os pa'i khyad par gyi chos dngos po 'ga' zhig dngos su brjod (30na)pa na/ shugs kyis khyad chos dngos po de rnams dang ldan pa'i khyad gzhi yul de'i yon tan ngo mtshar rgya chen po dang ldan par rtogs nus pa'i ngag de ni/ rgya che bar shar phyogs pa 'ga' zhig 'dod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtse dga' la rol ba'i dus dga' ba skyed pa'i gzhi chu skyes te pad+ma'i mtsho rdzing dang / gser gyi rna rgyan dang / gdu bu la sogs pa'i mdzes pa'i rgyan mang po zhig la bsngags pa'i shugs la/ rgyan 'di btags nas rdzing bur khrus la 'jug pa'i smin legs ma de khyad 'phags su ston nus pa bzhin no/ /dper na/ spang ljongs margad 'og pag gyon/ /rab dkar chu khur lang long g.yo/ /'brug gi sgra dbyangs dar dir sgrog /rma bya gzhon nu zlos gar bsgyur/ /ces pa lta bu/—232

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)brjid pa'i yon tan bshad pa/brgyad pa brjid pa la spyir bstan pa/ so sor bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ brjid pa ni/ 'bru mang la sogs pa ka tsan gyi bsdu ba'i skabs nas byung ba'i tshig sdud mang po yod pa nyid 'di ni lhug pa dag gis sos te mchog tu gyur pas/ brjid pa lhug pa la sbyor ba shar pa mi 'dod pa ma yin kyang /gtso bor lho pa nyid 'dod do/ /dper na lho shar gnyis thun mong du/ snyan tshig rig pa kun 'chad zla bral mkhas khyod/ shong dpang bstan 'dzin mchog gyur blo gsal dga' bskyed/ /rgol ngan klad 'gems/ rig gnas phyogs bcur spel gang rgyal 'gyur to/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa la shar lho gnyis/ (30bskong po la/ 'dod tshul/ mtshan nyid/ dper brjod/ mjug bsdu ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ yang gi sgras lhug pa la mi 'dod pa min kyang / shar phyogs pa rnams tshigs bcad la brjid pa 'di nyid dpung dang gnyen gyi gtso bor bzhed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ brjid pa de la pra sta ra lci ba dang yang ba rnams do mi mnyam par lci ba mang la yang ba nyung ba nyid dang de las ldog ste spel bas mtho ba dang dma' ba yi ni lci yang rnam par 'khrugs shing / bsdu ba dang bcas te brjid par 'dod pa de yang / brjod pa dang gtam la sogs pa rnams la lta zhing sbyar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ nub phyogs kyi ri bo'i mgor lhung ba ste gnas pa lta bu'i de'i phyogs mtha' dag mtshams sprin dmar po nyi ma'i 'od kyi mal stan can dang / chu ldan ma ste chu'i lha mo zhes bos nas/ bshad ma thag pa'i mtshams sprin 'di/ khyod kyi nu ma bsra zhing mkhregs pa la gnas pa'i stod g.yogs kyi gos dmar po lhab lhub tu g.yo ba bzhin mdzes so/ /rgya dper tshig sdud mang du yod pas brjid cing phyed snga ma la lci ba dgu dang / yang ba bdun 'byung ngo / /dper na/ g.yon mig dkyud phra zur 'phang skyes bu la/ /rno mtshon la 'gong mi zad gdung ba skyed/ /'dod pa 233

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ni/mi ldan 'phags rnams mi sdug mig /phra mo'i dbye ba mi mnga' ngo mtshar che/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/zhes pa'i tshig sdud dang bcas pa'i do mi mnyam pa ni brjid pa dang ldan pa'i tshig 'di/ tshigs bcad la yang shar pa dag sbyor ro/ /gnyis pa lho phyogs pa la/ mtshan (31na skad dang / dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzhan lho phyogs pa dag gtso bor lhug pa la 'dod kyang / tshigs bcad la yang mi ba ched pa med pas/ de'i mtshan nyid ni/ pra sta ra lci yang 'khrugs pa min par do mnyam pas mdzes pa yi tshig sdud rnams dang bcas pa brjid pa'i dper 'dod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ chu 'dzin te sprin lang long du g.yo ba'i ngos kyi phang ba na chags pa ste gnas shing / thun mtshams kyi nyi 'od dmar po'i gos dang ldan pa'i chu ldan ma khyod kyis ni sred ldan gyi skye bo su yi yid 'dod pas gzir bar byed par cis mi 'gyur te 'gyur ro/ /dper na/ sku mdangs ser po su war+ṇa bzhin/ snyan gsung pi waṃ ji lta bla lhag /rgyal mkhyen lta bu ldan blo ma ma/ tshangs sras ma su srid na mdzes 'dra/ zhes pa lta bu/mdzes pa'i yon tan bshad pa/dgu pa mdzes pa'i yon tan la/ lho shar gnyis/ dang po la/ mtshan nyid/ sbyor gzhi/ dper brjod/ don bsdu ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ mdzes pa zhes bya ba de yang 'jig rten grags pa'i don dag las ma 'das par/ 'ud mi che bas 'gro ba kun gyi blo la shong zhing mdzes so/ /gnyis pa ni/mdzes pa de yang / sbyor gzhi sngon byung gi gtam gyi mngon par brjod pa dang / yon tan la bsngags pa brjod pa la sogs pa rnams la sbyar ro/ /gsum pa la/ gtam la sbyar ba dang / bsngags(pa la sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngon gyi dka' thub la gnas shing bden pa grub pa sbyin bdag gi khyim du 'ongs pa na/ khyim bdag gis ngo mtshar (31ba)gyi phung po can khyod 'dra ba'i zhabs kyi rdul ni gtsang ma ge —234

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)ga'i chu dang 'dra ba rnams kyis yang dag par btab pa ste reg pa'i khyim gang yin pa de dag kho na nges par byin rlabs dang ldan pa'i khyim mo/ /dper na/ kun las chos rgyal chu srin rgyal mtshan can/ /'dren byed las 'ongs bi sha na ra'i bus/ /lhag mar btang bas skabs gsu ma pa yi dbus/ /zla bral mgrin sngon stobs ni e ma mtshar/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ skyon med cing mdzes pa'i lus can ma khyod ni 'jam zhing mnyen pa'i lag pa'i 'khri shing g.yo ba'i brang ngos kyi bar dag tu lang tsho rab tu rgyas pa'i nu ma 'di dag gi gnas yul gyi go skabs rnyed par 'gyur pa ma yin no/ /dper na/ nam yang zad pa med pa gnas lnga rig /mtha' klas yun du goms pa'i blo gros kyis/ /ji snyed ches brling shes bya'i pha mtha' de/ /'jal la ngal ba'i gnas gang srid na su/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ zhes pa khyim dang nu ma'i khyad par brjod pa yi/ legs par sbyar ba de dag 'jig rten na srid pa tsam yin pas/ 'jig rten lugs kyi rjes su ni 'breng ba thams cad ha cang 'ud mi che ba'i rigs pas 'grub cing / mkhas blun kun la mdzes par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa shar pa la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod/ mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'jig rten yongs grags 'das shing / 'ud chen pos brjod 'dod kyi blos brjod bya'i don gang yin pa las shin tu phul du byung ba bkod par gyur (32na)pa de yis shar phyogs pa'i mkhas pa rnams shin tu tshim par gyur la/ cig shos lho phyogs pa'i mkhas pa rnams ni ma yin te/ dper na/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa la/ gtam dang / bsngags pa gnyis/ dang po ni dam pa khyod kyi 'khas rdul lhung ba yis/ /khyim gyi nyes pa'i tshogs dag ni ma lus par bkrus pas/ dus deng nas gzung ste/ bdag gi khyim ni lha'i khyim ste gzhal med khang bzhin du bsten par 'os so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dper na/ dpal mgrin mig gi gtsug phud can mthong tshe/ /dus mtha'i zhugs kyang sgron me ltar 'gro na/ /yid srubs rags pa'i lus de bsregs pa la/ /bsngags par brjod —235

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)rnams blo chung gtam du zad/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ mdzes ma khyod kyi nu 'bur ri rab las kyang che ba 'di lta bu rnam par rgyas par gyur pa 'di/ srid pa gsum na shong ba'i snod mi 'dug pas/'jig rten gyi byed po tshangs pa yis nges par ma brtags par nam mkha' 'di dag ni chung ngur sprul lo/ /dper na/ dpang lo'i mkhyen pa'i 'dom gyis chos tshul kun/ /dka' ba'i dogs bral skad cig la gzhal bas/ /gang blo'i dpyod la 'os pa'i shes bya zhig /rgyal dang byed pos lan brgyar sprul kyang nyungs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ de yang lho pa rnams bud med kyi mig zur rna ba'i bar du mi rdzogs zhes pa lta bu brjod pas/ 'ud cung zad byung yang 'jig rten na grags pa yin la/ shar pa rnams (32ba/yeg zur srid pa gsum du mi rdzogs zhes pa lta bu zer ro/ /gsum pa ni/ bshad ma thag pa 'di ni ha cang 'ud chen po brjod pas na go ḍa pa la mdzes par brjod la/ 'jug pa snga ma 'ud chung ba ni gzhan lho phyogs pa yi lam la snying po nyid du bshad do/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan bshad pa/bcu pa ting nge 'dzin la/ mtshan nyid/ dper brjod/ mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/nams ldan g.yin gyi chos de sems med gzhan dag la/ 'jig rten lugs kyi rjes su 'brangs te bkod nas/ tshig sbyor gang du brjod byed kyi sgra yang dag par 'dzin par byed pa de ni ting nge 'dzin zhes bya bar brjod de/ dper na/ che'o/so/ /gnyis pa la/ spyir bstan pa/ bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyi ma shar ba na ku mu ta ni kha zum pa la/ mig 'dzum zhes btags shing / pad+ma dag kyang kha bye ba la mig 'byed ces sems med chu skyes la sems ldan mig gi bya ba bkod pa las/ de yi rjod byed mig 'byed 'dzum gyi sgra dag sems med la thob bo /dper na/ bung ba snyan 'gyur glu dbyangs len pa la/ /pad+ma dga' bas ldem ldem mngon par —236

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)rgod/ /'dod pas nyen pa'i 'gron la phan pa'i ched/ /lho phyogs rlung gis tsan+d+ra dri khyer bros/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa la chos gcig bkod pa/ chos du ma bkod pa gnyis/ dang po rgyu mtshan dang / dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ na ṣ+ṭha ta dang u rlu r+ṇa gnyis ka skyugs pa la 'jug pa las/ 'dir (33na)dngos bstan bud med la sbyor rgyu yin kyang / de sgribs nas skyugs pa la sogs pa phal pa'am btags pa ba pad+ma dang nyi ma la 'jug pa'i sbyor ba la brten pa ni shin tu mdzes pa yin la/ gzhan du dngos bstan la sbyar na/ grong pa'i tshig nyid kyi nus pa brten pa ste mi mdzes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ nyi mas 'od zer skyugs pa rnams pad+mas bag med du 'thungs nas ge sar gyi rdul dmar po skyugs pa rnams kha yi dag byed chu'i zegs ma rnams kyang shin tu mang po skyug par byed pa bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i tshul de mdzes pa yin te/ mi mdzes pa ni/ chung mas chang mang po 'thungs pas bzi ste skyug par byed do/ /zhes pa'o/ /'dir skyugs pa'i chos gcig kho na la sbyar ba yin no/ /dper na/ drang srong dka' thub bsten la gnod dogs te/ /chu klung tshogs rnams sgra med gnyid la yur/ /spyil por brtsigs pa'i lo 'dab gzhon nu rnams/ /g.yo 'gul cung zad med par gnyid la song / /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa chos du ma bkod pa la/ 'dod tshul/ dper brjod/ don bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ der ma zad gzhi gcig la gcig car nyid du chos du ma bkod pa dag kyang ting nge 'dzin la 'dod de/ dper na/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ shin tu lci ba'i mngal gyi khur chen pos ngal zhing / 'brug gi sgra'i khun par byed pa sprin gyi phreng ba 'di dag g.yo ba med pa'i steng gi nam mkha'i phang ba dag tu yang dag par nyal lo/ / dper na/ lha lam char gyis (33ba lnga krus nas lus pho par /mtshams sprin gsar pas mtshan mor nye tshe 'khyud/ /chu 'dzin skyengs te sgrib g.yogs ci yang byed/ /'jug pa brgya pa lta phyir sgron me 'degs/ /che khi/pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ grogs mo 'ga' zhig gi phang par nyal ba dang / bun bu'i skad 'don pa dang / lus lci ba nyid dang / ngal ba zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshig sbyor 'dir ni/ bud med mngal ldan ma'i chos mang po rnams gzhan sprin gyi phreng ba la bstan no/ /—237—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2//le'u dang po'i mjug bsdu ba/gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ ting nge 'dzin zhes bya ba'i yon tan gang yin pa 'di ni/ snyan ngag rnams kyi nang nas bdog pa kun te gces pa'i nor yin pas/ snyan ngag mkhan po thams cad don mthun gyis te tshong pa'i tshogs dang 'dra ba rnams kyang ting nge 'dzin 'di nyid kyi rjes su 'brang ba ste gtso bor byed do/ /dpa' bo gtsug lag pas/ sgra nyams kyi skabs ṣa yig mtshungs pa lta bu'i bshad pa dang 'dra bar/ bod skad la yi ge mtshungs pa zhig dgos rgyu la/ dri mtshungs pa dang yon tan mtshungs pa sogs kyi rtog bzo mang du byas 'dug cing / mdor na sbyar ba sogs bcu po 'di'i skabs phal cher 'brel med kyi bshad pa kho nar 'dug pas ngan skyugs kyi phung po bzhin legs nyes kyi rtog dpyod byed tshod ma zin par bzhag go /gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ de ltar sngar bshad pa rnams ni/mkhas pa so so'i kun slong gi bsam pa'i rang bzhin btags pa las/ lho shar gyi lam ni de gnyis su rnam par phye ste (34na)bstan pa yin la/ de dag gi dbye ba phra mo rnams ni snyan ngag mkhan so so'i bshad tshul la gnas pa mang bas brjod par mi nus so/ /dper na/ bur shing dang / 'o ma dang / bu ram sogs kyi mngar ba nyid kyi khyad par che ba de lta bu bstan du ga la nus mod kyi/ de bzhin du snyan tshig mtha' dag dbyangs can mas kyang brjod par mi nus na bdag gi nus pa ma yin no/ /gsum pa snyan ngag gi rgyu la/ phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu snod du rung ba'i rgyu/ de ldan gyi phan yon dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i spobs pa skyes thob kyi shes rab dang / shes bya'i gnas mang du thos pa dang de dag the tshom 'khrul ba'i dri ma med pa dang / rig pa'i gnas sems pa dang bsgom pa la mngon par sbyor ba'i gus sbyor dang rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus mi dman pa ste/ de gsum ni snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu'o/ /—238—

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i phe/ dbyangs/ (wa)gnyis pa ni/ gal te sngon gyi bag chags sad pa'i yon tan gyi rjes su 'brel ba las byung ba'i spobs pa rmad du byung ba de med pa'i skye bo la'ang / rgyu gnyis pa thos pa dang / gsum pa 'bad pa dag gi sgo nas snyan ngag la brten na/ dbang po rno brtul ci zhig ltar yang nges par rjes su 'dzin pa ste snyan ngag shes par byed do/ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar mkhas pa'i grags pa 'dod pa rnams kyis ni rtag tu ni sgom las med par thos bsam gyi rim pas dbyangs can te snyan tshig rig byed dang /(34ba)de'i lha dbyangs can ma bsten par bya ste/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na/ snyan ngag chung ngu tsam la lus ngag gi ngal ba byas pa'i mi yang / mkhas pa'i mdun bang dag tu 'dug pa la dbang ba ste/ mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /snyan ngag me long las/ le'u dang po'i 'grel pa dang dper brjod bshad zin to/ /smras pa/ snyan tshig rig byed 'chi med dga' tshal du/ shar lho'i lam bzang dpag bsam ljon pa las/ /dka' gnad 'bras bur smin pa'i ro brgya'i bcud/ /rnam bshad yol gor phyur bur spungs pa 'dis/ /med byung blo yi lang tsho rnam par rgyas/ /mang du thos pa'i mig dkyus rna bar 'gong / /'bad rtsol mchu yi 'dab ma ci yang 'dzum/ shes ldan lus phra'i tshogs rnams ci dgar spyod/ /ston mtshan zla shel gsar pa'i mdzes sdug dang / rab snyan rgyud mang 'bum gyi sgra dbyangs kun/ /nyams dang 'gyur bar 'char ba'i legs bshad 'dis/ /byed po blo ldan phur bur 'khrul gyi dogs/ /zhes bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /—239

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2re/le'u gnyis pa/don rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/shes bya'i rang bzhin rnam par yangs pa'i mdzes sdug lang tshor chags pa'i spyan/ /srid las brgal ba'i dkyus ring zur gyis gtsug lag kun la 'jug pa'i rdzas/ /snyan 'gyur rig pa'i dbyangs dang lhan cig 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ngag gi lha/ /tshangs sras ma kye mgrin par bzhugs la ngag gi dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /ngo mtshar gtam gyi 'brug sgra mngal (35na 'dzin can/ /grangs med rgyan gyi sgro gshog rab bkra ba/ /bcad lhug spel ma'i nyams 'gyur stong gi gar/ /bsgyur te dpyod ldan yongs kyi gzigs mor che/ /ma rig chu 'dzin rgyar grol mtha' klas chos/ /skyes thob pir gyis snyan tshig mkhar bris pa'i/ /gnas lugs dbang gzhus bkra ba'i gur khyim nas/ /legs bshad dbyangs can rgyud mang ci yang sgrog /gnyis pa thun mong gi rgyan bshad pa la/ spyir bstan pa/ bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ rgyan ngos bzung ba/ de'i rnam grangs sngon byung 'dir bsdus tshul dang gnyis/ dang po ni/ sde bzhi sogs phun sum tshogs pa'i brjod bya'i srog dang ldan pa'i snyan ngag gi lus bcad lhug spel ma gsum dang ldan pa de mdzes par byed pa'i khyad par gyi chos rang bzhin brjod pa sogs kyi sbyor ba sna tshogs pa rnams rgyan zhes rab tu brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgyan de dag ni snyan ngag mkhan rnams kyis sngar bstan par ma zad/ da lta'ang rnam rtog gi spros pas mtha' med pa'i phyir/ de dag ma lus pa'i spros pa ni sus kyang 'chad par mi nus mod/ 'on kyang rnam rtog gi sa bon tsam ni sngon gyi slob dpon mkhas pa rnams kyis rnam grangs mang du bstan pa de nyid tshig don rnams rab tu nyung ngur gsal zhing 'gril bar legs par sbyar ba'i phyir na/ mkhas pa rnams yongs su ngal so ba'i gnas dam pa 'ji ni dbyug pa can bdag gi'o/ /gnyis pa la (35na〉5tshams sbyor dang bcas te —240

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)dam bca' ba/ bshad tshul dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ shar lha'i lam srol tha dad pa dag ni rnam par dbye ba'i don du sbyar ba sogs rgyan 'ga' zhig ni sngar yang bstan zin la/ shar lho thun mong dag tu 'dod pa'i rgyan gyi ni rigs gzhan 'og nas 'byung ba dag rab tu bstan par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la don rgyan/ sgra rgyan/ gab tshig gi rgyan dang gsum/ dang po la mdor bstan pa/rgyas par bshad pa/ zlos gar gyi mtshan nyid kyang rgyan du bstan pa/ mjug bsdu zhing ma bshad pa bslab tshul dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rang bzhin brjod dang dpe dang ni/ /gzugs can gsal byed bskor ba dang / /'gog dang don gzhan bkod pa dang / /ldog pa can dang srid pa can/ /bsdus dang phul byung rab brtags dang / /rgyu dang phra mo cha dang rim/ /dga' dang nyams ldan gzi brjid can//rnam grangs brjod dang kun tu phan/ /rgya che bston dor sbyar ba dang / /khyad par mtshungs par sbyor ba dang / /'gal dang skabs min bstod pa dang / /zol bstod nges par bstan pa dang / /lhan cig brjod dang yongs rjes shis/ /rab spel de nas dgongs pa can te rgyan so lnga po 'di dag brjod byed kyi tshig rnams dag gi ni mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan du/ sngon gyi slob dpon mkhas pa rā ma sha rma sogs shar lto'i snyan ngag mkhan rnams kyis bstan to/ /rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/gnyis pa la sum cu rtsa lnga las/ dang po rang bzhin brjod pa la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod/don bsdu zhing bsngags pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ brjod bya'i dngos (36na)po rnams kyi rang bzhin te ngo bo dang / de dag gi rnam pa'i gnas skabs sna tshogs pa rnams med pa la yod dang yod pa la med pa'i sgro bkur spangs te/ 8/gas bstan ma yin par gnas lugs thams cad dngos su gsal bar byed pa de ni rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan dang / rgyan sum cu rtsa lnga po'i nang nas dang po'i rgyan yin cing /—241

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ma/rnam grangs rigs sogs kyi dper brjod bzhi yod do/ /gnyis pa so so'i dper brjod bzhi las/dang po rigs ni/ mchu mdog ni dmar zhing / dbyibs gug pa dang / gshog pa 'jam zhing reg bya gnyen pa dang / mgrin pa dkar sngo dmar pa'i kha dog gsum gyi phreng ba can tshig 'jam por smra ba dang ldan pa rnams kyi gnas lugs rnams ne tso 'di dag ste thams cad la khyab pa dper mtshon nas/ chos gang la'ang de'i gnas lugs drang por brjod pas rang dang 'dra ba'i rigs kun la khyab la rigs rus kyi rigs ni ma yin no/ /dper na/ dmar ser thun mtshams gsar pa'i mdangs gsal zhing / /na tshod bcu drug bgrang bya'i dpal ldan pa/ /mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud lnga pa can/ /dbyangs can dga' mar thob pa'i 'jam pa'i dpal/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa bya ba ni/ byed po phug ron bya yul rang gi dga' ma la rtse bar 'dod pas bya ba'i khyad par mgrin pa'i nang nas skad cung zad mi gsal ba'i tshul gyis snyan par sgrog cing chags pas myos pa'i mig ni dmar po kun tu sgor sgor du 'phrul pa yi rnam pas dga' ma la yongs su bskor nas mchu dag sbyor ba sogs chags pa'i rnam (36bsnogyur byed do/ /dper na/ brtun pa skyed de me skyes yongs bsgrubs pas/ /legs par sbyar ba'i gtsug lag rab rtogs shing / /gzhen nu bde spyod re ba skong byed pa'i/ /dbang phyug go cha blo gsal dga' ba bskyed/ /ces pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ yul dga' ma mdzes ma yi ni lus la reg pa'i reg bya'i yon tan 'di yis yul can rang gi lus la spu long rgyas pa dang / yid ni bde bas tshim par byed pa dang /'dod pas myos pa'i mig dag zum par byed cing 'khrig pa la 'jug pas/ tshor ba bde ba thob bo/ /des mtshon te gzugs sgra dri ro sogs 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la sbyor ba yin la/ shong los/ mi 'jigs stobs dang ma 'dres chos/ /zhes sogs sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud kyi yon tan dang sbyar ba 'dis mi gnod dam snyam na/ zag med kyi yon tan de thugs kyi reg bya yin zhes slob dpon mkhas pa chen po gsung ngo / /—242

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)dper na/ 'jam zhing gnyen pa'i chu skyes gdan la gnas/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i btung bas rab tu ngoms/ /thig le'i dpyid gyur sgeg mor 'dren byed ni/ /bcu gnyis dag gis blta ba'i gser mngal can/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi pa ni/ lha rnams kyi bsod nams las 'khrungs par gyur pa'i khyu mchog gi rgyal mtshan lag tu 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug la gzhan la med pa'i gang zag gcig gis rang mtshan du bdag tu bzung ba'i rdzas/ rgya mtsho las byung ba'i dug brtsegs pa'i bum pa mgrin par bzhag pas mdog sngo ba dang / lag na bdud rtsi'i snod tshangs pa'i thod pa ni gnas pa dang /(37na ji bor rgya mtsho las byung ba'i zla ba'i cod pan gyis spras pa dang / snum zhing dmar ba'i ral pa nam mkha' khebs pa can ni tshangs pa sogs g.yin la med pas khyad par pa'o/ /dper na/ yid 'ong rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang na/ /phyogs kun blta ba'i 'dren byed stong g.yo zhing / /zho 'thung rus pa'i rtse brgya snyim pa na/ /'dzin mkhas grags pa'i mu khyud lha yi mgon/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i rigs dang / bya ba dang / yon tan dang / rdzas bzhi po dngos po'i rang bzhin gyi gnas lugs drang por brjod pa 'di 'dra ba ni/ spyir bstan bcos kun la rgyal po'i rgyal srid kyi mnga' thang ltar gtso che zhing / bye brag tu drang por brjod pa'i snyan ngag la'ang 'di dag nyid 'dod do/ /dpe rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/gnyis pa dpe rgyan la/ mtshan nyid/ dper brjod/ skyon yon/ mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ mtshon byed kyi dpe la ji ltar yod pa dag ji gzhig tu mtshon bya'i dpe can la de ltar yod par mtshungs pa gsal bar gang du rtogs par byed pa de ni dpe'i rgyan zhes bya ste/ de yi spros pa mtha' dag 'dir ni rab tu bshad par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la sum cu rtsa gnyis las/ dang po —243

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2rje/chos dpe ni/ /dpe can mdzes ma khyod kyi lag pa'i mthil ni/ dpe dkar dmar gyi mdangs dang ldan pa'i chu skyes bzhin du kun tu dmar bar chos mtshungs (37ba)so zhes pas chos dpe dngos su ni bstan te/ rgyu mtshan mtshungs pa'i chos dmar po dag sgras gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na/ngag dbang dbyangs can dgyes pa'i zhal gyi sgo/ / yid 'ong 'dzum pa'i dbus na bzhi bcu'i tshems/ /tshar du dngar 'di nyi 'od kyis khyab pa'i/ /gangs kyi ri bo lta bur dkar zhing mdzes/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa dngos dpe ni/ dpe can mdzes ma khyod kyi gdong dang mig dag ni/ dpe pad+ma dang ut+pal la sngon po bzhin no/ /zhes dpe dang dpe can gyi ngo bo tsam dngos su brjod nas/ mtshungs chos gdong dang pad+ma dkar zhing mdzes pa dang / mig dang ut+pal mthing zhing dkyus ring ba sogs dngos su mi gsal bar shugs la bstan pas mtshungs chos gcig tu rtogs par byed pa de ni dngos po'i dpe nyid do/ /dper na/ dbyangs can lha mo'i dbu skra'i zur phud 'di/ /sprin bral 'chi med lam dang yang dag mtshungs/ /lang tsho'i rang bzhin dar ba'i nu 'bur zung / /dbyar gyi chu 'dzin gsar pa g.yo ba bzhin/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa zlog pa'i dpe ni/ dpe can mdzes ma khyod kyi gdong bzhin du/ dpe pad+ma ni rnam par rgyas par gyur ro zhes pa de ni/ spyir 'jig rten grags tshod la dpes dpe can phar 'jal dgos pa la/ de las go zlog pa'i phyir zlog pa'i dpe zhes bya bar 'dod do/ /dper na/ 'jo sgeg nyams ldan brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sku/ /'od kyi phung po mngon par 'phro ba bzhin/ bcu gnyis (38na thad ga po 'char la mngon phyogs pa'i/ /mtshams sprin gsar pa'i kha dog yid du 'ong / /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi pa phan tshun gyi dpe ni/ dpe can mdzes ma khyod kyi zhal bzhin/ chu skyes mdzes pa ltar/dpe chu skyes bzhin du khyod kyi zhal yang mdzes so zhes pa dpe dpe can gnyis phan tshun 'jal res byas pa'i sgo nas dkar mdzes sogs gnyis ka la mtshungs pa'i khyad 'phags brjod par byed pa 'di ni phan tshun gyi dpe'o/ /dper na/ dbyangs can 'dod pa'i myos bum ji bzhin du/ /lang long g.yo ba'i chu 'dzin gsar —244

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (5)pa ste/ /sprin dkar lta bur khyod kyi nu 'bur yang / /rab dkar g.yo ba yid kyi dpal du 'jebs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ lnga pa nges pa'i dpe ni/ dpe can lus phra khyod kyi zhal ni/ dpe pad+ma nyid gcig pu dang mdzes pa sogs kyi sgo nas mtshungs kyi/ dpe can khyad par du 'phags pa'i dbang gis de'i dper 'os pa g.yin ni 'ga' zhig ste gang dang yang yod pa min no zhes pa ste/ 'jig rten na mtshungs pa g.yin zlog phyir/ 'di ni nges pa nyid kyi dpe'o/ /dper na/ snyan tshig gzhung lugs rgya mtsho smra ba la/ /ngag gi dpal grub shong ston lo tsā ba/ /mtsho byung snying gar rol ba daṇ+ḍi dang / /mtshungs kyi rigs mthun g.yin na yod ma yin/ /zhes pa lta bu/ drug pa nges med kyi dpe ni/ /re zhig dpe can lus phra khyod kyi gdong ni/ dpe pad+ma yi rjes su 'gro bar ma zad/ dpe gzhan yang / dpe pad+ma de dang 'dra ba gal te yod na gdong gi dpe des byed par 'gyur ro zhes pa 'di ni gcig tu (38bsgod pa'i dpe'o/ /dper na/ 'jam mgon bla ma kun mkhyen myong kha pa/ zheng rta chen po klu sgrub dang mtshungs kyi/ /gzhan du de 'dra'i ngang tshul ldan pa dag /srid 'dir mchis na khyod kyi dpe zlar rigs/ /zhes pa lta bu/bdun pa bsdus pa'i dpe ni/ dpe can khyod kyi gdong mdzes pa kho na yis/ dpe zla ba'i rjes su 'gro ba ma yin te/ bya ba'i khyad par gzhan dga' ba skyed par byed pa'i las kyis kyang zla ba dang mtshungs so zhes pa 'di 'dra yon tan gzhan dag bsdus pa'i dpe yang yod do/ /dper na/ chos rgyal dge dbang drang srong blo ldan dang / /snyan par smra ba'i ngag gi dngos grub dag /thob pa tsam gyis mtshungasamin legs bris kyi/ /phum sum tshogs pa'i ngang tshul ldan 'dis kyang / /zhes pa lta bu/brgyad pa phul byung gi dpe ni/ dpe can mdzes ma khyod kyi zhal ni/ khyod kyi gzugs nyid kho na las mthong zhing / dpe zla ba ni nam mkha' las mthong ba'i mthong yul gyi khyad par cung zad tsam 'di nyid kho nas tha dad de/ gzhan khyad par med ces 'ud chen po byas pa 'di phul byung gi dpe ste/ dngos gnas la gdong las lhag pa'i khyad par zla ba la mang du yod pas so/ /dper na/ skad gnyis smra ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / /ngag gi dbang phyug lha mo dbyangs can ma/ /'dod pa'i myos bum ldan dang mi —245

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)ldan gyi/ /dbye ba tsam las g.yin du tha mi dad/ /ces pa lta bu/ dgu pa rab btags ni/ dpe can mdzes ma de yi bzhin gyi dpal/ dpe zla ba nga nyid la yod ces zla ba snyems par byed mi dgos so zhes dpe la bsam pa (39na)med bzhin du sgro btags te/ zla ba khyod du ma zad pad+ma la yang mdzes ma'i gdong gi yon tan de yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa 'di ni rab btags kyi dpe'o/ /dper na/ 'jam mnyen chu skyes gzhen nu'i yal 'dab rnams/ /dbyangs can lha mo'i phyag gi sor mo'i dpal/ /snyemasapar mi 'tshal legs bris rked med ma'i/ /lag pa'i yal ga de yi dgra zla byed/ /ces pa lta bu/ bcu pa med byung gi dpe ni/ gal te dpe pad+ma 'ga' zhig la 'dod pas rnam par 'phrul ba'i mig dang ldan na/ dpe can smin legs ma khyod kyi bzhin gyi dpal 'dzin te/ zhes dpe mig dang ldan pa'i pad+ma dkon pa ltar byas te/ dpe can ngo mtshar bar ston pa 'di ni med byung gi dpe'o/ /dper na/ na tshod dar babs yan lag mchog ma yis/ /mi zad ngag gi dngos grub ster nus na/ /rna ba brgyad pa'i mche ba las 'ongs pa'i/ /ngag dbang dbyangs can ma de'i 'gran zlar byed/ /ces pa lta bu/ bcu gag pa rmongs pa'i dpe ni/ dpe can lus phra ma khyod kyi gdong dang / dpe ri bong can gnyis ha cang 'dra bas gang yin zhes brtags kyang shan ma phyed par/ khyod kyi gdong ni zla bar 'khrul ba'i bsam pa yis/chags pa'i dbang gis bco lnga'i zla ba shar ba 'di'i yang rjes su snyeg go /zhes pa 'di ni dpe can dpe ru 'brul bas rmongs pa'i dpe ru bshad do/ /dper na/ 'chi med yul du gshegs phyir shākya'i tog /kun gsal ngos su thogs med rgyu ba na/ /(39bskyo bdun mkha' la 'gro zhes blun po 'ga'/ /pad dkar 'dab ma 'dzum la lta phyir rgyug /ces pa lta bu/ bcu gnyis pa the tshom gyi dpe ni/ dpe khyad gzhi pad+ma'i nang du khyad chos kyi bung ba 'khor ba'am/ dpe can khyad gzhi mdzes ma khyod kyi gdong pa la khyad chos mig g.yo ba gang rung zhig ci ltar yin pa 'dra yang / bdag gi sems ni the tshom gyi rnam par g.yo ba las gcig tu ngos ma zin no/ /zhes pa 'di ni the tshom gyi dpe'o/ /—246

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)dper na/ smra mkhas drang srong lha yi bla ma de/ /'dzam bus mdzes pa'i gling 'dir 'ongs pa'am/ /yang na thams cad mkhyen pa chos skyong bzang / /'chad rtsod rtsom la brel snyam 'phyang mo nyug /ces pa lta bu/ bcu gsum pa gtan la 'bebs pa'i dpe ni/ zla ba kha skyengs par byed pa'i shin tu mdzes pa 'di dpe pad+ma ma yin te/ pad+ma de ni zla bas tshar gcod cing zum par byed la/ 'di tshang mi gcod pa de'i phyir/ zla bas mi 'joms pa'i dpe can mdzes ma khyod kyi gdong nyid do/ /ces dpe dpe can zla bas 'joms mi 'joms kyi nges tshig yod pa 'di gtan la phebs pa'i dpe'o/ dper na/ brda' sprod gzhung brgya smra ba'i slob dpon 'di/ /lha chen sras po gdong drug dang mtshungs kyang / /gangs can ljongs 'dir legs sbyar ston pa'i phyir/ /pang ston lo chen blo gros brtan par nges/ /zhes pa lta bu/bcu bzhi pa sbyar ba'i dpe ni/ 'di ni don sbyar ba yin pas/ sbyor lugs dpe can mdzes ma'i gdong gis mdzes pa'i (40na〉sgo nas bsil zer can gyi 'gran zla byed pa dang / dpe pad+mas nyi ma'i phyogs yin pa'i sgo nas 'gran zla byed pa sbyar/ de bzhin du dpe can la mdzes pa'i dpal dang / dpe la bung ba'i dpal ldan pa sbyar/ dpe can mdzes ma'i kha la ut+pa la'i dri dang / dpe gsar gyi dri bzang po gnyis sbyar nas/ dpe can khyod kyi gdong ni/ dpe chu skyes bzhin no/ /zhes mtshungs pa'i sgra dngos su yod pa'i sgo nas sbyor rgyu gnyis las mi nyung ba ni sbyar ba'i dpe ru bshad do/ /dper na/ gang zhig bsten na legs pa'i dpal ster zhing / /mi mthun rgud pa'i tshogs kyi dgrar gyur pa/ /srid 'dir shin tu rnyed dka' zas gtsang sras/ /yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal por yang dag mchungs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bco lnga pa mnyam nyid kyi dpe ni/ mtshudas par phyi nus na/ sgra ga ṇi ga la gcod mtshams mi 'dra ba gnyis sam/ ming gcig la don mi 'dra ba gnyis su byed pa gang rung gis dpe dpe can gnyis mnyam pa nyid du brjod par nus par bya ba'i phyir mnyam nyid kyi dpe ste/ ji ltar na/ dpe can skyed mos tshal gyi phreng ba 'di/ dpe bu mo bzhin du mdzes pa dang ldan no/ /mtshungs chos swā la ste spos dkar gyi shing dang / kwa na na nags te/ skyed tshal spos dkar shing gi nags kyis mdzes —247

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheso/ /gcod mtshams gcig la/ sa bcas pa/ a la ka lan bu/ ā na na gdong pa/ mtshungs 'dra byas pas/ bu mo gdong (40ba)lan bu dang bcas pas mdzes so/ /yang na ming gcig pa la don mi 'dra ba/ kun las rnam par rgyal ba la sangs rgyas dang khyab 'jug mtshungs kyang / rgyal lugs mi gcig pa ste/ dper na/ stobs bcu mi 'jigs bzhi yi rtsal rnams kun/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen/ /mkhar nyal gtso bo tha gu'i lto can bzhin/ /kun las rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang phyug thob/ /ces pa lta bu/ 'di'i skabs 'jam kha dang / bya gshongs klu sgrub pa gnyis kyis sbyar ba dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bshad pa rnams ni rgyu mtshan med pa'i rtog btags kho nar 'dug cing / snar thang pa dang / zur mkhar ba gnyis kyis sgra rkyang par sbyar ba ni ha cang gu dog grags la rin spungs pas/'og gi sbyar rgyan kun la'ang zhes gsungs kyang / 'dir mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra dang bcas dgos shing / 'og ma rnams la sbyor tshul yang sna tshogs yod pas/ 'di'i rtsod spong la gsung ba ni nya dang nyung ma bsres pa'o/ /des na kho bo ni/ slob dpon mkhas pa'i gsung rgyun la brten nas 'di ltar smra ste/ sbyar ba'i dpe la ni mtshungs pa'i yon tan gnyis las mi nyung ba zhig dgos pa dang / don la sbyar ba yin la/'dir ni mtshungs pa'i yon tan gcig gis chog cing / sgra don gang la sbyar yang khyad par med pas/legs bshad kyi sor mos 'grel byed mkhan po rnams sbugs thum kyi sgrog tu tshud pa legs par bkrol ba yin no/ /(41na)bcu drug pa med pa'i dpe ni/ dpe pad+ma dang zla ba gnyis rim bzhin ge sar gyi rdul mang ba dang / nag phyogs la mdzad pas/ de dag las ni dpe can mdzes ma khyod kyi bzhin mtshungs pa la yang khyad par du 'phags pa dang bcas so zhes pa med pa'i dpe ru 'dod do/ /dper na/ dpal mo'i glu dbyangs yul gyis rnam par skal/ /dbyar skyes rnga gsang dus kyi gzhan dbang gyur/ /de dag tshogs las tshangs sras lha mo'i gsung / /mtshungs pa las kyang khyad par mang du mchis/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bcu bdun pa bsngags pa'i dpe ni/ dpe pad+mas tshangs pa mchog tu —248

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i che1 dbyangs/ (wa)bskyed pa dang / zla ba bde 'byung gi gtsug gis 'dzin zhes bsngags te/ de dag dang dpe can mdzes ma khyod kyi gdong mtshungs zhes pa/ de ni dpe la bsngags pa'i dper brjod do/ /dper na/ mi bsrun glags lta'i rgol ngan rab 'joms shing / /blo gsal tshogs rnams chos kyis tshim byed pa'i/ /thogs med sku mched ji bzhin btsong kha pa/ /lhar bcas skye dgu'i gtsug na mngon par mdzes/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bco brgyad pa brjod 'dod kyi dpe ni/ dkar ba'i yon tan dang ldan ni/ /re re'i skyon dang ldan par gyur kyang / /dpe zla ba dang / dpe can mdzes ma khyod kyi gdong mtshungs zhes pa brjod 'dod rtsom pa po bdag gi yid la yod do/ /zhes shugs kyi dpe'i yon tan dang mtshungs par go ba ni brjod 'dod kyi dpe zhes rig go /dper na/ legs pa'i (41ba〉rgon tan 'ba' zhig nyer ston pa'i/ /tshangs sras ngag gi lha mo'i snyan 'gyur gsung / /ka la ping ga'i dbyangs dang mtshungs brjod la/ /ji ltar gyur kyang yid kyi ngos su shar/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bcu dgu pa 'gal ba'i dpe ni/ dpe 'dab brgya pa dang ston zla gnyis/ dpe can mdzes ma khyod kyi gdong dang gsum po 'di ni mdzes chos la khyad par med kyang / de gsum gnas pa'am rten sa tha dad pa'i ngos nas/ phan tshun rnam par 'gal ces pa/ de ni/ shugs la mdzes pa sogs mtshungs par bstan pas 'gal ba'i dper brjod do/ /dper na/ smra ba'i dbang phyug drang srong me bzhi skyes/ /ngag gi dpal thob slob dpon da lha'i zhabs/ /gnas lnga rig pa lo chen blo gros brtan/ /'di gsum phan tshun rnam par 'gal ba nyid/ /ces pa lta bu/ nyi shu pa dgag pa'i dpe ni/ 'gog byed dri ma ldan zhid blun par gyur pas/ dgag bya dpe zla ba la ni/ dpe can mdzes ma khyod kyi gdong dang 'gran pa'i nus pa nam yang med do/ /zhes pa dpe dman pas mi mtshungs pa ltar dngos su bstan pa'i shugs la dkar ba sogs 'dra bar bstan pa ni dgag pa'i dpe nyid do/ /dper na/ ba mo'i reg pa chung ngus rnyings byed cing / /bung ba'i 'phur lding 'phrul yang phyi rol gzugs/ /mthong min 'dam skyes gzhon nus dbyangs can ma'i/ /yid 'ong —249

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)zhal gyi khyim dang ci zhig mtshungs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nyer gcig pa ngo bstod kyi dpe ni/ dpe can mdzes ma khyod gdong ri dwags kyi mig gis mtshan la/ dpe zla ba ni ri dwags nyid kyis mtshan pa (42na8 lta na dpe cung zad lhag dgos rgyu yin3kyang / 'di gnyis mtshungs pa nyid las/ dpe khyad 'phags min zhes dpe can la ngo bstod kyi dpe'o/ /dper na/ rgyal ba'i dbu skyes dbang sngon mdangs 'dzin zhing / /in+d+ra ni la'i rdul rtsegs dbang sngon dngos/ /'on kyang snang byed yul du mthon mthing 'od/ /mngon par mtsher la khyad par ci zhig mchis/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nyer gnyis pa de nyid brjod pa'i dpe ni 'di ni dpe can mdzes ma'i bzhin nyid yin gyi/ dpe pad+ma ni ma yin no/ /'di dag ni dpe bung ba ma yin gyi/ dpe can mig go zhes pa dkar mdzes sogs phan tshun rnam pa gsal bar mtshungs pa las/ dpe can dpe ru ma 'khrul bar gnas lugs nges pa de ni de nyid brjod pa'i dpe'o/ /dper na/ kha dog rnam par bkra 'di dbang gzhu dang / /mtshungs kyang 'ja' min 'chi med lha yi gos/ zhan tu snyan 'di bung ba'i skad 'dra yang / /ma yin dbyangs can phyag gi rgyud mang sgra/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nyer gsum pa thun mong min pa'i dpe ni/ dpe zla ba dang pad+ma dag gi ni mdzes pa las 'das pa'i dpe can mdzes ma khyod kyi gdong la dper 'os pa gzhan med pas/ bdag ste rang nyid kyi dper rang nyid mtshungs par gyur zhes pa thun mong ma yin pa'i dpe'o/ /dper na/ rab dkar chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor dang / /ut+pal 'dab mas mdzes pa'i cha tsam du/ /mtshungs pa'i go skabs bral bas mtshar ba'i dper/ /rang nyid (42ba〉legs bstan tshangs sras lus phra ma/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nyer bzhi pa 'byung min gyi dpe ni/ dpe pad+ma mdzes pa'i snying po kun byed pos phyogs 'ga' zhig dag tu bsdus pa ni mi 'byung la/ gal ste byung na de bzhin du dpe can mdzes ma khyod kyi zhal rnam par mdzes pa'i dpe'o zhes pa de ni 'byung min gyi dpe zhes rig go /dper na/ mang thos yon tan khur gyis rab lci ba'i/ /gnas lnga'i mthar son rin chen chos skyong bzang / /mkhas grub bye ba'i 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yi/ /blo gros mtha' dag gcig tu —250

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)gyur pa 'dra/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nyer lnga pa srid min gyi dpe ni/ dpe zla ba'i gzugs dang tsan+dan las ni rim bzhin dug dang me mi 'byung ba bzhin du/ dpe can dam pa khyod kyi zhal 'di las ni rtsub mo'i tshig mi 'byung ngo / /zhes pa srid pa min pa'i dpe'o/ /dper na/ kun phan zer gyis bskyed pa'i stug po'i mun/ /dpag bsam yongs 'du las 'ongs dri ngan bzhin/ /zur phud lnga pa'i mkhyen pa las brgal bas/ /ji snyed brtan g.yo'i chos de gang du ci/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nyer drug pa mang ba'i dpe ni/ dpe tsan+dan/ gangs chu dang zla ba'i zer/ zla shel sogs bzhin du mdzes ma khyod kyi lus ni reg pa yang bsil lo zhes dpe mang po zhig gis/ dpe can gcig gi khyad par dag gsal bar byed pa mang ba'i dpe'o/ /dper na/ dbyig 'dzin rdul phran grangs dang kun gsal mtha'/ /bskal pa'i char rgyun na kra'i grong (43na)khyer gting / /gser mngal can gyi grangs yas legs byas kyi/ /rjes 'gro rnam 'dren mkhyen brtse'i gting dpag dka'/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /nyer bdun pa rnam 'gyur gyi dpe ni/ /dpe can lus phra ma khyod kyi bzhin ras ni/ dpe zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dkyil nas tshur bton pa bzhin/ dpe pad+ma'i nang nas tshur phyung ba bzhin/ zhes pa 'di ni rnam 'gyur gyi dpe'o/ /dpal sgang lo tsā bas/ in+d+ra ni las byugs pa bzhin zhes phar byugs par bshad pa ni gzhung don dang ma 'brel zhing / khyed kyi gsung phal cher legs par bshad par 'dug na'ang / skabs 'gar nyes bshad mdzad pa bden par mchi ste/ ma mdzad na khyed dang zur mkhar ba gnyis ga rma pa'i khrod du pho rog dkar po byung gis dogs pa'o/ /dper na/ gangs can mkhas pa'i dbang po shong ston rje/ /'phags yul paṇa chen khrod nas byon pa bzhin/ /sngon med legs par bshad pa'i gsung gi tshogs/ /drang srong phur bu'i ngag las blangs pa bzhin/ /zhes pa lta bu/nyer brgyad pa phreng ba'i dpe ni/ dpe nyi ma'i 'od kyis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gzi brjid 'dzin pa bzhin du/ dpe can nyi ma yis nyin mo la snang ba 'dzin/ yang dpe can de dper byas pa bzhin du/ dpe can nyi mo'i snang ba des nam mkha' la gsal ba'i dpal 'dzin/ dpe can de dper —251 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)byas pa bzhin du/ dpe can gzhan sde rnam par gnon pa'i rgyal po khyod kyi dbang phyug dam (43ba)pa'i dpal 'dzin zhes snga ma snga ma dpe dang / phyi ma phyi ma dpe can du bkod pa de ni phreng ba'i dpe'o/ /dper na/ sgra gcan gyis ni nyi ma 'joms pa bzhin/ /rta ljang can gyis zla ba'i 'od la bzhin//ri dwags mtshan mas pad dkar 'joms pa ltar/ /dbyangs can lha mos mi shes rmongs tshogos 'joms/ /stuskos pa 9 2 ja//nyer dgu pa ngag don gyi dpe la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba gnyis dang po ni/ gang yang ngag gi don byed can drug las/ gsum pa dang gnyis pa gtso bor gyur pa nyid kyis gal te ngag don gyi dpe dpe can gyis khyad gzhi khyad chos go rim bzhin du nye bar 'jal nas ngag don gyi dpe ste de la bzhin sgra ni gcig dang du ma yod pa de rnam pa gnyis so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis las/ bzhin sgra gcig pa ni/ dpe can gyi khyad gzhi mdzes ma khyod kyi gdong / khyad chos mig ni mi brtan pa ste g.yo zhing / so yi 'od zer rab tu gsal ba 'di ni/ dpe khyad gzhi 'dam skyes dang / khyad chos bung ba g.yo ba dang ldan pa dang ni/ge sar dag gis mtshon bzhin mdzes so/ /dpe gsum gyi dpe can gsum go rim bzhin du mjal zhing / gis zhes gsum pa dang / mdzes zhes gnyis pa dang / bzhin sgra gcig yod pa'o/ /dper na/ 'jam dkar phyag sor rtse na ut+pa la'i/ /'khri shing steng na shes rab ral gri can/ /gangs ri'i rtse na sprin dkar g.yo ba la/ /nyi 'od kyis khyab bzhin du rnam par gsal/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa bzhin sgra du ma yod pa ni/ dpe pad+ma can sdong po bzhin du/ dpe can lus phra ma gnyis po (44na)khyad gzhi dang / khyad chos dpe pad+ma bzhin du dpe can de'i gdong pa/ dpe bung bas sbrang rtsi spyod pa bzhin du ni dpe can bdag gis 'thung zhing la thung zhing ste dga' mgur rtses so/ /zhes gyis gsung pa dang / 'thung dang rtse gnyis pa bzhin sgra mang du yod pa ste/ dper na/ be+eḍūr brtsegs pa'i ri bzhin thub dbang sku/ /gser mdangs mngon par bkra bzhin gang gi 'od/ /rlung gis bsgul nus min bzhin sgrib gnyis dgras/ /nam yang g.yo med spangs dang rtogs pa rdzogs/ /zhes pa lta bu/—252

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)sum cu pa zla bo'i dngos dpe la/ mtshan nyid dang / dper brjod/ dang po ni/ dpe can gyi dngos po 'ga' zhig phyed snga ma la nye bar bkod nas/ phyed phyi ma la de'i chos mthun gyi dpe rab tu bkod pas/dpe dpe can gnyis don mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa can de ni zla ba'i dngos po'i dpe yin te/ dper na/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dpe can 'dir rgyal po rnams ni mang du skyes par gyur kyang / da lta khyod dang 'dra ba ni gcig kyang med la/ de'i zla bo ste dpe yongs 'du'i tshal dag la dpag bsam gyi rkang 'thung ni gnyis pa nges par yod pa ma yin pas gcig /kho na'o/ /dper na/ sgron me'i bskal par sangs rgyas mang byon kyang / shwakya'i skyes mchog khyod kyi do zla med/ /chos bzang mdun sar skabs gsum grangs med dbus/ /pu lo ma dgra gnyis pa su zhig mchib / /che ni tha su pa shā/ sdo//so gcig pa mtshungs sbyor la/ mtshan nyid dang / dper brjod/ (44bsko nyis/ dang po ni/dpe lhag pa gcig gis dpe can dman pa gcig bya ba'i cho ga gcig la rab tu bsdus nas/ gang smras pa de ni dpe can mtshungs par ston pa dag sbyor ba'i dpe ru bshad de/ dper na/ gnyis pa ni/dpe lhag pa pu lo ma dgra de dang / dpe can dman pa mi'i bdag po khyod gnyis 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan/dpe de yis mtho ris bsrung ba dang / dregs ldan lha min 'joms pa dang / dpe can khyod kyis sa gzhi skyong ba'i mel tshe byed cing / 'gal zla'i mi'i bdag po 'joms pa'i bya ba'i cho ga gcig la bsdus pa ste/ dper na/ bu ram shing pa theg gsum gdul bya dang / /dpal mgrin mu stegs tsho gos kyi ston pa mdzad/ /rgyal bas mthar thug nges legs lam bston ba chin/ /legs ldan gnas skabs dge ba'i gtsug lag 'chad/ /ces pa lta bu/so gnyis pa rgyu'i rgyan ni/ /dpe can rgyal po khyod mdzes pa'i rgyus dpe zla ba dang / gzi byin gyis rgyus dpe nyi ma dang / brtan pa'i rgyus dpe rgya mtsho'i rjes su byed ces pa 'di ni rgyu dper dran par bya'o/ /dper na/ lus phra'i bzhin ras dkar bas bsil sbyin mkhan/ /yid du 'ong bas mtho —253—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2re/ris dbang mo ste/ /'jam zhing mnyen pas 0 la yi 'dab/ /mig dkyus bkra bas dbang po'i gzhu yi zla/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa skyon yon la/ yon tan dang / skyon gnyis/ dang po la mtshams sbyar ba/ dper brjod/ don bsdu (45na tha dang gsum/ dang po ni/ blo ldan snyan ngag la mi dgos pa med pa gang la/ nges par dpe rgyan gyi skyon dag ni/ pho mo ma ning gi rtags tha dad pa 'dres pa dang / gcig tshig dang mang tshig sbyar ba dang / mig dman pa dang lhag pa nyid la'ang skabs thob kyis sbyor shes na skyon med do/ /gnyis pa la rtags tshig la skyon med pa dang / dpe la skyon med pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dpe can ma ning 'di/ dpe bud med bzhin du 'gro'o dpe can bud med 'di dpe skyes pa bzhin du smra'o/ /zhes pa rtags 'dres pa dang / dpe can bdag gi grogs gcig pu 'di dpe tshe 'di phyi mang po'i srog rnams bzhin no/ /dpe can rig pa'i gnas lnga rnams bsgrubs pa dpe yid bzhin gyi nor bu gcig bzhin no/ /zhes tshig mang nyung sbyar ba ste/ dper na/ 'jam dpal dbyangs ni smra lamatsho byung bzhin/ /dbyangs can ma ni mthu stobs gsang bdag ltar/ /mdzes ma'i gdong ni dpe 'dab tshogs kun bzhin/ /mi bdag rnams ltar 'chi med gtso bo 'di/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ dpe sa gzhi skyong ba khyod bzhin du/ dpe can lha yi rgyal po rnam par mdzes so/ /zhes dpe dman pa dang / dpe tsha zer can gyi nus pa la/ dpe can mi bdag gzi brjid kyis 'gong bar nus so/ /zhes dpe lhag pa ste/dper na/ g.yon ma khyod kyi mdzes sdug rnam 'gyur ltar/ /tshangs pa'i sras mo 'di ni yid du 'ong / /dri za'i pi wang snyan zhing 'jibs pa yis/ /(45ba〉tsa ra ka yi skad kyi 'gran zla byas/ /snyes pa lta bu/gsum pa ni/ zhes pa de lta bu la sogs pa'i skal ba bzang po 'di dag nam yang gtong ba min pa nyid do/ /gnyis pa skyon la/ mtshams sbyar ba/ dper brjod/ mjug bsdu ba dang / dang po ni/ rtags tshig dpe dman lhag sogs kyi sbyor ba 'ga' zhig la ni snyan ngag rig pa'i mkhas pa rnams mi dgas pa yod de/ de ji ltar yod ce na/ gnyis pa ni/ dpe dang mo bzhin du/ dpe can pho rtags zla ba dkar/—254

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)dpe mang tshig mtsho rnams bzhin du/dpe can mkha' gcig pu dri ma med/dpe dman pa khyi bzhin du dpe can dpa' bo rje la gus/dpe lhag pa nyi ma bzhin du dpe can me khyer gsal zhes pa ste/dper na/dpal mo'i bzhin 'di rgyal ba'i mtshan bzang zla/khyu skar tshogs bzhin kun+da'i 'dab ma dkar//glang po'i 'gros ltar rta ljang lhag par mgyogs//yongs 'du ji bzhin seng ldeng rkang 'thung dkon//zhes pa lta bu/gsum pa ni/sbyor ba ngan pa 'di 'dra ba spangs te/mkhas pa rnams kyi snyan ngag gi rgyu phun sum tshogs pa yang dag par 'dir ni bsam par byos shig/mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi skor bshad pa/bzhi pa mtshungs pa gsal byed la/gzhung gis dngos su zin pa drug cu rtsa gsum bshad/ma zin pa ngag gi dbang phyug gi 'grel pa las bcu gcig bshad pa gnyis/dang po la sde tshan bzhin phye ba'i dang po ni/bzhin ni/dmar ser mdangs can thun mtshams kha dog bzhin//'jam mgon zhal 46na ) khyim mig gi bdud rtsi'i dpyid//ces pa lta bu/ltar ni/dri za'i rgyud mang sgra ltar dbyangs can ma'i//snyan 'gyur gsung 'di rna ba'i dpal du 'jebs//zhes pa lta bu/lta bu ni/brtan g.yo'i chos kun dbang sdud lha mo'i phyag/byu ru'i khri shing lta bur dmar zhing mdzes//zhes pa lta bu/ji ltar sgra ni/ka la ping ga'i sgra dbyangs ji lta ba/ri dwags mig can klu yi thos 'dzin spud//ces pa lta bu/mthun pa ni/shong ston zhal sgo las 'ongs legs bshad kun//mkhas mchog tsan+d+ra go mi'i gsung dang mthun//zhes pa lta bu/mtshungs pa ni/gser mngal bu mo'i dbu skyes lan bu 'di//stang zil brtsegs pa'i ri bo'i mdog dang mtshungs//zhes pa lta bu/yang dag mtshungs pa ni/yon por lta ba'i 'dren byed pad tshal du//bung ba'i 'phur lding bgyid dang yang dag mtshungs//zhes pa lta bu/mnyam pa ni/mtsho ldan sku stod 'dod pa'i myos bum gyi//mdzes pa mkha' la sprin dkar g.yo dang mnyam//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shezhes pa lta bu yang dag gsal ni/ rgyal bas skye dgu'i re 'dod skong ba yis/ /dpag bsam yongs 'du'i rang bzhin yang dag gsal/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nges par gsal ni/ gzhal bar ches dka' chos gzugs sku gnyis kyis/ /tshogs gnyis pha mtha' nges par gsal bar byas/ /ces pa lta bu/ rab gsal ni/ yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs snyan rab gsal bas/ /grangs med chos 'khor bskor ba'i ngo mtshar rtogs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gzugs kyi zla bo ni/ (46bsgo thong na mi mthun med pa'i mtshan dpe'i sku/ /'dzam bu'i gser sbyangs ri yi gzugs kyi zla/ zhes pa lta bu/ gnyen po ni/ gtsug na zla ba'i ri mo gsum pa'i mdog /in+d+ra ni la'i phung po'i gnyen po byas/ /zhes pa lta bu/ dgra zla ni dbyangs can zhal gyi dri bsung mngar ba yis/ /ma la yar skyes gang gi dgra zla byed/ /ces pa lta bu/so sor rtogs pa ni/ phyag sor rtse yi be+eḍūr pi wang dang / /rab snyan tshangs pa'i dbyangs gnyis so sor rtogs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ /mgrin pa ni ngag gi 'dod pa mtha' dag legs 'jo bas/ /yongs 'du'i shing dang yid bzhin nor bur 'gran/ /zhes pa lta bu/ 'dra ba ni/ thugs rje'i mi shes rmongs pa 'joms pa la/ /mgrin sngon can gyi lag pa'i nyag phran 'dra/ /zhes pa lta bu/ lta ba ni/ 'gro la rgyun chad med par rjes brtse ba/ /dzaḥ yi bu mo'i rgyun la lta/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bcas pa ni/ nye ring med par kun khyab thugs rje 'di/ khom mkha'i nor bu'i 'od kyi rang bzhin bcas/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bslu ba ni/phul byung chu zheng gab pa'i sku gzugs kyis/ /legs bris bu mo'i tshogs kyi mdzes pa bslu/ /zhes pa lta bu/ rigs mthun ni/ rab dkar mnyen 'jam chu skyes dbus bzhugs pas/ /mes po gser mngal can dang rigs su mthun/ /zhes pa lta bu/ rjes su smra ba ni/ lang tsho'i dpal yon dar la bab pa yis/ /mtho ris dbang mo dag gi rjes su smra/ /zhes pa lta bu/sde tshan gnyis pa la/ gzugs brnyan ni/ rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i (47na skong byed dkyus/ /ut+pal sngon po'i 'dab ma'i gzugs brnyan can/ /zhes pa lta bu/ so sor sdeb ni/ rab dmar gtam gyi 'byung gnas mchu sgros dang / /bas dzi wa ka gnyis so sor sdeb/ /ces pa lta bu/—256)

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)gzugs mtshungs pa ni/ 'jo sgeg 'gying bag sku yi rnam 'gyur 'di/ /rdo rje dbyangs kyi dbang phyug gzugs mtshungs nyid/ /ces pa lta bu/ gzugs mnyam pa ni/ dbu skra'i thor tshugs cung zad g.yon phyogs pa/ /dri za'i bu mo'i mthon mthing skra'i gzugs mnyam/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gzugs yang dag par gzhal ba ni/ mi shes dra ba gcod pa'i ral gri yis/ /mig stong can gyi lag nyal yang dag gzhal/ /zhes pa lta bu mtshan nyid mthun pa ni/ shes rab snang ba ma lus skyed pa la/ /tshangs sras dbyangs ldan ma dang mtshan nyid mthun/ /zhes pa lta bu/ mtshan nyid 'dra ba ni/ li khri'i mdangs kyi mdzes pa 'dzin pa la/ /dbang phyogs thun mtshams gsar pa'i mtshan nyid 'dra/ /zhes pa lta bu/ mtshan nyid mtshungasapa ni/ zhal khyim 'dzum gyis 'gro ba'i dbugs dbyung bar/ /kun mkhyen nyi ma'i rgyud dang mtshan nyid mtshungs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ drug pa 'di'i sbyor lugs 'grel pa rnams la mi gsal yang / slob dpon smon 'gro paṇ+ḍi ta'i legs par bshad pa'o/ /mthun phyogs ni/ sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spud pa dang / /mthun phyogs mig skya'i gan mdzod nor gyis dpya/ /zhes pa lta(47ba)bu/ dper byas ni/ sku stod lha rdzas dar kyi lhab lhub gos/ /rnam bkra'i dpe ru rlung gi rgyal mtshan byas/ /zhes pa lta bu/ /dpe ni/ phyag sor rtse na 'dam skyes g.yur za ba'i/ /dpe ru 'khri shing yal gar me tog ldem/ /zhes pa lta bu/ rtog ni/ mtha' bral zla ba'i ma ma'i gting dpag gis/ /chos kun gzhal ba'i thugs kyi tshad la rtog /ces pa lta bu/ dman pa ni/gang gi rigs pa smra ba'i rnam dpyod las/ /phan sems zhan pas phur bu'i snang tshul dman/ /zhes pa lta bu/ cung zad dman pa sogs ni/ gang dang mkhyen brtse mtshungs pa'i dbyangs can lha/ /khyod las rten gyi sgo nas cung zad dman/ /zhes pa lta bu/ rab tu smra ba ni/ chos kun dbyangs su len pa'i rgyal ba'i gsung / /zur phud lnga pa'i zhal las rab tu smra/ /zhes pa lta bu/ so sor zlog ni/ mnyen 'jam ljag dang tshems dkar bzhi bcu'i phreng / /pad 'dab mu tig byug ris so sor zlog /ces pa lta bu/rigs mthun mnyam byas sgra dag ni/ 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i zur mig gis/ /dbyangs ldan snang —257

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)byed dag dang rigs su mthun/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gang yang dpe don gnyis ka dman pa min pa'i don can gyi tshig chos mthun pa ni/ stobs bcu mnga' ba khyod kyis gsungs pa'i chos/ /rgyun chad med pa'i yan lag brgyad ldan chab/ /ces pa lta bu/ chos thun mong ni/ mchog dman skyes bu kun gyi thun mong du/ /longs su spyod pa'i nyi 'od (4sha po ser ldan gzhi/ /zhes pa lta bu/ grib ma 'dra ba ni/ chos ldan sa dbang rgyal po'i bka' khrims dang / /ljon pa'i grib mar 'gro rnams bde bar 'tsho/ /zhes pa lta bu/ sde tshan gsum pa ni/ gang gi gdong ri bong gi mtshan ma'i gdong pa can zhes sogs gzhi mthun du bsdus pa dang / 'bru mang po'i tshig sdud ni/ nam mkha'i mkhyen pa char gyi thugs rje can/ khri za'i sgra dbyangs gsung dang bung ba'i sgra/ /mtshams sprin bla gos gser gyi ri dbang dkyus/ /'gro ba kun gyi re 'dod rnam par skong / /zhes pa lta bu/ 'gran pa ni/ skye bo kun la bde ba ches ster bas/ /gar shi mdzes dga'i lus la rnam par 'gran/ /zhes pa lta bu/ rgyal ba ni/ 'od kyi phung po'i gzi ldan zhal gyi khyim/ /sgra can gyis sgrib rta ljang can las rgyal/ /zhes pa lta bu/ sdang ba ni/ bsil ldan kha ba'i ri la ches sdang ba'i/ /rab dkar mdzod spu'i mdzes pa ngo mtshar med/ /ces pa lta bu/ 'khru ba ni/ rnam dpyod rgya gar mkhas la 'khru ba yi/ khong ston 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i tshul 'di dpa'/ /zhes pa lta bu mi mthun sgrog pa ni/ bod yul shes ldan chos skyong bzang po dang / /lha yi bla ma'i snang tshul mi mthun sgrog/ces pa lta bu/ 'thab pa ni/ g.yon mig mdzes ma'i snyim pa chu skyes gnyis/ /dkar zhing mdzes pa'i tshul la rnam par 'thab/ /ces pa lta bu/ 'phya ba ni/ dpang ston blo gros brtan pa'i legs bshad kyis/ /paṇa chen (48bskoṇ+ḍi'i gsung la rnam par 'phya/ /zhes pa lta bu/ sma 'bebs byed pa ni/ 'brug sgra mngal 'dzin sgro gshog rab rkyong bas/ /rnam bkra dbang po'i gzhu yi dma' yang 'bebs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ smod pa ni/ rā ma ṇa yi rnon po'i nyag phran gyis/ /grong gsum 'joms pa'i mda' lad smod par byas/ /zhes pa lta bu/co 'dri ba ni/ 'jigs med dka' spyad bzod pa'i snying stobs kyis/ /gdong lnga'i dbang po'i —258—

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)tshul la co 'drir 'os/ /zhes pa lta bu/ 'gog pa ni si tar 'dod myos sgra yis mgrin nag gi /chagasapas dka' thubs nyams pa'i skad gsang 'gog /ces pa lta bu/ rgod pa ni/ lang rka'i bdag po'i yan lag mchog bcad pas/ /khyab 'jug tshangs mgo bregs pa'i dpa' la rgod/ /ces pa lta bu/ phrag dog ni/ rtsig ngos 'bod grogs shar bas zla ba'i gzugs/ /brgya phrag rdzing bur snang la phrag dog go /ces pa lta bu/ mi bzod pa ni/ lang tsho dar ba'i sked med sor mo yis/ /dbyar skyes lcug phran gzhen nu mi bzod byed/ /ces pa lta bu/sde tshan bzhi pa la/ de yi skal bzang phrog par byed pa ni/ /rgyal bas phan bde'i bsil mngar rab byin pas/ /lho phyogs dri ba yin skal bzang rnam par phrog /zhes pa lta bu/ de yi mdzes pa zum par byed pa ni/ /nyes pa'i skyon dang dang bral ba'i mdzad pa yis/ /mu stegs gtam gyi mdzes pa zum par byed/ /ces pa lta bu/ de dang 'gran las tshar gcod pa ni/ mkhyen dang brtse ba (49na jim mkha'i mthar snyeg pas/ /na kra'i grong khyer kha zheng tshar bcad do/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de dang mtshungs lasalhag par mdzes pa ni/ dbyangs can zur mig 'phrul 'di pad nang du / /rkang drug 'phur dang mtshungs las lhag par mdzes/ /zhes pa lta bu/ de yi rjes su rkang pa 'jog pa ni/ snyan 'gyur dbyangs la ka la ping rka'i sgra/ /dri za'i pi waṃ rjes su rkang pa 'jog /ces pa lta bu/ de yi nus pa la 'jug pa ni/brda' sprod tshul la yid ni gsal byed pas/ /ma drug pa der nyi ma'i nus pa 'jug /ces pa lta bu/ de yi rjes 'gro rjes su 'ching ba ni/ /zla gzhon zhags pa'i rjes su snyeg pa yi/ /bdud rtsi'i zer gyi bde bas rjes su 'ching / /zhes pa lta bu/ /de yi ngang tshul de 'gog pa ni/ dpang lo rgya gar mkhasapa'i ngang tshul gyis/ /dbus 'gyur paṇa chen mkhas pa'i grags snyan 'gog /ces pa lta bu dang / de yi rjes su byed ces pa ni/ mang thos skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po khyod/ /rig byed smra la tshangs pa'i rjes su byed/ /ces pa lta bu'i sde tshan bzhi po sdoms pa'i sgra drug cu rtsa lnga po rnams mtshungs pa gsal byed yin no/ /—259

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)ma zin pa ngag gi dbang phyug gi 'grel pa las bshad pa'i dang po cha ni/ 'dren byed zur gyis g.yo ba'i cha/ /bh+ra ma ra la longs su spyod/ /ces pa lta bu/ grogs ni/ in+d+ra ni la'i 'khri shing de/ /khyod kyi smin ma'i grogs po byed/ /ces pa lta bu/ spun zla ni/ gang gi 'jam mnyen mchu sgros kyis/ sta yil dmar po'i (49ba)spun zla thob/ /ces pa lta bu/ mthong ba ni/ gangs ri'i dum bu ltar dkar bar/ /soyi phreng ba bdag gis mthong / /zhes pa lta bu/ thos pa ni/ 1 bha yi gling bu'i skad/ / khyod kyi mgrin pa'i dbyangs las thos/ /zhes pa lta bu/ dran pa ni/ skye ba lnga pa'i ri mo yis/ /gang gi mgrin pa gsal bar dran/ /zhes pa lta bu/ reg pa ni/ 'dod pa'i myos bum zung gis ni/ /bal gyi glang po'i snar reg byed//ces pa lta bu/ pham pa ni/ phra nyid ldem pa'i sked skabs kyis/ /'khri shing gak+ṣ-i na nu pham par byas/ /zhes pa lta bu/ snyeg pa ni/ sna tsho gos nor bu'i do shal gyis/ /rnam thos bu yi nor la snyeg /ces pa lta bu/ 'jog pa ni/ chu skyes kyis brten zhabs pad zung / /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i spyi bor 'dzeg /ces pa lta bu/ sems pa ni/ dran pas don kun ster byed pa/ /dbyangs can lha mo yin pas sems/ /zhes pa lta bu/ zur mkhar bas/ skabs 'dir snar thang pa la dgag pa mdzad pa ni ma dag pas dag pa sun 'byin par 'dug cing / skabs 'di'i 'dra ba ni/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang dbyangs can ma'i zhal gnyis mtshungs shing 'dra ba yin la/ rab brtags kyi 'dra ba ni/ mi 'dis bya ba 'di 'dra zhig byed par 'dra zhes the tshom gyi 'dra ba de yin pas des mtshon te nor 'khrul 'byung ba'i gnas med pas/ mkhas pa zur mkhar pa yang skabs 'dir 'brul na ding sang gi snyan ngag pa blo chung rnams mgo bo 'khor ba bden mod/ 'on kyang the tshom gyi mdud pa bkrol ba la rjes su (50na tha rang bar byos shig /dpa' bo gtsug lag pa'i bshad pa rnams ni phal cher nyes bshad kho nar 'dug pas legs nyes kyi rtog dpyod byed mi dgos/ 'on kyang blo ldan mi dges med gang la zhes par gang la mkhas rnams mi dgos pa'i/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ ma ning 'di 'gro bud med bzhin/ zhes sogs kyi dmigs —260

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i phe/ dbyangs/ (wa)bsal skyon med pa rnams skyon yod par bsgrubs nas/ 'grel pa snga ma rnams ma dag ces zer ba 'di/ dpang ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'grel pa yang ma dag par smra rgyu yin 'dug pa/ rgya gar ba dang mi 'dra ba'i mkhas blun dbye ba med pa'i bod rgan rnams kyis mdzo rta khyi gsum/ yol sgor phyi nang / rmongs pa'i 'khor gyi 'du 'god lhur blangs pa'i chos brgyad kyi gong bu rnams la sangs rgyas su rtsi ba'i stabs kyis/ khyed cag dmi pa'i bla chen/ lha'i sob dar zab kyis dril ba rnams lang la shor te/ khyi rgan thog khar bzhag na gnam gyi skar mar snyeg pa'i dpe byed rgyu yin nam/ yang na snyan ngag me long gi bstan pa bsnub pa la bdud sdig can bsam bzhin du rab tu byung ba'i rtags bzung nas 'ongs par gdon mi za'o/ /gzugs can gyi rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/gsum pa gzugs can gyi rgyan la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod/ dpe rgyan dang thun mong du mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dpe dang dpe can du snang ba min par gyur pa yi gcig tu sgro btags pa'i dpe nyid dag (50ba)ni gzugs can du 'dod do/ /gnyis pa la/ nyi shu las/ dang po bsdus pa'i gzugs can ni/ dpe can gyi khyad gzhi dpung pa ni/ dpe'i khyad gzhi 'khri shing gzugs su bkod/ khyad chos lag pa dang sor mo dag pad+ma dang yal 'dab kyi gzugs su bkod cing / dpung pa'i zhes pa lta bu'i rnam dbye drug pa rnams bsdus pa'o/ /dper na nyi ma'i rgyud 'khrungs gzugs sku kun gsal ngos/ /thags bzang chu 'dzin phreng dkar legs 'khrigs shing / /zab rgyas dam chos dbyar rnga sgrogs pa yis/ /skal ldan blo gsal mdongs mtha' zlos gar byed/ /ces pa lta bu/gnyis pa ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can ni/ dpe can lag pa/ dpe 'khri shing gi gzugs dang /—261 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ni/sor mo rnams yal 'dab dang / sor mo'i 'od zer ni me tog gi gzugs su bkod par gyur pas/dpyid kyi dpal ltar mdzes pa khyod ni/ nged la bde ba ster phyir mngon sum du rgyu'o/ /zhes lag pa'i zhes pa lta bu'i rnam dbye drug pa ma bsdus pa'o/ /de yang zhes pa 'di ni ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can yin la/ snga ma ni bsdus pa'i gzugs can no/ /dper na/ 'jam dkar sku yi man shel lhun po la/ /bcu drug lang tsho'i rta bdun gzi mdangs can/ /mdzes sdug 'gying ba'i bang rim bzhis mdzes shing / /rmad byung mkhyen pa'i rang bzhin brtan cing brjid/ /ces pa lta bu/ gsum pa bsdus dang ma bsdus pa ni/ dpe can bzhin ras dang 'dzums pa gnyis/ dpe zla ba (51na rkong zla ba'i 'od ces pa'i gzugasasu bkod pa'i dang po'i rnam dbye drug pa bsdus la phyi ma'i ma bsdus pas gzugs can bsdus dang ma bsdus pa'o/ /dper na/ rab mdzes lang tsho'i dpyid kyi dpal mo las/ /dkar 'jam zhal khyim ut+pal 'dab g.yo zhing / /snyan 'gyur gsung gi bung ba'i glu dbyangs can/ /dbyangs can sku yi pad dkar sdong bu ldem/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi pa mtha' dag gzugs can la/ dpe dang / don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyad gzhi dpe can rgyal po khyod kyi zhabs ni dpe chu skyes kyi gzugs su byas shing /zhabs kyi khyad chos sor mo dmar ba dang / sen mo'i 'od/ pad+ma'i khyad chos 'dab phreng dang / ge sar can te/ dpe dpe can rnams gcig yod la gcig med pa ma yin par/ mtha' dag gzugs can bkod pa'i rkang pa 'di ni/ sa skyong rnams kyi spyi bor 'dzin no/ /dper na/ mnyen 'jam phyag gi yal ga rab rgyas rtser/ /sor mo'i lcug phran gzhen nu rnam par g.yo/ /ra sngon po'i pi wang 'dab ma can/ /tshangs sras sku yi a shwar+sha 'di mdzes/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ yan lag sor mo sogs la 'dab ma sogs gzugs su byas pa dang / yan lag can rkang pa dang pad+ma nyid gzugs su byas nas/ de 'god yul gyi 'os/ sa skyong gi tshangs gnas su rnam par bkod pa 'di ni mtha' dag gzugs can no/ /lnga pa cha shas gzugs can la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ glo bur nyid du ni/ gtum mo khyod kyi gdong cha shas can ni gang gi yang (51ba)—262
