snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)gzugs su ma bkod la/ cha shas mchu dang / rngul gyi chu yi thigs pa gnyis po yal 'dab g.yo ba dang mu tig gi dog pa'i 'od can 'dzin pa'i gzugs su bkod do/ /dper na/ mang du thos pa'i ral khur rab lci zhing / /gnas lnga rig pa'i lus stobs rnam par rgyas/ /mkhas mang gangs ri'i spo la 'gying mdzad pa/ /dpang lo khyod kyis blo ldan dga' ba skyed/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dir ni rngul chu mu tig gi dog par byas shing / mchu yang yal 'dab nyid kyi gzugs su byas kyi/ cha shas can gdong ni rnam pa gzhan ma byas pas de'i phyir cha shas gzugs can no/ /drug pa cha shas can gyi gzugs can la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ cha shas can gdong pa ni 'dam skyes kyi gzugs su bkod la/ cha shas smin ma 'byog pa dang / rngul gyi chu yi thigasapa ni zag pa dang / mig dag kun tu dmar ba gsum po 'di gang gi yang gzugs su ma bkod cing /rnam 'gyur 'dis myos pa'i gnas skabs gsal bar byed de/ dper na/ 'jam dbyangs bzhin ras li khri'i thig le'i ngos/ ta shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i spyan dkyus dang / /ji snyed legs bshad sgrog pa'i zhal gyi sgo/ /'dzum pas skal bzang skye dgu'i ngal gso ster/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/'dir ni gdong pa'i cha shas smin ma sogs dag rnam 'gyur ma byas la/ gdong pa nyid pad+ma ra bkod par byas pa des na 'di ni cha shas can gyi gzugs can no/ /bdun pa yan lag (52na)gcig pa'i gzugs can la/ dper brjod dang / rigs 'gre ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ yan lag can khyod kyi gdong pa dang / yan lag rnams kyi nang nas mdzes ma myos pa'i mkhur tshos dmar po gnyis gzugs su ma bkod la/ yan lag gi nang nas mig gcig pu ut+pal dmar po'i gzugs su bkod cing / 'dod pa'i rnam 'gyur 'di yis yang skye bo rnams chags pas dmar ba'i rang bzhin du byas so/ /yan lag can gdong gi yan lag mig āt+pal du bkod pa'i mdzes chos kyi sgo nas can sgra smos te bdag po'i sgra sbyar ba'i ldan rkyen byin pa'i shul yin pas/ mchu g.yo ba sogs byed las gtso che ba'i cha shas gzugs can dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ro/ /dper na/—263

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)zhing 'dir mchog gi sprul sku'i rnam rol gyis/ /mchog dman gdul byar chos 'khor legs bskor ba'i/ /snyan brjid gsung gi dbyar gyi rnga gsang can/ /mngon mtho nges legs ma lus gcig tu sgrog /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni rgyu mtshan des na 'di ni yan lag gcig pa'i gzugs can te/ de ltar 'dir ni/ dper na/ chos gang yin pa'i yan lag lnga tsam zhig tshigs bcad de la gsal yod na/de'i khrod nas gnyis tsam zhig gzugs su sbyor zhing lhag ma rnams ma sbyar na yan lag gnyis pa'i gzugs can sogs kyi mtshon te/ yan lag gsum pa sogs rnams kyang shugs la rtogs par bya'o/ /zur (52ba)mkhar bas cha shas gzugs can dang 'di gnyis kyi khyad par dka' dka' ltar mdzad kyang / tshigs bcad gcig la yan lag lnga tsam zhig gsal na/ cha shas gzugs can gyi skabs yan lag lnga ka gzugs su bkod dgos pas khrul gzhi skye ba'i gnas med do/ /zur mkhar ba sogs snyan ngag bslabs pa rnams kyis dogs pa skyes pa yin 'dug la/ ding sang ma bslabs par shes rlom gyi tshigs bcad dam dum sbyor shes pa la snyan ngag mkhan du 'dzin pa'i ri bong rwa'i spun zla rnams la the tshom yang mi 'dug go /brgyad pa ldan pa'i gzugs can ni/ ldan dang zhes pas ming bstan nas/ de ji lta bu snyam na/gdong ni me tog 'dzum zhing 'bor ba'i gzugs su bkod g.yo ba'i mig bung ba'i gzugs su bkod pas/ dpe can gnyis lhan cig tu gnas par ma zad/ dpe me tog dang bung ba dag 'grogs pas ldan pa'i gzugs can no/ /dper na/ dbyangs can snyim pa'i 'khri shing rtser/ /pi wang khu byug sgra snyan sgrog /mgo skyes mthing kha'i nam mkha' la/ /nor bu'i rgyan gyi 'od rnon 'phro/ /zhes pa lta bu/ dgu pa mi ldan pa'i gzugs can ni/ mi ldan tha dad byed ces pa'i ming bstan nas/ gdong 'di 'dzum pa zla ba 'od kyi gzugs su bkod/ snum pa'i mig ni yu t+pa la'i gzugs su bkod nas/ dpe zla 'od āt+pal gnyis mi ldan pas/ ldan min zhes pa'i gzugs can no/ /dper na/ mchu sgros u dum wā ra'i 'dab ma'i dbus/ /srab 'jam ro 'dzin glog dmar rab (53na)'khrug cing / /ma 'dres rnam par bkra —264

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)ba'i spyan gyi 'ja'/ /smin ma'i nags klung sdug po'i khrod na g.yo/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bcu pa mi mnyam pa'i gzugs can la/ mtshan nyid/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ yan lag can gzugs su byasapa dang yan lag rnams mtha' gcig tu nges pa med par 'ga' zhig gzugs su byas la/ 'ga' cig gzugs su ma byas pa la brten pa mi mnyam pa zhes pa'i gzugs can mdzes pa yin te/ dper na/gnyis pa ni/ 'dod pas myos pa'i mkhur tshos rab tu dmar ba gzugs su ma byas la/ smin ma 'khri shing / 'khri shing gar byed pa dang / mdzes ma khyod kyi gdong zla ba dang / zla ba yid grubs kyi gzugs su bkod nas/ 'di yis 'jig rten gsum po chags pas gzhom par nus so/ /dper na/ gsung dbyangs rna bar snyan 'jebs shing / /spyan zung rkang drug ngang mo dkar/ /dbyangs can gzugs sku'i pad dkar gyis/ /legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i bcud bzang ster/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bcu gcig pa khyad par dang bcas pa' gzugs can la/ dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'phrog byed kyi rkang pa tog gi gzugs su bkod pa ste/ dzaḥ yi bu mo chu bo ge gwa yi gos te rgyal mtshan gyi ras lhab lhub kyi gzugs su bkod nas/ rgyal mtshan de'i rtser tog de btags nas phyar ba yis/ lha ma yin rnams la dgras gnod pa'i dogs pa med cing / lha rnams dga' ba'i dga' ston gyi rgyal mtshan chen po rgyal (53ba thar gyur cig /dper na/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i/ /mkhyen pa'i ral gri mkha' la phyar ba na/ /g.yul ngo'i dmag tshogs 'jigs pa'i dogs bral zhid / gangs can thub bstan 'dzin rnams dga' ba skyed/ /ces pa lta bu/ mang thos klu sgrub pas/ skabs 'dir gzhud don dang mi 'brel ba'i rtog ge ba'i blos byas kyi tshig brjod pa ni snying po med do/ /gnyis pa ni/ gang zhig khyab 'jug gi rkang pa tog tu bkod pa'i khyad par gyi mthus dga' ston gyi tshogs kyi yon tan gzugs su grub pa 'di 'dra ba de ni de'i rkang pa ge ga'i zhabs bsil dang bcas pa rgyal mtshan gyi ngo bo bkod pa 'di ni/ lha dga' yang lha min la dogs pa med pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pas khyad par dang bcas pa'i gzugs can no/ /bcu gnyis pa 'gal ba'i gzugs can/ dpe don gnyis/ dang ngo ni/—265

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)dpe'i bya ba pad+ma rnams ni mi 'dzum pa ste mi zum zhing / nam mkha' yang mi 'gro ba'i/ dpe can khyod kyi gdong zla ba'i gzugs su bkod pas/ dpes mi byed pa'i bya ba bdag gi ni srog rnams 'phrog pa nyid du glags lta'o/ /dper na/ dbyangs can lha mo sred ldan g.yon mig mas/ /'gro ba'i nyon slongs tshogs rnamasami spyod cing / /'khrig pa'i bde ba ster bar mi byed par/ /chags bral sa dang lam la 'bad pas 'god/ /ces pa lta bu/gnyis pa ni/ zla ba'i bya ba zum 'gro gnyis kyi bya ba byed pa min pa dang / mtshon cha sogasagayin gyi bya ba'i bya ba 'dir yang dag par bstan te de'i phyir/ 'gal ba zhes bya'i (54na〉na zugs can no/ /bcu gsum pa rgyu'i gzugs can la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyal po khyod ni zab pa nyid kyi rgyus ni rgya mtsho'i gzugs su ste/ brling ba nyid kyi rgyus ri bo'i gzugs yin la/ 'jig rten rnams la 'dod pa ni ster ba'i phyir dpag bsam rkang 'thung gi gzugs su bkod do/ /dper na/ tshangs sras rmongs mun sel bas chu shel dbang / /phan bde'i khang bzang rtser khrid them skas te/ /legs bshad dga' ston skyugs pas dzaḥ/ /gzigs pa dus las mi yol rgya mtsho'i rlabs/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa ni/ 'dir ni zab pa la sogs pa/ brling ster gyi rgyu rnams dag gis/ rgya mtsho/ ri/dpag bsam gyi shing dag gi yang gzugs su byed pas na 'di ni rgyu'i gzugs can yin no/ /bcu bzhi pa sbyar ba'i gzugs can ni/ /rā dza lha sa ni mi'i rgyal po dang ngang ba'i rgyal po gnyis ka la 'jug pas/ snga mas ni dpe can grogs mo khyod kyi gdong la nye bar spyad par 'os la/ phyi mas ni dpe pad+ma la nye bar spyad par 'os so/ /zhes pa ni sgra sbyar ba yin la/ don sbyar ba ni/ dri zhim pa gdong pa gnyis ka la yod pas/ snga ma rgyal po dang phyi ma bung bas don du gnyer bar 'os so/ /zhes pa dpe can gyi khyad gzhi dpe'i khyad gzhi'i gzugs su byas te/ khyad chos 'ga' zhig la sgra dang / 'ga' zhig la don sbyar ba'i sgo nas dpe dpe can so sor bkod du yod pa ni sbyar ba'i gzugs can no/ /—266

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (5)dper na/ zas gtsang sras (54ba)kyi gsung gi rdzing bu la/ /gnyis skyes tshogs kyis longs su spyod pa'i dpyid/ /dri ma med cing rab gsal dwangs pa yis/ /lang tsho can rnams khrus la 'jug pa'i yul/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bco lnga pa dpe'i gzugs can la/ mtshan nyid dang / dper brjod gnyis/dang po ni/ gtso bo dpe'i khyad gzhi dang / phal pa dpe can gyi khyad gzhi gnyis la yod pa'i khyad chos mthun par gsal ba ni dpe'i gzugs can no/ /gnyis pa ni/ /'dod pas myos pa'i kun tu dmar ba'i mdangs kyis bkab pa yi phal pa bzhin gyi zla ba 'di/ gtso bo zla ba dngos la ni mtshungs pa gsal byed kyi sgra dang bcas/ thun mtshams 'char ga'i mdangs dmar ba phun sum tshogs pa gnyis ka la yod pas rab tu 'gran no/ /dper na/ sked skabs phra ldem yongs 'du'i shing / /'dod pa'i lo 'dab g.yo ba'i nyams/ /bde ba'i gang bu ster ba 'di/ /dpag bsam ljon pa'i tshul dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bcu drug pa ldog pa can gyi gzugs can la/ dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ dngos gzhi dpe'i gzugs can dang 'dra ba la/ dpe dpe can gnyis chos mi mthun par mthong bas/ 'byed byed kyi sgra bkod de mtshungs pa las ldog pas ldog pa can zhes pa'i gzugs hran/ bshad ma thag pa the ba'i rnam pa gnyis 'dod de/ dper na/ gnyis pa ni/ lha rnams kyis ni dpe gtso po'i zla ba dang /bdag gis dpe can phal pa khyod gdong gi zla ba gnyis mig gis yang yang (55na tshe pa cung bar mtshungs kyang / dpe 'di ni rtag tu gang ba ma yin par 'phel 'grib byed kyang / dpe can 'di ni rtag tu dkyil 'khor rdzogs so/ /dper na/ ri dwags khyod ni dra ba'i rgyar/ /tshud ba mtshon chas gcod nus kyi/ /bdag ni smin legs 'dod pa'i rgyas/ /bcings 'di gcod pa'i nus pa bral/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bcu bdun pa 'gog pa'i gzugs can ni/ dpe can mdzes ma khyod kyi gdong / dpe zla ba'i gzugs su bkod pa dgag bya/'gog byed gdong zla ba'i ngo bo yin na bsil ba zhig dgos rgyu la/ 'dod pa'i tsha bas 'di ltar gzhan dag gdung bar byed pas zla ba nyid du brjod pa min zhes pa de ni 'gog pa'i gzugs can no//—267

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2rje/dper na/ 'dren mchog rnam dkar mdzad pa'i zla ba yis/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan sdebacas mya ngan gyi/ /mun pa'i khung bur 'jug na snang ba'i dpal/ /ster ba'i gnyis skyes rgyal po ci zhig lags/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bco brgyad pa mnyam 'jog gi gzugs can ni/ zla ba bsil ba yin kyang / dpe can gtum mo khyod gdong / dpe zla ba'i ngo bor bkod pa 'dis kyang / 'dod pa'i mes brtse ba med par bdag sreg pa/ zla ba'i byed las mi 'os pa'i skyon dag bdag nyid kyang chags 'bras ha cang smin ches pa'i skal ba nyid kyi skyon zhes/ dpe dpe can gnyis ga'i skyon mnyam par ston pa ni mnyam 'jog gi gzugs can no/ /dper na/ shong ston mkhyen pa'i nyi zer gyis/ /(55ba〉sgol ba'i blo ngan mun par 'thums/ /nyes bshad kho nar yid gtad pa'i/ /log lta'i skal dman 'dis kyang skyon/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bcu dgu pa gzugs can gyi gzugs can ni/ /khyod gdong 'dam skyes kyi gzugs/ 'dam skyes do ra'i gzugs su bkod/ gdong gi khyad chos smin ma 'khri shing gi gzugs dang / 'khri shing gar mkhan ma'i gzugs su bkod nas/ rol sgeg gis dga' ba'i gar byed do/ /zhes dpe 'phar ma bkod pa 'di ni gzugs can gyi gzugs can no/ /dper na/ kun mkhyen gzugs sku'i gangs ri'i dga' tshal du/ /mtshan bzang chu klung man+ta ra 'khrigs las/ /bde legs bsil dang yid 'ong dga' ston tshogs/ /las ldan tshad gdungs mtho ris lus phra'i dpal/ /zhes pa lta bu/ nyi shu pa bston dor gyi gzugs can la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ shin tu mdzes pa 'di ni dpe can gyi khyad gzhi gdong dang / khyad chos 'di dag ste mig dang / khyod kyi so yi 'od zer ma yin ste 'di dpe'i khyad gzhi pad+ma dang / khyad chos bung ba ge sar 'di rnams nyid yin no/ /dper na/ gzigs mor spro 'di 'brug sgra mngal 'dzin gyi/ /lus 'degs ma yin rlung gi rgyal mtshan ste/ /dga' ba'i zlos gar rnam par sgyur ba 'di/ /rma bya ma yin dran pa'i snye mar nges/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ gdong pa la sogs pa dpe can nyid ma yin no zhes bston bzhin bzlog ste/—268

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)dpe pad+ma la sogs pa'i gzugs su byas pa'i sgo nas mdzes pa sogs (56na〉thon tan khyad 'phags gsal bar byed pa de nyid bston dor gzugs can no/ /gsum pa dpe rgyan dang thun mong du 'jug bsdu ba ni/ gzugs can dang dpe rgyan gyi rnam rtog gi spros pa rnams mtha' yod pa ma yin pa de'i phyir/ 'dir phyogs tsam bstan pa yin gyi dngos su ma brjod pa rnams blo ldan rnams kyi rjes su dpag par bya'o/ /gsal byed kyi rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/bzhi pa gsal byed kyi rgyan la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod/ ma bshad pa bslab tshul dang gsum/dang po ni/ sngar rang bzhin brjod pa'i skabs dang 'dra ba'i rigs dang / bya ba yon tan/ rdzas rnams la tshig gcig thog mtha' bar gsum gang la gnas pa yis/ gal te tshig sbyor gyi ngag kun gsal ba la phan na/ de ni gsal byed du brjod de/ dper na zhes so/ /rang bzhin brjod pa'i skabs yal 'dab sogs dang ldan pa'i shing gi rigs brjod pas/mtshan nyid de ldan gyi rig mtha' dag go nus pa yin la/ 'dir ni rigs sogs gang brjod pa'i gsal byed kyi tshig thog mtha' bar gsum gang na yod pa des tshig gzhan gsal nus pa zhig dgos pas mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ro/ /gnyis pa la gnas gsum gyi gsal byed/ phreng ba'i gsal byed/ gal don gyi gsal byed/don gcig gi gsal byed/ sbyar ba'i gsal byed dang lnga/ dang po la rnam par dbye ba'i sgo nas rigs sogs bzhi/ gnas nges pa'i sgo nas gsum du bstan pa dang gnyis/ dang po la brgyad(56ba)yod pa'i rigs brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed ni/ lco yi rlung gis zhes pa gsal byed du thog mar bkod nas 'og ma mtha' dag gsal ba ste/ gang gsal na/ des we shing rnams bsgul bskyod byas pasa'adab ma rnying pa ser po rnams lhung bar byed do/ /gzhan yang des lus bsil bar byas pas/ lang tshos —269

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)dud pa'i lus can rnams kyi yang mdza' bo mi dad pa'i khengs pa gsar du 'joms par nus so/ /dper na/ ba tso smra ba'i mchu ldan can/ /ma rgad mdangs kyi sgrog shog ngom/ /dkar nag dmar ba'i mgrin pa can/ /skye bo 'ga' yi yid du 'ong / /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa bya ba brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed ni/chu gter bzhi'i ngogs kyi skyed mos tshal du so can te glang po brgyad rgyu'o/ /khor yug phyi'i lcags kyi ri bo'i khongs su yang / rgyal po khyod kyi yon tan kun+da dkar po rgyu'o/ /dper na/ sbyin no rgyal bas 'gro la bde/ /dbyangs can skal bzang rnams la ngag /sgeg mos sred can chags pa'i ro/ /rlung gis tsha gdung can la bsil/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa yon tan brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed ni/ phyogs rnams ni dbyar skyes sprin gyi phreng ba 'khrigs pa yis sngo bsangs nyid du byed do/ /sa gzhi yang rtsa sngon gsar pa ni shin tu gzhen pa'i phreng bas sngo bsangs nyid du byed do/ /dper na/ dkar ro mkha' la zla ba'i gzugs/ /'dod ldan khrod na na chung gdong / /mkhas mang tshogs pa'i mdun sa na/ /chos skyong bzang po'i rnam dpyod mchog /ces pa lta bu/ bzhi pa rdzas brjod pa thog ma'i (57na skos la byed ni/ dwa nu'i bu lha min stobs ldan gyi 'byor pa dag gang du ming med par gtang ngo / /gang gis na gang zag gcig gis rang mtshan du bzung ba'i rdzas gzhan sde rnam par gnon pa'i mthu la gnas pa(sna khyab 'jug gis so/ /lha rnams kyi phun tshogs gzhan gang na gnas sa pa kun blangs te dar bar byas so/ /gang gis na/ rnam par gnon pa'i khyab 'jug go /dper na/ ri dwags kyis mtshan zla ba yis/ /rgya mtsho chen po rnam par rgyas/ /'dod ldan rnams kyis chags pa 'phel//gnyis skyes du ma dga' ba bskyed/ /ces pa lta bu/ zhes pa bzhi po dang po'i gsal byed bstan nas/de bzhin du bar dang tha ma yi yang gsal byed kyi tshig dag bdag gis bstan par bya ba ni/ de dag 'ga' zhig 'di lta ste/ zhes mtshams sbyar ro/ /lnga pa rigs brjod pa'i bar gyi gsal byed ni/mjug sgro can zhes bkod nas rang gi snga phyi thams cad gsal ba'o/ kheng ni tsu la'i 'dab ma'i phang pa na gar byed do/ /glu dbyangs len no/ / dga' ba rgyas pa'i mig dag kyang chu 'dzin 'brug sgra can la ni —270

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa' glu dbyangs/ (wanagatod par byed do/ /dper na/ shes bya ma lus dri med gzigs/ /bdud bzhi las rgyal rdzogs sangasargyas/ /kun la khyab pa'i thugs rje can/ /ris med 'gro ba ma lus skyabs/ /thes pa lta bu/ drug pa bya ba brjod pa bar gyis gsal byed ni/ dri bzhen nags klung na dal bu yang chags ldan 'ga' la gnod pa'i rgyu yin pas gdung bar 'gyur bar byed do/ /zla ba dag kyang me ru 'gyur ro/ /tsan+dan gyi byug pa lus la lhung ba yang / mtshon lhung ba ltar bud med dang bral te 'khyam pa (57bsgoms 'gyur ro/ /dper na/ shes ldan rnams la legs bshad dang / /'phongs pa rnams la bdog pa yis/ /dga' bar byed do 'dod ldan la/ /lang tsho rgyas pa'i smin legs mas/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bdun pa rigs brjod pa tha ma'i gsal byed ni me tog gzhu can dag gi dpung ni gsal byed yin pas rang gi sngon na yod pa mtha' dag gsal lo/ /gang gsal na dbyar gyi chu 'dzin gyis ni char chu rab tu gtor ba dang / khyim na bdag tu bzung ba'i gtsug phud ldan pa'i tshogs gar byed pa dang / glog gi thag pa khyug khyug tu g.yo ba gsum gyis kyang yid phrogs te 'dod pa g.yo bar byed pas so/ /dper na/ gnag snum zur phud lnga g.yo zhing / /ut+pal ral gris dpung pa mdzes/ /mtshams sprin mdangs 'dzin na chod gnas/ /ngag gi mchog ster 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ brgyad pa bya ba brjod pa tha ma'i gsal byed ni/byas zhes pa gsal byed du bkod nas/ mdzes ma khyod kyi rna ba la ut+pal spud pa dang / 'dod pa'i lha'i mngal ni me tog gi tshal na rgyus pa'i mda' bstan pa dang / rgyu de gnyis kyis nga yang chags sems kyis 'chi ba la thug pa gsum po 'di ni mnyam du byas so/ /dper na/ mdzes ma'i 'gram pa'i chang gis ba ku la/ /rta ljang 'od kyis sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan 'tshal/ /chos skyong bzang pos gnas lnga rig pa'i kha/ /blo bzang grags pas thub bstan sgo 'phar 'byed/ /ces pa lta bu/gnyis pa phreng ba'i gsal byed la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'phel byed ces pa gsal byed yin la/ dkar (58ba)phyogs kyis ni 'od dkar can/ 'od dkar can de yis mda' lnga pa/ mda' —271 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)lnga pa des kyang chags pa/ chags pas kyang na chung dga' ba'i dga' ston gyi dpal lo/ /gsal byed thog mtha' bar gsum la ma nges shing / /dper na/ legs ldan dpyid kyis char dus lang tsho'i dpal/ /dbyar gyis rkang 'thung 'dab 'bras ljang shon spel/ /des kyang ston gyi dus bskyed 'bras ldan mas/ /gsar tshes gnam lo'i dga' ston 'gugs par byed/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/zhes sogs rkang pa snga phyi gang la yod kyang de kha'i gsal byed yin mod/ 'on kyang snga ma snga ma la phyi ma phyi ma ltos pa'i ngag gi phreng ba rab tu ldan pa'i phyir/ de ni phreng ba'i gsal byed du 'dod do/ /bcu pa 'gal ba'i gsal byed la/ dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ sprin gyis zhes pa gsal byed yin la/ rlung gis gtsubs shing bskyod pa'i char gyi chu'i thigs pa can 'dod lha lus med dag gis ni 'dod chags kyi a pa le ba 'phel bar byed cing / lus tsha bas gdungs pa'i rngul gyi a ba le ba dag ni sel bar byed do/ /zhes byed po gcig gis 'phel sel gyi bya ba gcig car du bstan pas 'gal ba'o/ /dper na/ smin legs ma des chags pa yis/ /gzir ba'i sdug bsngal bskyed pa dang / /'khrig pa'i bde ba brten pa yis/ /'dod par dga' ba rgyas par byed/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/'dir ni gsal byed sprin gyi tshig dag dang (58ba)gsal bya a la ba'i tshig dag gis sngar bshad ma thag pa ltar bya ba 'gal ba dang ldan pa ste/ rgyu mtshan des na 'gal ba'i don gyi gsal byed do/ bcu gcig 'don gcig gi gsal byed la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ chu 'dzin dag gi phreng ba 'dis/zhes pa ni gsal byed yin la/ nam mkha'i phyogs rnams kyi ni go skabs med par phrogs pa ste bsgrigs so/ /skar ma'i tshogs rnams ni bzung ba ste ma gsal bar byas so/ /deng sang yang sred ldan dag gi srog rnams lan pa ste 'chi ba la thug pas gdungs so zhes pa rnam grangs gsum bkod kyang /don chags pa 'phel ba gcig pu gsal bar bstan pa'o/ /dper na/ mtshar sdug lang tsho dar bab sked med mas/ /bzhin gyi smin ma rab g.yo 'dren byed phyogs/ /dmar ba'i mchu sgros g.yo zhing so phreng ngom/ /gzhen nu'i snying la 'dod pa'i gdung ba bskyed/ /ces pa lta bu/—272

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)gnyis pa ni/ gang ga phyir chu 'dzin gyi phreng ba yis/ 'dod pa'i bya ba gcig nyid gsal bar byed pa 'dir rnam grangs du ma bkod pa'i sgra yis nye bar blangs pa yis/ de'i phyir don 'dod pa gcig gsal bar byed do/ /bcu gnyis pa sbyar ba'i gsal byed la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyu zhes pa gsal byed yin la/ sprin ni nam mkha' dang / glang po che 'di dag sa la rgyu bar byed pa'o/ /de yang sbyar lugs ni/ sprin ni dri'i gzhen pa rlung dang ldan pa yin la/ glang po ni gar chang gi dri'i gzhon pa yin la/ de gnyis ka mthong na yid du 'ong ba dang / dpangs mtho ba dang / kha dog sngo bsangs ta ma la'i 'od (59na)dang ldan pa rnams de gnyis ka la thun mong du yod pas sbyar ba'o/ /dper na/ legs bshad smra ba'i mgrin pa gzengs mtho zhing / /rig byed gzhung brgya 'chad pa'i ston pa che/ /lha yi bla ma 'chi med mdun sa dang / /chos skyong bzang po kha ba'i ljongs kyi rgyan/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ bshad ma thag pa 'di ni chos de rnams tha dad ma yin par sprin dang glang po rnams dag la sbyar bas/ rgyu zhes pa'i gsal byed nyid kyi tshig nyid kyis 'brel ba'i phyir/ sbyar ba'i don gyi gsal byed do/ /lnga pa ma bshad pa bslab tshul ni/ rnam pa 'di dag nyid kho na yis gsal byed kyi rgyan la ni rnam par rtog pa'i spros pa 'dir ma bshad pa'i lhag ma rnams kyang snga ma dang rjes su mthun par mkhas pa rnams kyis rigs pas dpag pa ste rtogs par bya'o/ /bskor ba'i rgyan bshad pa/lnga pa bskor ba'i rgyan la/ mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang / so so'i dper brjod gnyis/dang po ni/ gsal byed du bshad pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi gnas gang rung nyid du don gcig tshig mi 'dra ba la bskor ba dang ni/ don mi gcig la tshig 'dra bar bskor ba dang / tshig don gnyis 273

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheka bskor ba zhes bya ba ste rgyan gsum yod pa dag 'dod de dper na/ gnyis pa so so'i dper brjod la/ dang po don bskor ba ni ka da spa/ ku ṭa lhu du maḥgan+da pyo ka ku bha/ bzhi po tshig mi gcig kyang don du mo nyung gi shing yin pas/ shing gcig pu de bskor ba ste/ shing de rnam par rgyas/ rab tu gsal/rab tu byed/ gyes par gyur/ zhes pa ste/ (59brko per na/ stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang thob pa'i ched/ /lus med thul gyi bstan la rab zhugs te/ /mi 'jigs bzhi ldan gsung rab la sbyangs nas/ /rgyal bas grangs med tshogs bsags rjes su bslabs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis smyo pa/ tshig bskor ba ni/byed ces pa tshig bskor ba yin la/ sprin gyi phreng ba dag gis rma bya'i tshogs rnams dang / chu srin rgyal mtshan can gyis ni deng dus na chung rnams kyi yid 'dod pa dang ldan par byed do/ /dper na/ 'od dkar can gyi sa smos 'dab ma rgyas/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rjes 'gro ba'i phan bde rgyas/ /dbyangs can lha mos bdag blo'i shes rab rgyas/ /legs bshad gtam gyis blo gsal dga' ba rgyas/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa gnyis ka bskor ba ni/ rtse bar byed ces pa ni tshig bskor ba yin la/ rgyal po gsal rgyal nas dga' ba dang / dgra rnams lhar skyes pas dga' ba yang rgyal pos de rnams bsad pa la brten nas byung bas don rgyal po g.yul las rgyal ba gcig pu la bskor ba ste/dgra kun las rgyal nas de ring rgyal po khyod btsun mo rnams dang / khyod kyi bsad pa'i dgra sde rnams g.yul ngor shi ba'i dbang gis mtho ris su song ba ste skyes nas lha mo rnams dang rtse bar byed do/dper na/ nyin mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal/ /gzugs snang bkod pa sna tshogs gsal/ /dbyar rnga skad gsang sgrog pas brel/ /rma bya dga' ba'i gar gyis brel/ /zhes pa lta bu/—274

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)'gog pa'i rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/drug pa 'gog pa'i rgyan la/ mtshan nyid dbye ba dang /(60na)bcas te mdor bstan pa/ phye ba so so'i dper brjod rgyas par bshad pa/ ma bshad pa kha 'phangs su bstan te mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ don 'ga' zhig bsgrub pa sogs dgag byar byas nas/ de bsgrub tu mi ster bar thabs brjod pa ni 'gog byed do/ /de la yang 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum la ltos nas rnam pa gsum dang / de nas de yang bye brag rgyas par phye na dgag bya'i dbye ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ 'gog byed kyang mtha' yas so/ / gnyis pa la nyi shu rtsa gsum las/ dang po 'das pa 'gog pa la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ lus med kyi ni me tog gi mda' lnga 'jam zhing nyung ba des 'gro ba kun las rgyal bar gyur/ zhes pa mi srid te mi bden no snyam pa'i blo sngar byung zin pa ni dgag bya dang / yang na ni/'gog byed dngos po 'dod pa'i nus pa rnam par bkra ba ste bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /dper na/ nyi ma'i gnyen gyis lnga sder bden bzhi'i chos/ /gsungs pa tsam gyis grol ba ya ma rla/ /'on tang srid pa tha ma'i gang zag gi /rang bzhin tshur mthong skye bo'i yul las 'gong / /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/zhes pa 'di ni 'dod lha'i nus pa'i rgyu'i stobs kyis lus med rgyal bar mi rigs pa'i blo de ltar gyur zin bkag pa de'i phyir/ 'di 'dra de ni byung ba 'gog pa'o/ /gnyis pa da ltar ba 'gog pa la/ dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ snyan par sgrog ma dag ci'i phyir rna ba la ni ut+pal 'dzug par byed ces/ ut+pal (60ba tsher rgyanas bzhin pa ni dgag bya dang /'gog byed de lta bu las 'di la ni khyod rang gi mig zur dag yongs rdzogs min par sems bsam ci ste/ mig zur ring por spros na de las mdzes pa med do/ /dper na/ 'jams mgon khyod kyi phyag g.yas na/ /ral gri bzung des dgos pa ci/ stan na tu rno zhing ngar ba yi/ /mkhyen mchog 'di las lhag —273

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)nga/ gang / /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa ni/ mdzes ma 'ga' zhig dkar ba ma yin pa'i ut+pal rna ba'i rgyan du byed pa la/ de 'gog pa'i ched du mdza' bo yis/ de ltar mig la bstod nas 'gog par byed pa 'di ni mngon gyur 'gog pa'o/ /gsum pa ma 'ongs pa 'gog pa la/ dpe don gnyis/dang po ni/ mdza' mos bden par smra'o/ /gang smra na/ jo bo ste bdag po khyod kyis bud med gzhan dang tsusba na ste 'o byas pa las/ mchu sgros kyi rang mdangs 'phos pa lta bu rgya skyegs kyi mdog ltar dmar ba dgag bya dang 'gog byed khyod kyis chags pa'i mig gis bltas kyang / bdag sdug bsngal des 'chi bas nam yang mthong bar gyur pa ma lags so/ /dper na/ tshul 'chos sgom chen rgan po'i rdzu bag gis/ /tha snyad gtsug lag skyong bar mi byed pas/ /mi shes blun po tshogs pa'i gral khrod du/ /mgo skyes dkar po'i thor cog 'ching bar nges/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa ni/ sngar bud med rang nyid shin tu khengs pa dang ldan mas mdza' bo la ma 'dud pa'i dbang gis/ nam zhig bdag po 'di yis bud med gzhan dang 'grogs na rang la (61na〉na nod pa dag byung dogs pa ma 'ongs pa de dgag bya dang / de ltar 'gog byed 'chi bar smra ba 'di ni 'byung 'gyur 'gog pa'o/ / bzhi pa chos 'gog pa la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshogs ni 'jam pa yin pas lus phra khyod kyi yan lag rnams 'jam pa nyid du gnas pa rdzun pa ste/ dgag bya yin la/ 'gog byed gal te bden par 'jam pa yin na/ slo bur du bdag la gdung ba drag po skyed do/ /dper na/ skabs gsum pa rnams dge ba bcur spyod pa'i/ /sngon byung gtam rdzun bden na lha dbang gis/ /drang srong go ta ma yi mchis 'brang la/ /spyad pas mig stong byung de ci zhig yin/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ gang gi phyir de ltar 'dod ldan gyi skye bo 'ga' zhig reg bya 'jam pa'i chos de dang 'gal ba'i chos rtsub por sgrub pa 'dir/ bud med kyi lus ni 'jam pa dag 'gog pa de ni chos —276

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)'gog pa'o/ /lnga pa chos can 'gog pa la/ dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ chos can bud med kyi rten mthong ba ma yin pas lus mthong ba dgag bya/ lus der ni bltas pa na 'od tsam g.yo ba nyid mthong bar gyur gyi zhes pa 'gog byed/ rgyu mtshan des na bu mo'i lus de mdzes sam mi mdzes pa yin zhes rnam dbye byed pa'i rnam par rig byed 'di ni rgyu ci las skyes te khyad gzhi med pa'i khyad chos so/ /dper na/'jug pa bcu pas lha min stobs ldan dag /sa 'og bcings pa'i rnam 'gyur brjod mi nus/ /rig byed (61ba〉na zhud du bstan pa'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /cung zad thos las zhib tu mthong ba min/ /zhesapa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ gang gi phyir gzugs can mdzes ma 'di nyid ngo mtshar bar brjod par 'dod pas/ 'od tsam mthong zhes pa'i chos 'di khas blangs pas/ chos can mdzes ma'i lus mthong ba 'gog pa 'di ni chos can 'gog pa'o/ /drug pa rgyu 'gog pa la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'jigs pa'i rgyu/ rang gis skyes pa g.yin dang mthun pa'i mnong 'gyod dam nyes pa ni shugs bstan gyi dgag bya 'gog byed bdag po khyod kyi mig dag dmar por gyur cing / /mchu yi yal 'dab g.yo ba dang / smin ma 'byog po ste khro bar byed pa de lta na'ang / khro ba'i rgyu gzhan dang 'tsham pa'i nyes pa bdag la med pas mi 'jigs so/ /dper na/gzu mor mi gnas phyogs lhung gis/ /'phya smod gtam gyi sgra sgrags kyang / /tshe sngon bzod pa ma bsgoms pa'i/ /mnong 'gyod lus phra bdag la med/ /ces pa lta bu/gnyis pa ni/ gang phyir mdza' mo mkhas pa yi/ 'jigs pa yi ni rgyu'i gtso bo/ rang gis smad 'tshong byas pa'i nyes pa 'gog par byed pa de dag 'dir ni rgyu 'gog pa'o/ /bdun pa 'bras bu 'gog pa la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'bras bu shi ba/ dgag bya 'gog byed rang gi mdza' bo dag ni thag ring po na gnas pa dang / chu 'dzin g.yo zhing bgrod pa dang ldan pa 'di ni 'gro 'ong byed pa dang / shing ni tsu la yang rgyas pa mthong ba gsum po 'di chags pa rgyas te 'chi —277

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)ba'i rgyu tshogs kyang / bdag (62na〉te ba min pa 'di cig dper na/ yid srubs bdag po'i lus phra'i bzhin jom zhing / /dkyus ring rnam bkra mig zur g.yon du 'byog /mchu sgros 'dzum las so 'phreng ston pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i thugs la nyon mongs med 'di mtshar/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa ni/ 'chi ba de'i rgyu chu 'dzin bgrod pa sogs mi zad pa dag nye bar bkod nas ma shi ba bdag /'bras bu 'chi ba bzlog pa'i phyir/ de ni 'bras bu 'gog pa'o/ /brgyad pa rjes gnang gisa'agog pa la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'gro ba shugs bstan gyi dgag bya 'gog byed gal te gshegs par 'dod na phyogs gang yin pa der gshegs par nya cig dang khyod kyis thag ring du bgrod pas/ mdza' mo bdag la ni myur du 'chi ba 'byung bas/ gdung ba ste sdug bsngal yun ring du 'byung bar mi 'gyur bas/ tshul 'di la khyod ni dogs pa mi 'tshal lo/ /dper na/ rta ljang chu lha'i sa 'dzin la/ /brgal bar 'dod na ci bder 'tshal/ /skyed tshal mdzes pa'i 'dam skyes rnams/ /'dab ma'i tshogs rnams zum par byed/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ zhes pa 'chi ba gsal bar byed pa'i rjes gnang nyid kyi sgo nas ni mdza' bo'i bgrod pa 'gog par byed pa de ni rjes gnang gis 'gog pa'o/ /dgu pa dbang gis 'gog pa la/ dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ yul gzhan du 'gro ba shugs bstan gyi dgag bya/ 'gog byed der phyin na nor ni mang po rnyed par 'gyur zhing / lam du yang ni bde zhing dge la/ gzhis su (62ba tshe blo mo bdag kyang srog la bar chad mi 'byung bar the tshom med mod/'on kyang mdza' bo khyod 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /zhes 'jig rten na dbang che byed pa lta bu'o/ /dper na/'od dkar can khyod gling gzhan mkhar gshegs na/ /phyogs de'i mun tshogs 'joms shing sa smos rnams/ /rgyas shing na kra'i grong khyer 'phel byed kyang / /dbus 'gyur bram ze dga' ba'i dpal du bzhugs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ nor rnyed pa sogs mdza' bo 'gro ba'i mthun pa'i sbyor ba'i rgyu rnams dag ni rab bshad nas/ mdza' mo khyod kyi dbang nyid kyi sgo nas ni 'gro ba de 'gog pa 'di 'dra ba dbang gis 'gog pa'o/ /—278

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)bcu pa ma gus pas 'gog pa la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ mdza' bo phyogs la 'gro ba'i don/ nor bsgrub pa'i bsam pa stobs dang mi ldan pa ste/ mi 'dod pas phyi phyir 'gro ba ni dgag bya/'gog byed kho mo bdag ni nged rang khyo shug gson re ba'i bsam pa stobs dang ldan pas drang por rang gi gnas skabs smos pa lags/ gshegs sam bzhugs pa mdza' bo khyod rang gis shes zhes ma rangs pa'o/ /dper na/ khyod nyid shong dpang lugs bzang rab bzung nas/ /mkhas mang mdzes byed rgyan gyur rmad byung ste/ /'on kyang dwags rgyud rgan po'i ngang tshul dang / /dpyod ldan blo gsal rnam thar ci bder gzungs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ gang gi phyir 'dir ni chags ldan mas ma gus bzhin du gang 'dod dris zhes tshig sbyar nas mdza' bo'i bgrod pa 'gog par byed pa 'di ni ma gus pas 'gog (63na)pa'o/ /bcu gcig pa shis brjod kyis 'gog pa la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ mdza' bo gal te gshegs na bzhud ces/ 'gro ba shugs bstan gyi dgag bya dang / 'gog byed khyod kyi lam ni shes par gyur cig ces smon pa dang / bdag kyang khyod song ba'i rkyen des 'a bas/ gang du khyod ni gshegs pa der skye ba nyid du gyur cig /dper na/ rnyed bkur tshe 'di'i tshed du tshul chos rdzur/ /brten pa'i 'dod pa ji ltar 'grub par shog /phyi nas rnam dpyod ldan pa'i blo gsal dag /mang por tsho gos tshe 'gyod par ma byed cig zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar shis brjod kyi lam gang gi sgo nas rang 'chi ba'i gnas skabasagasal bar byed pas/ mdza' bo'i bgrod pa 'gog par byed pa 'di ni shis brjod kyis 'gog pa'o/ /bcu gnyis pa rtsub mos 'gog pa la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'gro ba dgag bya/ 'gog byed gal te khyod 'gro ba bden pa nyid na/ khyod kyis bud med g.yin pa 'ga' zhig tshol cig /de'i mthus bdag ni srog la glags 'tshol ba ste lcebs nas de ring nyid du 'chi ba yin no/ /zhes pas 'gog par 'gyur ro/ /dper na/ lkog gyur sems nyid rjen 'char du/ /rtogs pa'i zol gyis tshe 'di yi/ /'phul thabs mdzod cig phyi ma'i dus/ /mnar med gnas der mi dpyod 'tshal/ /zhes pa lta bu/—279

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2//gnyis pa ni/ gang gi phyir bdag po mdza' bo'i dbang du gyur pa mas/ tshig rtsub pa'i yi ge sngon du 'gro ba can gyis mdza' bo'i bgrod pa 'gog par byed pa ni rtsub mos 'gog pa'o/ /bcu gsum pa (63ba)grogs kyis 'gog pa la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ mdza' bo'i 'gro ba shugs bstan gyi dgag bya/ 'gog byed gal te gshegs na myur du bzhud cing / 'gor na phyi nas chung ma shi bas/ gnyen 'dun rnams sdug bsngal gyis 'khrug pa'i kha nas bsgrag pa'i ngu 'bod kyi cho nges/ 'gro ba'i gegs su gyur pa khyod kyi rna bar 'ong ngo / /dper na/ mgrin sngon can khyod gangs ri'i phag /dka' thub bsgrub na myur du mdzod/ /slad mar khyod kyi rjes 'jug 'gas/ /gzhan phan bskul ba'i nyes pa mchi/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ gang gi phyir 'dir ni mtha' gcig tu chags ldan mas 'gro ba'i grogs nyid byed pa ltar gyi sgo nas mdza' bo'i bgrod pa 'gog par byed pa ni grogs nyid kyis ni 'gog pa'o/ /bcu bzhi pa 'bad pas 'gog pa la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ mdza' bo 'gro ba dgag bya/'gog byed bzhud ces khyod dgyes pa'i tshig brjod 'dod kyang / kho mo bdag nyid dga' bar byed pa'i tshig ma gshegs zhes pa kha nas ni dbang med du byung bar gyur pa la bdag ci byed de thabs med do/ /dper na/ rab ljang dbyang skyes gzhon nus legs bstar pa'i/ /char dus dga' ston yun ring gnas 'bad kyang / /chu lha'i bu yi dkyil 'khor gyis mdzes pa'i/ /'bras ldan dus la ring pa'i tshig 'ga' thal/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ mi 'dod pa'i dngos po bzhud ces pa la 'bad pa ltar byas pa'i/ 'bras bu phyin ci log mi 'gro ba bskyed pas/ don med pa nye bar bstan pa'i phyir/ de ni 'bad pas 'gog pa'o/ / (64na)bco lnga pa gzhan dbang gis 'gog pa la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'gro ba de dgag bya/'gog byed kho mo la gros dris nas ci bya/ khyod la lta ba'i tshe skad cig tsam gegs byed pa'i rdzi ma bskyod pa la yang khro ba'i shin tu snying nye ba'i mdza' bo zhig 'dug pa de la khyod rang 'gro ba'i gros smros 280

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)dang / bdag ni de yis 'dod pa ltar 'dod do/ /dper na/ gzhan 'tshe'i dbang gis lci ba'i rnam smin gyis/ /mi zad nag por grub pa'i 'bras bu la/ /gser can gsod pa'i gros dris de'i smreng dang / /mtshungs par bdag kyang brjod do pad dkar mig /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ gang gi phyir mdza' ba'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa mas/ mdza' ba'i don 'di nye bar gsal bar byas nas mdza' bo'i bgrod pa 'gog par byed pa 'di ni gzhan dbang gis 'gog pa'o/ /bcu drug pa thabs kyis 'gog pa la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'gro ba dgag bya dang /'gog byed mgon po ste mdza' bo dang bral ba tsam bzod par bgyi mod/ /de'i rjes su bdag la 'dod pa'i mdas bsnun mi bzod pas/ gang gis mig la bsgos shing byugs pa tsam la/ 'dod lhas mi mthong ba'i mig sman gyi dngos grub mthong min te mi snang ba'i rdzas zhig stsol cig /dper na/ri klung spangs ljongs me tog gis/ /rab bkra dbyar khyod yol rung gi /phyogs kun char sprin lang long dbus/ /'brug sgra sgrog pa rgyun du 365/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa ni/ 'tsho ba'i thabs rdzas ni dka' ba dag snye bar bkod nas bdag po ni g.yin du 'gro /(64ba tha 'gog par byed pa'i phyir 'di 'dra thabs kyis 'gog par brjod do/ /bcu bdun pa khro bas 'gog pa la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'gro ba dgag bya/ 'gog byed jo bo khyod kyi zhal nas mdza' bo la brtse ba med par mi 'os pa'i tshig dang phyogs gzhan du 'gro zhes pa nges par byung bas/ gnyen la gdung ba med pa'i mdza' bo dman pa khyod kyi da ma phyin na yang bdag la ci zhig ste khyad par med do/ /dper na/ dar ba lang tsho'i dus su rig pa'i gnas/ /bslab sbyang dor te sgom chen byed sems na/ /slad nas na tshod yol tshe thos pa'i grar/ /zhugs kyang ma bsdad pa dang khyad par ci/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ mdza' ba'i chags pa rgyas pas dbang po ma bsdams pa'i bdag nyid ma des khong khro bas tshig gis mdza' bo'i 'gro ba rtsom pa bzlog pa gang yin pa de ni khro bas 'gog pa'o/ /—281 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2re/bco brgyad pa mya ngan gyis 'gog pa la dpe don gnyis/ /dang po ni/ ut+pal zegs par 'os pa'i bya ba dri bsnams dgos pa la ma bsgos shing / bu mo'i rna ba'i rgyan byed dgos pa la ma byas la/dri bzang ba'i phyir du chang la 'debs dgos pa la ma btab pas/ 'os pa gsum po ni gang rung gis snyigs dgos pa dgag bya dang / 'gog byed de gsum po gang yang ma byas par khyod kyi dgra zla'i rdzing nyid du ut+pal sngon po zags par gyur to/ /dper na 'dod chung ched du bsod stoms dag /slong min gzhan don bsgrub pa'i slad/ /grong yul (65na tha nyul sgom chen 'ga'/ /srang mdo'i khyi dang lhan cig gnas/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ dgras bcom nas ut+pal rnams zegs so zhes snying rje rje ltar mya ngan dang bcas shing smras pa des 'os pa'i bya ba gsum po las bzlog par byas nas mya ngan 'os pa'i skabs ston pas de'i phyir 'di ni mya ngan gyis 'gog pa'o/ /bcu dgu pa 'gyod pas 'gog pa la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gzhan phan pa'i don 'ga' yang tshogs par ma byas la/ sgra tshad sogs rig pa'i gnas 'ga' yang ma bsgrubs shing /dka' thub bsam gtan 'ga' yang ma bsags pas/ don gsum po 'di byas pa dgag bya/ 'gog byed snyoms las kyi ngang la na tshod mtha' dag song ba la 'gyod par gyur to/ /dper na mar mi'i nyamasadang rtogs pa mi ldan zhing / /dpang shong mkhas pa'i go sam zin la/ /stobs wor kha drag dag kyang med pa'i ngang / /ri rtser mi tshe don med ngang la zad/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni gang gi phyir 'dir ni tshe song bas don 'grub pa la sogs pa 'gog pa ni 'gyod pa gtso bor ston par byed pas/ 'di ni 'gyod pas 'gog pa'o/ /nyi shu pa the tshom gyis 'gog pa la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ ci shin tu dkar ba 'di ston gyi chu 'dzin nam/ yang na ngang pa'i tshogs sam zhes de gnyis gang rung du the tshom pa dngos bstan gyi dgag bya/ 'gog byed rkang gdub kyi sgra 'khrol ba 'dra ba thos pas dkar po de ni chu 'dzin ma yin no/ /—282

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)dper na/ mthon po'i (65ba)khrir 'dzegs 'di ni dpang lo'am/ /yang na grub rigs rgan po'i bla chen zhig /mkhas pa mgu ba'i legs bshad snyan pa'i dbyangs/ /sgrog phyir bka' rgyud 'dren par rlom pa min/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ rkang gdub kyi sgra'i chos 'di ngang pa la yod cing / sprin gyi rigs la ma reg pas/ skye bo gang zhig the tshom zlog par byed pa de ni the tshom 'gog pa'o/ /nyer gcig pa sbyar bas 'gog pa la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ gtso bo nam mkha'i zla ba gzhan gyis ci zhig bya zhes dgag bya dang / 'gog byed phal pa khyod gdong gi zla ba 'di yod bzhin no/ /sbyar lugs ni/ de gnyis ka lta ba'i mig la bdud rtsi ster ba'i bdag nyid yin pa dang / zla bas pad+ma tshar gcod cing / gdong gis pad+ma la mdzes pa'i sgo nas sdang ba dang / snum zhing dkar ba'i 'bras bu phun gsum tshogs pa can rnams thun mong du yod do/ /dper na/ skye dgu gdengs can gtsug na mngon 'phags shing / /bde legs 'dod dgu'i dpal gyis tshim mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal ba dbang gi rgyal po yod bzhin du/ /yid bzhin nor bu gzhan gyis ci zhig bya/ /zhes pa lta bu/ /gnyis pa ni/ phal pa gdong gi zla ba la brten pa gtso bo'i zla ba de dang mtshungs pa'i yon tan gsum po de rnams dang ldan par bstan par byas nas gtso bo'i zla ba 'gog par byed pa'i rnam pa de ltar sbyar bas 'gog go /nyer gnyis pa don gzhan 'gog pa la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyal po khyod kyis 'gro ba thams cad zil gyis mnan zin rung / da dung yang rgyal thabs rnam par gnon pa (66rna)tshim pa med pa la ngo mtshar ro zhes pa dgag bya/ 'gog byed 'on kyang bsreg za 'bar ba la bud shing ji tsam btab kyang tshig pa dag ni nam zhig mthong ste ma mthong ngo / /dper na/ srid 'dir dub pa'i 'gro la kun mkhyen gyis/ /ris su chad med bde legs stsol ba mtshar/ /'on tang mthun pa'i rgyu rkyen tshogs pa la/ /'bras bu 'byung ba dngos po'i gshis lugs yin/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ gang gi phyir 'dir ni rgyal thabs kyi don gzhan dag bkod pa de yi chos mtshungs sreg za bstan par byas nas/ ya mtshan rtsom pa 'gog par byed pa 'di ni don gzhan 'gog pa'o/ /—283

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2re/nyer gsum pa rgyus 'gog pa la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ ris med du ster ba'i mi dbang khyod la sbyin pa po zhes nam yang mi bstod de/ bstod pa dgag bya/ 'gog byed gang gi phyir slong ba rnams kyi bsam pa la/ rgyal po khyod kyi nor kho rang gi bdog pa nyid du bsam pa'i rgyus len no/ /dper na/ dbyangs can ma des bdag cag la/ /ngag gi dngos grub legs bstsal kyang / /khyod ni kun gyi shes rab lha/ /yin phyir bstod tshig ci phyir smra/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyal po de gtong phod rgya che ba zhes pa sogs la don gyis bstod pa'i phyir du/ de'i rgyu rnams slong mo ba kho nas longs spyod pa sogs kyi rgyus pha rol la bstod pa 'gog pa ni rgyus 'gog pa zhes bshad par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ phyogs 'di nyid kyi tshul la mkhas pa rnams kyis 'gog rgyan gyi rnam par rtog pa ga then dag kyang dpag par nus so/ (66ba)/don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/bdun pa don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan la/ mtshan nyid dbye ba dper brjod dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gang zhig dngos po 'ga' zhig sngon du bsgrub byar rab tu bkod nas/ de'i rjes su snga ma'i sgrub byed nus pa can dngos po g.yin dag 'god pa ni don gzhan bkod par shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ kun khyab khyad par la gnas dang / /sbyar ba can dang 'gal ba can/ /mi 'os byed dang 'os pa'i bdag /'os dang mi 'os bzlog pa'o ste 'di yi dbye ba brgyad po de lta bu la sogs pa tshig gi sbyor ba rnams la rab tu mtshon no/ /gsum pa dam bca' dang / dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i brgyad po 'di rnams kyi rang bzhin gsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ dper brjod kyi phreng ba bstan par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la brgyad las dang po kun khyab kyi don gzhan bkod pa ni/ skyes pa'i mthar 'jig — 284—

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)pa'i nges pa 'di la ni su zhig 'gong zhes nas bsgrub bya sngon du bkod nas/ 'jig pa'i chos de dngos po kun la khyab pa'i sgrub byed nus pa can/ legs ldan 'gro ba rnams kyi mig tu gyur pa'i nyi ma dang zla ba yang nub par 'gyur pa 'di nyid la ltos shig /gzhan rnams lo tsā ba'i 'gyur 'chugs pa yin pas 'dir tshig rkang mtha' ma sngon du mdzad pa'i bshad srol 'di grangs chen lo tsā ba'i rgyun yin zhes pa slob dpon mkhas pa gsung ngo / /dper na/ thig le mchog mar chags pas tshangs pa yis/ /gdong bzhi sprul pa 'di la su yis dmod/ /lam du ma zhugs lus can tha dag ni/ /'dod pas gzir bas 'khor bar ltung la ltos/ /(67na)zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa khyad par la gnas pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ bsgrub bya snying rje'i bdag nyid thob pa min nam ste thob pa'i sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis chos khyad par can gzhan gyi sdug bsngal zhi ba'i slad du thabs du ma mdzad pa bkod nas/ sgrub byed nus pa can sems med chu 'dzin 'di dag gis kyang / lus can rnams kyi tsha ba'i gdung ba yongs su 'phrog par byed do/ /'di'i 'gyur yongs grags kyi phyed phyi ma phyed snga mar byas na legs so/ /dper na/ nyi ma'i gnyen gyi thugs rjes yis/ /gdul bya'i rgyud kyi yon tan rgyas/ /lang tsho dar bab smin legs ma'i/ /bzin gyis chags ldan dga' ba 'phel/ /ches pa lta bu/ gsum pa sbyar ba'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ lho phyogs ma la ya'i rlung gis ni 'jig rten thams cad dga' ba skyed par byed do zhes bsgrub bya bkod nas/ sgrub byed dwa k+ṣi khyu/ lco dang / g.yas phyogs rjes mthun ya rkyen byin pas lto'i rlung sogs don mang po la 'jug pas/ de dang yang dag par ldan pas kun gyi snying la sdug pa ma yin nam zhes sgra gcig gis don du ma ston pa la sbyar ro/ /dper na/ 'gro ba'i mgon du zas gtsang sras/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi byin bla na 'bar/ /pū rba rā dz+ra sa mnga' 'bangs kyi/ /ra la pa'i cod pan rtse na 'gying / /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi pa 'gal ba'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ mtshan mor byed pa zla ba 'di dri ma dang ldan yang / 'gro ba rnams dga' ba skyed —285

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2ni/par byed pa bsgrub (67ba)bya/ sgrub byed nus pa can gnyis skyes te bram ze sna chad pa lta bu'i dbang po la skyon dang ldan yang / gdul bya gzhan dag la rig pa'i gnas ston pa'i sgo nas rjes su 'dzin par nus zhes ṇi skyon gyis bya ba legs po bsgrub pas 'gal ba ltar ston no/ /dper na/ mdzes sdug 'dong skyed dbyangs can mas/ /chags bral ye shes nye bar ste/ /lang tsho yol pa'i shong ston rje/ shes ldan rnams kyi snying du sdug /ces pa lta bu/ lnga pa mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ sbrang rtsi 'thung ba'i bung ba'i mgrin pa snyan po las byung ba'i sgra dag gis kyang chags pa 'phel bas/ rnam par rtsub pa nyid du gyur pa mi 'os pa'i bsgrub bya/ sgrub byed 'dod ldan thams cad la mi 'os bzhin du myong ba rgyu mthun gyi las rnams kyi sdig pa 'di 'dra ba zhes so/ /dper na/ blo bzang grags pa'i legs bshad bdud rtsi yis/ /blun sgom rgan po'i nad kyi zug rngu bskyed/ /tshe rabs mang por byol song bsgrubs pa'i thabs/ /goms pa'i bag chags ldan pa kun gyi gshis/ /zhes pa lta bu/ drug pa 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ 'dod ldan rnams kyi ngor chu skyes kyi 'dab ma'i mal bstan 'jam pa 'dis kyang bdag gi lus 'di gdung zhing sreg par byed pa 'os sam zhes pa bsgrub bya dang / sgrub byed spyir mi 'os kyang skabs 'di'i mtshan nyid dang bstun na/'dod pa'i dbang gis 'jam pa tsam gyis chags pa skyes nas nyon mongs pas bsreg pa'i bdag nyid byed pas sreg za dang 'dra bar rig pa ma (68na)yin nam/dper na/ rgyal bas 'gro la chos bstan pas/ /phan dang bde ba'i tshogs kun rgyas/ /rta ljang 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /pad dkar 'dab ma rnam par 'phel/ /cheX5 pa lta bu/ lnga/ sgrub pas/ lnga pa dang / drug pa gnyis po'i 'os mi 'os kyi khyad par rtsa ba mkhan po nyid la dri zer yang / lnga pa'i don ni/yul snyan pa des/ yul can la chags pas rtsub par gdung ba ni yon tan gyis skyon spel ba yin pas mi 'os pa yin la/ drug pa'i don ni/ 'jam pa tsam gyis gdung ba bskyed pa/ gdong mdzes pa tsam gyis chags pa'i sdug bsngal drag po bskyed pa 'jig rten na tshad mas grub pas 'os pa yin mod/—28(kyi

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)slob dpon daṇ+ḍi la dri ci dgos/ khyed rnams gcig tu mtshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i slob rgyun yin snyam pa'i dag snang dang / gnyis su bka' brgyud pa'i blun po rnams dang mi 'dra bsam pa'i mkhas 'thong yod kyang tshig rigs 'di tsho la dpags na drod che sar yang dbyar chu tsam mo/ /bdun pa 'os pa dang mi 'os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa ni/ bsil zer can gyis chags pa'i sgo nas nyams par byed pa 'os pa'i bsgrub bya/ dpyid dus kyi bdag ni ci la gdung ba mi 'os pa'i bsgrub bya/ sgrub byed kyang rim pa bzhin snga ma ni/ skyon gyi dri ma can yin pas/ spyod pa'i las kyang gzhan nyams byed yin gyi/ sgrub byed phyi ma ni rnam par dag pas mi 'os pa min nam/ dper na/ blo gsal mkhas la dga' 'os kyi/ /rmongs pa'i skye bos tshul (68ba〉de min/ /snyan pa'i sgra la thos 'dzin dag /ldan pas mnyan gyi 'os pas min/ /zhes pa lta bu/ brgyad pa mi 'os shing 'os pa'i don g.yin bkod pa ni/ ku mud ldan pa zla ba bsil yang sreg par byed pa mi 'os pa'i bsgrub bya/ pad+ma'i 'byung gnas nyi mas gdung ba cis mi byed de 'os pa'i bsgrub bya/ sgrub byed rim pa bzhin/ zla bas rjes su bzung ba'i ku mu ta'i 'dab ma rnams rtsub na/ cig shos nyi mas rjes su bzung ba'i pad+ma'i 'dab ma rnams 'jam par mi 'gyur ro/ /dper na/ sa sku'i bstan 'dzin nyes bshad 'chang byed na/ /bka' rgyud sgom chen blun gtam cis mi zer/ /mang por thos las legs bshad 'byung dgos kyi/ /thos nyung mu cor sgrog pa ngang tshul yin/ /zhes pa lta bu/ldog pa can gyi rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/brgyad pa ldog pa can gyi rgyan la/ mtshan nyid kyis mdor bstan/ dbye ba dang bcas te dper brjod bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dngos su sgra 'jug pa'am/ don gyi shugs dang skabs thob las rtogs par byed pa dag gi sgo nas/ dpe dpe can gyi dngos po gnyis ni rgyu mtshan 'ga' zhig gi sgo —287

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)nas mtshungs par gyur pa las/ khyad par zhig gi sgo nas mi mtshungs par ston pa de yi dbye ba brjod pa gang de ni ldog pa can zhes brjod do/ /gi nyis pa la sgras zin mtshungs pa'i ldog pa/ rtogs pas mtshungs pa'i ldog pa/ 'byed byed mtshungs pa'i ldog pa/ rigs mthun 'byed pa'i ldog pa can dang bzhi/dang po la lnga las/ gcig gis ldog pa can la dpe don (69na〉na nyis/ dang po ni mi 'gyur bar brtan pa dang / che ba'i bdag nyid dang / lwa wan+t+ra zhes pa mdzes pa dang / zab pa dang / lan tshwa rnams la 'jug pas/ de sogs yon tan gnyis ka las thun mong du 'jug rung gi sgo nas dpe can rgyal po khyod dang / dpe rgya mtsho mtshungs so/ /'on kyang rgyal po khyod kyi lus 'di 'dra skyes bu chen po'i mtshan nyid kyis mdzes pa gcig gi sgo nas dpe dang mi 'dra bar tha dad do/ /dper na/ 'chad pa'i rnam dpyod rtsom pa'i ngag gi dpal/ /rtsod pa'i spobs pa mkhas pa'i grags snyan gyis/ /dpang lo tsan+d+ra go ma'i mtshungs gyur kyang / /tshangs spyod brtul zhugs ldan pas rnam par dbye/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa ni/ gcig la gnas pa'i chos lus kyi ni dpe dpe can gnyis ka la gnas pa'i khyad chos tha dad dag rtogs pa'i yul du gyur pa'i phyir/ 'di ni gcig gi ldog pa can no/ /gnyis pa gnyis kyi ldog pa can la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ chu yi phung po dag dang rgyal po khyod gnyis/ chu mtshams dang ya rabs kyi spyod tshul las mi 'da' ba dang ring thung dang mkhyen pa'i gting dpag mi nus pas zab pa'i sgo nas mtshungs/ 'on kyang chu 'di ni mig sman gyi mdog dang mtshungs la/ khyod ni gser gyi 'od can no zhes dpe dpe can gnyis la nag ser gyi chos mi 'dra ba re re'i sgo nas khyad par 'byed pa'o/ /dper na/ ri dwags mig can zla ba gnyis/ /dkar 'jam mdzes sdug dga' bskyed pas/ /mtshungs kyang khyod ni nor 'dzin dang / /kun phan nam mkha'i ngos su rgyu/ /zhes pa (69ba〉〉 bu/ gnyis pa ni/ gang gi phyir 'dir ni dpe dpe can gnyis ka yi 'byed byed yon tan nag po dang ser po dag gis tha dad du bstan pa 'di ni gnyis ma'i ldog pa can no/ /—288

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)gsum pa sbyar ba can gyi ldog pa can la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyal po khyod dang rgya mtsho gnyis du rbu ro zhes pa bzlog dka' ba dang chu ngan pa gnyis la 'jug pas/ snga ma ni gang zag g.yin gyis mi bzlog pa dang / phyi ma ni ba tshwa sogs kyis ngan pa dang / de bzhin du ma ha sa twa snying stobs chen po dang sems can chen po gnyis ka la 'jug pas/ snga ma ni snying stobs che zhing / phyi ma ni chu srin chen po dang ldan pa/ te dzaḥni gzi brjid dang me gnyis ka la 'jug pas/ snga ma ni gzhan zil gyis gnon pa dang / phyi ma ni rgod ma kha'i me dang bcas pas/ sgra sbyar ba'i sgo nas dpe dpe can mtshungs kyang / rgya mtsho de ni chu'i bdag po dang / khyod ni blo dang ldan pa'i mkhas pa yin pas de yis khyod gnyis tha dad do/ /'di la sbyar gzhi gnyis las mi nyung zhing sgra nges par sbyar dgos so/ /dper na/me skyes gnas bstan yan lag 'byung dang gdong drug zla ba'i cod pan can dbyangs can ma dang dbang phyug gnyis/ /bsten pas dpa' bo ser skya gnyis/ /mtshungs kyang ma khol dkon mchog la/ /skyabs 'gro cig lha thos de las 'e1ga /ces pa lta khri//gnyis pa ni/ 'dir ni dpe dpe can gnyis ka sgra sbyar bas mtshungs chos kyis tshul dang ldan pa'i phyir sbyar ba can zhes bzung bar mdzod cig /bzhi pa 'gog pa can gyi ldog pa la/ dam (70na)bca' dang / dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'gog pa can yang bstan par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi lugs bzang po dang ldan pa dang / gzhan gyis g.yo bar mi nus pas brtan pa dang / rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas yin pa gsum/ dpe can rgyal po dang dpe rgya mtsho la yod pa mtshungs chos su bstan mod kyang / rgya mtsho chen po ni rgyal po khyod kyi 'gran zlar gyur pa ma yin pa ste/ yin pa dgag bya dang / 'gog byed dpe la ba tshwa sogs kyi dri ma dang ldan pa chu srin gdug pa gnas pa'i sgo nas ldog pa'o/ /dper na/ mi mthun las skyob re ba'i 'dod pa 'jo/ /snying du sdug cing kun gyis bsngags brjod kyang / /snyan 'gyur ngag gi cha shas yongs gang bas/ /tshangs sras ma la yongs 'dus 'gran du ci/ /zhes pa lta bu/ lnga pa gtan tshigs kyi ldog pa —289

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)can la/ dam bca' dngos dang / bshad ma thag pa rnams kyi mjug bsdu ba gsum/ dang po ni/ snga ma'i rjes su gnyis pa gtan tshig can de yang bstan par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ri rab gling bzhi rgya mtshor bcas pa yi sa gzhi mtha' dag 'dzin pa la dpe can rgyal po khyod dang dpe klu chen po mtshungs mod kyang / klu'i rgyal po lhag ma can gyi khyod ni lag 'gro rnams kyi rje 'gyur pa'i phyir na gtan tshigs kyis mi'i rje khyod pas dman no/ /dper na/ rtsa sdong lo 'dab ze'u 'bru sogs/ /bkra yang bud med 'gram chang gis/ /'byed phyir me tog ba ku la/ /pad+ma dag dang khyad par (70ba〉rtse/ /zhes pa lta bu/gsum pa ni/ dpe dpe can la sgra dag thun mong du 'jug par mtshungs pa yi khyad chos gzhan gyis mi 'dra bar ldog pa can ni 'dra ba bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa rtogs pa mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can la dam bca'/ dper brjod/ khyad par can bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po la sgras dngos su ma zin kyang shugs la rtogs par gyur pa'i sgo nas mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can yang yod pa de ni rjes su bsgrub bo/gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po rten gyi ldog pa can ni/ dpe can khyod kyi gdong pa ni bud med khyod rang la brten pa dang / dpe pad+ma ni chu las skyes pa'i phyir/ 'di gnyis kyi khyad par bstan pa'i sgo nas mtshungs pa dngos su ldog ste 'dra ba shugs la bstan pa'o/ /dper na/ dbyangs can ma dang kong co gnyis/ /snga ma tshangs pa'i bu mo dang / /rgya bza' shar phyogs rgyal po yi/ /sras mo yin pa'i khyad par yod/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis gnyis ka mtshungs pa'i sgras dngos su zin pa'i ldog pa can ni/ dpe can gyi khyod kyi gdong dang dpe pad+ma dkar po gnyis mtshungs chos kyi sgra rgyas pa dang dri bzang po dang ldan pa gnyis dngos su sgras zin pa/ mtshungs pa las ldog pa'i 'byed byed kyi sgra/ pad+ma la ni bung ba 'khor ba dang / khyod kyi gdong la mig rab tu g.yo ba'o/ /'dir snga ma rnams dang mi 'dra bar mtshungs chos dkar zhes pa lta bu thon dgos pas/ dper —29()

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i lha/ dbyangs/ (wa)na/ chags pas myos pa'i mchu sgros dang / /'dab brgya dmar ba'i mdangs 'dzin te/ /chu skyes 'di ni bung bas 'jib/ /mchu ni mdza' bos tsum pa na/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa mtshungs chos ma zin la 'byed byed kyi sgras dngos su mi zin pa'i ldog pa can la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ zla ba 'di dang ngang pa 'di ni 'byed byed kyi sgra nam mkha'i rgyan dang chu'i rgyan no/ /nam mkha' 'di dang chu 'di ni 'byed kyi sgra rgyu skar gyi phreng ba can dang / ku mud rgyas pa can no//zhes mtshungs chos shugs la bstan to/ /dper na/ blo ldan lha yi bla ma dang / /smra ba'i (71bskobang phyug shong ston gnyis/ /phur bu legs bris mdun sa'i rgyan/ /lo chen bod yul bstan pa'i dpyid/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dir ni zla ba ngang pa dag dkar ba nyid sogs shugs la rtogs pa dang /mkha' dang chu gnyis ni dwangs shing dag par yang shugs la rtogs par bya ba'i phyir / shugs la mtshungs pas dbye ba byas so/ /gsum pa ni/ dper brjod snga ma la ni rgyas zhes pa'i sgra dang ldan par dngos su mtshungs la/phyi ma la shugs bstan dang / gnyis ka la yang tha dad kyi dbye ba bung ba dang mig la sogs pa dpe dpe can rnams la mtshungs pa de'i phyir mtshungs pa'i ldog pa can no/ /bzhi pa rigs mthun ldog can la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ dpe can na chung lang tsho dar ba las byung ba'i chags pa'i mun pa dang /dpe spyi'i mun pa gnyis phyi'i gzugs blta ba 'gog par byed pa la rigs snamathun yang / snga ma ni/ rin po che snang ba'i 'od kyi phrog par mi nus shing / nyi ma'i 'od kyis mi bzlog pa yin la/ phyi ma ni de las go bzlog pas/ dpe can gyi skyon spongs gi dpe'i skyon sel mi thub pa'o/ /dper na/ pir gyis ri mor ma byas shing / /dbang po'i gzhu ris bkod min pa'i/ /rnam dpyod bkra ba'i gzigs mo yis/ /blo ldan mig la dga' ba ster/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni mun pa'i rigs las na chung gi mun pa 'dis gzugs blta ba 'gog pa nyid kyis mun pa dang mtshungs kyang / rna bas mi 'phrog pa sogs gzhan dag gis ni tha dad par brten (72na)pas 'di ni rigs mthun ldog pa can no/ /'dir zla —29/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)ba ngang pa gnyis dkar ba'i sgo nas mtshungs chos su bstan kyang / slar mi mtshungs par ldog yod pas dpe rgyan gyi skabs kyi skyon ga la 'jug /klu sgrub pa khyed 'di skor la sbugs thums po rang zhig byung 'dug pa/ khyed rang gis sku tshe rjes ma jo nang pa'i bstan pa la zhugs nas lta spyod thams cad zas gtsang gi sras po dang mi mthun pa'i gu yangs po zhig mdzad pa la smon lam btab pa 'dra'o/ /srid pa can gyi rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/dgu pa srid pa can gyi rgyan la mtshan nyid dang / dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'jig rten na rab tu grags pa'i rgyu bzlog nas/ gang zhig ma grags pa'i phyi nang gi rgyu g.yin cung zad dam grags ma grags gnyis ka la ma ltos par gang du rang gi ngo bo nyid ston pa de ni srid pa can no/ /gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po grags pa'i rgyu bkag nas/ phyi rol gyi rgyu cung zad kyi 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo nyid ston pa'i srid pa can ni/ ka da sba ste/ bya mthing ril gyis bzi ba'i rgyu chang ma 'thungs par myos pa dang / dri ma med pa'i rgyu 'phyid dgos par ma phyis par nam mkha' dag pa dang /dngas pa'i rgyu nor bu ke ta ka sogs kyis drungs par byed dgos pa la ma byas par/ dngas pa'i chu zhes yongs grags kyi rgyu bkag kyang / bshad ma thag pa gsum po 'di ston gyi dus su 'byung bas/ phyi ston gyi dus la bab pa'i rgyu cung zad kyi sgo nas 'bras bus 'gro ba'i yid ni 'phrog par byed do/ /dper na/ smra ba'i 'bab stegs dang bral ca co sgrog /(72ba〉tang pa med par nyin mtshan kun tu 'gro/ /gnod sems med par skye bo'i rgyu lam gcod/ /tshon gyis ma bsgyur mdog sngo dbyar gyi chu/ /zhes pa lta sdo//gnyis pa yongs grags kyi rgyu bkag nas nang gi rgyu cung zad dang bcas pas 'bras bu ston pa'i srid pa can la dngos dang / gnyis ma'i don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ nag pa'i rgyu mig sman ma —292

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)bskus par/ dkar ba min par gnag pa'i mig /smra ba'i rgyu mnan pa min par smin na smra ba dang /dmar ba'i rgyu tshon gyis ma bskus par mdzes ma khyod kyi mchu ni dmar ba 'di'o zhes yongs grags kyi rgyu bkag nas nang lang tsho rgyas pa'i rgyu cung zad bstan pa'o/ /dper na/ phrog min mkhas pa rnams kyi thos pas phyug /'tshe ba med par rmonges pa'i tsho gos kun bcom/ /'dod dang bral yang yon tan tshogs kyis 'khyud/ /dbyu gus ma bskul snyan pa'i skad gsang ldir/ /thes pa lta bu/ gnyisang pa ni/ gang gi phyir ma 'thungs pa dang ma bskus pa dang sogs las skyes pa'i 'bras bu myos pa dang nag pa nyid sogs kyi phyi nang gi rgyu g.yin can bstan no/ /gsum pa grags ma grags kyi rgyu gnyis ka bzlog nas 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo nyid ston pa'i srid pa can la/ dam bca'/ dpe don dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rgyu med pa dag kyang brjod 'dod pa de la skabs 'dir ni 'gal ba med do/ /gnyis pa ni/ dri zhim pa'i rgyu li shi sogs kyis dgos pa med par kha dri zhim/ mdzes pa'i rgyu bcos pa med par lus po mdzes/ dgra'i rgyu 'khon pa dag (73na)med par zla ba dgra/ grogs kyi rgyu mtshan phan pa dag med par 'dod pa grogs so/ /dper na/ ri mor ma bris ri dwags gzugs kyis mdzes/ / dgra zla min yang pad+ma'i tshogs kun 'joms/ /rgyu mtshan med par chu gter 'phel bar byed/ /snyegs mkhan bral yang mkha' la dal med 'bros/ / zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ bsgos pa med sogs kyi tshig gi skabs 'dir/ grags ma grags kyi rgyu ni dngos su rab tu bzlog cing / dri zhim pa nyid sogs 'bras bur brjod pa de'i phyir/ de ni srid can gyi rgyan no/ /klu sgrub pas rtog ge pa'i rigs pas 'gag bzhag sna tshogs 'dug pa ni snying por ma mthong la/'brel pa snga ma phal cher ya nga phyogs re'i mig tu song 'dug pas/ 'dir ni slob dpon mkhas pa'i legs bshad do/ /—293

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)bsdus brjod kyi rgyan bshad pa/bcu pa bsdus brjod kyi rgyan la/ mtshan nyid/ dpe brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ brjod 'dod dpe can gyi dngos po 'ga' zhig la bsam par byas nas/ de dang mtshungs pa'i dpe'i dngos po gzhan dag ngag tu bkod pa'i sgo nas/ dpe can de bsdus pa'i tshul gyis brjod par byed pa de ni bsdus pa brjod par 'dod do/ /gnyis pa la spyi dang / bye brag gnyis/ dang po ni/ bung ba rnams ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du pad+ma rgyas pa las sprang rtsi 'thung bar ma zad/ sbrang rtsi'i dri zhim po rgyas pa ma yin yang / me tog chung ngu kha ma bye ba la mchu sbyor ba la ltos zhes dpe dang / des dpe can gang bsdu na/ chags ldan (73ba)'ga' zhig bud med dar ma la 'khrig pa brten pa'i dga' ba'i rtse dgas bcings par ma zad/ de'i khyad par dag 'khrig pa brten ma ran pa'i bu mo chung ngu 'ga' zhig dag la yang 'dod pa 'phel ba ste/ mi tshangs par spyod pa'i tshul ston par byed do/ /zur mkhar me long ma'i me long du gar zhin gyis sgar pa chos grags rgya mtshos mdzad zer dper brjod bris 'dug pa la/ rang 'od 'bad nas spro mod kyang / / zer ba ni/ pad+ma rgyas pa'i phyir du zla bas rang 'od spro ba sems med rab rtog tu song bas/ mi shes pa'i rigs kyis shes mdog byed pa 'di/ rang gi nang cha ston par zad do/ /dper brjod ni/ /dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon pa'i grib sil la/ /longs su spyod pa'i dga' ston phyir dor nas/ /tshad pa'i gdung ba skyabs phyir blun po 'ga'/ 'ang skam 'khyog po'i yal ga dag la brten/ /ce kho smu pa lta bu/ gnyis pa la mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis las/ dang po ni/ khyad par can tsam tha dad cing / khyad chos rnam par mtshungs pa'ang yod la/ yang khyad gzhi tha dad pa la/ khyad par la tha dad cing la la tha dad min pa dang / 'di dag las gzhan pa sngon med pa'i bsdus brjod 'di dag kyang yod do/ / gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po khyad gzhi tha dad cing khyad chos mtshungs pa'i —294

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wanabasdus brjod ni/ dpe dpag bsam gyi ljon shing chen po dang dpe can skyes bu chen po gnyas khyad gzhi tha dad cing / khyad chos thun mong du sgra 'jug rung du yod pa/ gzhan gyis bsgul (74nas nus pas rtsa ba brtan pa dang / sde bzhi dang shing tog gi 'bras bu'i khur gyis brjid pa dang / slong ba rnams rtag tu yid dga' ba rgyas par byed pa dang / phan bde dang lo ma'i grib ma bar ma chad pas snum pa 'di ni bdag gis yang dag par thob bo zhes dpe can la bsams nas dpe dngos su brjod pa'o/ /dper na/zla ba'i ma ma gting dpag rtogs dka' zhing / /re 'dod ches skong nor bu'i 'byung gnas mchog /skyo ngal med par rgyu zhing bsil 'jam can/ /skyon ldan ro dang lhan cig mi gnas mtshar/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa khyad gzhi tha dad la khyad chos mtshungs shing mi mtshungs pa'i bsdus brjod la dngos dang / gnyis ga'i don bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni dpe dpe can gnyis dang / de'i khyad gzhi tha dad tshul bshad ma thag pa ltar la/ khyad chos yal ga'i khyon ni mi chung ba dang / me tog dang 'bras bu cig car du phun sum tshogs pa gnyis ni dpe kho na'i khyad chos yin la/ phan bde dang lo ma'i grib sil/ g.yin gyis bsgul bskyod mi nus par brtan par ldan pa gnyis ni mi dam pa dang shing gi dam pa gnyis ka la thun mong du 'jug tu rung bas/ shing 'di bdag gi skal bas rnyed do zhes dpe can la bsams nas dpe dngos su brjod pa'o/ /dper na/ 'jam zhing yid 'ong mdzes sdug can/ /ze'u 'bru yal 'dab rab ldem pa/ /pad+ma dkar po'i chun po 'di/ / bung ba rnams kyi yid du 'ong / /zhes pa lta bu/ 'bras bu ni sde bzhi la sbyar chog pa dang / (74ba)yal ga rgyal po la sbyar bar 'brel mi 'byung bas/ klu sgrub pa don med gyi rtog btags ma mdzad cig /gnyis pa ni/ bshad ma thag pa gnyis ka la yang skyes bu mchog 'ga' zhig la bsam nas ljon pa nyid kyi bsngags pa nye bar brjod nas khyad par gyi chos rnams thams cad dper brjod snga ma la dpe dpe can gnyis ka thun mong du yod la/ gzhan rjes ma la rnam pa gnyis mar yod med sna tshogs so/ /gsum pa sngon med bsdus brjod la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ dpe can rgyal po ngan pa'i —295—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)spyod pa dang mi 'grogs shing / dam pa'i spyod tshul rang bzhin gyis mngar ba/ legs byas kyi gter 'di dus kyi pho nya'i dbang gis 'chi'o/ /zhes pa la bsam nas/ dngos su dpe brjod pa ni/ sprul ngan pa 'grogs pa dang bral zhing ba tshwa med pa'i rang bzhin gyis ni mngar ba'i nang rin po che'i 'byung gnas can/ chu'i gter 'di ni kye ma dus kyi yongs su skams par gyur to/ /zhes sprul dang ba tshwa med pa'i rgya mtsho mi 'byung bas sngon med pa'o/ /dper na/ lha yi lam la mi 'gro zhing / ku mud rgyas par mi byed pa'i/ /chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /bdag gi snying la ci yang sdug /ces pa lta bu/ /gnyis pa ni/ rgya mtsho la yod pa'i skyon de med par brjod pa yis bsam bya'i mtshungs chos bsdus pas/ skyes bu'i yon tan gyi ldog pa gsal bar byed cing / snga ma'i chos sbrul sogs 'jig rten na grags pa ni bzlog pa'i phyir 'di ni sngon med bsdus pa brjod/ /phul byung gi rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/bcu gcig pa phul byung gi rgyan la mtshan nyid kyis mdor (75na tha stan/ dper brjod rgyas par bshad/ bstod pas mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ khyad par gyi ni ste mchog tu gyur par brjod par 'dod pa gang yin pa'i yon tan rnams 'jig rten gyi mtshams las brgal bar gyur ba'i 'ud chen po'i sgo nas phul du byung bar brjod pa 'di rgyan rnams kyi dam pa yin te/ dper na/ gnyis pa la bzhi las/ dang po khyad 'phags phul byung la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ khyad gzhi mdzes ma'i lus dkar ba'i steng gi khyad chos/ me tog shin tu dkar ba ma slo kā yi phreng tshogs can gyi thod bcings shing / tsan+dan dkar pos lus kun khyab par gsher ba/ sha mi sgrib pa'i ras du kū la dkar po'i gos can/ sngon du 'gro ba'i dkar ba 'di la zla ba'i 'od kyis mtshon nus pa ma yin no zhes 'ud brjod do/ /dper na/ legs sbyar la sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas/ / sbyangs shing mkhyen pa'i —296

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)mkhas dbang smon 'gro ba'i/ /med du byung ba'i rnam dpyod mchog 'di la/ /'jam dbyangs gzhon nu des kyang 'gran nus min/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ zla ba'i 'od ni shin tu dkar ba sogs yin pas lhag pa nyid/ de las kyang khyad par 'phags pa dang ldan par brjod do/ /gnyis pa the tshom phul byung la/ lhag ma rnams kyi dam bca' dang / dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/bshad ma thag pa de bzhin du the tshom phul byung la sogs kyang gsal phyir cung zad bstan par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dga' ma khyod kyi nu ma dang / dbyi mgo ste 'tshang ra (75btos gas pa'i nyams su byas pa'i bar na sked pa ni yod dam med ces bdag gis ni the tshom da dung bzlog par ma gyur to zhes pa ste/ dper na/ nyin mtshan khor yug kun tu thos bsam la/ /ngal med brtson pas bsgrub pa'i shes ldan khyod/ /'byung 'dus lus ni 'tsho ba'i bza' btung dag /spyod pa'i go skabs yod med 'phyang mo ༷stan /ces pa lta bu/ /gsum pa nges pa phul byung ni/ ni ta phri ni smad rgyas ma khyod kyi dbyi dang nu ma'i bar la ni sked pa yod ces nges par nus te/ 'o ma 'dzin pa'i khur gnas pa'i rten cig nges par dgos la/ sked pa med pa'i stong sang nam mkha' lta bu'i rnam pa la brten pa gzhan du srid pa min no/ /dper na/ grogs dang rtse dgar rol phyir 'byud pa'i tshe/ /nu 'bur min pa'i 'jam zhing gnyen pa yis/ /mdza' bo'i sked par reg bya'i bde ster ba/ /lus phra'i rgyan 'chang yul der nges pa rnyed/ /ces pa lta bu/bzhi pa ngo mtshar phul byung ni/ sa skyong khyod kyi grags pa'i phung po 'di ni dpag nus min yang srid pa gsum po 'dir ni shong ba/ e ma sa 'di'i khongs dag shin tu yangs so/ /dper na/ 'jam mgon bla ma kun mkhyen tsong kha ba'i/ /mkhyen brtse'i pha mtha' 'chi med lam gyis kyang / gzhal nus min 'di bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs/ /shong ba'i snod ni e ma ngo mtshar che/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gzhung gi tshig zin gtso bor byas nas grags pa phul byung zhes 'chad 'dug na'ang / rgya chung bar mngon la/'grel pa snga ma rnams su ldog pa'i phul byung sogs (76na〉pang por spro ba'i dper brjod mdzad kyang /—297

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)tshig tshogs che ba tsam du zad cing / rgyan 'dres pa spro bar shar na dpe rgyan sum cu so gnyis dang sbyar ba'i phul byung 'ong bas mtshon te bstod smad kyi rgyan 'dres pa khri phrag brgal ba 'byung ba'i phyir/ blo gros kyis dpogs pa las brjod par mi nus so/ /gsum pa bstod pas mjug bsdu ba ni/ sngar bshad pa dang 'chad 'gyur gyi rgyan ni gzhan pa dag las kyang / snyan ngag mkhan ngag gi dbang po rnams kyis mchod par gyur pa ste bsngags pa brjod pa'i yul ni phul byung gi rgyan zhes par brjod pa 'di gcig pu nyid ni mchog tu brjod do/ /rab rtog gi rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/bcu gnyis pa rab rtog gi rgyan la mtshan nyid/ /dper brjod/ log rtog dgag pa/ rab rtogs gsal byed kyi sgra bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ sems ldan srog chags dag gam/ cig shos srog med kyi rnam par gzhan du gnas pa'i tshul gang yin pa la dmigs nas/ gang du dngos po gzhan gyi gnas tshul la sgro btags nas/ rnam pa gzhan rab tu rtog pa ltar ston pa de ni rab rtog tu rig te/dper na/ gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po sems ldan rab rtog la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni glang po che dag ni nyi ma'i gung la nyi ma'i tsha bas gdungs pa yis/ bsil ba'i ched du pad mtshor 'jug pa la/ nyi mas gdungs pa'i lan du/ de'i phyogs su gyur pa'i pad+ma rnams gzhom par 'dod pa yin nam snyam zhes (76ba)sgro btags so/ /dper na/ dbyangs can thor tshugs rnam par g.yo ba'i rtse/ /zla tshes gsar pas rab tu legs brgyan pa/ /dmar phyogs rdzogs pa gsum pa'i sngo bsangs dus/ / stug po'i mun pa sel bar dgongs sam snyam/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa ni/ lag ldan khrus dang btung ba dang pad rtsa za ba'i phyir chur la jug pa la/ de ni 'khon lan glen pa'i phyir yin no zhes snyan ngag mkhan gyis rab btags brjod do/ /—298

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)gnyis pa sems med rab rtogs la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ lus phras mdzes pa'i phyir du ut+pal rna gong du 'dzugs pa la 'di ni mig bdag gi dkyus ring ba dag 'gog par byed pa'i ched du rna ba'i rgyan gyi zol du 'ongs so zhes/ de'i lan du khyod kyi mig gi zur ring por spros nas rna ba yi ut+pal la 'gong ba 'dra'o/ /dper na/ 'ja' 'od lus phus 'khril bag gis/ /'dod pa'i dga' ston la spyod par/ /ba spu'i tshogs rnams nyer langs te/ /mgo bo btegs nas blta ba bzhin/ zhes pa 'i lnga sdo//gnyis pa ni/ mig zur char ni lhung par gyur pa la btags nas/ mig gi 'od kyis ut+pal la reg pa min yang / snyan ngag mkhan gyi de ltar rab tu btags te brjod do/ /gsum pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rab rtog ni/ sems med mtshan mo mun pa thebs pa des/ sems ldan gyi bya ba rang gi lus la mun pa 'byug pa bzhin no/ /sems med nam mkha' 'dis ni sems ldan gyi bya ba mig sman gyi char pa 'bebs pa bzhin no/ /zhes pa 'di dang / yar ngo'i sgras rab rtog gi (77nasgo tshan nyid dang ldan pa shin tu mang ngo / /dper na/ zla gzhen shar bas ku mud ta/ /dga' bas yang yang 'dzum pa bzhin/ /bung bas bcud rnams khyer dogs nas/ /ge sar skrag nas 'dar ba ba'i na/ /zhes pa lta bu/gsum pa log rtog dgag pa la lung dang 'gal ba/ rigs pa dang 'gal ba/ mjug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'dir ni bzhin gyi sgra yis 'ga' zhig la dpe rgyan nyid du ni 'brul pa skyed kyang mi rigs te 'byug pa bzhin sogs kyi byings sgrub la tsan+da pa ltar na legs/ ka lwa pa ltar na kun bshad kyi wa rta ma na'i gcig tshig te byin shul ti nga'i mtha' yin la/ dpe la de phan gyi rkyen ster dgos pas ma yin no zhes pā ṇi sogs kyi yid ches kyi gsung las 'da' mi rigs pas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dpe dang dper bya nyid dag ni mtshungs pa'i chos la ltos dgos pas na/ 'byug pa dang ni mun pa gnyis la dpe don gyi mchungs chos 'di zhes mngon du mthong bar gyur tam ci ste med —299

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)do/ /gal te 'byug pa nyid dper brjod 'dod na/ 'byug ces pa bya ba las g.yin pa ci ste/ mun pa dang tha mi dad do/ /'byug pa de nyid mtshungs chos dang / chos can dpe yang yin zhes pa ma smyos pa sus kyang 'chad pa ma yin no/ /gal te byed pa dpe yin na/ ti zhes pa'i bya tshigs la 'byug ces pa ni dbang dang bral bar 'gyur te/ rang gi bya ba 'byug pa nyid kyang bsgrub mi nus pas na/ gzhan gyi dpe don mtshungs chos su sbyor ba'i re ltos su byar mi 'gyur ro/ /gang (77bskos 'byug pa 'di dang ni mun pa mtshungs zhes smra na yang / lus la zhes pa las kyi tshig dpe don ma 'brel te/ de yang yon tan sogs kyi mtshungs chos lta ci smos te med do/ /dper na khyod gdong zla ba bzhin/ zhes pas dpe dpe can gyi sgo nas mdzes chos rtogs par 'gyur ba ste de bzhin du 'byug pa 'di la yang ni 'byug pa las gzhan pa'i mtshungs chos zhig rtogs dgos pa la de rtogs pa ma yin pas dpe ma grub bo/ /gsum pa ni/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir 'byug pa zhes brjod pa 'di da ni bya ba mun pa byed pa dang //rus kyang las su nye bar sbyar ba'i don to/ /skyes bu mkhas pas de ltar rab btags zhes 'dod par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ snyam dang dogs dang nges dang 'dra/ min nam zhes pa la sogs pa'i sgra yis rab btags gsal bar byed/ bzhin gyi sgra yang de dang 'dra/ zhes pa rnams kyi dper brjod rim pa bzhin/ dbyangs can be+eḍūr rgyud mang brdungs pa na/ / dbyar rnga skyengs te sprin gos gyon nam snyam/ /ri dwags mig can bzhin gyi mdzes sdug gis/ /chu shel dbang po gling g.yin bros kyi dogs/ /sde srid phag grus rdzogs ldan bos pa na/ /nga las nu de slar yang 'ongs par nges/ zhang ston rig byed 'chad pa'i rnam dpyod 'di/ /bstan tshe phur bu sa 'dir 'ongs pa 'dra/ /dbyangs can zhal khyim dkar zhing 'dzum pa yis/ /pad+ma'i tshogs rnams dga' nas rgod min nam/ /zhes pa lta bu/ le'u dang po'i mdzes pa'i rgyan gyi skabs su/ lag pa lta bu phu dung gi nang du la jug bzhin pa'i lag (78na)pa zhig la/lag pa 'di ches grags nas phu dung gi nang du ma shong ngo zhes 'ud byed pa yin la/ phul byung gi skabs —3(///

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (5)su lag pa 'di gang gis kyang gzhal ma nus pa'i chen po zhig yin kyang / phu dung 'dir chud pa ya mtshan no zhes pa zhig dgos pas khyad par che zhing / le'u dang po'i ting nge 'dzin la rab rtog gsal byed kyi sgra med cing / 'dir yang yod pas blo gsar ba rnams mgo bo mgal me ltar 'khor mi dgos so/ /rgyu'i rgyan gyi skor bshad pa/bcu gsum pa rgyu'i rgyan la/ mtshams sbyar dang / dngos gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyu'i rgyan 'di ni tshig rnams dag gi rgyan gyi mchog go /gnyis pa la mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ 'jug bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rgyu la ni/ byed po gang gis las dang bya ba byed bzhin pas 'bras bu bskyed pa'i tshul gang yang rung ba zhig ni byed po'i rgyu dang / du ba'i rtags las me yod par rtogs pa lta bu shes byed kyi rgyu de dag la rnam pa du ma dper brjod na gnyis pa la dngos po'i rgyu/ dngos med kyi rgyu mtshar ba'i rgyu dang gsum/ dang po la byed po'i rgyu dang / shes byed kyi rgyu gnyis dang po la sgrub byed kyi rgyu dang /las kyi rgyu gnyis/ dang po la gnyis las/ dang po skyed byed 'grub pa'i rgyu la dpe don gnyis/ dang po ni/ tsan+dan gyi ljon pa gsar ba yi yal 'dab myo phyogs ma la ya'i rlung gis ni skyod par byed pa las byung ba'i dri zhim pa'i bser bu 'di skyed byed de rgyu yin la/ bskyed bya 'bras bu ni/ rlung 'di phog (78ba)pa'i skye bo kun sngar med gsar du yid kyi dga' ba skyed par byed pa de'o/ /dper na/ ngag gi dbang phyug dbyangs can ma'am/ med byung thugs rje chen po des/ /bdag la 'chad rtsod rtsom pa yi/ /blo gros snang ba ci yang 'phel/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa ni/ 'gro ba kun dga' ba bskyed par 'os pa'i rgyu/ rlung dang dri bsil ba'i rang bzhin snye bar sbyar ba 'di skyed byed kyi rgyu'i rgyan nyid du ni rab bstan te/ dga' ba de las ldog pa dag kyang 'chad par 'gyur pas/ de dang mtshungs so/ /gnyis pa nyams byed 'grub pa'i rgyu la/ dpe —30/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)don zhar byung dang gsum/ dang po ni/ ma la ya yis chu rgyun la reg cing bdar bas bsil ba dang /tsan+dan gyi nags bskyod pa las dri zhim dang lhan cig tu 'ongs pa'i rlung ni skyed byed dang skyed bya mgron po rnams bud med dag dang bral nas ring por song ba la phogs pas chung ma dran nas dga' ba nyams te 'chi ba byed pa'i phyir nye bar gnas so/ /zhes don dril na rgyu gcig gis 'bras bu bskyed lugs go ldog pa'o/ /dper na/ sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma'i/ /phul byung mkhyen brtse nus pa yis me tog mda' can dpung tshogs kyi/ /blo gros skal ba ngan par byas/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa ni/ de ltar byung ba'i rlung gi rgyus ni 'bras bu bud med dang bral ba'i skye bo chags pa rim pas 'phel ba las byung bar gyur pa yid 'ong ma la sred pa 'phel bas dga' ba nyams pa sgrub par byed par (79na〉kyis so/ /gsum pa ni/ dper na/ dpyid ka sa bon btab pa'i rgyus/ ston ka sngar med kyi 'bras bu skyed par byed pa lta bu ni 'grub par byed pa dang / snam bu dkar po de 'gyur bya/'gyur byed rams kyis 'bras bu gnas skabs gzhan sngon por song ba ni rnam 'gyur te/ 'gyur byed kyi ngo bo nyid la ltos pa'i rgyu nyid do/ /thob pa'i las phal cher ni bya ba la ltos pa'i rgyu nyid yin te/dper na/ nas khal gcig lta bu'i yon de 'bras bu thob bya yin la/ thob byed brgyad stong pa lta bu ni ma yin par/ de klog pa'i bya ba de yin no/ /'di dag gi skor 'grel ba phal cher la mi gsal zhing /'ga' zhig tu rtog btags kyis log par 'phyan pa yang snang mod/ 'dir ni slob dpon mkhas pa'i gsung la brten nas gzhung don nyi ma lta bur gsal bar byas pas/ legs par bshad drags pa'i skyon gyis stag lung mkhas pas mi zin pa'i dpe ltar/ bla chen rnams thugs rgyal bzhengs par gyur na bzod par gsol lo/ /gnyis pa las kyi rgyu la/ dam bca' ba/ rnam 'gyur gyi rgyu/ thob bya'i rgyu dang gsum/ dang ngo/ ni/ 'grub par byed pa'i rgyu dag ni bstan zin pa de ltar/ lhag ma gnyis po yi dper brjod gnyis ni da lta nyid du bkod par byas nas de rjes shes par byed pa yang bstan par bya'o/ /—3()2

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wanaganyis pa ni/ lo 'dab gsar du 'khrungs pa'i nags tshal dang / 'dab brgya rab tu rgyas pa'i rdzing bu dang / (79ba)zla ba rgyas pa rnams ni 'gyur bya yin la/ de rnams mthong ba la brten nas bud med dang bral bas nyen pa rnams la 'gyur bar byed mkhan 'dod pa yis 'gyur bya de rnams mgron pos lta ba'i dug tu byas pa ste bsgyur ba lta bu'o/ /dper na/ sor mo'i 'phrul gyis legs grub pa'i/ /thabs su byas pa'i lwa ba dkar/ /li khris gos shing dras sdebs pas/ /dge sbyong mchog gi bla gos mdzes/ /zhes pa lta sdo//gsum pa ni/ skye bo lang tsho can des bu mo mdzes ma rang gi thob bya'i 'bras bu dang / bu mo de'i grogs mo 'ga' zhig gis de g.yin dang mthun pa la zhe sdang ba yin yang / 'phral mdza' ba'i gnas su bkod pa ste snying gtam ltar byas nas/ mdza' bo la khengs pa goms par bya'o zhes zer ba bu mos rig ste/ smin ma 'khyog cing mig g.yon du log pa dang / smod tshig gi mchu ni g.yo zhing khro ba'i tshul gyis lta ba byed pa ni thob byed kyi rgyu yin no/ /dper na/ dbang phyug go chas dka' spyad kyis/ /ga the ne nu gdong drug legs bsgrub pas/ /legs sbyar gnas la lta ba'i blo/ / dka' ba med par lhun gyis sdi/ba/ /ces pa lta bu/gnyis pa shes byed kyi rgyu la gnyis las/ dang po phyi shes byed kyi rgyu ni/ nyi ma nub par gyur cing / zla ba yang gsal zhing mdzes la/ 'dab chags rnams ni so so'i gnas su nyal bar song ngo / /zhes pa 'di lta bu brjod pa gang shes byed kyi rgyu dang / shes bya mtshan mo'i dus kyi gnas skabs go bar byed pa legs par bstan pa nyid do/ /dper na/ ljon shing lo 'dab gser gyi mdangs 'dzin (80na jing / /gang bu'i tshogs rnams rab smin khur gyis lci/ /chu lha'i bu yi dkyil 'khor mngon par gsal/ /nyal 'gro'i rgyun rnams nad sel bdud rtsir gyur/ /ces pa lta bu/gnyis pa nang shes byed kyi rgyu ni zla ba'i 'od kyis kyang mi bzlog cing / tsan+dan gyi chu yis kyang bzod par mi nus pa'i grogs mo khyod kyi lus kyi drod kyi gdung ba 'dzin pa 'di nyid nang shes byed kyi —3/)3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)rgyu dang / shes bya ni grogs snying du sdug pa la yid 'dod pas gzir ba go ba'o/ /zhes pa'i sbyor ba rnams la yid du 'ong ba shes par byed pa'i rgyu dag mtshon no/ /dper na/ shes bya'i gzhung gi dka' ba'i gnas rnams dag /mthong tshe 'dzum dang bcas te lhug par smra/ /yon tan dregs pas 'gying ba mang tshogs tshe/ /'jigs pa med par chos kyi 'khri la 'gying / /thes pa lta bu/gnyis pa dngos med kyi rgyu la dam bca'/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ dngos med kyi rgyusamakhas pa yid 'phrog pas/ 'ga' zhig rab tu bsten par bya'o/
