tshes lta bu'i sos/ /dbang po mig stong sprul nas lta min nam/ /zhes pa lta bu/bcu pa bzhi spu'i thog ma la yod pa ni/ khyod kyi mgo'i skra bung ba dang 'dra zhing / gdong ni pad+ma ra phrag dog byed pa'i dkar ba/ lha mo dpal mo bzhin du skye bo mtha' dag rab tu myos par byed ma khyod kyis/ skyes bo su zhig 'dod myos kyi grangs su rtsi bar mi byed do/ /dper na/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsang gsum ma lus pa/ /rgyal sras gzhen nu'i gzugs su legs shar ba/ /rgyal phran mang po'i gtsug na 'gying ba'i phyir/ /rgyal po srong btsan sgam po bod kyi rje/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bcu gcig pa bzhi rka'i thog ma la yod cing byed snga phyi rigs mi gcig pa ni/ rgya che ba'i rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan zhing rgyags pa'i mig khor khor du lta ba dang / dza gha na ste tshang ra chung ba ma yin pas mdza' bo ni dga' ba dang ldan pa bya bar bzod nus so/ /dper na/ rab bsil dal gyis 'bab pa'i chu klung 'gram/ /—346

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (5)rab (110na〉snyan sgra de rna bar thos pa'i mod/ /bag phebs nags tshal dra ba'i dben gnas su/ /bag yod gtan bde bsgrub snyam phyang mo nyug /ces pa lta bu/ /bcu gnyis pa mi mnyam pa gnyis dang mnyam pa gnyis 'dra ba'i thog ma la yod pa ni gzhan gsos khu byug rnams kyi skad sgrags pa dang / mdzes ma khyod kyis brjod pa'i sgra dang ni/ lha yi phyogs kyi rlung gis kyang bdag gi yid phrog so zhes pho nya mo la bos so/ /dper na/ dkar 'jam zla ba'i gzugs la rab 'khu ba/ /mdzes sdug lang tsho rnam par rgyas pa can/ /dkar gsal bzhin ras ngom tshe khengs ldan can/ /mdzes ldan yongs kyi brtan pa rnam par phyogs/ /zhes pa lta bu/bcu gsum pa thog mtha' gnyis dang bar pa gnyis 'dra ba'i thog ma la yod pa ni sked pa shin tu phra zhing / 'dod pas rngul zags pa yis gdong gi zla ba yang bkrus nas rab tu mdzes par gyur pa/chang 'thungs pas ngo tsha bcom pa'i bud med rnams kyis skyes pa'i lus la 'dzegs shing 'byud par byed do/ /dper na/ sgra rgyan snyan tshig smra ba la/ /'jigs pa med pa'i spobs pa mchog /'jigasabral shes rab kyis thob tshe/ /sgra rgyan rtsom la 'tsho byung bzhin/ /zhes pa lta bu/gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ de ltar bar du chod pa'i zung ldan gyi rab tu dbye ba 'di yang bstan zin to/ /gsum pa chod la ma chod pa'i zung ldan dam bca' dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ bar ma chod dang (110ba)chod pa gnyis spel ba'i bdag nyid can gyi rnam rtog rnams kyang yod pa 'di lta ste/gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po phyed snga ma gnyis dang phyed phyi ma gnyis 'dra zhing chod cing ma chod pa ni/ ka li ka ste/ me tog gzhen nu thur du 'phyang ba'i yal ga dang ldan pa can gyi swā la'i shing lo 'dab rgyas pa de la lta bar mi nus shing / de bzhin du/ ba ku la chags pa'i bung ba la yang lta mi nus pa dang mtshungs par grogs mo khyod kyi pad+ma gzhon nu dang / lha phreng dkar po can la yang lta mi nus te/ chags pa ha cang rgyas pas so/ / dper na/ chil chil rlabs phreng g.yo ba'i rgya mtsho yi/ /chil chil rba rlabs che las bgrod pa'i thabs/ /brtan brtan gru rdzings tshags su tshud pa la/ /brtan brtan blo dang ldan pa'i —347

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)ded dpon gnas/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa thog mtha' gnyis dang bar pa gnyis 'dra ba ni/ sprin nag chen po mkha' la ldan pa'i dus su/ sno snga ba dang rgyu skar kun mi mtshon pa ste mi snang bar gyur ba dang / rma bya skad gsang mthon por dga' ba sgrog par byed pa'i dus su 'dod ldan bdag 'dra su yis blta bar mi nus te/ chags pas 'a bar dogs pas so/ /dper na/ ldem ldem pad dkar sdong bu g.yo ba'i rtser/ / 'byog 'byog mngon par 'phrul ba'i sked pa dang / /'khyog 'khyog zur du lta ba'i ut+pal spyan/ /ldem ldem thor tshugs rtsen zla tshes dkar/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa bzhi /la 'dra ba ni/ thun gsum (111na)gyi dbang du gyur ba'i ring ba yi mtshan mo gshin rje 'dra ba 'dis bdag shi bar gyis shig /rgyu mtshan dga' ma phyogs gang dag la bdag song yang bral bas/ 'dod pas srog gzir 'gro bas na/ mdza' mo de ni 'grogs pa'i blo med par bdag bcom mo/ /dper na/ 'grig 'grig legs par bshad pa'i lce med par/ /'grig 'grog rdzun gyis gzhan mgo skor byed pa/ /'grig 'grig so phreng ston pa'i g.yo khram can/ /'grig 'grig brag ri brtsegs ltar don gyis stong / /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa don bsdub ni/ zhes rkang pa dang po'i zung ldan gyi rnam par rtog pa'i lugs 'di ni bshad ma thag pa 'di 'dra ste/ 'di lta kho na ltar zung ldan gyi rnam rtog g.yin pa 'og nas 'byung ba rnams kyang blo gros kyis gzhal bar bya'o/ /bya dka' ba gnas g.yin la yod pa'i zung ldan gyi skor bshad pa/gnyis pa bya dka' gnas g.yin la yod pa'i zung ldan la/ dam bca'/ dper brjod gnyis/dang po ni/ gzhung ha cang spros pas cung zad 'jigs pa'i phyir/ zung ldan gyi dbye ba mtha' dag brjod par mi 'dod de/ sngar bya sla cung zad tsam bstan cing / da ni de la bya dka' ba mngon par 'dod pa gang 'ga' zhig dag ni bstan par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la rkang bzhi'i dbus na yod pa/ mtha' na yod pa/—348

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)bar mtha' gnyis na yod pa/ thog bar gnyis na yod pa/ thog mtha' gnyis na (111ba〉sgod pa/gnas gsum ka la yod pa dang drug /dang po la gnyis las/ chod cing ma chod pa ni/ blo brtan pa dang dbang po rab tu bsdams pa khyod ni sdom brtson gyi brtul zhugs la gnas pa'i phyir mi dge bas mi nyams pa de'i phyir g.yo sgyu med pa khyod kyi bde ba 'jig par mi 'gyur ba 'di snyed du ma zad/ bde ba thob pa'i ched du yon tan 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /dper na/ gang zhig 'phrog byed 'phrog byed la sogs pa'i/ khengs pa 'phrog byed 'phrog byed mkhyen brtse'i gter/ /gangs ri'i 'phrog byed 'phrog byed ji bzhin du/ /g.yin stobs 'phrog byed 'phrog byed 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa chod pa kho na ni/ rgyal po'i mdun sar lha yi ste bram ze rnams dag gis zhal chang gis ma bcom par/ rgyal po'i gtong ba sogs nor gyis mdzes pa rab tu bstod pa'i rgyus/ khyod kyi yon tan rab tu gsal ba la yid chags pa'i skye dgu bdag la grags pa'i phung po nyid du 'gyur bar ma zad/lha rnams kyi gnas su ni grags pa mi 'gro ba min no/ /dper na/ legs byas phul byung gangs ri las 'ongs stobs 'byor phul byung gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /gser spyangs phul byung 'khor lo las grub thogs med phul byung bsgyur ba'i shugs/ / stobs 'byor phul byung lhun gyis legs grub rdzogs ldan phul byung mgron du 'gugs/ /sde bzhi'i phul byung sgo 'phar brgya 'byed sa spyod phul byung 'khor los bsgyur/ /ḍi ni tha sdo pa 'u lnga sdo//gnyis pa la gnyis (112na〉pas/ dang po ni/ dam pa'i spyod pa la bag med kyi tshul dang mi ldan pa khyod kyi dga' ma gang zhig dga' ba'i dga' ston 'khrig pa'i dga' bas khyad par du myos ma de yis ni skabs 'dir ni 'od ldan gyi rin po che'i rgyan rnams gzung bar 'os kyi/ bdag la ni rgyan gzhan gyis mdzes ldan du byas pa nyid kyi 'bras bu 'ga' yang med do/ / dper na/ nor ldan dbusan dwa ri dra ltar ston/ mkhas pa'i dbus na rmongs pa bzhin du ston/ /blun po'i dbus na mkhas pa'i ngang tshul ston/ /so can dbus na 'dab chags gshog pa ston/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa chod la ma —349

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)chod pa ni/ mgon po khyod lta bus gzhan la dud pa'i ro ni ma mthong bas mi mkhyen te/ dman pa nyid dang mchog nyid dag ni nges pa 'gal bas/ gang zhig dman pa rnams kyis ni khyod la mgo bos 'dud cing / da na pa ni de dag kho na 'dud pa'i ro de mchog tu ngom shing bran du rgyu'o/ /dper na/ mig sman mdangs ldan dbu skra 'khyog ldem ldem/ /khyu mchog tog gi rgyal mtshan phra ldem ldem/ /rno ldan nyag phran 'phangs pa drang ldem ldem/ /sum rtsen lha mi'i dpung tshogs 'dar ldem ldem/ /zhes pa lta bu/gsum pa la gnyis las/ dang po chod pa ni/ rol pa'i 'dzum dkar dag dang / ngag 'jam por smra ba dang / mi zur chung ngus lta ba dang / lus lci ba'i tshul gyis 'gro ba dang / chags pas kun tu glal ba (112ba)dang / dza ghan tshang ra rgyas pa dag ston pa des 'dod pa bsnun pa des na bdag ni chags pas 'tsho ba dman par gyur to/ /dper na/ gsal byed nyi mas pad+ma rgyas par byed/ /mdzesabyed rgyan gyis skyes bu mdzes par byed/ /phan byed sman gyis nad las grol bar byed/ /bsil byed rlung gis tsha gdung sel bar byed/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa chod cing ma chod pa ni/ dpal ldan kun la khyab pas mi shong ba/ mi g.yo bas brtan pa dang ldan pa gang gi bdag nyid can ni/ /'chi med kyi lam dang mnyam pas tshad dang ldan pa/ rab tu dud pa'i 'gro ba rgyas par byed pa/ gzhan gyis mchode pa'i gnas dang ldan pa/ tshad gzung med pa'i ming can dang sa chen 'di gom pas 'jal bar byed pa'i mngon mtho'i phung po tshad med pa/ 'jug pa bcu sogs rnam grangs mang por bkod pa'i khyab 'jug la phyag mdzod cig / dper na/ mgul bar khrol khrol gdu bu'i sgra sgrog dbyangs can masahrūd legs bshad sgra khrol khrol/ /bsgrags tshe khrol khrol skad snyan 'byin pa'i khu byug tshogs rnams lhags te skad khrol khrol/ /sgyur bas khrol khrol rkang gdub ldan pa'i ngang pa 'phur lding mtsho mtha' dbyangs khrol khrol/ /mthong ba khrol khrol rgyang glu len pa'i smin legs ma rnams 'gyur khug gdangs khrol khrol/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi pa la gnyis las/ dang po chod pa ni/ bcud de 'khrig pa'i bya ba la zhugs te/ brang gi nu mas dga' bar (113na)byed cing / snying por gyur ba'i bcud mang rab tu 'dzin pa'i lang tsho can/—35()

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)bshad kyi rjes mtshungs skad kyi sgra ldan dril chung 'dra ba can ma des ni ro btsa' ba'i bcud len la snying po med par rig par byas so/ /dper na/ ngag dbang lha mosang ga gi dpal/ /ngag gi 'dod 'jo ngag rnams la/ / ngag dbang ma ltar ngag stsol bas/ /ngag 'dod tshogs rnams ngag gis bstod/ /ce thag pa lha rto khra//gnyis pa mi mnyam pa nyid kyi thog mtha' dang / mnyam pa gnyis kyi thog bar na yod pa'i chod cing ma chod pa ni/ rab tu brtan zhing / blo gros rgyas pa/ tshul dang tshul min pa legs par brtag pa 'di yis ni tshul legs pa med par dge ba'i thabs la mig long ba rnams kyi ma rungs pa rnam par thul zhig /g.yin yang rnyed pa la sogs pa'i slad du bzhen pa yongs su nyon mongs pa mi 'gro zhing /rgyal ba'i theg par 'gro ba dag gi dge ba'i thabs tshul ma thob pa rnams thob pa rnams thob pa dag la brten nas skyed par mdzod cig /dper na/ mdzes mdzes mig zur g.yo ba rnams mdzas mdzes/ /mdzes mdzes lang tsho ngom yul mdzes mdzes rnams/ /mdzes mdzes sgeg mo'i gam du tshul mdzes mdzes/ /mdzes mdzes das kyang 'dod ldan mdzes mdzes byed/ /ces pa lta bu/ lnga pa la gnyis las/dang po chod pa ni/ /mtshungs med lci ba'i mtshon cha dang ldan pa'i (113bsko yul du khyab 'jug gi rgyal mtshan la gnas pa'i dpa' bo bya yi sgras lha ma yin sa skyes kyang ni 'bros par byed na/ nyi ma bzhin du bzod par dka' ba'i drag po 'phrog byed 'di'i mdun 'jigs rung du ni g.yul la dgra rnams bshan pas lug gsod pa dang mtshungs par rig go /dper na/ dkar mdzes cha shas rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor dkar/ /dkar mdangs 'od zer tshogs kyi ku mud dkar/ / dkar 'dzum 'dab ma rgyas tshe pad+ma dkar/ /dkar ba'i 'dab ma zum tshe mtshan mo dkar/ /zhes pa lta bu/gnyis pa chod cing ma chod pa ni/ mtshan mo ring ba tshad med pa'i thun dang ldan pa/ lus rid pas dpal med la/ grogs med pas sdug bsngal tshad med cing / mthar ni bgrod bya 'khrig pa nyams su myong ba min pas tshe zad pa'i nad la brten pa dang / bcu drug cha yi rang bzhin zla ba las nad —35/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)'phel ba can/ mdza' bo dang bral ba'i nad kyis gzir ba/ skal ldan ma ni snying rje'i rang bzhin du soms la 'bral med mdzod cig /dper na/ ljang ljang spang ljongs 'og pag rnams ljang ljang / /ljang ljang rka dzo 'thung lo 'dab mdog ljang ljang / /ljang ljang yi sdu'i sgro ga lha ga srab ljang ljang / /ljang ljang ma gad khu bas byugs ljang ljang / /ceX5 pa lta bu/ drug pa la gnyis las/ dang po chod pa ni/ gzhan don ngal med khyod kyi blo la mnyam nyid las zlog pa nyid ni ma yin (114na tonang bla med chos kyi rjes su mi mthun pa'i phyir 'gro ba ma yin la gdung ba med par don thob pa dang / skyes bu mchog gi rjes su mthun pa nyid dang / srid 'byor la dga' ba dang 'dod pa med pa med pa'i drang srong rnams kyi bzhed pa zhi bde dag las rgyal lo/ /dper na/ blo gros rab rgyas blo gsal rnams kyi blo/ /blo rig 'jam dbyangs blo ltar thogs med blo/ /blo ldan kun smon blo chen rangs pa'i blo/ /blo mchog dam pa blo gros brtan pa'i blo/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa chod la ma chod pa ni/ dus kyi dus chen po dbang phyug ni mgrin nag ngo nag /khyu mchog nag po'i rgyal mtshan nyid dag 'dzin pa ni/ snyan sgrog glud byangs dag gi sgrog byed bung ba'i tshogs rnams dang / dbyar dus kyi sprin nag ltar gnag pa dang / 'chi bdag gi dus kyis mi gzung la/ dus gsum dang nyi zla la sogs pa'i dus brgyad du 'char ba/ cha thams cad kyi gtso bo dbang phyug khyod kyi chu 'dzin gyis mdzes pa gangs ri'i phag tu dka' thub las bzlog pa'i bya ba dka' bas 'tsho ba'i bud med skra'i lan bu'i phreng bas mgo bo nag pa can bsten par mdzod cig /dper na/ dkar dkar gangs kyi ri bo ji bzhin dkar dkar ri bong can dkar dkar/ /dkar dkar pad+ma'i rtsa ba lta bu dkar dkar rgyal ba'i thugs dkar dkar/ /dkar dkar 'o ma'i rgya mtsho ji ltar dkar dkar lus phu'i gdong dkar dkar/ /dkar dkar dpal mo'i logs skyes ltar du dkar dkar chu 'dzin phreng dkar (114ba)dkar/ / zhes pa lta bu/ /

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan gyi skor bshad pa/gsum pa mtha' thog sbyar ba'i zung ldan la/ dam bca'/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/rkang pa gnyis kyi mtha' thog ni rab tu sbyar ba zung ldan gyi gnas skabs 'dir brjod pa'i khongs su 'du mod kyang / rang dbang nyid kyis te rang skya thub pas 'dir bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdza' bo chags pas myos pas nye bar gnas kyang / bud med des bdag nyid la ma sbyar bas bdag gis lan len snyam pa'i khong khro ba yi sdig pa'i ro dang sbyar te/ lus med 'dod pa dag gis gdungs par gyur kyang / bdag ni mdza' mo 'di nyid gdung ba'i slad du khyim du ma sdad do/ /dper na/ snyan ngag rgya mtsho 'chad la mkhas pa'i dpal/ /dpal ldan dpa' bo'i khengs 'phrog phur bu yang / /yang yang 'dud pa'i tshul gyis nam mkha'i ngos/ /ngos kyis yang yang 'ong ba gzigs 95ba/thag tha 34/ /stu/rnga5 pa sko| ja//kun tu zung ldan gyi skor bshad pa/bzhi pa kun tu zung ldan la/ rkang pa bzlas pa/ tshigs bcad bzlas pa/ zung ldan chen po dang gsum/ dang po la spyir bstan pa/ so sor bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshigs bcad phyed rkang pa gnyis bzlas pa ni yang dag sbyar ba yin la/ 'di la dbye na/ dang po gsum pa dang / gnyis pa bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis pa dang gsum pa bzhi pa/ dang po bzhi pa dang gnyis pa gsum par bzla ba gsum du 'dod do/ /rkang pa bzlas pa la'ang / du ma ste mang po'i bdag nyid yod de/ phyed dang rkang pa bzlas (115na)pa de dag gi dper brjod gsal bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ phyed bzlas yang dag sbyor ba dang / gzhan rkang —353—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)pa bzlas pa gnyis/dang po la gsum las/ dang po la gsum pa dang gnyis pa bzhi par bzlas pa ni/ skyes bu brtan pa gang zhig snying stobs can des kyang khengs pa rab tu spang byar byas na/ spang bya khengs pa des mdza' mo khyod kyis kyang mchog tu 'bad pa yis spong ba'i yid brtan bya'o 'bad med ma/ rgya dper/na snya yaḥs tā yā brdza zhes pa mi mnyam pa gnyis la yod pas mtshon te shin tu gsal lo/ / dper na/gser sbyangs gser ri gtso ma'i 'od rab rnam 'bar ba/ /nor 'dzin sa gzhi mgo bo'i thod du rnam par mdzes/ /gser sbyangs co pan gtso ma'i 'od rab rnam 'bar ba/ /nor 'dzin rnam sras mgo bo'i thod du rnam par mdzes/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa dang po gnyis pa dang gsum pa bzhi par bzlabs pa ni/khyod kyi dpung gi bgrod pa khyab bdag ste khyab 'jug lta bu'i gzi byin gyis mtshon cha yang yang rab tu sbyar zhing bsnun pas/ dgra bo mdzes pa med pa yis zad do/ /des mi rnams dpa' ba'i tshul dang nga rgyal nyams par byas nas gdungs shing kye ma ro rnams byas zos shing rnam par bcom sko /dper na/thor tshugs zla dbyangs can lha tshes kyis mdzes pa/ /thor tshugs dbang phyug zla tshes kyis mdzes pa/ tags ldan rnams kyi dga' ba'i dpal/ ta shes ldan rnams kyi dga' ba'i dpal/ /che sko/pa lta bu/ gsum pa dang po bzhi (115ba)dang gnyis pa gsum par bzlas pa ni/ 'brug gi sgra yis sprin bgrod cing char babs pa na dbyar skyes sbal pa dang rma bya'i tshogs rnams mdzes pa nyid du nye bar gyur la/ rlung gi tshogs sdug po dang bral bas chur sgrog ngang pa'i tshogs rnams kyi sgra snyan pa dang bral ba nyid du gyur ro//dper na/ dkar 'jam can zla ba gyis dga' byed pa/ /snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs bram ze sgrog mkhas can//snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs bung ba sgrog mkhas can/ /dkar 'jam can pad+ma gyis dga' byed pa/ /ches/pa lta bu/gnyis pa ga then rkang pa bzlas pa la/ lan gcig bzlas pa/ lan gnyib(bzlabs pa/ lan gsum bzlas pa/ don bsdu ba dang bzhi/ dang po la drug las/ dang po dang pad+ma sho gnyis par bzlas pa —354

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)ni/ 'dod pas gdungs kyang srog 'tsho ba'i dbang phyug mdza' bo yis/ kho mo la 'dud kyang bdag ni ngo tsha dman zhing / khengs pa nges par grub pa'i dbang du gyur pas brtse ba spangs pa'i bdag nyid mas yid kyis mdza' bo'i brang la rang gi 'o ma 'dzin pa'i khur gnyis po nye bar gtad nas kun tu 'khyud par ma byas pas da do/ /dper na/ gnas lnga rig pa'i dbang phyug che/ /gnas lnga rig pa'i dbang phyug che/khong dpang mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod la/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir su yis 'gran/ / zhes pa lta bu/ /gnyis pa dang po gsum par bzlas pa ni/ lha rnams kyi mdun sar rtog med bud med rgyan gyis rnam par mdzes pa gnas pa'i sa der/ rgyal po khyod kyi yon tan pad rtsa dri ma med pa ltar (116na sgodzes shing / rgyal po de ni phyis grong khyer bzang po rnams kyi rgyan phun sum tshogs pas brgyan pa'i bud med dag dang rnam par rtse zhing spyod do/ /dper na/ rnam par bkra shing 'khyug pa yi/ /glog stong can de mkha' la rgyu/ /rnam par bkra shing 'khyud pa yi/ /rma bya sa la gar gyis rol/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa dang po bzhi par bzlas pa ni/ snyan par smra ba dang / lus skyes dud pa dang / nu ma gnyis mtho zhing lang tsho dar bab mas/ khyod las gzhan pa'i skyes bu su zhig 'dod pas ma bcom pa de'i phyir/ 'byung po lus ldan te mi rnams kyi nang nas 'dod pa'i skyon las grol pa khyod gcig bu yin pas sogs zhes drang ba la ni ming gzhan med pas nye bar 'gro ba ma yin no/ /dper na/ tsha gdung rnam par 'phrog mkhas pa/ /dpal gyi chu 'dzin ga 'ozhe nu ma/ /ma la ya yi rlung gis kyang / /tsha gdung rnam par 'a11ga mkhas pa/ /zhe tha pa lta khri//bzhi pa gnyis pa gsum par bzlas pa ni/ rgyal po khyod kyi dmag dpung khyab 'jug lta bu go bsgos shing mtshon rnon po ldan pa/ dpa' bo'i tshogs dag gis phyogs rnams su rnam par rgyal ba'i grags pa dang lhan cig par/ rta glang gi rmig pa'i rdul dag rgyas par byed pa'i g.yul gyi sbyor ba'i sgo nas/ /dgra'i rigs lus bral zhing gzi brjid med la/ rgyags pa nyams par byed do/ /dper na//rnam 'dren shākya'i dbang po yis/ / phan pa'i 'dod pa 'jo bar mdzad/ / phan pa'i 'dod pa 'jo bar —355

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)mdzad/ /yid ba the dbang gi rgyal pos kyang / /cheX/pa lta bu/ lnga pa gci skeg pa bzhi (116ba)par bzlas pa ni/ dran ldan bdag las phan pa'i tshig gcig nyan par mdzod cig / rgyal po khyod kyi dpal ldan pa'i lag pa dang lhan cig lag 'gro klu yis kyang sa'i dkyil 'khor rnam 'dzin pa de'i phyir/ sa gzhi 'dzin pa rang gi lag pa kho nar rigs nas rgyags pa rgyas par yongs su ma byed cig /dper na/ shesarab rnam par rgyas mdzad pa/ /ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs// mi shes mun pa zhi mdzad pa'i//ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ /drug pa gsum pa bzhi par bzlas pa ni/ 'dod pa'i me gang khengs pa rab tu bsgrub pa las/dus skad cig ma re dang mnyam du rgyas pas pad+ma'i mig can khyod rang gi mdza' bo la lta ba'i ro la zhen med khyod kyis bde ba de dag ni kun nas lhag med du nyams pa nyid du cis mi byed de byed do/ /dper na/ phyi rol rig smra'i ston pa dang / /nang pa'i lugs 'dzin gnyis kyi lha/ /gdong bzhi'i chas pa mche ba las ka'akhrungs pa/ /gdong ba'i phyi spyan ras gzigs mche ba las 'khrungs pa/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa lan gnyis bzlas pa la gsum las/ /dang po/ thog ma gnyis pa dang gsum par bzlas pa ni/ gzhan la ma dud pa'i rgyal po khyod kyi ni 'jig rten gyi bdag por gyur tshe/ bsod nams kyi mthu yis mthu ldan rin chen lnga po brgya byin dag gis btud pa de'i phyir gsar pa'i btung ba bdud rtsi dang ldan pa'i mchod sbyin ni/ dus kyi grangs nges pa nyid du chad par ma gyur to/ /dper na/ dkar zhing dri bzang dga' ba skyed/ /dkar zhing dri bzang dga' ba skyed/ /dkar zhing dri bzang dga' ba skyed/ /dbyangs can pad+ma zla ba mdzes/ /ḍi / 'a/ pa shā mi ja// /gnyis pa/ dang po ni gsum pa dang / (117na tha zhi par bzlas pa ni/ rgyal po khyod kyi dpung gi glang po rnams ni/ glang po g.yin dang gzhan dag mang po'i stobs dang ldan zhing / nga rgyal gyi sgra sgrog pa/ rab tu rgyud de bgrod pa yi thang la rdul bsgrubs pa yis nam mkha' 'gog par byed cing / g.yul —356

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)gyi stobs dang ldan pas mchog tu gzhan gyi glang po rnams gsad phyir rgyug go /dper na/ kha dog rnam par rma bya bkra ba can/ /'dren byed dag gi dga' ston de/ kha dog 'ja' rnam par bkra ba can/ kha dog rnam par lus phra'i mig bkra ba can/ cheX5 pa lta bu/ gsum pa/ gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi par bzlas pa ni/ smin legs khyod lta bu mnyam par ma bzhag pas/ srid pa 'dir ni chags sdang rnam pa gnyis/ mi mnyam pa dang / kun la phan pa med cing / gnod pa rnams kyi tshigs mi bden pa log pa gyur pa/ sgrub byed mi mnyam pa/ rdzun lhur len pa dang / g.yo sgyu sprul bgrod dang mtshungs la ngo tsha med pa'i bud med khyod la bdag mi dad do/ /dper na/ rna bar snyan zhing rab brjid pa/ mgrin par sgrog pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas kyi gsung snyan po/ /mgrin par sgrog pa'i dbyangs dri za'i snyan po/ /mgrin par sgrog pa'i dbyangs ka la piṅka snyan po/ /zhes pa lta bu/ /gsum pa lan gsum bzlas pa ni dgra yi mdzes pa nyams par byed cing / rgyal po'i sde kun gyis tshur btud pa/ skyes mchog u mas glu phan par byed pa'i lha'i/ rje dbang phyug gi dpal med pa min pa/ snying stobs kyi go cha bgos shing / u mas btud pas gtsug na zla ba dngos dang 'dra ba (117ba)kun gyis mchod yul thob pa'i dam pa nyes pa'i rdul med pa/ ma mdzes pa min pa'i gtso bo khyod do/ /dper na/ 'od kyi thugs rje'i 'od rnam par rgyas par byed/ /'od kyis rnam nyi ma'i 'od par rgyas par byed/ /'od kyis rnam par zla ba'i 'od rgyas par byed/ /'od sgron me'i 'od kyis rnam par rgyas par byed//ces pa lta bu/ bzhi pa don bsdu ba ni/ /de ltar rkang pa lan gcig dang / gnyis dang gsum bzlas pa yang bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa tshigs bcad bzlas pa la/ mtshan nyid/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshigs bcad gnyis dang ldan pa'i don ni/ tshigs bcad gnyis bzlas pa yin te/ dper na/gnyis pa tshigs bcad 'dra ba gnyis ni/ zlum zhing rgyas ba'i lag pa can grogs min pa dgra rab tu 'joms par byed pa rnam 'dren khyod kyi bstan pa 'dis sa'i dpal mi mtshungs pa ste do zla bral bas 'jigs pa med do/ /yang khyod kyi dgra ni kho rang gi 'dren pa dag dang bral bar gyur cing lag pa sreg —357

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)rdzas slong ba la sreg khang du nye bar gyur pa dang / rang gi grogs kyis blos btang zhing dgra yis ni mtshungs pa med pa'i sa mtho ris 'di mngon par bsten du 'jug go /rgya dper tshig gzugs gcig pa'i sgo lo ka gnyis so/ /dper na mig la dpal ster mdzes pa'i sku/ /rna bar snyan pa'i dbyangs sgrog mkhan/ /yid la dga' ba skyed byed pa'i/ / zla ba'i spun zla dbyangs can ma mtshang/ /mig la dpal ster mdzes pa'i sku/ rna bar snyan pa'i dbyangs sgrog mkhan/ /yid la dga' ba skyed byed pa'i/ /zla ba'i spun zla sgeg mo e ma mtshar/ /zhes pa lta bu/gsum pa zung ldan chen po la mtshan nyid rtsod (118na〉spong dang bcas te bshad pa dang /dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ rkang pa bzhi rnam pa gcig pa gang zung ldan chen por brjod pa yin la/ de la'ang lan gsum bzlas par mthong mod de/ des na'ang zung ldan snga ma'i bya ba dang mi 'dra ba gcig bar ma chod la yi ge gzhan med pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ mnyam med dpal ldan mtshungs med ma khengs pa dang ldan yang ngal ba tsam ste/ de dag dang ni mdza' bo bor ba'i khengs pa mnyam pa nyid du ldan pa ste/ tshul min pa de dag dor ba'i spyod tshul tshad ldan 'di dang 'grogs su chug cig /dper na/ dri med rgyal ba'i thugs rab gsal dri med dbyangs can sku gsal/ dri med nam mkha' rab gsal dri med dwangs mtsho gsal/ /dri med zla ba rab gsal dri med man shel gsal/ /dri med 'phags chen rab gsal dri med me long gsal/ /zhes pa lta bu/'dres pa'i zung ldan bshad pa/lnga pa 'dres pa'i zung ldan ni/ 'dzin ma 'dzin pa'i klu lhag ma can dang mtshungs pa de rnam par 'dzin pa 'dzin ma ste sa la spyod pa rnams kyi dgra sde'i lag pa rnam par gnon pa mi dman pas 'phral la 'joms par myur ba dang ldan pa khyod la mchod pa'i khur ni brtan pa yi/ sa gzhi dag ni rim pas —358

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (5)bsrung bar bzod pa ma yin no/ /dper na/ mdzad bzang mchog gis mchogo dman 'gro 'dren mdzad//mdzad bzang spel mkhas mkhas mchog dbus na btsun/ /btsun btsun zas gtsang rigs 'khrungs thams cad mkhyen/ / mkhyen brtse'i dpal gyur dpal ldan shākya'i gtso/ /zhes pa lta bu/ldog pa'i zung ldan bshad pa/drug pa ldog pa'i zung ldan la/ mtshan nyid dang dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ de yang rkang pa phyed pa dang / tshigs bcad phyed pa dang / tshigs bcad (118ba〉jings po ldog pa'i spyod yul can te/ lha/ lo ka gcig lugs las ldog pas bskor ba gsum ni zung ldan lugs las ldog pas na lugs las ldog pa zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po rkang pa ldog pa ni/gang la 'bad pa byas kyang dus btab pa las yol bas chags gdungs kyis bdag lus phra mo nyid de ni bdag gis thob par mdzad mod/ da ni mdza' bo khyod la re 'dod med pas byed med kyi lha bem po'i rang bzhin can bstod nas 'ongs pa khyod rang gang 'dod du gro bar gyur cig rgya dper/ yā ma tā sha kṛ tā yā swā swā yā tā kṛ sha tā ma yā/ zhes pas mtshon te shin tu gsal ba yod la/ dper na/ dkar mo lha mchog mdzes pa ldan/ /ldan pa mdzes mchog lha mo dkar/ /legs ldan bde ba ster gyi dpal//dpal gyi ster ba bde ldan legs/ /zhes pa lta bu gnyis pa tshigs bcad phyed ldog pa ni/ nā di ste/ de nyid rtogs pa ldan pa bdag rang gi blo mi 'dod pa 'ga' yang med pa ste myos pa min la/ sems dul ba 'joms par byed pa'i 'dod pa'i lha yi rang dbang du gdung pa dag kyang med do/ /dper na/ rab phra lus ldan ring dkyus mig /gdong pa'i mdzes pa 'dod pa'i rten/ /rten pa'i 'dod pa mdzes pa'i gdong / /mig dkyus ring ldan lus phra rab/ ces pa lta bu/ ba/gu pa tshigs bcad rangs po ldog pa ni/ kun gyi yid du 'gro zhing / bdud 'dod lhas skyong ba gzhan yid skul ba'i lcag mi dman pa/ gang —359
—)gles
dme( ——

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)brtan pa grub par byed pa'i brtul zhugs la dga' ba mchog tu rtogs pa'i rgyal po ku ru pas/g.yul du rang gi rigs kyi dgra bo rnams ni 'thab 'dzings che bar bkag cing / rgyal po'i gzi brjid lci ba 'dar bar byas so/ /dper na/ snying gi dkyil gyi ting 'dzin ni/ ga tsa na yang rab gsal ba//dpe med bshes gnyen de spel nges/ /de phyir snying nas dang bas dad/ /ces pa lta bu/ gsum pa gnyis su nges pa ni/ dpal dang gzi brjid ngo tsha grags pa dang / blo gros dang / lugs kyi steng du tshig dang dga' ba gnyis kyi 'phel ba ste/ khyod la 'phel ba gnyis po gang yod pa 'di gnyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la yang med do/ /dper na/ rab gsal dngas pa zla ba la/ /dkar 'jam mtshan mas rnam par brgyan/ /nyon mongs rnyog mtsho long long khrod/ /rmongs 'gro'i skyon tshogs 'joms mdzod go /ces pa lta bu/bzhi pa dbyangs gcig tu nges pa ni/ zla dang nad ring cis min gang / /dga' ma bdud kyi rgyar ma lhung / /bgrod bzlog sgra med dpal med ma/ /stobs ldan rgyu gnas 'chi slad du'o/ /zhes pa'i don gong du bkrol zin/ dper na/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa gang / /gdan sa 'gran zla bral ba na/ /ngag dbang 'jam dpal dbyangs zhal nas/ /dka' gnad ga6(5 byar rab 'khyams grags/ /'u sti spru pa lta bu/ gnyis pa gnas nges pa la bzhi las/ dang po gnas bzhir nges pa ni 'dren (121ba)byed kun dga' skyed par byed ma/ rgyu skar tshogs rnams dag gi gnas sprin med pa'i nam mkha' 'di la lus can ma khyod kyis lan gcig mig gnyis po byin pa ste lta bar mdzod cig /rgya dper/ gha dza ta ṭa rnams rim bzhin mgrin rka' so spyi bo rnams las skyes pas mtshon te/ gsal lo/ /dper na/ dad brtan la las sa la gser/ /gang gang rgya ngos gaṅgā khar/ /bye ma spungs pa'i phung phyur 'bul/ /tshab tshob tsub tsub yang yang mdzad/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa gnas gsum du nges pa ni/ lang tsho ma nu 'bur sdug por rgyas pa khyod kyi gdong gi skra yi lan bu'i 'khri shing bung ba ltar sngo zhing / 'dren byed pad+ma'i gzugs rnyan can/ lus zu ba ltar mdzes pas 'dod ldan su dag ma bcom ste bcom mo/—364

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)dper na/ mi pham dpa' bos pha ma bur/ /'phral phugs phan bde phung phung spungs/ /gang ka kā ka ha ha sgrog /tab rtab la lung la la 'thas/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa gnabs gnyibs su nges pa ni/ rtag tu sdig pa med cing kun dga' bskyed pa'i mchog rgyal po khyod kyis lang tshos lus dud pa'i mdzes ma dang yang dag par 'grogs nas chags pa spyad pas/ khyod rang gi btsun mo phrag dog gi dbang gis 'dod pa lus med kyis 'gongs te/ 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa du mas reg par gyur pa 'di la brtse bar mdzod cig /dper na/ ba mo babs pas phyur bur spungs/ /ba phyugs mang po bhu mir 'phyan/ /ha ha sgrog mkhas ku sgras 'gengs/ /nga rgyal sgra sgrog ngar ngar spyod/ /ces pa lta bu/ bzhi pa gnas gcig tu (122na jis pa ni/ ha ha zhes mu cor mi sgrog cing / mkha' 'gro nyi mas mtshan pa'i ri rab kyi rtser 'gro ba/ dbang po mig sogs 'khyog po dang ldan pa skye bo ngan pa'i spyod tshul la ma chags pa can khyod 'khyog cing 'gro ba dang / skad snyan pa lhung lhung du sgrog pas gaṅgā'i chur ni 'jug bzhin pas sdig pa bya rog ltar nag pa 'joms pas mtho ris su 'gro'o/ /dper na/ dung dung gsol thob lha la ste/ /sa la lus btud gtam rnams ldir/ /la la dad dad ltar du 'dud/ /mdongs ldan rta la thur thag thogs/ /stu/theg pa shā / ja//gsum pa gsal byed kyi yi ge nges pa la bzhi las/ dang po bzhir nges pa ni/ kye kye sgra snyan par sgrog pa ru ru'i brang 'joms pa'i sdig can sha ba ri pa khyod ri dwags kyi char yang yang 'gro ba grib can nad can gyi sar ma 'ong zhig /bdag gi mar gyur pa'i ri dwags laganod pa byed pa po dang / thar pa don du gnyer ba rnams phrad mi rigs pa/ dper na bya rog rma bya'i sgrar 'gyur ba ci yang mi srid do//rgya dper/ ra ga ka ma bzhir nges pas shin tu gsal lo/ /dper na/ so sos bsun bsun sa sa sar/ /dgyes dgye gus gus dga' sgra sgrog lo legs la lar las la lus/ /mtho mtho thad thad thang thang 'thud/ /ces pa gsum du nges pa ni/ lha rnams dga' bar byed pa'i lha rig byed la smod pa 'gog pa pos/ lha min rnams dga' bar byed pa'i gtso bo rnams bcom pa na a la la (122ba〉zhes —365

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)dga' ba'i sgra yis mtho ris rnams gang bar gyur to/ /dper na/ gang gi sgra brgya sgra sgrog gang / /gang gwa gab gyur gong gi gam/ las lam la lus la las lan/ /tang tang ting ting ste bu'i gtam/ /zhes pa lta khri/lta /gsum pa gnyis su nges pa ni/ mkhas pa lha dang lha ma yin kun la 'gro ba'i stobs dang ldan zhing / byin pa legs pas mdzas pa can/ chang gi ro myong ba'i ngang tshul dang ldan pa/ gshol 'dzin te stobs bzang zhes pa de ni ba 'ad dkar gyi snyan sgra dang ldan pa'i mtsho ru khrus la song ngo / /dper na/rong rong rong ri ru ru'i rwa/ /rang rang re re ring ring rung / khong shong shang shang shib shib gzhib/ sha sha shu ba shub shul sham shis/ /zhes pa lta bu/ /bzhi pa gcig tu nges pa ni/ bdag gi dgra 'di yis bdag cag rnams kyi bzhin ras/ khyod kyi bzhin rngam pa gshin rje lta bu'i tshul gyis nges par ma bcom pa min pa ste bcom mod/ brtul phod mi dman pa 'di dang bdag cag gi srog 'thab pa la sbyor ba ni/ rje bo khyod skyes bu dam pa min la/ rgyu mtshan sdig pa med pa ma yin no/ /dper na/ sgra sgrog sgra sgrog sgra brgya sgrog / dgyes dgyes gus gus mgo gug gug /gyol byol sgeg sgeg sgor sgor 'gro//rgyud rgyud glu'i sgrar gar bsgyur dge/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ de ltar bya dka' ba'i lam la yang rim pa cung zad kun tu bstan zin no/ /gab tshig gi rgyan skor bshad pa/gsum pa gab tshig gi rgyan la dam bca' ba/ dgos pa brjod pa/ dngos dang / gab tshig ltar snang mi 'chad pa'i rgyu (123nasgo tshan dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ gab tshig gi rnam pa'i rnam par rtog pa yi lugs kyang 'di rab tu bstan par bya'o/ gnyis pa ni/ rtsed mo sogs kyi mdun sar bzhag gad kyi ched dang / der shes pa rnams la tshogs su gsang gtam tshig tu smra ba dang / pha rol po de mi shes par —366

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)kun tu rmongs par byed pa la gab tshig dag ni nye bar mkho zhing ldan no/ /gsum pa la dngos dang / mjug bsdu ba gnyis/ dang po la/ bcu drug las/ dang po kun tu tshogs pa la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnam dbye dang mtshams sbyor sogs kyi sgo nas tshig mtshams sbyar bas sgra 'dres te don sbas pa ni kun tu tshogs pa zhes brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni/bdag gi skad dod a smad la rnam dbye gsum pa'i sa byin nas bsgrubs pas me zhes pa/ de'i pha rol tu gnod pa'i skad dod ā gas la si byin nas phyis/ de'i pha rol du ro'i skad dod ras/ de nas rim pa bzhin e a ya dang / sa rnam bcad dang / a dang sgra ldan gyi bar du u dang / mtshams sbyor rnams byas pas/ ma yā go raḥzhes pa 'grub la/ bsgrib bya 'di'i sgrib byed ni/ ma yā dag gi /go ba lang /ras ro bro ba ste/ der zhabrul ba'o/ /de yang bdag gi gnod pa'i ro bro ba'i sems kyis blangs pa'i shes pa cung zad med pa la ci'i slad du dus kun tu mig dmar ma khyod kyis khro ba'i gnas yod pa min par ngu ba 'di yis ci byed/ dper/ (123ba tharjod rgya bod kyi lugs gnyis las/ snga ma ni/ du rā gar twa yā byā/ tshul 'di ma lus ston pa yi/ /sa 'dzin phag tu mal 'cha' ba'i/ /'bri stag skar gsum rnam par thar/ /dur ngan pa dang ā dar 'byung gnas snyad la/ gsum pa byin pa'i twa yā khyod kyis bi 'jig pa dang ud sbyor ba yin la/ sgrib byed du dur stobs/ ā da 'dzin pa/ ka ra byed pa/ twa/ khyod kyis/ bi 'byor pa/ snye sbyor ba'o/ phyi ma ni/ tshig rkang dang por dkar nag dmar/ zhes pa lta bu/ phyi ma la gdong sems chu zhes pa lta bu lus phra'i bzhin ras ches cher nag / yid srubs grogs min pa yin pa/ /skyes bu'i gzugs la tsha bsil tshogs/ /nyin mtshan med par 'bar mi 'bar/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa slu byed kyi gab tshig la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ dngos po gzhan la grags pa'i sgra stobs ldan mdzes par brjod nus pa lta bu ngag gis don de gab nas gang du mi mdzes pa lta bu zhig tu 'khrul bas slu ba ni slu byed nyid do/ /gnyis pa ni/ kudzi ni grong khyer kā n+ya zhes bya ba'i yul gyi bud med shin tu mdzes pa la 'jug —367

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)la/ gab bya de'i gab byed/ gnya' ba sgur ba'i bud med la yang grags pas/ de 'dra'i mdzes ma grogs su bsten pa khyod kyi ni/ dga' ba ji lta bu/ 'phel bar gyur ba de ni khyad par 'phags te/ rgyu mtshan/ mdza' mo 'di 'chi med bu mo la co 'dri zhing mtshungs pas na mi mo la spyod pas de lta bu ma yin no/ /zhes sgra don gang rung bshad rgyu (124na〉dud pa'i sgo nas nor 'gro ba zhig dgos pas/ dper na/ khyod mthong lus ni gtsug phud can/ /brtan pa'i yid ni g.yon la gnas/ /ngag gi rkang pa 'theng por 'gro/ /me tog mda' ni srid na mang / /zhes yongs grags kyi rma bya g.yon rkang pa 'theng pa 'dod lha'i mda' rnams kyi don ni/ mi yon po tshig ring thung sna tshogs lus phra rnams so/ /gsum pa rim pa dang bral ba la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ sbyor ba'i go rims shin tu 'brugs pa yis don la rmongs par byed pa de ni rim pa dang bral ba ste/ gnyis pa ni/mchus yu bar 'o byed do/ /gang la na pad+ma can gyi'o/ /gang gis na zhal las sgra snyan par sgrog par byed pa'i ngang pas tsher ma rtsub mo can gyi rkang pa la lus ni 'dar bar byed pa'i sgo nas so/ /zhes phyed phyi ma'i mjug phyed snga ma'i mgo dang / phyed phyi ma'i dang po'i mjug phyed snga ma'i rjes ma'i mgor 'ong bsasgor mor 'khor 'gro bas gong 'og 'chol ba zhig dgos te/ dper na/ rnams kyis 'gro blo rab tu bskyed/ /dkar gyur rab nag rgol rmongs bzhin/ /ngan pa legs ldan shes rab can/ /dbyangs can lha mo'i thugs rje de/ /zhes pa lta bu sgor mor 'khor ba'o/ / bzhi pa rab bcom la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ gong du sgra don gang rung sbyar ba gang las don rtogs par dka' ba yi tshig gi phreng ba de ni rab bcom yin te/ dpe la kha 'phangs nas/ 'di su zhig ces pa lta bu/ gdam (124ba)nga can gyi tshig re byung tshe rgyan 'di nyid la rnam pa gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ bu mo khyod kyi rkang pa mdzes pa la rkang gdub rgyas pa sgra snyan pa sgrog pa/ mngon sum nyid du gyur pa 'dir/ chags pa'i dbang gis bdag gi srog ni brtan pa ma yin no/ /rgya dper/ dka' yang bod skad du zhig pa yin la/ ha ha mi sgrog mkha' 'gros mtshan/ zhes sogs kyi don dngos gzhi gong du bshad zin pa ltar dang de rab tu —368

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i rā/ dbyangs/ (wanabacom lugs ni/ snyan grags mtho ris la 'gro ba dang / mkha' 'gros mtshan pa'i rir 'gro zhes pa dang / sdig pa dang bya rog gnyis nag par mtshungs chos byas nas/ bya rog 'joms zhes dpe dngos la kha 'phangs pa lta bu ste/ dper na/ don smra nubs bral lce rkyong zhid / /rnam 'khyog g.yin la sems sa pa'i yid/ /nye bar gnas rnams rab bcom nas/ /khung bur nyal ba'i sbrul de su/ /zhes gab bya ri khrod pa zog po dang gab byed sprul lo/ /lnga pa mthun gzugs la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod/ gnyis/ dang po ni/ dngos po gzhan du phal pa ste btags pa'i don bkod pa'i tshig dag gis don go bar sdebs pa dag ni mthun pa'i gzugs te/ bsdus brjod la khyad gzhi chos mtshungs mi mtshungs sogs kyi dbye ba yod la/ 'di ni don mthun pa bstan rgyu yod pa tsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ gab bya sor mo rnams kyi rtse kha dog dmar ba'i gzhon nu ma yan lag lnga ldan yin la/ gab byed ni gang gi yal 'dab la me tog dmar (125na)po'i dog pa can/ 'khri shing yal 'dab lnga pa can ni skyed mos tshal 'di bdag gis mthong ngo / /dper na/rma med sdong bu yal ga zung / /lo 'dab ser pos mngon par klubs/ /mngar ba'i ro dang zhim pa'i 'bras/ /ldan pa'i ston gyi ljon shing mthong / /zhes gab bya dge slong dang gab byed shing ngo / /drug pa rtsub mo la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ mtshan nyid kyi bshad byar yod tsam gyi sgra'i nges tshig dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ da ni de dag bzod pa 'dug go zhes pa lta bu'i tshig rtsub mo nges par dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gab bya chang ma rnams so so'i khang par bya bas dal bur rgyu zhing chang gis bzi ste rgan mo ltar gyur pa la/ gab byed 'a dri bzang gi rdzing bu'i nges tshig bstan rgyu yod tsam ma gtogs 'jig rten na mi grags pas/ lha rnams lha yi khang pa sa so so'i 'od kyis dal bur rgyu zhing yongs grags kyi dri bzang gi rdzing bur 'brus byas pas 'dod pas myos par byas pa de rnams/ da ni rgan mo gzhin no/ /zhes rtsub cing gab pa ste/ dper na/ chu nang skyes shing chur brten pa//srog ldan mang po khar gnas pa'i/ /ldir ldir skad kyis khengs na yang / /nam zhig zhig tshe gzhan gyis —369

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)rdzi/ /zhes gzhan gyis rdzi ba ni rtsub mo'i tshig yin la/ gab bya pad+ma dang / gab byed chu srin no/ /gab tshig gi dngos po phan tshun sbyar ba'i skabs sgra don gang yin yang phan tshun gnyis ka la 'byar 'gro ba zhig dmas (125ba tshe pa/ 'dir ni gab byed de 'jig rten na ma grags shing / nges tshig ston rgyu yod pa tsam mo/ /bdun pa grangs la mtshan nyid dang / dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ gang du grangs kyis kun tu rmongs par byed pa ni grangs nyid ces bya ste/ gsum pa ni/ gab bya'i mi'i bdag po gnyu 8 ri sla ba zhes pa'i rgyal po yin la/ gab byed ni gsal byed ka tsa pu ri bzhis yongs su rnam par brgyan pa yi grong khyer nya sna ldan dbus na yod pa 'ga' zhig dang / grong gang zhig de na dañca pu ri sla ba zhes mi'i bdag po yi ge brgyad tshogs pa'i ming can yod do/ /dper na/ thub pa'i grong khyer dbus bzhugs sna ldan sngon/ / lnga pa'i gsum lnga mthar gnas dro ba can/ /mtsho yi rtse mo mthar gnas phyir yang rol/ /legs pa'i yon tan mang po rnam par ster/ /zhes pa gab bya bru smi ṇa de khyu dang gab byed sde pa rnams so/ /brgyad pa rab btags la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod gnyis dang po ni/ gang du brjod bya'i ngag don de rnam pa gzhan du snang ba de ni rab btags nyid do/ /le'u gnyis pa'i rab btags ni bye'u sa skad sgrog pa la sangs rgyas la bstod pa byed ces pa lta bu yin la/ 'dir ni bsgrib bya dge slong dang sgrib byed ngang pa lta bu la/ gnyis ka la 'jug rung gi chos shig bkod nas dge slong las g.yin ngang par sgro btags pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gab bya dbul po zhig nor slong ba'i tshe/ tshig rnams ldab ldib tu rab tu 'khrul ba dang / mgo bo dud cing zhus pa dang / mig dman pas lta ba dang / yid (126na/skug pas lus kyang 'dar ba dang ldan pa bdag la ni phyug po rjes su mi brtse 'am/ zhes pa yin la/ de'i gab byed ni/ mdzes ma la rgan mo zhes bzhad gad kyis/ bdag chags pas tshig 'khrul/ngo tshas mgo zhum/ 'dod pas lus 'dar ba la mi brtse 'am/ bri d+dha zhes pa phyug po dang rgan mo gnyisaka la 'jug go /dper na/ gang zhig mthong tshe dga' bas 'dzu pa/ /ston cing lus kyang ldem ldem du/ /—37()

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)'dar nyid rnam par g.yo ba dag /rgyas par gyis shig dkar 'jam can/ /zhes gab bya zla ba kun+da/ gab byed gzhen nu dang lus phra'o/ /dgu pa ming du 'dus pa la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ gang du ming thun mong ba dag la sna tshogs pa'i don du mas sgribs pa dka' bas btags pa de ni ming du 'dus pa nyid do/ /gnyis pa ni/ gab bya sa ldan ni rgyal po 'ga' zhig dang / rā dza ni rgyal po dang / sa nā ta na ste 'di ni/khyab 'jug dang bcas pa'i gsum po 'dir 'khrul ba 'dra ba la/ sa ldan zhes par sgrog pas mi'i rgyal po yang ma yin la/ khyab 'jug kyang ma yin no/ /mig mi brtan ma zhes pas gang 'gab par bya na/ don shing gi rgyal po de sgrib par byed do/ /rgyu mtshan gong gi sgra gsum po 'di rim pa bzhin du/shing dang / shing gi rgyal po dang / ma rgyas pa min pa gsum la 'jug go /dper na/ blo ldan kun phan mtsho las skyes/ /'chi med gtso bo rol mo mkhan/ /nyams 'gyur gar gyis rnam brel bas/ /(126ba)'dod pa'i dngos po stsol cig kye/ /zhes gab bya dbyangs can ma dang / gab byed ga bur/ zla ba/ pad+ma/brgya byin/ dri za/ gar mkhan sogs mang po yod pa'o/ /bcu pa sgrib pa la mtshan nyid dper brjod gnyis/ /dang po ni/ tshigs ni de dang mtshungs pa'i chos gzhan la rig pas de nyid go zhing don gzhan bshad bya'i chos de sgrib pas na sgrib pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gab bya rdzas bral dbul po'i mi ni gtang bar byas nas/ nor dang ldan pa can rnams kyi sar bgrod pa gang zhig /sna tshogs pa'i skyogs te thabs sa tshul brgya phrag gis 'jig rten 'gugs par byed pa khyod ni/ bzung zhing bzlog par dka' ba smad 'tshong ma yin la/ gab byed ni gong gi khyad par de rgyal po la yang yod pas der go ba lta bu'o/ /dper na/ snying stobs chen pos mi mthun bcom/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis kun las rgyal/ /gang 'tsham sprul pa ston mkhas khyod/ /pad dkar mig tu mngon par nges/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gab bya sangs rgyas dang gab byed khyab 'jug go /bcu gcig pa mthun pa'i sgra la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgra sbyar ba'i rnam grangs —371 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)bkod pa yis don rtogs dka' ba bsgrub pa dag ni mthun pa'i sgra'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ a dh+wa ra mchu dang / sa min pa gnyis la 'jug /pra bā la byu ru dang / skra'i ming can las rgyal ba gnyis la 'jug pa las/ gab bya mdzes ma khyod kyi mchu byu ru ltar dmar ba de yis ding sang bdag mchog tu ni sred pa dang ldan par byed do snyan sgrogs ma (127na〉kab byed sa min pa ming mthun pa gang dang rab tu gyur pa skra'i ming can las rgyal lo/ /'di la nges par sgra sbyar dgos shing / dper na/ rnam par gsal byed bla med 'od/ /gzhan dag dga' zhing rgyas par byed/ /brjid cing lhun chags gzi 'bar ba//bdud las rgyal khyod dge bar mdzod/ /rnam par gsal ba sogs sangs rgyas dang nyi ma gnyis ga'i yon tan la la jug cing / bdud las rgyal ba gnyis ga'i sgrar mtshungs pas gab bo/ /bcu gnyis pa rmongs pa'i gab tshig la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshig sbyor gang zhig mngon sum du brjod don bstan kyang / tshig de nyid kyis zhabrul rgyu byas nas rmongs pa'i phyir/de ni rmongs pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gab bya 'dod ldan dag ni mal stan la khro bas/ rgyab bstan nas phyir zlog ste nyal bar gyur la/ chags pas kyang de bzhin du gnyid nyal te/ dal bu yis pho mo dag kha sprad de sbyor ro/ /gab byed ni pho mo phan tshun khros pa dang / rgyab gtad pa dang / chags pas phyir log tu ji ltar nyal snyam pa dang / rgyab gtad na kha ji ltar sbyor snyam rmongs pa ste/ 'gal rgyan dang 'dra'o/ /dper na/ lce yi rlung gis tsha gdung skyed/ /'jam pa'i stan gyis lus ni rtsub/ /rkang chag skya rengs thogs med 'gro/ /smin legs mthong bas mun pa thibs/ /rlung gis tsha ba skyed mi thub pas ci yin nam snyam pa lta bu'o/ /bcu (127bsgo sum pa yongs phrogs la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ gang la tshig sbyor gyi phreng ba'i bdag nyid can ni/ bskor thag ring po byas nas/ snga ma snga ma la rten nas phyi ma go ba de ni yongs phyogs zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gab bya nyi mas tshig pa rnams sprin la dga' ba yin la/ gab byed bya rgyal ni mkha' lding yin zhing / des sngon rgya mtsho las byung ba'i bdud rtsi phyogs —372

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)pas rgyal ba yin la/ de'i zas bdud rtsi za ba ni brgya byin/ brgya byin las skyes pa ni srid sgrub/ de'i dgra kuṇ+ḍa/ de'i bla ma nyi ma/ de'i 'od kyis bcom pa'i skye bo rnams/ kha ba 'joms pa ni me/ de'i grogs min pa ni char/ de 'dzin pa yi sprin gyis khyab pa'i mkha' la mngon par dga'o/ /dper na/ stobs ldan gsod skyes dag gi dgra /lhar bsten rnams kyi gtso bo drug zhung zhen bu yi dmag tshogs rnams//rab tu bka' bsdus thal bar brlag /ces stobs ldan gsod pa po ni khyab 'jug/de las skyes pa ni 'dod lha/ de'i dgra ni dbang phyug de lhar bsten pa ni phyi rol pa/ de'i gtso bo ni mu stegs ston pa drug go /khyung zhen ni khyab 'jug de'i bu ni bdud/ de'i dmag tshogs 'joms mkhan ni zas gtsang sras/ de'i bka' bsdu ba po phyag na rdo rjes bcom pa'o/ /bcu bzhi pa gcig sgribs la mtshan nyid/dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ gang du rten ni gsal bar byas te brten pa sbas pa ni gcig sgribs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gab bya nam yang (128na)mtshon dang bud med kyi nu ma'i dkyil 'khor la reg pa'i bde ba ma myong yang / mi ma yin pa dri za 'ga' zhig gi lag pa'i ming can gyi shing e re ṇ+ḍal ni 'bras bu med pa yin no lo/ zhes brten pa lag pa'i chu shing ngo / /de gab byed ni rten dri za dang mi ma yin gsal bar byas so/ /gzhan la mtshon na sangs rgyas kyi phyag 'di ljon shing la lang ling du g.yo ba 'dra zhes brten pa yal ga sbas nas rten ljon shing brjod pa'o/ /dper na/ rkang 'thung gsar pa'i 'khri shing la/ /lo 'dab khur gyis rnam dud pa/ /rin chen gdu bus spras pa yi/ /sor mos mtshan pa 'ga' ltar mdzes/ /zhes pa rten lag pa sbas nas brtan pa sor mo brjod pa lta bu'o/ /bco lnga pa gnyis ka sgribs pa la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshig sbyor gang du rten brten pa gnyis ka sbas par gyur pa de ni gnyis ka la sgribs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gab bya skyes bu su zhig skra dang mgo bo gang 'grogs pa yi dus su skra bshad pa sogs bya ba thams cad nye bar ni thob ste bsgrubs shing / gal te kha zas kyi dus dag tu/ gal te de'i nang du skra'i nyag ma re re tsam song ba mthong na 'dor par byed do/ /dper na/ sa 'dzin phang bar gti mug gnyis kyi ro'i/ /bcud 373

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)chags skad 'byin 'ga' zhig ldem ldem la/ /gnas te 'bras bur 'dod pa de don dag /gal te grub na brkam pa chos nyid yin/ /rten chu shing dang brten pa bye'u (128ba)gnyis ka sbas pa'o/ /bcu drug pa yongs 'dres la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod don bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/gang la sngar bshad pa'i mtshan nyid bco lnga po sna tshogs 'dres pa de ni yongs su 'dres pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis(pa ni/ gab bya ha dro ba/ ya mthar gnas/ ga ka ste/ dza tsa sde/ bha pa sde/ ṭa ṭa sde/ bcas sa pa'i skad dod sa dang / yi ge'i skad dod u na mtshams sbyar ba'i na ta sde ste/ sde 'di gal te ma rgyal ba ste ma shes na/ mā tra ka ste yi ge'i phyi mo tsam yang shes pa med pa nged kyi bu 'di'i phyi rol rig byed rtag pa rang byung sogs kyi tshul shes kyang blun po'o/ /de'i gab byed ni/ ha ya rta dang / ga dza glang po/ bha ṭa dpa' bo ste dpung bu chung / se na sde ste/ de dag las ma rgyal na/ ma tri ka ma med pa'i bu 'di yi ge shes kyang blun pa'o/ /dper na/ mig gi khang par mda' yi me 'bar tshe/ /gnyis skyes la la zla ba mthong ba bzhin/ /gzugs med rnams ni dga' zhing sdug bsngal byed/ khams gsum dbang sdud brtse zhing dga' ba bsgom/ /zhes mig gnyis dang mda' lnga sogs gab tshig bdun pa dang / gnyis skyes ni mang po la 'khrul 'gro bas gnyis pa slu byed dang / gzugs med ni 'dre dang 'dod lha/ khams gsum dbang sdud ni lha mo ku ru kul+le dang dbang phyug gnyis la nges tshig gi sgra bshad rung tsam yod cing /sdug bsngal byed ces rtsub mo'i tshig yod pas drug pa rtsub mos 'gog pa dang gsum tshang la/ gab bya(129na〉pa dzes ma'i mig 'dod pa'i mdangs dmar ba dang / chags can rab byung nag phyogs la dga' ba'i 'dre/ lha mo rig byed ma/ gab byed dbang phyug gi mig gi me'i mda'/ bram ze khyab 'jug go /gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ bshad ma thag pa de ni ming du 'dus pa bsres shing bslus pa yi ni gzugs dang ldan pa/ de bzhin nyid du ni gab tshig gzhan gyi yang rgyan 'dres pa'i rim pa shes par bya'o//gnyis pa mjug bsdu ba ni bshad ma thag pa 'di rnams gab tshig bcu drug yin te/ de dag ni sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis bstan pa ltar bshad do/ /bzhi pa gab tshig ltar snang mi 'chad pa'i rgyu —374

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes sa pa 'phe/ dbyangs/ (wa)mtshan ni/ gab tshig ngan pa gzhan dag bcu bzhi po de dag rnams kyang sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis brjod pa yin la/ skabs 'dir ngan pa'i mtshan nyid med pa gang zhig de 'dod pas/ skyon gyis yongs su drang bar bya ba min par rig nas/ slar yang da rnye bdag cag gis legs pa kho na bcu drug brjod par byas so/ /skyon sel gyi rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad pa/gsum pa skyon sel rgyas par bshad pa la mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ don nyams don 'gal don gcig pa/ /the tshom can dang rim pa nyams/ /sgra nyams gcod mtshams nyams pa dang / /sdeb sbyor nyams dang mtshams sbyor bral/ /dgu po de'i steng du/ yul dang / dus dang / sgyu rtsal dang / sna tshogs pa'i 'jig rten dang / lung dang rig pa dag dang 'gal ba ste drug po 'di gcig tu sdoms pa'i skyon bcu po de dag snyan ngag la snyan ngag mkhan rnams (129ba)kyis spangs bar bya'o/ /g.yin yang dam bca'/ gtan tshigs/ dpe nyams pa zhes pa gsum po 'di yang skyon ma yin nam/'on kyang 'dir mi 'chad pa ni rtog par grags kyang phyogs 'dir ma grags pas phal cher dpyad par dka' ba nyid kyi phyir sbyar ba de yis ni 'bras bu ci bya ste dgos pa med do/ /gnyis pa la bcu las/dang po don nyams pa la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod/ dmigs bsal dang gsum/ dang po ni/ brjod byed kyi tshig tshogs pa la brjod bya'i don gyis stong pa gang de ni nyams pa zhes par 'dod la/ de yang myos pas smon pa dang / byis pa bsam med kyis brjod pa las gzhan du na de dag skyon yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ mi 'di ni rgya mtsho 'thung bar byed de/ byis pa bdag ni de ring rgas pas gzir la/ sprin pa 'di yang 'brug gi sgra rab tu sgrog par byed de/ /'phrogs byed ni glang po che sa srung dag la dga'o/dper na/ zla ba 'di ni shin tu dmar/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyis bsil bar byas/ /kho bo nyal nas rgyun du —375

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)'gro/ /na chung la 'khrud tshangs par spyod/ /ces pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ 'di lta bu sems rnal du mi gnas pas mngon par brjod pa la smad par bya ba min te/ gzhan du na de lta bu la sogs pa snyan ngag mkha po su zhig gis sbyor te ma sbyor ro/ /gnyis pa don 'gal ba la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod/dmigs bsal gsum/ dang po ni/ ngag gcig ni rab tu sbyar ba yis ngag snga ma dang phyi ma gcig (130na〉tes gcig gi nus pa g.yin 'joms pa 'gal ba'i don can nyid kyi skyon 'di ni don 'gal zhes par rab tu brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ dgra rigs mtha' dag 'joms pa dang / sna tshogs pa'i bya ba'i khur ldan 'di rgyal bar gyur cig 'byung po kun la brtse ba can khyod la dgra ni su yang med do/ /dper na/ nyon mongs ma lus bcom pa yi/ /gnas brtan dgra bcom khyod kyis ni/ /ri dwags mig can ma 'di la/ /log g.yem spyod par ma mdzad cig /ces pa lta bu/ gsum pa la 'ga' zhig 'dod tshul dang / dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ mngon par chags pa dang ldan pa'i sems la ni mu cor smra ba'i skabs de 'ga' zhig yod pas na chags pa phul byung brjod pa gang la 'gal ba'i don can gyi tshig dag kyang mngon par brjod par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ g.yin gyi bud med la sred pa 'ga' zhig /tshul de ni 'phags pa dag gis kyang ga la mi rig pas/ mdzes ma de yi so'i sgrib byed g.yo ba dang /bdag gis ni nam zhig 'thung bar 'gyur ram/ dper na/ ha cang chags myos drag po yis/ /myos te skyabs med gnas khang du/ spyad de skye bo gzhan ci smos/ /kun mkhyen rgyal bas ga la gzigs/ /ces pa lta bu/ gsum pa don gcig pa la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod/ dmigs bsal dang gsum/ dang po ni/brjod bya'i don nyid dam/ brjod byed kyi sgra gang la yang khyad par (130bsgod par sngar brjod pa/gal te slar yang rab tu sgrigs pa/ de ni don gcig par 'dod de/ dper na/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dod pa'i sred pa la sred pa 'phel bar byed pa'i bu mo rnams kyi chags pa'i rgyu ni de rnams skra'i lan bu'i 'od zer nag po can dang / chu 'dzin dang / glog dang ldan pa dang / 'brug sgra zab mo sgrog —376

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wanapa 'di dag go /zhes sred pa dang sred byed don gcig la/ chu 'dzin sogs kyang sprin du don gcig pas dgos pa med par ldabs pa'o/ /dper na/ nyon mongs sdig pa sgrib pa kun/ /ma lus zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /rgyal bas chos 'chad chos 'khor bskor/ /bka' yi rnam grangs du ma gsung / zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ rjes su brtse sogs khyad par las/gal te dga' bas gtam 'ga' zhig brjod par 'dod na ni yang yang brjod pa la skyon med de 'di ni rgyan du rigs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'dod pas bkab pa min pa ste rgyu mtshan med par 'khon pa yis bud med mchog 'di bcom par gyur to/ /yan lag kun mdzes pa 'di bcom par gyur to/ /ngag snyan cing 'jam par sgrog ma 'di bcom par gyur to/ /dper na/ yid du 'ong ba'i mdza' bo khyod/ /skyid pa'i gnas khang 'di ru shog /zhim pa'i kha zas za phyir 'dong / /snying gros lhug par smra phyir gshegs/ che'o/pa lta bu/ /bzhi pa the tshom can la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod/ dmigs bsal dang gsum/ dang po ni/ nges pa'i (131na)don du rab tu sbyar ba'i tshig rnams nyid kyis gal te ni the tshom byed mi dgos pa la de skyed par byed na ni 'di the tshom can zhes rab tu brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'khrig pa'i re 'dod kyi dga' bas blta ba yis ro la mig zur g.yo bar byed pa'i grogs mo dag /'di 'dra bas khris na yod na blta bar bzod pa ma yin te/ rgyang na 'dug pa'i ma ma 'dis kyang ngo / /rgya dper a ra rta ces pa nye ba dang ring ba gnyis ka la 'jug pas the tshom du 'gyur pa yin no/ /dper na/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba mchog gang gis/ /'gro la phan phyir go yi sgra/ /gsungs pa 'di yi don du ni/ /'gyur ram yang na mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ 'di 'dra ba'i the tshom gyi slad du ni gal te/ 'ga' zhig tu sbyar ba na/ de ni rgyan nyid du 'gyur gyi/ de la skyon med pa 'di lta ste/ gnyis pa ni/ ma smad pa de ni lus skyes te 'dod pa'am tsha ba'i 'jigs pas gzir zhing sbyor ba rtsub mo yis dus 'di nyid kyis ni bzung bar mthong ste/ da ni bdag cag khyod la 'dod pa'i re ba ci yang med do/ /dper na/ 'jam dbyangs —377

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)grub bam dbyangs can mas rjes su bzung ba'i skyes bu khyod/ snyan tshig gzhung brgya smra ba la/ rmad byung blo gros can der smon/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ 'dod pas gzir ram cha bas gdungs zhes pa nges med the tshom byed pa'i tshig gis (131ba)rtsed 'jos kyal ga'i sgo nas mdza' bo skyes pa de'i yid 'brugs par bya ba'i phyir du pho nya mos smras so/ /lnga pa rim pa nyams pa la mtshan nyid/ dper brjod/ dmigs bsal dang gsum/ dang po ni bshad bya'i don mang po dag snga mar mdor bstan nas/ de'i rjes su yon tan gyi don rnams go rims ma 'khrugs par sbyar dgos pa la/ gal te go rims kyis rjes su bstan par ma byas nas/ rim pa nyams par mngon par brjod pa'i skyon du de dag ni/ bshad de/ dper na/ gnyis pa ni/ 'gro ba rnamasakyi gnas pa'i rgyu khyab la jug /sprul pa'i rgyu tshangs pa/ 'jig pa'i rgyu dbang phyug ces mdor bstan nas rgyas bshad kyi skabs su/ ma skyes pa bde 'byung dang / sred med kyi bu dang chu skyes kyi skye gnas can gyis khyed rnams la srungs shig ces go rims 'tshol ba'o/ /dper na/ kha dog in+d+ra ni la su war+ṇa/ /gangs ri'i mdangs dang ldan pa'i lhag pa'i lha/ /phyag na pad+ma 'jam mgon gsang bdag gis//dus rnams kun tu dge legs stsal du gsol/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa la mtshan nyid dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ brjod don gyi 'brel pa nges par shes pa'i rgyur go rims/ zhakhrugs pa'i sbyor ba gang yang gal te 'bad par byas nas rim pa zlos kyang skyon min par mkhas pa rnams kyis smra ste/dper na/ gnyis pa ni/ gnyen dang bral bas gtong ba dang / shi ste lus gtong ba dang / yul dang bral nas gtong ba zhes pa gsum po (132na)la dang po dang tha ma gnyis dang bral ba ni nyon mongs pa'i sdug bsngal ring ba yin la/ bar ma lus dang bral ba ni skad cig gi gdung ba ste yun thung ngo / /dper na/ pad dkar me tog ba ku la/ /ku mu ta yi chu skyes gsum/ /dang mtha' nyi zlas kha 'byed kyang / /bar pa kha yi chang gis so/ /zhes pa lta bu/ drug pa sgra nyams pa la mtshan nyid dper brjod/dmigs bsal dang gsum/ dang po ni/ brjod don gyi mtshon bya la rnam dbye dang rkyen gyi mtshan nyid —378

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i che/ dbyangs/ (wa)kyi lam la mtshon na/ de dang mi mthun pa'i tshig sbyor ni mchog min pa mi mkhas pa dag 'dod pa ni sgra nyams pa yin te/ mchog gi mkhas pa rnams dag 'dod pa 'di ni skyon ltar snang yang skyon ma yin no//gnyis pa ni/ sa gzhi rgya mtsho'i ska rags can de ni rgyal po khyod kyi dpung pas srungs shag /ces rgya dper/ rgyal chen gyi skad dod ma hā rā dza na zhes las 'dzin gyi bsdu ba yod pas de'i mthar/tsan+d+ra pa'i mdo las tshig sdud kyi mtha'o/ /zhes spyir btang nas/ sa khi dang / a har dang / rā dzan rnams kyi ṭa tsu'o/ zhes pas ṭa tsu'i rkyen byin/ tsu dbyangs don dang / ṭi tra dha/ aṇa/ a nya/ bra ka ṭha nya/na nya/ sna nya/ gnya kwa ri khyun las so zhes pa'i khyad don gyis ṭa phyis a ba 'ag /na'i ri la sogasapa la ngos mtha'i aṇa phyis shing dbyangs med dbyangs la yang dag par sbyar bas/ rā dza zhes 'byung dgos pa la 'dir de med par rā dzan (132ba)zhes pa dang / rnam dbye drug pa'i tshab la bzhi pa byin pa'i skyon gyis/ rgyal chen khyod la dpung pas bsrungs zhes 'brel med kyi tshig 'byung bas mtsho ni te/ rgya dper/ rkyen dang rnam dbye nor ba'i dper brjod shin tu gsal lo/ / skyon 'di shin tu spang ba'i gnas yin kyang / da ni dus dbang gis mang po 'byung bar nges te gar lugs kyi drung pa si to bar kha khral phog nas/ mtshams sbyor lnga pa'i 'grel pa brjod bya gang yang med pa zhig brtsams/ de'i mjug tu lo tsā ba brtan pa ming le drug pa bsgral nas bslab ma myong ba de la blo brtan lnga pa zhes pa bsngags brjod byed pa sogs blun po'i snang tshul ni shin tu mang ngo / /zhes pa sngar bshad pa de ni/ tshig 'di la ni nyams 'gyur yod pa mi nus pa na shes 'dod med do/ /dper na/ 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /gtan bde thob las phyag btsal te/ /sangs rgyas rnams la byin brlabs nas/ /'dod pa'i don kun grub par gyur/ /ces gtan bde thob phyir dang / sangs rgyas kyis lta bu dgos pa la ma byung zhing / sgra sgrub la yang / su kha la rnam dbye bzhi pa'i de dgos rgyu la/ lnga pa'i des byin pa dang / bu d+dha la rnam dbye gsum pa'i lhas dgos rgyu la/ bdun pa'i su pu byin pas 'brul lo/ /gsum pa la dper brjod dang / sgrub byed gnyis/ dang po ni/ lho yi ri las nye bar btud pa'i —379

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)rlung gis tsū ta'i rkang 'thung gi ni yal 'dab rnams par rol zhing rtse ba ltar bskyed pa yis myu gu mdzes (133na)pa dang ldan par byed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ zhes sogs ka tsan+da gyi bstan bcos bdag nyid chen po rnam la lta ba la g.yel ba'i sems dang ldan pa 'ga' zhig la/ ri la zhes pa rnam dbye bdun pa thob mod snyam pa 'byung ba'i sgra nyams pa bzhin du snang mod kyi/ ming le bzhi par gnyis thob pa la pha rol ster bar bshad pas skyon med pa'i phyir skal bzang 'di nam yang gtong ba ma yin no/ /dper na/ rgyal bas thugs rje cher 'phel bas/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus zhi/ /phan bde'i 'khri shing myu gu de/ /dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel bar gyur/ /rgyal ba'i zhes drug pa thob pa 'dra yang byed tshig byas na legs so/ /bdun pa ngal so nyams pa la/ /mtshan nyid/ dper brjod/ /dmigs bsal dang gsum/ /dang po ni/ tshigs bcad rnams la ngal so nges pa'i gnas/ sdeb sbyor gyi tshig gi gcod mtshams ngal so bar rig dgos la/ de nyams gcod mtshams ming ma rdzogs par ngal so ba ni nyams pa ste/ nyan pa po dag dga' ba min pa skyed de/ dper na/ gnyis pa ni/ bud med rnams kyis yang dag par brjod pa'i tshig glu gar sogs snyan pa'i ro dang nyams med pa la/ skabs 'dir skyes bu'i mchog rnams nad 'grogs pa'i mi'i dbang po nyi ma'i rigs rgyud las byung ba 'dis lta bar byed do/ /la sogs pa sdeb sbyor nyams pa ni skyon no/ /rgya dper/ 〉〉 saṃ gī ti/ brjod pa'i skad dod gī ti ma rdzogs (133ba) par ngal sos pas ngal so nor ba sogs shin tu gsal lo/ /dper na/ mchog rnams 'dren sangs rgyas pa dag /lus/can kun brtse ldan ma ma/ /gang de yis bdag la phan 'dogs//myur stsol shig thugs rje can kye/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa la dngos dang / sgrub byed gnyis/ dang po ni/ gtsug lag gnyis kyi bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa blang dor ma tshang ba med par lung nyid kyi sgo nas lta bar byed cing / gzhan yang mi bdag 'di yi dbang du gyur pa'i sa 'dzin kun srung bar byed ces pa de ltar ming gi dbus su ngal so sbyor ba ltar yod kyang skyon med do/ /rgya dper/ kā rla n+ya zhes pa'i yā ni —38()

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)rnam dbye'i shugs las ring por gyur la/ ṇi ni rnam dbye yin pas/ dbus su ngal so byung ba la skyon med cing / ya btags byung ba ni mtshams sbyor gyi stobs so/ / dper na/ dbyangs can lha mo smos ci dgos/ /'jam dbyangs kyis kyang blo gros kun/ /'bad pa med par stsal ba yis/ /rnam par dpyod 'di de rmad byung / /zhes 'jam dbyangs dang kyis gnyis kyi bar bcad pa dang / de med ces sbrel ba la skyon med pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ ji ltar rnam dbye'i stobs kyis tshig gi mtha' phyis par byas pa la lhag ma tshig nyid du nges pa de bzhin du/ mtshams sbyor rnam 'gyur gyi mtha' yang tshig nyid ces ni brjod pa yin no/ /de lta na yang de rna bar rtsub pas snyan ngag mkhan rnams mi sbyor te/ rgyal po de'i rgyal (134na)mtshan gyi tog gi chu 'dzin bskul zhes pa 'di'o/ /rgya dper/ tog gi skad dod ke hu'i ke ni rkang pa dang po'i mtha' byung ba bdun pa'i tshig yin yang mi snyan pas spang bar bya'o/ /brgyad pa sdeb sbyor nyams pa la mchan nyid/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ gang du yi ge chad lhag shor bas ring thung dang lci yang sdeb sbyor las bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin mi gnas pa de ni sdeb sbyor nyams pa zhes bya ste/ skyon 'di ni shin tu smad pa'i gnas so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis las/ dang po chad lhag dper brjod ni/ zla ba'i 'od zer rab bsil bas reg ces pa rgya dper yi ge rkang pa bdun las med pas nyung ba nyid dang / sa ha kā ra'i lo 'dab gsar pa rnams snum zhing zhes pa 'di la yi ge dgu yod pas lhag pa'o/ /dper na/ kye ma bod rgan blun po rnams/ /tha ga pa 'dra'i bla chen rnams la dga'/ tags bya shes pa'i blo ldan rnams la/ /phag rgod lta bur gzur bar byed pa de'o/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa lci yang gi dper brjod ni/ 'dod pa'i mda' rnon po de dag ri dwags mig can ma rnams la rnam par 'phangs/ zhes pa dbang po rdo rje'i thog ma ta yin pas de'i lci yang dang ma mthun pas ji bzhin min la/ mdzes ma'i mig can dag la myos byed 'dod lha'i mda' snan po lhung (134ba) zhes pa yang / nye dbang rdo rje'i thog mar dza yod pas de dang mthun pas ji bzhin min rna/ /dper na/ ma hā ka ru rdo gag nā rlud+ma ma ti yasnro karaḥ de wa ba ma rā ma dz+nya shrī lha khri yan ma sma ཿ kā la/ /zhes pa bram ze —381 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)phrug gu rtsen gyi sdeb sbyor 'di la/ bha ta la ga thob kyang / 'dir hā shri kā dzu rnams yang ba thugs rje chen po'i mkha' dbyings las/ /blo gros nyin byed stsol mdzad pa/ /lha mchog 'jam dpal dbyangs la ni/ /dus rnams kun tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgos pa la lci ba dang / ti ma lci ba dgos par yang ba lta bu'o/ /dgu pa mtshams sbyor nyams pa la mtshan nyid/ /dper brjod/ dmigs bsal dang gsum/dang po ni/ bsdus pa'i tshig mtshams sbyar ba brjod par mi 'dod ces/ tshig gcig gam tha dad pa rnams la mtshams sbyor thob kyang med pa'i rigs gang zhig /dper na/ na ma ārla zhes pa lta bu rnam bcad dang e a ya'i ya phyis shul sogs dmigs bsal gyi rgyu mtshan med pa la mtshams mi sbyor ba de ni mchams sbyor bral ba zhes bstan no/ /gnyis pa ni/ mkha' dang bdag gi yid phyogs pa la yang /rlung gis dal bur rgyu ba yis ni 'dod pa 'phel te 'khrig pa bsten pa ni/ bud med kyi 'gram pa'i dkyil 'khor la rngul gyi chu rgyas pa ni sel bar byed do/ /rgya dper/ tsa ra tā/ aṅga nā gnyis mtshams ma sbyar ba lta bu ste/ dper na/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ji bzhin du/ /rab (135na〉nas la ma ti ā ka sha /ji bzhin mtha' yas pa ni/ /bla ma lha yi drin las so/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/ mtshan mo 'di la zhes pa'i skad dod kyi mgo'i ā dang / tshigs bcad snga ma'i gsham gyi yi gnyis po mtshams mi sbyor ba ni shad nyis brtsegs kyis chod pas/ 'di 'dra mkhas pas nyams pa'i skyon du rig par mi byed do//dper na/ mkhas dbang tsan+d+ra go mi yi/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bi tsā ra a ti sha yi ngo mtshar ni/ che zhes kun gyis gleng bar byed/ ces pa lta bu/bcu pa yul 'gal ba sogs kyi skyon la/ 'gal ba drug gi mtshan nyid mdor bstan/ so so'i dper brjod rgyas par bshad/ gnas skabs 'gal yang skyon med du bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ri dang / nags dang / yul 'khor la sogs yul dang / nyin mtshan dang / dbyar sogs dus drug la sogs dus dang / 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi don lnga la brten pa yi gar dang glu sogs sgyu rtsal te 'byung po sems can rgyu ba dang / mi rgyu ba bem po rnams kyi 'jug pa ji lta ba ni 'jig rten gyi ming can no/ /—382

snyan ngag me long gi dka ri 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)rig pa gtan tshigs rig pa rtog ge'i bdag nyid dang / thos pa rig byed dang bcas pa gsungs pa lung nyid yin te/ rgyu mtshan des na snyan ngag mkhan po ming shes rlom gyi bag med pa rnams kyis sbyor ba las/ tshul dang ldan pas yul dus dang mi 'gal ba dang der ji ltar (135ba)grags pa bzhin sbyor gyi/gnas lugs ji bzhin min par gal te sbyor ba la rab tu zhugs pa na 'dir ni yul sogs 'gal ba zhes brjod do/ /gnyis pa la drug las/ dang po yul 'gal ba ni ga bur rkang 'thung la reg pa'i ma la ya'i rlung gi dri bzang po can zhes pa/ ri de na ga bur gyi shing med pas 'gal lo/ /ka liṅgā yi nags su skyes pa'i glang po 'di dag ri dwags kyi rigs zhes pa ni/ ri de'i glang po rnams bha dra'i rigs yin pas 'gal lo/ /tso la'i yul gyi chu klung ka we ri'i 'gram ngogs kyi sa'i a ka ru nag po ni sngon po zhes pa/ chu de'i 'gram na a ga ru med pas 'gal lo/ /ches pa yul dang 'gal ba yi tshig gi 0〈cog pa 'di 'dra ba mang ngo / /dper na/ ke la sha rtser 'gying ba'i stag mo des/ /nga ro tsam gyis ri dwags ma lus 'dar/ /swā la'i ljongs kyi skyed tshal na 'khrungs pa'i/ /rnam rgyal gser mdog nad kun 'joms par byed/ /ces pa lta bu/ gnyis pa dus dang 'gal ba ni/ me tog pad+ma can ni mtshan mo rgyas shing / nyin par ku mu ta ldan pa dag gsal lo/ mang ni tsu la ni dpyid kyi dus su rab tu rgyas so/ /so ka dag ni nam mkha' dngas pa la sprin gyis gtabs so/ /ngang pa'i sgra ni dbyar mi snyan pa la de nyan par 'os so/ /ston ni rma bya mi dga' ba la dga' bas myos pa ste/ dgun stod rlung dang sprin pa ldang ba la nyi ma dri ma med do/ /dgun bsil ba'i dus can dan gyis dgos pa med pa la de bsngags par 'os so/ /(136na tshe zhes pa 'di 'dra dus dang ni 'gal ba'i lugs dag bstan pa yin no/ /dper na/ zla gzhen zer gyis phye ba'i pad+ma la/ /rtse dga' khong nas rgod pa'i bung ba lding / / dgun dus 'dab ma rgyas pa'i ut+pa la/ /mdzes ma khyod kyi rna ba'i rgyan du 'jibs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa sgyu rtsal dang 'gal ba la dam bca'/ dper brjod/ don bsdu ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sgyu rtsal dag dang 'gal ba'i lam cung zad bstan par bya ste/ dper na/ gnyis pa ni/ dpa' ba dang sgeg pa dag gi dngos —383 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)po'i nyams kyi rgyur gyur pa'i sems kyi khyad par brtan pa ni spro dga' yin pa la de khro ba dang ya mtshan pa ༷na zhes pa'o/ /dper na/ 'bod grogs mgrin gcod rā ma ṇa/ /mi sdug khro ba'i nyams dag gis//kun tu dga' ba'i 'dzum dang bcas/ /rtse ba'i zlos gar dag gis brel/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa ni/drang srong sogs dbyangs bdun rdzogs pa 'di dag ni tshang pa'am gang rung dman pa dang / tha dad pa'i lam ste yul dang mthun par rab tu 'jug go /'di ltar sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhir 'gal ba'i tshul legs par rtogs par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi yongs su bcad par le'u bzhi pa zhig slob dpon 'di nyid kyis mdzad pa yod par grags pa las/ der ni de yi rang bzhin gsal bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa 'jig rten dang 'gal ba ni/ /glang po dag la ni ral pa med par de g.yo ba dang / rta la ra ni med par de sno ba (136bskin pa dang / snying po med pa'i chu shing e raṇ+ḍal snying po lci'o/ /snying po lci ba'i seng ldeng ljon pa la snying po med do/ / zhes pa 'di ni 'jig rten gyi lugs nyid dang 'gal bas kun gyis smad do/ /dper na/ dbyar gyi char sprin sdug po las/ /byung ba'i tsha sreg me lce yis/ /bsregs pa'i dud sprin 951la ba yis/ /sa gzhi thams cad ldem ldem g.yo/ /ceXs pa lta bu/lnga pa rig pa dang 'gal ba la/ dam bca'/ dper brjod/ mjug bsdu dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rig pa zhes bya ba ni gtan tshigs kyi rig pa ste/ de dang 'gal ba bstan par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la phyi nang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bde bar gshegs pas 'dus byas thams cad 'jig par ni gsungs pa bden mod/ /de lta na'ang tsa ko ra'i mig can ma de ni bdag gi snying la da dung rtag par gnas so/ /dper na/ dug gsum ngan pa'i kha lo pas/ /'gro rnamasang na 'gror 'khrid byed kyang / /mdza' mo 'di la spyad pa yis/ /mngon mtho'i sa la 'gro bar nges/ / zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ ser sku'i slob ma gangs can pa rnams kyis sngar nas dngos por gnas pa la yod pa nyid rab tu skye bar 'gyur zhes nye bar brjod pa de ni mi rigs te/ dngos po rnams sngar med pa nyid ni bdag —384

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)cag gi phyis rab tu skye bar mthong ba gang gi phyir ro/ /dper na/ 'jig rten byed po tshangs pa ni/ /yin zhes smra ba rdzun pa ste/ /mes po'i sngon nas srid pa 'di/ /grub pa bdag gis nges par mthong / /zhes pa lta bur gsum (137na)pa ni/ rig pa dag dang 'gal ba yi lugs ni kun tu bstan par byas zin no/ /drug pa lung dang 'gal ba la dam bca'/ dper brjod gnyis/ dang po ni/ de nas lung dang 'gal ba yi/ 'jug pa dang ni bstan par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ me ma bzhag kyang mchod sbyin byed pa lung dang 'gal tshul/ cho ga ma byas kyang rig byed klag pa lung dang 'gal tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang btsas dus kyi me'i rgyun ni bzhag pa ma yin yang rang gi bu skyes par gyur pa'i tshe bram ze rang gi spyod pa ma nyams pas brgyan pa 'di dag ni be+e shā na rī ste me'i mchod sbyin slar sgrub par byed do/zhes ma bzhag kyang mchod sbyin byed pa lung dang 'gal ba ste/ dper na/ rgyun du srog chags du ma dag /bsad pa'i sha khrag longs spyod cing / /rnyed bkur ched du bram ze yis/ /gtsang spra'i spyod pa 'dzin par byed/ /zhes pa lta bu/ gnyis pa ni/ rig byed kyi gzhung las/ bu skyes pa'i tshe ston la cho ga byas nas/ rjes su rig byed klag dgos par/ 'dir ni cho ga ma byas kyang / bla ma'i gnas skabs dag las srid srung la sogs pa'i rig byed bklags so/ /dper na/ rang bzhin dag pa'i shel dag ni dbyi ba sogs 'du byed gzhan la ltos pa med pa bzhin no/ /zhes pa lung dang 'gal lo/ /dper na/gtsug lag yon tan ma bslab pa'i/ /de nyid gzhan la 'chad cing ston/ /dbang khrid gdams pa ma thob par/ /slob ma smin (137ba)grol lam la 'god/ /ces pa lta bu/ gsum pa gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu 'gal skyon med par bstan pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang / so sor bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sngar bshad pa'i skyon ni mtha' dag 'di la yang res 'ga' snyan ngag mkhan mkhas pas skyon gyi grangs las rab tu 'das nas yon tan gyi lam ni rnam par 'dzin no/ /gnyis pa la drug las/ dang po yul dang 'gal yang skyon med pa ni/ rgyal po de yi mthu yis ni/ de yi skyed mos tshal du lha rnams kyi dpag bsam gyi ljon pa yal 'dab kyi gos dam/ra po dang ldan pa dag gi gnas su gyur ro/ /dper —385

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)na/ bod yul tshong 'dus 'gur mo'i skyed tshal du/ /sman rgyal g.yu thog mgon po'i legs byas kyis/ /rnam rgyal gser mdog phyur bur spungs pa yis/ /lta na sdug gi grong khyer bzhin du mdzes/ /stu/thab pa 'u/ n+da//gnyis pa dus dang 'gal yang skyon med pa ni/ rgyal po 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa gsal bar byed pa'i ltas ngan pa'i tshe/ dus gcig tu ka dam pa yi me tog rdul dang 'grogs la/ 'dab ma bdun pa las 'khrungs pa'i me tog rnams skyed par byed cing / drag po yi rlung dag rgyu bar byed do/ /zhes ka dam pa dang 'dab bdun pa gnyis gcig dbyar dang gcig ston gyi dus ma gtogs mi 'byung bas spyir 'gal yang / rgyal po 'chi ba'i ltas ngan la skyon med do/ /dper na/ rtsa rlung las su rung ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ /dgun (138na)dus grang ba'i reg bya kun bcom nas/ /sa gzhi ri klungs dros pas spang ljongs kun/ /ma nad gzhen nu'i 'og pag gyon snyam byed/ / ces pa lta bu/ gsum pa sgyu rtsal dang 'gal yang skyon med pa ni/ khyogs kyis bteg nas g.yo zhing rab tu bskul bas yid skrag par gyur te/ de'i steng nas khas glu brjod pa'i skye bo bud med rnams myur bas glu'i stabs mi mnyam pas spyir mi snyan yang 'dod ldan 'ga' zhig la ni snyan pas chags pa dag ni 'phel bar byed do/ /dper na/ 'dod pas myos pa'i tsha gdung gis/ /lus phra'i rgyan gyi me tog rnams/ /snyigs kyang gar gyi ldem ldem la/ /chags ldan mdzes pa'i snang ba 'char/ /zhes pa lta bu/ bzhi pa 'jig rten dang 'gal yang skyon med pa ni/ zla ba'i 'od zer rab tu bsil ba yin yang / rang gi bud med dang bral ba'i nyon mongs kyis yid 'brugs pa 'di rnams tsha ba'i bsreg bya 'dzin par 'dod pa dang ldan pa rnams brtsi bar byed do/ /dper na/ da dhu ra yis cher myos pa/ /'ga' zhig kun gsal 'gram pa la/ /chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /du ma shar ba'i ltad mo mthong / /zhes pa lta bu/lnga pa rig pa dang 'gal yang skyon med pa ni/ dbang phyug ni nyi ma sogs gsal bas gzhal bya yin yang / 'ga' zhig tu mi snang bas gzhal bya min la/ sa sogs cha ldan yin yang / rang gi ngo bo cha —386

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (5)ldan min la/ rang gi gzugs rtag pa'i rang bzhin gcig nyid yin yang sprul pa (138ba〉sna tshogs pas gcig nyid min pa/ sna tshogs pa'i gzugs can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ dper na/ brgya phrag lo ldan bcu drug ngang tshul 'chang / /'gro kun la brtse 'dod lha 'joms la brtson/ /4nyon mo nge so bcom kyang dbyangs can lha mo la/ /chags pa'i nyams kyis 'khrud pa 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /zhes pa lta bu/ drug pa lung dang 'gal yang skyon med pa ni/ skya seng gi bu lnga po dag gi ni chung ma rgyal po lnga len gyi bu mo dro pā di zhes bya ba de ni bud med 'chol ba'i skyon gyis yongs su dag pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa 'di 'dra lha yis sgrub par byed de bsod nams kyi mthu'o/ /skyes pa lnga tsam dang 'grogs pa'i bud med la 'chol ba'i skyon med pa ni spyir 'gal yang / khyad par 'phags bstod kyi lung nas bshad pa'i skyon med do/ /dper na/ so so skye bo'i sa nas skad cig la/ /gsang sngags thabs lam zab mo'i man ngag gis/ /mchog gi dang po'i lam bzang thob pa 'di/ /rgyud sde yid bzhin nor bu'i dgongs pa'o/ /zhes pa lta bu/mjug gi don/bzhi pa 'jug gi don la/ dngos dang / phan yon/ rtsom pa po sgyur byed bshad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ rjod byed kyi sgra dang brjod bya'i don gyi rgyan ni rnam par bkra ba dang / tshegs chung ba bya sla ba dang tshegs che ba bya ba dka' ba dag gi lam ma nor ba dang / snyan ngag rnams kyi yon tan dang skyon gyi tshul de ltar gong du mdor bsdus nas rab tu (139na)bstan zin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ snyan ngag gi rig pa sgrub par byed pa'i thabs su daṇ+ḍi bdag gis bstan pa'i lam 'dir ni snyan ngag gi spang blang gi skyon dang yon tan dag rab tu rtogs pa'i blo gros can skal ba bzang po'i dbang phyug tu gyur pa'i snyan ngag gi tshig dang mngon par 'grogs par byas na legs tshogs 'byung ba'i dpe/ chang mig ma ste —387

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23) mig zim bur lta ba'i mdzes ma dag dang lang tsho dar la bab pa can gyi skyes pa dang dgyes dgur rtse ba chin pa'i yid la dga' ba/ lus la bde ba dang / 'phral yun kun tu dge ba'i snyan pa'i grags pa phul sdu byung ba'i skal ba bzang po rgyun mi chad pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /snyan ngag me long las le'u gsum pa'i 'grel pa dang dper brjod bshad zin to/ /gsum pa ni/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi snyan ngag mkhan rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu slob dpon dbyug pa can gyis mdzad pa'i shar lto'i lam gyi snying po mtha' dag bsdus pa'i snyan ngag gi bstan bcos me long gi gzhung 'di/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i ti shri dpal ldan sa skya pa bla ma chos kyi rgyal po dang / de'i nye gnas bod chol kha gsum la dbang sgyur ba'i dpon chen shākya bzang po gnyis kyis mthun pa'i rkyen sbyar ba la brten nas/ dpal sa skya'i gcug lag khang du/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta la snya ka ra dang / (139ba〉ra jig rten gyi mig gcig pu lo tsā ba 'jam dpal dbyangs shong lo rdo rje rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis legs par bsgyur cing / de'i rjes su dpang ston thams cad mkhyen pa lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa'i zhal snga nas kyis go dka' ba'i cha shas su gyur pa dang / don che ba rnams la 'gyur bcos mdzad pa yin la/ dus phyis rang cag tha snyad mkhan po rnams la bka' drin mchungs pa med pa ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta chen po chos skyong bzang pos kyang 'gyur bcos mdzad cing / snye thang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa bzhi pas kyang legs par 'gyur bde bar bcos pa yin no/ /smras pa/ smin legs bye ba'i snyems pa yongs 'phrog mtshan dpe'i ngo mtshar mdzes ma'i lang tshor grub pa'i snang ba ster mkhas dpal/ /mnyen lcug sor rtses bskul pa'i rgyud las chos kyi gnas lugs dbyangs su mtshar ba'i tshangs pa'i gsung gi dpe zla can/ /zag med bde chen dpal gyi rtse dga' khong nas rgod kyang chags pa'i nyams kyi 'jo sgeg gar mkhan kun dga'i dpyid/ smra ba'i dbang phyug ngag gi mchod sbyin 'dod dgur stsol ba'i sngon med dpag bsam yongs 'du gsar pa dbyangs can lha/ /gang gis rjes bzung phul byung mkhyen dpyod dri bral me long gtsang ma'i ngos/ rmad byung gtam sogs brjod don srog ldan bcad lhug spel ma'i phra ldem lus/ sgra don sna tshogs rgyan —388

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)gyis legs (140na〉skrud nyams 'gyur stong gi gar bsgyur ba'i/ khres ldan gzigs mor 'tshar du dngar ba'i byed po daṇ+ḍi'i gtsug lag mchog /dpyad gsum dag pa'i nor bus legs drungs rig gnas rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i chab/ /rnam dpyod gser gyi skyogs las bcus pa'i legs bshad rin chen phreng 'dzin la/ /'jam dbyangs gzhen nu dgyes pas mgrin 'khrud snyan tshig 'byung gnas dbang gi rgyal/ shes bya kun la 'jigs med rdo rje mkhas dbang smon 'gro paṇa chen de'i/ /gsung rgyun dbyangasakyi rgyal mo'i pi wang sgra/ /'chad mkhas sor mos legs bskul rna ba'i dpyid/ /legs bshad dga' ston 'jo ba'i bdud rtsi'i bcud// thos brtson shes rab yol gor 'phyur ba las/ /grangs med rig gnas ljon pas nyer dud dbus/ / snyan 'gyur bye ba'i 'bras bu g.yur za ba'i/ /mi zad gter gyi legs bshad ro brgya'i dpal/ / bstan bcos yongs 'du'i dbang po che 'di grub/ /rjod byed tsam gyi dbu ba'i do shal dang / /nyes bshad chu srin gdug pas ma gtses pa'i/ /dka' gnas zhib mor 'grel ba yol med rlabs/ /snyan ngag nor bu'i 'byung khungs 'di gcig pu/ /tshig nyung don rgyas rgyud las nyer drangs pa'i/ /daṇ+ḍi'i bzhed don rdzogs par blangs pa'i glu/ /skal bzang rna bar 'jebs pa'i dga' ston 'di/ /dbyangs can mgrin par chags las (140bsko zhan du ci/ /brtan g.yo'i chos kyis rang bzhin yangs pa'i zla/ /gtsug lag ga bur 'dzag pa'i kun dga'i dpyid/ /snyan 'gyur snang ba'i bsil zer 'bum 'phro bas/ /rgyal bstan kun da khong nas 'dzum pa bzhin/ /'khrul pa'i rang 'tshang ngom pa'i srid sgrub mgo/ dpyad gsum dag pa'i mtshon gyis nyer bregs pas/ /dgag sgrub dri nga'i ro des pad dkar mig / gnyis pa su la'i ljongs su 'ongs min nam/ /mang thos lang tsho rgyas pa'i rnam dpyod mig shes bya kun la 'jug pa'i dkyus ring la/ /rjes chags rgyal gsung yan lag bcu gnyis ma/ /mdza' ba'i skal bzang gtong min dam du 'khyud/ /mtha' med khengs pa'i ro ldan srid zhi'i dngos/ /sgra don rgyud du 'dren la dbyangs can ma/ /khyod dang tha dad dbye ba ma nus zhes/ /phur bus dbang po'i mdun sar gtam du gleng / zhang dpang rnyog bral shong lo'i dbyangs༅ mgul ༅ dpang —389

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)lo gzhung don gsal ba/ zha lu ba'i gnad bsdus pa lta bu/gsung gi gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /thos brtson hub kyis 'dren zhid skyug mkhas pa'i/
