/ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i dzaḥ mchis zhes/ /nyi zla gza' skar lta phyir mkha' la lhags//'jam kha snang thang pa rin spungs pa dpal snang pa zur mkhar pa klu sgrub pa/mkhas mang rgya cher 'grel ba'i ma la yar/ /legs bshad tsan+dan ljon pa'i phreng ba la/ /'khrul ba'i brang 'gro'i lce gnyis rkyong ba dag /sgrub dang sun 'byin dri yis bsal bar byas/ /me tog mda' (141na) can bshes gnyen rdzu bag gis/ /dpa' bo gtsug lag pa'i mchan dang / 'bri stag mar 'brug bzhi'i 'grel ba dper brjod sogs/ mu cor dug mdas bshad sgrub rigs pa'i tshogs/ /'joms pa'i dam bca' bsad pa'i dmar ba'i khrag /mtshams sprin ji bzhin thub bstan mkha' la mdzes/ /mongs rtul chang gis cher myos tshul 'chos kyi/ /'khar ba la brten rnam dpyod gom 'byor bas/ /gzig shun mgrin bzang gos su nyer klubs pa'i/ /bshes gnyen de rnams smra bcad ngal so mdzod/ /ba lang tshig ldan rtog ge'i e raṇ+ḍa ra/ /nyams dang 'gyur ba'i ro bcud ches mngar ba'i/ /snyan ngag 'bras bu re ba'i gzhung lugs pa/ /mkha' dbyings ut+pal phon po thod du 'ching / /gti mug khung bur sems gnas bde ba'i ror/ /rjes chags nyon mongs dug gis thar pa'i srog /gcod pa'i rdzun gtam phud sgrog sgom chen gyi/ /rna bar legs bshad 'di 'dra tsher ma'i grogs/ /dka' gnad kun gsal 'dren byed las 'ongs mes/ /paṇa chen bsod grags pa dang sgom sde nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sogs rang phyogs pa mang po dang / rje drung mi bskyod pa chos rje go rams pa/ rta nag mkhan po chos rnam rgyal sogs/tshigs bcad dam dum sbyor la snyan ngag par/ /khengs ldan 'dod lha bsregs dang lhan cig tu//gser mdog can mkhan po lcang 'dam pa/ 'brug pa sangs rdor ba spe pa mdar ba sogs cung zad sbyangs pa'i sngon gyi lha rnams 'dar/ /(141bsgog sbyor rjod byed bkra ba'i dbang po'i gzhu/ /don gyi snying por dpyad tshe stong pa'i gzugs/ /gnad 'gag gzung du med pa'i ltad mo la/ /byis pa'i blo can gnas rnying chos rje dang sde pa mdar pas pa rtsams pa 'i 'grel pa/ paṇa chen shāka mchog gi dper brjod/don med ngal bas mnar/ /de phyir dbyangs kyi rgyal mo rig pa'i 'phrul/ /mtha' dag mgrin par chags pa'i bang mdzod las/ /dbyangs —390

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs nor bu'i dpya/ shes ldan rna bar 'dod pa ci yang 'jo/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab 'khor lo yis/ /'brul pa'i dri ma bdar ba'i dkyil 'khor can/ /don bzang rig pa'i tsha zer 'bum 'phro ba/ / kho bo'i rnam par dpyod pa'i mkha' la shar/ /de lta'i mngar ba'i khyad par phra mo'i rdul/ /sbrang rtsir 'khyil ba'i glegs bam 'dab brgya ba/ /rnam par bzhad la shes ldan rkang drug tshogs/ /kun yid 'gugs pa'i snyan 'gyur glur long zhig /grags bla chen phal cher/skam chen por 'gying ba'i stobs ldan dpung / /rab rmongs nor 'dzin 'og tu nyer btang nas/ /kun las rnam bar rgyal ba'i bstan bcos kyi/ /gdugs dkar srid rtse'i bar du 'khor 'dir ltos/ /'jam dbyangs dbyangs can lha yis rjes bzung zhing / /mkhas dbang dbang po'i dpe zla nyer bsten pas/ /snyan tshig tshig gi spros pa nam mkha'i mtha'/ /mi 'dzad 'dzad pa med pa'i gter bzhin spel/ /phur bu'i blo ldan blo gros rnam par yangs/ shes bya (142na tshe/na gzigs kun mkhyen lo tsā ba/ /tshe dbang don grub don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta/ /rigs chos rgyud 'dzin rgyud ldan ngag gi lha'i/ /mang mang mtha' med rig pa'i gnasarnams kun/ /chil chil rlabs phreng g.yo ba'i rgya mtsho che/ /mngar mngar tshig gi phreng bar legasabargyus nas/ /gsal gsal blo yi nor 'dzin khyon kun bkang / /rjod byed lus kyi mdzes mdzes dar bab mar/ /sna tshogs snyan pa'i khrol khrol rgyan spud nas/ / don bzang nyams kyi ldem ldem gar bsgyur bas/ / yid kyi dga' ston yang yang spel ba'i mchog /bung ba'i mdangs 'dzin dbu skra 'khyog ldem ldem/ /yid 'ong zla ba tshes pa dkar gsal gsal/ /rin chen rtsa phran rna bas 'od 'tsher 'tsher//dbyangs can lha mo dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum 'dzum/ /'dzum bag nyams kyis sgeg pa'i sgyu 'phrul gar//gar stabs kho bo'i mgrin pa'i pad mtsho'i dkyil/ /dkyil 'khor gang ba'i zla ltar mdzes bzhin du//du mar sprul pa'i zlos gar de med byung / /brtson pa'i dpyid kyi mngal las sbrum/ shes rab dbyar gyi rgyal mo dar/ /legs bshad 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud/ /rig pa'i dri bsung ches cher rgyas/ /lung gi lo 'dab phang phung can/ /mi 'jig dam bca' rtsa ba brtan/ /ngag gi don kun 'bad med du/ /lhun —391 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)gyis grub pa'i dpag bsam dbang / /blo gros kun gsal yangs pa la/ / smra mkhas bcu gnyis bdag po'i dpal/ /(142ba〉skal bzang pad dkar gzhen nu'i tshogs/ /dga' ston ster ba'i gnyen gi cig bu/ /rgya chen rnam dpyod lcags kyu yis/ /mtsho byung lha mo 'gugs byed pa'i/ /'jigs pa med pa'i snying stobs kyis/ /ma med go cha btsan po gyon/ / thub pa'i bstan la 'chad rtsod dang /rtsom pa'i lang tsho dar ba'i kha/ lhag pa'i lha yi rab phye bas/ /kun las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ /mang thos gser gyi rtsibs stong gis/ /chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal/ /'dod pa med par lhun grub pa'i/ /rdzogs ldan dga' ston dpal de dar/ /de ltar dge tshogs shugs drag dri gzhen gyis/ /mi mthun rgud pa'i chu 'dzin mthar bskrad nas/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho'i rta ljang can/ /phan bde'i snang bas srid 'di legs khyab cing / /phul byung blo gros yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mchog gang gi /lung dang rtogs pa'i 'dod dgur spyod pa'i skal ba bzang po yi/ /grags snyan phyogs kyi rna lung rab mdzes kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i/ /chos dang srid kyi dpal kun srid mthar 'phel zhing dar ba dang / /bcu phrag rig pa'i gser gyi khrir 'gying chos kun lta ba'i mig stong can/ /rno ngar rig pa'i rtse brgya 'dzin mkhas kun las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ /mkhas mang 'chi ba med pa'i dbang phyug shong dpang brgyud pa'i bstan pa yi/ /legs bshad bdud rtsis kun nas 'tsho ba'i dga' ston mchog tu rgyas gyur cig /de ltar mkhas pa thams cad (143na)kyi dga' ston bla na med pa'i snyan ngag me long 'di nyid/ 'jam dpal dbyangs shong ston lo tsā bas bsgyur ba nas bzung / snyigs dus kyi kun mkhyen gnyis pa zha lu lo tsā ba rin chen chos skyong bzang po'i bar du dar rgyas che zhing / de nas kyang 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu de'i drin gyi blo gsal mang por 'phel ba'i rgyud las mchog tu gyur pa/sgang rgan 'od zer rgyal mtshan dang / grangs chen 'jam dpal rdo rje gnyis kyi legs bshad yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa smon 'gro paṇ+ḍi ta rig gnas rgya mtsho'i phreng ba 'dzin pa tsam ma gtogs/ tshul bzhin sbyangs pas shes pa'i mkhas pa nyung bar gyur cing / khyad par ding dus gzhung gi gnad phyogs tsam ma —392

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)rig par/ sngon gyi mkhas pa'i snyan tshig dper blangs na tshigs bcad dam dum sbyor ba la snyan ngag shes par smra ba sogs gzhung lugs tha snyad rig pa gang la yang ma bslabs par shes pa'i kun mkhyen dang paṇ+ḍi ta/ lam gyi gnad cung zad ma bsgoms par thob pa'i grub chen dang sprul sku/ kha zas 'di tsam gyis lto ba khengs mi khengs kyi tshod kyang me things par dus gsum rtogs pa'i mngon shes sogs rgyu med par 'bras bu skyed pa'i snang tshul ci mang zhig gangs can 'dir mchis kyang / kho bo ni 'o skol gyi ston pa nyi ma'i gnyen gyis rgyu 'bras kyi rnam gzhag mdo sde du mar bka' stsal ba la nges pa (143ba8da pa'i dbang gis na/ tshigs bcad tsam rtsom shes pa'i blo rtsa ma gtad par/ smon 'gro paṇa chen gyi rigs chos kyi rgyud 'dzin skad gnyis smra ba'i dpyod ldan 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje la lam rnam par dbye ba rnams la bzung / skyon bcu spong ba'i bar gyi gzhung don yongs su rdzogs pa'i dka' gnad dang bcas pa nan tan du thos shing / dper brjod kyi rtsom rgyugs sogs zhib mor byas te khong du chud par brten/ slob dpon mkhas pa nyid kyis kyang legs so dang bcas/ 'grel pa zhig brtsams na legs pa'i mtshams sbyar zhing / so zur gnubs gsum sngags pa'i rgyal por grags pa'i zur gyi rigs sngags 'chang pa'i rgyud du byung zhing / gsang sngags gsar rnying dang tha snyad rig pa sogs la rnam par dpyod pa'i snang ba mchog tu yangs pa'i chos kyi rje sngags ram pa dpal 'byor 'phrin las rab rgyas/ rang gi gam du nye bar bcar pa'i phyogs 'di la mos pa grong smad pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho/ gso rig smra ba blo bzang gzhan phan dbang po/ yig rigs bcu phrag shes pa'i sor mo'i 'du byed pa ngag dbang dge legs/ sa'i tshangs pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i mdun du lugs gnyis kyi blo gros can dka' bcu ba shes rab rgya mtsho sogs kyis bskul ba dang / bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs dang zhal mi gnyis pa gang gi bstan pa rin po che 'di la sngon chad zhang zhung pa chos dbang grags pa dang (144na)dbyangs can bzhad pa'i rdo rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho sogs du ma byon yang / deng dus phyogs 'di la ljags kyi dbang po rkyong ba nyin skar ltar gyur pa nas/ gzhan phyogs pa —393

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)'gas tha snyad mi shes zhes kha zer ba 'gog pa dang / shong dpang brgyud pa'i bstan pa yun ring por gnas tsho ched du lhag bsam gyis kun nas bslang ste/ gzhung don rdzogs par bkrag grol ba dang ni rigs dang mdzod/ ces pa nas skya seng bu lnga dag gi ni/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi dper brjod mtha' dag rang blos bskrun/ go sla ba rnams tshig nyung ngu dang dka' gnas kun zhib mor bkrol ba'i snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs zhes pa 'di yang / gnam skos kyi rgyal po dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po/ 'phags yul pa'i rgyal rigs swā la pa chen po za hor gyi rigs las byung zhing / dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs pa ngag gi dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am skad gnyis smra ba'i snyan ngag mkhan tshangs sras zhad pa'i rdo rje gdong drug dga' ba'i bshes gnyen du 'bod pas/ rgyal ba zas gtsang gi sras po drag po zhes pa lcags sprel la sku bltams nas nyis stong drug rgya drug tu sleb cing / rang lo so gcig pa/ 'phags yul ba ā dzi ta/ phyogs 'dir thams cad 'dul du grags pa/ rgya nag gi rgyal khab tu ting ha zhes me phag chu shel gyi dbang po smin drug gis nya ba'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum pa/ dus 'khor ba'i ya ṇa'i dbyangs ha gsal byed ji 'char zhing / khams nam mkha'/ snying stobs kyi snying stobs gsal chen po'i bu mo dbyangs 'char ba'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum pa/ dbyangs a gsal byed (144ba〉wa khams sa/ 'dod yon dri 'char ba'i tshes la chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi gzim khang lugs gnyis kyi mdun sa dga' ldan phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang du dbu btsugs/ lo de kha'i mgo zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa'i tshes kyi tat+pal gzhu'i dus sbyor la rdzogs par grub pa'i mthus/ gnas lnga rig pa'i bstan pa phyogs dus kun tu dar ba'i legs tshogs sirnyi ra stu/ /nam slar su:/ 'dzad pa med pa rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i phung por spungs pa'i nor/ /mdzes sdug dri za'i bu mo'i gzugs su grub pa'i lang tsho can/ /rgyud mang 'phrul las zab rgyas chos kyi glu yi —394

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)dbyangs snyan po/ /gdu bu'i sgra dang lhan cig sgrogs shig ngag dbang lhag pa'i lha/ khres bya'i rang bzhin pha mtha' bral ba'i mkha'/ /mtha' klas tshig gi sbyor ba'i ga9|ga rlabs kyis/ /'jam pa'i byed po mkhas dbang daṇ+ḍi yi/ /ngo mtshar gzhung brgya'i rtser son me long ma/ /tshul 'di'i gzhung don 'chad dang rgyan gsum tshig /smra ba'i dbang phyug shong pang lo tsā ba'i/ /dri med brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i 'jig rten mig /phal cher dus kyi bskal bas ches cher nongs/ /mkhas pa'i ngag sgros rku dang grong pa'i tshig /rnam par bcad la snyan ngag par rlom dang / / mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor grol ba'i sgro btags can/ /snying med chu shing lta bu'i skye bos gang / /'on kyang deng dus gtsug lag bye ba'i sgo/ /'byed la 'jam dbyangs smon gro lo tsā ba/ /'jig rten mes po rna ba brgyad pa yis/ /bsams bzhin sprul par nges las gzhan du ci/ /gang de'i drin las mi 'jigs spobs pa mchog /dge ba'i blo gros mi dman yangs pa las/ /dka' ba'i gnad kyis mdud kun 'grol byed pa'i/ /mkhas rnams dga' ba skyed par byed 'di (145na)bskrun/ /snyan 'gyur cha shas rdzogs pa'i pusta ka/ /sngon med zla ba 'dren pa'i cho ga mkhan/ mi zad par gyi rlung gi shing rta yis/ khres ldan gling bzhi'i mun pa cig car sel/ /gzigs mor tshar du dngar byed yi ge'i gzugs/ /sor mo'i 'phrul ldan blo bzang mchog gyur dang / /bsod nams bsam 'grub smin grub bstan pa rnams/ /bi shwa ga me sa 'dir 'ongs pa bzhin/ /tshul 'dir lus ngag yid gsum 'bad pa yis/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i 'bras bu'i bkra shis dung / /ma smad g.yas su 'khyil ba'i phan bde'i sgra/ /srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du sgrog gyur cig /bsod nams chu gter 'khyil ba'i rdzing chen por/ /tshe dpal 'byor pa'i gnyis skyes lus dkar tsam/ /bde ba'i snyan 'gyur glu dbyangs sgrog bzhin du/ /skyid pa'i phur lding rtse 'jor rol gyur cig /dag pa don dam 'gyur med rdo rje'i khams/ /lhun grub mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i gar mkhan ma/ zung 'jug sku bzhi'i dpal de mngon 'gyur nas/ /don gnyis 'bras bur longs su spyod gyur cig /(145ba tsher phags yul mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan smra ba'i dbang phyug daṇ+ḍi'i legs bshad me long gi dka' 'grel 'di rtsom —395

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)pa la/ thog mar rang gis tshul bzhin du bslab sbyang byas pa sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ rgya gar chu bo gaṅgā tshuX chad du rig pa'i gnas lnga la yang 'gran zla med pa'i mkhas pa chen po/ smon 'gro lo tsā ba rig gnas rgya mtsho'i phreng ba 'dzin pa tshe dbang don grub kyi chos kyi sras 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje'i drung du rig gnas 'di la sbyangs skabs/ go don dang rtsom rgyugs la bsngags brjod 'di ltar mdzad do/ /za hor rgyal rigs yongs 'du'i 'khri shing rtser/ /'jig rten dbang phyug dgyes pa'i me tog dkar/ /yongs 'dzin lha dang bcas pa'i gtsug rgyan du/ /bsngags 'os 'di ni ngo mtshar e ma phul/ /gang gi mkhyen bzang sprin gyi ba gam rtser/ /snyan tshig nyams kyi 'brug sgra ba 'ad pa'i tshe/ /bdag lus tsan+dan nags kyi khang bu na/ /sems kyi mdongs mtha' dga' ba'i gar gyis brel/ / shong pang bla ma'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /ma lus thugs kyi bum par legs bsdus nas/ /blo gsal 'gro la a bhi sti nyu'i chu/ /rigs med 'gyed pa'i smon 'gro lo tsā ba/ /de rigs ga bur 'thul ba'i nags klung nas/ /rig gnas dri (146na)yis dben pa phal pa'i shing / / snyom las lo ma'i khur gyis dud pa de'i/ /lag pa'i yal 'dab 'dzum zhing 'di skad zhu/ /gang tshe snyan tshig u dus ra'i phreng / /mkhas mang rnam dpyod yangs pa'i sku rgyan du/ /gsal bar 'god pa'i mkhyen ldan dge dbang yang / /khengs pa nyams te mtho ris bros sam snyam/ /zhes so/ /dka' 'grel 'di brtsams zin phral paṇa chen smon 'gro yab sras kyi drung du rtsom phud dang zhus dag la bsrings pa'i tshe/ sku mdun chen mos lan du 'phrin yig 'di ltar ro/ /mdo sngags sde snod gtsug lag gi 'byor ba ma tshang ba med cing mngon par 'byor ba'i mi'i nyi ma/ mkhyen rab nor bu 'bum phrag gis gtams pa'i sa mu dra/ rnam dpyod kyi 'od snang lhag par gsal ba'i zla ba/ mkhas pa thams cad kyi gtsug gi cod pan/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i zhabs kyi pa khror/ rgan bu'i sor bcu snying khar bkod nas zhu ba/ byang phyogs gangs ri'i ljongs 'di na/ tha snyad gtsug lag brdzun gyi 'khrul gtam dbyangs su len par sprin gyi rnga gsangs sgrog mkhan shin tu mang yang / legs bshad 'chi med lha'i rnga sgra tsam gyis kyang / smra byed nyi —3(36

snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can dgyes pa'i glu dbyangs/ (wa)mas kun mud zum pa ltar gyis 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i mdzad bzang khor mor (146ba)bskor ba'i skabs nas/ bka' dam yid kyi gsos sman du gyur pa snga phyir phebs pas dngos mjal gyi dga' spros gyur lags/ sngon med pa'i snyan ngag gi 'grel pa thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur nges/lcam bu dang zol sbyor spangs pa'i 'dren byed nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun yang 'dzag pa 'di khar gyur pa/snyan ṭīka 'di la lcags nan thar gsum gyis dpyad brdar byas/ blo nas cung zad mi gsal ba rnams la pang lo/ gung thang bde blo'i 'grel pa sogs tshad thub la/ bdag gnyis gas zhib bltas byas/rgan bu'i mig shin tu gsal yang / bab theg po rang mi yong 'dug pas/ o los bsgrags/ rgan bus sems g.yin la ma yengs par nyan nas/ dogs pa yong 'dra snyam pa thams cad la/ slob dpon mkhas pa rtsod bral yongs la grags pa'i gsung rgyun zab mo ma brjed pa rnams shog zer la yig chung du bkod pa ltar/ mkhyen rab rdo rje pha lam gyis thugs gzhig 'jug pa gnang cha dang / zhu dag grub nas 'gyang tsam song yang / stag tshang lo tsā'i dus 'khor spyi don la mchan zhib grags zhu dag byed pa 'di khas/ da bar 'gyangs pa la dgongs khrel mi 'jug pa dang / snying po'i zhu mchid/ da lam snyan tshig gi 'grel pa 'di par du rko ba gnang tshe/ rig gnas kyi bstan pa la phan pa gzhal du ma mchis pa 'byung ba ltar/ (147na)dam pa khyed kyis chab shog nas bzungs gsung rtsom thams cad par la bkod pa mkhyen mkhyen/ bstan pa rin po cher phan nges lags/ slar phebs 'os tshogs dal 'gro'i rgyun ltar dang / rgan bu lnga pa'i mthar gtugs 'dug pas/ 'di phyi thams cad du thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su 'dzin pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ zhu yig rten bkra shis kha btags la rgya mdzes/ hor zla brgyad pa'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba gsum pa'i tshes bzang la phul ba'i zhu yig /sras kyi 'phrin yig 'di ltar ro/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs rgyal dbang thams cad gzigs pa'i zhabs drung du/ zhu ba/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gser gyi ri dbang gur gum gyi char pas bkrus pa ltar brtan zhing /brjid chags par bzhugs pa'i ring nas/ nyams dang 'gyur bas yongs su sgeg pa'i thugs dam snyan —397

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)tshig gi phreng ba dang / rma bya'i mgrin pa'i kha dog la 'gran pa'i gos bzang / lha rdzas zla ba'i grogs po dang chabs cig par/ daṇ+ḍi'i zhal lung dang mthun pa'i tshig rgyan gyi 'grel pa zla ma mchis pa rnams spyi bo'i co rdo pan du 'byor zhing / nye bar yang / thugs dam zhib 'khod bkra shis pa'i dar dang bcas phyag rgya'i re kha ma nyams par zur phud kyi rgyan du thob pas/ bdag sems kyi gnyis skyes gzhen nu (147ba) bsam gtan gsum pa'i rtse dga' la reg par gyur lags/ ched zhus/ spyir pang lo chen po'i 'grel pa tshad gtug tu snang yang / ha cang tshig sne bsdus grags shing / gzhan ma gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir snyan ngag smra ba phal che ba ni nyes bshad mun pa'i lam du 'khyams pa kho na las/ gzhan du ma mthong lags kyang / da lam daṇ+ḍi'i dgongs don pad+ma'i tshal rnams dus gcig tu phye ba la/gsal byed kyi nyi ma mchog 'di legs bshad kyi 'od stong spro bzhin par shar bas/ bdag sogs rig gnas pa'i bung ba rnams gtam snyan gyi glu dbyangs phyogs bcur sgrog pa la chas par gyur lags shing bka' rtsom gsar gnang la/ lags drung dang thun mong nas zhu dag zhib tu grub bstun/ cung zad the tshom pa tsam gyi rigs la shog zer dang bcas stag tshang pa'i dus 'khor spyi don zhal bshus grub par zhus dag ding sang byed rtsis kyi 'phral nyid du 'bul rtsis lags na'ang / da lam sdebs su 'bul rgyu ma byung bar/ rnam dbyings dam pa mi khrel ba mkhyen mkhyen zhing / slad nas dus 'khor gyi spyi don 'bul ba dang bcas/ sku zhabs su 'phral nyid rdzong star zhu dgos 'dug pa/ zhib zhus nang so grong smad nas kyi zhu shog tu phul ba ltar/ dbyings bzhugs mkhyen ngos (148na)phebs 'os kyang gaṅgā'i rgyun ltar mkhyen mkhyen lags/ zhu yig 'degs rten bkra shes pa'i lha rdzas gangs ri'i mdangs ldan la rgya mdzes dang bcas nye bar zhu tho/ de ltar cung zad the tshom pa rnams kyi rigs la shog zer 'dug par dpyad pa byed dgos rnams kho bo shar phyogs gong ma chen po'i drung du bgrod pa sogs kyis g.yengs te 'gyangs pa las slar yang lo bzhi bcu pa me mo spre'u'i lor zhus dag par byas pa yin no// //—398—

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan nyin byed dbang po'i snang ba zhes bya ba bsdo kyigs rbe rgo/ /mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba/di ba re sa gya 4 nu na mo ga ṇa gi na k+ṣa tri : | nādwa ra byung bra sa t+ta jo be+e ha ra ti sma/ba rtsi rkyo sa ṣa ya shā nyi sha tsa mu kha ma hwa tsa pra pra sti ra yu ba rgyu zhib shu kra ku mu khro sgor wa na ka ra ma 'o ku khyi li pa ta shu kra/phul byung bde chen lang tsho rab rgyas kun da ltar dkar byang chub sems/ /nam yang 'pho med gtsug tor rtser bcings nor bu'i yol gor legs 'khyil bas/ /(2na)khyo ta ni rna ka yu pa rdzu ra jo ma ka na ma ཿ kā la tsa kro lha mi stunu bya spu sto di bu d+dha shri ba tsa bha wa a ta mā ya tsā 〈 rgya ཿ pa / /stong gzugs mtshan dpe'i ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul srid zhi'i rgud pa'i tshogs bcil ba /rnam kun mchog ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas zung la jug dus kyi 'khor lor 'dud/ /legs pa'i cha bsags grong khyer sham+bha lar/ /sa dbang tshul bzung khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon//chos rgyal bdud dang rigs ldan nyer lnga yi/ /zhabs sen bung ba spyi bo'i pad mtshor bsten/ /(2ba)mkhyen dpyod rlung gis gzhung lugs nyin mor byed/ /gangs can lha yi lam du 'dren mdzad pas/ /lo paṇa mkhas pa'i rnam par thar pa la/ /bsam kyin brjod du med pa'i bka' drin dran/ /rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i sis wa ra'i mdangs/ /'jam dpal rdo rje snan por shar ba'i gar/ /bshes gnyen tshul —399

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)gyis rnam rol btsong kha pa/ /mkhas grub yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur pa'i dpal/ /gsung rab phyogs rer sbyangs pa'i gom stabs can/ /mkhas rlom glang po'i lha chen mthong ba'i tshe/ /grags pa don ldan lo che rno stag tshang pa/ gnas lnga'i bstan pa rgyas mdzad khyod min su/ /rgya chen shes bya kun rig chos kyi grags/ /zung 'jug sgyu ma'i gar mkhan nor bu bzang / /phug lugs shing rta chen po lhun rgyam pa/ /dpal mgon 'phrin las snyan pa'i grags ka pa 'bar/ /gtsug lag smra ba'i dbang phyug zur rigs rje/ /rig gnas rgya mtsho'i 'phreng 'dzin smon 'gro ba/ /mdor na bdag blo ches phra'i za ma tog /legs bshad bdud rtsis gang bar mdzad rnams rgyal/ /dka' gnas dri ba'i tshig gi pad+ma dkar/ /zab cing brling pa'i 'dab ma stong ldan pa/ /blun rmongs tshogs pa'i thun gsum zum pa'i kha/ /dris lan nyi ma'i gzer gyis rnam par 'byed/ /ri mor bris mtshungs mtshungs med bla gral du/ /chud min 'jam dbyangs dbyangs can ngag gi lhas/ /smra ba'i rnam dpyod dpyod ldan mgu nus mchog /byin pas legs bshad bshad pa'i spobs pa thob/ /mdzes mdzes gzhan mgo skor ba'i tshul 'chos dang / /zob zob tshe 'di'i 'byid thabs mi shes kyang / /'grig 'grig mgrin pa'i lam nas legs drangs pa'i/ /snyan snyan dri za'i rgyud kyi (3na)dbyangs 'di nyon/ /zhes snyan tshig gi lam nas sdun bsus te/ste|nga ba/:sgo/gleng bar bya ba ni/ lus can mtha' dag gi 'dren mchog dam pa/ bskal ba bzang po 'di'i sangs rgyas kyi stong gi nang tshan/ dpal ldan stobs bcu'i rtsal 'chang ba zas gtsang gi sras po de nyid kyis gdul bya'i dbang po dang 'tsham par dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye ste/ mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa bla na med pa'i go 'phang gi srog 'tsho ba'i 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa rlabs po che stsal pa'i nang tshan gyi gtso bo ni spyi rgyud las/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen —4()khri

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)rnams/ /u dum wā ra'i me tog ltar/ /rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga ni/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ches dkon pa nam mkha'i pad+ma lta bu dang / don chen po dang ldan pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang mtshungs pa ni zab mo rdo rje theg par grags la/ de'i nang nas kyang bshad rgyud rdo rje 'phreng bar/ e ni gsang ba mkha' dbyings dang / /bha ga chos 'byung pad+ma dang / /chos dbyings seng ge'i khri dang ni/ /mchog tu rmad byung rjod par byed/ /wa ni rdo rje rdo rje sems/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang phyug che/ /hre ru ka dang dus 'khor lo/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs mtshan/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyi ma dang po'i sangs rgyas ni rtsa rgyud las/ bya rgod phung po'i ri chen por/ /theg pa chen po bla na med/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bstan/ /de nas gcig tu mchod rten cher/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /zhes dang / mdor bsdus (3ba)dang po'i bshad sbyar snying po'i snang bar yang / zla ba bzang po grong dgu bcu rtsa drug gi rgyal po dang bcas pas sham+bha la nas 'bras spungs su 'ongs te rgyud gsung ba'i don du gsol ba btab par bshad pa ltar/ 'phags yul dbus gyur 'chang bsto sa na/ bod skad du rdo rje gdan du grags pa'i lho phyogs/ shri dha na ka ṭa ka zhes dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten chen por/ las ldan gyi chos rgyal zla ba bzang po la dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa bka' stsal pa'i lugs srol de nyid byang phyogs ka lwa pa'i grong khyer chen por dar ba'i rtsa rgyud las phyung ba'i bsdus rgyud dang 'grel chen gnyis tsi lu pa dang dus zhabs pa'i drin las 'phags yul dang / de nas rwa 'bro shong gi mkhyen dpyod brtson pa'i byed pos bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir dar te/ thos bsam sgom pas gtan la 'bebs pa'i ring lugs ches cher 'phel bar gyur pa'i zab mo rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di nyid tshul bzhin rtogs pa la phyi nang gzhan gsum shes dgos pas/ phyi rol shes pa'i yan lag skar rtsis kyi gzhung lugs 'di nyid ma shes na sangs rgyas kyang thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /ci'i phyir na/ rgyal po shing rta can gyis ma ga dha'i rgyal po —4()/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23) byed cing / sen+ta pas o tan pu ri'i gtsug lag khang 'dzin pa'i tshe dus zhabs pa chung ba byon te/ nā lan+daḥ'i 9sgo gong la rnam bcu dbang ldan dang / de'i 'og tu/ gang gis dang po'i sangs rgyas mi shes pa des mtshams yang dag par rjod pa mi shes zhes pa nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i lam dang bral ba ste 'khor ba pa'o zhes pa'i bar bris pas so/ /rgya nag gi rtsis gzhung yang 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis ri bo rtse lngar gsungs nas/ ma hā tsi na'i rgyal khams su dar ba rgya mo bza' kong jos thog mar bod du bsnams (4na skos mchog dman kun gyis spang blang bya bar med du mi rung ba ste/ skar nag rtsis kyi tshul gnyis las brtsams pa'i dri ba tshig nyung zhing don brling ba/ mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan du grags pa zhig sngon rje mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus dpal o ṇ+ḍi yā na'i slob dpon chen po'i pad+ma'i zab chos kyi bka' babs so zur gnubs gsum sngags pa'i rgyal por grags pa'i zur 'ug bya lung pa'i rigs las nye bar son pa 'khor lo'i mgon po sngags ram pa dpal 'byor 'phrin las rab rgyas kyis mdzad snang ba/ rig sngags 'chang ba chen po nyid thog mar sngags rnying ma bka' gter la thos bsam sgom pa mthar phyin par ma zad/ yon tan ldan na skye bo kun/ /ma bsdus par yang rang nyid 'du/ /dri ldan me tog rgyang ring yang / /bung ba sprin gyi tshogs bzhin 'du/ /zhes pa ltar/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag /mkhas pa dang grub pa thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur ba/ rgya chen gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi snyan grags kyis thugs phyogs te/ chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i sgrub gnas skyid shod nyang bran pha bong khar yun ring po zhabs pad bsten nas gsang sngags phyi 'gyur dang tha snyad kyi rig gnas mtha' yas par sbyang pa mdzad de/ gtsug lag mang por gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhas pa chen por gyur pas/ dri tshig gi don 'di la som nyi ga la mnga' na'ang / deng sang gi dus 'dir gdung rus che che mo dang / skyi ba mang po brgyud brgyud par grags pa'i ched rlom mang po dang / lnga bsdus mgyogs rtsis gza' 'dzin gyi ri mo bre gang rde drug gi nag rtsis tsam shes pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal can dang / dgu mtha' tsam yang mi —402

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)shes pa'i dus 'khor mkhan po ngo mtshar (4bcan rnams la co 'dri shing / las dang po pa rnams la phan pa'i ched du mdzad par gor ma chag la/ rtsis rigs smra bar yid gzhungs pa'i gzur gnas kyi blo dang ldan pa'i dris lan dgos tshul nan tan du byung ba/ dri tshigs thog mar/ bla ma dang dus kyi 'khor lo 'jam dpal gzhen nu'i zhabs la lus ngag yid gsum phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha bcas 'gro ba'i bla ma zas gtsang sras/ /dpal ldan bde chen dus kyi 'khor lo dang / /mkhyen dang brtse ba'i bdag nyid 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas gus btud nas/ /gnas 'di'i dkar nag rtsis kyi legs bshad la/ tshe rabs sngon nas sbyangs par zhal bzhes pa'i/ /mkhas dbang rnams la dri ba zhu tshig la/ kho bo sbyangs pa chung zhing brtson pa zhan/ shes rab dman pas rtogs dkar gyur pa ni/ /zhes pa'i don ltar na tshe rabs mang por mkhas pa rim par brgyud pa/ khyad par dus 'khor sogs la sbyangs pa'i sngon gnas rjes dran yod pa zhig 'dri ba'i yul yin 'dug pa/ rigs pa nangs par 'chi yang bslab / /tshe 'dir mkhas par ma gyur yang / /skye ba phyi mar bcol ba yi/ /nor la rang nyid len dang mtshungs/ /zhes pa ltar na/ rgya bod kyi mkhas grub thams cad kyi yang rtse 'phags mchog klu sgrub dang / thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston lta bu'i skye ba'o zhes tshe rabs sngon ma'i gnas rjes su dran par zhal gyis mches shing / mngon mkhyen grub rtags sogs kyang thog med du yod par rlom pa rnams gtsug lag rgya mtshor gzigs par dka' ba'i gnas su mi 'gyur snyams pa 'dug kyang / dus snyigs ma bas kyang ches cher snyigs par gyur ba'i skyon yin nam/ dman pa spyod pa bzang gyur kyang / /de ni bcos(5na sgo'i rnam thar yin/ zhal la nor bus kha bsgyur kyang / /chu dang phrad na rang mdog ston/ /zhes pa'i don min las che/ /de 'dra'i rigs phal cher ni legs bshad smra ba'i ljags thung ngur gyur 'dug pas na/ sa phyogs de nas tsan+dan zhakrung rigs min 'dra bas/ yon tan med pa'i skye bo 'ga'/ / yon tan ldan la lhag par sdang / /gangs kyi yul du dgun skyes pa'i/ /lo tog ltas ngan yin zhes sgrog /ces dang / brgya yi nang na mkhas pa dkon/ /stong gi nang na dpa' bo dkon/ /brgya stong las kyang 403

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)ches dkon pa/ /tshig gi mdud 'grol re re tsam/ zhes pa'i don du mngon no/ /tsho rang nyid la dogs gnas gyur ba 'am/ gzhan la phan sems kyis dri ba dang / dpyad pa'i gnad ni/ /slob dpon nyi ma sbas pas/ gnam bskos rgyal po'i pho brang du/ /paṇa chen lnga brgya 'du ba'i gnas/ /legs bshad 'tshol dang 'dri ba dang / /dka' ba'i dogs sel de ru gyis/ /zhes pa ltar mkhas pa mang po la 'dri bar gsungs na'ang / dus dbang gis rig pa'i gnas lnga shes pa'i mkhas pa mang po gnas gcig tu tshogs pa lta ci smos/ gnyis gsum tshogs pa'ang dka' ba'i phyir na/mkhas pa 'jam gsar bas rmi lam gyi dga' ma'i dri lan du/ skabs shig tshong 'dus chen po'i dus ston bltas/ /skye bo phar 'gro brgya dang tshur 'ong stong / /blo ldan mkhas pa'i grogs po nyin skar tsam/ /kho bo tsu ta'i yul na rkang gnyis pa/ /de nas gzhan phongs 'jigs med seng ge'i sgra/ /sngon du bsgrags pa'i chos grwa chen por sleb/ /mi brtags bzhag tshe bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing / /brtags na chu shing lta bu'i skye bos gang / /zhes pa'i don thog tu babs pa'i dus tshod 'dir bdag lta bus wa (5ba〉skyes seng ger brdzu ba'i zol gyis dris lan cung zad bgyis par dpyod ldan rnams rjes su yi rang bar mi 'gyur ba ma yin te/ lha mdongs lo tsā bas bal yul gyi lam yig tu 'jam dbyangs phyag gis stsal ba'i pir/ /gang gis bde bar 'dzin pa yi/ /sman thang sprul sku 'jam dbyangs pas/ /legs bshad sil bu'i gleng mo mdzad/ /snyom las myos chus ngoms pa bdag lta yis/ /rig gnas ming tsam yod par mi nus kyang / /cung zad tsam la lan ldon ci nus phul/ /phan tshun rjes su yi rang gnas su gyur/ / ces pa'i don du sems/ /'on kyang tshe rabs snga ma nas sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa'i skye ba yin no zhes khas len cing der rlom pa ni ma yin te/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na/ bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhan chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / 'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i skye ba yin no zhes ngos 'dzin par gnang ba ni g.yin ngo tsam la dgongs par sems/ rang ngos nas skye ba dran pa dang / mngon shes grub —4(/4

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)rtags sogs ni lta ci smos/ rmi lam bzang ba tsam yang 'ong ma myong bas/ gong gi 'dri yul gyi khrod du tshud par ma gyur kyang / na tshod chung ngu nas bstan pa rin po che'i sgor zhugs/ mkhas pa'i dbang phyug mang po dang mjal te thos bsam cung zad byas pas/ blun po'i dbus na dga' zhing rtse/ /mkhas pa'i dbus na zhum zhing bzung / /nog dang lkog shal med na yang / /ya so can gyi ba glang yin/ zhes pa'i gral du sdod ma dgos tsam yod pa dang / yab rgyal po zas gtsang gi gsung las/ nga yi bu ni rigs dag dang / /rus la ngo mtshar 'dzin ma yin/ /yon tan bden pa chos kyi rnams/ /de la 'di yi yid dga' ba'o/ /zhes dang / lung bar ma las/ (6na tha tog dri ni rdzi phyogs min mi 'gro/ /rtsa ba'am rgya spos tsan+dan yang ma yin/ /mkhas rnams dri ni rdzi phyogs min 'gro ste/ /skyes bu dam pa phyogs rnamasakun du 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thos bsam gyi cha la/ sngon byon mkhas pa'i rnam thar la mig yar lta'i lugs su byas shing / sems can la sangs rgyas kyi ming btags pa'i bla chen gyi go sar gnas kyang / de dag gi khyu tshogs su spyi 'dre ma byas pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ lan cung zad spro bar bya'o/ /dri ba dang po/skar nag gtsug lag 'di nyid rig gnas lnga po gang gi khongs su gtogs min gyi dris lan/des na dri ba dang po ni/ de yang dang po skar nag gtsug lag 'di/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga'i khongs su gtogs dgos pas/ /bzo dang gso ba sgra tshad nang don te/ /rig gnas lnga po gang gi khongs su gtogs/ /de rnams gang gi khongs su gtogs min na/ /yan lag rig byed bzhi la gtogs dgos pas/ /snyan ngag mchod sbyin srid srung nges rjod kyi/ /rig byed bzhi po gang gi khongs su gtogs/ /der yang ma gtogs gtsug lag chos 'di nyid/ /rig gnas khol bu zhig tu khas len na/ /rig pa'i —405

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)gnas drug dag tu 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /rig gnas lnga ru bsdus pa don med do/ /zhes pa la/ spyir dzomagon po byams pas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la brtson par ma byas na/ /'phags mchog ci sems thams cad mkhyen nyid thob mi 'gyur/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar cad rjes gzung dang / /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson byed/ /ces smra ngan tshar gcod pa sgra tshad/ /blo ldan rjes su 'dzin pa bzo gso/ /rang nyid kun shes par byed pa nang rig pa ste/ lngar gsungs pa ni spyir btang las mtha' gcig tu grangs nges su gzung bar bya mi nus te/ de las spro bsdu sna (6ba〉tshogs 'byung bar bsgrub nus pas so/ /rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir na/ nyung ngur byed tshe rig gnas thams cad bzo rig pa'i khongs su bsdu nus te/ bzo rig pa la lus bzo ngag bzo yid kyi bzo dang gsum du bshad pa'i phyir/ lus bzo mchog ni bde gshegs sras bcas kya sku gsung thugs kyi rten yin la/ de yang / dbyangs can mas rjes su bzung ba'i dpal ldan blo gros bzang pos/ rgyal ba'i sku gzugs thal mo bcu pa la/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi mtho bcu zhan pa dang / /rgyal yum sogs kyi zhal tshad dgu pa dang / /rgyal dbang khros pa rnams la gdong brgyad dang / /mi'u thung la lus tshad mtho drug go /zhes sogs sku'i phyag tshad gsal bar gsungs pa'i khungs/ dus 'khor sam bu ṭi/ sdom 'byung sogs rgyud sde mang po dang / shā ri'i bus zhus pa sogs mdo las byung ba'i phyag tshad rnams yin zhing / mtho tshad re rer sor phyed bcu gsum du bshad pa'i/ gtsug tor nas gsar gnas kyi bar la mtho lnga/ gsang gnas nas rting pa'i bar la ste/ bsdoms pas sor brgya nyer lngar bshad la/ de yang dus 'khor gyi lugs la/ sprul sku'i cha tshad rags par sor mo brgya dang bcu gnyis su bshad pa dang / mdo phyogs dang rgyud sde 'gar yang /rdo rje sems dpa' bzhengs pa'i tshad/ /gdong pa dgu las sā ra ba med/ ces gsungs sa pa ni phra rags kyi dbye ba dang mdo sde sngags kyi khyad par mi 'dra ba'i dbang du byas pa yin te/ phar phyin theg pa'i skabs su/ sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin thob ma thag tu 'pho rlung stong brgyad brgya pa phra rags bcu 'gags/ sa bcu pa de nyid mthar phyin phyin gyi bar du/ 'pho rlung stong brgyad brgya pa phrag gnyis —406

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)'gags nas/ mdo lugs kyi longs (7na〉sku 'thob par 'dod na'ang / gsang sngags la/ da dung 'pho ba'i bag chags bem chos phra mo stong brgyad brgya pa phrag bcu gnyis lus pa/ kun du 'od la sogs pa'i sa bcu gnyis kyis spong zhing / spang bya de nyid phar phyin theg pa'i lugs kyi rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi spangs byar don gyis 'gro bas/ de lta bu'i spang rtogs yongs su rdzogs pa na longs sku 'thob pas/ gnad 'di la brten nas lus tshad che chung gi rnam gzhag 'byung na'ang / sngags kyi khyad 'phags kyi sa kun tu 'od sogs bcu gcig po dus yun ring por mi 'gor bar rdzogs 'gro ba'i phyir phra ba'i gnad de dang bstun pa'i lus tshad 'jog par dka'o/ /tshul 'di dag la/ grags pa don ldan gyi mkhas pa stag tshang lo tsā bas/ mdo sngags kyi longs sprul la sor gyi dbye bar gsungs pa ni/ gnad de dag la dgongs pa yin gyi/ deng sang lag len gyi skabs/ pir thogs dbang po sman bla don grub pas mdzad pa'i cha tshad gyi yi ge chen mo dang / de'i rjes 'jug dbyangs can lha mos rjes su bzung ba sprul sku ring mkhar ba sogs mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge dang phyag len gyi dkyus su/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la sor brgya nyer lnga 'byung ba de las gzhan pa'i ring thung gi dbye ba mi mdzad cing / zhal tshad bcu dang / de las cung zad thung ba'ang / gtso 'khor lta bu gzhi gcig la brten pa'i bltos sa ltos 'jog dgos par mngon no/ /da lta yongs grags kyi longs sprul ni/ rdo rje 'chang lta bu longs sku dang / shākya thub pa lta bu sprul skur ngos 'dzin pa mang yang / gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor rten brten pa rnams ni gang la gang 'dul du so sor sprul pas sprul skur ngos 'dzin dgos pas dri (7ba)za'i rgyal po rab dga' 'dul phyir dri za'i cha byad du bstan pa ni bzo bo sprul sku/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal/ khyis bu mo/ gru zam sogs su sprul pa ni skye ba sprul sku/ byang chub mchog mngon du mdzad pa'i tshul ston pa mchog gi sprul skur bshad pa ltar ro/ /gsung rten ni yi ge ste/ ji skad du/ ngo bo gzugs dang byed las dang / /ngesatshig dbye bsdu rgyu klog tshul/ /zhes gsungs pa'i yi ge'i ngo bo ni/ spang lo chen pos/ brjod 'dod —407

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)dbang gis rlung gis rlung g.yos shing / /de yis gnas dang byed pa dang / /rtsol pa bskyed de dbugs 'byung dang / /lhan cig yi ge'i gdangs rnams skye/ /zhi/ gnas dang byed pa dang rtsol ba rnams las yi ge 'byung ba'i gzugs kyi dbye ba ni/ tshangs pa'i yi ge lā ñca na/ de dang cha mthun pa dha ri/ de'i mgo gyen du bzed pa na ga ra/ de'i mgo thur du bkug pa wa rtu la/ 'dra min shas che ba ga smri ra/ gzhan yang / go ḍa/ ga 'u ra/ rgya mtsho mtha'i yi ge sin dhu/ bru sha /rgya dang bod la sogs pa'i yi ge'i gzugasarnams yod do/ / mdo rgya che rol par yang tshangs pa'i yi ge dang zhes sogs yig rigs drug cu rtsa bzhi tsam bshad de/ tshangs pa'i yi ge dang / kha ro dzi'i yi ge dang / pad+ma'i snying po'i yi ge dang / aṅgā'i yi ge dang / ba lha'i yi ge dang / ma ga dha'i yi ge dang / bkra shis pa'i yi ge dang / sor gdum gyi yi ge dang / sa kā ni'i yi ge dang / swa dha ni'i yi ge dang / ā hu ba'i yi ge dang / rtsub mo'i yi ge dang / 'gro lding ba'i yi ge dang / mon yul gyi yi ge dang / lho phyogs pa'i yi ge dang / drag po'i yi ge dang / grangs kyi yi ge dang / spyi'u tshugs kyi yi ge dang / rjes su mthun pa'i yi ge dang / bha ra da'i yi ge dang / khyu su'i yi ge dang / rgya nag gi yi ge dang / hū na'i yi ge dang / dbus kyi yi ge dang / rgyal gyi yi ge dang /lha'i yi ge dang / klu'i yi ge dang / gnod sbyin gyi yi ge dang / dri za'i yi ge dang / mi 'am ci'i yi ge dang / lto 'phye chen po'i yi ge dang / lha ma min gyi yi ge dang / nam mkha' lding gi yi ge dang / ri dwags 'khor lo'i yi ge dang / bya rog skad kyi yi ge dang / sa'i lha'i yi ge dang / bar snang gi lha'i yi ge dang /byang sgra mi rnyan gyi yi ge dang / nub ba glang spyod kyi yi ge dang / shar lus 'phags po'i yi ge dang /'degs pa'i yi ge dang / ba 'ag pa'i yi ge dang / rab tu ba 'ag pa'i yi ge dang / rgya mtsho'i yi ge dang /rdo rje'i yi ge dang 'phrin yig rab tu spring pa'i yi ge dang / rnam par bzhag pa'i yi ge dang / chung ngu ma yin pa'i yi ge dang / bstan bcos bskor ba'i yi ge dang / rtsis bskor ba'i yi ge dang / 'degs pa bskor ba'i yi ge dang / rkang pas bris pa'i yi ge dang / tshig phyi ma gnyis grub pa'i yi ge dang / ji srid tshig phyi ma bcu grub bya'i yi ge dang / bar ma sgrub pa'i yi ge dang / sgra thams cad kun bsdus pa'i yi —408

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)ge dang / rig pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i yi ge dang / rnam par bsres pa'i yi ge dang / drang srong dka' thub kyis gdungs pa'i yi ge dang / gsal ba'i yi ge dang / sa rab tu lta ba'i yi ge dang / sman thams cad kyi rgyu mthun pa'i yi ge dang / snying po thams cad kun bsdus pa'i yi ge rnams te/ yi ge drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /thugs kyi rten ni/ thub dbang sku bltams tshe ser skyar bkra shis sgo mang gi mchod rten/ ma ga dhar sangs rgyas tshe byang chub mchod rten/ wa ra nā sir chos bstan tshe bdud 'dul mchod rten nam chos 'khor mchod rten/ sum cu rtsa gsum du yum bden pa la bkod tshe lha babs mchod (8ba lhan/mnyan yod du mu stegs btul tshe pad+ma spungs pa'i cho 'phrul mchod rten/ rgyal po'i khab tu dge 'dun gyi dben bzlums pa'i tshe dbyen bzlums mchod rten/ yangs pa can du sku tshe byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe rnam rgyal mchod rten/ rtsa mchog grong du mya ngan las 'das tshe myang 'das mchod rten no/ /mdor na blos slangs dang / dkyil 'bor dri thig /dus 'khor/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ yo ga /'phreng ba sogs nas bshad pa'i sa gar/ mchod gar/ zhi khro sgyu 'khrul/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad/dpal chen phur pa sogs rtsa 'chams/ 'brub 'chams ji snyed pa snang ngo / /lus bzo phal pa ni/ rgya mtsho chen por bgrod pa'i gru gzings chen po/ rgya gar bal po rgya nag sogs kyi chu la bgrod pa'i gru chung / khang khyim/ khang brtsegs/ khang mig lnga brgya pa/ bza' btung gi g.yos/ gos rgyan gyi khyad par/gzhan yang bsdus rgyud las/ g.yul du pham pa'i dgra bo dag ni gal te 'phral la rdzong gi nang du zhugs par gyur pa na/ phyi rol tu ni 'khrul 'khor bya ste rgyun chad med par rdo dang me mda' rab tu bab pa dang / ral gri la sogs gcod pa'i 'brul 'khor dag dang sa gzhi'i gnas la gur dang go ni dbye ba yis/ de yi rdzong ni phye mar byas te nyin zhag cung zad dag gis gdug pa de ni bsgrub par bya/ zhes/ngo mtshar ba'i sbyor ba thang rdzong gzhig pa rda'i 'khrul 'khor te mgyogs chu rdzong 'joms pa gru'i 'khrul 'khor/ ri rdzong 'joms pa me'i 'brul 'khor/ ral gri 'khor ba gri gug gi 'khrul 'khor/ rtse mo 'byed pa rlung gi 'khrul 'khor/ rtsig pa 'jig pa gur gyi 'khrul 'khor te go cha 'jigs pa lcags mda'i —409

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)'brul 'khor rnams dang / rang (9na)phyogs srung ba ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor/ rgyal rigs 'thab pa shing rta'i tshad/ ltad mo la 'gro ba'i don du khang bzang gi mtshan nyid/ dga' ston gyi don du khyogs kyi mtshan nyid do ldum ra bcu pa'i don du chu gyen du 'dren pa'i 'khrul 'khor sogs dus 'khor las gsungs pa dang / ngag bza'i gtso bo ni/ lo chen rin chen bzang po sogs nas dar ba'i yo ga dang /g.yin yang sngags gsar ma'i yi dam chos skyongs la brten pa'i gdangs dbyangs dang / sngags rnying ma'i gyer dbyangs la/ 'gyur khug 'degs 'jog sbom phra ste drug ldan snyan brjid rngams pa sogs ma 'dres pa'i rigs dang / dkon mchog mchod pa'i ched du rol mo'i skad kyi gdangs sna tshogs su khrol ba/ ngag bzo phal pa ni/ dus kyi dga' ston gyi tshe skye bo mang po'i dbus su glu len pa/ pi wang sogasardung ba ji snyed pa/ yid bzo'i gtso bo ni/ lus ngag gi bzor mi gtogos pa'i gtsug lag la thos bsam sgom pa thams cad dang / phal pa ni/ sa gzhi dang / rin po che dang / ljon shing dang / gos dang /glang po che dang / rta dang / skyes pa dang / bud med brtag pa sogs te/ sems ldan dang sems med kyi dpyad don gyi rim pa rnams yin pas/ don dril na/ dman pa'i las rdza bzo nas bzung ste/ snying po'i mchog zab mo rdo rje rnal 'byor la brten nas tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya ba'i lam sgrub pa'i bar thams cad bzo rig tu bsdu nus pa'i phyir na/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nas gsungs pa'i/ lnga bsdus/ sgra gcan/ lo 'pho/ zla 'pho/ gza' 'dzin/ gza' lnga/ dus sbyor/ zhag gsum gyi rnam par dbye ba'i skor sogs skar rtsis dang / dbang phyug chen pos lha mo dbu ma la gsungs pa'i (9na)rgyal po lta bu la dbyangs gsal 'char tshul/ tshe tshad/ 'chi ba brtags pa/ blon po lta bu la/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo/ bum pa'i 'khor lo/ ral gri'i 'khor lo/ mda' gzhu'i 'khor lo sogs bem po'i rigs dang / sprul gyi 'khor lo/ sde rgyad kyi 'khor lo/ 'dabs chags kyi 'khor lo/ dgra gshed kyi 'khor lo/ rus sbal gyi 'khor lo/ bya khyung gi 'khor lo sogs srog chags la brten pa/ bag rtsis khyo shug rigs gsum sogs rang rigs kyi 'khor lo/ dmag mi lta bu la glang chen mche ba'i 'khor lo/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i —410

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)'khor lo/ rkang pa brgyad cu rtsa gcig pa'i 'khor lo/ rus sbal gyi 'khor lo/ seng ge ldan gyi 'khor lo/ gdugs kyi 'khor lo/ mtshon cha lta bu la/ sgra can rtsa ba'i 'khor lo/ dkar phyogs dang nag phyogasakyi tshes la 'char ba'i sgra can gyi 'bor lo/ yud tsam ra hu'i 'bor lo gnyis/ zla phyed ra hu'i 'khor lo/ thun ོ ra tso 'bar lo/ mdung rtse r+sā gnyis kyi ra tso 'bar lo/ bi rdzo 'bor lo/ thun 'tshams brgyad kyi ra hu'i 'khor lo ste ra hu'i 'bor lo bcu/ phyogs mtshams gza' brgyad kyi 'khor lo/ rnal 'byor ma brgyad kyi 'bor lo/ dus sbyor phyed pa'i 'khor lo/ thun phyed kyi 'khor lo/ bdud rtsi'i thun mtshams kyi 'khor lo/ rigs ldan 'char tshul gyi 'khor lo/ btsun mo lta bu la/ tat+pa la'i dus sbyor la 'khor lo brgyad cu lhag bcas 'khor g.yog lta bu la ming skar skyes skar 'tshol thabs/dkar po'i 'khor lo mdzes ma dbang sdud/ dmar po'i 'khor lo ri dwags gshor ba/ nag po'i 'khor lo dgra bgegs sgrol ba sogs dpal g.yul las rnam par (10na)rgyal ba'i rtsis dang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis kong rtse 'phrul gyi rgyal po la gnang ba'i lo zla zhag dus tshod/ srog lus dbang thang rlung rta spar rme sogs rtsis gzhir bzung nas/ gson rtsis la mi 'gyur rtsa ba'i rde'u drug /gcod dral gyi rde'u nyi shu rtsa gcig /rde'u zhe bdun ma bcu bzhi ma/ brgyad ma/ nad rtsis la/ thang shing gi rtsis/ tshe rtsis la/ rgya ma pha/ ngag gi rtsis/ gza' bzhi ma klung gi rtsis/ lha dpal che gsum gyi rtsis/ ging gong gnyer sbyor gyi rtsis/ gshin rtsis la/ zang 'khyam rnam grangs mi 'dra ba bcu gsum sogs rgya nag gtsug lag gi rtsis rnams kyang gong du bshad pa ltar yid bzor bsdu nus so/ /'on kyang deng sang rig pa'i gnas lngar yongs su grags pa ltar na/ bzo gso sgra tshad nang rig lnga po rig gnas che ba lnga yin pas 'di lnga shes pa la rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta zhes lnga rig pa chen po 'am mkhas pa chen por grags la/ rang cag bod yul 'dir mkhas blun dbye ba med pas rig gnas phyogs re tsam shes pa la'ang thams cad mkhyen pa/ kun mkhyen/ paṇ+ḍita/ mkhasang/'i dbang po sogs ming snyan por 'bod pa ni/ bya ba 'ga' la mkhas pa yis/ /gzhan dag shes —411 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)pa'i nges pa med/ /chu las 'o ma 'byed shes pa'i/ /ngang pas gzugs brnyan zas su sgom/ /zhes pa'i don ltar ro/ /lnga po de'i bye brag pa sgra rig pa rjod byed kun gyi gzhir bzung nas/ de nyid las 'phros pa'i rig gnas chung ba lnga ni/ snyan ngag shes na tshig rgyan la mi rmongs/ sdeb sbyor shes na tshigs bcad la mi rmongs/ mngon brjod shes na ming la mi rmongs/ zlos gar shes na skad rigs la mi rmongs/ skar rtsis shes na blang dor (10ba〉pa mi rmongs pas don de la dgongs nas/ 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu lo chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ skar rtsis snyan ngag sdeb sbyor dang / /mngon rjod zlos gar 'di lnga la/ /rig gnas lnga zhes 'phags yul na/ /grags pa'i ba dan rlung ltar sgrog /ces so/ /'jam dbyangs kha che/ sna thang paṇa chen se gha shrī/ rin spungs ngag dbang 'jigs grags sogs kyis sgra the ba'i rig gnas chung ba lngar mdzad pa/ rig gnas bcu phrag tu bshad par dgu las mi 'byung ba'i skyon la jug gam snyam mod/ /de dag ni grags pa don ldan gyim khas par bda' bas/ bab col min pa'akhungs shig yod nges te/ shes rab ldan pas nyes pa dag /sel bar nus kyi blun pos min/ /nam mkha' lding gis dug can sprul/ /gsad par nus kyi khwa tas min/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de lta bu'i rig gnas lnga la rig pa'i gnas chung ba lnga'i tha snyad byed pas/ de lnga shes pa la alpa paṇ+ḍi ta zhes paṇa chung gi ming ngo / /mkhas pa zur mkhar blo gros rgyal pos kyang / rig gnas bcu phrag gcig la spungs pa'i mthus/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom pa gsum/ /mkhas pa mang po tsho gos pa'i mdun sar yang / /mkhas rnams khrel ba'i gtam ni smra mi myong / /zhes gsung pa rang nyid mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob pa la brod kha rnyed pa'i gzengs bstod par snang yang / dus der skyogs ston lo tsā ba rin chen bkra shis blo gros ngo mtshar bye ba'i gter mdzod/ dpal khang lo tsā ba dbyangs can bsnyems pa'i sde/ lha mdongs lo cwa ba bshes gnyen rnam rgyal/ 'brug pa lo tsā ba ngag dbang grags pa sogs mkhas pa mang po'i —4/2

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)bsgang (11na〉pa jug sgang rgan 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ grangs chen rab 'byams pa 'jam dpal rdo rje/skad gnyis smra ba sangs rgyas dpal bzang / smon 'gro paṇ+ḍi ta rig gnas rgya mtsho pa tshe dbang don grub sogs mkhas pa mang po chu gnyer ltar gcig rjes gcog non du 'byung bar mngon du phyogs pa'i dus skabs bzang por song bas mkhas pa mkhas pa'i drung na mdzes par snang / deng sang ni zur mkhar ba rang bzhugs kyang / blun po'i drung na mkhas pa bas/ /spre'u 'dzin pa khyad par 'phags/ /spre 'dzin zas dang nor gyis mchod/ /mkhas pa lag pa stong par 'gro/ /zhes pa'i don thog tu babs pa'i dus kyi dbang las te/ sngon byon mkhas pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'ang nyin skar lta bur gyur cing / rig gnas bcu phrag phyogs tsam shes pa byung srid na'ang cho ga nyams par byed pa rnams/ cho ga tshang bar byed la brnyas/ /tsū ta'i yul du phyin pa na/ /rkang gnyis pa la mir mi rtsi/ /zhes pa'i dpe dang mtshungs par mngon no/ /spyir rig gnas kyi dbye ba la mdo rgyud dang mkhas pas bshad tshul mang bas mtha' gcig tu grangs 'di tsam mo zhes bzung mi nus te/ 'dul ba lung du bram ze rnams kyi las/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud dang / cho ga zhib mo dang / gtan tshigs rigs pa dang / rig byed dang / brda sprod pa dang / sgra nges par sbyor ba dang / shes gsal dang / nges pa'i tshig dang / sdeb sbyor bsdus pa dang /skar ma'i rig pa dang / rtog byed kyi rig pa dang / chur lhung gi rig pa dang / cher spyod kyi rig pa dang /'jig rten rgyang 'phen pa'i rig pa dang / bye brag pa'i rig pa dang / rgyud drug cu pa dang / khyur mid kyi rig pa dang / gnas 'dug gi rig pa ste bco (11ba〉brgyad gsungs pa lta bus mtshon nus so/ /gzhan yang snyan ngag me long du/ 'di ltar rgyu rtsal drug cu bzhir/ /zhes pa ltar/ bzo la sogs par gtogs pa sum cu/ rol mo'i bre brag bco brgyad/ glu dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun/ gar gyi cha byad dgu'o/ /dang po bzo la sogs par gtogs pa sum cu ni/ yi ge /lag rtsis/ grangs/ rtsis chen/thod tshugs/ gom stabs/ lcags kyus sgyur thabs/ ral gri'i thabs/ 'gas sa pa gdab pa/ mda' bo che 'phen pa/ mdun du bsnur ba/ phyir bsnur ba/ gcad pa/ dral ba/ dbug pa/ rgyang nas 'phog pa/—413

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)sgra drag par 'phog pa/ gnad du 'phog pa/ mi tshor bar 'phog pa/ tshabs che bar 'phog pa/ mchongasapa/ gyad kyi 'dzing stangs/ bang rkyal/ brgyal ba/ glang po che'i gnyar zhon pa/ rta la zhon pa/ shing rta'i bzo thabs/ mda' gzhu'i bzo thabs/ 'gyed stobs dang sum cu'o/ /rol mo'i bye brag bco brgyad ni/ /bro/ rnga bo che/ dzornga/ rnga phran/ dzornga wo po/ 'khar rnga / pi wang rgyud gcig pa/ rdza rnga kha gcig pa/ lcags kyi sil khrol/ 'khar ba'i sil 'khrol/ pi wang rgyud gsum pa/ rnga mu kun+da/ sil snyan glu dbyangs dang bstun pa/ pheg rdob rol mo'i sgra pi wang gling bu dang bco brgyad do/ /glu dbyangs kyi nges pa mdun ni/ bar ma pa/ drang srong ba/ sa 'dzin pa/ drug ldan/ lnga pa/ blo gsal/ 'khor nyan dang bdun no/ /gar gyi cha byad dgu ni/ sgeg pa/ dpa' ba/ mi sdug pa/ drag shul/ ba 'ad gad/ 'jigs rung ba/ snying rje/ dam pa/ zhi ba dang dgu'o/ /g.yin yang / theb kyi sha non pa/ rkyal gyis chu chen chod pa/yang rtsal bya lta bu ste lus rtsal gsum/ lo rgyus kyis dge 'thon pa/ gtam gyis bzhed gad 'thon pa/gshags kyis pha rol gnon pa ste ngag gi rtsal gsum/ mdzangs la blo 'gyu ba/ dpa' la bsran tshugs pa/ kha gsal zhing (12na) gting mi rtogs pa ste yid kyi rtsal gsum bcas pa'i pho rtsal sna dgu dang / gtam yig rtsis gsum/ mda' rdo mchongs gsum/ bang rkyal spe gsum ste pho rtsed sna dgu sogs rgyu rtsal dang rig gnas kyi dbye ba ni bgrang yas pa'i phyir mtha' dag spro bar ga la nus so/ /dri ba gnyis pa/zla bshol ji ltar 'don lugs sogs kyi dris lan/dri ba gnyis pa ni/ gnyis pa deng sang zla bshol 'don pa la/ /bzhed lugs mtshan mo'i skar tshogs ltar mang ba'i/ /la la dbugs thob bsgang tshad gtso che zer/ /la la zla dga' 'bar ba yin no —414

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)skad/ /rgya nag rtsis dang gso dpyad gzhu gi lugs sogs/ /bgrang yas dpag med bzhed lugs 'dug mod kyang / /dus 'khor rgyud kyi ri mo'i nges pa 'di/ /gtso cher go bas re zhig brtag par bya/ /de yang khyim zla 'di yis ston pa'i phyir/ /khyim zla gnas gnyis bzhag pa'i 'og ma ni/ /lhag pa 'tshol ba'i bzhi ru gsungs 'dug pas/ /dbugs 'di zhag tu longs tshul ji ltar yin/ /de bsags zla ba phyed bcas so gnyis nas/ /zla bshol gnyis su longs par khas len nam/ /zla ros bgosapa'i lhag ma de yis kyang / /gnyis sogs byung na phyed slar gsungs 'dug pa/ /snga ma'i phyed dam rjesama'i phyed gang yin/ /de ltar dbugs sogs snga ma bsags pa yis/ /phyi ma phyi ma'i zla bshol 'byung 'gyur na/ /bcu gnyis lon tshe lo bsgol 'gyung ngam ci/ /de ltar yin na zla bshol 'di nyid kyang / /'don par rigs mi 'gyur te dbugs sogs kyi/ /bsgol bsags zhag tu longs tshe dor zin pas/ /de bsags zla bskol 'byung don med par 'dod/ /'di don rgyas pa lung rigs 'thad ngos nas/ /the tshom med par myur du stsal tu gsol/ kho bo blun rmongs gnas su gyur pas na/ /lung yang bsdus rgyud rtsa (12ba)rgyud kho na 'dod/ /ces pa spyir zla bskol 'di mdo rgyud tha snyad kyi gtsug lag mang po nas gsungs la/ de'ang phra mo nas brtsis te lo zla 'jog dgos pas/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i lugs la/ mdzod las/ skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la/ /de yi skad cig de dag kyang / /drug cu la ni thang gcig go /yud tsam nyin zhag zla gsum ni/ /gong nas gong du sum cur 'gyur/ /zhag mi thub dang bcas pa yi/ /zla ba bcu gnyis la le gcig /ces/ skyes bu dar bab kyi se gol gcig pa la drug cu rtsa bzhir phye ba'i gcig la dus mtha'i skad cig ma/ de brgya nyi shu la de'i skad cig ma/ de 'dra drug cu la thang gcig /de sum cu la yud tsam/ de sum cu la nyin zhag /de sum cu la zla ba/ de bcu gnyis la lor bshad cing / 'jig rten la lo re la ston thog re las mi 'ong bas/ lo legs nyes zhes rjod par byed la/ lo'i skad dod wa ṇa zhes pa nges tshig gis bshad na/ yongs bgrang / bgrang gzhi/ rang skyob/'dor byed du grags pas 'chi med mdzod las/ yongs bgrang bgrang gzhi rang skyob dang / /'dor byed —415

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)ces bya lo yi ming / /zhes so/ /lo de la dus tshigs 'byed tshul mang du yod pa las/ dgun dpyid dbyar gsum bsdus nas/ dus tshigs gsum du bshad pa'i dgos pa phyag dar khrod pa'i gos de khyim pas zla ba bzhir longs spyad nas 'jog la/ de rtogs pa'i phyir gsungs pas/ dgra bcom pa sa ga lhas zla bzhi la sogs longs spyad pa'i/ gos de sdom brtson gyis rtog na/ zhes so/ /dus tshigs bzhir phye ba ni/ dpyid dbyar ston dgun te dus bzhir 'jig rten na grags pa dang mthun pa'i ched yin la/ 'on kyang rgya gar na dbyar ston dgun dpyid kyi tha snyad yod kyang / rab(13na 'bring tha chung gi tha snyad med pas/ rgya dper mgo zla ba la mārga shirnyi zhes pa las ra ba'i skad dod med do/ /dus tshigs lngar phye ba ni/ dbyar phyi ma khas len pa la dbyar thung ngu shes pa'i ched de/ rgya cher 'grel las/de ni nyin zhag gcig ste/ dbyar zla tha chung gi tshes bcu drug go zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go /zhes gsungs pas/ dbyar snga ma khas ma blangs pa zhig la/ zla ba bdun par dbyar zla tha chung du byas pa'i tshes bcu drug la dbyar khas ma blangs na lo gcig bu der dbyar gnas mi 'chags pas shi zla dang 'dra ba'i tha snyad kyang btags so/ /dus tshigs drug tu phye ba ni/ zhag mi thub shes pa'i ched yin te/ tshes zhag las yud tsam phyed phyed kyis nyin zhag ring bas/ zla ba phyed dang gnyis nas zhag mi thub kyi gso sbyong 'ong ba'i phyir/ lo dri ba las/ rgyal dang dbo dang sa ga can/ /chu stod 'khrums smad smin drug can/ /'di rnams kyi ni nag po'i phyogs/ /zla phyed gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa/ /zhes so/ /de la brten nas lo re la zla ba bcu gnyis/ de re re zhag sum cur byas pa'i zla ba bcu gnyis po des kyang mi chog gi /zhag mi thub kyi zhag drug dang bcas zhag sum brgya re drug re rdzogs pa'i dbang du btang nas/ lhag par 'gyur ba de bsags pa na zla bshol 'gyur te/ 'dul ba lung las/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab 'od ma'i tshal na bzhugs pa'i tshe na dge slong rnams la/ lo lnga lnga na bshol dor cig bka' stsal pas dge slong rnams lo lnga na bshol 'dor par byed ces gsungs la/ rgyal po'i lugs dang ma mthun par 'phya ba na mdo las blon —4/6

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)po rnams yus te/ de ltar na rgyal po'i gzhung bzhin du'ang gyis shig /ces dang /(13ba〉bstan bcos las/ zla ba'i bshol 'dor ba ni rgyal po'i rjes su 'brang bas shes par bya'o zhes gsungs so/ /'on kyang 'dul ba 'dzin pa phal cher gyis bshad pa'i skor rnams rags brtsis su 'dug pas dpyad nas zhag gsum gyi rnam dbye ma dgongs pa'i skyon cung zad yod par snang / mkhas pa la la/ rta bya byi ba yos la bskol/ /ston dgun dpyid dbyar 'bring po gnyis/ /zhes rta lo la ston dang / bya lo dgun 'bring bshol na zla ba nyi shu rtsa brgyad la bskol 'ong bar 'dug pas rtsing po'i blo can te/'dul mngon dang / dus 'khor gang gi rjes su 'brang yang legs par ma mthong ngo / /rgya nag gi lugs la/ kong rtse'i zhu lan du/ dug pa can gyi lo dag la/ /dug pa can gyi zla ba gdon/ /zhes/ stag ri mo ma yal bas zla gcig shol/ sprul shun lpags ma rjes pas zla ba gcig bshol/ spre'u shing thog ma smin pas zla gcig bshol/ phag ngur sgra ma yal bas zla gcig bshol bar bshad pas/ dper na stag gi lo la stag gi zla ba bshol bas mtshon nus so/ /don gyi snying po/ dus 'khor dang dbyangs 'char sogs kyi dgongs pa skar rtsis 'di rigs rtsis la ma bltos par phra mo nas dpyad pa'i rtsis yin pas/ mkhas pa mgu ba skye ba'i gnas kho nar snang zhing / dri ba'i snying por yang 'dug pas cung zad brjod par sems kyang / rig pa glegs bam nang gnas dang / /ma bsgrubs pa yi gsang sngags dang / /brjed ngas can gyis bslabs pa rnams/ /dgos pa'i tshe na slu ba mang / /zhes dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ mkhas pa'i mdun sar ci brdol gyis/ /smra byed dud 'gro'i gdol thabs yin/ /nyin par lha lu ka yi sgra/ (14na)/ngo mtshar rtsis su su zhig byed/ /dud 'gro'i skad gsang phyugs dkyil du/ /'byin na shin tu mdzes pa yin/ /blo ldan skye bo'i khrod nang du/ /'byin la ngo mtshar su zhig 'dzin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ kho bo brtson pa chung ba dang sbyangs pa zhan la shes rab dman pas/ phra mo'i gnad 'di dag tshul bzhin smra ba'i spobs pa thob par ma gyur cing / khyad par dus 'khor mkhan por rlom pa 'gas glegs bam chen po rtsom pa na zhib —4/7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)rtsis ma 'grig pas 'byol thabs lhur len pa'i tshig 'dri ba dang / rjes 'jug gis rkang rjes lag sub byed pa mthong tshe/ blo dman bdag 'dras dpyod ldan rnams dgyes pa skyed mi nus par ma zad blun gtam ci brtol du smras par gyur dogs mod/ 'on kyang / gang zhig gser gyi ri la gnas bcas pa/ /de yi 'dab chags rnams kyang gser du 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen/ dus zhabs pa chen po chos kyi grags pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nor bzang rgya mtsho/mkhas pa'i dbang po phug pa lhun grub rgya mtsho/ dpal mgon 'phrin las zhabs rnams kyi legs bshad la cung zad thos pa byas pa'i byed pos/ mkhas pa rnams khrel ba'i gnas su mi 'gyur tsam zhig gi rgyu mtshan gleng na/ zhib rtsis tshad ldan zhig byed par/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston zhabs kyi mkhas pa dga' byed dang / dus zhabs pa chen po lhun grub rgya mtsho'i pad dkar zhal lung lta bu zhig gi rgyu mtshan rtsis la sbyang dgos shing / bye brag bshol sogs la zhag gsum gyi rnam par dbye ba'i rnam gzhag la brten dgos na'ang / deng sang ni/ rmig rjes su chu yis dgang sla ste/ /mdzod chung nor gyis dgang ba sla/ /zhing chung sa bon gdab sla (14ba〉ste/ /blo chung rig pas mgu ba sla/ /zhes pa ltar/dus 'khor shes par khas 'che ba dgu mtha' tsam yang slob ma myong pa'i mun nag 'dom 'jal gyi rigs mtha' klas shing / lnga bsdus gza' 'dzin tsam shes pas rtsis pa chen po srid sgrub gnyis pa lta bur rlom pa mang la/ zhag gsum rnam dbye rna ba'i khung bur son pa nyung bar snang / rang lugs pad+ma dkar po'i zhal lung gi dgongs pa gtso bor byas te bshad na/ lo gcig bu de mkha' dus mes bsgyur bas/ sum brgya drug bcu byung ba des khyim lo'i zhag grangs bstan pa yin la/ khyim lo'i don nyi mas lugs sogs khyim bcu gcig la rdzogs par spyod pa'i yun tshad do/ /bshad ma thag pa'i zhag grangs de gnas gnyis su byas pa'i 'og ma mig gis bsgyur/ mda' ros steng du bgos pas sum brgya don gcig byung ba de tshes zhag gi grangs yin la/ zla ba 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis tshes longs la brten nas bzhag pa yin no/ /zhal lung gi dgongs pa ltar chu —4/8

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)tshod sogs lag len zhib tu byas na/ tshes dkyil chu tshod bzhi/ chu srang so drug /dbugs lnga/ cha shas bdun yod pas/ dkyil 'khor sum brgya don gcig po mkha' ros bsgyur/ chu tshod bcug /de bzhin du rang rang 'khor los bsgyur la/ cha shas kyi bang rim bzhin bcug /de ri mkha' ris bsgyur bas ther 'bum chen po bdun/ ther 'bum gsum/ dung 'phyur drug /bye ba drug /sa ya brgyad/ 'bum phrag gnyis/ khri phrag drug /stong phrag brgyad/ brgyad brgya rnams byung ba gnas gsum du bzhag /'og mar mkha' ris bgos/ bar mar sbyin/ de la mtsho ros bgos ste mar phri ba'i lhag ma rim pa bzhin/ ri mkha' ri/ 'dod pa/ ro/ mkha' ro/ mkha' ro rnams kyis bgos lhag sum (15na) brgya drug cu rtsa lnga byung ba ni nyin zhag gi dkyil 'khor te/ chu chod bcu drug /chu srang bcu bzhi/ dbugs gag /'dod cha bcu gnyis/ ri mkha' ri'i cha brgya nyer gcig yod do/ /tshes zhag gi yun tshad ni/ zla rkang las byung ba'i longs spyod la rag lus pas/ rim pa'i snga rkang du rgyun dang zhag gnyi ka la nor/ phyi rkang du rgyun la nor dang / zhag la bu lon/ rim min gyi snga rkang du rgyun dang zhag gnyis ka la bu lon/ phyi rkang du rgyun la bu lon dang zhag la nor du 'gro ba yin pas longs spyod de rnams gza'i chu tshod man chad du bsnan pa'i tshe/ tshes 'phel du chu tshod re bzhi'i bar du 'byung yang tshes 'grib dus chu tshod nga bzhi'i bar du 'ong bas/ rkang pa lugs 'byung du spyod dus tshes 'phel pas zla ba'i 'phel grib bul la/ rkang pa lugs ldeg gi dus su tshes 'grib pas zla ba'i 'phel 'grib mgyogs pa'i don gyis tshes ‘nag de rnams zla ba'i dkar nag gi cha re re nas 'phel 'grib byed pa'i dbang gis bzhag pa'i zhag yin pas/ cha re 'phel ba'i yun tshad la yar tshes re dang / cha re 'grib pa la mar ngo'i tshes su btags pa'i sgo nas de ltar bshad kyi zla ba'i dkar nag gi cha la/ cha bco lnga las gzhan du che chung yod pa ni min no/ /nyin zhag ni/ lo re la res gza' sum brgya lnga bcu rtsa lnga cung lhag par 'gyur pas bzhag grangs kyang de ltar byung zhing / nyin zhag gi yun tshad kyang tshes longs kyi ri mor shar ba la ma ltos pas/ dri med 'od las/ nyin zhag gi thog ma nam phyed —419

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)nas 'go brtsams pa'i gza'i 'pho 'tshams kyang gsung la/ da lta 'jig rten grags tshod dang bstun nas/ nam langs dus su dus rgyun du 'pho ba'o/ /dri med 'od kyis nyin nas mtshan phyed kyi bar nyin dang (15ba〉〉ga mar mtshan mo'i tha snyad mjad par lo chen nam mkha' bzang pos/ mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo las/ gzhon nus bla na de thos pa dang nyi ma de nyid la grags 'dzin ma la'ang khyi'u zhig btsas so/ /bdud rtsi zas la'ang khyi'u zhig btsas so/ /de nyid kyi nyin mo zla ba'ang sgra can gyis zin to/ /zhes par/ dus der phyi rol pa'i lugs kyi rtsis las med pa'i khungs dang bcas te 'bru gnyer ba dang / chos rje mkhas grub dge legs pas/nyin mo zhes pa mchan mor 'don pa bsgyur bar mdzad pa sogs smra bo thams cad nyin ma bdun nyin mtshan gnyis kyi zlas phyed pa'i nyin mo las 'od mi snyams gsung bar snang mod/ zhakhrul med kyi dus zhabs pa lhun grub rgya mtshos/ de nyid kyi zhags zla ba sgra gcan gyis 'dzin pa'i don du gsungs pa ni sngon med kyi legs bshad de/ snga ma tsho ltar na nyin zhag gi nang du mtshan mo mi 'du bar khas len dgos par don gyis song bas mkhas par rlom pa rnams kyang zhag gsum rnam dbye la sbyang 'tshal/khyim zhag ni nyi mas khyim re rer spyod pa'i yun tshad de sum cur bgos pa'i zhag sum brgya drug cu ste/dper na nyi ma lug gi khyim du zhugs nas glang khyim du 'pho ba'i bar la rags rtsis su tshes zhag sum cu rtsa gcig 'byung bar mngon yang / zhib tu brtsis na tshes zhag sum cu'i steng du chu tshod gcig /chu srang lnga bcu/ dbugs bzhi/ 'dod cha brgyad rdzogs nas khyim 'phos pa na tshes zhag sum brgya don gcig dang 'grog go /nyin zhag ni/ nam langs nas nam langs bar la ngos bzung ste/ res gza' tshes kyi chu tshod la ma ltos par/ gza' ni nam langs nas nam langs kyi bar du 'pho zhes pa lta bu dang / tshes zhag ni nges pa med par/ tshes kyi chu tshod 'phel dus chu tshod drug (16na〉dru rtsa bzhi tsam 'byung ba'i skabs yod na'ang 'grib dus chu tshod lnga bcu rtsa bzhi tsam las mi 'ong pas zla ba'i cha bco lnga po 'phel 'grib la ltos pas na phal cher nam ma langs gong nas rdzogs pa mang bas/ dper na —42(lha

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (5)chos kyi dus longs la/ chu tshod nga dgu/ chu srang gsum/ dbugs bzhi/ cha shas bcu drug /nyin zhag gi dus longs la chu tshod drug cu/ khyim zhag gi dus longs la/ chu tshod drug cu/ chu srang nga gnyis/dbugs bzhi/ cha shas brgya re brgyad 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir na/ tshes zhag gis nyin zhag gi dod mi thub/ nyin zhag gis khyim zhag gi dod mi thub pa la/ de yang zla bar ma longs par nyin zhag shugs che bas mkhas rmongs kun la nam langs nas nam langs kyi bar nyin zhag tu song zhing / zla bar longs na/ tshes zhag shugs che bas nyin zhag sum cu song ma song la ma ltos par/ zla ba nya ba nas nya ba'i bar la zla ba longs bar ngos 'dzin/ lo ru longs na khyim zhag shugs che bas/ don gyis lo gcig la khyim zhag sum brgya dang drug cu las med pas so/ /tshul de ltar mkhas pa yongs la grags kyang / zhag gsum gyi rnam par dbye ba'i don la zhib tu dpyad tshe zhag gsum kyi lnga bsdus mi 'dra ba ri mos gtan la 'bebs nus na'ang lugs gzhan gnyis kyi lag len byas pas/ rigs pa'i rnam grangs tsam las dgongs don lhag po mi 'byung ba'i phyir na/ da lta'i lag rtsis su byed pa 'di dag sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis tshes zhag gi lnga bsdus su mdzad pa yin pas/ res gza' tshes longs la ltos bar lung rigs kyis sgrub nus shing / smon 'gro paṇ+ḍi ta dang gtsang 'dar stod kyi rig byed pa dgra 'dul don grub rdo rje sogs mkhas pa mang po zhal mthun par snang ngo / /'on kyang (16ba)da lta lag len du byed mkhan shin tu nyung bas phyogs 'di la ro 'dzin g.yo bar nus pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis legs bshad kyis zur brgyan par 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten na yongs su grags pa'i lo gcig la zhag sum brgya drug cur bshad pa'ang spyir btang ste/tshes longs thung ba rnams bstud mar byung tshe/ tshes zhag gi chu tshod nga bzhi tsam des/ nyin zhag drug cu ma thub par/ nyin gcig pu der tshes snga ma'i chu tshod nas kyang gcig gnyis mar 'phyugs/ phyi ma'i chu tshod nas kyang gnyis gsum yar 'phyugs pas na tshes zhag gsum gyi ngo mthong bas chu tshod bar pa lnga bcu nga bzhi tsam pa de don du mi chad kyang / dngos bstan la da nangs snga gro ni kho ma sleb/ sang snga dro ni —421 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)kho rdzogs zin pas ma mthong ngo / /dper na tshes gcig la gza' nyi mar chu tshod gnyis/ tshes gnyis la nyi ma bldabs nas chu tshod nga brgyad tsam 'dug na tshes gcig gi tshes longs nga brgyad gnam stong la rdzogs zin/ tshes gnyis nas tshes longs gnyis tsam las tshes gcig la dngos su ma phan pas tshes gcig gi zhag nang der chu tshod nga bzhi yod pa'i tshes gcig rdzogs pa don gyis 'thob cing dngos bstan tshes gcig chad kyang don la tshes gnyis chad par ngos 'dzin pa lta bu'o/ /don dril na bshad ma thag pas dper mtshon te/ snga tshes kyi gza' nyi mas bdag byas pa'i nyin zhag de la tshes longs bzhi las lhag pa ma byung la/ phyi tshes la gza' gsar pa'i ngo ma mthong zhing tshes zhag 'og ma'i ngo'ang mthong bas tshes gnyis kyi tshes longs rnams tshes gcig gi khongs su bsdu dgos shing / ma bsdus na tshes longs bzhi las med pa'i tshes zhag gcig khas len dgos par 'gyur la/ de lta bu mi srid pas so/ /tshes lhag pa'i dus tshes longs drug cu rtsa bzhi tsam pa mang ba bsdud (17na)pas nyin zhag gi tshes zhag ma thub par/ tshes longs drug cu rtsa bzhi po'i drug cus nyin zhag rdzogs nas lhag ma bzhi pos/ nyi ma snga phyi gnyis gar chu tshod gnyis re tsam don gyis thob pas na tshes zhag gcig la nyin zhag gsum gyi don med pas/ dper na tshes gcig la res gza' nyi ma la chu tshod nga brgyad/ rkang pa'i longs spyod rnams nor gyi dbang gis tshu tshod 'khor lor longs pas gza' mchongs te tshes gnyis la res gza' mig dmar la tshu tshod gsum tsam yod na/ tshes gcig gi longs spyod kyi steng nas chu tshod gnyis yar 'tshangs te gnam gang gi ngo thong / chu tshod gsum bzhi tsam tshes gnyis kyi snga dro bsdad pas tshes longs drug cu re bzhi yod pa'i tshes de snga dro lan gnyis byung bas tshes gnyis lhag por 'don pa lta bu'o/ /don dril na snga tshes kyi gza'i chu tshod nga brgyad longs spyod rgyu yod pa'i steng du/ phyi tshes kyi longs spyod bdun yang byung bas na tshes zhag gcig la chu tshod brgya dang bco lnga tsam khas len dgos shing / de 'dra mi srid pas phyi tshes kyi khongs nas tshes lhag por bton pa yin no/ /chad lhag gi skabs tshes zhag gcig gis nyin zhag gsum gyi ngo mthong ba dang / nyin zhag —422

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ 95)gcig gis tshes zhag gsum gyi ngo mthong ba'i khyab pa rnam pa kun tu khas len mi dgos te/ pad dkar zhal lung du/ nyin zhag gcig gis tshes zhag gsum gyi ngo mthong ba'am/ ma mthong yang 'dra'o//nyin zhag gcig gis tshes zhag ril po gcig dang / tshes zhag 'og ma'i yang ngo mthong ba nam byung ba'i tshe/ chad par snang ba 'byung la/ zhes sogs gsungs pas mtshon no/ /don la chad lhag byung ba ni min te/ chad pa'i tshe tshes bco lnga la zla ba'i cha ma rdzogs par nag khyur pa'ang med cing / lhag pa'i(17ba)tshe zla ba'i cha zlum po la phyogs gcig 'bur mor yang mi 'byung bas so/ /de ltar tshes zhag dang nyin zhag gnyis phan tshun gcig gis gcig gi dod ma thub par lo re la tshes chad pa bcu gnyis tsam dang lhag pa drug tsam byung ba/ chad lhag phan tshun mgo bsdebs pa'i lhag ma rnams kyi nus pas/ 'jig rten yongs grags kyi lo gcig nyin zhag sum brgya dang nga bzhi las mi 'ong ba mngon sum gyis grub pas/ chad lhag 'byung ba zla ba'i 'phel grib la brten nas tshes zhag gi nus pa yin pa rgyu mtshan du byas te/ nyin zhag la chad lhag gtan nas ma brtsis na lor longs pa'i tshe tshes bco lngar sleb dus tshes brgyad dgu tsam gyi ming 'dogs dgos pa rgan mo zhig gis chad lhag ma brtsis pas nyer dgu la bco lnga'i zla ba shar pa'i dpe 'dir 'ong ngo / /rgyu mtshan des na tshes zhag sum brgya don gcig gi steng nas tshes zla bcu gnyis la sum brgya drug cur longs pa'i tshe/ lhag ma tshes zhag dang khyim zhag gi bar khyad kyi nus pas thon pa tshes zhag bcu gcig tshu tshod bzhi/ chu srang so drug/dbugs lnga/ 'dod cha bdun rnams lus shing / ba lang rdzi yan gyis shes pa'i nyin zhag sum brgya re lnga'i steng nas tshes zhag dang nyin zhag gi bar khyad/ chu srang nga bdun/ dbugs gcig /'dod cha bzhi/cha shas sum brgya re drug byung ba la brten nas/ zhag mi thub tshes zhag lnga rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i dbang gis/ zhag sum brgya nga lnga/ chu tshod bcu gcig /chu srang so bdun/ dbugs gnyis/ 'dod cha lnga/ cha shas brgya nyer gcig las mi 'gro la/ lhag ma nyin zhag lnga rjes 'brang dang bcas pa dang tshes dkyil dang nyi dkyil gyi bar khyad/ tshes zhag lnga/ chu tshod zhe brgyad/ chu srang nyer gnyis/ dbugs 423

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)gsum/ 'dod cha bdun/ (18na)ri mkha' ri'i cha lnga brgya gya drug dang bcas pa mi rdzogs shing / tshes zhag lhag po bcu gcig rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lhag po bcu gcig dang dod snyoms pa'i nyin zhag gi dbang du byas te rtsi na/ drug cu re lnga pa'i lnga po dang / bar khyad nyin zhag du btang ba'i zhag lnga/ chu tshod zhe gnyis/ chu srang nga lnga/ dbugs gsum/ 'dod cha gnyis/ ri mkha' ri'i cha lnga brgya dang nyer gcig /ri ro'i cha lnga bcu nga drug rnams 'byung / drug cu re lnga'i lnga rjes 'brang dang bcas pa dang bar khyad bton pa'i lnga rjes 'brang dang bcas pa bsdoms pas nyin zhag bcu/ chu tshod nga dgu /chu srang dgu /dbugs lnga/ 'dod cha gcig /ri mkha' ri'i cha drug brgya zhe gnyis/ ri ro'i cha nga drug rnamasa'ong ngo / khyim zhag gi sum brgya drug cu nas khyim zhag gi dbang du btang ba'i zhag bcu/ chu tshod zhe bzhi/chu srang zhe drug /dbugs gsum/ 'dod cha lnga/ ri mkha' ri'i cha shas bcu drug ma rdzogs pas don gyis lo rdzogs pa la khyim zhag rdzogs dgos so/ /rje 'phrin las pas 'bras rtsis rin chen 'phreng bar/ nyi tshes dus tshod la dbang ba'i/ /sa bdag 'bras bu bstan pa yi/ /zhes pa ltar na/ da lta nyin zhag re la dbang bar khas len pa'i sa bdag rnams tshes longs la ltos dgos mi dgos dpyad par ma bzod pas blo ldan gyis nag rtsis kyi khungs ma rnams la zhib tu bltas te mtha' chod pa bya bar rigs so/ /mkhas blun mang pos chad tshe snga ma chad/ lhag tshe phyi ma lhag par bshad pa ni lung rigs kyi sgrub byed ga la yod/ zhal lung du/ lta ba 'og ma mngon par chen pa'i khrigs nges rnam pa thams cad dgos pa'i 'thad pa mi snang la/ 'on kyang tha snyad skyong bde ba la tshul 'di mi legs (18ba)te/rgyu mtshan ni gong du bshad pa'i rang lugs kyis shes so/ /zhes pa ltar/ chu tshod mang ba'i tshes 'chad cing nyung ba'i tshes lhag pa ni legs la/ khyad par rtsis skar nag sgo bstun pa'i tshe chad lhag gi snga phyi'i dus nges can du ma byung na sa bdag 'phyugs pa'i nyes pa 'byung bar mngon no/ /mkhas pa dag gis gza' 'das par gsungs pa dang / la la dag 'das pa dang ma 'das pa'i cha sna tshogs yong par 'chad pa la/ lugs phyi ma ni mi 'thad par rtogs pa sla ba lugs snga ma la —424

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)dus bzhi chen po'i rjes su dbyid 'bring gnam stong gi rtsis byas par/ gza' nyi shu rtsa dgu dang chu tshod sum cu sogs bshad pas gza' nyer dgu pa de 'das nas dngos bstan gza' sum cu par khas ma blangs na/ lo gcig la gza' sum brgya drug cu rtsa lnga mi 'byung ba'i skyon yod pa'i gnod byed dang /thig la shar ba na gza'i 'khor lo longs nas dor pa ma yin par thal te/ da dung gza' spen pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / der ma zad stong gzugs ma yin pa'i mngon sum gyis grub pa/ nas khal gcig dang bre bco lnga lta bur/ khal gcig pu de 'das zin nas bre bco lnga'i steng du bre lnga bsnan na khal gnyis par 'gyur pa'i rigs pa sogs rnam grangs mang na'ang / don gyi snying po gza' da ltar bar khas len dgos te/ gcig shar na nyi mar khas len dgos pas so/ /rgyu mtshan/ 'grel chen las/ dris pa'i dbyangs kyi skabs su/ bdun gyi cha'i lhag ma ni gza'i cha lhag ma ste/ zla ba ste gza' gcig pa la gnas pa dang / me ste gza' gsum pa la gnas pa dang / mda' ste gza' lnga pa la gnas pa dang / ri bo ste gza' bdun pa la lhag ma gnas par gyur na mi rnams la grub pa yod pa ma yin te/nyi ma dang / bkra shis dang / phur bu (19na)dang / spen pa ste mi mnyam pa rnams la'o/ /mig ste gza' gnyis pa dang / rig byed de gza' bzhi pa dang / ro ste drug pa la bya ba 'grub par gyur ro shin tu mnyam pa'i gnas su gyur pa zla ba dang / gza' lag pa dang / pa wa sangs rnams la lhag ma gnas par gyur na'o/ /zhes/ bdun gyis bgos pa'i lhag ma gcig nyi ma yin pa sogs rdo rje'i tshig 'di la klan ka mi 'jug pas so/ /gzhan yang da lta lnga bsdus la gza' skar nyi ma sbyor byed ces yan lag lngar bshad pa'i yan lag gcig ma tshang ba'i skyon du gyur te/ dngos su shar ba'i gza' de 'das zin pas gza' ma tshang ba'i skyon yod do/ /bshol gyi rnam gzhag la/ dbugs bskol/ zhag bshol/ zla bskol/ lo bshol sogs rigs pas dpyad na rnams grangs mang por 'gyur/ 'gyur tshul 'jig rten khams ler/ stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig ro brgya ldan pa dag las so yi cha yis nges par phyung gyur pa/ lus la dbugs —425

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)lhag gang dag nyin zhag so so'i dus su 'byung ba ri dang dus rnams dag gi grangs/ stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug dag gis bsgyur ba rnams kyang lo brgya'i tshad du rab tu grags pa ste/ stong dus me yis rab tu phye ba rnams ni chu tshod du 'gyur drug cu'i cha yis nyin zhag kyang / zhes rgyur tshig gis bzhol gyi rnam gzhag 'di tsam las gzhan gsal bar bstan pa med cing / rje 'phrin las zhabs kyis/ dbugs 'byung 'dug dang bar ma ste/ de la dbugs gcig ces grags pa'i/ zhes pa ltar/ dbugs 'byung 'jug gnas gsum du byas pa'i dbugs sum cu na rags rtsis kyi dbugs bshol 'thon/ sum cu so gnyis na 'bring por brtsis pa'i bshel 'thon/ phyed bcas so gnyis na shin tu zhib pa'i bsgol 'thon (19ba)par 'gyur la/ la la rags pa zla ba'i ye shes kyi cha/ 'bring nyi ma'i ye shes kyi cha/ phra ba sgra gcan gyi ye shes kyi char 'dod/ 'ga' zhig zla ba rang la rags 'bring phra gsum gyi ye shes kyi char bshad pa'ang byed do/ /rgyud kyi skabs 'dir stong phrag nyi shu la khri tsho gnyis/ rtsa gcig gi gcig pus stong phrag gcigaro brgyas drug brgya bstan pas zhag gcig la dbugs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya byung ba la/ so ni sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi mngon rjod yin pas/ rags 'bring zhib gsum gyi nang nas 'bring po'i dbang du btang ba yin/ de bzhin du/ zhag /zla ba/ lo rnams la phra rags kyi dbang gis sum cu dang / soganyis dang /phyed so gnyis kyi rnam gzhag byar yod pa las dbugs bshol bton na ha cang thag nye grags/ zhag bskol ni chad lhag gi dbang gis ji bzhin 'don par mi nus/ lo bsgol ni thag ha cang rings pas nyes pa du ma 'byung ba'i phyir ring thung 'tsham pa zla ba la bskol mdzad pa yin no/ /de yang / tshes zhag sum cu'i dus nyi mas khyim nas 'pho ma nus pa'i dbang gis tshes zla phyed bcas so gsum nas bshol dgos te/ 'grel chen las/ 'dir zla ba phyed dang bcas pa'i sum cu gnyis na lhag pa'i zla bar 'gyur te/ gnam stong la nyi ma'i 'pho ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na longs spyod par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes 'byung la/ de yang phyi ru zla ba phyed dang so gsum/ nang du 'pho rlung sum cu so phyed dang gsum —426

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (5)gsum na ye shes kyi rlung re re yod pas 'pho rlung steng nas chad pa bsags pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis kyang shes dgos so/ /cha shas dang 'dod cha la grangs mang nyung mtha' gcig tu nges pa med pas na/ bcu gsum dang / ri mkha' ri dang / ri ro dang / bu mkha' mig bug yid sogs 'khor lo shin tu rnam grangs mang bas/ rtsis gsar ba rnams 'khor lo'i (20na) dbang gis cha shas la mang nyung yod dam snyam pa'i the tshom gyi dra bar tshud na'ang / 'di la nyin zhag mang por bsam blo btang ba'i dka' thub kyi ngal ba sten mi dgos te/ dper na/ nad kyi phung po gcig 'jal byed kyi bre 'bo sna tshogs yod pa lta bu'o/ /'on kyang / ri mkha' ris bsgyur ba'i cha shas bcu bzhi lta bus bgos pa ni min no/ /de ltar gza' lta bu mtshon na/ zhag gcig la cha shas bye ba gcig /sa ya lnga/ 'bum tsho gnyis/ /khri tsho bdun/stong dang nyis brgya yod pa de ri mkha' ri'i 'khor lo'i ngo skal gyi thob nor rer dbugs gcig /dbugs drug tu longs pa na chu srang gcig /chu srang drug cur longs pa na chu tshod gcig /chu tshod drug cu longs pa na zhag gcig /zhag sum cur longs pa na zla ba gcig /zla ba bcu gnyis su longs pa na lo gcig /de lta bu'i lo ji tsam rigs pa 'das lor bzhag nas zla dag sgrub dgos pas/ khams le/me mkha' rgya mtsho rnams la rab byung la sogs 'das pa rnams bsres kla klo'i lo ni rab tu grub/ kla klo'i dbang po'i lo ni lag pa gdangs can zla bas dman pa'i lhag ma dag kyang nyi mas bsgyur/ nag pa la sogs zla ba bsres te 'og tu dus kyis bsgyur ba mkha' me zla bas rnam par dbye/ rnyed pa steng du bsres pa dag ni mi yi bdag po zla ba'i tshogs pa rnam par dag par 'gyur/ zhes byung bas/ me mkha' rgya mtsho la 'das lo 'chol pa'am/ yang na/ rab byung re re zhes rtsis gzhi spo ba sogs gang byed kyang 'das lo de gnas gnyis su bzhag pa'i gong ma nyi mas bsgyur te zla bar gsil ba de la/ mkhas rlom 'ga' zhig gis/ zla ba'i tshogs de tshes zla yin zhes smra ba ni shin tu mi rigs te/ tshes zhag la tshes zhag gis bsgol 'don mi (20ba) thub pa'i phyir na/ gnas gnyis su bzhag pa'i 'og ma'i cho ga rnams byed mi dgos par 'gyur ro/ /zer rgyus phongs pa gcig gis/ 'das zla de la khyim zla dang —427

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)tshes zla ci rigs/ su yod zer ba ni/ glang la mdzub mo btsugs nas 'di la ba dang glang ci rigs su yod zer ba dang khyad par ci yod/ mkhas grub ṭika chen du/ de dag khyim zla dang tshes zla gang yang min gyi/ so sor ma phye ba'i zla ba'i phung po yin no/ /zhes dam bca' ba ni/ nas phung la 'di ni nas dang rtsam pa gang yang ma yin gyi/ so sor ma phye ba'i zas kyi phung po yin no zer ba dang 'dra bas/ mchog 'di la byang pa'i mkhas pa rnams dga' ba bskyed pa'i gnas ma yin no/ /des na bshad ma thag pa'i zla ba de khyim zla'i phung po yin la/ bgos byed phyed bcas so gnyis po srid pa'i don du bzhis bsgyur nas mkha' me zla bar btang / de dang gshed mtshungs par bya ba'i phyir khyim lo rnams gnas gnyis su bzhag pa'i 'og ma bzhis bsgyur ste/ brgya sum cus bgos pa'i thob nor rnams ni sngar rtsis gzhi spos pa nas bzung ste zla bshol byung ba'i grangs yin la/ de gnas steng mar byin pas khyim zla de tshes zlar song ba yin no/ /da lta lag rtsis su/ 'og ma mig bsgyur rtsis 'phros brgyan/ /mda' ros thog pa steng du sbyin/ /zhes pa dang gong gi rgyud tshig gnyis cung zad ma thun pa la/ mkhas pa ye bzang rtse pas/ thog ma
