bzhes bsgyur ba'i rgyu mtshan mkha' me zla bas bgos pa'i lhag ma la rten nas dhu ba 'tshol ba'i ched yin gsung par rgyu mtshan che ba med de/ zla ro'i lhag mas kyang dhu ba 'tshol thub pas so/ /des na rgyud du bzhis bsgyur ba rgya dpe la sdeb sbyor 'grig pa'i dbang gis yin zhes shong pang bu sogs tshad thub gyi mkhas (21na)pa rnams gsung pa legs so/ /rje stag tshang pas/ cha shas phra mo 'i kha tu rtsi na cung zad yod kyang rtsis kyi grub mtha' dang byed pa gang la'ang phan gnod byed mi nus pas mdzub mo tsha ba 'bras bur zad de/ zhes gsung pa lo 'ga' zhig gi ring cha shas ma brtsis kyang chu tshod yan lag la nyes pa skyed mi nus pa sogs la dgongs nas byed rtsis kyi rjes su 'brangs par mngon te/ byed rtsis la byed rtsis dang byed rtsis rnam dag gnyis su grags pa'i snga ma ni/ khams ler/ tshes rnams sbyin dang dor dang slar yang sbyin pa dag ni gza' dang chu tshod rkang pa rnams su ste/ tshogs kyi cha la chu gter zla —428—

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)bas mnyam dang mi mnyam thob pa dag la sbyin dor rkang pa'i don/ zhes skabs 'dir tshes rtsis dang gong du sgru ba thams cad gnas gnyis su mdzad nas/ bya sla ba dang / mu stegs rnams gdul ba'i don du de dag gi byed pa dang mthun par bstan pa yin zhing / mu stegs kyi byed pa de'ang thog ma nyid nas ma dag pa ma yin yang / bar skabs su slob dpon 'ga' zhig gis chos la dpe mkhyud kyi dbang gis gab drags pas man ngag gi rgyun nyams zhes mkhas pa rnams 'chad do/ /phyi ma byed rtsis rnam dag tu grags pa ni deng sang rtsis pa mtha' dag lag len du byed pa'i gnas lnga ma de yin na'ang / gza'i skabs su zhag re la cha shas bcu drug gis chad pa bsags pas lo nyis brgya nyer gcig na chu tshod lnga tsam chad pa'i nyes pa 'byung zhing / nyi ma la zhag rer cha shas zhe bzhis ma nges pa'i lhag po bsags pas/ lo nyis brgya nyer gcig na chu tshod brgyad tsam gyis mangs ba'i skyon yod pas/ cha shas phra mo tshun chad kyi skyon dang bral bar brtsis (21ba) pa'i grub pa'i mtha' 'di nyid yid ches kyi gnas yin no/ /rgyu mtshan des na/ bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bla dpon zung du 'jug pa gnam bskos kyi rgyal po dpal phag mo gru pa'i bla rtsis pa chen po phug nas chos rje 'phrin las pa dang / de'i dngos slob pa rnams kyi le'u thor/ gza' 'dzin sogs kyi skabs/ byed rtsis kyi ri mo cung zad ma gtogs/ rgyun gyi gza' skar mtha' dag grub rtsis kho na la brten 'dug na'ang / deng sang ni phug lugs pa'i rjes 'brang rnams kyang mon pa hre pas gsung rab la zhus dag byas pa'i dpe ltar byed mkhan mang ba rtags su bkod nas byed rtsis kyi zla skar sogs lung ston par snang mod/ gzur gnas kyi blo ldan zhig gis brtags na nyi dag gi cha shas ma dag pa'i dbang gis nyi skar 'phyugs la/ de la brtan nas zla ba'i skar ma'ang skar ma re re sngon du 'gro ba 'di ma dag pa rigs pas 'grub pas/ zla skar yang grub pa'i mtha' la brten par rigs so/ /dpal 'chi med bde bas/ phug lugs la grub rtsis kyi zla skar 'das par byed ces gsungs pa'i rgyun ltar na/ byed rtsis dang skar ma mthun pa 'ong rgyur snang yang / bla rtsis gar dbang ba sogs phal cher/ skar ma da ltar bar —429

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)mdzad la/ mig skar dang bstun tshe mtshan mo byed rtsis dang mthun pas/ nyin mo grub rtsis kyi zla skar da ltar ba dang 'grig par rjes su dpag nus pas na/ da lta lag len du de ltar byed na'ang / lugs mi 'dra bar gsung ba po gnyis ka rjes 'phrin las zhabs kyi dngos slob yin pas/ cung zad the tshom gyi gzhi 'dug par/ blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis dpyad par 'tshal lo/ /de ltar rtsis kyi dka' gnas kyi 'phros don la sngon gyi mkhas pa chen po kun gyi tshad ma'i (22na)gnas su gyur pa shong pang bu gsum/ phyis kyi mkhas pa stag tshang lo chen/ zha lu lo chen rnams dang / la lar legs par bshad cing 'ga' zhig tu nyes bshad sna tshob/sa kyang yod pa'i sngon gyi mkhas pa jo bo nang kun mkhyen dol po ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs/ phyis kyi mkhas pa ye bzang rtse pa/byang pa rigs ldan rnam rgyal grags bzang / mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang / paṇa chen byams pa gling pa/ khrus khang lo tsā ba/ ga me pa mi bskyod rdo rje/ 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa pad+ma dkar po sogs dus zhabs chen por zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams kyi yig cha dang gsung rgyun rnams la 'thad mi 'thad kyi dpyad pa blo dman bdag 'dras rang blo'i stobs kyis bya bar ga la nus/ 'on kyang zung 'jug sgyu ma'i gar mkhan dus zhabs pa chen po mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas dang /dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi shing rta pa chen po lhun grub rgya mtsho gnyis kyi legs bshad la brten nas cung zad spro bar nus na'ang / ha cang yi ge mangs pas 'jigs pa dang / dngos med kyi don rgyas bshad kyi khongs su 'thor dogs pas re zhig btang snyoms su gzhag ste dris lan gyi don snying por dril na/ deng sang gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir rtsis rigs smra ba mang por tshogs pa'i so so'i lugs la brtags tshe 'gos lo sogs mang pos zla bshol rags pa tsam 'thon rtsis kyi zla ba sum cu ma longs pa nas bskol bar bshad pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas lung ston pa thams cad ma ni'i zlas lung sbyor dngos rjes tshang tsam yang mi shes pa'i mthong thos dran reg tu grags pa'i bla chen gyi skyabs gnas dang 'dra bas (22ba los pa mngon sum byed bzhin du/ g.yo can tshig gis pha rol slu/ /lha chen smre sngags shor ba —43(lha

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)la/ /sdug bsngal bden pa bsgrags so lo/ /zhes pa'i don thog tu babs par snang / chag lo rin chen chos rgyal gyis/ rab byung shing pho byi ba nas/ /sa pho 'brug gis thar thug par/ /lo ni drug cu rtsa lnga'i bar/ /zla ba bdun brgya brgyad cu la/ /zla ba phyed bcas so gnyis na/ /zla bshol re re 'byung ba'i phyir/ /zla bskol nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o/ /zhes pa'ang rab byung me yos la sbyor rgyu shing byir sbyar bas nor zhing bshol yang rags rtsis so/ /'ga' zhig zla dag 'phar ba'i tshe zla ba phyi ma 'don zer ba ni lca rlon par yod pa rgyu mtshan du byas pa 'dra/ la la dag dbus nas bshol pa dang mtha' nas bshol ba'i don ma go bar/ mda' ro'i lhag mar gcig byung tshe ngo thog 'don pa dang / thig shar tshe zla ba rting ma 'don zer ba yang mun nag gi 'dom 'jal te/ zla dag 'phar nas kyang zla ba ma bton na nyi ma shar zin nas da dung nam ma langs zer ba dang 'dra'o/ /byed rtsis pa kha cig gis gsang ba'i man ngag yin zer nas zla dag 'phar nas brtsis pa'i bdun zur gyi steng du bshol 'don pa rig pa'i rtsal gyis 'thon pa mi 'dug na'ang / 'a zha bos pas bla g.yu'i mngon shes ltar stabs rang 'grig tu song nas mkhas pa'i phyag len dang 'grig par gda'/mkhas rlom kha cig khyim lo phyed bcas so gnyis nas tshes lo re re 'phar bas mthar lo bskol 'ong zer ba ni shin tu ma brtags pa sde/ khyim zla phyed bcas so gnyis kyi dus zla bshol ma bton na zla ba sum brgya dang brgyad cu gya bzhi la lo bskol thon 'ong / de ltar byas na zla ba brgya dang so gnyis tsam na ston gyi dus (23na)su shing rtsi kha 'bus shing dgun gyi tshe chu bo bsgang rgyas 'ong pa'i phyir dus tshigs thams cad 'phyugs 'gro la/ zla ba phyed bcas so gnyis nas bshol bton pas tshes zhag lhag po chu rang sar sim pa ltar lo bshol rgyu med do/ /de ltar bshad ma thag pa'i rang bzo dang yig hrul 'ga' zhig la blo bkal te smra ba de dag ni chu shing ltar snying po med par mthong la/ mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes khungs dang 'grel ba ni 'di lta ste/dngos bstan rgyud kyi dgongs pa gong du bshad pa ltar/ /so yi cha yis nges par phyung gyur pa/ /zhes —43/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)pa'i tshig gi nus pa dngos bstan so gnyis yin yang / zhib par phyed bcas so gnyis su byas pa so gnyis gnyis kyis bsgyur bas drug cu re bzhir song / phyed po de gnyis kyis bsgyur nas bsres pas mda' ror song ba des bgos pa'i nor steng mar byin pas khyim lo phyed bcas so gnyis kyi tshe zla dag grangs mchongs pa na chad pa'i grangs de bsab dgos pas zla bsgol 'thon pa yin no/ /lugs 'di'i rjes su 'brang ba'i mkhas pa shin tu mang zhing / khyad par smon 'gro paṇ+ḍita tshe dbang don grub dang / rig byed mkhan po mdar pa dgra 'dul don grub rdo rje gnyis kyi drung du dkar nag rtsis kyi zab gnad mtha' dag la legs par sbyangs pa'i gtsug lag 'dzin pa gzhon nu skal bzang las kho bos pad+ma dkar po'i zhal lung gi dgongs pa'i gnad rnams zhib mor thos shing dpyad pa'i tshe/ bshol yang zla 'phar dang bstun pa'i rgyud don 'phyug med smon mdar sogs mkhas pa tshad thub rnams kyi phyag len du mdzad tshul gyi rgyu mtshan la nges shes rnyed pas na/ phyag len 'di nyid grong rtsis pa 'dras rang bzo byas pa ma yin pa'i yid (23ba)ches kyi gnas su nges pa rnyed do/ /de ltar na lugs 'di dang mi mthun pa rnams tshad ma ma yin nam snyam pa'i log rtog ni byed mi dgos te/ rgyud kyi dngos bstan byed pa'i rtsis yin la de las grub pa'i rtsis nyid rnam par dag pas so/ /ga skun yang mkhas pa mgu ba skyed pa'i lugs gcig la/ grags pa don ldan gyi mkhas sdo/ba chen po nor bzang rgya mtsho'i bzhed pa nyi ldog 'khor lor grags pa/ lo grangs bdun brgya dang brgyad cu'i 'khor lo ngo mtshar can ri mo'i sgo nas sgrub tshul/ de la gsal byed srong btsan gdung gis mtho zhing gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha mthar son pa lha btsun bsod nams dpal bzang gis mdzad pa yod la/'khor lo'i re'u mig phyi nang bzhi rim du yod pa'i nang mar rgya gar gyi nyi ldog /de'i phyi mar lo bdag/de'i phyi mar bod kyi nyi ldog /de'i g.yon du bcu gcig gam bcu gnyis 'god pa nyi ldog gi zla ba ston byed/ de'i phyi ma zla bshol mtha' dbus gang nas 'thon rnams gsal bar bkod do/ /lugs 'di dang grub rtsis kyi zla dag 'phar ba'i snga ma 'don pa gnyis gung 'grig pas/ lha btsun rin po che'i —432

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (5)gsung las/ des na gnad kyi snying po ni/ /khyim zla gnas gnyis bzhag pa yi/ /'og ma mig bsgyur rtsis lo bsre/ /mda' ros thob pa steng du sbyin/ /steng du gnyis 'phar byung ba'i tshe/ /rang gis brtsis pa'i zla ba lhag /de yang lhag mar gcig byung tshe/ /zla bshol zla ba'i dbus dang ni/ /thig le shar tshe mtha' nas bskol/ /de yang lo grangs bdun brgya dang / /brgyad cu'i nyi ldog zla bskol gyi/ /khra ma gzigs pas mngon sum 'grub/ /ces gsungs so/ /zla ba snga ma la bshol thon zin pa'i nus pas zla ba rting ma la zla dag 'phar ba yin zhing / mda' ro'i lhag mar gcig byung ba na zla dag (24na)'phar ba'i zla ba de shar tshe zla bshol byung nas zla ba phyed song ba yin la/ mda' ro'i lhag mar thig shar tshe zla bskol rdzogs pa dang zla dag 'phar ba'i zla ba de shar ba dus mnyam pa'i don yin no/ /gzhan yang 'das zla sre pa'i skabs zla dag 'phar ba'i ngo thog gi zla ba de mi sre bas kyang zla ba gong ma bshol ba'i sgrub byed bla na med pa'o/ /da lta'i rtsis rig phal cher dang / 'jig rten rgan po tshod can gyi khur 'dzin thams cad mgrin gcig tu phyed bshol yod ces gleng ba'i zhe phugs la phyed zla 'thon dus zhag bco lnga tsam zhig rang 'thon pa'i nyams shar nas/ da lo'i snga phyi'i babs gang la bltas kyang zla ba hril po'i yun tsam 'thon pa mi 'dug zer mod/ de dag ni log rtog gis btags pa'i gtam/ bka' brgyud pa'i bla ma zhig gis spang bya gong mo/ blang bya bya bon/ dgag bya pho rog yin zer ba dang 'dra bas dgag bsgrub kyi yul min la/ phyed bskol zhes pa dper na/ sa ga zla ba la bsgol 'thon tshe zla ba hril por bton na/mda' dus hor zla lnga pa'i bsgang / /thag ma dus mar snye ma 'thon/ /rang cag gnas pa'i sa 'dir ni/ /dbyar gyi nyi ma ldog pa'i dus/ /'di yi shar nub sa yi khyon/ /tha dad gyur na shing grib kyis/ /brtags te ldog tshul tha dad smra/ /zhes sogs zla ba lnga pa'i nang du 'char rgyu'i thag ma dus mar snye ma 'thon pa sogs dus kyi snang tshul rnams zla ba bzhi par yar 'phyugs ches na/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu drug nas gnam gang gi bar tshes gcig dang / snron zla ba'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar tshar —433

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)gcig 'theb la bton na/ dus kyi snga phyi'i babs nas 'grig pa'i dbang du mdzad pa yin yang /dngos su 'don mi thub ste/ de ltar byas na gnam gang la zla ba nya zhing / tshes bcu bzhi la dgu zhal yod pa zhig gnag (24ba)rdzi rgan po yan chad kyis mngon sum du mthong nas smod pa'i yul du 'gyur zhing / 'jig rten gyi grags tshod 'gog mi nus pas/ don gyis 'thob kyang lag len du byed mi rung ngo / /rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa phug lugs kyi phyag bzhes ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar zhag gsum gyi rnam gzhag gi don dril na/ zhag gsum so so'i grangs la mang nyung yod kyang don du tshes zhag sum brgya don gcig dang / khyim zhag sum brgya drug cu gnyis yun tshad snyoms pa'i rgyu mtshan/dper na/ re kha yug ring thung snyoms pa gnyis steng 'og tu bris pa'i re kha steng mar ri'u mig zheng che ba bcu gnyis dang / 'og mar ri'u mig zheng chung ba bcu gsum byas na ri'u mig gi grangs la khyad yod na'ang / mtha'i tshad la ring thung med par snyoms 'gro ba ltar/ khyim zla phyed dang so gnyis kyi tshe zla re re 'phar bas tshes zla phyed dang so gsum nas tshes zhag la nyi khyim ma rdzogs pa'i ring thung shor ba de'i nyes pa sel 'gro'o/ /de ltar zla ba so so'i dbugs zla ba lnga ma'i nyer brgyad tsam la thob/khyim ngo thog gi tshes lnga tsam la sleb/ bsgang tshes bcu drug tsam la 'ong dgos rgyu/ lo gcig la tshes zhag sum brgya drug cur byas pas nyi mas khyim 'pho ma nus par rim gyis phyi gros su lus pas ris la 'thon khar bsgang tshad gnam stong dang / bskol 'thon ma thog bsgang tshad tshes gcig gnyis la 'ong ba mngon sum du grub pas zla ba'i bsnang tshad phyi ma'i tshes gcig la shar dus snga ma bskol dgos te/ma bshol na mgo zla'i bsgang tshad rgyal zlar 'phos pa de'i tshe dgun nyi zla ba bcu gnyis pa la log 'gro bar khas len dgos pas dus mi 'gyur ba'i gzer mngon sum du 'phyug pa sogs gnod byed mi zad pa thog tu 'bab bo/ /gong du rje nor bzang (25na)pa'i lugs kyi nyi ldog 'khor lo'i gsal byed du/ da lta'i ri'u mig 'og ma yi/ /g.yon du drag po phal cher bkod/ /zla lhag yod tshe skabs 'ga' —434

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (5)sa /nyi ma 'god par mdzad pa ni/ /yul 'di'i dgun nyi ldog pa yi/ /zla ba'i ngos 'dzin yin par nges/ /zhes pa byung bas/ phug lugs kyi phyag len thun mong ma yin pa 'di las zla ba drug gi bshol 'phyi bas na/ dgun nyi zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bdun tsam la log pa zhig 'byung bas de la dgongs nas nyi ma bkod pa yin zhing / 'jig rten khams ler/ gang phyir ri la skye bo rnams kyi nyin mtshan mnyam par 'gyur te lug nyi srang gi nyi ma la'o/ /zhes nyin mtshan mnyam pa lug dang srang gis longs spyod pa'i skabs su bstan cing / de bzhin du bgrod pa mthar thug pa gnyis kyang ga rkaṭa dang /chu srin gyi khyim du bshad pas/ dbyar dgun gyi nyi ldog kyang hor zla drug pa dang bcu gnyis pa la 'byung ba'i phyir na/ gong du dus mi 'gyur ba'i gzer zhes bshad pa mi 'thad do snyam na/ 'dzam gling chung ngu 'di yongs su rdzogs pa'i nyi ma dus gcig la ldog na/ khams le'i dngos bstan dang mi mthun pa'i skyon 'di 'byung na'ang lho gling 'di'i khyon yongs su rdzogs par ma zad/ lho gling shar ma nas dbus drang thad kyi bar la nyi ldog sum cu lhag tsam 'byung bar thams cad mkhyen pa nor bzang rgya mtshos slob dpon a bha ya'i dus 'khor la 'jug pa'i khungs dang bcas te gsungs pas nyes pa des 'jug sku tho /de ltar rgyud nas gsungs pa'i bgrod pa gnyis dang mnyam pa gnyis sogs bstan pa thams cad lho gling dbus ma'i tshangs thig drang po la dgongs te gsungs la/ rjes 'jug gi mkhas pa rnams kyis de'i shugs las nyi ldog sum brgya drug cu 'byung ba'i tshul rtogs te/ rang cag (25ba)gnas pa'i bod kyi yul 'dir 'khrig pa dang gzhu'i khyim du nyi ma ldog par khas blangs pa yin no/ /'o na thams cad mkhyen pa nor bzang rgya mtshos/ 'das lo'i thog ma reb byung me yos lo drug cu skor bdun dang / lo rkyang nyi shu pa mi zad pa me pho khyi'i dgun nyi ldog dus la thur shing gis brtags pas/ lo de'i hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin thur shing gi grib ma byang nas log par mngon sum gyis mthong bas de'i sngon ma'i tshes bzhi de la rang cag rnams gnas pa'i sa khyon 'dir dgun nyi mdug par grub la/ zhes bka' stsal pa ltar na hong zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bzhi la dgun nyi ldog pa —435

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)zhig 'byung bas/ gong gi dam bca' de la gnod dam snyam na/ mi gnod de/ rgyud lugs kyi zla bshol zla dag 'phar ba'i dbang du btang zhing / lugs de dang phyogs mthun tsam du nyi ldog 'khor lo'i phyag len mdzad pas/ lugs de'i zla bskol 'thon pa nye ba'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang du nyi ldog gi ri mo shar ba yin la/ zla ba bcu gnyis la de ni bod kyi yul 'di kho na'i dbang du btang ba'i nyi ldog dang bstun pa'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa ma yin pas so/ /'di dag las 'phros pa'i dka' gnas kyi legs bshad ni rje nor bzang rgya mtshos mjad pa'i nyi ldog gsal sgron sogs las shes par bya'o/ /g.yin yang nyi mas 'dzam gling chung ngu 'dir ldog thengs gcig las mi 'ong zhing / de rgyud nas bshad pa dang mthun dgos pa yin na/ rgyud nas bshad pa'i dgun nyi ldog pa'i tshe lho phyogs rta gdong gi re/ ri la bcar te de nas phar cung zad tsam yang 'gro mi nus pa'i lho bgrod mthar thug pa yin pas/de'i dus las sa chu 'khyags shing grang ngar che ba med la/ da lta bod kyi yul 'dir nyi ma log nas zhag nyi shu rtsa bdun (26na) gyi bar dgu 'dren pa zhes nges par grang du 'gro ba kun la grags shing mngon sum gyis grub pas/ sa 'dir 'os pa'i zla bshol nyi ldog dus sbyor sogs rigs pa'i lam nas 'dren dgos pa mngon sum gyis grub pa lta bu'o/ /dper na/ nyi ma nam so'i chu tshod zhe lnga'i steng nas skyes pas/ khams ler/ dus kyi rgyu skar rkang pa gsum bcas bu lon dag ste nyi ma'i longs spyod dbus nas spyad par bya/ zhes/ drug dang zhe lngas skyes khyim sbyong bar bstan cing / nam so'i rkang pa gsum pa'i mtha' nas nyi ma skyes pa dang lho bgrod kyi 'go brtsams pa yin pas/ rtsis rig smra ba'i gtsug rgyan dpal mgon 'phrin las kyis thur shing gi grib mas zhib mor gtan la phab pa na/ bod yul 'dir skar ma lag gi rkang pa dang po'i chu tshod drug pa'i steng nas lho bgrod kyi mgo brtsams pa mngon sum gyis grub pas/ phyag len thun mong ma yin pa'i skyes khyim zla dus kyis sbyong ba'ang shes nus so/ /de bzhin du dus sbyor yang / gangs ldan/ kai la sha /rgya nag /li/ bod/ 'phags yul te yul drug tu dus sbyor mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis rje 'phrin las zhabs kyis/ de ltar dus sbyor sa gzhan —436

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)'byung po'i bya/ /'dir 'os rta ljang rgyal pos phyogs mthar dang / /ces dang / sngon med legs par bshad pa yi/ /sa 'dir 'os pa'i dus sbyor dag /ces rgya bal nas 'gyur ba'i dus sbyor gyi tshig zin tsam la ma brten par rig pa'i 'phrul bla na med pa mdzad do/ /bsnang tshad 'don lugs kyang phug lugs kyi rjes 'brang mang du snang bar/ kho bos zur chen 'khor lo'i mgon po'i drung du bla brtsis pa gar dbang phun tshogs nas brgyud pa'i skar rtsis mtha' chod par sbyangs shing / rjes su g.yu lo g.yul rgyal ba'i man ngag gnyag ban ngag dbang 'jam dpal blo gros las thos pa gnyis gar khyim 'pho dbugs thob (26ba)bsnang tshad gsum ga nyi bar la ngos 'dzin cing / phug nas lhun grub rgya mtsho dang dpal mgon 'phrin las gnyis ga'i bzhed par mdzad/de la 'dod cha dang 'dod cha'i lnga cha gnon lugs bla rtsis gar dbang ba'i man ngag sogs ngo mtshar ba khong du chud pa dang / chu rta g.yas ru gtsang gi rgyal khams myul bar phyin skabs bod yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po smon 'gro lo tsā ba rig gnas rgya mtsho'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa zhes sku yon du ma zad sku tshe'ang pha mthar brgal ba de las dka' gnas mang po'i zhun thar bcad tshe phug lugs la gsar rnying gnyis su yod pa'i zhal lung phug rnying pa dang / der mi gsal ba'i man ngag zur pa rnams dpal mgon 'phrin las pas gsal bar mdzad pa'i skor phug gsar ba yin zhes zab gnad 'di bla rtsis pa chen po 'phrin las zhabs kyi lugs su bzhed par 'dug pas kyang bshad ma thag pa'i lugs 'di khungs thub par snang / gzhan yang mkhas pa zur mkhar ba'i gsung las/ tshul 'di ltar na spur rgyal 'dar/ /gzhan kun la phyogs med gtong ba dang / /rang legs bshad 'tshol bar rlom na yang / /don sbyin len gnyis ka gser las dkon/ /zhes pa ltar/ rig pa'i gnas mang por sbyangs zer ba phrad tshad la dri ba du ma byed kyin yod pas/ phug lugs par khas 'che ba 'dra la rtsad bcad tshe la la khyim 'pho nyi bar dang g.yin gnyis nyi dag la byed zer ba dang / 'ga' zhig ni/ de yang skyes khyim zla dus kyi/ /sbyangs pa'i nyi dag skar dbyug tu/ /mkha' ro me shar gsan pa'i bsgang / /zhes sogs dngos bstan —437

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)la chen nas man ngag gab pa ma rtogs par mthong bas/ mkhas pa ji ltar thabs rdugs kyang / /blun po 'jug pa'i lam mi 'gro/ /char 'dod byi'u kha skom yang / /sa la 'bab pa'i chu mi 'thung / /zhes pa la bsams nas yid (27na ji rtan du ma bzung ngo / /dri ba gsum pa/rgya lugs kyi rtsis gzhung las skor 'go'i gtso che skye rme 'dzin pa la brgyad cu skor dang drug cu skor zhes lugs gnyis las gang zhig khungs dang ldan min gyi dris lan/dri ba gsum pa la/ gsum pa rgya nag rtsis kyi gzhud lugs 'di/ /snga 'gyur phyi 'gyur bar 'gyur yang 'gyur bzhi/ /bod du 'gyur ba rlung ltar grags mod kyi/ /skor 'go'i gtso che skye rme 'dzin pa la/ /brgyad cu skor dang drug cu skor zhes pa'i/ /bzhed lugs mi mthun gnyis su 'dug pa 'di/ /dgongs pa can nam snga phyi gang khas len/ /snga 'gyur bar 'gyur rgyud rnams gzhir bzhag pa'i/ /brgyad cu skor nyid dag par khas len na/ /'gyur yang snga ma rgyud kyang khungs thub nas/ /da lta rgyal ba shāka thub bstan pa la/ /rme 'phreng bar ma shing byi bzhi ljang nas/ /brgyad dkar bar gyi drug cu 'di nyid la/ /skye rme 'dzin pa 'brul med yin par gsungs/ /phyi 'gyur rin chen gsal sgron gzhir bzhag nas/ /drug cu skor nyid dag par khas len na/ /rtsis rgyud 'brul med rin chen kun 'dus las/ zheng byi gcig dkar nas gzung ste/ /chu phag gnyis nag bar dag tu/ /sam kha gsum gyi rme ba tshang / /'khor zhing 'khor ba ma rdzogs pa/ /lhag dang bcas pa 'byung mi srid/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang mkhas pa khyung nag gis/ bzhi nas brgyad kyi bar dag gi /rme ba gsum chad gang gis gso/ /zhes gsungs der ma zad de bka' thang nas/ dus gsum mkhyen pa pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /—438

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (5)bod rtsis drug cu skor zhes gsal sgron zhes/ /rtsis rgyud kun dang mi mthun dar bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa log pa'i rtsis gzhud gsungs pas/ 'di rnams rtsod pa gang gi sgo nas spong / zhes par/ gtsug lag khang gi rtsis gnyis su grags pa'i nag rtsis ni/ mkhas pa'i dbang po stag tshang lo tsā bas/ nag rtsis ni rgya nag nas byung ba 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis gsungs pa sa bdag (27ba)gi rigs brtags la shin tu nye bar mkho zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rig pa'i gnas mi chung ba zhig yin yang / deng sang 'jig rten rmongs pa'i grags tshod la/ lha gsol dang skar rtsis kho na byed mkhan la bon dkar ba dang / nag rtsis par bon nag gi ming 'dogs pa ni snga ma skar ma'i yig sdebs kyi sa mgo yod pa dang / kha dog gi dkar ba das 'phul sogs kyi brda tsam yang ma shes pas/ bka' rgyud pa phyogs kyi ngag bgros su na ro par rtsa bshad pa zhes pa'i don ma go bar a nan dang ro ru song zer ba dang 'dra bas dpyad bzod pa ga la yin te/ dam pa khros kyang btud na zhi/ /dman la btud na lhag par rengs/ /gser dngul sra yang bzhu nus kyi/ /khyi lud bzhu na dri ngan 'byung / /zhes pa ltar yin la/ nag rtsis zhes pa rgya nag po'i yul nas dar pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis nag rtsis su bshad pa ma gtogs shin dur gyi rtsis tsam zhig gi byed las dang bcas kha dog nag por bzhag pa'i don min pas rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyi thos bsam gyi yul yin no/ /de yang 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rgya dang rgya nag che nyid las/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs ni rab tu grub/ /ces dang / de yi yul na 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /byis pa ga tho ne nu'i tshul gyis ni/ /mngon sum du ni rgyu bar byed/ /ces pa'i don ltar/ 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon po las/ kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di spyan ras gzigs kyis 'dul/ o rgyan gyi yul phyag na rdo rjes 'dul rgya nag gi rgyal khams 'jam dbyangs kyi gdul bya yin pas/ rtsis kyi gtsug lag sogs thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas rgya nag gi skye rgu rnams mngon mtho nges legs kyi sa la bkri bar dgongs te/ ri bo rtse lngar sku 'brung pa'i tshul bstan/ kong rtse sogs dngos kyis 'dul pa'i zhing (28na)kun rjes su bzung nas —439

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)rtsis 'go sum brgya drug cu rgyas par mdzad/ da lta'ang skal ldan rnams kyi snang ngor dngos su bzhugs par grags so/ /de lta bu'i ston pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis gsungs pa'i gtsug lag 'di nyid la bod du 'gyur tshul rgya nag snga 'gyur rnying ma'i rnying mar grags pa ni/ lha mo dri ma med pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bod yul 'di sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dbu brnyes/ srol btod/ dar rgyas su gyur pa'i bar pa srol btod par dgongs te/ 'phags pa phyag na pad ma rgyal po'i tshul bzung srong btsan sgam pos/ bstan pa rgyas par mjad pa'i slad du bstan pa'i bdag po'i snang brnyan gser gyi lha shākya mu ni gdan 'dren pa la rgya dang gnyen du sbrel na bu mo'i rten skal du jo bo rin po che bod du sbyan 'drongs par mkhyen nas/ thabs mkhas pa'i rnam par dpyod pas 'jig rten dang sgo bstun te/ rgya nag thang gi rgyal po la che ba thang khu thu han chan gyis mtshan du'ang 'bod la/ yongs grags la/ thang ga'u dzung gi rgyal por grags pa'i sras tha'i jung dang gnyen byed pa'i tshul gyis de'i sras mo lhan shing kong jo zhes bya ba/ bod skad du mtsho nang gi pad+ma zer ba/ sgrol ma'i sprul pa de btsun mor bsus pa'i tshe spor thang brgyad cu skor du grags pa'i nag rtsis kyi gtsug lag gangs can gyi yul du thog ma byung ba yin/ 'byung ba rin chen kun 'dus/ rgyud gab pa gnad gzer/ rin chen spungs pa/ sdong po kun 'dus sogs la brten pa rgya rtsis snga 'gyur/ rgyud nyi ma gser 'phreng / gter mdzod (28ba)rin chen sgron me sogs kyi rjes su 'brang ba rgya rtsis par 'gyur/ rgyud stag sna dang / mdo byang sogs kyi rjes su 'brang ba rgya rtsis phyi 'gyur dang gsum du byung la/ rgya nag snga 'gyur la rgya bza' dang lo tsā ba dar chen thig les bsgyur ba dang /mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan gyi dus lo chen be+e ro tsa na sogs kyis bsgyur ba gnyis ka mthun pas be+e ro'i 'gyur de bar 'gyur du grags kyang don snga 'gyur phyi mar gtogs pa'i lugs dang / phyi 'gyur mnga' bdag khri ral gyi dus bsgyur ba/ yang 'gyur lo tsā ba kham pa khra mos gsal sgron sogs bsgyur —440

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)ba'i 'gyur snga phyi bzhi tsam bshad pa dang / yang lugs gsum du byas pa'i rgya nag snga 'gyur gyi rjes 'brang grwa phug lugs/ bar 'gyur gyi rjes 'brang byang pa rigs ldan chen po dang spug ston/ phyi 'gyur gyi rjes 'brang mkhas pa rgya drug pa dang zur mkhar ba mang thos blo gros rgyal po sogs byung bar snang mod/ 'on kyang lo rgyus rnying pa rnams su chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi yum rgya bza' rang gi lus nas chad pa'i bu dbang rgyu ma byung bar brten bod kyi sa dpyad thams cad kyang nyams su bcug rtsis kyi skor 'go thams cad 'phyugs par byas pas lo 'go sogs ma dag pa byung zer ba ltar na be+e ro'i 'gyur dang / rgya bza' sngon ma'i rtsis gnyis zhus dag pher mi pher som nyi'i yul du 'dug cing / gang ltar gong du drangs pa'i grwa phug pa sogs mkhas pa de rnams lo 'go la rim pa ltar/ mgo zla rgyal zla/mchu zla gsum gyi ngos 'dzin so sor byung zhing sgrub byed kyang sna tshogs pa zhig snang la/ gter ston sangs rgyas gling pas spu ri phug mo che nas gdan drangs pa'i dgongs 'dus kyi skar yig gi lo 'go rgyal la ngos bzung 'dug pas/ de lta na be+e ro'i (29na tshe gyur sogs bar 'gyur gyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams kyi lugs dang mthun dgos 'dra na'ang / 'gyur rnying dag rtsis khungs ma de dang ma mthun tshe lhad can du 'gro la/ rnam par mi dag pa lo chen be+e ro lta bus bsgyur ba'i skabs ga la srid/ bar skabs su blun po snying khams can gyis rang dang ma mthun pa rgyu mtshan du byas te lhad sna tshogs pa ma bcug pa'i nges pa ni mi 'dug rung / dgongs 'dus gter chos su song bas bar skabs su lhad rang ni 'ong don mi 'dug /dus gsum mkhyen pa o rgyan 'khrul pa mi srid/ sangs rgyas gling pa gter ston rnam dag tu nges na'ang / skar yig de gdul bya'i khams ci rigs la dgongs pa'i drang don yin nam/ gal te dgongs pa can min na blun po snying khams can gyi le'u tho rnying pa zhig la 'go ru mkha' 'gro'i brda yig dang mjug tu sa ma ya rgya rgya bris nas gter chos kyi khrod du bcug pa min las che snyam phyang mo nyug tu gyur to/ /gong gi lugs srol de dag rnam grangs mang zhing / lung rigs rnam dag gis dpyad bzod mi —441 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)bzod kyang sna tshogs snang bar bar skabs su lhad ches mang ba zhugs pa'i skyon du rtogs pas/ rgyal zlar lo 'go byed pa rgya bzas rtsis gzhung dkrugs skyon kho nar go zhing / rta zlar byed pa ni/ ming la'ang hor gyi zla ba dang por grags shing / hor jing gir rgyal pos mi nyag gi lag nas rgya'i rgyal sa thob pa'i zla ba bkra shis pa'i dga' ston byas pa lo gsar du bzung ba dkyus su shor bas/ jing gi me gis san pa brnyed pa'i zla ba zer/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas kyang 'dul ba'i dus go blo gsal mdzes rgyan du/ kye ma gangs can ljongs 'dir na/ /mkhan slob khyim pas byed pa dang / /(29ba)sdom pa gtor mas len pa dang / /lo 'go hor zlas byed pa sogs/ /zhes 'brel khungs chung bar mdzad la/ de ltar na cis tshin tri hwang / ha na/ ang me/ tan/ tsha bo tsha/ 'u ma/ he'u cing / ching sang / su'i g.yang di yi/ thang / hang ma'o/ spung / mi nyag /hor/ rta ming / mnyu sogs mu tig gi rgyal sa 'pho len shin tu mang bas lo 'go'ang sna tshogs par 'gyur mod/ deng sang gi rgya rnams kyi le'u tho hor zla dang po rang la lo 'gor byas nas sa bdag bkod zer ba kha mthun lan gsum tsam thos pa ni wan li rgyal po'i rjes su khrims lhod pas yul gru khol bur byas pa 'dra/ mkhas pa la la thang gi rgyal rabs rdzogs nas spung gi dus shig dus 'khor rgya nag tu phebs pas 'byung ba skye rim dang mthun par mchu zla la lo gsar mdzad gsung bas kyang kong jo'i dus mchu zla'i lo 'go med pa dang dus 'khor gyi khungs drangs pas nag rtsis rang lugs min pa'i sgrub byed du song bas sprang po rdung ba'i lag cha sprang po rang gis khyer ro/ /'byul pa dang bral zhing blo gros dang ldan pa mgu ba skye ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/khyung nag gis/ dpyid zla ra ba stag yin te/ /mgo la nya na zla bshol med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/dgun nyi ldog pa'i zla bar lo 'go 'dzin rigs pas/ rin chen spungs pa las/ zla ba ma nor nges pa ni/ /dpyid zla ra ba rkang mtho bdun/ /'bring po drag la tha chung lnga/ /dbyar ra bzhi dang 'bring po gsum//tha chung gnyis dang ston pa gcig /de nyin rang grib rang la 'khor/ /zhes dang / man ngag snang gsal le'u brgya dang bcu bzhi ma las/ zla ba ma nor legs par brtsis/ /dpyid zla ra ba rkang mtho bdun/ /—442

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)zhes nyi ma'i gung gi dus rang grib la rkang mtho bdun 'byung ba nyi ma gzhu khyim du spyod pa'i skabs (30na tshe yin pas/ sgrub byed shin tu bzang la/ snang gsal las/ the se rgyal po rlung la zhon/ /the khyim rgyal po'i btsun mo de/ /zhag gnyis rting la skya bor 'gyur/ /zhes the se rgyal po lo 'pho 'tshams nas gnas spo bas kyang rtogs nus shing / 'byung ba khong khrol le'u bcu pa las/ lo zla bas 'pho/ zla ba tshes grangs kyi 'pho/ tshes grangs dus tshod kyis 'pho/ dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes gcig gi nam langs nas lo gsar bar rtsis shig /ces sogs lung rigs mtha' yas so/ /rme ba ma 'khrul bar nges pa zhig byung yang zla ba 'phyugs na zla ba'i srog lus dbang thang dang rme ba 'thab pa'i skabs ji lta ba mi 'ong bas/ rtsis tshad ldan zhig byed pa'i sngon du rgya gar skad lta bu'i med du mi rung ba thog mar lo dang zla ba'i 'go tshul bzhin shes dgos pas mtha' cung zad dpyad pa yin/ mkhas pa chen po zur mkhar ba blo gros rgyal pos zhu dag mdzad pa'i gra thang gi gso dpyad kyi rgyud bzhi spar mar/ dpyid zla gsum ni shing rtsi kha 'bus dus/ /rtag pa dbo dang nag pas nam tshod 'dzin/ /byi'u co ka rang skad 'byin pa'i dus/ /bdun cu rtsa gnyis shing khams mchin rtsa rgyu/ /co ga'i skad ltar phra la grims par 'phar/ /lhag ma bco brgyad sa khams mcher rtsa rgyu/ /zhes dag cha mdzad nas mes po'i zhal lung du/ dpyid zla ra ba stag gi zla ba ma nor ba ni/ bya gzhug lcags kyi sgo mos tshes nas rta pa gser gyi sgo mos nya/ rang rtags su stag gcan gzan gyi rgyal po sgra don/ gcan gzan thams cad 'jug /phyi rol shing gi khams 'phel ba la drod bag tsam phebs/ shing rtsi kha 'bus/ bar na co ga skad 'byin/ bya go bo tshang gsog /rlung dmar 'go ldang / (30ba〉ter gsum la phyi thol babs/ zhes sogs kyi sgrub byed mtha' yas par mdzad cing / de dag la brten nas la la zur mkhar ba'i lugs kho na la chen pas phug lugs sun 'byin/ la la phug lugs la chen pas gso dpyad kyi phyogs la dgag pa byas nas tsha grang ltar mthong mod/ bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud 'di dngos gzhi nag rtsis pa'i bde chad gtso che ba yod pas/ nag rtsis pa'i lugs la dpyid ra stag la lo 'go byed par —443

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)grags pa'i rjes su 'bring ba tsam yin na'ang nag rtsis/ tshad ldan dang cung mi mthun pa'i rgyu mtshan/gso dpyad la 'byung ba lnga ma bu dgra grogs kyi skor dang / chu mdo'i skabs/ gdon chu gang btang ngos de shar du brtsi/ /chu de srid pa'i rus sbal gan rkyal gnas/ /mgo bo lhor bstan thig bzhis sa dgur gcad/ /g.yas gsum lha sa mi sa gdon kyi sa/ /g.yon gsum dur sa khang sa zhing gi sa/ /dbus gsum pha mes rang dang bu tsha'i sa/ /ling tshe dgu po'i sa der gzugs brnyan brtag /ces pa sogs 'ga' zhig ma gtogs spar rme sogs kyi zhib cha med par/ gtso bor gso ba gnyen po sman gyi sbyor sde byed pa la/ gso bya'i nad ngos zin dgos/ de la dus bzhi khams lnga'i rtsa ma nor bar rtogs dgos pa/ nad lus kyi shing rtsa dar ba phyi rol gyi shing rtsi rgyas pa la ltos dgos par/ ji skad du/ pad+ma'i mtsho la ngang pa 'du/ /dri ldan me tog bung ba sdud/ /'brog bzang du ni ri dwags 'khor/ kha yi dri la sha sbrang 'khor/ bza' gtung mang sar skye bo 'tshog /gal te de dag mi ldan na/ /bsdus kyang skye bo phal cher 'bros/ /zhes dang / mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung 'di rgyal ba yi/ /gsung gi mdzod kyi gces pa zab mo ste/ /gang gi 'di ni (31na〉thang dag mthong ba des/ /sangs rgyas de nyid rig pa rnams mchog mthong / /zhes pa ltar/ rten 'brel gyi chos nyid 'di mi slu bas ma mdzol bar 'grig dgos pa yin/ de'i dbang du byas nas rtsa brtag pa'i dbang gis phyi'i dus gtso che bar byung zhing / de yang rta zla la gtsang mkhris mda' skor gyi shing rtsi kha 'bus/ dbo zla la bar tshigs pa rnams kyi shing rtsi kha 'bus/ nag zla la phu rags kyi shing rtsi kha 'bus pas rtsa rtogs pa'i ched du 'di gtso bor 'don/ tshes la rgyu ba'i sa bdag sogs kyi mkho byed med la/ gra phug pa ba'i lugs ni rtsa'i phyi nang gi dus mi gtso bar/ lo zla zhag tshes kyi sa bdag mi 'phyug pa gtso che bas/ lung rigs gzhan gyi sgrub byed lta ci smos/ sa bdag rgyal po the se rang gnam lo'i rta la zhen nas mgo zla'i nang du 'phos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis the se gar gnas kyi byi ba sogs gnam lo yin par song bas kyang lo 'go'i sgrub byed gzhan gyis byed ma dgos par the se rang gis byas pa yin no/ /—444

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)des na snga mas dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog dang bstun nas rtsa lta/ phyi mas ni sa bdag gi rjes su 'brangs nas spang blang ston pa yin pas dgongs pa mi 'gal bar nag rtsis rang byed dus hor zla bcu gcig pa dang / gso dpyad la 'jug dus hor zla dang por lo 'go zungs shig ces gso ba ri pa'i gtsug lag dang / rgya nag spor thang gi rtsis phyogs tsam mthong ba'i snyom las mkhan tsu ti'i yul gyi rkang gnyis pa zhig mgrin pa'i lam nas ngo mtshar ba'i gtam cung zad smra ba lags so/ /kong tse lta bu'i mkhas mchog dpal mgon 'phrin las dang / drang srong yid las skyes lta bu'i zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po gnyis kyi dgongs pa'i zhi phugs ma go ba'i tshig tsam la thos sgrog tu (31ba)byed pa'i da lta'i phyogs re'i mig can 'ga' res gso rig la zhen pa rgyu mtshan du byas te zla ba bcu gcig pa bcu gnyis pa dang po gsum gyi sa bdag rnams dang po gnyis pa gsum pa gsum la bkod nas 'jig rten phung ba'i sbyor ba rtsom/ rtsis la zhen cing gso dpyad cung zad shes pa 'ga' zhig gis zla ba bcu gcig pa chu gong bur 'dril dus lcags khams kyi rtsa 'phar ba shing khams su ngos bzung nas nad bu can skal dman mang po'i gshed du gshin rje'i zhags thogs mngon sum du rgyu ba rnams gong du bshad pa de dag brten nas blo nang du 'gugs rigs na'ang / ngan pa ji ltar bcos gyur yang / /rang bzhin bzang po 'byung mi srid/ /sol ba 'bad de bkrus na yang / /kha dog dkar po mi srid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phan par dka'o/ /'phan yul rgyal gyi lha rje gnas brtan pas/ hor zla dang po la shing rtsi kha mi 'bus zhes smras pa na/ zur mkhar bas/ khyod rang 'phan yul gyi lung pa'i phur bsdad pas/ gtsang mkhris kyi shing rtsi kha 'bus pa ma mthong bar 'dug ces gsungs par snang / de sang yang blo chung mang pos/ hor zla bcu gcig pa dpyad pa yin pa'i 'gros thos tshe/ dgu 'dren dus dpyid ka mi 'ong zhes gtam rngams po cher rtsi ba ni rgyal khams ma mthong ba'i skyon te/ mkhas pa'i gsung las/ khams kyi dbyer mo thang zhes par/ /ston yang dpyid la dpyid kyang ston/ /mon yul mthil gsum dpyid kyang ston/ /kong yul —445

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)bri snar dgun yang dbyar/ /byang khams sna brgyad dbyar yang dgun/ /de bas de ltar rig par 'tshal/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /'on kyang gso dpyad dang rtsis su ma zad rig gnas gang la'ang dus dbang gi thos bsam byas pa nyung nyid tshul (32na)bzhin shes pa re gnyis byung na'ang / mkhas pa mkhas pa'i nang na mdzes/ /blun pos mkhas pa ji ltar go /tsan dan gser las rin che ba/ /blun pos sol bar byas pa ltos/ /zhes pa'i don ltar rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams lha med dbang po ma tshang bar song zhing /dud 'gro che ge mo dang / mi che ge mo'i sprul pa'o/ zhes bslabs shes te yon tan gang yang med pa la/grub thob dang sprul sku'i ming snyan snyan por byas te chen po'i khengs dregs dang bcas nas ma bslabs pa dang mi shes par ngo so byed pa mang bas/ gting nas nyams pa'i khrel 'das rnams/ /rang gi gtam ngan ngo sor 'khyer/ /dzin rtsi'i yul gyi rgyal rigs 'ga'/ /pha bsad pa la rgyal rnga rdung / /zhes dang /mkhas rnams rig pa yon gyis blu/ /blun po rig pa bslabs kyang spong / /phal cher nad la sman za yang / /la la gson por lceb pa yod/ /ces pa'i brjod don no/ /'ga' zhig mdo 'dzangs blun las/de'i tshe dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes zhag gcig gi nyin bcom ldan 'das cho 'phrul 'gran pa'i gnas su gshegs pa dang / rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis mchod pa'i yo byad dang zhal zas bshams nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag bdar te phul lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi tshems shing gsol nas/ /tshems shing sa la btsugs so/ /sa la gtsug ma thag tu skyes nas yal ga dang lo ma rgyas pa/ mtho khyad dpag tshad lnga brgya bar gyur te/ yal ga dang lo ma kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad lnga brgya khebs so/ /zhes pa khungs su 'dren pa ni mi rigs te/ spyir mdo las khungs che ba ci yod kyang / mdo nas bshad pa rnams rgya gar ba'i lugs yin la/ rgya gar du sa bdag sogs kyi rnam gzhag med pa sogs (32ba)lugs srol mi 'dra zhing / du 'khor ba nag zla nas lo 'go byed pa dang / 'dul mngon hor zla brgyad pa dgu pa bcu pa gsum la lo 'go ngos 'dzin nang mi mthun pa sna tshogs yod la/ mar ba lo tsā bas/ cho 'phrul khra yi zla ba la/ /mi kho bo rgya gar lam du chas/ /zhes hor zla gnyis par mdzad pa dang / byams 446

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (5)pa lung bstan pa tshigs su bcad pa brgyad par/ cho 'phrul wa yi zla ba la/ /zhes par brten/ wa ni skar ma skag yin la de rgyal dang nye ba'i dbang du btang nas hor zla bcu gnyis par 'chad pa'ang snang /lugs srol tha dad pa mang bas na so so'i rang skad dbye shes pa'i rig pa'i bdag nyid phyed dgos pas/ mkhas pa rang gis dpyod shes kyi/ /blun po grags pa'i rjes su 'brang / /khyi rkan ku co 'don pa na/ /rgyu mtshan med par gzhan dag rgyug /ces pa'i lugs su song na mkhas pa'i khyur mi chud do/ /dpal ye bzang rtse bas/ cho 'phrul wa zhes pa'i wa'i skad dod rgya dpe la med gsung ba legs par bshad pa yin mod/ da ni dus dbang gis cher rlom dang mkhas rlom phal cher rnams rgya dpe pha ri ngos su bzhag nas bod dpe gzigs khyad kyis ka mad sum cur thugs gnyer gnang ba zhu/ dngos don gyi snying po drug cu skor bar grags pa'i lugs la/ mar me mdzad kyi bstan pa la/ /shing pho byi ba'i gcig dkar nas/ /chu mo phag gi lnga sar zad/ /ma 'ongs byams pa'i bstan pa la/ zhang pho byi ba'i bdun dmar nas/ /chu mo phag gi gnyis nag zad/ /da lta thub pa'i bstan pa la/ stonang pho byi ba'i bzhi ljang nas/ /chu mo phag gi brgyad dkar zad/ /ces khungs byed pa ni/ blo ngan las la spyod pa la/ /rang gi 'bad pas thob par sems/ /khyi rgan ya skan phug pa'i khrag /rus pa'i bcud du bsgoms (33na)nas 'cha'/ /zhes pa dang 'dra bas snying po ci yang med de/ sngon 'byung 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po yul 'khor skyong la bu stong dang lnga yod par/ bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis ril ba gli ka ra bya bar gzhen nu rnams kyi mtshan bcug ste rim gyis bton nas brtags pa'i tshe/ 'o kol gyi ston pa shākya thub pa la gzhen nu mig mi 'dzum du gyur pa des snyigs ma bas kyang snyigs ma'i dus su 'tshang rgya bar zhal gyis bzhes par bshad pa'i sangs rgyas de sangs rgyas stong gi bzhi pa yin/ bskal bzang sogs nas bshad pa'i sangs rgyas stong mthar chags su 'byung rgyu'i bskal pa 'di la bzang po'i bskal par grags shing / mar me mdzad ni bskal pa 'di'i sngon du byung bas/ de'i dus 'jam dbyangs kyis rtsisagasungs zin pa'i sgrub byed tshad ldan ci yod/ de ltar na/ mdo dang 'dul ba lung las gsungs pa'i —447

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig /gser thub/ 'od srung sogs kyi rme ba'ang don gyis 'thob pas/ bskal ba 'di la rme 'phreng stong tsam dgos par 'gyur/ rme 'phreng bar ma rkyang par 'khor tshe rme ba lnga ser drug dkar bdun dmar gsum chad nas mchongs pa'i nyes pa 'jug cing / de la skyon mi 'ong na lo'ang nges med 'chol bar byas na'ang 'gal ba ci yod/ lugs ngan 'di 'dra la yid rton pa ni/ gyol po gsum gyis yul 'jig pa'i dpe 'dir 'ong ngo /des na rin chen spungs pa'i rgyud le'u drug pa las srog gi skye bo dbus bzhag ste/ /srog nas bzhi ni lus yin la/ /lus nas bzhi ni dbang thang yin/ /zhes dang / bzhi yi tha ma brgyad la zad/ /brgyad zad pa de bdun la 'khor/ /bdun gyi tha ma gnyis la zad/ /gnyis zad pa de gcig la 'drongs//gcig gi tha ma lnga la zad/ /lnga zad (33ba)pa de bzhi la 'khod/ /zhes rme 'phreng la drug cu tshar gsum yod pa'i drug cu skor re la rme 'phreng re spyad pas/ dpal mgon 'phrin las zhabs kyi dus drug cu skor dgu pa'i tshe/ rme 'phreng gong mar res babs/ de nas da lta drug cu skor bcu gcig pa'i tshe rme 'phreng 'og mar yod la/ rme 'phreng chad lhag med par 'khor bas/ rme ba'i rgyud sam bka' sum 'gyur las kyang / pho brang dang po gcig 'byung ste/ /gcig gi tha ma lnga la zad/ /lnga zad pa de bzhi la 'drongs//bzhi yi tha ma brgyad la zad/ /brgyad zad pa de bdun la 'drongs/ /bdun gyi tha ma gnyis la 'drongs/ /gnyis zad pa de gcig la 'khor/ /'khor zhing 'khor ba ma gtogs pa/ /lhag cing chad pa logs na med/ /rme ba drug cu tshan gsum la/ /brgya dang brgyad cu tham pa 'byung / /brgyad cu skor zhes brjod pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de ltar lhag chad med pa'i srog lus dbang thang gi rme 'phreng gsum po de yang / pho brang brgyad cu'i 'grel pa las/ dang po rme ba'i rtsis 'go ni/ /srog skyes pa yi rme ba la/ zhang pho byi ba'i gcig dkar nas/ /chu mo phag gi lnga ser bar/ /lo 'gros drug cu tham pa tshang / /de nas lus rme ba ni/ zhang pho byi ba'i bzhi ljang nas/ /chu mo phag gi brgyad dkar bar/ /lo 'gros drug cu tham pa tshang / /de rjes dbang thang skyes rme de/ zhang pho byi ba'i bdun dmar nas/ /chu mo phag gi gnyis nag —448

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (5)bar/ /lo 'gros drug cu tham pa tshang / /de nas shing byi gcig 'khor/ /de ltar drug cu tshan gsum la/ /brgya dang brgyad cu tham pa yod/ /ces so/ /gzhan yang gnam gyis bskos pa'i rgyal po sde srid phag mo gru pa'i pho brang sne'u gdong rtser drug cu skor bdun pa'i (34na〉jug gi chu pho khyi la rten 'bul ba 'ongs skabs/ ching shri skal bzang gis khyer ba'i rgyal pos khrims kyis bcad pa'i khyi lo'i li'u tho la dgu dmar dbus su byas pa dang / yang drug cu skor dgu pa'i chu spre lo la gnyis nag dbus su byas pa sogs/ rtsis rig smra ba'i gtsug rgyan chos rje 'phrin las pas mngon sum du gzigs shing / kho bos kyang shar phyogs 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i rgyal khab tu bgrod tshe li'u tho tshar gnyis tsam mthong ba'i tshes kyi chad lhag bshol sogs thams cad grwa phug lugs kyi phyag len dang zhus dag pher bar snang ngo / /dri ba bzhi pa/rgya nag 'gyur gyi skor 'go tshul bzhin shes pa las mngon mtho nges legs sogs 'thob pa'i gnas yod med kyi dris lan/dri ba bzhi pa ni/ bzhi pa dpal ldan dus 'khor rgyud don gyi/ /lam la gzhung bzhin lugs nas nyams blangs na/ /nges legs mthar thug zung 'jug 'khrul med kyang / /rgya nag 'gyur gyi gtsug lag mdo rgyud kyi/ /rgyud don skor 'go tshul bzhin shes pa yis/ /mngon mtho nges legs 'thob pa'i gnas e yod/ /gzhan du khrims dang sngags lam ma bsten par/ /mngon mtho mtho ris gsum dang nges legs kyi/ /mthar thug zung 'jug 'thob par ma gsungs so/ /mngon mtho nges legs 'thob pa'i gnad yod na/ /de nyid 'grub byed rgyu yi gtso bo dang / /lam gyi 'gros rnams bka' dang mi —449

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)'gal ba'i/ /lung rigs 'khrul med cig ni ston dgos so/ /de nyid 'thob pa'i gnad ni med gyur na/ /gtsug lag kho na'i lam gyis zung 'jug sku/ /'thob pa lta theg mtho ris gsum tsam yang / /'thob skal med na deng sang dus kyi ni/ /mo gshen rnams dang khyad par ci yod de/ /sto rgyab khol bu tsam du zad par thal/ /de yi tshe na rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyang / /ston par bzung la dgos pa ci zhig yod/ dper na mig mang (34ba7rgya dang ma 'brel na/ / rde'u ji ltar mang yang shi ror 'gyur/ /de bzhin mngon mtho nges legs mi 'thob pa'i/ /gtsug lag mdo rgyud mang yang ro dang 'dra/ /zhes pa spyir mgon po klu sgrub kyis mdza' bo bde spyod la springs par/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten legs par gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar rgyu ba bcud kyi sems can dang / /mi rgyu ba snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad sa chen po la brten pa ltar srid zhi'i yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhi tshul khrims yin te/ zhi ba myang 'das thob par byed pa la de sgrub pa'i rten mngon mtho'i go 'phang thob dgos pas/ mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ /lha yul bgrod pa thag mi ring / /lha dang mi yi them skas la/ /'dzegs na thar pa gam na 'dug /ces gsungs pas 'grub la/ lha mi'i rten 'thob pa yang tshul khrims la rag lus/ rten de la tshul khrims dag pa'i 'bras bu thar pa'i go 'phang 'thob nus pas/ mdo las/ nga'i dge slong tshul khrims dri ma med pa de la mtho ris ni ras yug gis chod pa tsam la/ thar pa ni yol bas chod pa tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs shing bsnyen par rdzogs ma thag pa la/ tshe dang ldan pa khyod bsnyen par rdzogs zin gyis/ bag yod par sgrubs shig ces brjod par snang bas/bag yod pa na/ chos mngon pa las/ bag yod pa gang zhe na/ ma chags pa dang / zhe sdang med pa dang /gti mug med pa dang brtson 'grus dang bcas pa la gnas na dge ba'i chos rnams sgom zhing / zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos rnams la sems srung ba ste/ zhes bshad do/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pas/ /gnas skabs 'bras bu lha mi dang / /mthar thug 'bras bu (35na)byang chub gsum/ /thob par 'gyur zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /dpyod ldan rnams kyis 450

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)so so thar/ /mnyan pa'i phyir ni 'bad par bya/ /zhes pa lha mi'i lus 'thob pa ni thabs gzhan la lhos mi dgos par tshul khrims rnam par dag pa gcig pus chog la/ byang chub gsum yang 'thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur bar dgongs so/ /gong du mdo lung gi /dge slong zhes pa gtso che ba'i dbang du btang ba ste/gzhan du na de bzhin gshegs pa ni thabs la mkhas/ thugs rje che bas nyin zhag gcig pa'i khrims yan lag brgyad pas kyang 'grub bo/ /sangs rgyas 'thob pa la gsang sngags bla med kyi lam nyams su blangs pa zhig nges par dgos te/ las mtha' rnam 'byed las/ bskal pa mtha' yas rnams su yang / /mgo dang rin chen sogs byin pas/ /snang ba rnam par ma dag phyir/ /byang chub 'bras bu thob mi 'gyur/ /mtha' yas bskal pa rnams su yang / /de bzhin tshul khrims bzod sogs kyis/ /snang ba gsum po ma dag phyir/ /byang chub 'bras bu thob mi 'gyur/ /mtha' yas bska pa pa rnams su yang / /sngags kyi sku yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /snang ba rnam par ma dag phyir/ /byang chub 'bras bu thob mi 'gyur/ /snang ba gsum po dag pa ni/ /thams cad mkhyen nyid the tshom med/ /ces pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bskyed rim tsam dang / rgyud sdo'og ma gsum gyis snang ba gsum dag mi nus pas na nges par rnal 'byor bla med kyi rdzogs rim la brten dgos par bshad pas so/ /man ngag snye ma las kyang / mchog tu mthar thug pa na'ang nges par thabs 'di la ltos so zhes brjod par bya ste/ dper na nam (35ba7khar bzhugs pa'i rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gnang ba'i shes rab kyi dbang la shākya'i mgon po byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs pa byang chub 'thob pa'i ched du mtshan phyed na ltos pa bzhin dang / ji ltar yang bcom ldan 'das 'di kho nas rdo rje snying po la thig le mchog mas dbang bskur ba byin pa bzhin no/ /zhes dang /grol ba'i thig le las/ ci phyir shākya thub pa yis/ /grangs med bar du tshogs bsags kyang / /'di don ma rtogs ni ra lhar/ /ci yang ma yin ting 'dzin gnas/ /de tshe bde gshegs kun gyis kyang / /thal byung blo can de bzlog ste/ /nam mkha'i dkyil ltar rnam dag pa'i/ /zab gsal dri med rab —45/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)bstan to/ /nam phyed dus su brgyal ba ltar/ /de nyid bsgoms pas tho rangs su/ /skad cig gis ni yang dag rtogs/ /zhes gsal bar byung la/ khyad par bla med kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa ste/ rgyud phyi ma las/ e ma'o shin tu rnyed dka' ba/ /byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs 'di yin/ /rgyud kyi phyi ma'i phyi mar gyur/ /gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya'i rgyud/ /ces dang / sgron gsal las kyang /ji srid ya ra la ha'i bar/ /ka kha gha mtha' ṇa dza'i mtha'/ /ta dha'i mtha' dang ma mthar bcas de de'i rtsa ba yi ge gsum/ /thub pa chen pos chos phung po/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa yi/ /dpal ldan nga 'dus 'ad snod yin te/ /de bas de ni rgyud kyi rtse/ /zhes so/ /don hril gyis dril na/ mi slob pa'i zung la jug 'thob pa la/ slob pa'i zung 'jug thob dgos/ de 'thob pa la sgyu lus thob dgos/ sgyu lusakyi bsgrub gzhi sems dben gyi ye shes rdzogs par skyed pa phyi'i las rgya la ltos pas/ rim lnga las sgyu ma dang ni thams cad las/ /(36na)bud med sgyu ma khyad par 'phags/ /ye shes gsum gyi dbye ba ni/ /gsal bar 'di las mtshon par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi bde ba lam du byed tshul 'di rnal 'byor rgyud man chad thams cad la med cing / so so skye bo tshe gcig la gsang sngags rang lam gyis bgrod par tshul de dgos par ma zad/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i sa bcu'i lam mthar phyin pa rnams kyang / mthar 'tshang rgya ba'i tshe dngos kyi rig ma la brten nas dbang skur dgos pa'i khungs su/ kye rdo rje las/ 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrug pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu bzhengs nas ni/ /rdo rje snying po dbang sbyin phyir/ /thig le mchog nyid bkug pa nyid/ /ces gsungs so/ /'dus nga/ bde dgyes sogs su las rgya la ma brten na tshe gcig la 'tshang mi rgya bar bshad do/ /de lta na'ang thams cad mkhyen pa tsong kha pas/ mdo rgyud g.yin dang bshad srol mi 'dra ba'i/ /shing rta'i srol 'byed dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud/ /ces pa ltar dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lor gdul bya dman pa la byang chub kyi sems 'dzag pa'i bgrod pa dang / 'bring la g.yo ba'i —452

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)bgrod pa dang / mchog la mi g.yo ba'i bgrod pa gsum las dang po las kyi phyag rgya/ gnyis pas ye shes kyi phyag rgya/ gsum pas phyag rgya chen mo gsum la rim bzhin brten nas mchog tu mi 'gyur bas bde chen sgrub pas na/ rtsa rgyud las/ mchog tu mi 'gyur bsgom par bya/ /pad+ma ra rdo rje rab bkod nas/ /srog ni thig ler gzhug par bya/ /'khor lo thig le thig le yis/ /g.yo ba rdo rje dgag par bya/ /rtag tu rtag rengs rnal 'byor pa/ /rtag tu steng du khu (36ba thar 'gyur/ /phyag rgya chen po sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje 'bebs pas byin gyis rlabs/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur skad cig ni/ /stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / /drug brgya rdzogs pas rgyal po che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs la/ gdul bya mchog gis mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba sten nus pa dang / dman pa dang bar mas phyag rgya gzhan gnyis spangs nas ye rgya kho na la brten nus pa'i sa mtshams kyang / sgrub le'i rgya go dgu pa las/ sems ni nog pa dang bcas las kyi phyag rgya 'di dang btags pa'i ye shes phyag rgya spang bya ste/yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub ched du rgyal ba mchog gi skyed ma mchog gi phyag rgya dgos pa med/ /rnam par 'gyur ba med cing mkha' mnyam mun bcom khyab byed rnal 'byor dag gis bgrod byed ther zug gnas/ /ye shes gzi brjid srid pa'i dri ma 'phrog cing dus kyi 'khor los rjes su rig pa bsgom par bya/ zhes sogs kyis shes so/ /'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pas/ /'di na rdzogs sangs rgyas su bgrod pa la/ /zab mo rdo rje theg dang phar phyin theg /rnam pa gnyis yod gsang sngags phar phyin las/ zhan tu khyad par 'phags pa yin no zhes/ /nyi ma zla ba lta bur kun tu grags/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ bskyed rim nas bzung ste 'od gsal gyi bar gyi lam gyi dod thub rnams sngags lam la ma ltos par/ phar phyin theg pa rang lam gyis bgrod pa'i sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha mar gyur pa la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang gsum pa dngos dbang du bskur te/ slob pa'i zung 'jug dang /de'i rjes su dbang bzhi pa bskur nas spyod pa byed du bcug pas/ mi slob pa'i zung 'jug mngon du —453

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)byed par bshad pas/ mthar (37na)dus yun thung ngu zhig la zung 'jug gi lam mngon du byas pa tsam las gzhan sangs rgyas kyi sar bgrod pa'i lam phal cher pha rol tu phyin pa la brten nas bgrod pa la dgongs sam mnyam/ gal te sngags lam la ma ltos par phar phyin kho na'i lam la brten nas sangs rgyas su bgrod pa yod pa'i dgongs pa yin srid na'ang / mdo phyogs kyi rang skad la yod pa'i dbang du gnang ba ste/ spyir btang dang ni dmigs bsal dag /bstan bcos kun la gces pa yin//zhes spyir btang dang dmigs bsal la dgongs pa yin no/ /de ltar bstan pa spyi'i skad du byed na/ mngon mtho 'thob pa khrims dag pa dang / sangs rgyas 'thob pa nges gsang rdo rje theg pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa la rag lus na'ang / de gnyis ma gtogs chos gzhan gyis dgos pa med pa lta bur go na sangs rgyas 'thob mi nus te/ rgyal bas chos tshul grangs med gsungs pa thams cad sems can rnams kyis sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i thabs su gsungs pas so/ /tshul de la brten nas 'brom ston pas/ bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam 'khyer shes pa nga'i bla ma zhes dpal mar me mdzad la bsngags pa brjod pa dang / rgyal ba btsong kha pas/ bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtogs pa dang / /gsung rab ma lus gdams par 'char ba dang / /zhes pa'ang / rang nyid ngan 'gro las thar pa tsam don du gnyer ba sogs dmigs bsal can 'ga' re ma gtogs skyes bu chung ngu'i chos rnams kyang 'bring nyams su len pa la dgos/ rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde don gnyer sogs 'ga' re ma gtogs 'bring gi chos rnams chen po'i (37ba tshe nyams len la dgos shing / rdo rje theg pa'i sngon du lam thun mong ba'i rgyud sbyang 'gro dgos pa la/ deng sang theg pa gsum dang grub mtha' bzhi sogs kyi rnam gzhag la thos pa cung zad kyang ma byas par phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa klong du gyur pa skad byas nas ri sul kun du grog tshang rdol ba lta bu ni/ sgom na thos pa mi dgos zhes/ / blun po blo rgya chung du smra/ /thos pa med par sgom pa tsam/ /'bad kyang dud 'gro'i sgrub thabs yin/ / zhes pa ltar ro/ /—454

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (sga)'o na nang rig pa tsam la thos bsam byas pas mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang 'grub bam snyam na/ spyod 'jug las/ rgyal sras rnams kyis mi bslab pa'i/ /dngos de 'ga' yang yod ma yin/ /de ltar gnas pa'i mkhas pa la/ /bsod nams mi 'gyur gang yang med/ /ces dang / rje btsun sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa/ rang blo shes bya kun la ma sbyangs na/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nam mkha'i mtha' las ring / /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyal ba'i sras gzhan phyir bla na med pa'i byang chub don du gnyer ba rnams rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' thams cad la sbyang dgos pa yin te/ dpal chos kyi grags pas grangs can gyi grub mtha'i gsang tshig rnams shes pa'i ched du bran du brdzus te zhang po'i chung ma'i g.yog byas nas grub mtha'i gnad 'di 'dra dri dgos byas pas/ 'dod pa spyod tshe dri yis/ khyed rang yid la zungs zer ba ltar byas/ de'i tshe mo'i rkang pa la tha gu btags nas gang dka' sar then then byas tshe mos nan chen dris pas mkhyen to/ /de bzhin gshegs pas grub mthas blo ma 'gyur ba'i skye bo ba lang lta bu la/ skye ba snga phyi dang las 'bras med par 'dod pa'i mu stegs rgyang pan gyi bstan bcos (38na)bstan pa'i sgo nas bkri ba'i skabs yod de/ ci'i phyir na/ rgyang pan pas kyang rigs pa khas len pas so/ /sngon bsam yas su mkhan po'i zhal chems ltar rje btsan pos hwa shang gdul don du mkhas pa ka ma la shi la gdan drangs tshe thog mar hwa shang dang / paṇ+ḍi ta chu pha ri tshu ri byung bar/ paṇ+ḍita sa tshod brtag pa'i phyir du/chag shing klad la lan gsum bskor bas/ hwa shang gis khams gsum 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu dris par go nas gzung 'dzin gnyis yin pa'i brda chad du ber gyi mthu ba lan gnyis sa la brdabs pas/ ka ma la'i thugs la hwa shang rigs pa khas len pas thul bar dgongs pa'i lo rgyus dang / 'jig rten gyi gtam la'ang / shes can de dgra la yod kyang mkho zer ba'i dpe 'dir 'ong / slar rgyang pan de skye ba snga phyi tsam 'dod pa'i mu stegs dpyod pa pa dang / de yang thar pa 'dod pa'i mu stegs grangs can dang gcer bu pa sogs kyi lugs su 'khrid la/ de dag gis/ kha ba rgya spos me tog dang / /ba zho ba mo mu —453

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)tig mdog /gdugs dkar bzung ba'i dbyibs 'dra ba/ /thar pa yin par rgyal bas bshad/ /ces pa lta bu 'dod/ myang 'das khas len pa la/ chos rnams bden med du blor mi tshud pa la bye brag smra ba dang / de las bzlog ste bya byed las gsum yul steng nas ma grub pa'i blos btags 'dod pa la mdo sde pa dang / phyi don bkag nas gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi shes pa bden grub tu 'dod pa la sems tsam pa/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos thams cad bden med du blor chud pa'i rigs la dbu ma'i grub mtha' sten/ brtag gnyis las/ lta dang rgod dang lag bcings dang / /gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang rnam pa bzhi/ /srin bu'i tshul gyis rgyud bzhin (38ba〉na sungs/ /zhes shing la gnas pa'i srin bus shing nyid lhag med du za ba ltar/ nyon mongs spang byar ma byas par lam du 'khyer tshul bzhi'i sgo nas sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs dam pa ston pa'i snod du gyur pa dbang po ches non po rnams la gsang sngags kyi theg pa ston pas na/ lha mo dbyangs can ma'ang nges don du gshin rje gshed dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i gnyis med gnyis su snang ba'i yum rdo rje dbyings phyug ma yin la/ phyi rol pa rnams kyi don du tshangs pa'i bu mor bstan cing / nang pa'i lugs 'dzin rnams kyi ngor spyan ras gzigs kyi mche ba las 'i(grangs par grags/ spyan ras gzigs kyang bka' gdams glegs bam rin po cher/ bon gyi ngor gshen lha 'od dkar du bstan par gsungs shing / dus gsum mkhyen pa o rgyan gyi zab gter mang por lha chen dbang phyug gi sgrub skor la/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar por sgrub pa zhes phyag na pad+ma ra bstan/ de ltar mu stegs rgyang pan gyi grub mthas kyang mthar mngon mtho dang sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid nus pa yod na/ rgya nag gi gtsug lag rtsis kyis mngon mtho dang sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur ba yod pa la som nyi mi 'tshal gyi/ 'on kyang 'di kho nas mngon mtho nges legs 'thob mi nus mod/ de rgyu mtshan du byas nas yang dag pa ma yin par sgrub mi rung ste/sangs rgyas 'thob pa la don gyi gnad nang rig pa theg pa gsum gyi chos tshul la ma rmongs pa zhig dgos/ theg pa gsum gyi gzhu gi 'u/gas la mkhas par byed pa tshig gi cha la 'khrul pa sel ba gtan —456

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (5)tshigs rig pa dang don gyi cha la 'khrul pa sel ba sgra rig pa la ltos pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa lo chen chos skyong bzang pos/ mkhas shes bya ba mang na yang / /sgra tshad kyi (39na 〉 lbang la bcur na shes//zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan du na legs sbyar gyi bstan bcos kho na la brten nas kyang 'tshang rgya bar mi nus pas/ brda sprod kyi gzhung kun yang don med du 'dod dgos par 'gyur ro/ /nag rtsis kho nas byang chub mchog 'thob mi nus pas de ston pa po rje btsun 'jam dbyangs ston pa yang dag tu bzung mi rigs par mi 'gyur te/ nag rtsis su ma zad srid pa 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal drungs nas 'byin nus pa'i zab mo stong pa nyid ston pa'i gzhung lugs kyang 'jam dbyangs kyis mgon po klu sgrub la gsungs shing / 'jam pa'i rdo rje dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bzhengs nas/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mchog gi chos tshul rgya cher bstan to/ /gzhan yang / de bzhin gshegs pas gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos rnams rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub par bstan pa'i mdo dang / rdo rje gur du/ mig sman dang ni rkang mgyogs dang / /ral gri dang ni sa bon 'grub/ /ril bu dang ni mkha' spyod nyid/ /mi snang ba dang bcud kyi len/ / tha mal pa zhes bshad pa yin/ /zhes grub chen brgyad dang / sgron gsal las/ dgos pa yang ni bshad bya ste/ /zhi sogs bya ba'i cho ga dang / /zhes zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las rab 'byams sogs rgyud sde mang por byung ba/ bshad ma thag pa'i don tsam brjod byar byed pa'i mdo rgyud tsam la brten kyang sangs rgyas mi 'thob pas/ de rnams bka' tshad ma min pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'ang ston pa rnam dag tu 'dzin mi rung bar 'gyur ba sogs rigs pa go mtshungs so/ /nag rtsis kyi rang gzhung kho nas mngon mtho nges legs mi 'thob pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas/byed pa po rnams kyi lto gos (39ba)sogs tshe 'di 'byid thabs rkyang par 'gro ba'i nges gzung med de/mdo sngags tha snyad kyi rig pa sogs gang la'ang byed pa po'i bsam pa gtso che bas so/ /ci'i phyir na/da lta mchog dman bar ma thams cad kyi ngag las rlung ltar rjod cing / chos thams cad kyi yang rtser byed pa'i nges don phyag rgya chen por grags pa 'di la/ spyir sdom gsum du/ nged kyi phyag rgya chen po ni//—457

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)dbang las byung ba'i ye shes dang / /rim pa gnyis kyi khyad par las/ /byung ba'i rang byung ye shes yin/ /zhes phyag rgya chen de gsang sngags bla med kyi lam du mdzad pas na/ sngags rnying ma las theg pa rim dgur gsungs pas dbang dang rim gnyis las byung ba'i phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes las mtho ba rdzogs pa chen po lhun grub 'od gsal snang bzhi'i lam yod par bzhed na'ang / gsar ma sor bzhag par/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi gong na theg pa gzhan med pas chos kun gyi rtse mor son pa yin mod/ da lta'i phyag rgya pa'i lugs 'di gnas lugs phyag chen zhes lta ba la sbyar nas mdo lugs yin zer bas phyag chen mtshan nyid tshang bar mi 'gro'ang don rnal ma zhig byung na zhi lhag zung 'brel lta bur snang la/des na mdo sdo rgyan las/ chos kyi ming ni sdom pa'ang 'di/ /zhi gnas lam du shes par bya/ /lhag mthong lam min de don rnams/ /rnam par dpyod par shes par bya/ /zhes chos rnams kyi gnas lugs las mi g.yel bar bsdus te/ rtse gcig tu nyams su len pa zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong ni mi g.yeng bar brtan pa thob pa'i ngang nas so sor rnam par dpyod pa yin pas/ lhag mthong gi sgo nas gnas lugs phyin ci ma log (40na)pa shes par byed pa/ de nyams su bstan pa'i gzhi rten/ zhi gnas la rag lus pas/ mdo sde dgongs 'grel las/ de gcig tu dben par 'dug ste nang du yang dag par bzhag nas ji ltar legs par bsam pa'i chos de dag nyid yid la byed cing / sems gang gis yid la byed pa'i sems de nang du rgyun chags su yid la byed pas yid la byed do/ /zhes gsungs la/ der ma zad dper na mar me gsal yang rlung gis bskyod nas gzugs brnyan tshul bzhin mi mthong ba ltar/dmigs pa las mi g.yo ba'i zhi gnas med na lhag mthong gis don tshul bzhin du g.yo ba med par mi mthong zhing / gal te de ltar g.yo med du mthong nus na lhag mthong gis so sor dpyad pa tsam gyis gnas lugs kyi don la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin je 'phel du song nas ri dang mtshungs par shin tu brtan par 'gyur te/ zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las/ zhi gnas stobs kyis g.yo ba med par 'gyur/ /lhag mthong gis ni ri dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /—458

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (5)de bzhin du phyag chen po rnams kyis kyang gnas pa skyong zhes smra ba 'di/ zhi gnas kyi lugs su byed 'dug pa/ khyed rnams kyis gnas pa brtan po yod par sgom chen bzang bzang mo byed pas na/de lta bu'i nyams len de skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyi rtsis ma zin na mu stegs byed la gnas cha de 'dras cha tsam du'ang sgrun mi nus pa'i srid rtse'i bar du 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin yod pas/ phyag rgya ba'i sgom chen pa de nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i bral du'ang mi tshud la/ yang nag rtsis pa zhig gis gshin gson gyi rtsis rnams skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i sgo nas byas na sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan zan changs gcig tsam (40ba)byang chub kyi sems kyi sgo nas byin kyang sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur na/ nag rtsis kyi sgo nas 'gro rnams bde skyid la 'god nus te/gshin rtsis kyis yul dang nye 'brel la phan par ma zad gshin po rang gi sdig pa sbyong thabs su 'gyur bas/ khyung nag gi zangs skyem bsdus don bcu gsum ma las/ 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog /dag par byed cing sdig sel pa/ /ngan song thams cad sbyong ba yi/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /'gro ba'i las dang rkyen dbang gis/ /sdug bsngal chu bo bzhi yis gdungs/ /'jig rten pha rol tshe 'phos pa'i/ /gshin bcos phung po gtang thabs bdun/ /zhes 'jam dpal gyi thugs rjes ngan song sbyong bar gsungs shing / der ma zad/ steng lha'i yul na lha dbang brgya byin la 'dod khams dang gzugs kyi lhas bskor ba der skyes sam bya ba dang gcig /'og gshin rje'i 'jig rten gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po la/ 'khor ngan song gsum gyis bskor ba der skyes sam bya ba dang gnyis/ bar mi'i 'jig rten na bar do'i sems can de gar skye nges par gnas pa dang gsum zhes brtags nas/ skye gnas bzang por sgyur zhing ngan pa 'gegs pa'i thabs yod pas/ sngags rnying ma'i na rag gi skong dang / gsar ma'i kun rig dang cha mthun/ gson rtsis la khyung nag sgang dril las/ 'gro ba'i gtsor gyur rkang gnyis mi lus 'di/ /'byung ba las grub rnam rtog rkyen dbang gis/ /'dus pa'i nad dang gdon gyi ye 'byog 'byung / /tshe 'dir legs nyes skyid sdug 'byung bas byed/ /de phyir 'byung ba rtsi ba —459

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)shin tu gces/ /zhes pa brtsi bya'i skor la go rde'u bdun ma sogs kyi sgo nas blang dor bstan pas/ tshe ring zhing nad (41na)gi ba/ longs spyod 'phel ba sogs phan pa rgya cher 'byung / nad par phan don/thang shing chen po bzhi yi rtsis dang gcig /gser gyi zam chen bco lnga'i rtsis dang gnyis/ /g.yung drung shug pa 'dab rgyas rtsis dang gsum/ /dpag bsam ljon shing 'bras bu'i rtsis dang bzhi/ /dpal khyim dang ni byung khyim rtsis dang lnga/ yī mig gson mig bgrang ba'i rtsis dang drug /ling tshe brgal lam ma brgal rtsis dang bdun/ /zhes 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i duḥkhas mnar ba rnams 'chi gsos kyi bdud rtsi'i sman dang de mtshungs pas/ rje 'phrin las zhabs kyis/ dge legs tshogs gnyis ches cher rab bsgrubs pas/ /gang gi thugs rjes sa gsum lus can gyi/ /dug gsum las skyes bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad/ / zhi bar mdzod cig 'jam dpal sman pa'i rgyal/ /zhes dang / de skad nad kyis gdungs pa'i 'gro ba la/ /phan don thang shing chen po rtsis kyi gzhung / /zhes pa'i don gyis shes la/ ga gong gnyan sbyor gyi rtsis kyi gnas skabs su phan pa'i byed las/ dbyangs 'char rin chen rgya mtsho las/ /bud med skyes ming skar ma ni/ /khyo yi snying la song ba na/ /tshe ring yid gcug 'grogs par 'gyur/ khyo yi skyes skar bud med song / /de dang 'dra ste skyid pa yin/ /bud med gza' de pa wa sangs/khyo yi snying la song ba na/ /phyogs kun rnam par rgyal 'gyur te/ /mchog tu dag zhing skyed pa yin/ /lhag pa skyes pa'i gza' yin te/ /bud med snying la song ba na/ /bzhen dang nor rnams 'phel ba dang / /bu lnga dag ni skye ba yin/ /zhes skar rtsis las byung ba dang / khyad par nag rtsis dngos bstan du'ang / bde legs kun 'byung las/ srog gi 'byung ba(41ba〉pa thun 'gyur na/ /tshe ring gcig sgra gcig gis 'thu/ /gcig gi gnyer ma gcig gis 'dren/ ston na tu 'grogs yun ring ba yin/ /lus mthun bu tsha 'phel ba ste/ /mal gang shi chad med pa la/ /dbang po skyon med bzhin legs skye/ /dbang mthun nor rdzas lo phyugs 'phel/ /lag pa mi la mi gdeng nyid / /zas nor phun sum tshogs pa 'ong / /rlung rta mi kha byams pa ste/ /phyi mi nang mi thams cad byams/ /lhag par ya rabs gong mas skyong / /—46(/

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)zhes/ 'di snang gi bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa la spyod par 'gyur bar ma zad/ 'di phyi'i legs tshogs thams cad kyi rtsa ba dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i rten dal 'byor gyi mi lus dang / khyad par gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa bskyed rdzogs kyi zab lam nyams su len pa la rten mngal skyes khams drug dang ldan pa zhig dgos pas na/ sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i snod gyur pa/ /lus kyi dgra dang 'dra mod kyi/ /blo dang ldan pas 'khol shes na/ /'di la bsod nams brtan du rung / /skad cig 'jig pa'i tshe na yang / /dge ba'i bag chags ring du 'khyer/ /rlung gis gos pa'i tsan dan dri/ /ring du 'thul yang dga' ba skyed/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /mi lus skyed pa'i cha nas gtan bde'i rgyur 'gyur bas bzang por sgrub rigs pa'i rgyu mtshan/dper na tshong pa rnams kyi thob bya'i gtso bo rin po che yin yang / de 'thob pa la rgya mtsho chen po la bgrod dgos shing bgrod pa'i thabs gzings dang phug ron dung gson po sogs dgos te/ phug ron med na chu srin brtag mi thub/ dung med na chu srin gsod mi thub par chu srin gyis gru 'jig pas/ don chen po dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i nor bu len pa 'dab chags dman pa phug ron la ltos pa ltar/ gtan bde'i don chen po lhun gyis (42na snyib pa'i zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sa 'thob pa/ de sgrub par byed pa'i rten mngal skyes khams drug ldan gyi lus bzang po skyed pa phan tshun gnyen du 'brel pa la ltos so/ /tshul de dang cha mthun 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa skyed byed kyi rgyu la rag lus pa'i dbang du mdzad nas/ bco lnga'i zla ba nya ba de tshes gcig gi zla ba tshes pa las byung ba ltar bdag cag gi ston pa shākya thub pa rang dang rgyud mi gcig pa 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs sogs kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad nas sems skyed du bcug /rang dang rgyud gcig pa'i yul shi pi pa'i rgyal po sogs kyis rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la bslabs te sangs rgyas pas mtshon pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rang rgyu byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs par dgongs te/ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ 'od srung / dper na zla ba tshes pa la phyag 'tshal ba ltar nya ba la ni ma yin no/ /—46/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)'od srung / de bzhin du gang dag nga la dad pa de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag bya yi/de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la ni de lta ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' las ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'byung ngo / /zhes so/ /dri tshig gi mjug tu/ de ltar dri ba brtsams pa bzhi po 'di/ /min pa'i rgya che zhu rgyu mang 'dug kyang / /'di 'drar dogs pa tsam yang mi 'dug pas/ /zur tsam zhus mod dris lan stsol bar rigs/ /zhes pa rtsis dkar nag la dka' gnas kyi dogs pa'i gnas mtha' yas kyang / da lam dri ba bzhi tsam las ma mdzad 'dug pa skabs su bab ste/ dri tshig nyung ngu 'di tsam gyis kyang / dri ba'i yul sku tshe mang por spyir mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skyes rabs (42ba)kyi 'phreng ba 'dzin pa dang / dgos su dus 'khor la sbyangs pa'i sprul par zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / tshe 'dir sbyangs rlom gyi rtsis rig smra ba mang po lan med du gyur pas na/ shes rab med pa'i blun po rnams/ /mang yang dgra bo'i dbang du 'gro/ /glang chen stobs ldan khyur longs pa/ /ri bong blo ldan gcig gis btul/ /zhes pa'i don du snang ngo / /yang / mi thebs pa rnams bdag la phrag dog dang / sdang sems mi 'tshal gtan la 'bebs rgyu'i don/ /da dung zhabrul med legs par ma btsal na/ /rang gzhan thams cad slu ba'i nyen brda'o/ /zhes pa la/ nor ldan blun po'i nang na mang / /dpa' bo gcan gzan khrod na mod/ /legs bshad mkhas pa'i khrod 'byin pa/ /dam pa 'jig rten 'di na dkon/ /zhes pa ltar deng dus skyes bu dam pa'i mtshan snyan gyi pi wang rdung ba'i yul/ sngo bsangs ma'i skar tshogs lta bu las legs par bshad pa'i ljags thung ngur ma gyur pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i do zlar song bas/ ral gri shugs chud kyis bya sla zhing / tshe rta lhag sprod mas don 'grub pa'i spyan ltos skyo ma snga btsan gyi dbang gis mdung ring sna gcur khugs dka' ste/ phal cher bu tsha'i spyod pa ni/ /rigs rgyud snga ma'i rjes su 'brang / /khu byug phru gu bye khra sa /'gro ba rgya lam srid pa tsam/ /zhes pa ltar dang / da lta'i rtsis par khas 'che ba phal cher yang /blun pos bya ba legs grub kyang / /stes dbang yin gyi bsgrubs pas min/ /srin bu'i kha chu dar skud —462

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)du/ /'gro ba mkhas nas byung ba min/ /zhes pa ltar/ gza' 'dzin gyi sgo yig sbyar ba skabs re 'grig pa dang / sbyin bdag bsod nams can la thang re gnyis gza' tshes dus sbyor sa bdag phyugs kyang nyes skyon ma byung ba rtags su bkod de/ nged rang tsho'i pha mes nas (43na〉pag len 'di ga byed kyi yod zer nas gzur gnas kyi tshig dag tu gleng ba la ngo mtshar 'dzin pa rnams/ slar thos bsam la 'jug pa dka' ste/ skye bo ngan pa 'byor thob kyang / /lhag par spyod pa ngan par 'gyur/ /'bab chu ji ltar bzlog gyur kyang / /thur du bab pa kho nar 'dod/ /ces dang / byang pa ta dben gyis/ chos log par sgrub pa'i thar lam dka'/ /chos byas tshad lam du 'gro ba dka'/ /lam nor ba dgos sar sleb pa dka'/ /yul 'dzam bu gling du skye ba dka'/ /zhes pa'i don ltar ro/ /sbyar byang du/ zhes pa 'di nyid kha ba can pa yi/ /'dzin pa'i thig le skyid shod stod smad kyi/ /mkhas pa'i khrod nas phul du phyin gyur pa/ /lcang lo 'dzin pa 'khor lo'i dbang phyug dang / /rig gnasa'adi yi mkhas mang zhabs gtugs pa/ /yid kyi lha lam rtog brjod rgyu skar bkra/ /ngag gi dbyar skyes rnga chen dal du dgod/ /sor mo'i chu 'dzin dag nas rig gnas char/ /'bebs mkhas shākya'i btsun pa snyom las pas/ /thub dbang lcags sprer bltams nas nyis stong dang / /lnga brgya gya lnga bzlas pa shing glang lo'i/ /gro zhun zla ba'i dkar phyogs bco lnga la/ /sprul pa'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po sogs/ /skyes chen du mas byin gyis legs brlabs shing / /da lta mdo sngags bstan pa'i bdag po ni/ /mtshungs med dpal ldan bla ma zhugs pa'i gnas/ /byang chub shing gi nags khrod dag tu sbyar/ /ces dri ba mdzad pa po rang gi cha nas gya tshom du bris pa min par tshul de dag la legs par rtogs nas bris so zhes gsungs pa khungs dang shin tu 'brel te/ gang thig 'jig rten thams cad kyis/ /rang la tshad mar byed 'dod na/ /de yi gzhung 'di (43ba〉pegs brtags te/ /gnyen po skyed la 'bad de sgrubs/ /zhes dang / mkhas 'jug las/ des na blo gros ldan pa yis/ /dang po slob dpon mkhas bsten te/ /phyis nas rang gis legs brtags na/ /dri za'i dbang po lta bur 'gyur/ /zhes—463—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)dang / byang ta dben gyis/ gzugs lha ru shes pa'i sngags pa sla/ phya g.yang du khugs pa'i bon po sla/ /'khrul rtsis la sbyangs pa'i rten 'brel sla/ /gros gang byasahrūb pa'i gtso bo sla/ /sman 'tsho byed shesapa'i lha rje sla/ /mdzangs dpa' ngar 'dzom pa'i stag shar sla/ /sgo khrel lcag yod pa'i dman shar sla/ /shes rig pa rgyas pa'i byis pa sla/ /gzhan khag 'khrur yod pa'i mdun gros sla/ /tshong bod 'brog 'cham pa'i gnas po sla/ /blo shes rab can la gang yang sla/ /zhes pa'i don ltar thog ma'i slob dpon 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ku mā glo ni/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa gangs ri thod dkar du bzhugs skabs paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra zhal gzigs nas/ nga'i snying thig 'di don 'dus shing go sla ba'i nying khur bsdus pa zhig tu rtsoms/ khyod la chos 'di ston pa'i bla ma ku mā ra dwa dza'i skye ba da lta'i slob ma gzhen nu sangs rgyas 'di yin pas de la ston/ de nas kyang sna la a yig gis mtshan pa'i ku mu'i ming can bdun 'byung bar lung bstan pa'i ku mā'i ming can zhig tu/ mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi yon tan gyi rnam 'phrul chos rgyal dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis ngos 'dzin mdzad pas gtsug lag khang 'di la sbyangs stobs kyang phul du phyin pa'o/ /'dren mchog thub pa'i dbang po 'khrungs lo rje btsun sa skya pa sa 'brug /stod lung pa jo bo chen po tshul khrims shing glang / nil pa paṇ+ḍita chu byi/ bod rgyal po'i zhal chems su grags pa'i 'dasalo mang ba'i phyogs dang (44na)gi ba'i phyogs thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston me rta/ stag tshang lo lo chen sa byi/ tsan dan jo bo'i lo rgyus sogs mang du byung yang / mkhas grub nor bzang ba dang zhal lung gi dgongs pa 'khrul bral gyi gtan rtsis lcags sprer sku bltams pa 'di nyid dpyad bzod bla na med pa yin no/ /skyid shod nyang bran pha bong kha 'di chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos/ ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i sngon 'gro sa gzhi byin gyis rlob par rigs gsum mgon po'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i gnas yin par ma zad/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las/ bod kyi yul dang de bzhin du/ /ma la wa dang pu waṃ sogs/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul yin no/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang dpal 'khor lo sdom —464

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ 'dapa'i rgyud nyung ngu las/ rnal 'byor ma yi sa dang gnas/ /he ru ka dpal rgyu yan lag /thams cad brtan g.yo'i bdag nyid can/ /gnas ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /de bzhin nye gnas dri ma med/ /zhing 'dir 'od byed shes par bya/ /nye ba'i zhing ni 'od 'phro ba/ /byu do ha ni mngon gyur nyid/ /nye ba'i ston do sbyang dka' ba/ /'dus pa ring du song ba yin/ /nye bar 'dus pa mi g.yo la/ /dur khrod legasapa'i blo gros nyid/ /nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin/ shwe he ru ka gzhung spyod pa'i/ /'di ni nang gi bdag nyid sa/ /pha rol phyin bcu sa rnams ni/ /rnal 'byor ma yi brda yi skad/ /mtho ris sa steng sa 'og tu/ /dpa' bo'i yan lag brtan g.yo'i bdag /pū smir la sogs gang bstan pa/ /phyi nang bdag nyid can du gnas/ /zhes pa'i nang tshan/ gnas di khyi ko ṭi bod skad du lha mo mkhar zhes pa tsā ri/ de dang 'brel pa'i zhing tsā gong yin la/ nye ba'i gnas di khyi ko ṭi de pha bong kha dang / nye (44ba tha'i zhing lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang nye 'khor gyi grong khyer dang bcas pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan/ pha bong kha'i rgyab ri ngal po che phyi gdugs rang byon gyi rnam pa la nang 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang du yod cing / pha bong kha rang gi shar gyi brag 'og tu dbang phyug gi rten rang byon shin tu gsal/ lha sa'i bdud rtsi ma'i chu rgyun gyi chu mig 'di lha mo u ma'i gsang gnas kyi mtshon byed du yod pa 'di ma shes par/ sa bon ma btab kyang myu gu rang babs su 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa 'gas 'phya ba ni rang nyid gsal bar ston pa'i me long ngo / /nye ba'i gnas khyad 'phags de sngon gyi dam pa grangs med pas byin gyis brlabs shing / rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag mkhas pa dang grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba/mkhon rigs 'jam dbyangs dpa' bo dpal 'byor lhun grub chos kyi khrir zhabs pad 'god bzhin pa'i dus su phyogs bral gyi rna lung du dri tshig gi rgyan sdud pa'i don du nges so/ /smras pa/ ma la ya las 'ongs pa'i dri bsung gis/ /mi bzad tsha gdung ma lus 'joms pa ltar/ /legs bshad ke ta ka yis gtsug lag gi /don mang rnyog pa kun gsal drung ba(par byas/ /phul byung mkhyen dpyod ha lu byu yis/ /gtsug lag 'bod grogs gzugs dang snang brnyan dag /so —465

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (23)sor phyed kyang mkhas rlom spre tshogs kyis/ /rtogs pa'i skal ba phra phyir gsal bar bshad/ /mkhas dbang dri tshig dar gyi srad bu la/ /legs bshad nor bu brgyus pa'i do shal 'di/ /blo gros lang tsho rgyas pa'i zur mig can/ /ka shi mdzes dga'i tshogs rnams da gyon cig /ces bya ba ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /zhar byung 'phan yul drug brgya ba'i rtsis rig smra ba nang so bstan 'dzin gyis ra sa 'phrul snang gi rtsis pa rnams la dri ba bzhi btang ba'i dris lan khag /dri ba dang po'i dris lan/zhar byung phan yul drug brgya ba'i rtsis rig smra ba nang so bstan 'dzin gyis (45na)ra sa 'phrul snang gi rtsis pa rnams la dri ba bzhi btang 'dug pa'i/ dang po'i dri tshig ni/ su sti/ dge legs kun gyi 'byung gnas zas gtsang sras/ /dam chos gtam la 'jigs med 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /mgon de'i rnam 'phrul rig ldan grags pa sogs/ /zol med dad pa'i sgo nas phyag btsal te/ /dag pa'i yul mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi yi/ /nang tshan mchog gyur ra sa 'phrul snang nas/ /dpal ldan dus 'khor ri mo'i las tshul dang / /gtsug lag rig pa'i dpal mnga' brgya dga'i mtshan/ /mkhas pa'i tshul 'dzin khyod la 'di skad zhu/ /de yang dpal ldan bsdus pa'i rgyud rgyal las/ lo 'di nas ni drug brgya'i lo yis bsal bar mi bdag grags pa sham+bha la zhes bya bar 'byung / /zhes gsungs pas na/'di nas zhes pa'i lo ngos gang nas 'dzin/ /ston mchog mnyam med shākya seng ge des/ /dus 'khor chos gsungs dus nas 'dzin mod kyang / /dgung lo so drug dus su gsungs pa dang / /brgyad cu'i dus —466

rtsis skar nag las brtsams pa'i dris lan/ (wa)la gsungs par bzhed pa gnyis/ / brgyad cur gsungs pa ba ched na rtsa rgyud las/ /bya rgod phung po'i ri chen por/ /theg pa chen po bla na med/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bstan/ /de nas gcig tu mchod rten cher/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /dam pa dang po dpal ldan rgyud/ /dpyid zla 'bring po'i nya la gsungs/ /'di ltar lugs na so drug dus su gsungs/ /zhes pa'i lung don 'di dang mi 'gal lam/ /so drug dus su gsungs par khyed bzhes na/ /de nas drug brgya 'das rjes rigs ldan ni/ /grags pa 'byon 'gyur mngon sum lung (45ba tha stan ni/ /lo
